items.desc: About Peraton Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure. Program Overview Wide-scope strategic U.S. Army mission support for expeditionary OCONUS joint task force mission. Key roles include strategic analysis, exercise planning, IT support, logistical planning, financial analysis, medical operations, public affairs, and executive administration. About The Role Peraton is hiring an experienced Data Science and Visualization Support Analyst for our Southern European Task Force-Africa (SETAF-AF) Strategic Mission Support program. Location: Vicenza, Italy (Relocation is available, and the position can be accompanied) This position is based in Vicenza, Italy and will require extensive, short-notice business travel to the African continent or other global locations. Job Description : This role will support SETAF-AF in the planning and execution of U.S. Africa Command (USAFRICOM) directed data science, analytics, and visualization initiatives. As an embedded Data Science and Visualization Support Analyst , you will serve as a key technical leader driving the command's data-driven transformation efforts. In this role, you will: Design, deploy, and sustain advanced data visualization solutions, develop automated data pipelines, conduct operational analyses, and create modeling and simulation tools that enhance decision-making across the command. You will collaborate with operational staff, intelligence professionals, logisticians, and planners to deliver innovative technical solutions that improve readiness, operational effectiveness, and strategic outcomes. Key Responsibilities Include: Data-Driven Execution and Visualization Design, develop, deploy, and maintain interactive dashboard suites across multiple digital platforms. Visualize readiness, intelligence, logistics, and operational performance metrics. Integrate authoritative data sources from across the enterprise. Develop and implement automated data pipelines that eliminate manual processes and enable near real-time reporting. Collaborate with staff directorates including G-2, G-3, and G-4 to identify and deliver data-driven solutions. Kill Chain Analysis and Operationalization Conduct functional analyses of the command's operational kill chain (F2T2EA). Develop simulation and analytical models to identify operational bottlenecks and process inefficiencies. Create dynamic visualizations that provide real-time status monitoring and operational decision support. Assess and model the impacts of new technologies and process improvements on mission effectiveness. Modeling, Simulation, and Staff Integration Support planning efforts within the Joint Planning Process (JPP). Participate in exercises, operational planning events, and wargaming activities. Design, build, and operate custom analytical tools to support operational decision-making. Develop and maintain agent-based models and complex adaptive systems addressing challenges related to: Logistics Force projection Non-Combatant Evacuation Operations (NEO) Operational readiness Technology Prototyping and Deployment Rapidly prototype and field AI/ML, analytics, and visualization solutions. Develop and maintain API integrations and database connectivity solutions. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative applications to mission requirements. Deliver training, coaching, and technical guidance to command personnel on data literacy and analytical tools. Promote a culture of data-driven decision-making across the organization. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Operations Research, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline, and a minimum of ten (10) years of experience delivering technical and analytical solutions in operational environments. Minimum of five (5) years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and fielding technical capabilities, such as dashboards, data platforms, analytical tools, simulation models, or decision-support systems, that were adopted and actively utilized by military organizations. Kanske använder du redan AI-verktyg i ditt arbete eller vill utforska möjligheterna tillsammans med oss. Låter det intressant? Välkommen med din ansökan! Vi berättar gärna mer om Knowit Datalytics och möjligheterna hos oss. Vi är cirka 2 100 kollegor i Sverige inklusive Polen med ytterligare 1 500 kollegor i Norge, Finland, Danmark, Tyskland och Serbien. We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

FAO’s commitment to environmental sustainability is integral to our strategic objectives and operations. The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) contributes to the achievement of the 2030 Agenda through FAO Strategic Framework by supporting the transformation to MORE efficient, inclusive, resilient and sustainable agrifood systems, for better production , better nutrition , a better environment, and a better life , leaving no one behind. Organizational Setting The Statistics Division (ESS) develops and advocates for the implementation of methodologies and standards for data collection, validation, processing and analysis, in the food and agriculture statistics domains. In these statistical domains, it also plays a key role in the compilation, processing and dissemination of internationally comparable data, and provides essential capacity building in support of member countries. The Division also disseminates publications, working papers and statistical yearbooks, that cover agriculture and food security statistics, including prices, investments, production, trade and agri-environmental statistical data. Finally, as the ESS Director also plays the role of FAO Chief Statistician, the Division supports the various functions of the Chief Statistician, that is to ensure stronger governance of FAO's data and statistical system, foster consistency of FAO's Data and Statistical programme within the Strategic Framework, ensure statistical excellence through the implementation of statistical standards and quality assurance mechanisms, and position FAO's presence in data and statistical discussions at global level. The incumbent will work for the Methodological Innovation Team within the Statistics Division, which aims to ensure that the Organization produces and disseminates high-quality data and statistics related to its mandate. The team leads the development, testing and maintenance of statistical methods and standards across the whole statistical production cycle (from data acquisition and editing to estimation, validation, compilation and preparation for dissemination) in the corporate Statistical Working System (SWS). It designs and pilots methodological innovations such as model-based estimation, statistical learning, and integration of big data and other non-conventional sources establishing reproducible workflows, metadata and quality assurance procedures to close data gaps and produce timely, policy-relevant indicators. In this light, the team continuously reviews and strengthens FAO's core statistical processes within the corporate Statistical Working System and contributes to the implementation of FAO's statistical standards, including the dissemination of statistical classifications in a Link Open Data environment. The SWS is a corporate system that supports data collection, processing and validation, metadata management, and quality assessment of FAO's main statistical domains in line with the Generic Statistical Business Process Model. The position is located in the Statistics Division (ESS) at FAO headquarters in Rome, Italy. Reporting Lines The Statistician (Statistical Working System) reports to the Senior Statistician, leader of the ESS Methodological Innovation Team, under the overall guidance of the Director of ESS. items.desc: About Us We are a stealth startup building the AI platform for luxury hotels: a live digital twin of the whole hotel, with an AI agent personalising every room. We work alongside technology leaders in AI and with luxury hospitality brands. Our working prototype is a live twin of a luxury hotel room, rendered in real time and driven by a GPU-based building simulation. Now we take it from one room to a whole hotel. About the role Reports to: Head of Engineering A digital twin is only as good as its connection to the real building. As Integrations & Infrastructure Engineer, you will connect our platform to hotel systems (property management, building management, IoT sensors, access control) and run the GPU infrastructure the twin and the agents depend on. You work across both tracks. Responsibilities - Integrate with property management systems such as Oracle OPERA Cloud, Mews and Cloudbeds for reservations, guest profiles and room status. - Integrate with building management and room controls over BACnet, KNX, Modbus and MQTT: HVAC, lighting, blinds and sensors. - Build the pipeline from sensors to the twin's live state, including time-series storage and event streams. - Run GPU infrastructure for Omniverse rendering, streaming and model serving: provisioning, scaling and cost control on cloud GPUs. - Own CI/CD, monitoring, alerting and secrets, and keep demos and pilots up. - Secure it: network separation for building systems, UK GDPR for guest data, and payment-data rules where they apply. Qualifications - 3+ years in backend, platform, DevOps or integration engineering. - Docker, Kubernetes or similar, Terraform or equivalent, Linux and networking. - Experience integrating third-party enterprise APIs and messy real-world systems. - Python or Go, and SQL. - Building automation and IoT protocols (BACnet, KNX, Modbus, MQTT, Matter) are a big advantage. - Hospitality systems (OPERA, Mews, Salto, ASSA ABLOY), GPU cluster operations, WebRTC infrastructure (TURN, STUN) or edge computing are a strong plus. The details - Day rate: £500 to £700 per day. - Location: in person, five days a week, at our office in central London. - Contract: 6 months, full-time, as a contractor or on a fixed-term contract. Strong performers can convert to a permanent role with equity. Contracts are with Ellie Technologies Ltd. - IR35: Ellie Technologies Ltd is a small company, so contractors working through their own limited company assess their own IR35 status. A fixed-term employment contract on payroll is also available. - Start: as soon as possible. We are interviewing now. - Right to work: you need the existing right to work in the UK. We cannot sponsor visas for these roles. - Process: a 20-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical session, then an offer. We aim to decide within a week of your application. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from every background. Pay: £500.00-£700.00 per day Work Location: In person

items.desc: Vil du bruke teknologi, data og AI til å forme fremtidens industri og verdikjeder? I Accenture Supply Chain & Engineering jobber vi med hele verdikjeden: fra hvordan materialer kjøpes inn og leveranser planlegges, til hvordan produkter og tekniske løsninger utvikles, fabrikker drives og kritisk utstyr vedlikeholdes. Vi kombinerer supply chain, engineering, industriell teknologi, data og AI for å løse reelle utfordringer i noen av Norges mest komplekse virksomheter. Som graduate blir du en del av tverrfaglige team fra dag én. Du jobber sammen med konsulenter, ingeniører, teknologer, data- og AI-spesialister og endringsledere, og er med hele veien fra analyse og design til implementering og forbedring i praksis. Supply Chain & Engineering er en ny, sammenslått avdeling med over 65 kolleger i Oslo og Stavanger. Vi er i vekst, og som graduate får du være med å forme hvordan vi jobber, utvikler oss og vinner sammen. Hvorfor Supply Chain & Engineering? Fordi de mest interessante problemene ikke stopper ved én funksjon. Vi ser helheten, fra innkjøp og planlegging via design og produksjon til levering og drift. Det gir deg mulighet til å jobbe med både forretningsprosesser og teknologien, dataene og ingeniørmiljøene som får verdikjeden til å fungere. Hva kan du jobbe med hos oss? Planlegging, leveranse og ettermarked: forbedre hvordan virksomheter planlegger etterspørsel og kapasitet, styrer lager og logistikk, leverer til kundene og følger opp service og ettermarked, i økende grad støttet av AI og autonom planlegging. Innkjøp og leverandørstyring: utvikle strategisk innkjøp, styrke samarbeidet med leverandører, håndtere leverandørrisiko og modernisere innkjøpsprosesser og kontrakter. SAP ERP og digitale planleggingsplattformer: være med å innføre og ta i bruk løsninger som SAP, o9, Kinaxis og Blue Yonder, slik at bedre beslutninger tas på tvers av hele verdikjeden. Smart produksjon og Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES): digitalisere og forbedre produksjon, kvalitet, flyt og drift på produksjonsgulvet. Digital engineering, PLM og vedlikehold: koble produkt-, engineering- og anleggsdata gjennom hele livsløpet, og forbedre pålitelighet og arbeidsprosesser for kritisk utstyr og kritiske anlegg. Data, AI og digitale tvillinger: bruke data, modeller og AI til bedre planlegging, beslutningsstøtte og operasjonell forbedring, også ved å koble industrielle systemer og virksomhetsplattformer på en sikker måte. Hva slags profiler ser vi etter? Du trenger ikke å kunne alt fra før, det vi er mest opptatt av at du er analytisk, nysgjerrig og har et ønske om å lære. Du vil gjerne forstå hvordan komplekse verdikjeder og virksomheter fungerer, og hvordan teknologi kan være med på å gjøre dem bedre. I tillegg ønsker vi gjerne at: Du fullfører mastergraden våren 2027, eller er nyutdannet. Du har sterke faglige resultater og en strukturert, analytisk tilnærming. Du liker å løse problemer i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi og forretning. Du trives i tverrfaglige team og er god til å gjøre komplekse problemstillinger forståelige. Du snakker og skriver norsk og engelsk flytende. Du studerer gjerne Industriell økonomi, logistikk og supply chain, økonomi og finans, ingeniørfag, kybernetikk og automasjon, maskinfag, produksjon, energi, informatikk, data science, optimering, teknologi eller tilsvarende. Du trenger ikke ha en ingeniørbakgrunn, selv om avdelingen har engineering i navnet. Mange av oss har bakgrunn fra økonomi, logistikk og supply chain. Stilingen har oppstart august 2027. Hva får du hos oss? Reelle kundeprosjekter fra dag én, tett på virksomhetene og verdikjedene som skal forbedres. Mulighet til å utforske en bred faglig plattform før du velger en tydelig spesialisering. Et sterkt globalt fagmiljø innen supply chain, innkjøp, engineering, produksjon, data og AI. Læring gjennom prosjektarbeid, kurs, sertifiseringer og faglige nettverk. Et stort graduate-kull, sosiale aktiviteter og tett oppfølging fra din egen People Lead. Gode karrieremuligheter, betalt overtid og helseforsikring. Hvordan søker du? Last opp følgende dokumenter samlet under "Resume/CV": Søknadsbrev CV Vitnemål fra videregående Karakterutskrift fra høyere utdanning Vi vurderer kun søknader der alle dokumentene er lastet opp. Søknadsfrist: Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende Spørsmål? Kontakt studentsupport.NO@accenture.com Er du klar for å bruke det du har lært til å forbedre hvordan produkter utvikles, verdikjeder planlegges og industrielle virksomheter drives? Smartpush compte plus de 300 clients, avec un taux de churn inférieur à 1 %. Rejoindre Smartpush, c'est travailler sur des sujets d'IA agentique à fort enjeu technique et réglementaire, avec des cas d'usage concrets en production. Description du poste Contexte Smartpush développe alchimia, un OS agentique souverain pour les secteurs régulés (banque, assurance, cabinets). Vous rejoignez l'équipe qui conçoit la plateforme : orchestration d'agents IA, intégration de LLMs (dont Mistral), connexion aux SI existants de nos clients, le tout avec des données hébergées en France et conformes à l'IA Act et au RGPD. L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Laboratoire d'analyse et d'architecture des systèmes Type de Contrat Convention de stage Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 31031 TOULOUSE Durée du contrat 5 mois Date d'Embauche 01/02/2027 Postuler Date limite de candidature : samedi 5 décembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Title: Master 2 Internship - Runtime Monitors of Neural Network in Aerospace Supervisors: Jérémie Guiochet (https://homepages.laas.fr/guiochet) Profile: Computer Science, AI Level: Master 2 (MSc) Duration: 5–6 months Location: LAAS-CNRS, Toulouse, France (https://www.laas.fr) Salary: ~€600/month Keywords: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Generation, Safety Monitoring Technologies: Python, AI Frameworks Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being used in safety-critical applications, such as autonomous vehicles and surgical robotics. In these systems, perception tasks largely rely on deep neural networks (DNNs). However, the use of these components remains challenging because their behavior cannot be fully guaranteed, raising concerns about reliability and safety. Runtime monitoring mechanisms are among the promising approaches to address these limitations. Their purpose is to continuously monitor neural network behavior in order to detect or prevent potential errors. Two main families of monitors can be distinguished: rule-based monitors, which verify whether predefined safety properties are satisfied, and data-driven monitors, which are themselves developed through machine learning, often using neural networks. Evaluating the performance of these monitors is essential, particularly in situations where the main neural network produces incorrect predictions. This raises several important questions: What data should be used to evaluate these monitors? How should such data be collected, generated, and selected? How can the dataset cover both nominal and abnormal operating conditions? The objective of this internship is to investigate data generation and selection strategies for monitor evaluation and to develop a framework for testing and evaluating one or more monitoring mechanisms proposed by the AI research community. The internship will be conducted as part of an aviation-related case study, focusing on runway detection during aircraft landing approaches. It builds on the LARD (Landing Approach for Runway Detection) tool and dataset, which we have extended into Lardon-x, a tool currently under development at ANITI and LAAS-CNRS. Our Mission We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK. About The Role Our Data Science team focuses on the development of machine learning and AI solutions, to solve business problems and deliver actionable insights. We are a talented, collaborative and enthusiastic group, who use our expertise to make sense of complex data, working in close collaboration with our business partners. This role will primarily focus on critical business challenges in underwriting; developing and maintaining the models used to make customer lending decisions. We are interested in candidates who have a deep grounding in statistics and experience of Model Risk Management. Experience of working with Open Banking or Credit Bureau data is also welcomed. What you’ll do Develop and maintain the models used by our key underwriting programs, Explore and evaluate data using advanced feature generation and categorisation techniques, in order to stay at the forefront of innovation. Consult on complex statistical test design, to efficiently learn our way into new areas of the market. Use a combination of business acumen, coding and statistical skills to navigate large amounts of data and extract actionable solutions, working cross-functionally to support key business initiatives and drive sustainable growth. What we’re looking for A strong understanding of probability, statistics, machine learning, feature extraction and familiarity with large data set manipulation. Familiarity with Open Banking or Credit Bureau data. Experience in producing reliable and maintainable code in Python, with an ability to adapt to new languages and technologies. Experience of Model Risk Management; technical documentation, coding best practices, the importance of validation and ongoing monitoring. Natural curiosity and proactive engagement with all areas of the business, with a desire to ask questions, challenge the status-quo and identify where Data Science can add value. items.desc: Bij incidenten kan het achterhalen van de oorzaak veel tijd kosten. In deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe AI beheerders kan ondersteunen bij het uitvoeren van een Root Cause Analysis. Preventief beheer is een belangrijk uitgangspunt, maar in sommige gevallen is een incident onvermijdelijk. Door de grote hoeveelheid data uit de monitoringsystemen kan het uitvoeren van een Root Cause Analysis na een incident veel tijd in beslag nemen. AI biedt tegenwoordig mogelijkheden om beheerders hierbij te ondersteunen. AI-systemen kunnen patronen herkennen in grote datasets, relaties leggen tussen gebeurtenissen en hypotheses formuleren over mogelijke oorzaken van incidenten. Het is echter nog onvoldoende duidelijk in hoeverre AI in staat is om op basis van de beschikbare monitoringgegevens betrouwbare en onderbouwde ondersteuning te bieden bij een Root Cause Analysis (RCA) binnen een beheeromgeving. De opdracht Onderzoek of en hoe AI kan worden ingezet om beheerders te ondersteunen bij het uitvoeren van een Root Cause Analysis na een incident. Onderzoek daarbij welke AI-technieken geschikt zijn om de beschikbare monitoringgegevens te analyseren. Ontwerp op basis hiervan een proof of concept en onderzoek in hoeverre deze: incidentgerelateerde monitoringgegevens kan interpreteren; mogelijke oorzaken van een storing kan identificeren; inzichtelijk kan maken waarop mogelijke oorzaken zijn gebaseerd; beheerders kan ondersteunen bij incidentanalyse. Over Info Support Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst. De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan. Om te zorgen dat alle medewerkers altijd op de hoogte kunnen zijn van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen beschikt Info Support over een inhouse IT Academy waar graag wordt voldaan aan de honger naar meer of andere kennis en vaardigheden. Om deze opdracht te kunnen doen is B2-taalvaardigheid in het Nederlands vereist.

items.desc: We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity. From our London HQ, we unite world-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution - because the best ideas take time to evolve. Together we’re building a world-class platform to amplify our teams’ most powerful ideas. Join a research team where curiosity meets scale. You’ll investigate foundational questions, uncover market insights and push the boundaries of what's possible - all with the support of near-limitless compute and world-class peers. Take the next step in your career. The role 10-week summer programme (21st June - 27th August 2027) 09:00-17:30 working hours Based in Central London Over the course of 10 weeks, G-Research Summer Research Programme interns gain a unique insight into life as a Data Science practitioner at a leading quantitative research firm. Our business is to predict the future of financial markets, applying scientific techniques to find patterns in large, noisy and rapidly changing datasets. Our mission as a Data Science team is to help discover, enrich and analyse data sources that will drive tomorrow’s research initiatives. In this role, you will apply your knowledge to support the exploration, enrichment and even creation of new datasets for research. You will use your knowledge of data blending, statistical analysis and machine learning methods to help scale and automate the way we analyse, validate and visualise diverse data sources; and you will help build tooling to enable data science initiatives across the company. This is a team at the forefront of the company’s data strategy, responsible for finding solutions to some of the many important data challenges within the firm, meaning you will have a unique opportunity to make an impact from the beginning. The successful candidate will be comfortable working within a multi-disciplinary team, collaborating with industry leading data scientists and financial experts, developing solutions that adapt to a rapidly changing data landscape. items.desc: De volgende stap in de ontwikkeling van social companions ligt in visuele emotieherkenning. Door gezichtsuitdrukkingen te analyseren met AI-modellen onderzoek je hoe een systeem zijn gedrag realtime kan aanpassen aan de gemoedstoestand van de gebruiker. Het resultaat is een prototype dat laat zien hoe empathie ook digitaal vorm kan krijgen. Het ValleiLab van de Christelijke Hogeschool Ede (CHE) werkt samen met Info Support aan manieren om technologie betekenisvoller te maken in de zorg. In dit lab komen studenten, zorgprofessionals en technologische innovaties samen om te onderzoeken hoe digitalisering kan bijdragen aan mensgerichte zorg. Vanuit deze samenwerking is de interesse ontstaan in de rol van social companions, digitale gesprekspartners die emoties herkennen en daar op een natuurlijke manier op reageren. De ontwikkeling van deze social companions laat zien hoe mens-machine-interactie verandert. Waar chatbots vroeger vooral simpele vragen beantwoordden, richten moderne systemen zich op het aangaan van een persoonlijke band met gebruikers. Toch blijft een belangrijk aspect vaak achter: het vermogen om de emotionele signalen van een gebruiker te begrijpen en mee te nemen in het gesprek. Klassieke chatbots reageren nog volledig tekstgebaseerd en hoewel moderne social agents zoals ChatGPT pogingen doen om de toon van een gesprekspartner te spiegelen, lukt het ze nog niet om de emotionele staat van de gebruiker mee te nemen in het gesprek. Om de stap te maken van chatbot naar social companion is het essentieel om emoties te kunnen herkennen. Dit kan bijvoorbeeld door gezichtsuitdrukkingen te analyseren en deze informatie te gebruiken om gesprekken persoonlijker en empathischer te maken. In hoeverre kan emotieherkenning op basis van beeld geïntegreerd worden in een social companion? De opdracht Onderzoek hoe je emoties kunt herkennen op basis van visuele input en hoe je deze informatie inzet binnen een social companion. Breng in kaart welke definities van emotie relevant zijn en welke AI-modellen geschikt zijn om emoties te identificeren. Ontwerp en bouw vervolgens een Proof of Concept (PoC) van een social companion die realtime visuele signalen verwerkt en zijn gedrag daarop aanpast. Zo laat je zien hoe visuele emotieherkenning kan bijdragen aan een persoonlijkere en empathischere interactie tussen mens en machine. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst. De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan. Om te zorgen dat alle medewerkers altijd op de hoogte kunnen zijn van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen beschikt Info Support over een inhouse IT Academy waar graag wordt voldaan aan de honger naar meer of andere kennis en vaardigheden. items.desc: AI-native platforms create new opportunities for customers and Managed Services providers to innovate together. However, continuous innovation also requires clear agreements on collaboration, decision-making and shared responsibilities. This master’s thesis explores how existing co-creation frameworks can support this collaboration within AI-native platform ecosystems. Research on innovation ecosystems shows that value creation increasingly takes place through collaboration between multiple parties. Existing research on co-creation provides models and approaches for structuring such collaboration, including joint value creation, facilitation and different phases of collaborative development. At the same time, research on AI-based software systems shows that these systems introduce additional challenges related to lifecycle management and governance. AI-based systems may require continuous monitoring and adaptation, while governance responsibilities extend across design, development and operations and involve multiple stakeholders. However, it remains unclear how existing co-creation approaches can be applied to collaboration between customers and Managed Services providers within AI-native platform environments. In particular, it is not yet clear how well existing approaches describe how responsibilities for continuous experimentation, AI governance, decision-making, and platform development should be distributed in this context. Therefore, existing co-creation frameworks need to be evaluated to determine what adaptations are required for AI-native platform services. The Assignment Research question: How can existing co-creation frameworks be adapted to support continuous innovation between customers and Managed Services providers within AI-native platform ecosystems? You will first conduct a literature review of existing co-creation frameworks and innovation ecosystem frameworks. In doing so, you will identify the principles used to organize collaboration and value creation. You will then investigate the characteristics of AI-native platform services and the challenges they introduce for collaboration between customers and Managed Services providers. Through interviews with stakeholders and the analysis of one or more Managed Services cases, you will examine the extent to which existing co-creation approaches address these requirements. You will also identify the areas in which adaptations are needed. Based on these findings, you will adapt an existing co-creation framework into a structured approach for AI-native platform services. The framework should clarify how customers and Managed Services providers collaborate in areas such as joint decision-making, experimentation, governance, ownership and continuous platform development. The proposed framework will be evaluated with relevant experts. items.desc: A clear understanding of requirements is essential for effective software engineering. As AI becomes more integrated into development workflows, its ability to support developers in understanding and clarifying requirements becomes increasingly important. This master’s thesis explores how context-driven AI can help developers identify missing information and ask relevant questions before development begins. Artificial Intelligence is increasingly integrated into software engineering and DevOps workflows. However, the effectiveness of AI-assisted development is often limited by incomplete, ambiguous, or poorly specified requirements. Service requests, change requests and development tasks frequently lack essential contextual information, forcing developers and AI systems to make assumptions. Incorrect assumptions can result in rework, reduced software quality, increased development effort and lower trust in AI-assisted workflows. Although research has explored requirements elicitation and clarification techniques, it remains unclear how AI-driven questioning strategies can systematically improve requirement completeness and reduce downstream rework in practical software engineering environments. The challenge is to determine how AI systems can proactively identify missing information and help developers ask the most relevant clarification questions based on the type and context of a request. The Assignment Your task is to explore to what extent context-driven AI can be used to effectively guide developers in asking relevant questions and clarifying requirements. Previous research has investigated the use of LLMs for detecting and explaining ambiguities in software requirements, showing that contextual information and relevant examples can improve ambiguity detection. More recent work has also explored LLM-driven clarification and conversational requirements elicitation, but effectively determining which clarification questions should be asked based on the context of a development request remains an active research area. Volledig geautomatiseerde uitrol brengt echter risico’s met zich mee, omdat patches invloed kunnen hebben op applicaties, configuraties en afhankelijkheden. De beoordeling vooraf en validatie na afloop vragen daardoor nog om handmatige controles en specialistische kennis. Dit vertraagt het patchproces. De uitdaging is om een herhaalbare en aantoonbaar betrouwbare aanpak te ontwikkelen waarmee relevante patchinformatie kan worden geïnterpreteerd, passende controles kunnen worden geselecteerd en de technische toestand na installatie automatisch kan worden beoordeeld. Daarbij is nog onvoldoende duidelijk welke onderdelen met bestaande automatisering kunnen worden opgelost en waar technieken zoals taalmodellen aanvullende waarde bieden. De opdracht Onderzoek hoe de beoordeling en validatie van OS-patches binnen een afgebakende beheeromgeving betrouwbaar kunnen worden geautomatiseerd. Breng in kaart welke beslissingen nu nog handmatig worden genomen, op welke informatie die beslissingen berusten en aan welke criteria een veilige uitrol en een geslaagde installatie moeten voldoen. Vergelijk bestaande patch-, test- en validatiemethoden en bepaal welke aanpak past, van regelgebaseerde automatisering en technische tests tot taalmodellen. Ontwerp een aanpak en toon de toepasbaarheid aan met een proof of concept voor één afgebakend platform, waarmee je onderbouwd kunt rapporteren of een patch veilig is uitgerold. Evalueer de PoC aan de hand van zelf gekozen, meetbare criteria en beschrijf de voorwaarden waaronder verdere automatisering verantwoord is. Laat daarbij zien of en waar AI iets toevoegt ten opzichte van traditionele automatisering. Over Info Support Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst. De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan. Om te zorgen dat alle medewerkers altijd op de hoogte kunnen zijn van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen beschikt Info Support over een inhouse IT Academy waar graag wordt voldaan aan de honger naar meer of andere kennis en vaardigheden. Om deze opdracht te kunnen doen is B2-taalvaardigheid in het Nederlands vereist.

A IA vai acabar com boa parte disso. A questão é quem faz essa mudança, e se a faz bem. Nós achamos que tem de ser feita por engenheiros. Quem somos A Seekers é uma consultora de IA aplicada para AECO e Energia. Entramos em empresas de construção, projecto e energia, percebemos como o trabalho se faz de facto, e construímos os sistemas de automação e IA que devolvem os engenheiros à engenharia. O que já fizemos está em seekers.global. O que vais fazer Numa semana estás numa empresa de construção a perceber porque é que os autos de medição levam três semanas a chegar à facturação. Na seguinte estás a construir o sistema que os faz chegar em três dias. Noutra estás numa empresa de energia a juntar numa só plataforma o que hoje vive em dez folhas de cálculo. Na prática, vais: Acompanhar diagnósticos com directores de obra, equipas técnicas e financeiras Transformar o que ouves em especificações claras do que é preciso construir Construir automações e agentes de IA com n8n, Claude e Python Apresentar o que construíste aos clientes, e melhorá-lo com o que te dizem Não é para quem só quer programar, nem para quem só quer estar com clientes. É para quem quer as duas coisas. Com quem trabalhas Directamente com o fundador, mestre em engenharia de estruturas, com percurso comercial sénior na Hilti e na Autodesk. Vais às reuniões de cliente com ele desde o primeiro mês. Aprendes a construir e aprendes a conduzir uma conversa com quem decide. Provavelmente és tu se És engenheiro. Civil de preferência. Electrotécnica, Mecânica, Energia, Ambiente ou Engenharia e Gestão Industrial também, se a tua tese, o teu estágio ou o teu trabalho passou por construção ou energia Programas, nem que seja um pouco. Python, Dynamo, Grasshopper, VBA no Excel, um script para a tese. O que conta é já teres automatizado alguma coisa que fazias à mão Explicas uma coisa técnica a quem não é técnico, sem o fazer sentir-se ignorante Quando não sabes, dizes. E depois vais aprender Não precisas de ser recém-formado. Se já passaste uns anos em obra ou num gabinete e sentes que a tua engenharia está a ser gasta em tarefas que uma máquina devia fazer, este estágio foi pensado para ti. Estás lá fora e a pensar voltar? Se trabalhas no estrangeiro há pelo menos um ano, também podes entrar por esta via. Sabemos que a bolsa não compete com um salário em Paris, Londres ou Zurique. O que oferecemos é outra coisa: voltar, e voltar para a frente da mudança que o sector vai viver em Portugal. Como cresces No primeiro mês , aprendes as ferramentas e acompanhas clientes, ao lado do fundador. Ao fim de três meses , acompanhas um cliente no dia-a-dia. A partir daí , começas a desenhar as soluções, não só a construí-las. O estágio é o começo. Se correr bem para os dois lados, queremos que fiques. Não o prometemos antes de vermos trabalho, mas é para isso que este estágio existe. Quem já fez um estágio profissional apoiado pelo Estado só é elegível se tiver obtido, depois disso, uma qualificação de nível superior ou noutra área. Como te candidatas Candidata-te aqui, no LinkedIn, com o teu CV. Se tiveres algo que construíste, um script, um modelo Dynamo, uma automação, põe o link no CV. Não é obrigatório. Respondemos a todas as candidaturas em cinco dias úteis. Se fizer sentido, o passo seguinte é uma conversa de quinze minutos. Seekers. IA que devolve os engenheiros à engenharia.

items.desc: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. About The Role Callosum believes that the next generation of AI systems will emerge from models and hardware being optimised together. Today's model architectures have largely evolved around the capabilities of conventional GPUs, leaving significant opportunities unexplored as new accelerator architectures emerge. We are building infrastructure that allows models to be adapted to different computational substrates, rather than treating them as fixed algorithms that hardware must accommodate. This role explores how model architectures and inference algorithms can be adapted to exploit heterogeneous hardware, creating specialised variants with different trade-offs between capability, latency, and cost. You will investigate transformations spanning numerics, sparsity, model structure, memory, and execution, alongside new algorithms designed around emerging accelerators. A central part of the work is developing automated approaches to these adaptations and rigorous evaluations that establish when the resulting models offer meaningful advantages. What You'll Build Develop hardware-aware transformations that adapt models to different accelerator architectures and execution environments. Explore numerical, structural, and memory-related optimisations to create model variants with different capability, latency, and cost trade-offs. Investigate new inference algorithms, including speculative decoding, designed to exploit heterogeneous computational resources. Develop automated methods for discovering, characterising, and optimising hardware-specialised model variants. Build evaluation methods that measure model quality and establish the trade-offs introduced by hardware-aware adaptations. What Sets You Apart Deep understanding of modern LLM architectures, including attention mechanisms, model structure, and their implications for inference. Experience in model architecture research, efficient inference, or hardware-aware machine learning. Familiarity with a range of architectures, such as mixture-of-experts, diffusion, JEPA, or alternative attention mechanisms. Strong intuition for the interactions between model capability, numerical behaviour, memory requirements, and execution efficiency. Experience designing rigorous experiments to assess model quality, efficiency, and the effects of architectural modifications. items.desc: We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity. From our London HQ, we unite world-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution - because the best ideas take time to evolve. Together we’re building a world-class platform to amplify our teams’ most powerful ideas. Join a research team where curiosity meets scale. You’ll investigate foundational questions, uncover market insights and push the boundaries of what's possible - all with the support of near-limitless compute and world-class peers. Take the next step in your career. The role 10-week summer programme (21st June to 27th August 2027) 09:00-17:30 working hours Based in Central London Over the course of 10 weeks, G-Research Summer Research Programme interns gain a unique insight into life as a Machine Learning (ML) practitioner at a leading quantitative finance research firm. Our full-time ML researchers use a wide range of tools and techniques in an applied setting, putting their expertise to use in direct, production-ready applications with immediate results. They have access to vast computing resources and are limited only by their imagination. As an ML intern, you will have the opportunity to experience some of this as part of a 10-week programme working on a meaningful and challenging research project that demands the application of innovative yet pragmatic mathematical and computational analysis. You will be paired with a mentor who will supervise your work and provide ongoing feedback to help you improve and develop, as well as access to senior staff who are leaders in their fields. Your internship will culminate in a final presentation of your research ideas to senior management. Taking part in G-Research's Summer Internship Programme will give you an in-depth insight into our academic approach to the world of quantitative finance and allow you to explore the thriving city of London, while you get to know your fellow interns and colleagues through a full itinerary of fun social events. Top performers on the programme will be considered for full-time opportunities on completion of their studies. Who are we looking for? The ideal candidate will, at a minimum, have experience in the following areas: A post-graduate degree in Machine Learning or a related discipline, or commercial experience developing novel machine learning algorithms. We will also consider exceptional candidates with a proven record of success in online data science competitions, such as Kaggle. PhD level study is preferred Experience in one or more of deep learning, reinforcement learning, non-convex optimisation, Bayesian non-parametrics, NLP or approximate inference Excellent reasoning skills and mathematical ability are crucial: off-the-shelf methods don't always work with our data, so you will need to understand how to develop your own models Strong programming skills and experience working with Python, scikit-learn, SciPy, NumPy, Pandas and Jupyter Previous experience in finance is not required, although an interest in finance and the motivation to rapidly learn more is a prerequisite for working here. Why should you apply? Highly competitive compensation plus accommodation G-Research community with weekly intern activities Lunch provided (via Just Eat for Business) and dedicated barista bar 30 days’ annual leave pro-rated Informal dress code and excellent work/life balance Central London office close to 5 stations and 6 tube lines Location: London

About The Role Callosum believes that scaling heterogeneous AI infrastructure requires understanding how emerging hardware will behave as part of larger computational systems. Performance characteristics measured on individual accelerators rarely translate directly to distributed deployments, where networking, memory, and execution strategies introduce new constraints. We are developing simulation infrastructure that allows us to explore these interactions and evaluate future systems before they exist. This role advances the simulation and performance modelling tools that inform Callosum's hardware and infrastructure decisions. You will extend models that project device-level performance to rack-scale systems, explore alternative hardware configurations and execution strategies, and provide experimental environments for automated optimisation. The work also encompasses profiling, workload tracing, and performance instrumentation, connecting measurements from real systems to accurate and useful models of those we want to build. What You'll Build Extend our simulators to predict heterogeneous compute performance from individual accelerators to multi-rack deployments. Model networking, memory, and execution behaviour to evaluate alternative system architectures and configurations. Develop profiling, tracing, and workload capture tools that inform and validate simulation models. Extend simulation environments for rapid experimentation and automated optimisation of systems and algorithms. Characterise emerging accelerator architectures and translate hardware measurements into predictive models of system-level performance. What Sets You Apart Strong experience in systems simulation, performance modelling, or performance-critical systems software. Deep understanding of computer architecture, distributed systems, or high-performance computing. Familiarity with profiling, tracing, instrumentation, and methods for characterising computational workloads. Strong systems programming experience, ideally including C++ or Rust. Ability to reason about modelling accuracy, abstraction, and trade-offs between simulation fidelity and computational cost. What We Offer Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience Equity & Ownership Private healthcare We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world We work in person at our London office. L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Laboratoire d'analyse et d'architecture des systèmes Type de Contrat Convention de stage Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 31031 TOULOUSE Durée du contrat 5 mois Date d'Embauche 01/02/2027 Postuler Date limite de candidature : samedi 5 décembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Title: Master 2 Internship - Runtime Monitors of Neural Network in Aerospace Supervisors: Jérémie Guiochet (https://homepages.laas.fr/guiochet) Profile: Computer Science, AI Level: Master 2 (MSc) Duration: 5–6 months Location: LAAS-CNRS, Toulouse, France (https://www.laas.fr) Salary: ~€600/month Keywords: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Generation, Safety Monitoring Technologies: Python, AI Frameworks Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being used in safety-critical applications, such as autonomous vehicles and surgical robotics. In these systems, perception tasks largely rely on deep neural networks (DNNs). However, the use of these components remains challenging because their behavior cannot be fully guaranteed, raising concerns about reliability and safety. Runtime monitoring mechanisms are among the promising approaches to address these limitations. Their purpose is to continuously monitor neural network behavior in order to detect or prevent potential errors. Two main families of monitors can be distinguished: rule-based monitors, which verify whether predefined safety properties are satisfied, and data-driven monitors, which are themselves developed through machine learning, often using neural networks. Evaluating the performance of these monitors is essential, particularly in situations where the main neural network produces incorrect predictions. This raises several important questions: What data should be used to evaluate these monitors? How should such data be collected, generated, and selected? How can the dataset cover both nominal and abnormal operating conditions? The objective of this internship is to investigate data generation and selection strategies for monitor evaluation and to develop a framework for testing and evaluating one or more monitoring mechanisms proposed by the AI research community. The internship will be conducted as part of an aviation-related case study, focusing on runway detection during aircraft landing approaches. It builds on the LARD (Landing Approach for Runway Detection) tool and dataset, which we have extended into Lardon-x, a tool currently under development at ANITI and LAAS-CNRS. items.desc: Bei der TOOLPLACE GmbH digitalisieren wir Angebots-, Kalkulations- und Beschaffungsprozesse in der Kunststoffspritzguss- und Werkzeugbau-Branche. Unsere B2B-Plattform vernetzt OEMs, Tier‑1/Tier‑2-Zulieferer, Spritzgießer und Werkzeugmacher und macht die Zusammenarbeit transparenter und effizienter. Damit wir intern genauso effizient arbeiten, wie unsere Kunden es von uns erwarten, suchen wir einen Praktikanten oder Masteranden, der unsere internen Unternehmensprozesse AI-first denkt und konsequent automatisiert – von wiederkehrenden Abläufen bis hin zu komplexeren Workflows rund um Administration, Finanzen, Vertrieb, Projekte und Daten. Aufgaben Du analysierst bestehende interne Abläufe (zum Beispiel Sales-Funnel, Angebots- und Projektdaten, Reporting, Onboarding) und identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale. Du baust und optimierst Automationen mit No-/Low-Code-Tools (zum Beispiel Make, Zapier, n8n) sowie mit bestehenden Systemen (zum Beispiel CRM, Projektmanagement-Tools, Dokumentenablagen). Du konzipierst und implementierst AI-/LLM-basierte Workflows – etwa zur strukturierten Aufbereitung von Kunden- und Projektdaten oder zur automatisierten Erstellung von Standarddokumenten und Zusammenfassungen. Du entwickelst kleine interne Tools oder Skripte, um Datenflüsse zwischen Systemen zu automatisieren (zum Beispiel in Python). Du dokumentierst Deine Lösungen verständlich und erstellst kurze Anleitungen, damit Kollegen die Automationen im Alltag nutzen können. Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und dem Produktteam zusammen, um interne Prozesse konsequent AI-native zu gestalten. Optional (für Masteranden): Du leitest aus Deiner Arbeit ein Thema für Deine Abschlussarbeit im Umfeld AI-Automation, Prozessdigitalisierung oder interner Plattform-Workflows ab. Qualifikation Du bist eingeschriebener Student, zum Beispiel in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, BWL mit starkem Digital- oder Tech-Fokus oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Studiengang – wichtiger als der genaue Titel ist Dein echtes Interesse an Automatisierung und KI. Du hast bereits praktisch mit Automatisierungs- oder AI-Tools gearbeitet, zum Beispiel eigene Projekte mit Make, Zapier, n8n oder ähnlichen Tools oder die produktive Nutzung von LLMs (zum Beispiel ChatGPT, Claude und andere) zur Unterstützung oder Automatisierung von Aufgaben; erste Skripting-Erfahrung (zum Beispiel in Python) ist ein Plus. Du verstehst grundlegende Konzepte von Datenflüssen, APIs und Webhooks – oder bist bereit, dich schnell und eigenständig einzuarbeiten. Du arbeitest strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und möchtest nicht nur Konzepte schreiben, sondern Lösungen live bringen. Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Abläufe zu durchdringen und pragmatische, funktionierende Automationen zu bauen. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kommst im beruflichen Kontext auch auf Englisch zurecht. Benefits Die Möglichkeit, ein B2B-SaaS-Startup mit starkem Industriefokus (Kunststoffspritzguss, Werkzeugbau, OEMs, Tier‑1/Tier‑2) von innen kennenzulernen. Eine zentrale Rolle dabei, TOOLPLACE intern AI-native aufzustellen – Deine Automationen werden im täglichen Arbeiten Direkt spürbar sein. Direkten Austausch mit den Gründern und den Fachbereichen, kurze Entscheidungswege und schnelle Iterationen. Praxisnahe Einblicke in Prozessdigitalisierung, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und KI-gestützte Workflows entlang von Angebots- und Beschaffungsprozessen. Die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen für AI- und Automationsprojekte einzubringen und eigenverantwortlich umzusetzen. Option, deine Masterarbeit im Kontext von AI-Automation und Prozessdigitalisierung bei TOOLPLACE zu schreiben. Rahmenbedingungen: Vollzeit-Praktikum oder Masterarbeit, Mindestdauer: 6 Monate, Arbeitsort: Leipzig, überwiegend vor Ort, mit Möglichkeit zu mobilem Arbeiten nach Absprache. Klingt das passend für Dich, und Du möchtest AI-Automation nicht nur in der Theorie, sondern direkt in einem Industrie-SaaS-Umfeld umsetzen? Dann schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu Deinen bisherigen Erfahrungen mit Automatisierungs- oder AI-Tools.

items.desc: Since our founding, IDEMIA Public Security has been on a mission to unlock the world and make it safer through our cutting-edge identity technologies. Our technology leadership makes us the partner of choice for hundreds of governments and thousands of enterprises in over 180 countries, including some of the biggest and most influential brands in the world. In applying our unique expertise in biometrics and cryptography , we enable our clients to unlock simpler and safer ways to pay, connect, access, identify, travel and protect public places – at scale and in total security. Our teams work from 5 continents and speak 100+ different languages. We strongly believe that our diversity is a key driver of innovation and performance. Purpose As part of our work on innovative iris recognition solutions, we are developing a demonstrator combining embedded software development, computer vision and 3D sensors. This 6-month internship is based in Osny, starting in March 2027 . The aim of the internship is to contribute to the design and implementation of a complete software pipeline capable of detecting a user’s eyes, estimating their position in three dimensions and automatically controlling an optical system to capture iris images. The internship covers the entire development cycle, from low-level hardware integration to the development of a PC demonstration application, including video stream acquisition, inter-processor communication, data processing and system validation. Key Missions As Part Of The Development Team, You Will Design and develop the platform’s software components in C/C++. Integrate various devices into a distributed multiprocessor architecture running embedded Linux and an RTOS. Develop communication interfaces and data exchange mechanisms between the different subsystems. Implement video stream acquisition and synchronization. Process and fuse data from an RGB camera and a Time-of-Flight (ToF) sensor to estimate the 3D position of the eyes. Implement calibration and geometric registration methods for the different sensors. Develop the processing algorithms required to automatically control the optical system. Design a PC application to visualize and analyze data in real time. Contribute to debugging, performance analysis, optimization and overall validation of the demonstrator. The internship will result in a fully integrated, functional demonstrator combining image acquisition, 3D localization, automatic control and real-time visualization. Profile & Other Information Final-year engineering student or student in the second year of a master’s degree. Strong C/C++ software development skills. Good understanding of software architecture concepts and object-oriented programming. Knowledge of Python for prototyping and validation tools would be an asset. Initial experience developing software on Linux would be an asset. Ability to work independently, attention to detail, technical curiosity and a hands-on approach to experimentation. Strong interest in embedded systems, computer vision and biometrics. By choosing to work at IDEMIA Public Security , you will join a unique tech company, offering a wide range of growth opportunities. You will contribute to a safer world, collaborating with an international and global community. We value the diversity of our teams and welcome people from all walks of life, regardless of how they look, where they come from, who they love, or what they think. We deliver cutting edge, future proof innovation that reach the highest technological standards and we’re transforming, fast, to stay a leader in a world that’s changing fast, too. At IDEMIA Public Security , people can develop their expertise and feel a sense of ownership and empowerment, in a global environment, as part of a company with the ambition and the ability to change the world. items.desc: The Prywes Lab at the University of Cambridge Biochemistry department is seeking a postdoc with experience in protein engineering. Experience with high throughput sequencing, metabolic circuit manipulation, microbiology and in vitro enzymology is desirable. The Prywes lab studies studies enzyme evolution, mechanism and engineering (visit our website, pryweslab.org). We have previously generated a map of the rubisco biochemical landscape (Prywes et al. Nature 2025). Current lab aims include expanding that landscape and studying enzyme mechanism through high-throughput data generation. The project for this position will involve growth-coupled E. coli strains to study enzyme properties in high throughput. The project will involve Machine-Learning for protein design, mutant library generation and cloning, library selection by E. coli growth and high throughput sequencing and analysis. In vitro enzymology will also be required. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in two or more of these techniques and demonstrate a willingness to learn new methods and concepts. Moreover, a suitable candidate will have completed a PhD and demonstrated a high research impact and extensive experience. We are looking for individuals who can think independently and serve as a driving force for their research projects. The Prywes lab is part of the Department of Biochemistry at the University of Cambridge (https://www.bioc.cam.ac.uk/research/faculty/noam-prywes). The University of Cambridge offers a vibrant scientific community, access to cutting-edge research facilities, and numerous collaboration opportunities. In our group, we foster an inclusive, friendly, and supportive environment to help all trainees achieve their scientific and career goals. We strongly encourage international applicants and individuals from underrepresented groups to apply. Fixed-term: The funds for this post are available for 18 months in the first instance. Click the 'Apply' button below to register an account with our recruitment system (if you have not already) and apply online. items.card: We are seeking an enthusiastic Research Fellow to join our vibrant research community at the National Oceanography Centre Southampton, University of Southampton, to work on the European Research Council-funded ROSS-SHIFT (Ross Sea Regime Shift) project. The successful candidate will investigate potential regime shifts in ocean circulation in the Ross Sea and wider Southern Ocean, and their implications for Antarctic
items.desc: We are seeking an enthusiastic Research Fellow to join our vibrant research community at the National Oceanography Centre Southampton, University of Southampton, to work on the European Research Council-funded ROSS-SHIFT (Ross Sea Regime Shift) project. The successful candidate will investigate potential regime shifts in ocean circulation in the Ross Sea and wider Southern Ocean, and their implications for Antarctic Ice Sheet melting and the Southern Ocean Overturning Circulation. The research will aim to improve our understanding of how changes in ocean circulation and freshwater content influence ocean heat transport towards Antarctic ice shelves, affect their basal melting, and interact with the large-scale overturning circulation. The work will involve the analysis of satellite observations, alongside in situ oceanographic measurements and numerical model outputs, to identify, characterise, and understand changes in Southern Ocean dynamics. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge Antarctic research in an international, collaborative environment, with the possibility of participating in Antarctic research cruises. The successful candidate will work closely with collaborators at the British Antarctic Survey, University College London, the University of Gothenburg, the Norwegian Polar Institute and the University of Naples Parthenope. We welcome applications from researchers with experience in physical oceanography, satellite remote sensing, ocean observations, numerical modelling, or related disciplines such as mathematics and physics. The position is expected to start on 1 March 2027 for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension subject to satisfactory progress and funding availability. Some flexibility regarding the start date is available and can be discussed with the successful candidate. For further information or informal enquiries, please contact Dr Alessandro Silvano a.silvano@soton.ac.uk. Tiene como misión buscar y transmitir la verdad , contribuir a la formación académica, cultural y personal de sus estudiantes; promover la investigación científica y la actividad asistencial; ofrecer posibilidades adecuadas de desarrollo a sus profesores y empleados; y realizar una amplia labor de extensión cultural y promoción social , con una clara finalidad de servicio. Descripción de la oferta Un punto crítico en Alumni es la gestión de los datos por lo que buscamos un perfil digital, capaz de marcar la estrategia, pensar en la calidad del dato y su usabilidad, y completar las competencias que reúne el equipo del servicio Alumni. Asimismo, esta persona impulsaría el desarrollo digital del Servicio, cruzando datos (Linkedin, Salesforce, etc.), para realizar informes internos y externos que ayudarán en la toma de decisiones. Para todo ello, se considera importante la incorporación de herramientas de IA que agilicen y mejoren los procesos. Esta plaza se ofrece en la sede de Pamplona o en la de Madrid. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate to gain broad business experience while supporting key decision-making processes across the organisation. The role will primarily focus on supporting Finance and Business Analytics functions through reporting, data analysis, forecasting, and process improvement activities. The successful candidate will also work closely with Commercial teams including Sales, Customer Service, and Project Management, providing analytical support and helping drive business performance. This position offers significant exposure to multiple business functions and provides an ideal foundation for developing a career in business analysis, finance, commercial operations, or project management. Key Responsibilities Finance Support Assist with the preparation of monthly financial reports and performance dashboards. Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis activities. Analyse financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Assist in cost tracking, profitability analysis, and business case development. Support month-end and year-end reporting processes. Help maintain data accuracy across reporting systems and business databases. Business Analytics Implement processes to standardise the capture of data for business analytics purposes. Develop and maintain reports and dashboards. Report on key performance indicators (KPIs). Gather, analyse, and interpret business data to support operational and strategic decisions. Identify opportunities for process improvement through data analysis. Support the development of automated reporting solutions using business intelligence tools. Assist stakeholders in understanding data insights and performance metrics. Commercial Support Sales Support sales reporting and pipeline analysis. Analyse customer, market, and product performance data. Assist with pricing and profitability reviews. Provide insight into customer trends and business opportunities. Customer Service Monitor and report customer service performance metrics. Analyse customer satisfaction and service level data. Identify trends affecting customer experience and recommend improvements. Project Management Support project reporting, forecasting, and performance tracking. Assist with project financial analysis and cost monitoring. Prepare project status reports and performance dashboards. Help ensure project data is maintained accurately and consistently. Continuous Improvement Participate in process improvement initiatives across departments. Assist with the implementation of new systems, tools, and reporting solutions. Document business processes and support best practice initiatives. Contribute ideas that improve efficiency, reporting quality, and business performance. Candidate Profile Essential Qualifications Degree (2:1 or above preferred) in: Business Studies Finance Economics Accounting Business Analytics Mathematics Data Analytics Engineering Management Related discipline Essential Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent numerical skills and attention to detail. Strong Microsoft Excel capability. Ability to interpret and present data clearly. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively. Strong organisational skills. A proactive and positive approach to learning. Desirable Skills Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools. Basic understanding of financial reporting and accounting principles. Experience using SQL, Power Query, or data analysis software. Understanding of project management principles. Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP. items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
R&D Team Lead 
 __
Your role and responsibilities 
In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.
The work model for the role is: hybrid 
 In this role, you will define engineering opportunities for the ABB switchgear portfolio. You will specify requirements and develop novel protection concepts for evolving applications such as microgrids, energy storage systems, or new topologies for a sustainable energy generation and distribution. You will perform experiments and model products, to integrate them in state-of-the-art simulations of new protection solutions for medium and low voltage grids.
Reporting to the research team manager, you will engage with cross-functional teams inside and outside the company and work together to demonstrate these concepts in electrical systems. Furthermore, you will contribute to the team research roadmap and to the management of research projects. 
You will be mainly accountable for: 
 Conducting applied research in the area of system protection and switching
 Developing sustainable protection solutions for upcoming applications of switchgear, e.g. for reliable energy distribution, grid integration of renewable energies or integration of energy storage systems
 Model products that will then be used to simulate entire systems to survey and validate sophisticated protection concepts
 Driving research activities, cooperate with scientists and engineers, generating intellectual property, and writing scientific publications
 Qualifications for the role 
 PhD in physics or electrical engineering
 Experience in modelling complex phenomena and their integration into system analysis
 Experience in practical laboratory measurement and data analysis techniques
 Knowledge and experience in electrical systems is a plus but not a must-have
 A collaborative, solution-focused approach, with strong written and spoken communication as well as relationship-building skills
 Strong communication skills in English (both written and spoken)
 More about us 
 The Switching group at the ABB research center in Switzerland develops and improves protection concepts and devices for todays and future sustainable electrical systems and novel applications. Our solutions are used to support the development of next-generation products. This is a unique opportunity if you have the desire to carry out research in an evolving field, to contribute with your expertise to ABB’s success by reinforcing our team of scientists and engineers. If you are passionate about science and technology and want to work in an inspiring environment where your skills and ideas become part of solutions that tackle the future of sustainable energy distribution, then apply now. 
The recruitment process is managed by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland. 
 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
 Ready to make an impact? 
 Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

items.card: you will contribute to the first phase of an innovative measurement analysis framework that helps translate measurement-related questions into structured and reproducible analysis workflows. Your work will support the development of scalable analytical solutions that can be expanded into future intelligent decision-support systems. This internship offers a unique opportunity to combine software engineering, data
items.desc:
Introduction
 The Applied Data Science team develops reliable artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for ASML products and services. We work closely with domain experts to turn engineering knowledge into data-driven solutions that improve system performance, diagnostics, and maintenance. In this internship, you will contribute to the first phase of an innovative measurement analysis framework that helps translate measurement-related questions into structured and reproducible analysis workflows. Your work will support the development of scalable analytical solutions that can be expanded into future intelligent decision-support systems. This internship offers a unique opportunity to combine software engineering, data science, and machine learning in a highly innovative environment.
 Your assignment
 As a internship student, you will help develop a prototype framework that guides users from measurement-related questions to structured and validated analysis workflows. You will focus on creating a modular system backbone that supports data intake, analysis planning, validation, and reproducible reporting. The framework should be scalable and designed for future extensions, including advanced modeling capabilities and intelligent user interaction. Your main responsibilities will be:
 Define a structured analysis specification for measurement studies
 Develop a prototype for data intake and data structure inspection
 Build workflow selection mechanisms based on analysis objectives
 Implement validation checks to assess data quality and analysis suitability
 Create reproducible reporting and workflow archiving functionalities
 Demonstrate the framework using representative measurement-analysis cases
 Collaborate with domain experts to translate analytical requirements into practical solutions
 This is a bachelor/master internship for minimum 6 months, minimum 5 days per week (3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027, but an earlier start date is also possible .
 Your profile
 To be suitable for the internship, you: 
 Are pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Data Science, Applied Statistics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
 Have experience with Python programming and developing structured software solutions
 Have knowledge of data analysis, statistics, and machine learning concepts
 Are analytical and comfortable working with complex structured datasets
 Are proactive and able to communicate technical findings clearly
 Have experience with version control tools such as Git and reproducible development practices
 This internship is ideal if you enjoy building practical analytical systems, combining software engineering with data science, and creating solutions that can be used by engineering teams. During this internship, you will gain experience in developing scalable analytical frameworks while working alongside experts in data science and engineering. The internship offers hands-on experience in an innovative and collaborative environment where your work can contribute to future AI-enabled solutions.
 Other requirements you need to meet: 
 You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship; 
 If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement); 
 You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular; 
 You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate. 
 Inclusion and diversity 
 ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.
 Do you want to know more about the internship allowance, visa support and applying for an internship at ASML? Read this page .
