items.desc: Graduate Data/AI Engineer Location: London Type: On Site Starting Salary: £28,900 Why Grayce? Grayce specialises in delivering change and transformation for some of the UK’s most ambitious organisations. For over a decade, we have partnered with FTSE 100 and FTSE 250 companies to deploy high-performing early career talent across major programmes of work. Our Accelerated Development Programme offers a structured, fast-track route into industry. You will gain hands-on experience working on business transformation initiatives, developing technical solutions, automating processes and contributing to large-scale change programmes. You will typically work with one client at a time, delivering meaningful outcomes in a professional, client-facing environment. Alongside this, you will complete a minimum of six industry-recognised accreditations, with clear progression pathways and salary growth as you develop. About Our Opportunities We are recruiting graduates into specialist Data and AI Engineering opportunities, supporting leading organisations within the financial services sector. These roles will focus on using Python, data and emerging AI technologies to develop innovative solutions, automate processes and improve business efficiency. You will have the opportunity to work on real-world business challenges, developing and implementing technical solutions that enhance operational performance, improve accuracy and support business transformation. Ideally, candidates will have an interest in financial services, alongside strong Python skills and an enthusiasm for applying AI and emerging technologies to solve complex business problems. Please note this role forms part of our Data pathway - therefore please apply through this page. What You'll Be Doing Supporting the automation of key Investment Operations activities, including Trade Operations and Settlements. Developing Python-based solutions to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual processes. Supporting trade reconciliation and investigating trade failures. Working with complex financial and operational datasets to identify trends, discrepancies and opportunities for improvement. Exploring and applying AI technologies to enhance existing processes and develop innovative solutions. Collaborating with stakeholders and technical teams to understand business requirements and deliver effective solutions. What Makes a Great Grayce Consultant Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. A genuine interest in data engineering, automation and AI. Attention to detail and the ability to work with complex datasets. An interest in financial services, ideally with an understanding of Investment Operations. Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively. A proactive approach to learning and developing new technical skills. Technical Skills (Essential & Advantageous) Python: Strong Python skills are essential, with an ability to develop scripts, automate processes and work with data. AI & Machine Learning: An interest in AI, machine learning and exploring how emerging technologies can solve business problems. Financial Services: Previous exposure to financial services is advantageous, particularly Investment Operations, Trade Operations, Settlements or reconciliation. Data: An understanding of data manipulation, analysis and transformation. SQL: Experience working with databases and querying data would be beneficial. Why Work for Us Locations Locations are updated regularly based on client demand, with opportunities currently available across the UK. Greater geographical flexibility gives you access to a broader range of client projects. Opportunity Gain hands-on experience working full-time, on-site with leading organisations, supported by structured training and industry-aligned development. Delivery Work directly with a client, delivering high-quality outcomes in a professional, client-facing environment. Mentoring Receive dedicated coaching and support throughout your placement and development journey. Progression Complete a minimum of six industry-recognised accreditations, with clear pathways for career progression and salary growth. Wellbeing Support Access our Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24/7 confidential support across financial, legal, health, and wellbeing areas. Salary Our salaries are dictated by location and client, with significant annual salary increases. Our Approach to AI At Grayce, we embrace the responsible use of AI. We use AI-assisted screening to help assess eligibility and suitability for our roles, enabling us to review applications fairly and consistently. We also recognise that candidates may use AI tools when preparing their applications. We welcome the thoughtful use of AI to support your application, but we want to get to know the real you. Please ensure your application reflects your own experiences, strengths and motivations.

items.desc: 🚀 Graduate Software Engineer | Forward Deployed Engineering | Graduating soon or recently graduated and looking for something more challenging than a traditional graduate software engineering role? I'm partnering with a well-funded, VC-backed Defence AI start-up building advanced AI-powered systems designed to solve complex problems in real-world operational environments. They're looking for Graduate Software Engineers who want to work at the intersection of software engineering, AI and real-world deployment. This isn't a role where you'll spend your first year working through a backlog of small features. It's an opportunity to work alongside exceptional engineers and AI researchers, tackle difficult technical problems and help deploy sophisticated software into environments where it actually gets used. 🛠️ What makes this interesting? → Building and deploying advanced software and AI-powered systems in real-world environments. → Writing production-quality code and developing your skills across complex software systems. → Working alongside experienced software engineers and AI researchers on challenging technical problems. → Getting exposure to everything from backend engineering and systems integration to AI deployment. → Working directly with end users to understand complex challenges and develop practical engineering solutions. → Taking meaningful ownership early in your career and seeing the direct impact of what you build. 🔍 Who would be a good fit? We're looking for graduates with strong foundations in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a closely related technical discipline. You might have developed your skills through challenging university projects, internships, research, open-source contributions or building technically ambitious projects independently. Particularly interesting backgrounds include: → Strong programming ability, ideally with Python . → A solid understanding of algorithms, data structures and software engineering fundamentals . → An interest in AI, distributed systems, backend engineering or complex software architectures . → Experience tackling difficult technical problems beyond standard coursework. → The ability to learn quickly, think independently and communicate technical ideas clearly. You don't need previous experience in Defence AI or Forward Deployed Engineering. What matters is your technical ability, curiosity, adaptability and willingness to take on problems that don't always have an obvious solution. 📍 UK | Office-first with flexibility | Travel required 🔒 UK right to work and eligibility for SC clearance required

items.desc: Descripción de la empresa Como referente de la transformación ecológica, en Grupo Veolia ofrecemos soluciones para la gestión eficiente de las actividades de agua, residuos y energía, impulsando el desarrollo sostenible de las ciudades, industrias y agricultura. Trabajamos principalmente en tres grandes áreas: agua, ofreciendo soluciones tanto en gestión urbana como industrial; residuos ♻ transformándolos en nuevos recursos, y energía mejorando la eficiencia y reduciendo el consumo y las emisiones en edificios, industrias y ciudades. Descripción del empleo Desde Aigües de Barcelona buscamos incorporar un/a Data Analyst / Data Scientist Junior con experiencia para formar parte del Departamento de Clientes. Buscamos una persona que quiera seguir desarrollándose en el ámbito del dato y que combine conocimientos técnicos con capacidad para comprender los procesos de negocio, cuestionar la información, formular hipótesis y transformar los datos en conclusiones y propuestas accionables. No buscamos un perfil recién titulado, sino una persona con una primera experiencia profesional en análisis y explotación de datos, autonomía, pensamiento crítico, curiosidad y capacidad para trabajar con diferentes equipos y clientes internos. ¿Qué harás? Realizar análisis complejos de bases de datos relacionadas con el ciclo comercial de Aigües de Barcelona: lecturas, facturación, impagos, cobros y otros procesos vinculados a la relación con el cliente. Dar soporte, a través del análisis de datos, a iniciativas de mejora, eficiencia y transformación digital de los procesos comerciales. Analizar bases de datos de Salesforce Service Cloud y Amazon Connect para identificar errores de proceso y detectar ámbitos de mejora. Analizar los datos de la operativa de los agentes y operadores para identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer cambios en los procedimientos de trabajo. Realizar el seguimiento de las mejoras implantadas y cuantificar su impacto económico y operativo. Formular propuestas de cambio de procesos a partir de los análisis realizados. Coordinarte con los usuarios para definir funcionalidades, mejoras y cambios en los procesos operativos. Naloge: • ustvarjanje AI videov in slik po idejah kreativne ekipe • natančen pregled vsakega rezultata, dokler ni brezhiben • izboljševanje naših AI procesov • vsakodnevno sodelovanje s kreativno ekipo Kaj pričakujemo: • možnost dela do 8 ur na dan, dolgoročno • strast do mode, TikToka in AI orodij • oko za detajle, potrpežljivost in zanesljivost • osnovno angleščino • predznanje ni potrebno, vse te naučimo Kaj nudimo: • jasno pot do vodstvene pozicije z ogromnim potencialom zaslužka • delo neposredno z ustanovitelji in znanje, ki ga ne dobiš na nobeni fakulteti • najnovejša AI orodja • osebno uvajanje in dnevno podporo ⚠️ Ta vloga NI za vsakogar. Ne prijavljaj se, če: • iščeš lahko delo za nekaj ur na teden • te moda, TikTok in AI ne zanimajo zares • kritiko jemlješ osebno in ne znaš sprejeti konstruktivne kritike („to ni dobro“ pri nas pomeni „gremo znova, bolje“) • nisi zanesljiv/-a in ne moreš opraviti naloge, ko te pokličemo • ne maraš ponavljajočega se dela in ponavljanja, dokler ni popolno Če pa si ambiciozen/-na, lačen/-na uspeha in želiš rasti hitreje od drugih, te želimo spoznati. 👉 Prijava samo prek obrazca (5 minut): https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdVQdxLpR_hAwp7QgLFd5mTT5BQQyoY82SRJOwlkb9iOD4s-w/viewform

items.desc: Wil jij impact maken met Machine Learning binnen een internationale productieomgeving? Bij Lamb Weston krijg je de kans om een bestaand voorspellend model verder te ontwikkelen en te verbeteren. Lamb Weston behoort tot de wereldwijde marktleiders in aardappelproducten en beschikt over zeven productielocaties in Europa. Onze fabrieken draaien 24 uur per dag, 7 dagen per week. Om ongeplande stilstand van productielijnen te minimaliseren, maken we gebruik van data en Machine Learning om verstoringen in het productieproces te voorspellen. V oor deze afstudeeropdracht ga je aan de slag met een bestaand Machine Learning-model dat downtime voor de komende maand voorspelt. Je onderzoekt de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van het huidige model, analyseert de gebruikte data en ontwikkelt verbeteringen die leiden tot nauwkeurigere voorspellingen. Wat ga je doen? Het analyseren van het bestaande Machine Learning-model, de codebase en de gebruikte datasets. Het controleren van de dataverwerking en modelcode op fouten, inconsistenties en mogelijke dataleakage. Het onderzoeken en toevoegen van nieuwe relevante features die de voorspellende waarde kunnen verhogen. Het optimaliseren, trainen en testen van verschillende Machine Learning-modellen. Het vergelijken en valideren van modelprestaties aan de hand van meetbare resultaten. Het documenteren van jouw aanpak, resultaten en aanbevelingen voor toekomstig gebruik en onderhoud. Het inzichtelijk maken van terugkerende patronen in verstoringen binnen het productieproces. Wat is het eindresultaat? Aan het einde van jouw afstudeerstage heb je een verbeterd en gevalideerd Machine Learning-model opgeleverd dat downtime nauwkeuriger voorspelt. Je onderbouwt jouw verbeteringen met experimenten, analyses en meetresultaten en geeft advies over de betrouwbaarheid en verdere ontwikkeling van het model. Wie ben jij? Je bent een enthousiaste en analytisch sterke HBO-student die graag werkt op het snijvlak van data, softwareontwikkeling en Artificial Intelligence. Daarnaast: Volg je een hbo-opleiding Informatica, HBO-ICT of vergelijkbaar. Heb je affiniteit met Python en Machine Learning. Vind je het interessant om grote hoeveelheden data te analyseren. Werk je zelfstandig en neem je initiatief. Kun je technische keuzes goed onderbouwen. Heb je interesse in industriële processen en data-gedreven optimalisatie. Wat bieden wij? Een uitdagende afstudeeropdracht met directe impact op een internationale productieomgeving. Begeleiding door ervaren professionals binnen IT, Data & Analytics en Operations. Toegang tot real-life data en een bestaande Machine Learning-omgeving. Ruimte voor eigen onderzoek, ideeën en innovaties. Een passende stagevergoeding. De mogelijkheid om waardevolle praktijkervaring op te doen binnen een internationaal bedrijf. Interesse? Ben jij klaar om jouw kennis van Machine Learning toe te passen in een complexe en innovatieve productieomgeving? Solliciteer dan op deze afstudeerstage bij Lamb Weston en help ons de volgende stap te zetten in voorspellend onderhoud en procesoptimalisatie

items.desc: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here. We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. Why the Faculty Fellowship? Founded in 2014, Faculty is one of Europe’s leading applied AI companies. Faculty’s PhD-heavy team of deep AI experts has delivered hundreds of real-world AI products to improve critical public services and drive sustained economic returns across every sector of the economy. Widely recognised as a leader in AI safety, Faculty works for the world’s leading AI labs, such as OpenAI, Meta and Anthropic, to ensure their latest models are safe, human-led and explainable. The Faculty Fellowship builds the AI talent engine for the world’s most ambitious organisations. It selects exceptional scientific minds and accelerates them into the top tier of AI practitioners. Past Fellows hold some of the most critical AI posts for organisations across every sector of the economy. As part of our international expansion, we are bringing the Faculty Fellowship to Denmark through Halfspace, part of Faculty-a leading applied AI company in Copenhagen. Building on Faculty’s decade-long track record of developing exceptional AI talent and Halfspace’s expertise in delivering real-world AI solutions, the Fellowship will offer outstanding STEM talent in Denmark an opportunity to accelerate their careers in AI. As a Fellow, you will learn directly from leading AI practitioners before being embedded within an ambitious organisation, applying advanced AI and data science to solve complex commercial challenges and deliver meaningful impact. How It Works 2 Weeks of Intensive Training: Learn to apply your advanced technical knowledge to real-world data science problems. 6 Week Paid Placement: Tackle a commercial data science project with a host company. Demo Day Finale: Present your work to senior stakeholders and industry leaders, showcasing your technical capabilities and project impact. Where our alumni go: our alumni have gone on to shape the future at companies like Google, Meta, Tesco and AstraZeneca, as well as disruptive startups like Physics X and Orbital Witness. We are also incredibly proud that a high percentage of fellows choose to continue their journey internally, joining the Faculty team permanently. About The Role As a Fellow at Faculty, you will join an elite cohort transforming industries through cutting-edge data science. This intensive, eight week programme bridges academic and real world impact, embedding you directly into highs-stakes commercial environments. You will apply advanced machine learning techniques to solve complex, ambiguous problems for our clients, turning theoretical knowledge into high-value deployable solutions. It is a fast-paced launchpad designed to accelerate your technical growth, build exceptional commercial acumen and employer you to shape the future of artificial intelligence in an ambitious, forward-thinking tech community. Who We're Looking For You hold a finished PhD or Master’s degree in a STEM subject, complemented by a strong foundation in data science or machine learning. You possess a high level of mathematical competence alongside solid experience with theoretical concepts like hypothesis testing, Bayesian inference, and neural networks. You demonstrate strong programming skills, particularly in Python, and feel comfortable navigating core data science coding libraries. You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, showing the resilience and autonomy needed to structure your own project plans and hit critical deadlines. You can communicate complex technical ideas clearly, adapting your language seamlessly for both technical peers and non-technical partners. You thrive in fast-paced, ambitious environments, showing curiosity and a relentless drive to learn and deploy new technologies. Requirements Right to work: We’re unfortunately unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role, so you’ll need to already have the right to work in Denmark. This includes citizens of EU/EEA countries and Switzerland, as well as anyone holding a valid Danish work permit or residence status. items.desc: Summary ABOUT SAINT LAURENT Founded in 1961, Yves Saint Laurent was the first couture house to introduce the concept of luxury prêt-à-porter in a 1966 collection called ‘Rive Gauche’, synonymous with youth and freedom. This shift represented a first critical step in the modernization of fashion and revolutionized the socio-cultural landscape. Today, Saint Laurent collections include women’s and men’s ready-to-wear, shoes, handbags, small leather goods, jewelry, scarves, ties and eyewear. items.desc: The Impact You'll Make Join our two-year Graduate Program and become part of a team that turns ideas, data and technology into real business impact. Work on projects that drive AI and digital transformation in a global industrial company, while exploring how digital technologies can create smarter, more sustainable solutions for people and the planet. How The Program Works Starting 1 September 2027, you’ll complete three 8-month rotations , each designed to broaden your experience and deepen your digital & business capabilities. Your journey starts at our headquarters in Nordborg or Graasten, Denmark and continues in regions such as the USA , Asia or Europe . You’ll work in cross-functional teams - from digital environments to office spaces and production floors, gaining a broader understanding of how technology, business, innovation and sustainability connect at Danfoss. After completing the program, you’ll be well prepared to take on future opportunities - potentially moving into a permanent role at Danfoss that aligns with your strengths, ambitions and career path. What You’ll Be Doing Take ownership of projects within AI, data, digital and IT. Collaborate and implement solutions with experts and peers from all over the world. Push the boundaries of what can be achieved with data and AI, turning new possibilities into practical business value. Communicate the value of AI and digital solutions, address concerns and bring people along as new technologies are introduced. What We're Looking For Master’s degree in IT, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field with graduation in 2026 or 2027. Recently graduated, with a maximum of two years of full-time professional work experience after graduation. Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken. You are curious about AI, data, digital technologies and their potential to transform business. Work well across cultures and value inclusion, teamwork and respect. Have experience from an internship or student project. What You'll Get From Us Learning & Mentoring: You’ll have a dedicated mentor, a buddy, project-based learning and structured workshops to understand the business. Global Opportunities: Experience diverse cultures, build your international network and discover your best-fit career path. Inclusive Culture: Be part of a workplace where you can bring your whole self -your background, ideas and ambitions all matter. items.card: Ihre Aufgaben Gemeinsam mit Leidenschaft aus Ideen Fortschritt bauen Digitale Erfassung unserer Produktionshallen und Werksbereiche mit mobilen 3D-Scannern sowie weiteren Aufnahmeverfahren Aufbereitung von Punktwolken und Erstellung aktueller 3D-Hallen- und Werksmodelle für unsere Fertigteil- und Windfertigteilwerke Bereitstellung der 3D-Modelle als Planungsgrundlage für Hallenlayouts, Produktionsanlagen,
items.desc: Wir - die Firmengruppe Max Bögl - sind über 7.500 überzeugte BöglerInnen, erwirtschaften gemeinsam einen Jahresumsatz von über 3 Mrd. Euro und sind stolz darauf, dass wir zu den größten Bau-, Technologie- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen der deutschen Bauindustrie gehören. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 1929 sind wir ständig geprägt von Innovationskraft in Forschung und Technik. Das breite Leistungsspektrum und eine hohe Wertschöpfungstiefe mit eigenem Stahlbau, eigenen Fertigteilwerken, modernstem Fuhr- und Gerätepark sowie eigenen Roh- und Baustoffbetrieben macht uns zum einzigartigen Arbeitgeber mit vielfältigsten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Wir arbeiten daher dort, wo wir uns am besten entfalten können und streben stets nach höchster Qualität von der ersten Konzeptidee bis zum fertigen Bauprodukt. Dabei bleiben wir immer noch eine große Familie mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und der Leidenschaft zum Bau. Ihre Aufgaben Gemeinsam mit Leidenschaft aus Ideen Fortschritt bauen Digitale Erfassung unserer Produktionshallen und Werksbereiche mit mobilen 3D-Scannern sowie weiteren Aufnahmeverfahren Aufbereitung von Punktwolken und Erstellung aktueller 3D-Hallen- und Werksmodelle für unsere Fertigteil- und Windfertigteilwerke Bereitstellung der 3D-Modelle als Planungsgrundlage für Hallenlayouts, Produktionsanlagen, Materialflüsse und Umbaumaßnahmen Planung und Durchführung drohnen- und kamerabasierter Aufnahmen von Werks-, Lager- und Außenflächen Entwicklung und Erprobung von KI-Bildanalysen zur automatisierten Erkennung von Lagerbeständen und Lagerplatzbelegungen Aufbau von Lösungen zur Ermittlung freier Lagerkapazitäten sowie zur Überwachung definierter Mindestbestände Umsetzung von Pilotprojekten zur Objekt-, Zustands- und Anomalieerkennung, z. B. Risse oder Oberflächenabweichungen an Betonbauteilen Definition einheitlicher Standards für Erfassung, Datenqualität, Modellstruktur, Ablage und Aktualisierung Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, Produktionsplanung, Qualität, Vermessung und IT – vom Pilotprojekt bis zum produktiven Einsatz Ihr Profil Abgeschlossenes Studium in Produktionstechnik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Vermessung, Geoinformatik, Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation Erfahrung oder großes Interesse an 3D-Laserscanning, Punktwolken und digitalen Werksmodellen Kenntnisse in der Verarbeitung und Aufbereitung von 3D-, Geometrie- und Bilddaten von Vorteil Kenntnisse in Bildverarbeitung, Computer Vision oder KI, z. B. Python, OpenCV oder YOLO, von Vorteil Erfahrung mit Drohnen, Photogrammetrie oder kamerabasierter Datenerfassung wünschenswert Verständnis für Produktionsprozesse, Hallenlayouts und Materialflüsse Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe IT-Affinität Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Einsätzen an unseren Fertigteil- und Windstandorten in Deutschland Unser Angebot Als Bögler realisieren Sie herausfordernde Projekte und Aufgaben in einem innovativen und zukunftsorientierten Familienunternehmen Begleitung ab dem ersten Arbeitstag durch unser hybrides Einführungsprogramm „Bögler werden“ Bedarfsgerechte sowie gezielte Einarbeitung mit Unterstützung durch unser Patensystem Interessantes und umfangreiches Aufgabenspektrum Offene Gesprächskultur und kollegiales Umfeld Sonderkonditionen über das Corporate-Benefits-Portal Vertrauensarbeitszeit und Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten Ist Das Ihre Position? Dann Freuen Wir Uns Auf Ihre Aussagekräftige Bewerbung Mit Angabe Des Möglichen Eintrittstermins Und Ihres Gehaltswunsches. items.desc: Rejoins une équipe data de trois personnes pour faire évoluer le modèle de données utilisé par toutes les équipes de Yomoni et construire nos premiers agents IA. En deux ans et demi, nous avons bâti un socle data complet et adopté : Fivetran, Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Metabase et Hightouch, plus de 300 modèles dbt et 29 sources de données. Tu arrives donc sur un socle à faire grandir, pas sur une plateforme à reconstruire. Le poste poursuit deux objectifs : renforcer notre capacité à répondre aux besoins des métiers et à automatiser les traitements récurrents, notamment en finance ; et faire passer à l'usage nos premières briques d'IA agentique (semantic layer dbt MetricFlow, dix skills Claude Code, prototype de fiche client en langage naturel). Tu seras rattaché·e à Léa , Senior Analytics, ta référente au quotidien, et accompagné·e par Benjamin , Head of Data, qui porte les sujets d'IA agentique. Tu travailleras aussi avec Guillaume , Data Engineer, responsable de la plateforme. Dans une équipe de cette taille, tes livrables sont visibles et tes propositions se transforment vite en réalisations. 1. Faire évoluer le socle des modèles de données pour l'analytics C'est le cœur du poste et la priorité des premiers mois. Être le point de contact data des équipes finance, marketing, opérations et service client : comprendre le besoin, le challenger, le traduire en solution et la livrer. Faire évoluer le modèle de données dbt : nouveaux modèles, refactorisations, tests, documentation et amélioration continue. Maintenir et fiabiliser les traitements en production qui alimentent la finance et la relation client (modèle de valeur client, calcul des remboursements, flux de données des partenaires), puis les faire évoluer. Concevoir et maintenir les tableaux de bord Metabase réellement utilisés, et retirer ceux qui ne répondent plus à un besoin. Automatiser des traitements aujourd'hui réalisés manuellement, en commençant par les processus de finance. Documenter les définitions et les règles de calcul pour garantir une lecture cohérente des indicateurs. 2. Construire l'analytics agentique L'objectif est de rendre la donnée plus directement accessible, avec le niveau de rigueur attendu dans un environnement régulé. Développer des agents d'analytique en libre-service avec Claude ou Dust, déjà en place, appuyés sur notre semantic layer, pour que les équipes métier obtiennent des réponses documentées sans ouvrir de ticket et tendre vers la BI en self-service. Concevoir des règles de validation, de traçabilité et d'escalade lorsque la réponse d'un agent doit être vérifiée par une personne. Créer des outils pour l'équipe data (skills, MCP, agents) qui accélèrent les tâches répétitives. Identifier les cas d'usage, les prototyper, mesurer leur utilisation et décider avec l'équipe lesquels industrialiser. Tes douze premiers mois À 3 mois : tu es autonome sur le modèle de données dbt et sur les demandes courantes des métiers. Un premier agent est utilisé en interne. À 6 mois : les traitements finance ciblés sont automatisés de bout en bout, documentés et sans reprise manuelle. À 12 mois : plusieurs agents en libre-service sont utilisés par les métiers et tu es référent·e d'une partie du modèle de données. À deux ou trois ans, une évolution vers un rôle de référent·e de domaine puis de Senior Analytics Engineer pourra se dessiner. La stack Fivetran, Snowflake, dbt Cloud et semantic layer MetricFlow Metabase, Hightouch Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Dust, skills et MCP Confluence et dbt Docs Un périmètre qui est le tien dès le premier mois, et l'IA agentique comme responsabilité concrète. Des collaborations directes avec les stakeholders métiers incluant les managers/directeurs Rémunération fixe sans variable individuelle : le fixe annoncé est le fixe proposé. Hybride, au moins 3 jours au bureau par semaine. Deux séminaires par an. Un global et un d'équipe Un plan d'épargne entreprise. Une mutuelle prise en charge à 70 %. Une carte titres-restaurant de 8 €, prise en charge à 60 %. Des RTT. 20 € remboursés chaque mois sur ton forfait internet. Une salle de sport sur place et un abonnement Wellpass. Les bases indispensables Une expérience pratique en analytics ou en analytics engineering, idéalement acquise en production. Une pratique avancée de SQL. Une expérience de dbt en production. Une bonne compréhension des enjeux métier et la capacité à transformer une question opérationnelle en modèle de données pertinent. Les bases de Git. Nous recherchons une expérience réelle de production, pas un nombre précis d'années de carrière. Vous n'avez pas besoin d'être senior pour réussir dans ce poste. Les atouts supplémentaires Une pratique de Python. Une expérience de Claude Code ou de Claude Cowork. Un usage personnel sérieux compte autant qu'une expérience professionnelle. La connaissance d'un environnement fintech ou régulé. Étapes Échange de 30 minutes avec Léa ou Benjamin, pour comprendre ton parcours, tes attentes et ta manière de …

items.title: Praktikant (m/w/d) Data & AI
items.card: Aufgabenbereich Unterstützung unserer Projektteams bei der Optimierung und Automatisierung von Planungsprozessen Mitarbeit im Rahmen interner Initiativen im Bereich der Integration und Optimierung von KI- und Automatisierungs-Tools Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von finanz- und leistungswirtschaftlichen Kennzahlen-Analysen Einbringen deiner Expertise zu verschiedenen Tools und Anwendungen Dein Profil Studium:
items.desc: Wer wir sind FTI Consulting, Inc. ist die weltweit führende Beratung für Unternehmen in Krisen und Transformationen. Wir arbeiten eng mit weltweit führenden Unternehmen, renommierten Anwaltskanzleien und Private-Equity-Firmen zusammen, wenn sie vor ihren größten Herausforderungen und Chancen stehen. Gemeinsam erzielen wir Ergebnisse, die einen Unterschied machen. items.desc: Job Description: Location: Milton Keynes, UK (Office-based) Job Type: Full-time, Permanent Probation Period: 6 months Visa Sponsorship: Potentially available, subject to eligibility and UK immigration requirements. Language: Mandarin Required Job Overview We are a UK-based technology company developing innovative AI-powered telephone ordering and business automation systems. We are seeking a motivated and technically minded Junior AI Systems Tester & Technical Coordinator to join our growing team in Milton Keynes. This position is particularly suitable for recent graduates with a background in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a related discipline. You will play an important role in testing and improving our AI systems, identifying technical issues and coordinating with our Mandarin-speaking software development team in China. No extensive professional experience is required, as training and support will be provided. Key Responsibilities Test and evaluate AI-powered voice ordering and telephone systems. Identify, investigate, reproduce and report software bugs. Communicate technical requirements and feedback to the software development team in China. Assist with API integrations involving OpenAI, Twilio, Stripe and other third-party platforms. Monitor system performance and conduct regression testing following software updates. Prepare technical reports, testing records and documentation. Support troubleshooting and ongoing product development. Work with internal team members to improve system functionality and user experience. Essential Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a related subject. Good understanding of software systems, APIs and basic troubleshooting. Strong Mandarin Chinese and English communication skills. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills. Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with international development teams. A genuine interest in AI, software development and emerging technologies. Desirable Skills The following experience would be beneficial but is not essential: Software testing or quality assurance (QA). Basic programming knowledge (e.g. Python, JavaScript or similar). Experience working with REST APIs. Familiarity with AI tools, automation systems or cloud-based applications. University projects or personal projects involving software development or AI. What We Offer Competitive annual salary, depending on experience and technical ability. Full-time, permanent employment. 6-month probationary period. Practical training and hands-on experience with AI technologies. Opportunities to work with international software developers and technical teams. Career development in AI systems testing, software QA and technical coordination. Potential UK Skilled Worker visa sponsorship following successful completion of probation, subject to the company's sponsorship arrangements, eligible occupation and salary requirements, and individual immigration eligibility. How to Apply Please email your CV and a brief covering introduction to: Email: info@haveorder.com Please include the following in your application: Your educational background. Relevant technical skills and knowledge. Any university, personal or professional projects related to AI, software development or IT. Your current UK right-to-work status, where applicable. Email Subject: Junior AI Systems Tester Application We welcome applications from recent graduates and candidates who are enthusiastic about developing their careers in AI technology.

items.title: Internship Data Analysis and Data Science (Digital Airport team)
items.card: Responsibilities As an intern in the Digital Airport team, you will contribute to several data-driven projects that will help our global support market objectives, with a strong focus on passenger satisfaction. Your responsibilities may include: Performing innovative analyses to gain insight into customer behavior and identify opportunities for action Developing predictive models to help ground staff in their work
items.desc: Are you passionate about applying analytical methods and data science models to make a significant impact on both passengers and airport staff? Join our Digital Airport team as a Data Analysis & Data Science intern and help build our mission to improve the digital airport experience! What will you do? Responsibilities As an intern in the Digital Airport team, you will contribute to several data-driven projects that will help our global support market objectives, with a strong focus on passenger satisfaction. Your responsibilities may include: Performing innovative analyses to gain insight into customer behavior and identify opportunities for action Developing predictive models to help ground staff in their work on the ground. airport. Creating predictive models to monitor customer sentiment. Designing interactive dashboards to generate actionable insights. Where do you land? You will work together with a diverse and ambitious Digital Airport team, consisting of a Product Owner, Business Analysts, Information Analysts, an architect, and front-end and back-end developers. This product team makes is part of the Travel & Recovery department within the joint Digital department of Air France / KLM (AFKL). The team is geographically spread across the Netherlands and India. Together, we share a common goal: to Leveraging data to improve digital products and services for our passengers. We work closely with together with the A2H team (internal app for ground staff), the CRMPush team (for email, messages and notifications), Customer Experience, User Experience and ground staff at the airport. We are located in the head office of KLM in Amstelveen. Your profile Qualifications We are looking for a practical, motivated and ambitious team player who would like to gain valuable work experience during his/her studies. Key qualifications include: Currently pursuing a university or college degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Sciences or a related field; Demonstrable analytical mindset and experience in applying statistical models; Proficiency in programming with knowledge of Python and SQL as a great advantage; Accurate, proactive and independent working style; Good command of English, Dutch and/or French are an advantage; Available to work for at least 4 months, preferably 6 months, 32-40 hours per week; The start is possible between December 2026 and April 2027; As an intern in our team, you will thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic and enjoyable work environment that is a fast learning and growing environment We offer flexibility to work partly from home, of course in consultation with the team. In addition to learning about data, you also gain insight into working in a large corporate environment. We also organize with the team various social activities. In addition, you will have the opportunity to join Taxibaan, the association for KLM interns and dual students. This association offers fun social activities with for example, a visit to a hangar or catering. What Do We Offer KLM offers you a highly instructive experience in a dynamic organisation in which you will play an important role. You can develop yourself considerably during this internship, both personally and professionally. In addition, this internship offers you the opportunity to build up your network, as you will be working with many different KLM employees! Another advantage of a internship at KLM is the KLM Taxibaan association run by and for interns. This association expands your network and organises fun events and interesting excursions within the KLM organisation. There is also a internship allowance. Ready for your next destination? Then don't wait any longer and apply for this function before the final boarding call on 11/19/2026! You don't need to write a cover letter; during your application we will ask you some specific questions. You will be notified within two weeks of the closing date of the vacancy.Did you know that according to research, women are less likely to apply than men when they don't meet all the job requirements? What a shame. Because, in our view, 'the perfect candidate' is a myth. So, if you have the drive to grow in aspects of this role, we look forward to your application.

items.desc: About Intergrid Intergrid is a Helsinki-based technology company offering an Autopilot for industrial energy operators. Economics, emissions and resilience are pushing industrials to adopt hybrid energy systems that can't be effectively run manually with traditional tooling. More intelligent, integrated and autonomous energy operations are needed to lower costs and emissions, reduce manual operator workload and accelerate the whole energy transition by making industrial electrification easier and more economical. Intergrid has emerged as the category leader in autonomous industrial energy operations, with: 100+ industrial sites across Europe already trusting us €20M+ raised from top investors in Finland and Silicon Valley A high-performing 40+ person team from different nationalities and backgrounds at our vibrant Helsinki office We’re an office-first team that values active collaboration and getting to know one another beyond our Zoom profiles. We’d love to see you at our office in Helsinki as often as possible, while recognizing that we all appreciate the option to work remotely from time to time. About the role We're hiring a full-time AI Engineer to join our fast-growing team in Helsinki. We already serve 100+ industrial sites today, and AI is an everyday part of how we work. However, to allow maximal scalability, we want to take it to the next level. This requires going beyond individual productivity tools and agents towards robust, auditable AI-based systems that raise efficiency and quality across the whole company. As our first cross-functional AI Engineer, you'll report to our CTO, work with every team in engineering, operations and commercial, and fundamentally shape how we run as a company. Over time, the role can grow towards a senior expert role or closer to our product and software development team. Key responsibilities Help teams get most of AI: Support teams in mapping and prioritizing areas where automation and AI can deliver most impact. Ship robust AI workflows that run without you: Create software that automates our most critical processes across operations, engineering, and commercial. Raise company-wide quality of AI: Contribute to best practices on how to utilize AI effectively and safely, while keeping the team up to date on AI development that matters most to us. Measure the impact: Measure real outcomes, such as time saved, fewer errors and how we scale customer sites per person, not just adoption. Who we are looking for AI-native builder: You have shipped automated AI-based workflows and systems that people and decisions depend on. Pragmatic problem solver: You quickly understand how a system works, spot where AI can make the biggest difference, and propose solutions that work in practice. High-agency: You take ownership, work independently, and ship and iterate fast. Technically capable: You're comfortable with Python, SQL, data analysis, and working with APIs and integrations. Curious learner: You follow AI developments closely and keep improving both yourself and the way we work. Clear communicator: You work well with people from different backgrounds, and you communicate clearly in English. We also value if you have Experience from a fast-growing startup or scale-up environment. Project management experience and the ability to drive initiatives across several teams. Interest in energy, power markets or industrial operations. What we offer Values-driven culture : Be part of a culture built on kindness, curiosity, and creating win-win-win outcomes for customers, planet, and our success. Build with AI where it matters : Energy keeps everything, including AI, running. It’s also one of the slowest adopters of new technologies due to legacy systems and strict security requirements. Competitive salary & stock options : Reflecting your experience and commitment to our shared success. Real ownership and impact : A company-wide mandate and impact you can see across the whole organisation. Fast-track your career : Take on meaningful responsibilities within days, not months. Top talents advance quickly when Intergrid is growing this fast. Thrive in our Helsinki HQ : Vibrant, supportive, and inclusive office-first environment. Our hiring process will typically follow these steps: First discussion (45 min) Get to know each other, learn about your motivation and previous experience. Discussion about the role and your potential fit with Intergrid, including our mission, vision, and ways of working. You are more than welcome to visit our office. Case interview (90 min) Show off your skills in a hands-on case at our office, where you'll build an autonomous AI workflow and walk us through your reasoning. We'll also use this session to explore your growth potential and get to know you beyond your CV: what drives you and what experiences have shaped you. Summer Job – Data Science & A.I. (Performance office) Tasks: We are looking for two summer students to work on the following tasks: • Turn data and AI into practical business solutions. • Work on real business challenges, exploring how AI, GenAI, data and digital technologies can improve the way we work and make decisions. • You may analyze data, prototype AI applications, test new technologies and help bring solutions into real business use. • The role goes beyond coding, giving you hands-on experience across technology, business transformation and change. Preferred background: • 3rd or 4th year Master’s student in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, geoscience or a related quantitative discipline. • Curiosity about AI, data and technology and an interest in solving real business problems are important. • Relevant industry or work experience is an advantage. • Fluency in English oral and written • Proactive, structured self-motivated and solution oriented • Computer proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Additional Information: Please combine your CV, motivation letter, and latest grade documentation within a single document, as only one file can be submitted as your application. Applicants should already live or be able to accommodate themselves at the work location (Stavanger) for the duration of the summer job. Deadline for applications: 6 December 2026 Profile description: About Harbour Energy Since its creation in 2014, Harbour has grown to become one of the world’s largest and most geographically diverse independent oil and gas companies. As part of its growth journey the company successfully completed the acquisition of Wintershall Dea’s upstream assets in September 2024. Today, Harbour is producing between 475,000 and 485,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day with significant production in Norway, the UK, Germany, Argentina and North Africa. With low GHG emissions intensity and a leading CO2 storage position in Europe, Harbour remains committed to producing oil and gas safely and responsibly to help meet the world’s energy needs. Harbour is a global company with approximately 5,000 staff and contractors across its operations and offices. Our office in Norway is based in Stavanger with around 350 employees.

items.desc: About Us ERGO Technology & Services S.A. (ET&S), a member of the Munich Re and ERGO Group, is delivering integrated IT and business services to international markets. Our expertise lies in providing advanced IT services, with a focus on modern, business-driven technology solutions. On the business side, we also support the Group in various end-to-end insurance processes, including finance, operations, and underwriting. With offices in Warsaw and Gdansk, and strong global partnerships, we foster a dynamic, multicultural environment that promotes diversity and international opportunities. About the role As an Actuarial Data Scientist, you will work with stakeholders across the business to implement pricing applications, bridging the gap between technical possibility and business impact, while actively fostering innovations that enhance our pricing strategies. You will be part of a global team responsible for the German market. How you will get the job done delivering actuarial and data science support for pricing, risk, and analytics initiatives developing and enhance pricing, risk, and predictive models, including machine learning solutions supporting pricing projects from data analysis and modeling to implementation and delivery analyzing market and business data to generate actionable insights and recommendations monitoring and improving model performance through validation and optimization activities developing dashboards, reports, and analytical tools to support decision-making collaborate with stakeholders and senior actuaries to deliver high-quality analytical solutions Skills and experience you will need fluency in English successfully completed degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field experience with actuarial and pricing tools such as Akur8, WTW Pricing Suite, ResQ, R, SAS, Power BI, Tableau, or similar solutions familiarity with cloud technologies such as Azure, AWS, or Databricks knowledge of predictive modeling, machine learning, and actuarial analytics experience building, validating, and monitoring analytical models strong analytical mindset and problem-solving skills ability to communicate insights effectively through reports, dashboards, and data visualizations What we offer Let's be healthy – medical package, sports card, and numerous sports sections – these are some of the beneﬁts that help our employees stay in good shape. Let's be fun – company- wide bike races and soccer matches, ﬁlm marathons in our cinema room or other engaging team-building activities – we got it covered! Let's be diverse – every team member is valued, regardless of gender, nationality, religious beliefs, disability, age, and sexual orientation or identity. Your qualiﬁcations, experience, and mindset are our greatest beneﬁt!

items.desc: Informations générales Statut: Employé de l'État Groupe d'indemnité: A1 Date limite de candidature: 27/11/2026 Ministère: Ministère des Finances Administration/Organisme: Administration des contributions directes Lieu: Hesperange Tâche: Tâche complète Nombre de postes vacants: 1 Type de contrat: CDI Nationalité: Être ressortissant UE Catégorie de métiers: Technologie de l'information et de la communication Qui recrute ? L’Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) recherche un Data Scientist pour son Département Données, Analyses & IA. Le candidat contribuera à la valorisation du patrimoine de données de l'ACD en développant des solutions analytiques, des pipelines de données et des modèles avancés pour soutenir les activités opérationnelles (e.g., priorisation d’audit), les analyses stratégiques (e.g., pour réformes fiscales) et les initiatives d'intelligence artificielle. Missions Collaborer avec les équipes métier et IT afin de transformer les besoins opérationnels en solutions data innovantes et pérennes ; Réaliser des analyses ad hoc et produire des KPI afin de soutenir le pilotage opérationnel et stratégique de l’ACD ; Développer des modèles analytiques, statistiques et d’intelligence artificielle répondant aux besoins des métiers ; Concevoir et maintenir les pipelines de traitement de données ainsi que les jeux de données analytiques nécessaires aux analyses et à l’intelligence artificielle ; Participer à la conception et la maintenance des applications et services data permettant la diffusion et l’exploitation des résultats analytiques ; Participer à l’évolution de la plateforme de données de l’ACD en veillant à la qualité, la performance et la fiabilité des données. Profil Compétences techniques Maîtrise des technologies de développement et de traitement des données (Python, SQL et technologies associées) ; Connaissance des techniques de traitement et d'analyse de données non structurées (NLP, extraction d'informations, LLM, IA générative, etc.) ; Expérience dans la conception, le développement et l'industrialisation de solutions Data et IA ; Solides connaissances en statistiques, machine learning, intelligence artificielle et analyse avancée des données ; Capacité à transformer des problématiques métier complexes en solutions analytiques et data-driven ; Expérience dans le développement rapide de prototypes et leur évolution vers des solutions opérationnelles. Compétences comportementales Rigueur, autonomie, pédagogie et collaboration multidisciplinaire ; Adaptabilité aux évolutions réglementaires et technologiques ; Motivation et capacité d’apprentissage rapide pour maîtriser les spécificités fiscales internationales. Atouts Expérience dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions basées sur l’IA générative créant une valeur métier mesurable ; Une exposition à un environnement fiscal ou réglementé (finance, assurance, administration publique) est un atout clé pour ce rôle. Conditions d’admission Ce poste est à pourvoir sous le statut d'employé de l'État. En savoir plus sur le statut d'employé de l'État Niveau d’études Vous êtes titulaire d’un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d’enseignement supérieur reconnu par l’État du siège de l’établissement et sanctionnant l’accomplissement avec succès d’un master en informatique, mathématiques, data science en informatique ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Expérience Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine. Langues Vous devez remplir les conditions générales de connaissance des trois langues administratives. Une dispense de deux des trois langues administratives peut être accordée sous certaines conditions. Nationalité Vous êtes ressortissant d’un État membre de l’Union européenne. Documents à fournir Lettre de motivation, copie du diplôme, CV Pour ce poste, vous devez obligatoirement postuler en ligne via MyGuichet, les candidatures via courriel ou via courrier postal n’étant pas acceptées. Les documents sont à introduire via MyGuichet en format pdf (taille maximale 20 Mo).

Beratend stehen wir Unternehmen bei grundlegenden Analysen und weitreichenden Entscheidungen im strategischen, operativen und finanziellen Bereich zur Seite und sorgen für deren konsequente Umsetzung. Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam auf abwechslungsreichen Teamevents und kommen bei regelmäßigen After-Work-Drinks und -Dinners zusammen. Uns ist wichtig, deinen Einsatz bereits in der studentischen Mitarbeit mit einer überdurchschnittlichen Vergütung zu honorieren und dich damit beim Absolvieren deines Studiums zu unterstützen. Let’s connect: Neben verschiedenen Teamevents laden wir dich zu unseren Netzwerktreffen sowie den wöchentlichen Connect@FTI-Andersch Lunches mit anderen Studierenden ein. Set the foundation: Du setzt den Grundstein für eine langfristige Karriere in der führenden Turnaround- und Transformationsberatung und kannst wertvolle Kontakte knüpfen. Perspectives: Bei exzellenten Leistungen hast du nach Ende deiner Tätigkeit die Möglichkeit, Teil unseres Talentprogramms Inside@FTI-Andersch zu werden und von exklusiven Benefits zu profitieren, unter anderem einem Angebot für den Festeinstieg. items.desc: Die Capgemini Engineering Service GmbH ist Teil von Capgemini Engineering, dem weltweit führenden Anbieter von Ingenieurdienstleistungen. Gemeinsam bringen wir ein globales Team von Ingenieur*innen, Wissenschaftler*innen und Architekt*innen zusammen, um die innovativsten Unternehmen der Welt dabei zu unterstützen, ihr Potenzial zu entfalten. Steige bei uns ein und entdecke eine Karriere voller Möglichkeiten. Wo du wirklich etwas bewirken kannst. Wo kein Tag wie der andere ist. Deine Rolle Du entwickelst, implementierst und betreust Data-Science-, Machine-Learning- und KI-Lösungen für innovative Messsysteme. Du analysierst große Datenmengen und Bilddaten, um neue Erkenntnisse und Optimierungspotenziale zu identifizieren. Du arbeitest eng mit einem interdisziplinären Algorithmus-Team zusammen und erschließt neue Methoden der Datenanalyse. Du treibst Digitalisierungs- und KI-Initiativen von der explorativen Analyse bis zur produktionsreifen Anwendung voran. Du koordinierst Projekte und unterstützt Fachbereiche dabei, neue ML-Potenziale in der EUV-Metrologie erfolgreich umzusetzen. Dein Profil Abgeschlossenes Studium in Physik, Mathematik, Informatik, Data Science, Künstlicher Intelligenz, Ingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in Data-Science-Projekten von der Algorithmenentwicklung über statistische Analysen bis zur Produktivsetzung von Modellen. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Data Analytics, Machine Learning sowie statistischen und algorithmischen Methoden. Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung, OOD-Prinzipien, Test Driven Development, Git und Azure DevOps. Sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. items.desc: Pengon Oy on tekoälyvetoisen analytiikan edelläkävijä, jossa agentit ja automaatiot ovat osa arkea. Arkesi on erittäin tekoälyvetoista: ohjaat jatkuvasti tekoälyagentteja (esim. Claude), katselmoit koodia, viet työtä eteenpäin versionhallinnassa ja jaat toimivia skillejä muulle tiimille. Näiden tehtävien kautta ratkot merkittävien toimialojen liiketoimintahaasteita ja kasvat tavoitteellisesti kohti vastuukonsultin roolia. Saat heti toteutusvastuuta mielenkiintoisissa asiakasprojekteissa sekä edelläkävijän paikan aidosti tekoälyvetoisessa analytiikkakehityksessä. Kasvuasi vastuukonsultiksi tuetaan selkeällä oppimispolulla ja sinulle mahdollistetaan alan halutuimpien Anthropicin ja Microsoftin (esim. DP-600, DP-700) sertifikaattien suorittamisen. Arkeasi tukevat asiantunteva tiimi sekä joustava hybridimalli! Työtehtävät Data ja AI -konsultin rooli on monipuolinen, ja siinä yhdistyvät tietomallinnus, raportointi ja tekoälyvetoinen kehitystyö asiakasrajapinnassa. Työtehtäviin kuuluu muun muassa: Määrittelyjen vastaanotto, rajaukset ja työmääräarviot asiakasprojekteissa. Tietovarastojen, latausten ja tietomallien suunnittelu ja toteutus Microsoft Fabric-, Databricks- tai Azure-alustoille. Power BI- ja Qlik-ratkaisujen sekä konversioiden toteuttaminen. Datan laadun varmistaminen, lukujen täsmäytys ja testaus ennen julkaisua. Tekoälyagenttien (Claude Code) hyödyntäminen ja ohjaaminen kehitystyössä. Työskentely versionhallinnan (GitHub) ja Kanban-mallin mukaisesti. Etsimme Hyvää osaamista vähintään toisesta alustasta: Microsoft Fabric tai Databricks Hyvää Microsoft Power BI -osaamista Kokemusta työnkulkujen automatisoinnista esimerkiksi Power Automatella tai n8n:llä Kokemusta tekoälyagenttien (kuten Claude Code) hyödyntämisestä ohjelmistokehityksessä tai analytiikassa Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa Hyviä kommunikaatio- ja konsultointitaitoja sekä asiakaslähtöistä asennetta Arvostamme, jos sinulla on Hyvää SQL-osaamista ja kokemusta ETL/ELT-latauksista Edistynyttä Python-osaamista ja kokemusta ennustavasta analytiikasta. Microsoft- ja Databricks-sertifikaatit (esim. PL-300, DP-600, DP-700). Toimialaosaamista (esim. energiateollisuus, valmistava teollisuus tai puolustusteollisuus) Ymmärrystä organisaation eri toiminnoista: talous, myynti, tuotanto, logistiikka, hankinta, HR ja IT Omia projekteja, AI-kokeiluja, GitHub-portfolio tai muuta harrastuneisuutta Rekrytointiprosessimme Academic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille. Hakijoita haastatellaan jatkuvasti ja mikäli olemme edenneet jo rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja. Valintaprosessiin sisältyvät luonteenpiirteitä sekä kognitiivista kykyä mittaavat testit. Testit toimivat työkaluina oikean tekijän löytämiseksi tehtävään sekä takaavat tasa-arvoisen ja oikeudenmukaisen arvioinnin. Pengon Oy Pengon on tietojohtamisen asiantuntijayritys, joka auttaa asiakkaitaan hyödyntämään dataa, analytiikkaa ja tekoälyä liiketoiminnan kehittämisessä. Pengon toteuttaa kokonaisvaltaisia ratkaisuja dataintegraatioista ja data-alustoista edistykselliseen analytiikkaan useilla toimialoilla, sekä jalostaa tiedon päätöksenteon tueksi ja kilpailueduksi – tekee siis tiedosta tulosta. Pengonilla työskentelet kokeneiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa ympäristössä, jossa oppimista arvostetaan aidosti. Pengon on pieni ja ketterä asiantuntijayritys, jossa jokaisen panoksella on merkitystä. Pengon rakentaa analytiikkaa tekoälyvetoisesti: agentit, skillit ja automaatiot kuuluvat jokaisen konsultin arkeen. Pengonilla työskentelee monipuolisia asiantuntijoita, ja toimistot sijaitsevat Jyväskylässä ja Vantaalla.

items.desc: Job description: YOUR ROLE As part of its continuous improvement and digital transformation strategy, the Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Department aims to strengthen the use of digital tools and Artificial Intelligence to support risk prevention, regulatory compliance and performance management. This internship is part of a broader initiative to modernize HSE processes, with the objective of improving operational efficiency, the quality of analyses and the monitoring of key performance indicators. WHAT ARE YOU GOING TO DO ? ou will identify and map HSE processes and activities that could benefit from Artificial Intelligence, focusing on high-value use cases You will design and test Generative AI solutions to support HSE activities, including document drafting, field data analysis, audits and inspections, reporting, document management and regulatory monitoring You will develop AI user guidelines and best practices, and support HSE teams in adopting new digital tools through change management initiatives and pilot projects You will analyze existing HSE indicators and reporting needs to define a structured performance monitoring framework You will develop and automate dashboards using Power BI, Excel or other Business Intelligence tools, improving data collection and consolidation You will monitor key HSE performance and prevention indicators, including workplace accidents, near misses, safety audits, corrective actions, regulatory training and compliance You will produce data-driven analyses to support action plans and management decision-making You will contribute to the HSE Department’s AI roadmap, automated reporting system and recommendations for continuous improvement JOB ENVIRONMENT Location: Marseille, France (13) Internship duration: 6 months Travel: No Accessibility: Accessible by public transport Profile description: WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR ? You are currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Engineering, Business or at University, with a specialization in Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation, Information Systems, Risk Management or HSE You have strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly advanced Excel, and good knowledge of Power BI You have a strong interest in Generative AI and are comfortable working with, analyzing and interpreting data Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Copilot is a plus, as well as knowledge of Health, Safety & Environment topics Analytical and curious, you demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset You are autonomous, detail-oriented and proactive, with the ability to suggest and implement new ideas You have strong interpersonal and teamwork skills, as well as excellent written communication abilities

items.desc: About BlockTech BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets. We’re looking for a AI Quantitative Research Intern to join our researchers and traders in Amsterdam. You'll join our option pricing team and work alongside experienced Quantitative Researchers, Traders and Analysts, with a dedicated mentor guiding your project. What will you do? You’ll have the opportunity to help shape an emerging field, taking ownership of designing and improving our agent-driven research framework. You’ll have the freedom to explore new approaches, pioneer solutions, and make a meaningful impact on how we conduct research. You Will Architect our agent-driven research framework, designing networks of agents and harnesses. Design research pipelines and experimentation loops with quants and traders. Build evaluation and feedback mechanisms that show what’s working and what isn’t. Own the framework in use: track how it performs and keep improving it. Share what you learn, so the team keeps improving its AI setup. You’ll Need What we’re looking for To have a background in a highly quantitative field, with a focus on AI (MSc or PhD) At least 6 months of practical experience with LLMs, agents, and harnesses. Comfort designing evaluation and feedback loops that tell you whether an agent is actually improving. High ownership and clear communication. Availability to start in (early) 2027, full-time and on-site in Amsterdam, for a minimum of 12 weeks. Nice to have Experience using AI for quantitative research, such as working on math problems. Python, and exposure to trading. Dates, location, and accommodation Duration: From 12 to 16 weeks, with flexible duration and start date. Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office. After the internship: the opportunity to convert into a full-time role after graduation, based on performance. What Else Is In It For You A dedicated mentor and a great team of colleagues to learn from. An in-house training program and a close look at how engineering, research, and trading work together. An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems. Sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer. Weekly Friday drinks and other celebrations. Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and soft drinks all day. How We Work We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from. You'll be challenged from day one, with a mentor and diverse team around you. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development. Excited to join us? Make your move and apply! You can expect to hear back from us within 5 working days. Our culture At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals. In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities. We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees. Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

items.desc: AI‑Praktikant (Mensch*) I Private Equity Die Hannover Finanz Gruppe ist seit 1979 ein familiengeführter Eigenkapitalpartner für mittelständische Unternehmen in der DACH‑Region. Aktuell betreuen wir 27 Portfoliounternehmen mit über 15.000 Mitarbeitern und einem Umsatz von mehr als 4 Mrd. €. Zu unseren Investoren zählen vor allem Versicherungen, Versorgungswerke und vermögende Privatinvestoren. In den Bereichen HF Equity, HF Debt und HF Opportunities verwalten wir derzeit mehr als 900 Mio. € und haben in der Vergangenheit namhafte Unternehmen wie Fielmann, Rossmann und Aixtron unterstützt. Wir bauen aktuell unsere interne KI-Taskforce weiter aus, um Beteiligungscontrolling, Reporting, Accounting, Value Creation sowie Transaktionsprozesse konsequent zu automatisieren und datengetrieben zu skalieren. Als AI-Praktikant (Mensch*) im Team Financial Excellence arbeitest Du direkt an dieser Schnittstelle aus Finanzanalyse und angewandter KI. Mit dem Ziel, manuelle Prozesse durch KI-Agenten und automatisierte Workflows abzulösen. Deine Aufgaben: Mitarbeit am Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung KI-gestützter Automatisierungslösungen für das Beteiligungscontrolling (KI-Agenten, Power Automate, Make, n8n, Copilot, Power BI) von der Prozessanalyse über das Prompt-Design bis zum Testing im Livebetrieb. Identifikation und Bewertung von Automatisierungspotenzialen entlang der PortCo-Reporting-Architektur: Wo lassen sich wiederkehrende Analyse-, Konsolidierungs- und Reportingschritte durch KI-Workflows und No-Code/Low-Code-Automatisierung ersetzen oder beschleunigen? Unterstützung bei der Durchführung des monatlichen Beteiligungscontrollings, einschließlich der Analyse der finanziellen Performance unserer Portfoliounternehmen als fachliche Basis für die zu automatisierenden Prozesse. Mitwirkung an der Erstellung von Finanzberichten und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Geschäftsführung und Gremien, zunehmend KI-gestützt vorbereitet und aufbereitet. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachexperten aus Controlling und IT sowie externen Partnern bei der Entwicklung, dem Testing und der Skalierung von KI-Agenten für das "Beteiligungscontrolling 2.0“ sowie in der internen IT-Infrastruktur (u.a. Data Warehouse). Laufende Weiterentwicklung und Dokumentation von Automatisierungslösungen und Mitgestaltung interner Best Practices für den KI-Einsatz im gesamten Unternehmen und perspektivisch auch bei den PortCos. Dein Profil: Du bist mindestens im 4. Semester eines Bachelor-Studiums in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL, Finanzen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit belastbarem technischem und betriebswirtschaftlichem Grundverständnis. Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an der praktischen Anwendung von KI mit und hast Dich bereits mit Prompt-Engineering, KI-Agenten oder Automatisierungstools wie Make, n8n oder Power Automate auseinandergesetzt. Erste eigene Projekte oder konkrete Anwendungsfälle sind ein Plus. Erste Erfahrung mit Python, SQL oder idealerweise einer anderen für KI-Entwicklung relevanten Programmiersprache (z. B. R, JavaScript) sowie Neugier auf KI-gestützte Entwicklungsumgebungen wie Claude Code, Cursor oder Copilot sind von Vorteil. Du musst kein Softwareentwickler sein, solltest aber keine Scheu vor Code und technischen Tools haben. Erste praktische Erfahrungen durch vorherige Praktika in den Bereichen Data Analytics/KI, Unternehmensberatung, Private Equity oder Controlling sind von Vorteil. Du denkst analytisch und prozessorientiert: Du erkennst nicht nur, wo Zahlen herkommen, sondern auch, wo und wie sich ein Prozess sinnvoll automatisieren lässt. Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office (primär Excel und PowerPoint); Erfahrung mit Power BI oder ähnlichen BI-/Automatisierungstools ist von Vorteil. Du hast Dir bereits konkrete Gedanken gemacht, wie KI im Private-Equity-Kontext wertsteigernd eingesetzt werden kann – sowohl in Portfoliounternehmen als auch intern zur Effizienzsteigerung. Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und Kommunikationsstärke zeichnen Dich aus. Du bist motiviert, engagiert und bereit, Verantwortung für eigene Automatisierungsprojekte zu übernehmen. Wir bieten Dir: Direkten Einblick in den Aufbau einer KI-gestützten Reporting- und Controlling-Architektur in einer etablierten Private-Equity-Gruppe. Kein Zuarbeiten, sondern aktive Mitgestaltung. Ein dynamisches und vielseitiges Arbeitsumfeld mit spannenden Projekten an der Schnittstelle von Finance und KI sowie echten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Die Chance, konkrete Automatisierungslösungen zu entwickeln, die im Tagesgeschäft der Hannover Finanz und ihrer Portfoliounternehmen zum Einsatz kommen. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns, wie KI das Beteiligungscontrolling der Zukunft prägt! items.desc: Position description Category Engineering science Contract Internship Job title Stage Steering LLM to inhibit biases- Saclay-H/F Subject Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly capable of processing and integrating information from multiple modalities, including text, images, audio, and speech. However, these models can inherit and amplify biases across modalities, potentially affecting the fairness, reliability, and robustness of their outputs. This internship will investigate steering-based approaches to identify and inhibit such biases at the model level, with the goal of developing more controllable and robust multimodal LLMs. Contract duration (months) 6 mois Job Description As an intern at the CEA, you will have the opportunity to work in a world-renowned research environment. Our teams consist of passionate and dedicated experts, providing an environment conducive to learning and collaboration. You will have access to state-of-the-art equipment and top-tier research resources to carry out your assignments. The work performed may potentially lead to a scientific publication. Context Through the thesis of Clément Cornet, the team has already developped several approaches of steering and other works in mechanistic interpretability [1,2]. A large part of the work is integrated into a light python library that can serve as basis for the work. What do we expect from you ? The intern will work on the following tasks : Conduct a literature review on methods for bias in inhibition in multimodal LLMs with steering Conduct experiments with available steering approaches to inhibate biases, including a rigorous quantitative evaluation on well chosen models and modalities Develop novel approaches to inhibate biases with steering, in particular to determine its strength automatically Develop a demonstrator to showcase the work carried out Depending on the profile and motivation of the intern, the work may lead to a scientific publication and may be pursued with a PhD focused on a similar topic. The person will work in collaboration with Clement Cornet, Hervé Le Borgne, Romaric Besançon and possibly other researchers of the lab, depending on the direction of the work. [1] Cornet et al (2025) Explaining How Visual, Textual and Multimodal Encoders Share Concepts, CoRR:2507.18512 [2] Cornet et al (2026) The Deleuzian Representation Hypothesis, ICLR # Cea List Methods / Means Python - PyTorch Applicant Profile Profil : Students in their final year of studies (M2 or last year of engineering school) Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning Interest in mechanistic interpretability and bias of AI models Python proficiency in pytorch Position location Site Saclay Job location France, Ile-de-France, Essonne (91) Location Saclay Candidate criteria Prepared diploma Bac+5 - Master 2 Requester Position start date 01/12/2026

items.desc: Onderzoek hoe we complexe documentstromen slimmer, inzichtelijker en beter beheersbaar kunnen maken. Opleidingsniveau: Hbo Studierichting: ICT, softwareontwikkeling, informatica of vergelijkbaar Soort opdracht: Meewerk- of afstudeeropdracht Start, duur en uren: Februari 2027. 5 Maanden. Uren in afstemming. Standplaats en hybride werken: Dedemsvaart De opdracht Binnen Vrieling worden vanuit ANVA documenten en gegevens aangeboden aan PlanetPress. Daarna worden deze verwerkt en verspreid via onder andere e-mail, de online klantomgeving en print en post. Achter dit proces zit een digitale outputstraat met applicaties, scripts, workflows, bestanden, mappenstructuren en loggegevens. De onderdelen werken samen, maar de werking en status van het totale proces zijn niet altijd op één plek inzichtelijk. Daardoor kost het soms tijd om te bepalen waar een document zich bevindt, waarom een verwerking is vastgelopen of welke herstelactie nodig is. Jij brengt de belangrijkste documentstromen en knelpunten in kaart. Op basis van technisch onderzoek en gesprekken met beheerders ontwikkel je met AI-ondersteunde softwareontwikkeling één of meerdere praktische hulpmiddelen. Op basis van je onderzoek bepaal en onderbouw je samen met je opleiding, bedrijfsbegeleider en betrokken collega’s welke oplossingsrichting de meeste waarde biedt. Mogelijke oplossingsrichtingen Een dashboard voor de status en voortgang van documentverwerkingen. Een hulpmiddel voor loganalyse en foutsignalering. Een controle op verwachte en daadwerkelijk verwerkte documenten. Een signalering voor ontbrekende of vastgelopen documenten. Een beheer-, rapportage- of documentatietool. Wat ga je doen en wat verwachten we van jou? Je zet zelfstandig een passende onderzoeksaanpak op en stemt deze af met je opleiding en bedrijfsbegeleider. Je haalt behoeften op bij beheerders en andere betrokken collega’s en vertaalt deze naar concrete eisen. Je analyseert bestaande systemen, scripts, bestanden, loggegevens en technische documentatie. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en test één of meerdere proof of concepts of prototypes. Je gebruikt AI-tools en vibe coding zorgvuldig en verantwoord. Gegenereerde code beoordeel, test en onderbouw je. Je legt keuzes helder vast en gaat zorgvuldig om met privacy, informatiebeveiliging en vertrouwelijke gegevens. Wat lever je op? Een beschrijving van de digitale outputstraat en de belangrijkste documentstromen. Een analyse van knelpunten, risico’s en verbeterkansen. Een onderbouwd oplossingsontwerp met één of meerdere werkende prototypes. Test- en validatieresultaten. Technische documentatie, beheerinstructies en aanbevelingen voor vervolgontwikkeling. Het resultaat hoeft niet direct productie klaar te zijn. Het moet aantonen dat de gekozen richting technisch uitvoerbaar, veilig te beoordelen en praktisch bruikbaar is. In welk team kom je terecht en hoe word je begeleid? Je voert de opdracht uit binnen de ICT-omgeving van Vrieling. Je werkt samen met collega’s uit onder andere applicatiebeheer, technisch beheer, procesanalyse, productmanagement en ICT-management. Ook spreek je medewerkers die dagelijks met de outputstraat werken. Je krijgt een vaste bedrijfsbegeleider en vakinhoudelijke ondersteuning van collega’s met kennis van de systemen en documentstromen. Zij helpen je bij het begrijpen van de huidige situatie en zijn beschikbaar voor interviews, feedback en validatie. Waar mogelijk krijg je toegang tot relevante documentatie, voorbeelden, loggegevens en een test- of acceptatieomgeving. Je werkt met geanonimiseerde, fictieve of afgeschermde testgegevens. Wijzigingen in productie voer je niet zelfstandig door. Code, scripts en configuratiewijzigingen worden vooraf beoordeeld door je bedrijfsbegeleider of een betrokken beheerder. Wie zoeken we? Deze opdracht past bij een hbo-student in de richting ICT, softwareontwikkeling, informatica of vergelijkbaar. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar bestaande techniek, combineert graag onderzoek met praktisch ontwikkelen en durft vragen te stellen. Ervaring met programmeren of scripting is gewenst. Belangrijker is dat je zorgvuldig werkt, wilt leren en jouw keuzes kunt uitleggen. Interesse? Krijg jij energie van het onderzoeken van technische processen en wil je ontdekken wat AI hierin praktisch kan betekenen? Solliciteer dan direct via de sollicitatiebutton! Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Heb je toch eerst nog vragen? Neem dan contact op met Daniëlle Timmerman, onze Corporate Recruiter, via d.timmerman@vrieling.nl. Bellen mag natuurlijk ook, via 06 23 95 13 38.
