Develop and deploy
items.desc: Full time Hamburg or Siegen eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future. We are looking for a Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and build and operate the scalable, secure cloud platform that connects users with our trapped-ion quantum computers. Responsibilities: You will join our Quantum firmware Team as a Cloud Engineer. You will build the layer through which the world reaches our quantum computers. Users submit quantum programs; your services compile, schedule, and dispatch them to our machines and return the results: Build and operate the cloud services that let users submit quantum programs to our systems and retrieve their results. Develop and deploy our compilation pipeline as a scalable cloud service , from circuit input through transpilation down to hardware-level instructions Design and maintain the public API and SDK entry points to our platform Implement job queuing, scheduling, and dispatch towards the hardware backends, including quota, prioritisation, and result handling Own authentication and authorisation across the platform: user and tenant identity, API keys and tokens, and role-based access to machines, jobs, and results, built on an established identity provider rather than from scratch Guarantee tenant isolation, so that quantum programs and results are never visible across customer boundaries, and manage secrets and credentials across the stack Work with the quantum firmware and hardware teams on the interfaces between cloud services and the machine itself Instrument the platform for observability and keep an eye on latency, throughput, and cost Required Skills: 3+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying backend or platform services in production Strong Python; additional systems-level language experience (Go, Rust, C++) is welcome Solid API design skills (REST and/or gRPC) for services other developers have to use Practical experience implementing authentication and authorisation in production systems: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, token handling, and role-based access control Secure engineering habits: least privilege by default, proper secrets management, and awareness of dependency and container supply-chain risks Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar) Working understanding of GDPR and data residency requirements, and a genuine interest in digital sovereignty Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage for working with public-sector partners Nice to have (Bonus) Running an identity provider in production (Keycloak, Zitadel, Ory, Authentik, or a managed IAM service) Multi-tenant isolation patterns in SaaS platforms Contributing to security certification work (ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, BSI C5) or acting on penetration test findings Familiarity with quantum SDKs and toolchains (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, QIR) or hardware abstraction interfaces such as QDMI Batch scheduling or HPC environments (Slurm or similar) Observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry Prior exposure to quantum computing or other deep-tech domains What you can expect from eleQtron: Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements Flexible working hours : We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development Wellness Package : We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus At the forefront : Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms

items.desc: About the Role NPL is seeking an experienced Higher Scientist based in Teddington to plan and deliver a number of technical activities to take our research to the next level. This full-time Research Scientist job comes with a generous salary and benefits package. As a Higher Scientist, you'll be expected to acquire new knowledge to find solutions to advance our research. Also, if commercial opportunities arise from your work, you'll need to flag these – as this is how new products and services are born. At NPL, we learn from each other, respect each other, and work together to do better for ourselves and our customers. Your primary responsibilities will include: Sharing your learnings so that we all benefit and mentoring those with less experience than you Developing partnerships to strengthen our capability Acting as an ambassador for our work externally and being willing to promote what we do Providing technical support for any bids, we may be undertaking About You This position is within the Dimensional Metrology Group at NPL and will primarily focus on theme of volumetric dimensional metrology. Applicants should have demonstrable expertise in the development, maintenance, and/or use of non-contact metrology instruments, such as laser trackers, optical CMMs, laser line scanners, and X-ray computed tomography (XCT) systems. Experience in calibrating and establishing traceability for these systems is highly desirable. A relevant PhD, EngD, or equivalent industrial metrology experience is required. The successful candidate will help to establish and run a range of measurement services and deliver bespoke technical solutions to customers via contract consultancy, while supporting the ongoing maintenance, research and development activities within our Critical Measurement Infrastructure and Applied Metrology projects. The successful candidate will support and contribute to deliver measurement service to internal and external customers. To be highly successful in this Higher Scientist role, you should be confident in: Planning and efficiently delivering complex activities both individually, and as part of a team. Following established procedures and standards, to support the quality team to ensure activities are completed to the highest standards. Challenging yourself and others, developing and exploring new ideas for improvement and taking these from conception to fruition. Communicating technical outputs and establishing connections with internal and external stakeholders/customers. Beyond that, we're looking for someone who will thrive in a diverse scientific environment like ours. Being a member of a multi-disciplinary team, you will be expected to develop, capture, exploit, and transfer your technical knowledge to support the continued development of expertise within the group and may be called upon to mentor junior members. Essential skills: Ability to think creatively and solve problems independently A desire to expand their knowledge and skills across multiple adjacent fields Strong written and verbal communication skills Demonstrable expertise in the development, maintenance and/or use of state-of-the-art non-contact metrology instruments. Understanding of the fundamental operating principles of various non-contact metrology systems including laser trackers, optical CMMs, laser line scanners, and/or X-ray computed tomography (XCT) systems. Desirable skills: The following skills would be advantageous, but not essential: Knowledge of measurement uncertainty budgeting and calculations. Experience with calibrating and establishing traceability for a measurement tool. Knowledge of data processing, analytics and visualisation using commercial metrology software. Knowledge of a programming language such as Python, MatLAB, or LabVIEW for bespoke data analysis and/or instrument control. Proven ability to document, present, and publish complex results. Project/activity costing, planning, and management experience. At NPL, we set the standards by which everything is measured. In doing so, the National Physical Laboratory is helping to combat issues on a global scale such as climate change, curing diseases, and the development of cutting-edge communications technology. Our role is to research, create and deliver the measurement infrastructure which underpins the UK's prosperity and quality of life across many fields of industry. We actively recruit citizens of all backgrounds, but the nature of our work in specific departments means that nationality, residency and security requirements can be more tightly defined than others. You will be asked about this throughout the recruitment process. To work at NPL, you will need to obtain BPSS security clearance. Please note: Applications will be reviewed, and interviews conducted throughout the duration of this advert therefore we may at any time bring the closing date forward. We encourage all interested applicants to apply as soon as possible. About Us The National …

items.card: You will build the computational foundations and state estimation suites for our multi-modal sensor systems (RGB cameras, LiDARs, IMUs) and ensure these algorithms run seamlessly on physical hardware. If you have a deep passion for writing clean, performant software, solving complex state estimation problems, and deploying your solutions directly onto advanced robotic platforms, you will want to join us. What You'll
items.desc: Our Mission Our mission is to solve the most important and fundamental challenges in AI and Robotics to enable future generations of intelligent machines that will help us all live better lives. We are looking for exceptional Master's and PhD graduates to join our team full-time as the critical bridge between algorithmic research and on-robot deployment. This role sits at the intersection of state estimation, sensor calibration, and high-performance systems engineering. You will build the computational foundations and state estimation suites for our multi-modal sensor systems (RGB cameras, LiDARs, IMUs) and ensure these algorithms run seamlessly on physical hardware. If you have a deep passion for writing clean, performant software, solving complex state estimation problems, and deploying your solutions directly onto advanced robotic platforms, you will want to join us. What You'll Do Play a key role in developing and integrating robust, real-time state-estimation pipelines for multimodal sensor systems. Write robust, low-latency modern C++ code for real-time execution directly on robotic hardware, optimizing for embedded platforms like the Jetson family of devices. Apply classical optimization (e.g., factor graphs) as well as learning algorithms to practical, real-world robotics problems. Profile, benchmark, and eliminate performance bottlenecks in resource-constrained Linux environments. Design and build clean, scalable software components using modern software engineering practices and ROS 2. Work collaboratively with researchers to provide a solid foundation for building advanced robotic systems, making complex algorithms easy to use and deploy. What You'll Need A Master's (MS) degree or a completed (or soon-to-be-completed) PhD degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Vision, Computational Science & Engineering, or a related field; early-career and junior candidates with a few years of experience are highly encouraged and welcomed to apply. Exceptional core software engineering foundations with mandatory proficiency in Modern C++ and Python, including system architecture, data structures, and memory management. Solid understanding of state estimation and optimization techniques, with familiarity in factor graph optimization (ideally including experience with GTSAM). Proven software engineering experience (e.g., industry internships, significant open-source contributions, or complex project work demonstrating system design capabilities). A strong interest in building robust tools that support both cutting-edge robotics research and real-world deployment. Bonus While strong core software engineering and state estimation fundamentals are required, experience in any of the following areas is a massive plus: State Estimation & Fusion: Experience with multi-sensor state estimation, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), or SLAM algorithms. Hardware Acceleration & ML Systems: Experience with GPU programming, CUDA, parallel processing, or optimizing embedded neural network inference and hardware-level ML acceleration. Open Source Contributions: Significant open source projects that showcase your problem-solving skills in robotics, computer vision, or high-performance computing. Physics & Simulation: Familiarity with computational physics, rendering pipelines (e.g., Gaussian splatting), or scalable software infrastructure for GPU-based simulation. items.desc: Vill du arbeta med utveckling av AI i avancerade signalspaningssystem? Vill du bidra till att omsätta forskning till nya verktyg och arbetssätt i en verksamhet med höga krav på informationssäkerhet? Då kan FOI vara din nya arbetsplats! Vi erbjuder ett arbetsliv i balans, en utvecklande arbetsmiljö och ett samhällsviktigt arbete! Telekrigsområdet hos FOI i Linköping befinner sig i en mycket expansiv fas och nu söker vi dig som vill bidra inom signalspaning mot radiokommunikation. Du får en viktig roll i en verksamhet där vi varje dag bidrar till att stärka Sveriges säkerhet. Vi är en arbetsplats med en stor gemenskap där du som är nyfiken på ny teknik och har god samarbetsförmåga kommer trivas. Du arbetar tillsammans med erfarna forskare och ingenjörer med olika tekniska kompetenser. Om tjänsten Du kommer att arbeta med programmering och systemutveckling för att omsätta AI-teknik i praktiskt fungerande lösningar som stödjer vår forskning och teknikutveckling. Arbetsuppgifterna varierar beroende på projekt och kan omfatta utveckling av mjukvara, anpassning och utvärdering av AI-modeller samt integration i våra experiment- och demonstratorsystem. Du får följa arbetet från idé till färdigt system, samtidigt som du får möjlighet att utvecklas inom ditt specialistområde. En del av arbetet handlar också om att utveckla och tillgängliggöra AI-baserade verktyg för våra medarbetare och stödja kollegor i hur tekniken kan användas. Informationssäkerhet är en avgörande del av vår verksamhet, vilket ställer särskilda krav på kontrollerade miljöer, lokal modellkörning och säker informationshantering. Vi arbetar i projektform där din insats blir en viktig del av helheten och där du har stora möjligheter att påverka resultaten. Vi värdesätter att du vill ta ansvar, dela med dig av din kompetens och bidra till andras framgång. För dig som har intresse finns möjlighet att ta ett större ansvar och på sikt leda tekniska projekt. Vi genomför praktiska tester och mätningar i verklig radiomiljö, vilket innebär att arbetet även kan ske utanför kontor och laboratorier. Om enheten Du kommer att ingå i en teknisk inriktad enhet som arbetar med system för radiokommunikation och signalspaning som tillhör avdelningen Telekrig. Tillsammans med kollegor inom radioområdet utvecklar och anpassar vi tekniska lösningar för att radiokommunikation ska kunna förstås, skyddas och påverkas i krävande miljöer. Enheten Spaning mot radiokommunikation utvecklar metoder för att upptäcka, identifiera och lokalisera radiosändare samt analysera hur kommunikationssystem fungerar. Vi arbetar med hela kedjan – från antenner och mottagarsystem till mjukvara för signalanalys, inklusive konstruktion, integration och test av prototyper. Vi finns nära våra uppdragsgivare i Försvarsmakten, men har även goda kontakter i den akademiska världen och försvarsindustrin. Har du den kompetensprofil vi behöver? Krav Vi Söker Dig Som Har civilingenjörsexamen med en relevant inriktning mot AI och maskininlärning, eller annan erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Vad erbjuder vi dig? Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI) är en statlig myndighet som bedriver världsledande forskning inom försvar och säkerhet till stöd för Sveriges militära och civila försvar. Vi erbjuder en unik arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta med det som är viktigt för totalförsvaret och hela samhället. Forskningen tillämpas både inom försvarsmyndigheter och hos civila aktörer och spelar en avgörande roll i att bygga en relevant och effektiv försvarsförmåga. Vi arbetar medvetet för en god arbetsmiljö med en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Utöver detta erbjuder vi en rad förmåner. items.desc: You’ve been building your knowledge at university. Ready to see what you can do with it? Studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or Business Analytics? At Progeny, we’re looking for curious graduates who enjoy technology, have ideas to share and want to solve real-world problems. Bring your enthusiasm, and we’ll help you build your skills. You’ll join us in a full-time, permanent role on a two-year structured programme. Get hands-on experience from day one, build your technical skills and confidence, and work towards your next step as an Associate. What will you actually be doing? You’ll help build and develop business applications, automate everyday tasks, connect systems and turn data into useful insights using tools like Power Platform and Azure. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you’ll explore how AI can make technology work smarter, solve problems and help keep our digital tools secure, reliable and easy to use. Who are we looking for? We’re not expecting you to know everything on day one. We’d Love To Hear From You If You Enjoy solving problems and coming up with creative ways to make technology work smarter. Ask questions and enjoy trying new things. Enjoy working with others and sharing ideas. Have a strong degree in Digital, Data, Computing, Business Analytics, Engineering or a related subject. Understand the basics of how apps, data or digital systems work. Have tried, or are keen to explore, Power Platform, APIs that connect systems and cloud tools such as Azure. Are curious about how AI is evolving and how tools like Azure AI Foundry can solve real-world problems. Think logically, notice the details and keep your work organised. Are ready to learn new tools and explain your ideas clearly. What’s in it for you? Support from a dedicated line manager and technical mentor, so you have people to turn to as you learn. Regular feedback and chats about your development, so you know how you’re doing and what to focus on next. A clear learning plan, with opportunities to gain certifications and keep building your skills as you progress. Time to build the basics in year one, then take on more responsibility and bigger challenges in year two. You’ll also get 30 days’ holiday plus statutory public holidays, private medical insurance and a workplace pension. Why Progeny? We bring financial planning, tax, legal and asset management experts together in one business. Technology helps those teams work together and support our clients, so you’ll see how your skills make a difference beyond the screen. Our values are simple: We Connect. We Care. We’re Clear. That means working together, supporting each other and making space for questions and fresh ideas. Ready to turn your curiosity into a career? Start here.

items.desc: Kort Om Os FoodVoice bygger Freja, en AI-telefonmedarbejder, der tager imod takeaway-bestillinger på dansk for pizzeriaer og restauranter. Hun tager telefonen, når køkkenet har travlt, og sender ordren direkte ud på bonprinteren. Vi startede i juni 2026, har de første restauranter live og rigtige opkald hver eneste dag. Nu skal produktet fra godt til fremragende. Opgaven Du får ansvaret for det vigtigste i vores produkt: at Freja hører rigtigt, svarer rigtigt og får ordren rigtigt første gang. Det Betyder Blandt Andet, At Du ejer stemmekvaliteten: talegenkendelse, turtagning og ordrebekræftelse lytter til rigtige opkald, finder mønstrene i fejlene og retter dem bygger og vedligeholder et fast testsæt, så rettelser ikke forsvinder i næste udgivelse arbejder med prompts, nøgleord og menudata for hver restaurant styrer udgivelserne, så hver ny version er bedre end den forrige måler det hele på et tal: andelen af korrekte ordrer Ansvar for løbende features og implementeringer Hvem du er Du har dansk som modersmål. Du skal kunne høre forskel på “tolv” og “tre” på en dårlig forbindelse fredag aften. Du har arbejdet med sprogmodeller i praksis: prompts, værktøjskald og test. Du kan som udgangspunkt kode basalt og selv rette det, du finder (Python eller TypeScript). Du går systematisk til værks og vil hellere måle end gætte. Erfaring med tale-AI (fx ElevenLabs, talegenkendelse eller telefoni) er et plus, men ikke et krav. Hvad vi tilbyder En nøglerolle i en ung virksomhed, hvor dit arbejde kan mærkes hos kunderne samme uge. Du arbejder tæt sammen med direktøren, vores udviklere og vores kundeteam. Rigtige data fra første dag: hundredvis af rigtige samtaler at lære af. Kontor i København fra januar 2027 og fleksibilitet til at arbejde hjemmefra. Løn: 30.000–37.000 kr. om måneden efter erfaring. Praktisk Fuld tid, med start hurtigst muligt. Arbejdssted: Remote i 2026. Fra Januar 2027 i København på vores nye kontor. Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV. Fortæl os gerne om et problem, du har løst med en sprogmodel, og hvordan du målte, at det virkede. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

items.desc: Vår verksamhet Vill du arbeta med utveckling av hållbara AI-lösningar? AI Center är Region Uppsalas centrala funktion för ansvarsfull och värdeskapande artificiell intelligens inom bland annat hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, administration och regional utveckling. I tvärfunktionella team arbetar vi från behov och data till utveckling, drift, uppföljning och förvaltning. Vi utvecklar vår plattform och arbetar med dataanalys, analysnära datautveckling (analytics engineering), maskininlärning och produktionsnära AI-utveckling. Vi förenar verksamhetskunskap, teknik, drift och regelefterlevnad med datakvalitet, spårbarhet, dokumentation och återanvändbara lösningar som grund. Ditt uppdrag Som teknisk dataanalytiker bedömer du databehov, betydelse och kvalitet för lösningen. Du analyserar data och förklarar resultatens betydelse för lösningens utformning och användning. Du bidrar till metadata, spårbarhet, gör återkommande kontroller reproducerbara och automatiserar valideringar där det är lämpligt. Du utvecklar AI Centers plattform med testbara, återanvändbara komponenter för datainläsning och omvandling. Vi använder främst Python, SQL, DuckDB och Parquet, Git för versionshantering och Prefect för arbetsflöden. Du bör trivas att arbeta kodnära och föra arbetet från analysmiljö eller notebook till en robust, förvaltningsbar lösning. Infrastruktur, CI/CD och drift hanteras tillsammans med andra roller i teamet. Dina kvalifikationer Krav Högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom exempelvis statistik, matematik, dataanalys, informatik, systemvetenskap eller annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Erfarenhet av att självständigt undersöka och analysera data, bedöma datakvalitet och förklara resultat och begränsningar för både verksamhetsnära och tekniska målgrupper. Goda kunskaper i SQL och Python för dataanalys och databehandling samt av att utveckla reproducerbar och testbar kod och versionshantera den i Git. God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift. Meriterande Vi vet att erfarenheter kan se olika ut och förväntar oss inte att du har arbetat med samtliga områden nedan. Erfarenhet av dataarbete inom hälso- och sjukvård, offentlig verksamhet eller annan reglerad verksamhet. Erfarenhet av metadata, datakataloger och spårbarhet i dataflöden. Erfarenhet av öppen källkod (open source), gemensamma kodbibliotek eller andra komponenter som utvecklas och återanvänds av flera team eller organisationer. Din kompetens Du är analytisk och strukturerad, bryter ner komplexa frågor och identifierar mönster och samband. Dina analyser, antaganden, kod och slutsatser är begripliga, återanvändbara och möjliga att följa upp. Du är trygg i din kompetens och stärker teamet genom att dela kunskap, ta emot återkoppling och ompröva egna lösningar. Samarbete, kodgranskning och gemensamt ansvar är självklara i vårt team av erfarna specialister. Du lyssnar på verksamhetens kunskap och skiljer tydligt mellan vad data visar, våra antaganden och vad som behöver undersökas. Vi erbjuder Du följer arbetet från dataanalys till en användbar, hållbar lösning med dataingenjörer, data scientists, AI-arkitekt, DevOps-ingenjörer, kravanalytiker, uppdragsledare, digitaliseringsjurist och AI-strateg. Du kan påverka gemensamma komponenter när vi utvecklar plattform, arbetssätt och leveransförmåga och fördjupa dig inom dataanalys och produktionsnära datautveckling. Vi arbetar öppet och kodnära och bygger begripliga, reproducerbara lösningar som kan förvaltas över tid. Tjänsten är på heltid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Vi erbjuder hybridarbete, friskvårdsbidrag och kollektivavtalade villkor med tjänstepension och förmånliga villkor vid föräldraledighet och sjukdom. Du får extra semesterdagar från året du fyller 40. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag, så ansök gärna snarast. Hos oss får du förmåner som gör skillnad, läs om förmånerna här. Vill du veta mer? items.desc: Job Description Are you a data scientist with hands-on Python experience, keen to develop your expertise in Probability of Default (PD) models? Join the DoD/PD Team within IRB Framework and contribute to models central to Danske Bank’s risk management and regulatory compliance. Part of Group Risk Analytics, IRB Framework maintains and operates Danske Bank’s Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) models, with the DoD/PD Team focusing on PD models. You will join an international team based in Denmark and Lithuania, delivering analytical and technical solutions in a complex regulatory environment. The team combines recurring processes with analytical and development projects, offering opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues. We are looking for a Data Scientist to help maintain and improve PD models. You will combine hands-on analytical work with stakeholder collaboration, gradually taking on more responsibility with guidance when needed. Through model monitoring and improvement, you will deepen your knowledge of PD models, banking regulation and model governance while strengthening your technical and analytical expertise. What you will be doing: Preparing, validating and analysing data to support PD model maintenance, monitoring and development. Investigating and resolving issues related to data, methodology and implementation to ensure PD models operate as intended, working with colleagues as needed. Clearly documenting and communicating analytical findings, monitoring results and model changes to stakeholders and supporting internal governance and regulatory processes. Collaborating with colleagues, sharing knowledge and contributing to continuous improvement. About you: Have 2+ years of relevant experience in a data science, analytical, quantitative or technical role. Have practical Python and SQL experience, including writing, adapting and testing code to prepare and analyse data. Hold a higher education degree in a quantitative field, such as mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering, physics, data science or a related discipline. Are curious, organised and collaborative, with a willingness to learn, take initiative and ask for guidance when needed. Can explain analytical findings clearly and are interested in translating technical topics into accessible business insights. Are interested in credit risk and banking. Experience with PD models or in a regulated environment is an advantage, but not a requirement. Are fluent in English, both spoken and written. What we offer you: Monthly salary range from 2640 EUR to 3960 EUR gross (based on competencies relevant to the role). Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives an employee benefits package, which includes: Growth opportunities: a professional and supportive team, e-learning, development programmes (including professional certificates) and 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities. Health & well-being: a diverse and inclusive work environment that supports work–life balance, additional health insurance, mental well-being practices, partial psychologist counselling compensation, silence and sleep zones at the office, and game rooms. items.desc: Do you want to work at the intersection of data, AI and business, turning data into real impact for leading Nordic organisations? Are you looking to kickstart your career in a growing team where you’re trusted with real responsibility? If so, read on! Vuono Group is looking for students and recent graduates eager to grow both as full stack data scientists and as trusted advisors. We are a process AI company. We help Nordic organisations across the private and public sector create superior business processes and measurable impact through data and AI. About The Role As an Associate Full Stack Data Scientist, you’re interested in what happens under the hood of modern data solutions and care about data quality and the value it can bring to business. You’ll work alongside experienced data scientists and business experts to make our clients’ businesses more intelligent with data. In practice, this means building data pipelines, analysing data and utilising machine learning and AI for insights and operational use cases. Depending on your interests and project needs, your work can lean more towards data science or data engineering. We’re technology-agnostic by nature. We start with the business challenge and find the best way to solve it, without being tied to any particular technology or platform. The work isn’t always easy, but that’s where the learning happens. You’ll grow fast, going deep in your own field and broad beyond it, with experienced colleagues supporting you along the way. What Your Days Will Look Like Help build data pipelines and prepare data for analytics and modelling. Explore and analyse data to identify patterns, trends and opportunities for business improvement. Support the development and deployment of machine learning models, and help set up process mining and automation capabilities. Take part in client workshops and work with business engineers, software developers and process specialists to turn business problems into data-driven solutions. What We’re Looking For Your motivation to learn and a “get things done” attitude matter the most. Along with that, here's what will help you get up to speed: Currently studying or recently graduated in Data Science, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field. Programming skills in Python, familiarity with SQL, and basic knowledge of Git and Unix. A basic understanding of statistical methods and machine learning, or of data engineering concepts such as data modelling and ETL/ELT. Hands-on experience using LLMs and generative AI at work or in studies, and curiosity about how they can create business value. Confident communication skills in both Finnish and English. An interest in consulting and a desire to develop your client-facing, project management and problem-solving skills. Based in the Greater Helsinki area, as we work closely with our clients, often on-site. Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) or data tools such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, dbt or Airflow is a plus. Why you’ll like it here Work on real client projects, not just academic exercises. Grow fast with the support of an experienced team who are always happy to help. We run on trust, not titles. You'll get plenty of freedom and real responsibility. We're just entering our next stage of growth, which means there's plenty of room for your career to evolve. Our work isn't linear, and neither is life, so we keep things flexible. Your life outside work matters. Competitive pay in line with TEK salary recommendations. Great perks like extensive healthcare, lunch and sports benefits, Friday breakfasts, fun team events and more, plus the chance to join our employee share programme. We're building the best workplace for software, data, AI and business process professionals like you. That means investing in our people, their well-being, work-life balance and growth. Further information and next steps Please send us your application and CV by December 13, 2026. We’ll start interviewing already during the application period, so don’t wait too long! To make sure you learn and have a real opportunity to make an impact (and not just eat ice cream in an empty office in July), we’re looking for new Vuonoans to join us either at the beginning of 2027 or after the summer holidays, around August. This is a 4 to 6 month fixed-term position to start, with the possibility to continue if the fit is right for both sides. We look forward to hearing from you! Vuono Group is a process AI company. We create superior business processes through data and AI. Our growing team of kind and ambitious people is on a mission to turn AI into real, measurable business impact. Take the next step, explore our open positions and connect with us to find your next opportunity!

items.desc: AI Engineer – Business Enablement London (Remote) · £50,000-£70,000 About us We’re an established, international business that’s growing through acquisition. We’re partway through a multi-year shift to become a company that genuinely runs on data and AI. We have a strong data team and a CEO who’s fully behind it. What we need now is someone to bring AI into the rest of the business, the parts that don’t write code for a living. The role You’ll sit inside our business teams, starting with People, then Finance, then Account Management. You’ll find the repetitive, manual work that slows them down, then use AI to eliminate it. In practice, that means spending time with a team and watching how they work. You’ll spot where things could be faster, build something to fix it, and then show them how to do more of it themselves. Once a team is up and running, you move on to the next one. You’ll have a lot of freedom. Come up with ideas, share them, get feedback and get building. Nobody will hand you a backlog of tickets. What you’ll do Embed with business teams, learn how they work and spot where AI can help Build small tools, scripts, workflows and automations using Claude, Cursor and agent tools, covering things like reporting, data pulls, documents and scheduling Get those solutions used, showing people how they work and improving them based on feedback Teach colleagues to use AI in their own day-to-day work, so they can automate things themselves Help make AI-first working normal across the company, one team at a time Who we’re looking for You don’t need a computer science degree or a traditional engineering background. Some of the best people for this role started out in account management, operations, finance or sales. Then they got hooked on AI tools and started building things. What matters is that: you’re genuinely fluent with AI tools and use them every day to build things, not just to write emails you’ve built something useful with AI, whether at work or on the side, and can show us you’re curious about how businesses work and enjoy solving other people’s problems you’re comfortable explaining things to non-technical people, and patient when you do you’re self-directed and happy working things out without someone managing your every step If you’ve been the person in your team who quietly automated half their job and then showed everyone else how, we’d love to hear from you. Why join You’ll see your impact quickly: you’ll be making people’s working lives better within weeks You’ll get broad exposure across the whole business, not just one department You’ll be backed by a data team and leadership who take AI seriously and invest in the best tools It’s a real chance to grow into an AI career, wherever you’re starting from

items.title: Research Engineer - Robotics
items.card: you will work on exciting robots, including custom ones that exist nowhere else, take research from simulation to real hardware, and work directly with our research teams. We are onsite in our Zurich office. We are looking for multiple Research Engineers who are generalists with depth: roboticists who work across the whole stack and bring real expertise in one or more areas of it, such as simulation and learning,
items.desc: Our Mission Our mission is to solve the most important and fundamental challenges in AI and Robotics to enable future generations of intelligent machines that will help us all live better lives. We work in physical AI, on both existing commercial robots and our own custom hardware, from actuators and sensors to the software that runs them. As a Research Engineer you will work on exciting robots, including custom ones that exist nowhere else, take research from simulation to real hardware, and work directly with our research teams. We are onsite in our Zurich office. We are looking for multiple Research Engineers who are generalists with depth: roboticists who work across the whole stack and bring real expertise in one or more areas of it, such as simulation and learning, agentic systems, perception and spatial AI, or robot software and hardware integration. You will work with research, hardware and operations colleagues, and split your time between areas as projects require. If you are strong in one area, we expect you to understand the others, interface with them and contribute to them. Our Stack Our stack includes the following components. We look for T-shaped people: broad across the stack, with deep expertise in one or more of these areas. Reinforcement learning for robotic control. Reinforcement learning in simulation with zero shot sim2real deployment. Agentic pipelines. High level agentic reasoning and planning pipelines for long horizon tasks. Perception and Spatial AI. Perception and spatial understanding for robots: calibration, state estimation, and 3D scene representations that feed policies and agents. Robot software. The interfaces between hardware and software, and the tooling used to operate, debug and test robots to accelerate research. What You'll Do Work across simulation, learning, control, software and hardware to close the loop between research and real robots. Build and improve the stack we use to train, evaluate and deploy robot policies and controllers, in simulation and on hardware. Work with research teams to apply new ideas to working prototypes on real robots. Make advanced robotics pipelines robust on real robots. Set priorities and make sound technical decisions when the problem is ambiguous, and solve real problems alongside researchers. Build the software that connects models, agents and robots: libraries, interfaces and tooling. Deploy your work on real robots in experiments inside and outside the lab. What You'll Need BS, MS or PhD in robotics, computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics or equivalent practical experience. Preferably >2 years of experience. System-level thinking: you reason about how software, hardware and algorithms interact, and you can trace a failure across layers. Either a research background with deep technical expertise that you enjoy applying to real robots, or experience in applied research: working with R&D teams and using state-of-the-art methods in physical AI. A solid understanding of robotics theory and math: kinematics, dynamics, control, estimation and optimization. Hands-on robotics experience: you build, debug and run things yourself, in code and on robots. Real hardware experience is highly preferred. Strong C++ and Python. Strong Linux skills. A collaborative mindset, working closely with researchers, engineers and operators. Contributions to open-source robotics software. Note: Candidates are not expected to meet every qualification in the above list. If you do not have all of these qualifications you are still encouraged to apply. items.desc: Gjensidige har røtter tilbake til 1816 og er i dag et ledende nordisk forsikringsselskap med rundt 4600 medarbeidere i Norge, Sverige og Danmark. I Norge tilbyr vi forsikring, pensjon og sparing, og er notert på Oslo Børs. Sammen sikrer vi liv, helse og verdier, og går på jobb for å være der når det gjelder – for kundene våre, for hverandre og for samfunnet. Vil du bruke data og maskinlæring til å påvirke kommersielle beslutninger? I Kunde- og porteføljestyring i Privat får du jobbe tett med forretningen og ledelsen – fra å utforske data til å gi anbefalinger som former utviklingen av porteføljen. Du analyserer lønnsomhet, prisstilling og konkurransekraft og utvikler analytiske løsninger og maskinlæringsmodeller for overvåkning og styring. Du blir en del av et sterkt analytisk fagmiljø med høy kompetanse innen skadeforsikring, kunde- og porteføljeanalyse. Her får du faglige sparringspartnere og mulighet til å påvirke hvordan vi bruker data og analyse til å utvikle forretningen. Hva du vil gjøre: Du får kombinere avansert analyse og data science med konkrete forretningsutfordringer. Oppgavene spenner fra utforskende analyser og beslutningsstøtte til statistisk modellering og utvikling av datadrevne løsninger. Analysere utviklingen i porteføljen med særlig fokus på lønnsomhet, prisstilling og konkurransekraft. Bidra i prosjekter for å videreutvikle distribusjon og prising. Omsette komplekse data og analyser til innsikt, anbefalinger og konkrete forretningsmuligheter. Utvikle og dele kunnskap sammen med dyktige analytikere og data scientists, og bidra til teamets rolle som kompetansesenter for analyse i divisjonen. Samarbeide med forretningen og andre fagmiljøer om strategiske problemstillinger der analysene dine kan gjøre en forskjell. Vi ser etter deg som: Er nysgjerrig, analytisk og motiveres av å løse komplekse problemstillinger ved hjelp av data Kombinerer sterke analytiske ferdigheter med forretningsforståelse og interesse for kunder, lønnsomhet og porteføljeutvikling Evner å omsette komplekse data og analyser til tydelig innsikt, anbefalinger og beslutningsgrunnlag, og kommuniserer dette godt til både analytiske og ikke-analytiske målgrupper Tar initiativ, driver problemstillinger fremover og trives med både selvstendig arbeid og tett samarbeid med andre Har høyere utdanning innen eksempelvis økonomi, statistikk, matematikk, fysikk, informatikk eller andre relevante kvantitative fag Har relevant erfaring som analytiker, data scientist, konsulent eller fra andre roller med sterk bruk av data og analyse Har gode ferdigheter i SQL og gjerne Python, R eller tilsvarende verktøy for analyse og modellering Trives med flere parallelle problemstillinger og evner å prioritere der analysene kan skape størst verdi Hos oss får du stort handlingsrom til å utforske problemstillinger, utfordre etablerte sannheter og utvikle analytiske løsninger. Du får bruke kompetansen din til å forstå kundene våre, utvikle porteføljen og bidra til bedre beslutninger. Vi ser etter deg som vil ta initiativ og være med på å utvikle både fagområdet og teamet. Gode grunner til å jobbe i Gjensidige Vi har jobbet med å sikre liv, helse og verdier i over 200 år. En av grunnene til at vi har lyktes i så lang tid, er at vi hele tiden utvikler oss i takt med - og helst i forkant av - de stadige endringene i forsikringsbransjen og samfunnet ellers. Gjensidige er en arbeidsgiver som bryr seg om sine ansatte og legger til rette for god personlig og faglig utvikling. Vi sørger for at du kan utvikle deg innenfor rollen du allerede har, men også bygge karrieren din ved å bevege deg på tvers av organisasjonen. Fleksibilitet og åpenhet er essensielle egenskaper for at vi skal utvikle oss. I Gjensidige er det derfor superhøyt under taket, og nulltoleranse for trangsynthet. Vi tilbyr også: Mulighet for å jobbe delvis fra hjemmekontor, etter avtale. Spesielt god pensjonsordning, forsikringsordninger med behandlingsforsikring og personalrabatter, firmahytter i inn- og utland, aksjespareordning og sommertid. Flotte kontorlokaler sentralt i Oslo sentrum. Her finner du treningsmuligheter i eget treningsstudio og gymsal, i tillegg til bedriftsidrettslag med for eksempel klatregruppe, turgruppe og fotball, kulturaktiviteter og andre sosiale grupper. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, etnisitet eller bakgrunn. Hos oss jobber alle slags mennesker, med hver sin personlighet og historie - og det er nettopp dette mangfoldet som gjør oss sterke. Gjensidige gjennomfører bakgrunnssjekk ved alle ansettelser. Omfanget tilpasses stillingens risikonivå og ansvar, og innebærer blant annet identitetskontroll, referansesjekk, verifisering av CV og en kredittsjekk. Bakgrunnssjekk gjennomføres i sluttfasen av rekrutteringsprosessen, etter samtykke og i tett dialog med deg som kandidat. Du trenger ikke å skrive søknad, bare last opp CVen din og svar på noen korte spørsmål som hjelper oss å bli bedre kjent med deg. Vi …

A key part of your role will be reviewing chatbot conversations,
items.desc: At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds. We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a CS AI Quality Specialist in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change? The role As a CS AI Quality Specialist , you will play an important role in improving how customers interact with our digital customer service across Allente and Viaplay. Working within the CS System and Transformation team, you will focus on the quality and continuous improvement of our AI-powered chatbots, customer service systems and processes. A key part of your role will be reviewing chatbot conversations, understanding where things work well and identifying where customers may need better answers or support. You will turn these observations into actionable suggestions and work closely with colleagues and relevant system owners to help improve bot content, knowledge and customer journeys. This is a hands-on role for someone who is curious about technology, enjoys problem-solving and wants to be part of developing smarter and more customer-friendly ways of working. You don't need to be an AI expert – we're looking for someone with the right mindset, analytical skills and willingness to learn. Your Responsibilities Will Include Reviewing chatbot conversations to assess accuracy, clarity and whether customers receive the help they need. Identifying recurring issues, gaps in bot knowledge and unnecessary handovers to customer service, and documenting findings and suggesting improvements. Supporting updates to bot content, knowledge articles and conversation flows together with relevant teams. Testing changes to chatbots and customer service systems, reporting issues and checking that improvements work as intended. Following up on basic quality measures and customer feedback, sharing insights and highlighting areas for improvement. Collaborating with colleagues across Allente and Viaplay to support the continuous improvement of customer service systems and processes. Following company policies and guidelines, including information security and data protection, while continuously developing your knowledge and skills. What we’re looking for We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following: Some experience working with customer service, digital tools, AI, chatbots or similar systems, either professionally or through relevant studies. An interest in AI and how technology can improve customer experiences. Strong attention to detail and the ability to spot patterns, identify issues and suggest improvements. Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to your work. Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different teams. A curious mindset and willingness to learn new systems, tools and ways of working. Fluent communication skills in English; Swedish or another Nordic language is a plus. It’s a bonus if you have: Experience working with chatbots, AI tools or automated customer service solutions. Experience with customer service systems, CRM platforms or knowledge management tools. Experience reviewing customer interactions, analysing feedback or working with quality assurance. An interest in process improvement and digital customer journeys. A can-do attitude, a sense of humour and the ability to work humbly with others. What we offer you We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift. Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance. A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development. Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do . So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more. items.desc: About the role We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer, to join our growing Data Science Engineering team. You’ll work with other engineers, data scientists, product managers, systems engineers, and analytics professionals to help deliver valuable and innovative outcomes for our customers. You’ll work within and across our Engineering and Data Science teams, delivering scalable products that improve how we serve our customers and run our operations. This role would suit someone with previous experience working as a ML Engineer / Data Science Engineer. About the Team: Within Tesco Data & Analytics, we help our customers and the communities where we operate get the most value from data. We build and run Tesco’s data platforms, we architect and engineer data onto these platforms, provide capabilities and tools to the analytics community across Tesco, develop data products at scale and maintain existing applications. Our Data Science team are involved in a broad range of projects, spanning across supply chain, logistics, store and online. These include projects in the areas of Operations Optimizations, Commercial Decision Support (e.g. Forecasting, Range Optimization, Supply Chain support), Online (e.g. Search and Recommendation) and Intelligent Edge (e.g. Computer Vision). Our Machine Learning Engineers work alongside our data scientists, helping with everything from development of tools and platforms, code optimization through to deployment of solutions on the edge, cloud and big-data environments. You will be responsible for Participating in group discussions on system design and architecture Working with product teams to communicate and translate needs into technical requirements Working alongside our Data Scientists, Software Engineers and Product teams across the software lifecycle Delivering high quality code and solutions, bringing solutions into production Performing code reviews to optimize technical performance of data science solutions. Supporting production systems, resolving incidents, and performing root cause analysis Look for how we can evolve and improve our technology, processes and practices Sharing knowledge with the immediate engineering team Collaborate with other teams on more complex initiatives via working groups Improve and build solutions using GenAI Applying SDLC practices to create and release robust software You will need You come from either an Engineering or Data Science background, with a good understanding of the Data Science Toolkit (Programming, Machine Learning, MLOps etc) and bringing data science solutions into production. You therefore tick the majority of the following points: Key Requirements: A higher degree in engineering, computer science, maths or science. Customer focus with the right balance between outcome delivery and technical excellence. The ability to apply technical skills and know-how to solving real world business problems. Demonstratable experience of building MLOps systems according to the best market standards. Commercial experience contributing to the success of high impact Data Science projects within complex organisations. Awareness of emerging MLOps practices and tooling would be an advantage e.g. feature stores and model lifecycle management. An analytical mind set and the ability to tackle specific business problems . Experience with different programming languages and a good grasp of at least one language. The ideal candidate is fluent in Python. Use of version control (Git) and related software lifecycle tooling. Experience with tooling for monitoring, logging and alerting e.g. Splunk or Grafana. Understanding of common data structures and algorithms. Experience working with open-source Data-Science environments. Knowledge of open source big-data technologies such as Apache Spark. Experience building solutions that run in the cloud, ideally Azure. Experience with software development methodologies including Scrum & Kanban. A background or strong understanding of the retail sector, logistics and/or ecommerce would be advantageous but is not required. Unsure if you fit all the criteria? Apply and give us the chance to evaluate your potential - you could be the perfect fit! Whats in it for you? Salary UoP 20 000 - 25 000 PLN gross/month Hybrid working We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about different flexible working options. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a career, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support. This role requires you to be based in or near Kraków, as you will spend 60% (3 days) of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely. Benefits Tesco is a diverse and exciting employer, dedicated to being #aplacetogeton, …

items.desc: Jij bepaalt wat AI voor het onderwijs kan betekenen Meer dan 400 schoolbesturen in heel Nederland sturen hun organisatie aan met onze software. Dat zijn ruim 1,3 miljoen leerlingen en studenten. Jaar na jaar komen er begrotingen, formatieplannen, realisaties en prognoses bij ons samen. Weinig organisaties hebben zoveel informatie over de beheerprocessen in het onderwijs en jij gaat daar iets mee doen. We zoeken een data scientist met diepgaande AI-ervaring, die modellen begrijpt, traint en in productie brengt. Een back-end achtergrond is niet nodig. Onze klanten werken met gevoelige gegevens. Daarom kijken we nadrukkelijk naar lokale en zelf gehoste modellen, met de data binnen onze eigen omgeving. Wat ga je doen? Je wordt onderdeel van ons productteam en wordt onze AI-specialist. Je hebt veel vrijheid. Wat werkt, gaat naar productie. Je onderzoekt waar AI het verschil maakt in ons product: prognoses, het herkennen van afwijkingen in begrotingen, slimmere analyses en ondersteuning bij het opstellen van een meerjarenbegroting; Je zet lokale modellen op, traint ze en maakt ze beter. Je kiest het juiste model voor de vraag, fine-tuned waar dat loont en weet wanneer een eenvoudig statistisch model het beter doet; Je brengt modellen samen met onze engineers naar productie; Je bouwt mee aan AI-ondersteuning voor klanten en consultants, zodat veelgestelde vragen direct beantwoord worden en consultants tijd overhouden voor advies; Je denkt mee over onze AI-strategie. Als onderdeel van de Visma-groep heb je toegang tot een groot netwerk van AI-specialisten. Jij zorgt dat Datapas daar iets aan heeft en er zelf ook aan bijdraagt; Je deelt wat je leert. Collega's in consultancy en ontwikkeling werken al met AI-tools, en jij tilt dat naar een hoger niveau. Wie ben jij? Een data scientist of ML-engineer met aantoonbare ervaring in het trainen en inzetten van modellen; Ervaring met het lokaal draaien en fine-tunen van (open source) taalmodellen; Sterk in Python en de gangbare ML-tooling; Een goede statistische basis. Je weet wanneer een uitkomst klopt en wanneer niet; Je kunt technische keuzes uitleggen aan collega's en klanten zonder technische achtergrond; Nieuwsgierig en zelfstartend. Je volgt wat er in het vakgebied gebeurt en probeert het uit; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal; Ervaring met SQL, datawarehouses of financiële data is een pré; Drie (of meer) jaar relevante werkervaring is ideaal. Ben je net afgestudeerd en heb je indrukwekkend werk laten zien? Solliciteer vooral! Wat bieden wij? Fulltime functie, 32 uur is bespreekbaar; Marktconform salaris afhankelijk van medior of senior startpunt; 25 vakantiedagen per jaar op basis van fulltime dienstverband; 8% vakantiegeld; Opleiding en training; Pensioenregeling; Fietsregeling en thuiswerkvergoeding; Verzorgde gemeenschappelijke lunch; Een unieke dataset over de bedrijfsvoering van het Nederlandse onderwijs, en de ruimte om er iets mee te bouwen; Budget en vrijheid om te experimenteren met modellen, hardware en tools; Een hecht team van specialisten in het monumentale Olympia-gebouw in hartje Haarlem, op 5 minuten lopen van het station; De stabiliteit en kennis van Visma, met de sfeer en korte lijnen van een klein bedrijf. Over ons Datapas is een organisatie die zich specialiseert op het gebied van het onderwijs, in de onderwijsondersteunende processen. Wij leveren oplossingen op het vlak van planning en control en de monitoring van het onderwijsrendement. Daar waar andere organisaties ophouden, gaan wij verder – een flexibele organisatie vraagt om flexibele oplossingen. Door middel van onze software kunnen we naast een standaardapplicatie ook maatwerk leveren, zodat elke schoolorganisatie haar eigen processen hierin kwijt kan. Als marktleider in het PO- en VO-segment ondersteunt Datapas schoolbesturen met innovatieve SaaS-oplossingen op het gebied van begrotingen en integrale management dashboards. Sinds 2022 zijn wij onderdeel van Visma, waardoor we de charme van een klein bedrijf combineren met de slagkracht van een grote organisatie. Dat geeft ons de mogelijkheid om niet alleen ons product te verbeteren, maar óók onze manier van werken slimmer te maken. Samen met ons team werk je aan projecten die écht het verschil maken in het onderwijs. Interesse? Solliciteer op deze functie via bovenstaande knop of stuur je cv met motivatie naar Marjolein de Goeij-Weijers via werken@datapas.nl. Heb je vragen of wil je meer informatie, dan kun je mailen naar hetzelfde e-mailadres. Voor deze functie zoeken we een kandidaat die in Nederland woont en de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst. For this position, we are looking for a candidate residing in the Netherlands with a good command of Dutch.

Key Responsibilities/Tasks Research,
items.desc: Location: Zurich Contract: 40%-60% with flexible duration (min 6 months) Rate: CHF 30/hour Start: ASAP / by arrangement Role Overview As an AI Operations & Enablement Intern, you will play a central role in turning the AI tools and automations Rivero already relies on into shared, well-governed company infrastructure. Your work will span research, prototyping, and hands-on build-out, from evaluating an internal knowledge-management system to tracking automation usage and closing the feedback loop. Key Responsibilities/Tasks Research, prototype, and help select an internal "second brain" / knowledge-management system for the company Help move automations and "skills" that today live on individual laptops and personal AI accounts into a shared, company-owned, version-controlled repository with a real handover process Build lightweight usage monitoring across our automations, tracking which ones are active and how often they run, so we know what's working and what could be improved. Design a feedback loop so any team can flag quality issues with an automation and get it routed to whoever owns it Support a move toward provider-agnostic tooling, so our automations aren't locked into a single AI vendor Get hands-on with further real-world use cases — e.g. compliance/contract-review support, HR onboarding automation, or customer-support and meeting-intelligence agents for our product teams What We Are Looking For You'll thrive in this role if: You're currently studying Computer Science, Data/AI, or a related technical field (Bachelor's or Master's) You're genuinely curious about and hands-on with modern AI tools — agents, coding assistants, automation frameworks. You follow the latest developments and AI usage patterns. You have solid software fundamentals and you're comfortable with git; cloud knowledge is a plus. You have a structured, process-oriented mindset; you'd rather build a system than ship a one-off script You're comfortable taking a loosely-scoped, week-sized task and driving it yourself with minimal check-ins You're fluent in English and based in or able to work from Zurich What We Offer CHF 30/hour, flexible around your semester schedule Real ownership; your work becomes infrastructure the rest of the company relies on Direct exposure to how a fast-moving fintech uses AI in production, across engineering, compliance, and operations Mentorship from our engineering team A possible path to a longer-term role Additional Requirements: This is a hybrid role based in Zurich. Candidates must currently hold the right to live and work in the EU/EFTA area. How to apply Send your CV and a short note about an AI tool, agent, or automation you've built or used and are proud of.

items.card: About The Role As an Associate Business Engineer, you'll learn to tackle complex business challenges across different industries. You'll translate business needs into practical solutions and help clients design and build better processes. Using your technical background and business understanding, you'll act as a bridge between business and technology teams. We’re technology-agnostic by nature. We always start with
items.desc: Do you want to work at the intersection of business and technology, solving real challenges for leading Nordic organisations? Ready to kickstart your career in a growing team where you get real responsibility and learn from experienced colleagues, rather than just build slide decks? If so, read on! Vuono Group is looking for Associate Business Engineers to join our growing team in Helsinki. We are a process AI company. We help Nordic organisations across the private and public sector create superior business processes and measurable impact through data and AI. About The Role As an Associate Business Engineer, you'll learn to tackle complex business challenges across different industries. You'll translate business needs into practical solutions and help clients design and build better processes. Using your technical background and business understanding, you'll act as a bridge between business and technology teams. We’re technology-agnostic by nature. We always start with the business challenge and find the best way to solve it, without being tied to any particular technology or platform. Sometimes, the best solution doesn't involve technology at all. You'll get hands-on experience turning data into business value. This means analysing data with business intelligence tools, defining KPIs and building dashboards that support better decision-making. Depending on the challenge, you'll also work with tools such as low-code automation, process mining and various business technology platforms. The work isn't always easy, but that's where the learning happens. You'll grow fast, going deep in your own field and broad beyond it, with experienced colleagues supporting you along the way. What Your Days Will Look Like Consult with clients to identify and analyse business needs and challenge and translate them into solutions that work, not quick fixes. Develop insights using data analytics tools like Power BI and Celonis and deliver actionable reports Leverage low-code automation, process mining platforms, and business technology platforms to design and implement client solutions. Collaborate with technical and business teams when implementing client solutions What We’re Looking For What really counts is your drive to solve business challenges with technology and your motivation to keep learning. Along with that, here's what will help you get up to speed: Currently studying or recently graduated in Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Networks or a related field. A basic understanding of business processes, data analytics and IT systems in modern digital businesses. An analytical mindset and get things done attitude. Confident communication skills in both Finnish and English, including presentations. An interest in consulting and a desire to develop your client-facing, project management and problem-solving skills. Based in the Greater Helsinki area, as we work closely with our clients, often on-site Curiosity about technology, especially AI, and how it can create business valu Hands-on experience with technologies such as Fabric, Databricks, Celonis, Power BI, Power Automate, UiPath or n8n is a plus. Why you’ll like it here Work on real client projects, not just academic exercises. Grow fast with the support of an experienced team who are always happy to help. We run on trust, not titles. You'll get plenty of freedom and real responsibility. We're just entering our next stage of growth, which means there's plenty of room for your career to evolve. Our work isn't linear, and neither is life, so we keep things flexible. Your life outside work matters. Competitive pay in line with TEK salary recommendations. Great perks like extensive healthcare, lunch and sports benefits, Friday breakfasts, fun team events and more, plus the chance to join our employee share programme. We're building the best workplace for software, data, AI and business process professionals like you. That means investing in our people, their well-being, work-life balance and growth. Further information and next steps Please send us your application and CV by December 13, 2026. We’ll start interviewing already during the application period, so don’t wait too long! To make sure you learn and have a real opportunity to make an impact (and not just eat ice cream in an empty office in July), we’re looking for new Vuonoans to join us either at the beginning of 2027 or after the summer holidays, around August. This is a 4 to 6 month fixed-term position to start, with the possibility to continue if the fit is right for both sides. We look forward to hearing from you! Vuono Group is a process AI company. We create superior business processes through data and AI. Our growing team of kind and ambitious people is on a mission to turn AI into real, measurable business impact. Take the next step, explore our open positions and connect with us to find your next opportunity!

items.desc: About Us STRATOS is a London-based, high-growth technology startup. We build commercial data products on Palantir Foundry for large industrial businesses, and we're growing fast on the back of strong commercial traction. The team is young and exceptionally talented: former MBB consultants alongside strong engineers, and we're about to double in size. Why Forward Deployed Engineering We have a scalable technology backbone, but we believe Forward Deployed Engineering is the future of differentiated B2B software in the GenAI age. Rather than shipping static tools, we partner closely with customers to deliver tailored solutions, where the value is created in the implementation, not just the codebase. The Role Most graduate schemes put you on a rotation for a year before you touch anything real. Here you'll be working on a live customer problem in your first month. We're looking for Junior Forward Deployed Engineers to join the team and: Deploy our existing product offering to new and existing customers. Own, define and build new use cases on top of our core data asset and product, delivering bespoke value and solving real, unique problems for each customer. What you'll get: A rare, in-demand skillset. You'll work hands-on with Palantir Foundry every day, building deep expertise in a platform few engineers get access to. No prior Foundry experience needed. We'll teach you, and that's the point. Someone to learn from. You'll pair with a senior engineer from day one. The team is small enough that you learn by sitting next to people, not through a training curriculum. Problems that matter. You'll be close to the customer, working on high-value problems where the impact of what you build is visible immediately. Room to grow. We anticipate doubling the size of the engineering team, which means leadership, ownership and scope arrive early for the people who grab them. What You'll Do Deploy and customise the STRATOS core product suite for new and existing customers. Integrate external data sources: pulling data in via REST APIs and cloud storage, and connecting to customers' CRM systems. Contribute to the STRATOS core product suite, extending existing products and helping build new ones from the ground up. Rapidly deploy bespoke workflows on the front line to solve unique problems for specific customers. What We're Looking For Proficiency in Python and SQL is a must. Prior internship experience in a technical role is a must. We'll ask you to walk us through what you built and what you'd do differently. The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-changing environment. The ability to work with a wide range of stakeholders: managing the technical side of projects, liaising with our Commercial Product Managers, and understanding each customer's context and problems through a business lens. Nice to have Prior experience with Palantir Foundry is heavily valued but not essential. Experience with PySpark. What we offer Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company. Private healthcare. Pension scheme. 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. Work from abroad: up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time. Visa sponsorship available. A company committed to social and environmental responsibility: we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes. items.desc: Organisatie Voor een landelijke toezichthouder in de zorg zoeken we een Data Scientist. De organisatie houdt toezicht op zorgaanbieders, zorgverzekeraars en zorgkantoren. Ze onderzoekt onder meer of zorg correct in rekening wordt gebracht en of zorgaanbieders hun financiële bedrijfsvoering op orde hebben. Je sluit aan bij een team dat data inzet om toezichtsvragen te beantwoorden. Je werkt samen met data-analisten en toezichthouders en helpt collega’s om data te gebruiken in hun onderzoeken. Het team draagt ook bij aan producten die inzicht geven in de betaalbaarheid en toegankelijkheid van zorg. Functie Als Data Scientist analyseer je grote hoeveelheden zorgdata en vertaal je de uitkomsten naar inzichten waarmee toezichthouders gericht vervolgonderzoek kunnen doen. Je onderzoekt bijvoorbeeld welke patronen opvallen in declaraties en of die patronen wijzen op bredere risico’s in de zorgmarkt. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit: Analyseren van declaratiegedrag van zorgaanbieders en verkennen van mogelijke marktbrede risico’s. Uitvoeren van data-analyses op verzoek van toezichthouders en helder toelichten wat de uitkomsten betekenen voor hun onderzoek. Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van tools die collega’s ondersteunen bij data-analyses en risicogericht toezicht. Ondersteunen van onderzoeken naar de bedrijfsvoering van zorgaanbieders en de toegankelijkheid van zorg. Functie-eisen Een afgeronde wo-master in een kwantitatieve richting, zoals (bedrijfs)economie, wiskunde, statistiek, natuurkunde of econometrie. Minimaal twee jaar werkervaring als Data Scientist of in een vergelijkbare rol. Ervaring in een andere functie telt mee als je op grote schaal data hebt verwerkt en de resultaten hebt vertaald naar bruikbare inzichten. Aantoonbare ervaring met grootschalige dataverwerking en het vertalen van analyseresultaten naar inzichten die aansluiten op een concrete onderzoeksvraag. Aantoonbare ervaring met programmeren in R. Je bent analytisch en nieuwsgierig, verdiept je graag in complexe vraagstukken en weet hoofd- en bijzaken te onderscheiden. Je stelt kritische vragen wanneer dat nodig is, legt je bevindingen helder uit en werkt graag samen met data-analisten en toezichthouders. Your responsibilities will include: Talk to our clients — strategy, M&A and corporate development teams — and understand how they work: which questions they need to answer and where today’s process breaks. You’d rather build product than slides — and you’ve already built something others use. You build it yourself. You write Python that runs in production & ship on a shared codebase. API and service design , clean enough that someone else can build on it. Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. You’ve worked on lending, credit risk, consumer or SME finance, Open Banking, or a closely related area of banking or payments. Strong analytical skills. items.desc: KI, die in der Halle ankommt. Gebaut mit den Menschen, die dort arbeiten. Aufbau KI-Werkstatt (m/w/d) Viele Unternehmen reden über KI. Wir setzen sie ein, und zwar dort, wo es konkret wird: an der Werkbank, im Lager, in der Buchhaltung, an der Maschine. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Technik versteht, Menschen ernst nimmt und etwas aufbauen will, das bleibt. Wer wir sind Wir fertigen Interieur für die anspruchsvollsten Fahrzeuge der Welt, mit Holz, Lack, Leder und Chrom, vieles davon in Handarbeit. Unser Grundsatz ist, erst das Handwerk so gut wie möglich zu machen und es dann den Maschinen beizubringen. Unsere Roboter lernen bei uns Handwerk. Diesen Weg gehen wir jetzt in der ganzen Firma. Worum es geht In unseren Abteilungen wird jeden Tag abgetippt, abgeglichen, gezählt, gesucht und nachgefragt. Vieles davon kann heute KI übernehmen. Wir bauen dafür keine große Software von außen, sondern viele kleine Apps, die genau einen Ablauf lösen und miteinander sprechen. Dazu binden wir Technik ein: Kameras, die Teile erkennen und zählen, Scanner, Sensoren, Waagen, Maschinendaten. Du baust diese Werkstatt auf, als erste Person mit dieser Aufgabe im Haus. Bei uns verliert niemand seinen Arbeitsplatz durch KI. Wir nehmen den Menschen die Sacharbeit ab, damit Raum bleibt für das, was sie ausmacht: urteilen, gestalten, Handwerk, miteinander arbeiten. Wie du arbeitest Gemeinsam, nicht für andere. Du baust nichts am Schreibtisch, um es dann zu übergeben. Du setzt dich zu den Menschen, die die Arbeit machen, und entwickelst die Lösung mit ihnen. Sie wissen, wo es hakt, du weißt, was technisch geht. Ihr probiert, verwerft, verbessert. Am Ende steht ein Werkzeug, das sie verstehen und selbst weiterentwickeln, weil es auch ihres ist. Dein erstes halbes Jahr •⁠ ⁠Monat 1 - Finanzen: vom Rechnungseingang über Zahlungen bis zum Monatsabschluss. •⁠ ⁠Monat 2 - Einkauf: Anfragen, Bestellungen, Bestätigungen, Liefertermine. •⁠ ⁠Monat 3 - Lager und Halle: Buchungen, Bestände, Zählen mit Kamera und Scanner. •⁠ ⁠Danach: Qualität, Prüfung, Maschinen und jede Stelle, an der es hakt. Worauf es beim Bauen ankommt •⁠ ⁠Klein im Werkzeug, groß im Blick. Jede App löst einen Ablauf, alle zusammen ergeben ein System, keine Insellösungen. •⁠ ⁠Software trifft Hardware. Du verbindest KI mit dem, was physisch passiert, mit Kameras, Sensoren und Maschinen. •⁠ ⁠Sicher und nachvollziehbar. Rechte, Datenschutz, Sicherungen. Was du baust, hält auch an einem schlechten Tag, und jeder Schritt bleibt prüfbar. •⁠ ⁠Die Menschen bleiben verantwortlich. Wer die Arbeit heute macht, prüft, was die KI tut. Ihr seid ein kleines Team und arbeitet direkt mit dem Inhaber. Die Stelle gibt es nur vor Ort, weil die Arbeit dort passiert, wo die Menschen sind. Wen wir suchen Diesen Beruf gibt es noch nicht, also auch keinen festen Abschluss. Gut passen würden zum Beispiel eine Ingenieurin oder ein Ingenieur aus Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Informatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, eine Technikerin oder ein Techniker, oder jemand aus der Praxis, der sich das Bauen selbst beigebracht hat. Entscheidend ist, was du mitbringst: •⁠ ⁠Du hast schon etwas gebaut, das andere benutzen. Eine App, ein Skript, eine Steuerung, eine Auswertung. Du arbeitest mit Coding-KI wie Claude Code oder Codex, mit echtem Code, versioniert und so, dass ein anderer ihn weiterführen kann. •⁠ ⁠Du hast Freude an Technik zum Anfassen. Eine Kamera, ein Raspberry Pi, ein Scanner, eine Maschinenschnittstelle: Du willst sie zum Laufen bringen. •⁠ ⁠Du verstehst Arbeit. Du interessierst dich dafür, wie ein Monatsabschluss, eine Inventur oder eine Prüfung wirklich abläuft, und hörst zu, bevor du baust. •⁠ ⁠Du bist mental stark. Du bleibst ruhig, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, wenn Kollegen skeptisch sind oder wenn drei Dinge gleichzeitig brennen. Du führst dich selbst, setzt Prioritäten und bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch die letzten zehn Prozent. •⁠ ⁠Du arbeitest gern mit Menschen. Dein bester Moment ist nicht, wenn der Code läuft, sondern wenn eine Kollegin sagt: „Das haben wir gebaut.“ Wen wir nicht suchen Wer Lösungen allein entwickelt und dann übergibt, ist hier falsch. Ebenso wer Präsentationen über KI erstellt, ohne etwas zu bauen, oder wer bei Gegenwind das Interesse verliert. Was wir bieten •⁠ ⁠Sinn, den man sieht. Was du baust, verändert die Arbeit von Menschen spürbar, oft schon in der nächsten Woche. •⁠ ⁠Gestaltungsfreiheit. Du baust etwas auf, das es so noch nicht gibt, mit kurzen Wegen und direkter Entscheidung durch den Inhaber. •⁠ ⁠Echte Technik. Roboterzellen in der Lackiererei, eigene Apps, Kameras, Sensoren, dazu Budget für die Werkzeuge und KI-Dienste, die du brauchst. •⁠ ⁠Lernen auf höchstem Niveau. Du arbeitest an der Grenze dessen, was KI heute kann, in einer Fertigung für die anspruchsvollsten Kunden der Welt. •⁠ ⁠Ein stabiles Haus mit rund 100 Menschen, gesund und wachsend, mit eigenen Produkten in Vorbereitung.
