items.desc: We build and scale AI and data capabilities globally; advance AI and data training across Accenture; and develop cutting-edge methods for designing, building and delivering the most modern AI and data foundation in the technology stack and embedding AI and data across the enterprise, powered by Accenture’s Center for Advanced AI. Bring your innovative vision to Accenture! With your experience, you can reinvent entire industries while working with the world’s leading companies. Shape the future of business and technology by developing cutting-edge solutions that can create new value. Your role and opportunities Join Accenture’s Global Responsible AI team and help organizations design, deploy and operate AI responsibly, addressing the technical challenges emerging from traditional, generative and Agentic AI systems. You will: Design and assess Responsible AI architectures and technical governance solutions, defining evaluation and assurance approaches covering AI quality, safety, robustness, fairness, explainability, privacy, observability and ongoing monitoring. Evaluate traditional, generative and Agentic AI systems, performing model auditing, adversarial testing and technical assessments to identify vulnerabilities, potential bias, data leakage and other AI-related risks, and recommend appropriate technical controls. Develop Safe AI architectures and AIOps lifecycle practices, partnering with cybersecurity, model risk and engineering teams on AI threat modelling, guardrails, governance controls and mitigation strategies. Support Responsible AI projects end to end, contributing to client engagements, technical proposals, reusable reference architectures, playbooks, accelerators and governance evidence packs while acting as a trusted technical advisor to client teams and senior stakeholders. The position is based in Milan or Rome . The role may require travel depending on business needs and client requirements. Where compatible with project activities and company policies, hybrid working arrangements may apply. Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to role, level, seniority, responsibility, skillset, and level of experience. For this position, the job level is B2 under the Metalmeccanico (C011) National Collective Bargaining Agreement. The gross annual salary range is between 33.058,74€ and 46.700€. The Work: Join us to participate in Responsible AI projects from end to end — engaging clients, shaping innovative proposals from a technical standpoint, and delivering AI technical governance solutions. You’ll act as a trusted advisor, guiding organizations on how to deploy and run AI safely and can be expected to: Define AI evaluation and assurance methodological approaches covering quality, safety, robustness, bias, explainability, privacy and monitoring. Assess and design Safe AI architectures, AI system architectural practices, and AIOps lifecycle processes Perform model auditing and adversarial testing of traditional, generative and Agentic AI (using specialized market tools and custom assets), providing recommendations Partner with cyber, model risk and engineering teams on AI threat modelling, data leakage mitigation and adversarial testing. Shape proposals, reusable reference architectures, playbooks, accelerators and governance evidence packs. Work closely with AI and transformation teams to provide strategic guidance, support project delivery, and advise senior leaders. Evaluate algorithms for transparency, fairness, and reliability, manage AI-related risks, and turn them into opportunities for innovation and value creation. Contribute to shaping global AI standards, build insights on regulatory trends, and represent Accenture’s Responsible AI perspective. Drive responsible AI adoption, influence business outcomes, and help shape industry practices. Requirements & Skills : Experience in Responsible AI, AI Governance, and Artificial Intelligence, including Agentic AI Enterprise AI Architecture, and AIOps lifecycle Good knowledge of Python Fundamentals of AI Safety, threat modelling, guardrails, and AI observability Nice to have : Experience with AI model governance platforms of the major enterprise vendors Certifications in AI, cloud, security, architecture, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF or related standards. Publications, speaking or external thought leadership on Responsible AI or AI Safety

items.desc: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital is looking for an intern to join the End-to-End Validation & Performance (EVP) team and contribute to image-processing and calibration/validation (CAL/VAL) activities for Earth-observation missions. In this internship, you’ll explore how AIT captures and routine onboard imagery can support optical performance testing and radiometric calibration, and turn that work into an evaluated engineering prototype. Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station) Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027. About this role: Review DSNU, radiometric calibration, and relevant EVP processing and CAL/VAL practices Work with EVP engineers to identify suitable routine images, metadata, and reference calibration data; document data limitations and provenance Prepare a reproducible dataset and establish reference baselines, including a holdout evaluation strategy that avoids tuning and testing on the same acquisitions Implement a baseline estimator: a data-fit term combined with a regularizing prior Investigate additional AI/ML methods only where suitable training or validation data are available; compare them against the baseline rather than assuming they are superior Evaluate correction quality, residual fixed-pattern structure, stability across images, runtime, and failure cases Package the workflow as a prototype script or notebook with plots, quality checks, and an auditable record of inputs, parameters, and outputs Present findings and recommendations to EVP and CAL/VAL stakeholders; document what evidence would be needed before operational use The intern will gain experience in: Radiometric calibration and CAL/VAL for space-based optical imaging Push-broom image characteristics and PRNU/DSNU correction Applied optimization and, where appropriate, machine learning for image processing Experimental design, reference-data limitations, and quantitative performance assessment Building reproducible engineering tools and communicating technical evidence to mission teams Must Haves: Student in engineering, applied physics, remote sensing, image processing, data science, or a related field Fundamentals of signal or image processing and a strong interest in Earth observation Basic programming skills in Python and comfort working with scientific data Analytical mindset, rigor, and ability to document assumptions and limitations Interest in calibration, validation, sensor behavior, or image quality assessment Nice to Haves: Exposure to satellite imagery or remote-sensing data Experience with optimization, statistical estimation, or machine-learning evaluation Familiarity with image-analysis libraries and scientific Python tools Understanding of radiometric calibration or data-quality assessment What Can We Offer? You will join a stimulating environment, surrounded by passionate engineers, conducive to learning, innovation, and personal and professional development — and help build the future of space infrastructure. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, USA | Golden, USA | and Toulouse, France. Some of our awesome internship benefits: Gratification: €1,300 gross/month Lunch vouchers (tickets restaurant), because let's be honest, we love food! (we even have a Slack channel about it: #loft-gourmand) Sustainable mobility package (forfait mobilité durable) A genuinely international environment comprising 20+ different nationalities A genuine mentoring program to support you on a daily basis throughout the internship Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes Who We Are Loft: Space Made Simple. Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure. As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English. …

items.desc: Machine Learning Engineer Salary: £75,000 - £80,000 per annum Location: London - Hybrid - 2 days per week We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join an ambitious, collaborative technology team within a well-established, knowledge-led organisation. This is a chance to help shape production AI capability in a business that is investing in modern data products and intelligent digital experiences. Reporting to a senior technology leader, you will work closely with data, product and engineering colleagues to take machine-learning solutions from concept through to reliable, scalable deployment. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will have real ownership in a greenfield environment, improving how models are built, governed, monitored and used across the organisation. The Opportunity This is more than a model-building role. You will create the engineering foundations that allow AI solutions to deliver lasting value in production. Design and develop robust MLOps practices, platforms and standards. Build and deploy AI/ML solutions with a focus on natural-language applications, personalisation and semantic/graph-based data. Improve the end-to-end model lifecycle, including version control, deployment, monitoring, security and auditability. Monitor live models and optimise performance, reliability and cost. Partner with engineers, data specialists and non-technical stakeholders to solve meaningful business problems. Act as a technical escalation point for deployed ML solutions. Share knowledge and mentor colleagues, developing their engineering capability. Keep abreast of developments across AI, cloud and MLOps, bringing practical improvements into the team. What's in it for you? £75,000 - £80,000 salary. Hybrid working and home-working support. 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays and additional personal days. Pension and employee loan schemes. Funding and support for training, professional qualifications and continued learning. A supportive, inclusive culture with genuine scope to influence the organisation's AI direction. Skills and Experience Proven experience building and deploying production machine-learning solutions. Strong practical knowledge of MLOps, including model deployment, monitoring, governance and CI/CD. Experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based data services. Strong Python skills; experience with another language such as R, Java or C# is also welcome. Sound understanding of data engineering, ETL pipelines and data security. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams. Experience with NLP, recommender systems, knowledge graphs or semantic technologies. Familiarity with Azure DevOps or comparable CI/CD tooling. Experience with Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL Database or similar cloud storage platforms. Previous mentoring or coaching experience. A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent commercial experience. items.desc: Buscamos a un Machine Learning Engineer para un proyecto en banca 100% remoto Industrialización y MLOps: Despliegue, productivización y mantenimiento de pipelines de entrenamiento e inferencia batch para modelos de Machine Learning en Azure Databricks y PySpark, garantizando trazabilidad, reproducibilidad y escalabilidad. Previsión de demanda ( Forecasting ): Análisis, refactorización y optimización de modelos de series temporales (StatsForecast, MLForecast, LightGBM, Prophet) para la predicción de demanda de efectivo a nivel de red y cajeros. Modelado de optimización operativa: Integración y productivización de algoritmos de optimización matemática y heurísticas para la asignación eficiente de denominaciones de billetes, respetando restricciones logísticas y operativas de negocio. Gobierno y ciclo de vida de modelos: Implementación de flujos de registro, versionado de artefactos, auditoría y monitorización de drift mediante MLflow y herramientas corporativas de gobierno (Delphi). Migración y calidad de software: Refactorización de código exploratorio y notebooks a librerías modulares de Python, aplicando principios de testing unitario, control de excepciones, logging avanzado y tipado estático. Automatización y CI/CD: Configuración y mantenimiento de pipelines de integración y entrega continua (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git) para automatizar el ciclo de vida del software y el despliegue de modelos. Resolución de incidencias y soporte N3: Diagnóstico de fallos en ejecución productiva, análisis de causa raíz ( root cause analysis ) y ejecución de planes de remediación operativa. Colaboración técnica multidisciplinar: Coordinación directa con equipos de Data Engineering, Plataforma Cloud, Data Science y Negocio para la definición de contratos de datos, SLAs y validación de casos de uso. Documentación técnica y operativa: Redacción de manuales de arquitectura, procedimientos de relanzamiento y contingencia ( runbooks ), y análisis de viabilidad ( trade-offs entre coste de cómputo y rendimiento).

items.desc: What's Red Points all about? Red Points is the most widely used solution to recover digital revenue. Over 1.300 companies rely on our platform to fight counterfeits, piracy, impersonation, and distribution abuse. They leverage Red Points to take back the revenue that’s rightfully theirs. With 270+ professionals and offices in New York, Barcelona, Beijing, and Salt Lake City, Red Points has disrupted an industry traditionally led by service providers with a scalable, cost-effective solution. Be part of the change: join us on our mission to make the Internet a safer place! Job Description The Role Red Points protects more than 1,300 brands from counterfeits, piracy and online impersonation, using AI to find and remove infringements at scale. Attackers now use AI too. They clone executives’ faces and voices, spin up fake stores and scam ads in minutes, and try to change what AI assistants say about brands. We’re building a new intrapreneurial team to define and launch new prototypes that fight back: AI against AI. You’ll be a founding member of this team, with C-level reporting. You’ll own the technical side: researching what’s feasible building prototypes fast be a part of market launch and validation Your day-to-day here Turn product ideas into working prototypes in days, using AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) and language, vision and voice models. Run prototypes on real data, so every demo shows a prospect their own problem, not a mock-up. Check the technical feasibility of each new idea and sum it up in a short go/no-go note: data sources, platform APIs and their terms, model options, accuracy, and cost per check. Explore opportunities to build, partner or license. Join technical stakeholder conversations on design, functionality, data and security. Qualifications Requirements 4+ years in product or engineering software teams, including recent hands-on work shipping products on top of large language models (agents, tool use, retrieval, evaluations). Daily, fluent use of AI coding tools, and the judgement to tell when code is good enough Experience working with third-party APIs and messy data sources. Basics on data security, privacy and GDPR. Comfortable with short cycles and dropping your own prototypes when the data says so. Great communication skills in English, written and spoken. Spanish is a plus. Nice to have Background in cybersecurity, fraud, threat intelligence, trust & safety or brand protection. Experience with image, video or audio models, deepfake detection or adversarial machine learning. A 0-to-1 track record: a startup, a side project with real users, or a product you launched inside a company. Additional Information What we offer A friendly, diverse, and international team You’ll have top-notch Private Health Insurance, fully covered by the company. 23 working days of holidays per year, plus the local public holidays. Indefinite Contract Fridays we have reduced working hours. And every weekday during August. Tax relief/ ¨Retribución Flexible¨ will also be available for you. We offer a discount with the amazing DIR gyms! We have a Referral policy with a very sweet Bonus scheme. We have a hybrid model, with flexible start time. At the office, we offer fresh fruit, and a huge variety of different kinds of milk, coffee, thé, and cereals. Analyze model behavior and failure modes, identifying systematic weaknesses and translating findings into actionable improvements for training and evaluation. Build tooling and infrastructure that support large-scale experimentation, data generation, review workflows, and evaluation pipelines. Establish best practices for coding-agent assessment, ensuring methodological rigor, reproducibility, and measurement quality. Experience designing, reviewing, or validating technical assessments, benchmarks, coding tasks, or evaluation methodologies. Familiarity with large language models, coding agents, reinforcement learning, model evaluation, or related AI systems. Proven ability to build tooling, automate workflows, and improve technical processes through systematic experimentation. Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate model behavior and derive insights from complex technical systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate technical findings to diverse audiences. items.desc:
We Are Waiting for You 
 Hi there! 
 I am Álvaro, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you! 
 First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center : The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich ! 
 First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier. 
 Who Are We? 
 Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units. 
 In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions. 
 If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale. 
 What Can You Expect? 
 And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked. 
 As an SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Subject Matter Consultant, you will play a key role within the IT Global HR Portfolio Team, supporting SAP SuccessFactors and other global HR systems. 
 Your main responsibilities will include contributing to and advising on the evolution of our SAP SuccessFactors Compensation module, as well provide support to Employee Central module and other global HR SaaS applications. To succeed in this role, you will need to understand customer requirements and recommend design and configuration improvements. You will also ensure alignment with business requirements, acting as a key liaison with the Global HR Technology team. 
 As an SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Subject Matter Consultant , your main responsibilities will include : 
 Collaborate with global and local HR teams to implement, maintain and enhance SuccessFactors Compensation functionality in line with the goals of the Global HR Systems Portfolio and Zurich’s broader IT strategy: 
 Configure and maintain Compensation, Variable Pay and Total Compensation templates, including eligibility rules, budgets, guidelines, workflows, compensation worksheets, statements and executive review processes. 
 Design and support bonus plans, proration logic, business goal mapping, Route Maps and approval workflows, and link Performance Management forms and rating sources to compensation processes. 
 Bring proven hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, as this is an additional requirement for the role. You will contribute to the continuous improvement and enhancement of the Employee Central implementation , including support for new projects and acquisitions, working closely with the Employee Central support team to ensure that IT deliverables are clearly defined and successfully deployed. You will also conduct quality reviews of project IT deliverables , including system configuration, role-based permissions, integrations, and data and system security assessments. 
 Collaborate with the Applications Support team on the overall administration of implemented SuccessFactors modules. This includes reviewing and validating documentation and technical specifications, conducting impact analyses across the landscape, coordinating the implementation of change requests, providing support, and ensuring the prompt resolution of system defects. 
 Collaborate with suppliers and HR teams to implement SAP releases and updates , ensuring that their impact is clearly understood by the HR team. Recommend improvements to applications and integrations and, where appropriate, application decommissioning. 
 Act as a liaison between the CoEs, Global HR and IT within your area of responsibility. 
 What Makes You a great Fit? 
 While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you! 
 A bachelor’s degree or equivalent, preferably in an IT-related field, and at least five years of relevant experience in implementing, supporting and enhancing SuccessFactors systems within multinational organizations

items.desc: Description du poste En tant que Data & IA Engineer , vous rejoindrez l'équipe Conseil de Sahar. Elle accompagne des organisations privées et publiques dans leur transformation par la donnée et l'intelligence artificielle , de la stratégie à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle. Votre rôle : transformer des problèmes métiers concrets en solutions data et IA qui fonctionnent vraiment. Vous travaillerez au plus près des équipes clients pour comprendre leurs enjeux et leurs contraintes. Vous concevrez, construirez et déploierez ensuite les solutions adaptées, du prototype jusqu'à la mise en production, puis vous accompagnerez leur adoption. Vos principales missions seront : Comprendre et cadrer les problématiques métiers Aller sur le terrain auprès des équipes clients pour comprendre leurs processus, leurs données et leurs irritants. Animer des entretiens et des ateliers pour identifier et prioriser les cas d'usage data/IA à plus forte valeur. Transformer des besoins métiers parfois flous en spécifications techniques concrètes et réalistes. Concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions data et IA Construire rapidement des prototypes et des preuves de concept pour tester la valeur d'une solution. Développer et industrialiser des pipelines de données (collecte, traitement, préparation, qualité). Intégrer des briques d'IA (modèles de machine learning, LLM, RAG, agents…) aux outils et aux systèmes existants des clients. Déployer les solutions dans des environnements contraints (sur site, cloud souverain, réseaux isolés…) en respectant les exigences de sécurité. Contribuer à la définition de l'architecture data/IA des solutions. Accompagner l'adoption et faire vivre les solutions Former et accompagner les utilisateurs, y compris ceux qui ne sont pas techniques, dans la prise en main des outils data et IA. Recueillir les retours du terrain et améliorer les solutions en continu. Présenter les résultats et les recommandations aux interlocuteurs métiers et à la direction. Contribuer à la dynamique de l'équipe Capitaliser sur les solutions développées pour créer des briques réutilisables d'une mission à l'autre. Faire remonter les besoins du terrain aux équipes produit et contribuer, selon les opportunités, aux projets OSINT (renseignement en sources ouvertes) de Sahar. Assurer une veille technologique et partager vos connaissances avec les communautés tech de l'entreprise. Vous travaillerez toujours au sein d'une équipe projet et gagnerez progressivement en autonomie sur des volets entiers de missions. Ce que nous proposons Des projets à fort impact, où vos développements répondent directement à des besoins métiers réels. Une grande variété de projets et de secteurs clients, avec la possibilité de travailler sur plusieurs missions. Un accès aux outils IA les plus avancés, intégrés à vos pratiques de développement. Une intégration aux communautés tech de l'entreprise. Une politique de télétravail hybride (2 jours/semaine). Un environnement qui encourage et favorise l'apprentissage continu (hackathons, formations aux usages de l'IA par métier, formation continue…) . Des événements réguliers et fédérateurs, pour célébrer nos réussites individuelles et collectives. Une culture d'entreprise forte, où l'excellence, la sobriété, la curiosité et la confiance sont les maîtres-mots. Compétences requises Compétences techniques : Excellente maîtrise de Python et de SQL . Expérience en ingénierie de données : conception et industrialisation de pipelines, traitement et qualité des données. Bonnes connaissances en IA appliquée : machine learning, LLM, RAG, intégration de modèles dans des applications. Notions solides d' architecture de données et de déploiement (API, conteneurisation, Git, CI/CD). Capacité d' analyse et de synthèse : savoir décomposer un problème métier complexe et proposer une solution pragmatique. Français et anglais courants, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Compétences comportementales : Orientation résultats et pragmatisme : vous privilégiez une solution utile et livrée à une solution parfaite sur le papier. Adaptabilité et flexibilité : vous êtes à l'aise quand les sujets, les environnements clients et les technologies changent. Écoute active : vous savez comprendre les besoins de vos interlocuteurs, y compris quand ils ne sont pas exprimés clairement. Communication : vous savez expliquer des sujets techniques simplement et convaincre des interlocuteurs de niveaux variés. Organisation personnelle , rigueur et souci de la qualité de votre code et de vos livrables. Profil recherché Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs (ou d'un parcours équivalent), avec une spécialisation en data, IA, informatique, cybersécurité ou technologies numériques . 1 à 2 ans d'expérience (stages de fin d'études et alternances compris) en développement data/IA, idéalement dans une ESN, une start-up tech ou chez un industriel de la défense ou de la tech . items.desc: Vill du kombinera din utvecklarbakgrund med AI och hjälpa andra att arbeta smartare? Som AI Adoption Specialist på QueensLab hjälper du våra kunder att använda generativ AI för konkreta förbättringar, både i utvecklingsprocessen och i resten av verksamheten. Med Claude Code, GitHub Copilot och andra AI-verktyg hjälper du utvecklingsteam och andra delar av organisationen att arbeta snabbare, höja kvaliteten och hitta arbetssätt som fungerar i praktiken. Vi tror att AI ger mest när tekniken kombineras med människors kompetens och blir en del av det dagliga arbetet. Om rollen Du arbetar nära kundernas utvecklingsteam, verksamhet och ledning för att hitta användningsområden, testa nya verktyg och bygga upp arbetssätt med AI. Med din egen erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling känner du igen teamens vardag, tekniska utmaningar och arbetsflöden, och kan visa hur AI används på ett praktiskt och ansvarsfullt sätt. Du hjälper också andra funktioner, till exempel HR, ekonomi, sälj och kundservice, att hitta sina egna sätt att använda AI. I rollen kombinerar du teknisk förståelse med coachning, kunskapsdelning och förändringsarbete. Målet är att organisationen ska gå från enstaka experiment till arbetssätt som håller och går att mäta. AI-stödd mjukvaruutveckling Identifiera var AI kan förbättra utvecklingsprocesser, kodkvalitet och produktivitet. Arbeta praktiskt med Claude Code, GitHub Copilot och andra AI-verktyg för mjukvaruutveckling. Utforska hur prompting, kontext, instruktioner och AI-agenter används bäst. Utvärdera nya verktyg och arbetssätt utifrån kundens tekniska miljö och behov. Hjälpa team att gå från enstaka AI-experiment till arbetsflöden som fungerar. Samarbete, coachning och förändring Coacha och stötta utvecklingsteam och andra delar av verksamheten i att arbeta med AI. Hålla praktiska workshops för utvecklare, verksamhet och ledning, utifrån deras behov. Upptäcka vad som hindrar AI-användningen och hjälpa teamen förbi det. Stötta införandet av nya arbetssätt så att AI blir en självklar del av utvecklingsprocessen och det dagliga arbetet. Stötta ledningen i att ta fram riktlinjer, prioritera insatser och skapa förutsättningar för AI-användning i hela verksamheten. Kvalitet och kontinuerlig förbättring Utforska hur AI kan bidra inom kodutveckling, testdesign, testautomatisering och kvalitetssäkring. Hjälpa medarbetare och team att förstå vad AI-verktygen är bra på, var de brister och vilka risker som finns. Verka för ett ansvarsfullt användande med mänsklig granskning och kvalitetssäkring. Följa upp effekterna, till exempel på produktivitet, kodkvalitet, utvecklingsflöde och nytta i verksamheten. Dokumentera lärdomar och arbetssätt som kan återanvändas. Vem söker vi? Du har erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och är intresserad av hur AI förändrar sättet vi bygger mjukvara, och hur hela organisationer arbetar. Du tycker om att testa nya möjligheter, men är minst lika driven av att få dem att fungera i vardagen. Bakgrund som utvecklare, till exempel inom .NET, Azure eller frontend. God insikt i utvecklingsteamens vardag, tekniska utmaningar och arbetsflöden. Praktisk erfarenhet av generativ AI i mjukvaruutveckling, till exempel Claude Code, GitHub Copilot eller liknande verktyg. Förståelse för hur kod, tester, versionshantering, CI/CD och utvecklingsmiljöer hänger ihop. Kunskap om DevOps, Azure och hur man konfigurerar utvecklingsmiljöer, verktyg och arbetsflöden. Förmåga att se var AI kan göra nytta, både tekniskt och i verksamheten, och omsätta det i konkreta förbättringar. Erfarenhet av kundsamarbete och av att stötta eller coacha team. Förståelse för kvalitet, säkerhet och varför mänsklig granskning är viktig när AI används. Du uttrycker dig väl på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Meriterande erfarenheter Förändringsledning eller införande av nya arbetssätt i en organisation. Som person Du är nyfiken, kommunikativ och tar gärna initiativ. Du delar med dig av det du kan och får lätt förtroende hos både utvecklare, verksamhet och ledning. Du kan förklara AI så att både tekniker och icke-tekniker förstår. Du lyssnar in teamens och kundernas behov och anpassar ditt sätt att arbeta efter dem. Du testar gärna nytt, men är pragmatisk och vet att nya arbetssätt måste fungera i vardagen. Det som driver dig mest är att hjälpa människor och team att bli bättre med hjälp av teknik. Därför QueensLab Hos QueensLab kombinerar du din tekniska kompetens med möjligheten att påverka hur våra kunder arbetar. Du får testa ny AI-teknik, omsätta idéer till praktiska förbättringar och hjälpa både utvecklingsteam och hela organisationer framåt. Vi använder AI i vårt eget arbete varje dag, inte bara i det vi gör åt kunderna. Vill du hjälpa fler organisationer att lyckas med AI? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig. items.desc: About the Role Join an early-stage research team working at the intersection of robotics and AI. You will spend most of your time training robot-learning policies, building benchmarks, and publishing results, while helping translate research findings into practical improvements in robot performance. What You'll Do Train and fine-tune policies using robotics datasets, then measure and report their performance improvements. Design benchmarks that assess policy performance on real-world robotic tasks. Select and run appropriate training methods for research questions from start to finish. Help set priorities for tasks, robot embodiments, and data quality standards. Publish research, contribute to open-source work, and explain findings to technical and non-technical audiences. Coordinate with clients, robotics partners, and data teams to connect research with real-world needs. What We're Looking For A completed or nearly completed PhD in robotics or machine learning, or equivalent research experience demonstrated through publications or work at a robotics or AI research lab. Hands-on experience training and evaluating robot policies in simulation or on physical hardware. Research experience in physical AI or robot learning, such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, or dexterous manipulation. Strong experimental habits, including running experiments early, documenting findings promptly, and reporting negative results. Clear communication skills for sharing technical results with researchers, operations teams, and clients. Daily familiarity with AI tools and coding agents. Early-career research experience, from near completion of a PhD to a few years of postdoctoral or equivalent experience. Publications at leading robotics or machine learning venues, real robot hardware experience, or familiarity with large-scale robotics datasets and data pipelines are valuable. Professional English and willingness to work on-site in Barcelona or relocate. Compensation & Benefits Competitive salary, equity, and relocation support are available. Salary range and visa sponsorship policy were not specified. Location On-site in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain.

You will work closely
items.desc: About Boltz Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible. Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes. We focus on two things: Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations. Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster. The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs. You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto. About the role As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own getting Boltz Lab running inside our enterprise customers' environments, and keeping it running. Large pharma partners often need our platform deployed in their own cloud or tenant, and how fast and smoothly we do that decides how quickly they can start real discovery work; our goal is a full enterprise deployment in under 30 days. You will work closely with customers' IT, security and cloud teams, our Platform and Product engineers, and our Commercial team. This role is ideal for someone who likes being the engineer in the room with the customer, is calm when a deployment breaks, and turns every hard install into a faster one next time. What you'll do Lead deployments of Boltz Lab into customer cloud environments and dedicated tenants, from kickoff to acceptance. Work through each customer's networking, identity, security and compliance requirements, and track blockers to resolution. Support live tenants against agreed service targets: monitoring, upgrades, incident response and root-cause fixes. Automate what you learn into infrastructure-as-code, deployment tooling and runbooks, so each deployment takes less time than the last. Bring what you see in the field back to Platform and Product, from missing features to security and compliance needs (including our SOC 2 and ISO work). About you Minimum Requirements Experience deploying and operating production software on cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS, GCP or Azure), as a DevOps, SRE, infrastructure or solutions engineer. We're hiring at Junior to Senior level. Hands-on with Kubernetes, Docker and infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), plus solid Linux, networking and scripting (Python or Bash). Working knowledge of enterprise security: identity and SSO, network isolation, secrets management and access control. A track record of getting deployments or migrations over the line under real constraints and deadlines. Clear, confident communication with technical customers, and the judgment to know when to escalate. Preferred Requirements Experience in a customer-facing engineering role (forward deployed, solutions or implementation engineering), especially with pharma, biotech or other regulated enterprises. Experience running GPU workloads, or ML systems in production; exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar compliance work. Early-stage startup experience; experience using Boltz models or open-source contributions. We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you. What we offer Own how Boltz Lab reaches the world's leading pharma teams. Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field. Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment. Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company. Benefits: 25 days plus bank holidays a year Annual team offsite trip Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions Pension program Paid parental leave Wellhub gym membership Free lunch every day Travel expenses How we hire Initial screen with a member of the Talent team Technical interview: a deployment and troubleshooting scenario Onsite in London with the team Offer + Onboarding Our commitment Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

items.desc: Faculty of Science and Engineering - School of Architecture, Computing and EngineeringFixed Term: 36-month contract Full time: 37 Hours per weekThe University of Wolverhampton is seeking an exceptional MSc or PhD graduate to join a pioneering Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP) with Korutek Engineering Ltd, one of the UK's leading low carbon food cooling solutions providers. Surface Engineer (KTP Associate) - FTC Faculty of Science and Engineering - School of Architecture, Computing and Engineering Fixed Term: 36-month contract Full time: 37 Hours per week The University of Wolverhampton is seeking an exceptional MSc or PhD graduate to join a pioneering Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP) with Korutek Engineering Ltd, one of the UK's leading low carbon food cooling solutions providers. As a surface engineer (KTP Associate) you will develop and help commercialise MuMiGroovEs (Multiscale MicroGrooves) evaporators, a passive, ultra-efficient anti-frost fin technology that keeps freezers running. You will be employed by the University of Wolverhampton and work full-time to the company's Norwich premises for the 36-month project duration. Co-funded by Innovate UK and Korutek Engineering Ltd, this KTP brings together world-class academic expertise in coalescence-induced jumping-droplet condensation and superhydrophobic micro-grooved surfaces with Korutek's deep industry knowledge. The partnership will deliver commercially viable anti-frost fin packs, enabling a step-change in energy efficiency, frost reduction and system compactness. Main Duties and Responsibilities include: Technical Development Develop multiscale micro-grooved surface engineering, laser micromachining of aluminium and advanced thermo-fluids protocols specifically for Korutek Engineering. Develop a highly efficient, scalable and sustainable evaporator technology that cuts energy use, reduces defrosting, boosts productivity and lowers environmental impact for freezing and chilling systems Develop in-house capability in surface engineering and laser-texturing, delivering major energy savings, cut frost accumulation, extend production time, and allow retrofit installation Design, optimise and test laser-etched micro-grooves, from nano- to micro-scale, that trigger coalescence-induced jumping-droplet shedding so condensate leaves the fin before it can freeze. A dedicated test freezer will benchmark performance over six months of freeze-thaw trial Remove the need to use fluoropolymer coatings which carry PFAS forever chemicals Research, Innovation and Commercialisation Apply state-of-the-art research in multiscale micro-grooved surface engineering, laser micromachining of aluminium and advanced thermo-fluids to practical use cases. Engage with academic experts to ensure the scientific validity and robustness of the solution. Contribute to academic publications, industry-focused project demonstrators, and knowledge dissemination. Support the company in creating a sustainable model for MuMiGroovEs within the business. Engage regularly with scoping and estimating, design and commercial team and other stakeholders to refine product-market fit and user experience Contribute to intellectual property development and the exploration of commercial pathways for MuMiGroovEs Project Management and Stakeholder Engagement Plan, monitor, and deliver KTP project milestones on time and within scope. Produce progress reports and presentations for senior stakeholders and Innovate UK. Work collaboratively across academic and industrial teams. What we are looking for MSc or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or Project Management. A background in Surface Engineering/Modifications and/or Thermofluids Competency in control systems and automation Design and fabrication experience is highly desirable Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an entrepreneurial mindset. Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role offers a competitive salary alongside a dedicated personal training and development budget to invest in building your skills across the life of the project. You will also have the opportunity to attend the fully funded KTP residential leadership and management programme facilitated by Innovate UK. Working closely with leading researchers at the University of Wolverhampton, you will have the opportunity to contribute to academic publications and develop a credible research profile that runs alongside your industry delivery. There will be the opportunity to interact with company staff, industrial partners, clients as well as University of Wolverhampton academics. The role will allow the successful candidate to apply their knowledge to a commercial project, finding creative innovative solutions to industry problems. For an informal discussion about the post please contact Professor Arun Arjunan at the University of Wolverhampton (A.Arjunan@wlv.ac.uk) FTC …

items.desc: Rejoignez Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence (CA-AI), la nouvelle entité du groupe Crédit Agricole dédiée à l’industrialisation et au déploiement de solutions IA communes, au service de la transformation des métiers du Groupe [lancement officiel le 19/10/2026]. En agissant chaque jour dans l'intérêt de la société, nous sommes un groupe engagé en faveur des diversités et de l'inclusion et plaçons l'humain au cœur de toutes nos transformations. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Les missions seront : Etablir un état de l’art du domaine en croisant à la fois les articles récents concernant les VLM et le grand nombre de techniques anciennes d’attaques adverses Implémenter des attaques innovantes en réutilisant des schémas d’attaques connus venant du passé Expliquer le manque de généralisation avec des outils observant le fonctionnement global des modèles (explicabilité, activations, …) Rédiger un rapport permettant de rendre compte des travaux menés et potentiellement publier un article scientifique Organisation et livrables : Dans l’objectif de livrer des fonctionnalités intégrables au sein des solutions industrielles en production, les stages se déroulent sous l’encadrement d’experts IA au sein d’une Squad pluridisciplinaire ayant comme référent fonctionnel un chef de projet IA, et selon la méthode Projet du DataLab Groupe qui fait l’objet d’une certification IA de confiance et d’une labélisation RSE. Le stagiaire aura accès à des environnements d’engineering industriel puissants et à l’état de l’art, en local et dans le cloud. Les modèles seront évalués sur des données internes (annotées si besoin) ainsi que des données externes (open-data), et seront intégrés dans les produits et services IA en production. Des interactions avec l’ensemble des équipes data science et engineering et des experts métier du Groupe auront lieu. items.desc: Au sein du modeleur géométrique, l'équipe élévation de sémantique et solveurs est en charge du modèle 3D et des algorithmes fondamentaux du modeling 3D utilisés par l'ensemble des solutions du groupe Dassault Systèmes. Vos missions Le but du stage est la reconnaissance automatique (éventuellement par IA) des connecteurs de pièces Le stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’un projet dont le but est la reconnaissance automatique des connecteurs de pièces plastique en vue de calculs de structure. Un fois identifiés, ces connecteurs nécessitent un traitement particulier pour le maillage. Le problème de la reconnaissance des connecteurs peut se ramener à la reconnaissance de sous-graphes issus d'un catalogue dans un grand graphe cible. Parmi les approches possibles, une implémentation IA utilisant les GNN (Graph Neural Networks) semble prometteuse. L’objectif du stage est d’étudier des pistes pour améliorer la qualité de la reconnaissance. Ceci pourra passer par l’évaluation d’approches de la littérature ou par l’amélioration de certains composants algorithmiques (estimation d’épaisseur par raycasting) pour permettre un meilleur apprentissage. Recherches bibliographiques Evaluation des forces et faiblesses du code existant Selon les conclusions : Amélioration algorithmique Nouvelle approche IA par reconnaissance de sous-graphe Vos Qualifications Étudiant en cursus BAC+5 en école d’ingénieurs ou formation universitaire avec une spécialité en informatique / mathématiques appliquées, vous êtes à la recherche d'un stage de 6 mois. Vous êtes à l’aise sur la programmation C++ et Python (Pytorch) Vous avez un goût prononcé pour la géométrie et avez des connaissances en IA Vous faites preuve de motivation, d’autonomie et d’un esprit critique Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais Type de contrat : Stage conventionné seulement Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé (salles de sport & de musique, conciergerie…) Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes, etc Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. items.desc: Job Title Internship Building the Future of Work with Low-Code AI Skills for Vanderlande Job Description Assignment type Internship Start date February 2026 Assignment duration 6 months Location Veghel Education level Bachelor / Master Desired study Business IT & management, software engineering, data science & artificial intelligence, business innovation Language Dutch / English Description of assignment At Vanderlande, we are accelerating the way our global workforce operates by embedding AI initiatives into daily workflows. Today, many employees and citizen developers across teams are actively experimenting with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Power Platform, SharePoint agents, and Copilot Studio. However, these innovative AI skills and prompt patterns are not yet structured or shared consistently, making it difficult for teams to reuse proven solutions and scale AI adoption effectively. In this forward-thinking internship, you will help design, build, and structure Vanderlande's first reusable AI skill catalogue. You will explore employee needs, establish clear criteria for categorizing and sharing AI tools, and develop a first series of practical, reusable skills ranging from Office productivity tools to advanced low-code building blocks. Your research will provide a scalable framework that enables colleagues to adopt AI safely, practically, and efficiently. Department description You will join the Digital Acceleration team, a global unit within ICT Support at Vanderlande. As an AI Adoption Engineer, you help clients move from AI ideas to usable solutions. You will support business teams in identifying needs, structuring use cases, organizing workshops, shaping prototypes and guiding adoption. You will not work alone: you will be backed by CGI experts in AI, automation, DevOps, ITSM, data, security and change management. What You Will Do Identify and structure AI opportunities Facilitate business and IT workshops Prioritize use cases by value, feasibility and risk Support Copilot, AI agents and automation prototypes Guide training, documentation and adoption How You Strengthen Our Team You are technically strong, analytical, and enjoy solving complex challenges in a multidisciplinary environment. You thrive in dynamic environments where reliability, scalability, and performance are essential. IT delivery, consulting, Business Analyst, product ownership or automation background Good understanding of Copilot, ChatGPT or similar GenAI tools Clear communication with business and technical teams Pragmatic mindset: start small, test fast, measure value Interest in responsible AI and workflow automation Fluent in English and French, Dutch is a strong plus depending on client context. A pre-employment screening is part of the application process Why CGI? CGI is one of the world's largest IT consultancy companies. Our people keep Belgium running. Government institutions, banks, infrastructure organization's, energy and utilities, manufacturing and life sciences companies are CGI's clients . We work on interesting projects that touch the everyday lives of millions of people. We have a regional presence, reinforced with global domain expertise, our ecosystem and colleagues spread across the globe. We are proud of the impactful projects we make a success together with our colleagues. At CGI, we value diversity and inclusion as it not only promotes collaboration, but also often leads to better results. We look forward to your contribution to our team! Working in small self-managing teams consisting of experts in your field. Directing your own career with the space to keep developing yourself. You work with the latest technologies. An excellent salary and attractive fringe benefits An immediate permanent contract And the opportunity to become a CGI shareholder Join our team of experts and apply now! Questions about the position? Ask them to Ramiro Santos, Vice President Consulting Services, via ramiro.santos@cgi.com. For more information about the application procedure, please contact recruiter Nick Damen nick.damen@cgi.com We do not collaborate with external recruitment agencies. Therefore, unsolicited acquisition is not appreciated. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Criteria Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. In 1976 opgericht als een familiebedrijf, is CGI vandaag de dag een van de grootste onafhankelijke zakelijke en ICT-dienstverleners ter wereld. Bij ons draait het om ownership, teamwork en respect. Je krijgt de ruimte om al je talenten volledig te ontplooien. Vanaf je eerste werkdag ben je mede-eigenaar van CGI. We profiteren samen van ons succes en je krijgt de kans én verantwoordelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de koers en strategie van ons bedrijf. Jouw inzet voegt waarde toe. Je werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en bouwt aan je netwerk van collega's en klanten. Je hebt toegang tot wereldwijde kansen om je ideeën te realiseren, mogelijkheden te benutten en te profiteren van onze kennis van de industrie en technologische expertise. Ontdek bij ons de mogelijkheden voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en zet de volgende stap in je carrière. Hier staat jouw succes centraal!

items.desc: Role Title : Arabic AI Evaluator (Remote) Role Type : Full-time Location : Remote About : Based in San Francisco, California, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Key Qualifications 1. Arabic Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Arabic with a high degree of comp, as Arabic is the focus language for this project. 2. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. 3. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. 4. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality. 5. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. 6. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections. 7. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. 8. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. 9. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. 10. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 11. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. 12. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: 1. In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: 2. Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences. 3. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. 4. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. 5. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating". 6. Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. 7. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. 8. Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. 9. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience 1. BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). 2. Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: 1. Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. 2. Engagement type: Contractor 3. Engagement Length: 3 months 4. Our offered rate for this project is $15 per hour. Evaluation Process - 1. Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. 2. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. 3. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will …

items.desc:
Lieu : Palaiseau, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
Thales Research&Technology, notre centre de recherche dans les domaines matériels, et CortAIx Labs, notre centre de recherche en IA et digital ont pour mission de proposer des innovations de ruptures, de maintenir et d’accroitre l’avance technologique et d’en assurer la compétitivité pour le groupe. 
 Les algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique, en particulier fondés sur les réseaux de neurones, présentent une difficulté de caractérisation des sorties : comment savoir si un résultat est fiable, quel niveau de confiance peut lui être accordé ?
 Une approche de caractérisation intrinsèque de la confiance d'un résultat, à travers l'analyse des états internes du modèle au cours du processus d'inférence, a été développée. Cette approche a été testée sur des tâches de classification, en testant la capacité à détecter des nouveautés à l’inférence, mais limitée à des nouveautés « naturelles », c’est‑à‑dire réalistes ou perturbées mais non spécifiquement conçues pour tromper l’algorithme.
 Votre objectif sera d’étudier les possibilités méthodologiques pour adapter cette approche à la détection d’attaques adverses, et de réaliser des implémentations de cette méthodologie à travers la génération de ces attaques et l’analyse de la capacité de l’outil à les détecter.
 Dans ce contexte, vous aurez pour missions :
 Vous approprier l’existant : méthodologie et Framework open source « scio » ;
 Parcourir la littérature scientifique pour identifier des approches adaptées à la détection d’attaques dans les espaces latents des modèles d’apprentissage profond ;
 Établir, avec l’équipe, un protocole de génération d’attaques et des approches de détection ;
 Réaliser l’implémentation de ces méthodes en préservant la compatibilité avec l’existant.
 Bien qu’une partie significative de vos missions porte sur des expérimentations pratiques, vous vous concentrerez sur la création de connaissances plutôt que sur l’expérimentation débridée. Vous pourrez ainsi appliquer vos connaissances à des cas d’application réels, tout en découvrant comment une méthode scientifique structurée peut répondre à des enjeux industriels et techniques.
 Votre profil 
 STAGE – Ingénieur en détection d’attaques adverses en temps réel : scores de confiance en Machine Learning (H/F) – 6 mois 
 Vous avez l’ambition de rejoindre Thales et de contribuer à l’innovation ?
 Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche fondamentale et appliquée et les innovations technologiques ?
 Vous êtes motivé par la recherche expérimentale en milieu industriel ?
 Étudiant en Master 2 en école d’ingénieur ou équivalent, en algorithmique/IA ou informatique, vous avez des compétences en :
 Apprentissage automatique et réseaux de neurones ;
 Développement de logiciels en Python, utilisation des bibliothèques de ML classiques (en particulier Pytorch) ;
 Application de techniques de ML sur des projets réalistes, et préparation de données associée ;
 Méthodes scientifiques expérimentales : extraction de méthodologies et de bonnes pratiques à partir de campagnes d'expérimentation et de tests ;
 Français courant et Anglais (lu, parlé, écrit) niveau C1 attendu.
 Autonomie, rigueur et esprit de synthèse sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?
 Alors ce stage est fait pour vous !
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc:
Are you a details-oriented communicator who loves turning messy data into clear, actionable insights?
 At Bosch Home Comfort , we are looking for a proactive Operations & Customer Data Coordinator to join our team in Jüri (Harjumaa). In this role, you will play a vital part in ensuring the quality and safety of our installed hot water preparation systems across the Baltic region. You will bridge the gap between end-user databases and real-world safety updates, reaching out directly to customers while keeping our regional and factory teams aligned.
 Your key responsibilities: 
 Data analysis & management: Collect, clean, and analyze information regarding installed hot water systems. You will work with end-user data which is often incomplete, identifying missing details to prepare systems for rebuilds or safety equipment (CO detector) deliveries.
 Proactive communication: Reach out to end-users (private individuals) to verify technical configurations, update missing customer details, and coordinate safety solutions.
 Reporting: Prepare regular progress and operations reports for our manufacturing factory.
 Stakeholder alignment: Communicate smoothly with Bosch Home Comfort colleagues across the Baltics and international offices.
 External coordination: Act as the main contact point for external partners, including hotlines, support services, and technician networks.
 Information management: Prepare and update operational information to be published on company websites and portals.
Excel savvy: Strong skills working with Excel and managing databases. You should feel comfortable sorting, filtering, and organizing messy data.
 Excellent communication: Strong interpersonal skills with a friendly, professional approach to speaking with different types of people (from end-users to corporate colleagues).
 Languages: Fluency in Estonian and English (written and verbal) is required.
 Quality focus: A highly responsible, thorough, and structured approach to your work.
 Technical mindset: You do not need deep technical engineering knowledge. However, a general understanding of gas heating systems is a great advantage!
Salary: €1,500 – €1,900 gross/monthly (depending on your experience and skills).
 Employment contract until 01.08.2027 with outlook for extension.
 Office in Jüri (Harjumaa) with flexible opportunities to work from home.
 Personal and professional development within international working environment
 Make it happen! 
 If you see that you are finding new challenges in the BOSCH Group, please send us your CV and motivation letter in English (as HR team is located in Latvia).
 Contact person: Jaak Lond, after sales manager, phone number +372-5161202
 We will contact the applicants who qualify for the job interview.

 CSEM mission and values
 We believe in a future that is imagined, shared, and created TOGETHER.

 A solar team focused on enabling solutions to energy challenges for a sustainable world

items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 13, 2026, 4:19PM Durée du contrat : 6 mois Au sein d'une équipe qui conçoit des solutions data et d'intelligence artificielle pour les métiers des infrastructures réseau, Orange recherche un·e stagiaire en data science et IA. L'objectif : transformer les données techniques et opérationnelles en analyses, outils et prédictions réellement utilisés par les équipes sur le terrain. Vos missions : Comprendre les besoins des métiers avec les chefs de projet et les utilisateurs, puis explorer et préparer les solutions Concevoir, entraîner et évaluer des modèles de machine learning adaptés au cas d'usage Industrialiser le modèle retenu avec les experts data, IA et les développeurs : code maintenable, tests, documentation et suivi de la performance Contribuer à la conception des architectures nécessaires aux solutions, avec les équipes cloudops et devops Présenter vos résultats à des interlocuteurs non spécialistes et participer à la veille de l'équipe sur l'IA Vous utilisez les outils data et IA de l'équipe dans le respect des règles de sécurité et de confidentialité des données. Vous êtes intégré·e à l'équipe : animations, réunions et suivi de vos activités dans Jira. Votre tuteur et les experts vous accompagnent tout au long du stage. Vous préparez un Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs ou Master) en informatique, avec une spécialisation en data science ou en intelligence artificielle, pour un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois. Vos compétences techniques (hard skills) : Maîtrise de Python et de ses bibliothèques de data et de machine learning Connaissance des méthodes de machine learning et de l'évaluation de la qualité d'un modèle Première pratique du deep learning ou des grands modèles de langage (LLM) SQL pour interroger des bases de données Bonnes pratiques de développement : gestion de versions, code lisible, tests, documentation Sensibilité à la qualité, à la sécurité et à la confidentialité des données Très bon niveau de lecture de la documentation technique en anglais Vos qualités personnelles (soft skills) : Aisance en communication : vous échangez facilement et n'hésitez pas à poser vos questions ou à signaler une difficulté Curiosité et force de proposition Autonomie : vous traitez les tâches confiées, demandez de l'aide quand il le faut et rendez compte régulièrement Rigueur et méthode : précision, respect des procédures et des jalons Goût du travail en équipe et des méthodes agiles Capacité à expliquer simplement vos travaux à des interlocuteurs non techniques Vos projets, vos activités extra-scolaires avec un vrai investissement (association, travail d'été, compétition) sont les bienvenus. Les ++++ Des cas d'usage concrets d'IA, au service de la performance du réseau d'Orange Un stage de 6 mois pour mener un projet de bout en bout Une équipe pluridisciplinaire : data analysts, experts IA, développeurs, chefs de projet La découverte des environnements cloud et des outils data/IA d'un grand groupe Une équipe nombreuse, avec un accompagnement au quotidien L'indemnité mensuelle brute de stage proposée est comprise entre 1300 et 1600 euros selon votre niveau d'études en cours. À cela s'ajoutent l'accès aux activités sociales et culturelles proposées par votre comité social et économique, l'accès au restaurant d'entreprise ou aux titres-restaurant, ainsi que la prise en charge à hauteur de 50 % de votre abonnement au transport en commun. La direction des Infrastructures a pour ambition d’être l’opérateur d’infrastructures de référence sur chacun de nos territoires. Ses missions sont : piloter la construction, la vie du réseau, l’exploitation et la maintenance des infrastructures fibre, cuivre et génie civil, pour Orange et pour le compte de tiers en tant qu’opérateur d’infrastructures ou opérateur industriel ; assurer la qualité de service et la performance opérationnelle des infrastructures ; mettre en œuvre les programmes de déploiement des infrastructures et de fermeture du réseau cuivre ; réaliser les études techniques et assurer le support opérationnel (gestion des ressources, maintenance préventive, expertise, back office). Elle compte 2 922 salariés répartis sur 9 régions. Au sein de cette direction, l’équipe Data accompagne les équipes opérationnelles d’Orange France dans le déploiement, l’exploitation et la maintenance des réseaux des opérateurs d’infrastructures (Orange, Orange Concession, collectivités). Elle participe à la transformation numérique de l’entreprise et construit des architectures de données innovantes (Power BI, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure). Ses nouveaux projets intègrent l’intelligence artificielle et la géomatique. Date de début souhaitée : Jan 04, 2027, 12:00AM Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent. Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur …

Une culture d’entreprise dynamique : Événements fédérateurs, actions solidaires, webinaires innovation, challenges variés… Faites l’expérience d’un environnement stimulant où vous pourrez partager vos talents et vos passions. items.desc: LoopforgeLab enables machine and hardware makers make better design decisions by better we mean shorter design iterations, more sustainable products with less cost to manufacture and own. We are building the Forge Engine is an agentic tool for manufacturing. Give it a BOM and a STEP file and it returns what the part costs to make and what the machine will cost to own over fifteen years, while there is still time to change the design. The lifecycle engine is built and runs on declared drivers. The agent already modifies geometry from natural-language instructions on our platform. The next piece is the reason we are hiring. We need geometry reasoning that holds up on real customer CAD: feature recognition from B-rep, tolerances read per feature rather than per part, similarity against parts we have already costed, and an evaluation setup that shows whether the agent is improving or only sounding more certain. Also we need to build integrations with different CAD/ERP and PLM systems. What you would own: The geometry reasoning module. Feature extraction from STEP, manufacturability signals, tolerance and surface finish handling. The design agent’s optimisation loop. Iterating a design against a cost or lifecycle target rather than following instructions. Evaluation. Benchmarks, regression suites, and the discipline to drop approaches that do not beat the baseline. Architecture decisions with the founder, including when LLM reasoning beats rules and when it does not. Reasoning Engine and live context retriever Who you probably are: Strong experience with one of those: Python/Rust and C++ and real ML depth. You have built at least once in your life a geometric deep learning, GNNs, 3D representation learning modules in real production data settings and they're used by real users right now. You have touched mechanical engineering for real. A degree, CAE/CAD/CAM work, manufacturing process knowledge, or a PhD near feature recognition, DFM or process simulation. You know why a tight tolerance on one face costs more than a loose one on five. Comfortable with messy industrial data. Re-exported CAD that parses differently, BOMs with missing fields, 40 parts rather than 40,000. You ship. Two-week demoable checkpoints rather than six-month research tracks. Familiar with sustainability concepts and how do they be applied in the context of design and manufacturing Nice to have: OpenCascade, PythonOCC, or commercial CAD kernel experience. MCP servers, agent tooling, or LLM-in-the-loop CAD work. Co-founder-level equity with standard vesting. You would be the third engineer in the room, which means you own things outright, including the parts nobody enjoys. We plan to open source what the community builds and put a private product layer on top.

items.desc: Vill du kombinera din utvecklarbakgrund med AI och hjälpa andra att arbeta smartare? Som AI Adoption Specialist på QueensLab hjälper du våra kunder att omsätta möjligheterna med generativ AI till konkreta förbättringar – i utvecklingsprocessen och i resten av verksamheten. Vi tror att AI skapar störst värde när tekniken kombineras med människors kompetens och blir en naturlig del av det dagliga arbetet. Om rollen Du arbetar tätt med kundernas organisationer – från utvecklingsteam till verksamhet och ledning – för att hitta användningsområden, testa nya verktyg och bygga upp effektiva arbetssätt med AI. AI-stödd mjukvaruutveckling Identifiera användningsområden där AI kan förbättra utvecklingsprocesser, kodkvalitet och produktivitet. Stötta ledningen i att ta fram riktlinjer, prioritera insatser och skapa förutsättningar för AI-användning i hela verksamheten. Förmåga att se var AI kan göra nytta, både tekniskt och i verksamheten, och omsätta det i konkreta förbättringar. Erfarenhet av kundsamarbete och av att stötta eller coacha team, både inom utveckling och i verksamheten. Förståelse för kvalitet, säkerhet och varför mänsklig granskning är viktig när AI används. Gärna erfarenhet av förändringsledning eller av att införa nya arbetssätt i en organisation. Som person Du är nyfiken, kommunikativ och tar gärna initiativ. Du delar gärna med dig av det du kan och har lätt för att bygga förtroende hos allt från utvecklare till verksamhet och ledning. Du kan förklara AI så att både tekniker och icke-tekniker förstår. Du lyssnar in olika teams och kunders behov och anpassar ditt sätt att arbeta efter dem. Du testar gärna nytt, men är samtidigt pragmatisk och vet att nya arbetssätt måste fungera i verkligheten för att skapa värde. Det som driver dig mest är att hjälpa människor och team att växa och bli bättre med hjälp av teknik.
