One Health, Data Centre Sustainability). You will be involved in
items.desc: Salary - £40,574 - £43,056 Hybrid working (50/50) Permanent, full-time (37 hours per week) Closing date for applications: Thursday 26 November 2026. We reserve the right to close this advert early if we find the right candidate, so we encourage you to apply early. An exciting opportunity for an Environmental Data Scientist to join our Digital Innovation group at UKCEH Lancaster to work on delivering the cutting-edge data science, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and analytical components of the UKCEH Digital Strategy across our monitoring and modelling portfolio and integrating these into our Digital Research Infrastructure (DRI). The DRI at UKCEH supports the full lifecycle of environmental science projects, from monitoring and processing data to analysing and visualising data for decision-making under uncertainty. This involves a range of services for stakeholders, and most importantly for this role, the Environmental Data Science Toolbox – enhancing the discoverability and reuse of data science and AI methods across the environmental community. Other tools include data repositories such as the Environmental Information Data Centre (EIDC) and virtual laboratories for scientific collaborations (such as DataLabs). You will play a crucial role in developing innovative approaches to exploit and integrate the data we collect, enhancing its discoverability within the wider environmental science community and explore how the latest advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be used to support systems thinking approaches to environmental science challenges (E.g. One Health, Data Centre Sustainability). You will be involved in working with a variety of digital objects (e.g., models, methods, workflows) from across the UKCEH portfolio, leveraging the latest data science and AI techniques (ranging from machine learning to large language models). This will enable us to address increasingly complex scientific questions and improve the efficiency and sustainability of our processes. Your main responsibilities will include: Use state-of-the-art data science and AI techniques to investigate new ways of integrating a broad range of data and other digital objects available in the UKCEH portfolio and beyond (E.g. Citizen science data, sensor networks and large process-based models.) Research and develop novel and reusable approaches and associated methods to enhance discoverability of UKCEH’s digital objects, specifically large scale long-term environmental data Build on techniques such as natural language processing, spatial analysis, and machine learning to develop data science methods and analytical workflows to drive forwards whole systems approaches to tackling environmental science challenges (E.g. Individually, our departments lead their fields. In partnership, they develop new responses to pressing world issues. As a whole, they represent a world-leading, multidisciplinary faculty, united by the radical spirit of UCL. Our vision is of a world where everything that’s built aims to add to the well-being of people and the environment. The Bartlett is unrivalled in its breadth and depth of disciplines, programmes and departments. It is made up 13 Schools, Institutes, Centres and Units, providing teaching and research in a wide range of subject areas to over 4,000 students each year from across the world. About IIPP The Institute for Innovation and Public Purpose (IIPP) at University College London (UCL) brings together cutting-edge academic theory with teaching and policy practice, to rethink the role of the state in tackling some of the biggest challenges facing society. IIPP works with partners to develop a framework which challenges traditional economic thinking, with the goal of creating, nurturing and evaluating public value in order to achieve growth that is more innovation-led, inclusive and sustainable. This requires rethinking the underlying economics that have informed the education of global public servants and the design of government policies. IIPP’s work feeds into innovation and industrial policy, financial reform, institutional change and sustainable development. A key pillar of IIPP’s research is its understanding of markets as outcomes of the interactions between different actors. In this context, public policy should not be seen as simply fixing market failures, but also as actively shaping and co-creating markets. Re-focusing and designing public organisations around mission-led, public purpose aims will help tackle the grand challenges facing the 21st century. IIPP is uniquely structured to ensure that this ground-breaking academic research is harnessed to tackle real world policy challenges. IIPP does this through its high-quality teaching programme, along with its growing global network of partners, and the ambitious policy practice programme. IIPP is a department within UCL - and part of The Bartlett, ranking number one in the world for architecture and the built environment in the world. About the project The University College London (UCL) Institute for Innovation and Public Purpose (IIPP) is working with the support of Bloomberg Philanthropies to develop the Public Sector Capabilities Index, the first global tool designed to assess dynamic capabilities in city governments. Since 2023, the project has engaged over 200 city officials across 40 cities in more than 20 countries to build the foundations of the Index. The next phase is a three-year collaboration to scale and embed adoption of the Index. Our aim is to reach at least 3,500 cities worldwide, creating a robust and globally comparable dataset that establishes the Index as a standard for cities and their funders and governments, to catalyse city government improvements. This will allow decision-makers at city, national, regional and multilateral levels to better assess where and how to invest in public sector capabilities. Further details about the Public Sector Capabilities Index are in our recent report available here. https://www.ucl.ac.uk/bartlett/publications/2025/oct/assessing-dynamic-capabilities-city-governments-creating-public-sector-capabilities-index About the role Duties and responsibilities Contribute to conceptual development by furthering our understanding of how city government officials in varying contexts use language. We are always interested in connecting with talented Process Analytics Engineers (gn) who want to help our customers get real value from process data. There's no open position for this role just yet - we're building a talent pool of qualified candidates so we can move quickly once hiring starts. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will reach out as soon as a matching opportunity opens up. This is a hybrid role. We especially welcome applications from candidates based in or near Hasselt (Belgium) or Barcelona (Spain). In return, we offer you Build something that matters. Join an innovative company that’s growing fast, and grow right along with it. Work with great people. Be part of a talented, ambitious team that collaborates across countries and cultures. Stay ahead of the curve. Explore, learn, and experiment with cutting-edge technologies every day. Make your mark. Your ideas count here: Help shape our technology choices, pitch new features, and see your impact firsthand. We’ve got you covered. Competitive salary package, with fringe benefits depending on country of residence Your Role Through an affinity with technology and special interest in data analytics, you quickly gain a deep understanding of our platform to serve as a functional expert to our client You implement and roll out scaled analytics solutions on top of TrendMiner. This will involve the use of core TrendMiner capabilities while also leveraging Python. These custom packages offer additional functionalities specific to the needs of our client's different business units, and are built working together with the client's process experts. You work on developing data models and integrating different data sources and applications (process historians, relational databases, BI tools, etc.) with the TrendMiner platform. You train the client's process experts on how to use the solution packages, and the TrendMiner platform in general. You take the lead on your own projects, working proactively with contacts across the client organisation to keep them moving. You build up intimate knowledge of how this customer uses TrendMiner to achieve value, which enables you to serve as the voice of the customer within our company, helping direct further product development. You will be part of the Customer Success team within TrendMiner, but will be dedicated to a client full-time. Given their global presence, occasional travel to production sites may be required. items.desc: Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. But we've got more left to do — and that's where you come in! We are looking for a research assistant with expertise in research methods and project management to help Duolingo's Efficacy Research Lab with critical tasks, including providing project management for internal research studies to evaluate Duolingo's courses and assisting with data analysis. This is a freelance contract position with potential for renewal. All work will be conducted remotely and hours are flexible. What you'll do Coordinate the day-to-day operations of a portfolio of concurrent research studies, keeping timelines, milestones, dependencies, and next steps visible and on track. Work closely with learning scientists in the Efficacy Research Lab to plan and execute study logistics, including preparing materials, coordinating pilots, launching data collection, and arranging testing with external providers. Build, maintain, and quality-check surveys and assessments in Qualtrics, including setting them up for recurring use. Manage ongoing data collection: monitor study and data-collection workflows, troubleshoot operational issues, respond to participant emails, and coordinate participant payments. Serve as a reliable point of contact for external partners and agencies, track deliverables and follow through on open items. Support data organization, quality checks, and basic analysis using Google Sheets and Python. Help prepare research reports and manuscripts by coordinating review steps, proofreading, and checking materials for accuracy and consistency. What you will need Experience coordinating research with human participants, including study logistics and participant-facing communication. Strong project- or study-management skills: you can keep multiple workstreams organized, anticipate dependencies, track details, and follow through reliably. Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills, including comfort coordinating with researchers, participants, and external partners. Meticulous attention to detail and excellent time management. Strong proficiency with Qualtrics and/or JavaScript, including building and maintaining surveys or assessments. Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas and pivot tables. Working proficiency with Python for data organization, quality checks, or analysis. Exceptional candidates will have Experience managing multiple studies or research projects at once, especially studies involving external vendors or testing providers. Experience with statistical analysis in Python, R, or similar tools. Familiarity with assessment science, applied linguistics, or educational technology. Experience preparing research outputs for publication, including LaTeX or other document-formatting tools. About Duolingo Duolingo is the most popular language-learning application in the world, with over 500 million users and over half a billion exercises completed daily. Beyond our core learning product, we also offer English proficiency testing with the Duolingo English Test, and are bringing new subjects into the Duolingo app, where people can develop their Math and Music skills. We are passionate about educating our users, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. We offer meaningful work, limitless learning opportunities, and collaboration with world-class minds. Come brighten your life and over half a billion more! Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. By applying for this position your data will be processed as per the Duolingo Applicant Privacy Notice (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yCQDlSKOH3xLNRnJZc3IZGoHhNRPA6jX/view?usp=sharing).

items.desc: £42,159 per annum This is fixed-term position for 12 months to cover a period of family leave. This is a rolling advertisement and may close early if sufficient applications are received. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible. Interviews will be arranged on an ongoing basis as applications are reviewed. Overall purpose: To work within the group of Noe Rodriguez at the MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology (LMB), on a programme aimed at investigating the cellular and molecular mechanisms regulating the crosstalk between neurons and immune cells during viral infections and cancer. Specifically, to undertake research to investigate how neurons communicate with immune cells in lung organoids. This job is a maternity cover to work on a project which is part of a research programme aimed at understating how sensory neurons modulate immune cells at mucosal tissues during inflammation. The investigation will focus on developing in vitro systems (such as mucosal organoids) to study cell communication, dynamics and signalling. Main duties: To undertake research aimed at developing and characterising in vitro co culture systems and organoid models to investigate the cellular and molecular mechanisms regulating the crosstalk between neurons and immune cells during viral infections and cancer. To identify, develop and apply a broad range of techniques to pursue the research objectives. To present scientific work at seminars within the laboratory and at external meetings. To contribute to laboratory-wide discussions on developments within the field. Where appropriate, to draft scientific papers, and contribute to the overall preparation of research for publication. To contribute to the LMB’s mission in the public engagement of science, and the translation of research findings into improvements in health care. To assist in the training of PhD students and other members of the LMB. Key responsibilities: To plan your own work and objectives and manage your experimental work within the project along with your Supervisor. To introduce and apply new techniques across a wide range of disciplines and to have the creativity and initiative to develop novel approaches and methods where required. items.desc: Description You’ll apply generative AI across the software development lifecycle for embedded products, from requirements analysis and coding to code review, testing, and documentation. You’ll learn how target hardware constraints and project requirements for quality, traceability, and code confidentiality shape embedded development, and adapt AI tools and workflows accordingly. You will work alongside experienced engineers who bring deep domain knowledge, with a strong focus on practical skills, hands-on experimentation, and mentoring-driven growth. Curiosity, structured thinking, and the ability to critically evaluate AI output are key to this position. We also expect a responsible, communicative team player who is ready to learn, ask questions, and share findings. Requirements We are looking for a Trainee AI Engineer (Generative AI) to join our AI-DLC initiatives in the embedded domain. This role suits a candidate who is already confident with GenAI and LLM tooling and wants to apply it to embedded software development, working side by side with experienced embedded engineers to build AI-assisted workflows tailored to the specifics of these projects. You will help rapidly prototype ideas, build small PoCs, and experiment with solutions based on large language models (LLMs) and other generative AI techniques. Your focus will be to implement well-defined tasks, run experiments, and use GenAI tools to speed up coding, analysis, and documentation – while learning how to do this safely and reliably in production-oriented environments. Required Qualifications: Practical experience in software development, data science, or ML (commercial experience, internships, or strong personal projects). Solid basic skills in Python and core data/ML libraries (e.g., NumPy, pandas, Scikit-learn). Understanding of fundamental ML concepts (datasets, train/validation split, basic metrics, overfitting). Practical familiarity with generative AI / LLMs: – regular use of tools like ChatGPT, Copilot or similar for coding and data tasks; – basic understanding of prompts, context windows, and common limitations (hallucinations, privacy, bias). High motivation to learn, ask questions, and accept feedback. Organized and responsible: able to follow a spec, document work, and meet agreed timelines. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field. Coursework, pet projects, or a thesis related to ML, NLP, or Generative AI. Basic exposure to RAG, embeddings, or vector databases (from articles, courses, or small experiments). Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) from labs or online coursesю. Experience with Jupyter notebooks, Git, and simple CI/CD or MLOps tools (even at a “student project” level). Participation in hackathons, Kaggle competitions, or open-source projects. Job responsibilities Rapidly prototype and iterate on ML / GenAI ideas in notebooks and scripts, turning high-level concepts into small PoCs and demo flows. Implement well-defined tasks in Python (data preprocessing, basic model training, evaluation scripts, and utility functions) as part of prototypes and production-oriented components. Experience building evaluations from scratch: defining success with domain experts, creating representative test cases, automating checks and investigating failures across multistep workflows. The ability to turn an exploratory prototype into software that others can operate, maintain and improve. Ownership when requirements are incomplete: you test assumptions early and know when to ask for input. Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical choices to people with different expertise. Interest in applying AI to pharmaceutical quality. Useful, But Not Essential Experience with GxP software or other regulated environments. What You’ll Do You will own the AI applications and agents you build, from initial design through deployment and operation. Design and build agents, including orchestration, retrieval, tool use and integrations with enterprise systems and data sources. Build the software around the AI, such as APIs, data processing and application components, so the result is a usable product. Work directly with users and process experts to understand their workflows, test prototypes and improve based on their feedback. Develop evaluation datasets and automated evaluations that cover individual components and complete agent workflows. Use evaluations, regression tests and production feedback to investigate failures and assess changes to models, prompts, tools and orchestration. Apply sound engineering practices, including code review, automated testing, version control, deployment and monitoring. Who You’ll Work With You will join Quality AI & Data, part of Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo value chain, stay close to stakeholders and help deliver trusted technology and high quality. [Insert hiring manager and team details.] Your partners will include fellow engineers, process experts and end users, as well as senior management. The scope is global across Novo Quality processes, so you will build relationships across functions, units and geographies. You will present clear analyses, recommendations and progress updates that help managers make decisions, and you will help simplify ways of working and improve the user experience across the department. The position is based in Ballerup, Denmark. What You Can Expect Here You will be trusted to act independently within your scope and to take ownership of what you build. You will be challenged with complex problems, and supported by colleagues who share curiosity and a drive to raise the bar. You will grow by working at the forefront of AI and technology, applied to a regulated, high-stakes domain, and by learning from users and experts across Novo. Salary For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience. Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here. Start now Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn AI into software that strengthens quality across Novo, apply for the AI Engineer role by 21 November 2026 . We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

items.desc: Job Description We are looking for motivated interns to support our Finance and Support Functions in their digital transformation journey. You will help translate real business challenges into practical digital solutions. Depending on the project, these solutions may range from low-code automations and data transformations to AI agents and reusable tools that allow agents to perform specific tasks. You will work directly with stakeholders from areas such as Accounting, Controlling, Risk and other Support Functions. Together with them, you will analyse existing processes, understand their challenges, rapidly develop a first solution and improve it based on feedback. The Internship Can Include Projects Such As Automating data preparation, transformation and consolidation using Excel, Power Query or Python Automating repetitive processes in SAP and other business applications Building workflows and RPA solutions using Power Automate Developing AI agents using tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio Creating reusable tools for agents, such as Python scripts or Power Automate workflows Connecting agents with documents, data sources and existing business processes Developing clear dashboards, reports or lightweight applications Improving the reliability, documentation and maintainability of existing solutions This internship offers you the opportunity to gain hands-on experience at the intersection of business, data, automation and artificial intelligence. You will work in an environment where experimentation is encouraged, but where solutions must also deliver tangible value to their users. You will also gain insight into the energy sector and contribute to an organisation working towards a more sustainable energy future. Your daily job as an intern You engage with business stakeholders to understand their processes, challenges and objectives. You translate sometimes complex or unclear business problems into structured technical requirements. You design and develop practical automation, data or AI-enabled solutions. You build low-code automations using tools such as Excel, Power Query, Power Automate and SAP scripting. You contribute to the development of AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio or other internal agent platforms. You develop reusable agent tools, which may include Python scripts, workflows, prompts or connectors. You test your solutions with end users and improve them based on feedback. You document your solutions so that they can be understood, maintained and reused by others. You communicate progress, challenges and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You work independently on your assignments while receiving guidance and support from experienced team members. You develop a practical understanding of digital transformation, Finance, the energy sector, automation and agentic AI. Your profile We welcome students from a wide range of educational backgrounds, including IT, data science, artificial intelligence, engineering, business, economics and related fields. You do not need to be an expert in all the technologies listed below. We are primarily looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn and motivated to turn business problems into working solutions. You must be enrolled at a college or university at the time of the internship. What We Are Looking For You are interested in data, automation, artificial intelligence and digital transformation. You enjoy understanding how a business process works and identifying how it could be improved. You have experience with, or a strong interest in learning, tools such as Excel, Power Query, Power Automate, Python or Microsoft Copilot Studio. You are curious about AI agents and how they can use knowledge, workflows and technical tools to support users. You are comfortable experimenting with new technologies and learning through practical projects. You approach problems in a logical and structured way. You can work independently, while actively asking for feedback when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable refining a solution iteratively based on user feedback. You pay attention to quality, documentation and maintainability. You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a strong asset. Experience with SAP automation, VBA, Power BI, Qlik Sense, Git, APIs or application development is an advantage, but not a requirement. Practical information The internship lasts between 5 and 12 months. You are expected to be available at least four days per week. The position is hybrid, with regular presence in our Brussels office. We are currently looking for interns who can support the team during the first semester of 2027. If you are eager to gain professional experience in a team that combines business understanding with automation, data and AI, this internship will give you the opportunity to work on real challenges and deliver solutions that are used by …

items.desc: About The Science And AI Team The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair. As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions. About The Role The AI Applied Scientist turns our science into results for clients. Most of your time goes on client projects: adapting our AI scoring to each client’s roles, analysing their data, and showing them what it means. The rest goes on improving the scoring systems that every client relies on. Client projects Adapt AI scoring for structured interviews, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency to each client’s roles and needs. Analyse client assessment and performance data to show how scores relate to job performance and retention. Set and review cut-offs and thresholds with clients, backed by evidence. Present findings and recommendations directly to clients, in a way non-technical audiences can act on. Work closely with implementation and customer success teams from setup to go-live. Testing scoring quality Compare AI scores with expert ratings to check accuracy and reliability before anything goes live. Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection. Fairness in practice Run bias checks across demographic groups for each client project. Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance. Support fairness reports and compliance documentation for clients. Improving our scoring systems Help choose the right models and prompts for production, balancing accuracy, speed and cost. Support the move onto self-hosted open-weight models, including fine-tuning on expert-rated data. Work with engineering to roll out scoring changes safely. As one of Maki People’s early employees, you’ll help shape the team’s future. Our Ideal Candidate Required MSc or PhD in data science, machine learning, psychology or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Hands-on experience with LLM-based scoring or evaluation. Strong Python or R skills, with solid statistical analysis. Experience presenting data-driven findings to clients or senior business stakeholders. Able to manage several projects at once and keep to deadlines. Preferred Experience in consulting, people analytics or assessment. Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT. Experience testing AI systems for fairness and bias. Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA. Working knowledge of ethical AI and compliance, such as the EU AI Act. Application Process Stage 1 - Screening assessment (25 min) Stage 2 - Power skill assessment with our AI agent (15 min) Stage 3 - Hiring manager interview (45 min) Stage 4 - Executive interview (45 min) Stage 5 - Deep-dive technical interview (60 min) Stage 6 - Interview with Co-founder (30 min)

items.desc: Do you want to work with data from 8.7 million daily users, at a fast-growing and profitable tech company? About us Instabridge builds the apps people use on their phones every day. Our apps include Eyecon (dialer and caller ID), Nova Launcher, WiFi Finder and eSIM, and two of them have more than 100M downloads each. Together they reach 8.7 million people every day. We are also building Nova Agents, our own platform for AI agents. It makes agents smarter and uses half the tokens, and it won a Google AI Innovation Award. Our own teams use it every day, and next it goes into our apps for our 8.7 million daily users. What our traction looks like • 8.7 million daily users across our apps • Revenue up 5x in two years, and we are profitable • A team of 40+ people from 10+ nationalities Our vision We want to build the apps people rely on most on their phones. We already own the launcher, the dialer and the SMS app, and we grow every product we take on. Data is at the center of how we make decisions, and this role sits right there. The role We're looking for a junior data scientist/analyst to join our data team part-time. You'll work directly with the data lead on production pipelines and on analysis the group acts on, handling real data at scale from day one. The role is 50% and fully remote, which makes it a good fit for a student working alongside their studies or someone who has recently graduated. Tasks • Support the team in keeping our existing data pipelines running, and step in when a job breaks or the numbers look off. • Support the improvement and extension of the pipelines by adding new data sources, making jobs more reliable, and cutting out manual steps. • Build and maintain ETL jobs that pull data from outside platforms (ad networks, analytics providers, app-store and marketing sources) into our data warehouse in a clean, query-ready shape. • Help run recurring analysis the group relies on, covering performance, revenue, retention, and user acquisition, and flag anything unusual. • Write clear queries and light documentation so the work is reproducible. • Answer ad-hoc data questions from around the group as they come up. Skills required • Studying, or recently graduated in, data engineering, data science, computer science, statistics, or a related field. • Solid SQL, comfortable writing and debugging real queries against large and complex datasets. • Working Python for data manipulation and scripting. • A basic grasp of how pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows fit together (batch jobs, scheduling, transformations, warehouse tables). • A basic grasp of statistics for experimentation, enough to reason about A/B tests, sample sizes, common biases, and whether a result is real. • Careful with data. You check your results and don't trust a number until it reconciles. • Enough English to work and document in it. Other skills of interest • Hands-on time with Google Cloud and BigQuery, or another cloud data warehouse and its SQL dialect. • Exposure to job scheduling or workflow orchestration tools. • Version control (Git) and working from the command line. • Statistics beyond the basics, such as designing experiments or evaluating A/B tests properly. • Experience with mobile-app, advertising, or marketing data. • Comfort working with AI tools as part of the daily workflow. A lot of our analysis and reporting is built and/or run with the help of AI agents, including writing reusable prompts and skills that automate recurring queries and reports. • A basic understanding of how large language models actually work, enough to know where they are strong, where they tend to go wrong, and how to prompt and structure work to get reliable results. What we offer • Production work from the start: the pipelines and reports you work on are used across our apps. • A fast-growing, profitable company with a positive, warm and welcoming culture, where we give each other feedback and have fun at work. • Close day-to-day work with the data lead, with reviews of your queries and code. • A modern stack: BigQuery, Python, Metabase, and AI agents built into the analytics workflow. • Flexible hours that can fit around studies. • Perks when you are at our Stockholm office: free lunch, breakfast and access to a gym in the same building. • Wellness allowance. Practical details • Extent: 50% (about 20 hours per week) • Location: Remote within Sweden, or from our office in Stockholm. You choose what suits you, and you are always welcome to work from the office. • Language: English, Swedish is a bonus but not required • Start: As soon as possible, by agreement • Employment starts with a 6-month probationary period How to apply Send your CV and a short note on why the role interests you and your expected salary range. If you have a SQL or Python project you can share, such as a GitHub repo or a course project, include a link. We review applications as they come in, so don't wait to apply.

items.desc: Du baust KI-Anwendungen, die im Alltag wirklich laufen, und Python ist Dein Werkzeug dafür? Dann komm zu SYNQONY. Bei uns entwickelst Du KI für die Kreislaufwirtschaft, angefangen bei unserem KI-Voicebot, der für Landkreise, Kommunen und Entsorger rund um die Uhr die Abfallberatung am Telefon übernimmt, bis hin zu den nächsten Ideen, die in unserer Software-Gruppe schon bereitliegen. WAS WIRST DU MACHEN? Als AI Engineer gestaltest Du den Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz in den Softwarelösungen der SYNQONY-Gruppe. Du identifizierst geeignete Anwendungsfälle, entwickelst Prototypen und überführst sie in einen stabilen, skalierbaren Produktivbetrieb. Dein Aufgabenbereich Konzeption und Entwicklung von KI-Anwendungen mit Large Language Models, von Prompt-Design und Tool-Calling bis zu agentischen Abläufen Aufbau und Optimierung von RAG-Lösungen mit Vektorsuche (pgvector) und Volltextsuche, inklusive systematischer Bewertung der Antwortqualität Weiterentwicklung unseres KI-Voicebots: Gesprächsführung, Tools, Spracherkennung und Sprachausgabe auf Basis von LiveKit Agents, Telefonie über SIP Entwicklung der Python-Dienste (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL), die unsere KI-Anwendungen mit Kundendaten und Fachsystemen verbinden Schnelles Prototyping neuer KI-Ideen für die Produkte der Gruppe und Überführung in den Cloud-Betrieb mit Docker und Kubernetes auf Azure Sicherstellung der Qualität durch Tests, Evaluationen und Code-Reviews, damit KI-Antworten im Livebetrieb verlässlich bleiben Das bringst du mit Praktische Erfahrung im AI Engineering mit Large Language Models – um Anwendungen mit Prompt-Design, Tool-Calling und Agenten zu bauen, die im Alltag funktionieren. Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Python – damit Du KI-Ideen selbst bis in den Produktivbetrieb bringst. Erfahrung mit RAG und Vektordatenbanken – um Wissen aus Dokumenten und Kundendaten zuverlässig für KI nutzbar zu machen. Erfahrung mit der Bewertung von KI-Systemen – damit Du Antwortqualität messen, Fehler finden und Verbesserungen belegen kannst. Agentisches Programmieren (Vibe Coding) – Du arbeitest produktiv mit KI-Coding-Assistenten wie Claude Code oder Cursor und prüfst deren Ergebnisse mit Tests und Reviews. Sicherer Umgang mit FastAPI, asynchronem Python und REST-Schnittstellen – um KI-Dienste sauber an andere Systeme anzubinden. Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken, idealerweise PostgreSQL – um Datenmodelle und Migrationen sauber aufzusetzen. Erfahrung mit Docker, Git und CI/CD – um Änderungen sicher in die Cloud auszuliefern. Neugier und Eigeninitiative – damit aus einer Idee schnell ein Prototyp wird und aus einem Prototyp ein Produkt. Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse – damit Du mit Fachbereichen und Kunden auf Deutsch arbeitest und Code, Doku und Reviews auf Englisch schreibst. Schön, wenn Du außerdem mitbringst Computer Vision – Erfahrung mit Bild- oder Dokumentenerkennung, etwa mit OpenCV, PyTorch oder Sprachmodellen, die Bilder verstehen. Voice-KI und Telefonie – LiveKit, Vapi, SIP sowie Speech-to-Text und Text-to-Speech sind Dir nicht fremd. Kubernetes und Azure – um KI-Dienste in der Cloud skalierbar und sicher zu betreiben. Grundkenntnisse in C# und .NET – denn unsere Cloud-Plattform, an die unsere KI-Dienste angebunden sind, basiert auf .NET-Microservices. Was dich erwartet Eine spannende Tätigkeit in einem zukunftssicheren Umfeld Modernste Technik und spannende Digitalisierungsprojekte Komplett remote & flexible Arbeitszeiten Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten Team-Events und ein offenes Miteinander Über uns SYNQONY | digitizing circular economy Wir sind eine starke wachsende Gruppe innovativer Softwareunternehmen, die smarte Digitalisierungslösungen für Abfall- und Umweltmanagement entwickeln. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, effizienter und umweltschonender zu arbeiten. SYNQONY vereint technologische Innovation mit nachhaltigem Denken.Unsere Mission: Den gesamten Lebenszyklus des Abfalls nahtlos zu digitalisieren – von seiner Entstehung bei gewerblichen Abfallerzeugern und den privaten Haushalten, über den Transport bis zum Recycling bzw. der Entsorgung und weiter bis zur Kommunikation mit den Umweltbehörden. Mit der SYNQONY-Software-Suite bilden wir die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette der Kreislaufwirtschaft digital ab. Dies umfasst die Entstehung des Abfalls bei den Bürgern und gewerblichen Abfallerzeugern über die Beförderer und Sammler sowie die gewerblichen und kommunalen Entsorger bis hin zu den Umweltämtern. items.desc: Haluatko kehittää ohjelmistoja uudella tavalla – tekoälyn, agenttien ja automaation tukemana, mutta laadusta ja tuotantokelpoisuudesta tinkimättä? Etsimme AI Software Engineeriä rakentamaan moderneja digitaalisia palveluita vaativiin enterprise- ja finanssisektorin asiakkuuksiin. Tässä roolissa et ole vain kehittäjä, joka käyttää Copilotia, vaan hyödynnät tekoälyä hallitusti koko kehitystyössä vaatimuksista ja suunnittelusta testeihin, koodiin ja dokumentaatioon. Mitä pääset tekemään Rakennat ohjelmistoja AI-assisted engineering -mallilla. Hyödynnät koodausavustajia, copilotteja ja agentic workflow -käytäntöjä. Kehität testattavaa, ylläpidettävää, katselmointivalmista ja tuotantokelpoista koodia. Osallistut testaukseen, dokumentointiin, koodikatselmointeihin ja palveluiden tuotantoon vientiin. Työskentelet arkkitehtien, laadunvarmistuksen asiantuntijoiden, DevOps-asiantuntijoiden ja muiden AI engineerien kanssa. Autat löytämään ratkaisumalleja, joita voidaan hyödyntää myös muissa tiimeissä. Sinulta löytyy Kokemusta generatiivisen tekoälyn ja AI-avusteisten työtapojen hyödyntämisestä ohjelmistokehityksessä, esimerkiksi koodausavustajien (kuten GitHub Copilot) ja agenttien käytöstä. Vahvaa kokemusta backend- tai fullstack -kehityksestä pilviympäristöissä (mielellään Azure) sekä kokemusta LLM-ratkaisujen integroinnista sovelluksiin. Vahvaa kokemusta modernista ohjelmistokehityksestä esimerkiksi Pythonilla, Javalla tai TypeScriptillä. Ymmärrystä versionhallinnasta, DevOpsista, CI/CD:stä, testauksesta ja tuotantoympäristöistä. Halukkuutta jakaa osaamistasi tiimissä. Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito. Plussaa Kokemus finanssi- tai muista säännellyistä ympäristöistä. Kokemus tuotantokriittisistä palveluista. Työskentely Tehtävässä työskennellään hybridimallilla, jossa työ jakautuu lähityöhön pääkaupunkiseudulla ja etätyöhön. Lähityön määrä tarkentuu asiakkuuden tarpeiden mukaan, joten toivomme sinulta valmiutta joustavaan hybridityöskentelyyn. Huomioithan, että työskentely asiakkuudessa voi edellyttää turvallisuusselvitystä sekä muita taustaselvityksiä, kuten luottotietojen tarkistusta. Miksi HiQ? Pääset mukaan rakentamaan AI-first software deliveryä käytännössä, kokeneen tiimin kanssa ja yhteiskunnallisesti merkittävissä asiakasympäristöissä. Tämä rooli sopii sinulle, jos haluat olla tekemässä tekoälystä aidosti hyödyllistä osaa ohjelmistokehityksen arkea. HiQ:lla missiomme on yksinkertaistaa ihmisten elämää. Syvän ja monipuolisen teknologia- ja toimialaosaamisemme sekä luovan ajattelun avulla taklaamme asiakkaidemme haasteita ja luomme entistä toimivampia ratkaisuja. HiQ:lla rakennetaan aidosti arvokkaita palveluita asiakkaalle. Meillä pääset rakentamaan yhteiskunnallisesti merkittäviä palveluja, asiakkaiden tarpeet täyttäviä end-to-end -ratkaisuja, kriittisiä taustajärjestelmiä ja meidän kaikkien käyttämiä kuluttajapalveluita. Haluamme olla ylpeitä työstämme, ja pyrimmekin aina parhaimpaamme. Siitä tulee nimemmekin, HiQ, High Quality. Mitä tarkoittaa olla HiQlainen? Se on mielenkiintoisia projekteja, afterworkeja, uuden oppimista ja toinen toisemme tukemista. Työkavereita, joista tulee aitoja ystäviä. Lapset saa lähteä hakemaan kotiin etuajassa ja välillä taas puristetaan loppukiri porukalla. Haluamme olla yhteisö, jossa haluat olla vuodesta toiseen. Paikka, jossa voit kehittyä työnantajaa vaihtamatta. Jokainen meistä vaikuttaa siihen, mitä tarkoittaa olla HiQlainen. Hae nyt Mikäli tunnistit itsesi suurimmasta osasta edellä mainituista kohdista, haethan rohkeasti – kuulisimme erittäin mielellämme sinusta lisää! Voit laittaa hakemuksesi alla olevan lomakkeen kautta. Jos sinulla heräsi kysymyksiä meidän suuntaan, voit olla yhteydessä Anjuli Jaakkolaan ( anjuli.jaakkola@hiq.fi ).

A key driver of this is data and AI, as such the Security Data & AI lab plays a critical role. We have a brilliant opportunity for a data scientist to join our team. In this role, you'll help in transforming how we detect, mitigate, and prevent threats using advanced machine learning and agentic in one of the UK's most data-rich environments. What you’ll be doing: Collaborating with data engineers, DevOps engineers, and domain experts to deliver solutions across many branches of security. Working with our internal customers and stakeholders to convert business problems into data science solutions. Integrating solutions into the existing systems and processes through MLOps and model explainability, in order to ensure model insights are actionable. Growing domain knowledge in Security, one of the most important fields of the future. Building and maintaining both traditional machine learning and agentic systems. Contributing to the growth of data science understanding with demonstrations and show & tells to audiences of varying prior knowledge levels. Participating in team ceremonies to better understand the work through planning, commit to clear achievable goals, drive appropriate prioritisation, escalate impediments accordingly and manage external dependencies effectively. Why join us? If you think all banks are the same, you’re wrong. We’re a pioneering, fast-changing business that’s shaping finance as a force for good. If you’re after a role where you can have an impact and do the best work of your career, you’ve just found it. What we’re looking for: Experience delivering data science or analytics projects from problem definition through to implementation, with the ability to articulate measurable business impact. Solid understanding of machine learning and the underlying statistics. Much of our work is with unsupervised ML models so we must draw on knowledge of fundamentals to make design decisions. Knowledge of foundational model systems and frameworks / best practices for building agents. Experience using Python and common data science libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy and visualisation frameworks. Strong SQL skills with experience querying and transforming large datasets, ideally using platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar 'big data' warehouses. items.desc: Jij bouwt slimme oplossingen die data en AI laten werken voor NieuweStroom. Hoe jij het verschil maakt Een interne tool die collega’s tijd bespaart. Een API die systemen verbindt. Een AI-toepassing die een bedrijfsproces slimmer maakt. Als Data & AI Engineer bij NieuweStroom vertaal jij technische mogelijkheden naar praktische oplossingen die onze organisatie verder helpen. Je maakt deel uit van ons Centraal Data Team (CDT). Samen met data engineers, data scientists en analisten bouw je aan betrouwbare data, waardevolle inzichten en toepassingen voor onze collega’s. De basis is ons centrale dataplatform in Microsoft Fabric. Vanuit daar werk je op het snijvlak van data engineering, softwareontwikkeling en AI aan het verbeteren van onze producten, dienstverlening en bedrijfsprocessen. Jij krijgt energie van zelf bouwen, uitproberen en doorontwikkelen. Je verkent ideeën met een eerste prototype en ontwikkelt kansrijke oplossingen tot toepassingen die in productie betrouwbaar werken en goed te onderhouden zijn. Daarbij zoek je actief de samenwerking met de business, zodat je begrijpt welk vraagstuk je oplost en wat daarvoor nodig is. Je krijgt ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verantwoordelijkheid te dragen voor je werk en mee te denken over onze technische koers. Vooral op het gebied van AI zie jij kansen die je graag onderzoekt én toepast. Wat ga je doen? Je ontwikkelt API’s en backendservices met Python en FastAPI en bouwt integraties en geautomatiseerde workflows die systemen en processen verbinden. Je ontwikkelt en test AI-toepassingen, waaronder LLM-integraties, agentic workflows en MCP-servers. Je ontsluit, verwerkt en transformeert data met PySpark voor ons dataplatform en data science-initiatieven. Je verpakt applicaties in Docker-containers en rolt deze uit en beheert ze met Kubernetes. Je verbetert oplossingen binnen de hele datapipeline: van het ontsluiten en verwerken van data tot het beschikbaar maken ervan voor verschillende toepassingen. Je vertaalt samen met technische en niet-technische collega’s vraagstukken uit de organisatie naar concrete, werkbare oplossingen. Je werkt aan ontwikkelingen vanuit onze backlog en roadmap en speelt in op ad-hocvragen en kansen voor verbetering. Je draagt bij aan onze ontwikkelwerkwijzen met Git, CI/CD en AI-ondersteunde ontwikkeltools. Je werkt onder andere met Python, PySpark, SQL, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, Microsoft Fabric en Azure. Afhankelijk van de oplossing gebruik je ook Bicep/Terraform en Angular of React. Hier laad jij van op! Bij NieuweStroom geloven we dat werk en welzijn hand in hand gaan. Daarom bieden we: Een salaris tussen € 4.100,- en € 5.300,- bruto per maand op fulltime basis, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring; Volledige betaling van de pensioenpremie door NieuweStroom; In totaal 34 verlof- en ADV-dagen op fulltime basis; Een persoonlijk vitaliteitsbudget van bruto € 1.100,- per jaar. De energie die je meebrengt! Je bent een nieuwsgierige bouwer die graag begrijpt hoe iets werkt én hoe het beter kan. Je combineert een stevige technische basis met een praktische aanpak en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je oplevert. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende ontwikkelwerkzaamheden en maakt technische keuzes begrijpelijk voor je collega’s. Daarnaast Breng Je Het Volgende Mee Minimaal drie jaar werkervaring in data engineering, softwareontwikkeling of een vergelijkbare technische functie. Goede kennis van en ervaring met Python, PySpark en SQL. Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van API’s en backendservices, bij voorkeur met FastAPI. Ervaring met Git, CI/CD en gestructureerde softwareontwikkeling. Kennis van dataplatformen, dataverwerking en het efficiënt beschikbaar maken van data voor verschillende toepassingen. Ervaring met Docker en het ontwikkelen van applicaties op basis van containers. Affiniteit met cloudomgevingen, bij voorkeur Microsoft Azure. Interesse in en bij voorkeur ervaring met AI-toepassingen, LLM-integraties en agentic workflows. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en plezier in samenwerken met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines.

items.desc: About VISUALFABRIQ - Will you take us to the Next Level? Visualfabriq helps the world’s largest consumer goods companies make smarter decisions, sooner. Built for CPG, its platform runs the full commercial cycle in one system: integrated business planning, trade promotion and pricing, revenue growth management, and revenue forecasting and optimization. With our platform, customers get a predictable outlook on their P&L, machine learning forecasts, and numbers they can audit. Switch on Assistant Mike, Visualfabriq’s agentic AI, and CPG expert agents spot risks, propose fixes and actions within agreed guardrails. Across the world, Visualfabriq is a high-performance, values-driven team with every individual putting our vision into action every day. Today we are looking to strengthen our Operations team with a skilled and talented AI Solution Specialist who enjoys understanding how colleagues work, identifying bottlenecks, and turning them into practical AI solutions that make their daily jobs easier. Will you be the one to take us to the next level? About the Role - Turning AI into Everyday Value: As our AI Solution Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining our position as a reliable, innovative, and competitive tech vendor in the CPG industry. You support the organization to automate & transform processes through AI. You report to the Strategic Transformation Manager within our Operations department and work closely with internal department managers, IT operations, and colleagues companywide. What you will do: Talk to colleagues across internal departments to understand their day-to-day processes, map how work gets done and identify bottlenecks where AI or automation could make a practical difference Turn process bottlenecks into working AI automations: design and build prototypes, test them with colleagues, refine what works and roll out solutions that improve everyday operations Design and build reusable AI components, such as skills, agents and MCP tools Help colleagues adopt AI in their daily work through hands-on support, demos, drop-in sessions and reusable guidance Track and report on AI adoption across departments, using the results to focus support and improve solutions Operate within data security, privacy and compliance guardrails across data sources, the data warehouse and AI solutions (for example GDPR, access control and AI usage guardrails) Where relevant to AI solutions and your experience, support data source connections and smooth integration between the data warehouse and connected systems As an additional contribution, help maintain a centralized approach to the data warehouse and dashboards so departments can work with consistent insights and analytics Are You Ready to Excel with Us? - We Value Your Expertise. To thrive in this role, you will need: Hands-on experience building AI/LLM and automation solutions (connectors, skills, agents, workflows), with working knowledge of LLM capabilities and limitations; Claude experience is relevant Ability to listen, ask thoughtful questions and understand how colleagues in various departments work, then translate their process bottlenecks into practical, working AI solutions Ability to explain AI in plain language and to coach colleagues with different levels of technical confidence Strong stakeholder management, communication, and project management skills Ability to influence without direct authority: involve colleagues in shaping solutions, build support for new ways of working and stay adaptable as AI tools and approaches evolve An open-minded, proactive approach: you explore new AI tools, experiment with ideas and question assumptions, while recognizing when a simpler solution is more useful than AI Curiosity about how people work and a willingness to learn by building, trying new approaches and improving solutions based on feedback A plus: hands-on Power BI experience, including semantic modelling and report development Our Technology Our AI and automation tools include Claude (Anthropic), Microsoft 365 Copilot and AWS Bedrock. Our wider technology landscape includes Microsoft Fabric (data warehouse), Microsoft Power BI (dashboards), Power Automate, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft SharePoint, Zendesk (tickets and knowledge base), Atlassian/Jira, GitHub, AWS, Salesforce, Timechimp, HiBob, etc. You do not need experience with every system: practical AI automation experience is the priority, while familiarity with our data platforms and integrations is a bonus. What's in It for You? - Visualfabriq Offers the Best. As part of the Visualfabriq family, you can expect: Competitive salary (depending on experience) Pension: 100% employer contribution Holiday Pay: 8% (Netherlands only) Holidays: 25 days based on 40 hours (option to buy more) Travel reimbursement Facilitated training activities and learning possibilities €30 monthly phone allowance 4 weeks of working abroad per year A hybrid working schedule (2-3 days in the …

items.desc: AI-agents werken steeds vaker (semi-)autonoom samen om softwareontwikkelingstaken uit te voeren. Maar hoe houd je overzicht wanneer meerdere agents, tools en systemen betrokken zijn bij één taak? In deze opdracht onderzoek je hoe je de werking en samenwerking binnen zo’n AI-systeem visueel inzichtelijk maakt. Een (semi-)autonoom AI-systeem bestaat uit een platform om AI agents te draaien en configuraties. Een configuratie kan er per team of project anders uitzien. Deze configuraties zijn meestal niet eenvoudig te lezen of te overzien. Daardoor is voor ontwikkelaars en andere betrokkenen niet direct zichtbaar hoe het geheel werkt en hoe AI-agents zelfstandig taken uitvoeren en samenwerken. Er is behoefte aan een visuele weergave waarmee gebruikers snel kunnen overzien hoe de omgeving in elkaar zit en hoe de componenten met elkaar interacteren. Het is nog onvoldoende duidelijk hoe deze omgeving het beste kan worden gevisualiseerd, zodat de werking van en de interactie tussen componenten goed te overzien is. De opdracht In deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe de werking van een bestaand (semi-)autonoom AI-systeem visueel inzichtelijk kan worden gemaakt. Hierbij onderzoek je welke informatie developers nodig hebben om de samenwerking tussen agents, systemen en mensen te begrijpen en welke visualisatiemethoden hiervoor geschikt zijn. Denk hierbij bijvoorbeeld aan het visualiseren van de stappen binnen een workflow, de betrokken agents, onderlinge handoffs en momenten waarop menselijke interactie nodig is. Daarbij kan zowel worden gekeken naar de vooraf gedefinieerde workflow als het verloop van een daadwerkelijk uitgevoerde taak, waarbij AI-agents zelfstandig stappen uitvoeren. Op basis van het onderzoek ontwerp en realiseer je een Proof of Concept waarmee de samenwerking tussen AI-agents binnen een bestaand (semi-)autonoom systeem visueel inzichtelijk wordt gemaakt. Het resultaat moet aantonen hoe visualisatie kan helpen om van inzicht in één agent naar inzicht in de samenwerking tussen agents en het verloop van de volledige workflow te gaan. Over Info Support Info Support is specialist in maatwerksoftware, data/AI solutions, beheer en trainingen en actief in de sectoren Finance, Industry, Agriculture, Food & Retail, Mobility & Public en Healthcare. Wij bieden solide en innovatieve oplossingen voor complexe en bedrijfkritische softwarevraagstukken. Onze hoofdkantoren zijn gevestigd in Veenendaal (NL) en Mechelen (BE). Op dit moment zijn er circa 500 medewerkers bij Info Support in dienst. De werkwijze van Info Support kenmerkt zich door een aantal kernwaarden: soliditeit, integriteit, vakmanschap en passie. Deze kernwaarden zijn verweven in ons werk en de manier waarop we met elkaar omgaan. Om te zorgen dat alle medewerkers altijd op de hoogte kunnen zijn van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen beschikt Info Support over een inhouse IT Academy waar graag wordt voldaan aan de honger naar meer of andere kennis en vaardigheden. Om deze opdracht te kunnen doen is B2-taalvaardigheid in het Nederlands vereist.

items.desc: Volumental is the footwear industry’s leading FitTech™ company, using 3D scanning and machine learning to match people with shoes that truly fit. Our vision is “a world without sizes, where every body fits.” We work with brands such as New Balance, Red Wing, Fleet Feet, and Vivobarefoot across 3,000+ stores in 60 countries, with 60M+ foot scans collected, one of the world’s largest datasets of its kind. Computer vision, machine learning, and AI have always been at the core of our product. Today, we also use AI agents as everyday companions in our work, helping us shorten feedback cycles, deepen our expertise, and explore new areas. We believe the best work comes from people who never stop learning and who care deeply about their craft. Our Products and Teams We target businesses and stores selling footwear such as shoes, ski boots and hockey skates, as well as insoles. We develop two related products, each with its own team: In-store product. We sell a 3D scanner that our business customers put in their physical retail stores and use to scan shoppers' feet. The scanner is controlled by a tablet, which shows the 3D scans and recommends footwear from the store's range. Online product. We sell 3D scanning and recommendation web components that our business customers integrate into their online store. It allows online shoppers to scan their own feet using their own phone and get size recommendations for the footwear in that online store. We are also exploring new product opportunities, such as 3D scanning beyond feet and footwear. You will start in our Online product team, with the chance to move into other teams over time. Whichever team you are in, you will be part of shaping our current and future products. Algorithm Development at Volumental Both of our products are built on top of two core algorithmic systems: 3D foot scanning system. It takes images of a person's feet and reconstructs a 3D model. This involves areas such as camera calibration, image processing, image classification, image segmentation, object detection, parametric 3D models, numerical optimization and machine learning. Footwear recommendation system. This is based on machine learning and our ever-growing dataset of more than 30 million samples of 3D scans matched with footwear purchases. Given a shopper's unique pair of feet, we predict and recommend what footwear will fit them. This involves areas such as machine learning, probabilistic methods, model fitting, numerical optimization, training, inference, ranking, statistics, data visualization, data cleaning and outlier detection. For both systems, we put a strong emphasis on empirical evaluation and optimization, based on data that we continuously gather from our users. We want to measure what works and what does not (yet) work in practice, and find ways to improve it. You will have the chance to work on either of these systems, depending partly on your previous experience and interests and partly on the current needs of our products and users. Our algorithmic tech stack includes technologies like: Python, C++, Go, SQL, NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Polars, TensorFlow, Keras, JAX, Eigen, Ceres, OpenCV, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Devin AI, Greptile, Claude… You will influence which tools we use, and if you find something better, we want to hear about it. We offer premium AI agent subscriptions and encourage everyone to explore, test, and share useful ways of working with AI. We are excited about you because you: Have experience in both mathematical modeling and programming. Are a collaborative and kind team member. Can solve difficult problems in practice. Have experience working with datasets and evaluating different methods. Have a master's degree in computer science, engineering physics, electrical engineering, or similar. It is a plus if you: Have professional experience of software engineering. Have professional experience working with algorithms in areas like: Machine learning Computer vision Computer graphics Image processing Robotics Numerical optimization What we can offer you: Personal learning budget and access to coaching Opportunity to work with a great team of 15+ nationalities in our English-speaking office Occupational pension at ITP1 level Flexible Public Holidays Policy Options Program Parental pay top-up Wellness allowance Flexible work policy (at least 3 days a week from our Stockholm office) The monthly compensation range for this role in Stockholm is 50,000-77,000 SEK. Actual compensation will depend on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. We are hiring for multiple positions and welcome both junior and senior engineers from all backgrounds. We’d love to hear from you!

Both approaches have well-known limitations, especially as history grows long and needs to
items.desc: Paris, 75, FR ABOUT CFM Founded in 1991, we are a global quantitative and systematic asset management firm applying a scientific approach to finance to develop alternative investment strategies that create value for our clients. We value innovation, dedication, collaboration, and the ability to make an impact. Together, we create a stimulating environment for talented and passionate experts in research, technology, and business to explore new ideas and challenge existing assumptions. Your Role How Much History Does an LLM Need? Memory-Augmented Language Models for Financial Text Financial text about a company accumulates continuously over years. Today's language models typically process this history either by feeding in as much as fits in their context window, or by splitting it into independent chunks. Both approaches have well-known limitations, especially as history grows long and needs to stay historically consistent. This internship explores an alternative: building a compact, incrementally updated memory of a company's disclosure history, one that is updated as new documents arrive rather than fully re-read each time. The central question is twofold: Does a long disclosure history help understand or predict a company's future, compared to only recent information? If so, what is the best way to represent and maintain that history over time in a language model? Key Responsibilities Design and compare strategies for incrementally updating a compact memory representation as new documents arrive. Build comparison baselines, including a retrieval-based system. Evaluate the resulting representations both for faithfulness to the source documents and for usefulness on a downstream financial prediction task. Read and implement research papers (a significant part of the work). Your Skills Required Final-year engineering or Master's student in NLP, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or Computer Science. Strong Python skills, including PyTorch. Solid understanding of LLMs and sequence modeling. Ability to read and implement research papers. Fluent English Appreciated Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agent memory systems, or reinforcement learning for LLMs. Interest in financial applications (a bonus). Prior knowledge of finance is not required. French is a bonus. items.desc: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a Threat Research Engineer, you’ll take ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. This is a full-stack role, with AI central to how we work. You’ll build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster. What you’ll do Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems. Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools. Analyze software supply chain incidents and events. Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection. Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work. Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories. Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it. What you’ll bring Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them. Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model APIs or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent SDKs. Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and maintainable code. Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud. Understanding of how package ecosystems work and how software supply chain attacks happen. Ability to map possible attack vectors, name trade-offs, and make data-driven decisions, balancing quality and speed with customer outcomes in mind while keeping up with security and AI industry trends. Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience. Helpful, but not required: published vulnerability findings; security research on AI agents, large language model applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; Google Cloud Platform experience; or infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu. You don’t need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing engines. A high-level understanding is enough. About the team The Threat Research group researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab’s dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. You can read more on the Security Labs blog. items.desc: Descriptif de fonctions La Communauté du Pacifique (CPS) principale organisation scientifique et technique du Pacifique, sert le développement de la région depuis 1947. Organisation internationale de développement, la CPS tient lieu de maison commune aux 27 États et Territoires qui la composent et en assurent la gouvernance. Œuvrant pour le développement durable au bénéfice des populations du Pacifique, l’Organisation intervient dans plus de 25 secteurs d’activité. La CPS est renommée pour ses connaissances et sa capacité d’innovation dans des domaines tels que les sciences halieutiques, la surveillance de la santé publique, les géosciences et la conservation des ressources phytogénétiques pour l’alimentation et l’agriculture. La Division pêche, aquaculture et écosystèmes marins (FAME) est composée de trois programmes : le Programme pêches côtières et aquaculture (CFAP) ; le Programme pêche hauturière (OFP) et le Programme écosystèmes marins (MEP). Le Bureau du·de la Directeur·rice offre un appui à la mise en œuvre de ces trois programmes et des projets transversaux, et fixe leur orientation stratégique. Œuvrant aux côtés des 22 États et Territoires insulaires océaniens, la Division peut compter sur un solide réseau de partenaires régionaux, infrarégionaux et nationaux du secteur marin. Les effectifs de FAME sont répartis entre la Nouvelle-Calédonie, les Fidji, les États fédérés de Micronésie, les Îles Salomon et les Tonga, la majeure partie de ses agents étant en poste en Nouvelle-Calédonie. Le·La Chargé·e de la gestion des informations et des bases de données halieutiques (pêches côtières) apportera des compétences stratégiques et techniques spécialisées en conception, élaboration, gouvernance et déploiement de systèmes de données sur les pêches côtières et l’aquaculture, notamment en ce qui a trait aux bases de données, aux plateformes numériques et aux solutions alimentées par l’intelligence artificielle (IA). Il·Elle appuiera une gestion reposant sur des données factuelles et renforcera les capacités dans l’ensemble des pays insulaires océaniens au moyen de systèmes de données innovants, normalisés et durables. Les principales responsabilités du poste sont les suivantes : Mettre sur pied et gérer des systèmes d’information et des bases de données nationales et régionales de grande qualité sur les pêches côtières et l’aquaculture et dispenser des formations à l’utilisation de ces outils. Développer, gérer et mettre à jour les bases de données régionales sur les pêches côtières (connaissance scientifique, gestion et développement) et l’aquaculture, notamment en dispensant des formations à l’utilisation des bases de données, ainsi qu’à l’extraction et à l’analyse de données. Développer de nouvelles applications Web et mobiles pour les bases de données régionales et nationales, selon les besoins des pays et des agents du Programme CFAP. Développer des bases de données nationales à partir des bases de données régionales et des modules supplémentaires, et contribuer à leur gestion. Élaborer des requêtes particulières pour l’extraction et l’analyse de données, selon les demandes des pays ou des agents du Programme CFAP. Promouvoir et encourager l’utilisation de bases de données et de systèmes d’information normalisés dans toute la région pour les données relatives aux pêches côtières et à l’aquaculture, et inciter les pays à fournir les données qu’ils collectent à des fins de sauvegarde et de stockage à la CPS. Repérer et développer des liens entre les bases de données sur les pêches côtières et la pêche hauturière en collaboration avec la section chargée des statistiques et de la collecte de données sur la pêche hauturière. Déterminer des moyens d’améliorer l’utilisation de produits de systèmes d’information géographique (SIG) et de données de télédétection dans le cadre de l’analyse de données relatives aux pêches côtières et à l’aquaculture. Fournir une assistance pratique aux membres pour la conception et le ciblage d’informations adaptées à des fins de sensibilisation et d’éducation. Élaborer des supports de formation sur la saisie, le nettoyage et l’extraction de données. Contribuer, en collaboration avec la Section information halieutique, à la construction et à la maintenance du site Web du Programme CFAP afin de faciliter la diffusion d’informations en général. Contribuer à la mise au point de supports d’éducation et de sensibilisation axés sur les sciences halieutiques côtières et/ou la gestion des pêches côtières, ou sur les moyens de subsistance et l’aquaculture. Élaborer des outils et des modèles alimentés par l’intelligence artificielle pour la collecte de données. Améliorer la collecte de données sur les pêches côtières et l’aquaculture au moyen de photos et de vidéos traitées automatiquement par la vision par ordinateur et l’intelligence artificielle (IA). Les projets phares : notre ambition est de devenir une école de référence pour sensibiliser les acteurs du monde socio-économique et accompagner les projets de transition énergétique et d’adaptation au changement climatique. L’école accueille plus de 1200 élèves (ingénieurs et masters), pour un effectif de 300 enseignants titulaires et vacataires et 50 personnels administratifs et techniques. items.desc: Contexte Au sein de la direction Mobilité et Systèmes d'IFP Energies nouvelles, vous rejoindrez une équipe réunissant des compétences en mécanique des fluides numérique, thermique et thermomécanique. Historiquement reconnue dans les domaines de l'injection et de la combustion des moteurs thermiques, l'équipe développe aujourd'hui ses activités vers de nouveaux secteurs : propulsion spatiale, aéronautique, turbomachines, combustion stationnaire, systèmes cryogéniques et nouvelles technologies. Ces nouveaux domaines soulèvent des enjeux scientifiques et technologiques variés, notamment autour de la combustion stationnaire, des écoulements réactifs et diphasiques, des transferts thermiques et de l’analyse des turbomachines et systèmes propulsifs. L’objectif est de mobiliser la simulation numérique pour comprendre le fonctionnement de ces systèmes, identifier les phénomènes limitants et contribuer à l’amélioration de leurs performances et de leur conception. Mission(s) principale(s) et activités Vous prendrez en charge des études CFD appliquées à des systèmes thermo-fluidiques, thermodynamiques et propulsifs complexes, depuis l'analyse du besoin jusqu'à l'interprétation des résultats. À ce titre, vos principales activités seront de : Contribuer aux études portant sur les turbomachines à flux continu, la combustion stationnaire, la propulsion aérospatiale, les écoulements diphasiques, l'injection et les systèmes cryogéniques. Analyser les phénomènes physiques et les problématiques technologiques associés aux projets. Définir les méthodologies et stratégies de simulation, préparer les géométries, réaliser les maillages et mettre en œuvre les calculs. Exploiter les moyens de calcul haute performance et assurer le post-traitement des résultats. Évaluer la qualité et les limites des simulations, et confronter les résultats numériques aux données expérimentales disponibles. Mobiliser les résultats de simulation pour identifier les phénomènes limitants et proposer des pistes d'amélioration des composants. Collaborer avec les équipes spécialisées dans le développement de modèles physiques et avec les partenaires industriels. Contribuer au développement des méthodes et des pratiques de l'équipe, notamment par l'utilisation et le développement d'agents IA pour la mise en données et le post-traitement. Déplacements à prévoir Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et, selon les projets, à l’international, notamment pour des réunions avec les partenaires ou des conférences. Critères candidat Compétences techniques et aptitudes Vous maîtrisez la mécanique des fluides numérique et les différentes étapes d'une étude CFD : préparation géométrique, maillage, calcul parallèle, post-traitement et analyse physique des résultats. Vous avez une bonne connaissance des solveurs CFD industriels ou open source. La connaissance de CONVERGE constitue un atout. Une connaissance technologique des turbomachines à flux continu et de leurs principaux composants est particulièrement recherchée, afin de relier les résultats de simulation au fonctionnement et à l’amélioration des composants. Une expérience des écoulements diphasiques, des changements de phase ou des systèmes de stockage et de transfert de fluides cryogéniques constituerait également un plus. Une expérience des moteurs à combustion interne pourra également être valorisée lorsqu’elle est complétée par une expertise dans l’un des domaines prioritaires du poste. Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous faites preuve de rigueur scientifique, d'autonomie et de curiosité. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et savez communiquer et partager vos connaissances. La maîtrise de l'anglais technique, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, est attendue. Langues Anglais (Courant) Diplôme(s), niveau d'études Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un doctorat en mécanique des fluides, énergétique, combustion, thermique ou dans un domaine équivalent. Expérience(s) professionnelle(s) souhaitée(s) Vous disposez d'une expérience professionnelle confirmée en CFD appliquée, acquise dans l'industrie, un organisme de recherche ou un environnement académique orienté vers les applications. Une expertise dans au moins l’un des domaines suivants est particulièrement recherchée : turbomachines et aérodynamique interne, combustion stationnaire et chambres de combustion aéronautiques, ou propulsion spatiale. Une expérience de l’injection, de la pulvérisation, de l’allumage ou des transferts thermiques constituera un complément apprécié.
