items.desc: Position Summary We are seeking an experienced and technical Product Owner to own and drive the product backlog and lifecycle for our D&I wireless and edge portfolio. In this role, you will act as the Content Authority for the backlog, bridging customer needs, industry standards, and R&D execution. You will partner closely with systems engineering, R&D, NPI (New Product Introduction), and global cross-functional teams to deliver secure, highly reliable industrial wireless and edge platforms for utility and critical infrastructure customers. Job Description Location: Massy or Hybrid in France with 3 days in Massy office Reports To: Senior Product Manager Segment: Grid Automation / Digital & Infrastructure (D&I) Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Backlog Ownership & Requirements Backlog Management: Own and maintain the product backlog; translate portfolio strategy and multi-year roadmaps into prioritized epics, features, and enablers. Content Authority: Make explicit trade-offs across scope, cost, schedule, and quality, ensuring a release-ready backlog ahead of each planning cycle. Requirements Definition: Translate customer insights, field feedback, and standards obligations into clear, testable system requirements—including non-functional requirements (coverage, latency, availability, cybersecurity, environmental ratings). Traceability & Change Control: Maintain requirements traceability and change control; assess and communicate the impact of scope changes on committed release plans. 2. Product Execution & Lifecycle Portfolio Ownership: Own backlog and release execution across wireless platforms, including: Private LTE / PLTE Core & RAN Wireless Edge devices and industrial IoT platforms Edge Applications for Distribution Automation (e.g., Smart RTU, protocol conversion) Broadband power line communications Microwave and narrowband radio systems R&D & NPI Partnership: Act as the "voice of the customer" to R&D and NPI program teams. Lead backlog refinement, support Program Increment (PI) Planning and NPI tollgate reviews, and validate delivered value against acceptance criteria and the Definition of Done. Architecture & Dependencies: Partner with System Architects to balance feature content against architectural/platform enabler work, managing cross-team and supplier dependencies. Release Rhythm: Pace release content to portfolio operating rhythms, including multi-generation product plans, business plans, and NPI cycles. Compliance & Security: Ensure product security, safety, certification, and type-approval requirements are integrated into the backlog (e.g., FCC/ISED/CE, 3GPP, IEC 62443, IEEE 1613). Sustaining & EOL: Prioritize sustaining content (field issues, firmware maintenance, security patches, obsolescence-driven redesign) alongside new development; support product End-of-Life and installed-base migration plans. 3. Cross-Functional Collaboration Alignment: Drive alignment across Technology/R&D, Global Supply Chain (GSC), Sourcing, Services, Quality, and Commercial teams on backlog priorities and release commitments. Team Leadership: Partner with Technical Coordinators, Team Product Owners, and Scrum Masters to ensure team-level stories reflect customer needs and system intent. Business Strategy: Support the Senior Product Manager with business case inputs, cost targets, and pricing structures for new platform content, while contributing to competitive and technology analysis. 4. Commercial & Customer Engagement Voice of the Customer: Lead requirement workshops, pilots, field trials, and user acceptance testing with distribution utility and industrial customers. Sales Enablement: Support global commercial teams, ITO (Inquiry-to-Order), and OTR (Order-to-Remittance) with release content, roadmap clarity, configuration guidance, and technical support arbitration. Go-to-Market: Contribute to launch readiness, value propositions, sales enablement materials, and conference papers focusing on product and solution use cases. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Experience: Minimum 8 years of experience in product ownership, product management, systems engineering, or technical development within the Utility/Industrial Communication segment in a multicultural environment. Domain Expertise: Prior experience in the telecom industry with a strong focus on wireless communications (e.g., PLTE/LTE/5G, Wi-Fi, microwave backhaul, mission-critical wireless networks, IP, Cloud). Agile Acumen: Demonstrated experience defining and prioritizing requirements and backlogs in an Agile or SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) environment. Global Collaboration: Proven experience working successfully with global teams and customers. Modern Tools: Experience using AI-driven tools for requirement drafting, data analysis, or process automation. Desired Characteristics Certifications: SAFe POPM, CSPO, or equivalent product ownership certification. …

items.desc: Date: 12 Nov 2026 Location: Zoetermeer, NL Company: Miniclip The UA & Monetisation Specialist independently manages and optimises user acquisition and monetisation initiatives across Miniclip’s mobile gaming portfolio. Building on foundational experience, this role requires the ability to execute campaigns, evaluate performance trends, and propose improvements with limited supervision. Operating with growing ownership, the Specialist ensures that campaigns, monetisation activities, and live-ops initiatives are delivered to quality standards and aligned with game performance goals. This role offers the opportunity to deepen expertise in performance marketing, in-game monetisation, influencer campaigns, and ad revenue management while contributing to strategic discussions and cross-team collaboration. What will you be doing at Miniclip? Monetisation & Revenue Growth Execute and optimise monetisation initiatives to support revenue growth and improve ARPDAU. Contribute to the planning and refinement of IAP strategies, promotions, and in-game events using data-driven insights. Conduct A/B tests and assist in evaluating changes to the in-game economy, pricing models, and monetisation features. Identify early opportunities to enhance player lifetime value, including deep spend mechanics. Assist in improving ad revenue through placement reviews, mediation adjustments, and creative performance analysis. User Acquisition, Performance Marketing & Partnerships Manage and optimise paid UA campaigns across key platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, and emerging networks. Own channel-level budget pacing and optimisation, ensuring efficient spending within assigned budgets. Support creative and audience testing efforts to strengthen funnel performance and user engagement. Contribute to organic growth activities including ASO, search visibility, in-game placements, and social initiatives. Coordinate influencer and partner activities and assess their performance and scalability. Run small-scale tests with new partners or formats and summarise post-campaign learnings. What are we looking for? Education Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or related field (or equivalent experience). Certification Advanced certifications in mobile advertising tools, analytics platforms, or monetisation technologies are beneficial. Experience 1–3 years of experience in user acquisition and/or ad monetisation. Although optional, we encourage you to include a cover letter explaining why you're interested in this opportunity and why you'd like to join Miniclip. It will help our team better understand your motivation and what makes this role the right fit for you. About Miniclip Miniclip is a global leader in games and one of the world's biggest developers and publishers of mobile games, with a mission of unleashing the gamer in everyone. It distributes highly engaging games to a global audience of over 450 million monthly and 60 million daily active users across mobile, PC, console, social, and online platforms. Operating in 15 countries, Miniclip develops and launches games in multiple categories across its 22 studios. Founded in 2001 with an internationally recognised brand name, Miniclip has successfully grown a global audience across 195 countries and six continents. It has a unique understanding of the games space, developing and distributing a strong portfolio of over 60 high-quality mobile games globally. To date, Miniclip’s studios and companies have generated more than 12 billion downloads, including the following games: 8 Ball Pool, Subway Surfers, Golf Battle, Football Strike, Carrom Pool, OSM - Online Soccer Manager™, Football Rivals , Pure Sniper , Puzzle Page™, Head Ball 2, Motorsport Manager, Darts of Fury, Mini Football, Triple Match 3D™, Agar.io, PowerWash Simulator, Sudoku.com™, and We Are Warriors™. For more information, visit https://miniclip.com/

Own and maintain linguistic assets, including glossaries, style guides, terminology, and translation memories, continuously improving translation quality and consistency. Knowledge of terminology management, glossaries, translation memories, and localization best practices. Familiarity with translation quality frameworks such as MQM, DQF, or similar. Near-native or C2-level English with the ability to interpret nuance, tone, and context. Strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to work independently. Interest in supporting localization operations beyond translation work. Desirable Experience with Lokalise or other translation management systems. Previous experience in localization project coordination or management. Background in affiliate marketing, ad-tech, e-commerce, SaaS, or a related digital industry. Experience working as the sole linguist for a language or within a small in-house localization team. items.desc: We are looking for an enthusiastic, organised and dynamic individual to join our team at Berkshire and Surrey Pathology Services as Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Coordinator . This is a brand new post that has been established to support our ambitions to strengthen our research identity, visibility and operational capability. BSPS is a large network of NHS laboratories serving 7 NHS hospitals: Ashford & St Peter’s, Frimley Park, Royal Berkshire, Royal Surrey, Heatherwood, Wexham Park and East Surrey Hospital. You will be an organised person able to interact with multiple colleagues from different scientific, clinical, financial and administrative backgrounds to support the RDI Network Lead coordinate research activities across the pathology network. Amongst other duties, the post holder will be the main point of contact for researchers, industry and academics contacting the BSPS network, will consolidate peer-reviewed publications, develop the BSPS website research pages, work with partner trust RDI teams and have oversight of research income. Please note that interviews for this post will be conducted in person only. Remote or virtual interviews are not available, and candidates will be required to attend the interview at the specified location. The Research coordinator will act as a focal point for communication in relation to anything Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) related across the Berkshire and Surrey Pathology Services (BSPS) pathology network. This will include communication with Research teams of the BSPS partner organisations and research active scientists, clinicians and other colleagues across the network Within the network the research coordinator will be responsible for keeping track of documentation related to RDI, keep a record of on-going studies, keep an up to date library of peer-reviewed papers published by members of BSPS. The post holder will work closely with and provide support on-going to the BSPS RDI lead. The post holder will liaise with clinical research departments across the BSPS network, research support staff, scientists, finance staff and external stakeholders as required. The post holder will be expected to undertake duties in an independent manner without the need for direct supervision and be capable of using and taking initiative. To develop and maintain positive and constructive working relationships with peers and colleagues across BSPS and BSPS partner Trusts. Regularly has contact with Senior Managers, Clinicians, Directors, R&D teams and scientific and clinical colleagues within BSPS. Liaises with other staff and colleagues across BSPS and the five Partner Trusts at all levels. Royal Surrey is a compassionate and collaborative acute and community Trust. Recognising that our 5,000 colleagues are our greatest strength, we offer a comprehensive health and wellbeing programme alongside a strong commitment to developing your career. Our diverse and welcoming Royal Surrey family ensures you feel valued from your initial interview and throughout your time with us. We are clinically led and provide joined-up care by bridging hospital and community services, alongside delivering regional specialist cancer care. Our main acute hospital site is in Guildford, with community sites at Milford, Haslemere and Cranleigh, and services delivered in patients’ homes across Guildford and Waverley. We work in partnership with Ashford & St Peter’s Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. The Care Quality Commission (CQC) has rated us as Outstanding. We are proud of our achievements and continue to invest in our people and infrastructure. To learn more about life at Royal Surrey, please watch our short video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R96pMboIYdo Adverts may close early, so you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. The Post holder will coordinate RDI activity across the network. This will include; First point of contact for anyone contacting BSPS re RDI Maintaining the R&D section of the BSPS website Establish an organised process for R&D activity within and linked to BSPS Attendance and minute taking at BSPS RDI meetings and any other meetings required Work with the RID Lead and BSPS finance team to ensure appropriate reimbursement for RDI activities across the network Maintain an up to date library of peer-reviewed publications from BSPS The post holder will be based at the Royal Surrey Foundation Trust in Guildford and share an office with a friendly, supportive and active research team at the Bowel Cancer Screening South of England Hub on the Surrey Research Park. Because the role is for the entire pathology network the postholder will be expected to travel across the pathology network as required. Please see the attached Job Description and Person Specification to understand more about the opportunity this role presents you.

You
items.desc: Background At Motion Applied - Connected Intelligence (CI), we create cutting-edge wireless connectivity solutions that are transforming customer experience across the transport industry. We create solutions that improve service effectiveness and cost-efficiency for customers, delivering high-quality internet connectivity services. By applying our expertise, we deliver real benefits and pioneer a better future. Purpose of the Role You will investigate data from our connectivity products and live operations to identify patterns, define reliable analytical logic and help convert evidence into product features and automation. Your work will move beyond one-off reporting: you will create reusable measures, definitions, classifications and validation cases that software and data engineers can implement, test and operate in production. You will work across telemetry, network, location, device, service-performance and commercial data. You will turn loosely defined product or operational questions into measurable hypotheses and repeatable analyses, establishing what data, transformations and quality controls are required. Working with Product Managers, Systems Engineers, Software Engineers and Data Engineers, you will define and validate analytical logic. Data Engineers will provide or productionise data assets where appropriate, while you will own the analytical definition, evidence, test approach and refinement of the logic. You will use deterministic rules where reliability, explainability and repeatability are required, and apply statistical, machine-learning or large language model approaches only where they add demonstrable value and can be appropriately validated. Principal Accountabilities Investigate and structure new product insights Explore telemetry, network, location, device, operational and commercial datasets to identify useful patterns, behaviours, anomalies and product opportunities. Turn ambiguous stakeholder questions into measurable definitions, testable hypotheses and repeatable analytical methods. Assess data availability, quality, lineage and limitations, and define any additional data, transformations or reference datasets required. Clean, combine and validate data from multiple sources, documenting assumptions, definitions and methods so results are traceable and reproducible. Produce evidence and analytical logic that can be reused in products and operational processes, rather than only in presentations, dashboards or static reports. Convert findings into deterministic product logic Define the clear sequence from source data, to metric or classification, to observed event or behaviour, to a deterministic rule or product response. Specify thresholds, exceptions, precedence, confidence measures, edge cases and validation criteria clearly enough for engineering teams to implement and test. Compare candidate rules or models against historical and live operational outcomes, quantifying false positives, false negatives and areas of uncertainty where appropriate. Distinguish between deterministic logic, statistical inference, machine learning and LLM-based approaches, selecting the simplest reliable method that meets the need. Use AI-assisted analytics and LLMs responsibly where they add value, without substituting generated outputs for reliable rules, evidence, traceability or validation. Enable product features and automation Work with Product Managers, Systems Engineers and Software Engineers to convert validated analytical concepts into product requirements, acceptance criteria and test cases. Create reusable definitions, classifications, calculations and reference logic that can be maintained as governed product assets. Support engineering during implementation by clarifying logic, validating outputs and refining rules using representative data. Help develop analytics-driven capabilities such as fault detection, service optimisation, operational alerts, coverage analysis and automated recommendations. Monitor implemented logic against real-world outcomes and recommend controlled changes when performance, operating context or available data changes. Communicate and collaborate Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, separating evidence, assumptions, interpretation and recommendation. Explain analytical limitations and trade-offs and recommend practical next steps where the evidence supports them. Contribute analytical artefacts within version control and participate in peer review, agile delivery and cross-functional product discovery. Promote responsible use of data, including appropriate consideration of privacy, governance, security and customer commitments. Location This role is based at our head office in central Woking. The role is included in our hybrid working policy, with the expectation of a minimum of two days a week in the office, coordinated with other members of the Engineering team. We’re a compact, talent-dense technical team, with deep domain expertise in machine learning, formal verification and software system engineering. Join us to develop the next frontier of formal reasoning and software engineering. Proof follows function. items.desc: Our students and researchers rely on a growing range of digital resources, from academic journals and databases to specialist platforms and Open Access content. Behind that access is a complex network of suppliers, systems, authentication, entitlements and discovery services. We are looking for a Digital Access & Discovery Librarian to join the management of our Content Team and lead this important area of Library service delivery. This is an opportunity to combine specialist digital library expertise with people and service leadership, shaping how our digital collections are accessed and discovered and helping us continually improve the user experience. What you'll do You will: Lead digital access, authentication, entitlements and discovery services for our electronic collections. Investigate complex access and discovery issues, using service data, user feedback and operational insight to identify recurring problems and lead improvements. Increase the visibility and discoverability of Open Access resources, ensuring they are effectively integrated alongside purchased content. Manage and monitor electronic resource-related enquiries within the CRM, using data and insights to identify trends, improve services, enhance the user experience, and support evidence-based decision-making. Line manage team members within the Reading Lists and Metadata functions, coordinating operational resources and supporting colleagues to develop and deliver effective services. Work collaboratively with Library Digital colleagues, publishers, suppliers and platform providers to ensure our digital content and services work effectively for users. You will also support the Content Manager with wider team management and development, deputising where required, and keep abreast of developments across the sector, including emerging AI-enabled functionality. What we're looking for We're looking for someone who can bring: Experience and expertise in electronic resources and digital access, with a good understanding of authentication and discovery services. Experience of investigating and resolving complex access and discovery issues. Knowledge of Open Access and approaches to improving the visibility and discoverability of open content. The ability to lead, support and develop colleagues and coordinate resources effectively. Confidence working with publishers, suppliers and system providers. Strong analytical skills and an evidence-led approach to service improvement. The ability to translate technical issues into clear advice for colleagues and stakeholders. A collaborative approach and the confidence to contribute to wider team management and service development. Why join us? This role offers the opportunity to take real ownership of a specialist and developing area of Library service delivery. You'll combine hands-on professional expertise with management responsibility, work across Content and Digital teams, and have the scope to influence how our services develop as the digital information environment changes. You'll be joining a collaborative team with the opportunity to develop your professional and leadership experience while making a visible difference to how students and researchers discover and access the resources they need. What's in it for you? Competitive salary - and excellent pension scheme An impressive 32 days leave - plus bank holidays, additional time off at Christmas and the opportunity to buy even more! Flexible working - we support a culture of flexible and agile working to help you find the right balance Professional development - we offer a comprehensive package of training and development opportunities to help you achieve your full potential Our community - there's a real sense of belonging here at Salford. We value diversity, in backgrounds and in experiences. Our difference makes us stronger, and together we share a passion for improving students' lives The Perks! - MySalford, our online employee portal offers a wide range of lifestyle benefits and discounts A rewarding career - where everything you do will make a difference. To our students, our local community, and the world around you **Please note this opportunity may close early depending on applicant volume.**

items.desc: Generation AI: Your Career Starts Here. Where It Goes Is Up to You. Curious about AI? Excited by technology? Full of ideas you can't wait to put into practice? This is an opportunity to work on real challenges, experiment with emerging technologies and see what you're capable of. At Sofigate, we're looking for a small group of ambitious, curious, and driven talents to join Sofigate’s Generation AI -team in January 2027 . This is an opportunity for higher education students near graduation or just graduated, who are eager to put their skills into practice, learn fast, and build a career at the intersection of business, technology, and AI. You'll work alongside experienced professionals, tackle real business challenges, and have the freedom to explore where your strengths and interests can take you. If you have built something with AI, automated a boring task, written code just to see if an idea would work, created something nobody asked you to create, you may be just the person we are looking for. What Could You Be Working On? Imagine using artificial intelligence to uncover insights, improve decision-making, and discover possibilities in leading and managing organisations. That's just one of the opportunities we're currently exploring. Your projects could take you in many directions, from AI innovation and automation to business technology transformation. Some opportunities are already taking shape. Others haven't even been imagined yet. Depending on your interests, skills and the projects ahead, you could: Experiment with AI, automation, and other technologies to solve real problems. Help develop smarter business processes and technology solutions, including platforms such as ServiceNow. Work on customer projects or internal innovations and products that turn ideas into measurable results. Challenge how things are done and find better, smarter ways forward. Learn from experienced Sofigators, while taking increasing ownership of your work. One thing is certain: you won't be short of things to learn, explore, or get involved in. Who Are We Looking For? You might be studying computer science, business, industrial engineering, or something completely different. What matters is that you're at graduation, ready for full-time work , and excited to put your skills to the test. We're looking for people who bring: Curiosity that goes beyond the classroom. You're genuinely interested in AI, already experimented and created things with it and other technologies, and how they can change the way businesses work. Hands-on AI experience. You've gone beyond chatting with AI and started building with it. Maybe you've created an AI agent, developed a skill, or automated something just to see if you could. What matters is that you've turned curiosity into action. A get-things-done attitude. You take initiative, enjoy solving problems and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves. The courage to experiment. You ask questions, challenge assumptions and learn from things that don't work the first time. A willingness to learn and grow. You're independent when needed but know that great things are built together. Strong communication skills. You're comfortable working in English and Finnish. Why join us? AI is changing every industry. Businesses are searching for practical ways to create value, improve productivity and reinvent how they operate. At Sofigate, you'll have the opportunity to be part of that transformation from the very beginning of your career and create your path in the consulting world. How we work At Sofigate, we're helping organizations bridge the gap between business and technology. We call this Business Technology. We're neither a traditional management consultancy nor a software development company. Our mission is to help organizations create tangible business outcomes through technology, and increasingly through AI. You'll join an international, collaborative and low-hierarchy culture where initiative is encouraged and new ideas are welcomed. We believe diverse perspectives create better outcomes, and we want every Sofigator to have the opportunity to grow, contribute and shape the future of our company. Growth isn't just something we help our customers achieve. It's something we expect and support within our own community. What We Offer Challenging customer assignment opportunities, environment varying from large internationally operating companies to purposeful public organisations Opportunities for professional growth and development. Full 2.5 days/month of vacation accrual starting from the beginning of your employment Shareholder program, which allows you to be a part owner in Sofigate Extended healthcare insurance and a wellness programme that is available for all employees Work on meaningful challenges where AI and technology create real business impact. How to Apply The recruitment process also includes a short video assignment : Tell us in English, in 1 minute about a project you've already done with …

items.card: Your mission As an Applied AI Intern at revel8 you sit between our customers and our product: you understand what security teams at enterprises like Allianz or Beiersdorf actually struggle with, and you turn that into working AI prototypes and simulations, fast. You will leverage AI to solve real customer problems and shape what we build next. How Your Day-to-day Will Look Like Engineer AI Workflows: Design, test
items.desc: Our mission We’re on a mission to create 10 million human firewalls! At revel8, we redefine cybersecurity training with hyper-realistic simulations that reflect today’s evolving attack landscape. Our innovative platform combines AI-driven multi-channel attacks with gamified, real-time learning to build resilience where it matters most: the people. Your mission As an Applied AI Intern at revel8 you sit between our customers and our product: you understand what security teams at enterprises like Allianz or Beiersdorf actually struggle with, and you turn that into working AI prototypes and simulations, fast. You will leverage AI to solve real customer problems and shape what we build next. How Your Day-to-day Will Look Like Engineer AI Workflows: Design, test and implement AI-driven features using prompt engineering and AI coding tools. Prototype with AI: Build working prototypes fast with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor and the like) to validate new product ideas within days, not months. Create Intelligent Content: Develop adaptive, AI-enhanced simulations and content that reflect real-world cyber threats. Collaborate Cross-functionally: Work closely with product and engineering teams to ensure seamless product development and delivery. Talk to customers: Join customer calls and innovation projects, understand the problems behind the requests, and feed what you learn into what we prototype next. Think like a product owner: Assess whether an idea is worth building, what it costs, and how it would create value for revel8 and its customers. Shape the Future: Contribute directly to building products that will help create 10 million human firewalls and revolutionize cybersecurity training. Is it you we are looking for? You are... A curious generalist with business acumen: you can sit in front of a customer, ask the right questions, and understand their problem before you build anything. Comfortable building things with AI tools, even if you are not a software engineer by training. An AI-native builder: AI coding tools are part of how you work, and you have already built something real with them, a prototype, an agent, an automation, anything you can show. From an engineering, data science, business informatics or similar background. What matters is that you can build with AI tools, not which degree says so. Interested in cybersecurity, AI and product innovation. A resilient builder who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and likes owning projects end-to-end. Detail-oriented and creative, you are not afraid to prototype fast and iterate until you find the right solution. A strong communicator with the skills to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams, and with customers. Why revel8? Our revelutionary Energy: A team that's ambitious, kind, and genuinely excited about what we're building. We move fast, we have fun, and we treat each other well. Timing: Product-market fit is proven. The work now is to scale through rigorous execution. Mission-Driven Impact: Contribute to a meaningful mission of building human resilience against cyber threats. Learning & Growth: We are still a small company, which means you’ll have real ownership and experience first-hand how a startup scales from the inside. Working alongside experienced Product and Engineering professionals, you can expand your skills across multiple technologies and own new product development initiatives that directly shape product strategy and company direction. New Munich Office: We thrive on an office-first culture in the heart of Munich (Stiglmaierplatz) - unlimited coffee, table tennis and good vibes included. EGYM Wellpass membership for your daily balance. Stay with us: Strong performers often continue with revel8 in a working student role or full-time position after the internship. We love growing talent we've already worked with. Ready to join the revelution? Perfect, let’s talk! Just submit your application, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible. items.desc: We are ELCA, one of the largest Swiss IT tribe with over 2,300 experts. We are multicultural with offices in Switzerland, Spain, France, Vietnam and Mauritius. Since 1968, our team of engineers, business analysts, software architects, designers and consultants provide tailor-made and standardized solutions to support the digital transformation of major public administrations and private companies in Switzerland. Our activity spans across multiples fields of leading-edge technologies such as AI, Machine & Deep learning, BI/BD, RPA, Blockchain, IoT and CyberSecurity. In this 6-month internship starting in Spring 2027, you'll test whether sovereign, locally-run AI can reliably scope complex legacy data migrations so our clients can get accurate fixed-price offers. Your tasks Benchmark open-source LLMs that can be self-hosted on sovereign infrastructure against leading cloud models on three migration-scoping tasks: understanding schemas, extracting business rules and assessing data quality. Deploy and run candidate models locally with tools such as Ollama, vLLM or Hugging Face, and see how sovereign AI works in practice. Design and build a prototype agentic pipeline that analyzes legacy schemas, code and sample data on its own. Uncover hidden business rules in legacy systems, including .NET-based applications, that often only show up after in-depth analysis. Validate data consistency and quality, and assess the complexity of a representative legacy migration case. Generate automated effort and complexity estimates , along with step-by-step migration guidelines, from a locally-run model. Define criteria and best practices for when a local model is accurate enough to replace manual scoping in fixed-price migration bids. Evaluate and document the resource, cost and licensing trade-offs between self-hosted and cloud models. Shape how we scope one of our most frequently fixed-price-quoted services for clients with strict data sovereignty needs. What we offer A dynamic, collaborative workplace with a highly motivated, multicultural team working across international sites Monthly AI meetups with our expert AI team, where you can ask questions and move your topic forward The chance to make a difference in people's lives by building innovative solutions Internal coding events such as Hackathons and Brownbag sessions, plus our technical blog Monthly After-Works organized at each location About your profile You have a Bachelor or Master degree (EPFL, ETH, University) in Computer Science or related discipline You are comfortable programming in Python and SQL , and ideally have some familiarity with .NET-based systems You have worked with LLMs and, ideally, tried deploying them locally (e.g. Ollama, vLLM, Hugging Face) You are curious about agentic AI and keen to build and benchmark your own pipeline You have a basic understanding of database schemas and data quality You like to work in a structured way and to share your findings clearly You are fluent in written and spoken English, as well as German or French Application: Please attach your academic transcripts to your application. If you take on challenges with curiosity, motivation and drive, you've come to the right place! Let our motto inspire you: We make it work!

items.desc: Lieu : Palaiseau, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Thales Research&Technology, notre centre de recherche dans les domaines matériels, et CortAIx Labs, notre centre de recherche en IA et digital ont pour mission de proposer des innovations de ruptures, de maintenir et d’accroitre l’avance technologique et d’en assurer la compétitivité pour le groupe. Les approches impliquant de l’apprentissage profond ont, ces dernières années, montré des performances très intéressantes pour des problèmes de traitement du signal audio. La mise en place de ces approches passe par une phase d’optimisation ou entraînement en laboratoire sur des bases de données dites source les plus représentatives possibles des données qui seront rencontrées sur le terrain. Cependant, pour des raisons de confidentialité, de spécificités du capteur ou de conditions d’emploi, ces données d’intérêt, dites cible, sont souvent manquantes, non-labélisées ou en très faible quantité lors des phases d'entraînement initiales ; ce qui mène souvent à une perte de performances lors du déploiement. Il y a donc un besoin de mettre en place une adaptation dynamique directement sur le terrain ce qui implique une contrainte de frugalité en termes de données cible et de ressources computationnelles accessibles. L’objectif du stage sera de mettre en place une approche d’adaptation dynamique non-supervisée sur de nouvelles données arrivant continument sur le terrain dans la phase d’exploitation de l’algorithme. Les approches étudiées seront appliquées en priorité au problème de restauration de la qualité de la voix. Le stage est orienté recherche, le stagiaire réalisera un état de l’art scientifique et technique, participera à l’élaboration du protocole expérimental, proposera et comparera plusieurs approches pour répondre au problème posé.. Dans Ce Contexte, Vous Aurez Pour Missions Travailler en collaboration avec l'équipe de recherche : doctorants et chercheurs expérimentés Comprendre la problématique métier et mise en place d'un protocole expérimental et d’une implémentation académique pour la recherche ouverte Objectifs Prise en main de différentes méthodes état de l’art en rehaussement de la voix Développement en python d’une ou plusieurs méthodes innovantes pour pallier la problématique d’apprentissage continu pour compenser le domain shift entre les données d’entraînement initial et les données rencontrées lors de l'inférence. Dimensionner la solution pour être cohérente de la contrainte de frugalité en termes de données, d’annotations et de ressources de calcul disponibles sur le terrain. Participation à la vie du laboratoire (interactions avec d’autres stagiaires, participation aux séminaires de recherche hebdomadaires...) items.desc: Lieu : Palaiseau, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Thales Research&Technology, notre centre de recherche dans les domaines matériels, et CortAIx Labs, notre centre de recherche en IA et digital ont pour mission de proposer des innovations de ruptures, de maintenir et d’accroitre l’avance technologique et d’en assurer la compétitivité pour le groupe. Un stage précédent a permis de développer et de valider une approche de reconnaissance du locuteur par fusion multimodale (audio et vidéo). Il a été prouvé que l'ajout de la modalité vidéo améliore les performances de reconnaissance par rapport à une approche purement audio. Cependant, dans des conditions réelles et adversariales, un système biométrique doit faire face à de multiples tentatives de fraude (spoofing). Avec la démocratisation des intelligences artificielles génératives (deepfakes, voice conversion, lip-sync), un attaquant peut tenter d'usurper l'identité d'un locuteur en falsifiant l'audio, la vidéo, ou les deux de manière asymétrique (ex: une personne porte un masque ou modifie sa voix tout en gardant son visage). L'objectif de ce stage est d'évaluer la robustesse du système actuel face à ces attaques et de développer des contre-mesures intelligentes, notamment en repensant la stratégie de fusion multimodale pour détecter ces fraudes. Objectifs Concevoir et générer différentes attaques (symétriques et asymétriques) pour tester la vulnérabilité du système actuel. Étudier la cohérence temporelle et la "preuve de vie" (Liveness) entre l'audio et la vidéo pour détecter les rejeux été les deepfakes. Tester la résilience du système dans des conditions environnementales dégradées (bruit, luminosité faible). Proposer et implémenter une stratégie de fusion dynamique capable d'ajuster le poids de chaque modalité en fonction de leur niveau de confiance respectif. Vos missions Évaluer la vulnérabilité du système de reconnaissance actuel en concevant et générant des attaques adversariales (symétriques et asymétriques telles que deepfakes audio/vidéo, voice conversion, ou port de masques). Tester la résilience du système multimodal face à des conditions environnementales dégradées (bruit acoustique, basse luminosité, qualité vidéo réduite). Développer des contre-mesures axées sur la "preuve de vie" (Liveness) en analysant la cohérence temporelle audio- vidéo (synchronisation labiale) et en explorant la détection de signaux vitaux (rPPG). Concevoir et implémenter une stratégie de fusion multimodale dynamique, capable d'ajuster le poids de chaque modalité en temps réel selon son niveau de confiance afin de contrer efficacement les fraudes. Votre profil Etudiant en dernière année (Bac+5) d'une école d'ingénieur ou équivalent, vous recherchez un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois. Vous avez de solides compétences en programmation (Python, PyTorch ou TensorFlow) ? Vous avez des connaissances de base en apprentissage profond (réseaux de neurones, CNN, RNN/Transformers) ? Vous avez une appétence pour le traitement du signal audio/vidéo et/ou la cybersécurité (connaissance des deepfakes est un plus) ? Vous êtes connu pour votre curiosité, autonomie et rigueur scientifique ? Alors n'hésitez plus, ce stage est fait pour vous ! Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc: Gruppo Digital360 è il gruppo italiano che supporta imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione nella trasformazione digitale, nell’innovazione organizzativa e valorizzazione del brand e posizionamento. Digital360 unisce rigore accademico e visione imprenditoriale, affiancando le organizzazioni e le imprese, pubbliche e private, con team multidisciplinari che integrano competenze di natura umanistica, economica, tecnologica, legale e organizzativa e riunisce manager, imprenditori e professionisti presenti sul mercato da oltre quarant’anni. All’interno delle sue tre Business Unit – Advisory, GOV e Connect- il Gruppo offre servizi che si sviluppano sui principali pillar della trasformazione digitale, diventando un vero abilitatore dell’evoluzione organizzativa e tecnologica delle aziende e delle organizzazioni. Nato nel 2012 da un’iniziativa del Politecnico di Milano, il Gruppo Digital360 è oggi una Società Benefit, con headquarter in Italia, a Milano e a Roma, con oltre 1.300 persone e 140M € di ricavi nel 2025. Attualmente siamo alla ricerca di un/una candidato/a per la posizione di Junior CRM Specialist focalizzato/a sull'ecosistema HubSpot , con un forte interesse verso l'Intelligenza Artificiale per potenziare le strategie data-driven dei nostri clienti. La figura deve possedere buone basi tecniche sulla piattaforma HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service Hub), una buona comprensione del Digital Marketing e un approccio propensivo all'utilizzo delle nuove funzionalità IA native (come l'ecosistema HubSpot Breeze ) per la digitalizzazione e l'ottimizzazione dei processi operativi. Tale risorsa è fondamentale per supportare il team nell'aiutare i nostri Clienti a sfruttare l'Intelligenza Artificiale per trasformare i dati in insight azionabili e personalizzare la Customer Experience. La figura svilupperà inoltre una crescente comprensione delle logiche RevOps (Revenue Operations), supportando l’allineamento operativo tra Marketing, Sales e Service. Contribuirà alla configurazione di processi integrati che abilitano la crescita scalabile dei clienti, garantendo ordine nei flussi e miglioramento continuo. Effettua il monitoraggio delle performance, creando dashboard e reportistiche standard su HubSpot. Applica le best practice per un utilizzo etico dell'IA e la conformità alle normative sulla privacy (es. GDPR). Collabora con i team interni per supportare i Clienti nell'utilizzo efficace delle nuove funzionalità. Spiccata attitudine all'analisi dei processi e dei dati. Esperienza (o forte interesse a svilupparla) nella configurazione di strumenti IA all'interno di HubSpot per l'automazione. Capacità di comprendere i requisiti di business per tradurli in flussi CRM. Conoscenza di base di Google Analytics e di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto MS Office, in particolare Excel. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, parlata e scritta. Interesse o prima esperienza in logiche di Lead Generation. Conoscenza dei principali tool di Project Management (es. Monday, Asana). Familiarità con i fondamenti di prompt engineering per l'utilizzo efficace di strumenti di IA Generativa. Requisiti: Da 1 a massimo 2 anni di esperienza in un ruolo analogo, con esposizione all'utilizzo di HubSpot. Sarà valutata positivamente la curiosità o la prima esperienza con funzionalità IA. Diploma o laurea in ambito informatico, Ingegneria Gestionale, Digital Marketing o discipline affini. Costituiranno titolo preferenziale le certificazioni base della HubSpot Academy. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, parlata e scritta. La conoscenza di francese/tedesco/spagnolo è considerata un graditissimo plus. items.desc: Software Engineer (Python / AI) Dublin | €85,000- €100,000 + Equity | Fully Onsite Want to build real AI products, take ownership of what you ship, and join a startup that's scaling quickly? I'm working with a well-funded, high-growth AI startup in Dublin that's building some seriously interesting technology. They've recently surpassed $1 million in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), are onboarding major enterprise customers across the UK and Ireland, and are now growing their engineering team to keep up with demand. This isn't a business experimenting with AI or trying to figure out where it fits. They've built a product that customers are paying for, they're scaling quickly, and there's a huge amount still to build. They're looking for a Software Engineer with strong backend fundamentals who wants to get stuck into building products, solving difficult problems and helping shape the next stage of the company's growth. What makes this interesting? You'll be joining a small, talented engineering team where you'll have genuine ownership over what you build. There's no sitting around waiting for tickets to be assigned. You'll be involved in designing solutions, making technical decisions, building features and seeing your work go into production. Some of the projects you'll be working on include: Multi-Agent AI Systems: Building and improving AI agents that automate complex workflows, manage communications and make intelligent decisions. AI-Native CRM: Developing a completely new approach to CRM, moving away from traditional record-keeping towards proactive, intelligent systems that drive actions. Telephony Infrastructure: Building and scaling in-house communication infrastructure, tackling challenges around real-time systems, different technologies and international markets. Multimodal AI: Developing products that work across voice, WhatsApp, SMS, email and chat, bringing multiple communication channels into one intelligent platform. APIs & Integrations: Building integrations with third-party platforms and developing a unified API layer to support a growing enterprise customer base. LLM Evaluation: Building frameworks to test, compare and evaluate AI models, helping decide which models and agents deliver the best results. You'll be working on real technical challenges, with the freedom to influence how things are built. What they're looking for Ideally, you'll have 2-5 years of commercial software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend development. The key things: Strong backend engineering fundamentals and the ability to write clean, reliable, production-ready code. Experience with Python , or strong experience in another backend language and the willingness to work primarily with Python. A track record of building products and taking ownership of features from start to finish. Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity and the ability to pick up new technologies quickly. An interest in AI, particularly LLMs, AI agents and the possibilities of agentic systems. A genuine desire to work in a fast-growing startup where you can make an impact. Experience building AI agents, working with LLMs or developing complex integrations would be a big advantage, but you don't need to have done all of this before. Equally, startup experience would be great, but it's not essential. If you've worked in a strong product environment, enjoy building things and want more ownership, they'd love to hear from you. Let's talk about the startup environment I want to be upfront about this because it's an important part of the opportunity. This isn't your typical 9-5 engineering role. The company is growing quickly, the team is lean, and there's a huge amount of work happening as they scale. They're looking for people who genuinely enjoy building, want to take ownership and are excited by the challenge of helping grow a technology business. You'll be working alongside the team in their Dublin office five days a week. That's intentional. They want engineers collaborating closely, solving problems together, moving quickly and learning from each other. There will be periods of longer working days, particularly at this stage of growth. The ambition isn't for that intensity to last forever, but right now they're building something significant and want people who are excited to be part of that journey. In return, you'll get a level of ownership, technical exposure and influence that can be difficult to find in a larger organisation. What's on offer? Up to €100,000 base salary Equity in a growing, well-funded AI business The opportunity to build and ship real AI products used by enterprise customers Genuine ownership over features, products and technical decisions Direct access to the people building and scaling the business, and clients A small engineering team where your contribution will have a visible impact Exposure to multi-agent systems, LLMs, real-time communications and complex integrations The chance to join at an …

items.title: Stage : Creative AI & Generative Design
items.card: Vos missions : imaginer, expérimenter, développer Intégré·e à un projet R&D en cours, vous participerez au développement de nouveaux outils et workflows IA dédiés à la création, depuis l'exploration d'une idée jusqu'à son intégration dans un prototype utilisable par un designer. Imaginer → Explorer → Assembler → Prototyper → Tester → Simplifier → Intégrer Concevoir de nouveaux workflows créatifs : imaginer comment
items.desc: Imaginer Les Nouveaux Outils Du Designer L'écosystème de l'IA évolue vite : nouveaux modèles open source, contrôle géométrique, vision par ordinateur, reconstruction 3D... Ces avancées ouvrent de nouvelles manières de dessiner, transformer, contrôler, visualiser et explorer un design. L'enjeu dépasse la simple génération d'images : comment masquer la complexité technique pour mettre la puissance de l'IA au service du geste créatif ? Nous recherchons un·e stagiaire curieux·se, créatif·ve et explorateur·rice pour intégrer un projet R&D dédié au design automobile, à la croisée de l'IA générative, de la computer vision, du développement Python et de la création automobile. Vos missions : imaginer, expérimenter, développer Intégré·e à un projet R&D en cours, vous participerez au développement de nouveaux outils et workflows IA dédiés à la création, depuis l'exploration d'une idée jusqu'à son intégration dans un prototype utilisable par un designer. Imaginer → Explorer → Assembler → Prototyper → Tester → Simplifier → Intégrer Concevoir de nouveaux workflows créatifs : imaginer comment l'IA peut enrichir ou transformer certaines étapes du processus de design : dessin, contrôle géométrique, exploration visuelle, transformation d'image, analyse, représentation 3D ou rendu. Assembler et détourner des briques open source : expérimenter avec Qwen, Stable Diffusion, ControlNet, LoRA, VLM/LLM, computer vision, Gaussian Splatting, reconstruction 3D ou d'autres technologies, et chercher comment les connecter ou les utiliser au-delà de leur usage initial. Développer et prototyper : construire ces expériences avec ComfyUI, Python, Diffusers, PyTorch, OpenCV ou des APIs, modifier des pipelines existants et développer les briques manquantes lorsque nécessaire. Adapter et spécialiser les modèles : expérimenter l'entraînement de LoRA, ControlNet ou ControlNet-LoRA, le conditionnement visuel, la segmentation ou d'autres approches permettant d'obtenir davantage de contrôle et de cohérence. Transformer l'expérimentation en outil de design : évaluer les résultats du point de vue du créatif et chercher à rendre les technologies développées simples, fluides et contrôlables, en masquant autant que possible leur complexité technique. Cette démarche s'accompagnera naturellement d'une veille active de l'écosystème open source : découvrir de nouveaux modèles, méthodes, repositories et outils, évaluer leur potentiel et identifier les briques susceptibles d'améliorer ou de faire évoluer les workflows développés. Profil Profil recherché : un profil explorateur École d'ingénieur, d'informatique, école de design ou formation hybride (design computationnel, creative coding...) : votre curiosité, votre capacité à expérimenter et vos projets personnels comptent autant que votre diplôme. Culture Generative AI & open source : vous êtes familier·ère de ComfyUI, Hugging Face, GitHub, Stable Diffusion/Qwen et de technologies comme ControlNet, LoRA, VLM/LLM. Vous aimez explorer de nouveaux outils et comprendre comment les combiner. Prototypage : Python est ici un outil d'exploration et de création. Vous savez naviguer dans un repository, adapter du code existant, connecter des APIs et construire rapidement une expérimentation avec des outils comme Diffusers, PyTorch ou OpenCV. Culture visuelle et outils créatifs : vous avez une sensibilité à l'image, au dessin, aux proportions, aux volumes, à la perspective et à la 3D. Une pratique de Photoshop, du sketch numérique, de la 3D ou d'autres outils de création visuelle constitue un vrai plus. Intérêt pour le design automobile : vous êtes curieux·se des problématiques propres au car design et comprenez que le respect d'une intention, d'une géométrie ou d'un geste créatif peut être plus important qu'un résultat simplement spectaculaire. État d'esprit : autonome, curieux·se et analytique, vous aimez expérimenter, comparer plusieurs approches et vous demander : « Cette technologie a été conçue pour cela… mais que pourrait-on en faire d'autre ? » Comment candidater ? Au-delà du CV, nous serons attentifs aux projets et expérimentations qui témoignent de votre curiosité et de votre capacité à explorer par vous-même : workflows ComfyUI, entraînements LoRA, prototypes Python, contributions ou explorations GitHub, expérimentations 3D, projets mêlant IA et création, détournements ou assemblages de technologies open source. Quelques exemples accompagnés d'une courte présentation de votre démarche, des choix techniques effectués et des résultats obtenus permettront de mieux apprécier votre profil. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Diverse teams will allow us to better meet the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future. Our team is passionate about technology, player experience, and responsible gaming. We work in a fast-paced, international environment where creativity and collaboration drive our products forward. We are committed to operating with integrity, protecting our players, and promoting safe and responsible play. About the Role We're looking for an AI Engineer specialized in building production-grade agentic systems on Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK. This is a builder role, not a prompting role: you'll design multi-agent architectures, custom tools, and deterministic guardrails that turn LLMs into reliable automation for real business workflows. Responsibilities Design and orchestrate multi-agent architectures : decompose complex workflows into isolated subagents (explore, verify, write), each with its own context, reporting only conclusions to the orchestrator Parallelize agent work while protecting the main agent's context window from pollution Design and build custom tools (MCP servers, functions, APIs): define what to expose, at what granularity, with model-readable descriptions and context-efficient outputs Iterate on tool ergonomics based on observed agent behavior — diagnose why an agent fails or loops, and fix it at the tool/architecture level Implement context management strategies: summarization, delegation, persistent memory (CLAUDE.md, knowledge files) Build deterministic guardrails with hooks (pre/post-command validation, logging, output checks) Script the glue: automation in Python/Bash/Node around agentic pipelines Must-Have Requirements Hands-on experience with Claude Code and/or Claude Agent SDK in real projects (not tutorials) Proven tool design experience: you've built MCP servers or custom tool integrations and can show them Demonstrated subagent/multi-agent orchestration : you can explain how you split tasks, isolated contexts, and merged results Strong scripting skills: Python, Bash, Node Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, testing, CI/CD, API design Fluent English (written and spoken) Based in Malta or Europe, Fully Remote Nice to Have Published MCP servers, Claude Code plugins, or skills (public repos are your CV) Experience with hooks and deterministic guardrails around LLM systems Familiarity with evals and benchmarking of agent performance Experience integrating agents with business tools (Slack, CRM, ticketing, databases) How We'll Evaluate You Live exercise : a real automation task in Claude Code (1–2h, screen share) — architecture decisions matter more than speed. Deep-dive interview: walk us through an agent you built — what tools you gave it, how you managed context on long tasks, what guardrails you set.

Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. 8. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. 9. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. 10. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 11. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. 12. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: 1. In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: 2. Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences. 3. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. 4. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. 5. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating". 6. Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. 7. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. 8. Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. 9. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience 1. items.desc:
Mission 
 We are offering a challenging position as a full-time (100%) PhD Student in the Laloui Group at EPFL inLausanne. The group brings expertise in geomaterials and their mechanical behaviour to research at theinterface of material science and engineering applications.
 You will work on the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)-funded project “DFabuLis: Digital FabricationUsing Living Systems”, conducted in collaboration between Dr. Dimitrios Terzis, Senior Scientist in the LalouiGroup at EPFL, and co-PI Prof. Benjamin Dillenburger of the Chair of Digital Building Technologies at ETHZurich. The project investigates how biologically driven mineralization can transform demolition and excavationmaterials into materials suitable for digital fabrication under ambient conditions.
 Digital fabrication methods, including extrusion 3D printing and robotic spraying, offer opportunities to controlmaterial placement and curing, create complex geometries and reduce material consumption. Integratingbiomineralization into pumpable, extrudable and sprayable granular materials remains largely unexplored. ThisPhD will investigate the coupled biogeochemical, rheological and mechanical mechanisms governing particledeposition, mineral precipitation and hardening.
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:
 Take full responsibility for your dissertation and the progress of your research.
 Conduct research in close collaboration with project partners at EPFL and ETH Zurich and, whereapplicable, industry partners.
 Design and execute experiments, and analyze and interpret experimental results.
 Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals and present your findings at internationalconferences.
 Participate in teaching and supervise student projects.
 More specifically, within this project, you will:
 Investigate the rheology and processability of granular materials, including yield stress, plastic viscosity,thixotropy, water content, ageing and particle interactions.
 Study microbial activity and biologically driven mineral precipitation, and determine how evolving mineralphases affect mechanical hardening and material performance.
 Characterize the coupling between biogeochemical reactions, rheological properties and mechanicalbehaviour over space and time.
 Connect experimental findings to extrusion 3D printing and robotic spraying in collaboration with thedigital fabrication team at ETH Zurich.
 Profile 
 An MSc degree in Civil Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Chemical Engineering or aclosely related discipline.
 A background in mechanics and the strength of solid materials, or materials science applied to the builtenvironment, is particularly welcome.
 Experience in rheology, granular or cementitious materials, experimental mechanics, materialcharacterization, geomechanics, mineralogy, or organic and inorganic chemistry is an advantage.Expertise across all these fields is neither expected nor required.
 Interest in experimental and interdisciplinary research, and in translating fundamental physical andchemical understanding into new construction technologies.
 Good communication skills and willingness to work as part of a team across disciplines and institutions.
 Enthusiasm, scientific curiosity, eagerness to learn, good organizational skills and rigor in experimentalwork.
 A high level of motivation for academic research.
 Fluency in English is essential.
 We offer 
 At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled tosucceed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research andinnovation. We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, weaim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference.
 Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiativespromoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program ofcultural, sports and community activities throughout the year.
 Read about our employment conditions and employee benefits.
 Informations

items.desc:
Nevral Forensics Intelligence (NFI) | Research Partner Program | REMOTE (worldwide)
NFI is a digital forensics platform for laboratories that keep evidence on their own premises, under their own law. I am the founder. We are building, from first principles, a lawful device-access capability for locked devices, delivered to licensed laboratories only through signed Capability Packs. The software enforces the legal gate itself: a locked-tier extraction is refused unless the operator first records a court-order authorization, bound to the case and the device in a signed, hash-chained record, before any method runs.
Stated plainly: this program starts from zero proven capability, and our public claims stay "no unlocking" until a method is proven. Research runs only on devices the researcher or the company owns.
Instead of a job posting, this is a research exchange. Independent researchers and laboratories who join as research partners receive the NFI platform at no charge while they are active partners, plus Academy access. In return, partners share the device-access research they produce on owned devices: methods, findings, and limits. We validate shared research on our own reference devices to a fixed proof standard, write proven methods into our coverage matrix with the contributor credited, and only then productize them into Capability Packs. Unproven research ships nowhere.
The conditions are the same ones our own team works under, and they do not bend: owned devices only; the court-order gate on every locked-tier extraction; responsible disclosure; and plain disqualifiers, because they are continuing conditions of partnership: no history of selling exploits to brokers for offensive use, no involvement in the stolen-data trade, no work on devices the program does not own.
The bar is evidence, not polish: published vulnerability research on mobile platforms, CVE credits or equivalent credited disclosures, or a verifiable laboratory record. The research tracks are MediaTek, Unisoc, Qualcomm, Apple, Samsung, and passcode recovery, weighted toward the devices our markets actually seize.
Apply: email info@nevrallab.com with links to your published research and your CVE credits, or your laboratory's equivalent record. That evidence is the application.

items.desc: Associated with 2 categories Associated with 2 categories See allSee all Stage-Machine Learning pour la planification proactive des ressources d'un service cloud F/H Associated with 2 categories Data & AI IT & Engineering 44-46 Avenue de la République, 92320 CHATILLON Location: CHÂTILLON,FRANCE 2026-55352 Internship Not Specified Orange SA Publication date : Nov 10, 2026, 6:36PM Contract duration : 6 months Dans ce stage, nous nous intéresserons au «capacity planning » d’un service cloud, qui consiste à anticiper, de manière proactive, les ressources nécessaires à son bon fonctionnement. L’activation des ressources n’étant pas instantanée, une décision trop tardive peut dégrader la qualité de service ; à l’inverse, une réservation excessive augmente les dépenses. S’ajoutent les bénéfices d’une réservation anticipée et les coûts liés aux modifications successives d’un plan de capacités. Le problème sera donc abordé dans une perspective « cost-sensitive » : prendre des décisions qui minimisent l’ensemble des coûts opérationnels, et non les seules erreurs de prévision. Dans le prolongement de nos travaux sur la classification précoce de séries temporelles, nous étudierons une architecture de prise de décision séquentielle inspirée des modèles à espace d’états. Les décisions s’appuieront sur une représentation évolutive du système, tenant compte: (i) des observations disponibles de charge, (ii) de l’incertitude sur la charge future et (iii) des engagements déjà pris pour la réservation de capacités futures. À mesure que de nouvelles informations arrivent, le plan de capacités pourra être conservé ou révisé. L’apprentissage par renforcement fera notamment partie de l’architecture cible, et sera exploré pour tenir compte des conséquences à long terme des décisions. Le stage débutera par un état de l’art sur l’autoscaling prédictif, la prévision probabiliste et la décision séquentielle. Il se poursuivra par le développement d’un simulateur à la fois de données et de modèles synthétiques de prévision probabiliste. L’architecture cible sera ensuite prototypée, permettant la mise au point de différentes stratégies de décision séquentielle et d’apprentissage en ligne. Notamment, la comparaison entre une stratégie myope, minimisant le coût attendu à «t+1», et une politique apprise par renforcement dans le but de minimiser les coûts à long terme fera partie des expérimentations. Enfin, des études d’ablation permettront d’évaluer: (i) l’apport des informations utilisées en entrée de la politique de décision; (ii) l’intérêt de la non-myopie lorsque les coûts de révision sont importants; (iii) la robustesse de l’approche face à une variété d’hypothèses sur les délais d’activation. Ces expérimentations constitueront une première étape scientifique vers une thèse CIFRE. __PRESENT BAC + 5, Master informatique et/ou statistiques ou école d’ingénieur. Fort intérêt pour la recherche et volonté affirmée de poursuivre en thèse CIFRE. Compétences : maîtrise de Python et de Scikit-learn, bonnes bases en probabilités, statistiques et apprentissage statistique. Une première expérience en séries temporelles ou en apprentissage par renforcement serait appréciée __PRESENT Vous serez accueilli au sein d’une équipe composée de chercheurs en Machine Learning et de Data Scientists dans une direction d’innovation. Ce stage est conçu comme une première étape vers une thèse CIFRE, sous réserve des validations nécessaires. __PRESENT Vous rejoindrez l'équipe ADIS (AI & Data Innovation Services) au sein du département AI Factory, le pôle d'expertise et d'innovation en Intelligence Artificielle d'Orange, situé au cœur de l'écosystème de recherche et d’innovation d'Orange Gardens. Notre mission est d'explorer les technologies de pointe, de développer des preuves de concept à forte valeur ajoutée et de construire les briques logicielles qui seront déployées dans les différentes entités du Groupe. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrerez une équipe dynamique et passionnée, où vous collaborerez avec des experts en data, software, cloud et architecture. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement qui encourage la prise d'initiative, la montée en compétences et la contribution à des projets stratégiques, tout en bénéficiant de l'envergure d'un leader mondial des télécommunications. __PRESENT Desired start date : Mar 01, 2027, 12:00AM At Orange, only your skills matter. Regardless of your age, gender, background, origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, or appearance, we actively encourage diversity within our teams, as it is a collective strength and a driver of innovation. items.desc: Zensai’s AI Office leads the company’s AI Roadmap, focusing on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that solve shared business challenges and create value across Zensai. As our AI Solution Developer , you will turn the priorities in our AI Roadmap into reliable, well-designed solutions that people actually use. You will work directly with teams across the business to understand their needs, design the right solution, build and refine it, and take it all the way into production and adoption. The AI Office is led by Maria, our VP of AI Office. You will work closely with the rest of the team and take ownership of AI projects from design and development through to successful implementation. As a Microsoft partner, we use the Microsoft ecosystem as the foundation for our solutions wherever it makes sense, rather than introducing new platforms unnecessarily. One of your first projects could involve connecting customer emails, calls and support interactions to help our commercial teams identify customer risks, sentiment and growth opportunities earlier. Other projects will involve AI agents, intelligent workflows, internal tools and integrations across our business systems. What you’ll be doing Work directly with teams across Zensai to understand how they operate, uncover the real problem and define what a useful outcome looks like Design, build and deploy AI agents, AI-assisted workflows and intelligent automation solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem Connect systems and data through APIs, Model Context Protocol, integrations and data transformations Decide where AI creates value, where deterministic logic is more appropriate and how to balance technical possibilities with business needs Monitor solutions after deployment, handling failures, performance, cost and continuous improvement to keep them reliable and useful This is not a role focused primarily on model experimentation or AI research. It is for someone who enjoys solving business problems and building solutions that work reliably in production. What you bring Experience building and deploying software solutions that solve real business problems, with confidence working in Python Hands-on experience with large language models, AI-powered workflows, agent-based solutions and intelligent automation Experience connecting systems through APIs, Model Context Protocol, integrations and data transformation Solid hands-on experience within the Microsoft ecosystem, particularly Azure, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft Foundry or Foundry IQ Strong business understanding and clear communication: you can turn messy problems into practical solutions, explain complex technology to non-technical colleagues and take ownership through to production Meet the AI Office The AI Office works across Zensai and sits close to our CEO, reflecting the importance of AI to the company’s direction. The team brings together technical development, business enablement and implementation to help promising ideas become solutions that deliver real results. We are still establishing some of our processes and ways of working. You will have experienced colleagues to collaborate with and challenge, while also having the freedom to structure your own projects and influence how the team delivers solutions. The team is based across Copenhagen and Aarhus. This role is based in Copenhagen, with occasional travel to Aarhus so we can work and spend time together as one team.
