Et, aussi, là où les réponses sont à inventer ou à réinventer : lutte anti-drones, cybersécurité Notre esprit Tech et pragmatique, ainsi que notre agilité d’ETI nous permettent d’allier proximité, engagement, agilité et innovation, pour diffuser notre culture à tous les niveaux : dans la relation client, dans le mode de management interne, dans notre engagement social et environnemental… Nous accordons une importance particulière au développement professionnel de nos collaborateurs. Chez CS GROUP, chaque employé bénéficie d'un accompagnement personnalisé pour construire sa carrière, avec des opportunités d'évolution. Nous favorisons la mobilité, la formation continue et encourageons l'innovation à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. Notre culture d'entreprise est fondée sur l'engagement, la proximité et l'excellence technique, offrant à chacun la possibilité de s'épanouir dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant. Nous sommes engagés à vos côtés, au service de votre épanouissement professionnel ! Pour plus d’information, retrouvez-nous sur LinkedIin, Facebook & Instagram ou visitez https://www.csgroup.eu/fr/ \n\n Description de l'entreprise CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l’intégration et l’exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l’énergie, l’industrie, le transport, l’aéronautique et la cybersécurité. Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Protéger les territoires, anticiper les menaces. Forte de plus de 840 collaborateurs répartis sur l’ensemble du territoire, elle conçoit des systèmes critiques pour l’armée et l’aviation civile. Nos équipes interviennent sur des projets à haute valeur ajoutée : liaisons de données tactiques, lutte anti-drones, surveillance maritime, simulation et entraînement, sûreté aérienne. Grâce à notre expertise et à notre engagement dans des programmes internationaux, nous contribuons activement à la sécurité des territoires. Rejoindre cette Business Unit, c’est contribuer à la protection des citoyens au sein d’un collectif engagé. items.desc: Do you want to shape the future of plastics processing intelligent automation? Are you an expert in intelligent automation and data processing and ready to turn ideas into impact and grow with us? VTT might be just the place for you. VTT is one of the leading applied research organizations in Europe. What unites us are curiosity, a passion for learning, and a purpose: to solve the biggest challenges of our time and turn them into sustainable growth and well-being. Our cross-disciplinary community of over 2000 brilliant minds from 55+ different nationalities focus on creating impact through science-based innovation. Get to know us further by exploring VTT's tech & infra . We are now looking for Senior Scientist focusing on intelligent automation to join our materials processing and circular solutions team. In this role, you will strengthen our capabilities in process automation, data acquisition, and data-driven process control for plastics processing and recycling. You will work hands-on with pilot-scale equipment, particularly extrusion and plastics pre-treatment processes, developing solutions that connect process and sensor data with automation, control and online analytics. You will apply data-driven and machine-learning methods to process and sensor data, for example to derive online quality metrics and enable smarter process control. Your work will initially focus on extrusion-based process control and the automation and digitalization of plastics pre-treatment, including washing and sorting. You will also contribute to connecting our laboratory and pilot-scale equipment and their data to broader data architectures. Depending on your interests, there will be opportunities to develop new research directions beyond these initial applications. "We have a healthy work culture where you can be yourself, share your views, and improve things without fear of making mistakes - that’s what makes the work truly meaningful. " -Your new Team Leader Marjaana Mussalo- Our team is located in VTT’s Industrial Chemistry research area and focuses on the development of thermoplastic materials, their processing, and sensor-, spectroscopy- and software-enabled process control methods. Our target is to advance sustainable thermoplastic materials and products with high performance and increased circularity. We have unique pilot facilities for thermoplastic compounding, pre-industrial converting, and material characterization. In addition to these, we have unique pilot opportunities for identifying, sorting, washing and advanced mechanical recycling of plastic waste. The Material Processing and Circular Solutions team works in close collaboration with our customers and other research teams at VTT with business development and customer-oriented approach. The position is located in Tampere. As Senior Scientist, you will: work very closely with process automation and data flows. programme and implement the process automation yourself. process and analyze research data using appropriate digital tools (e.g. MATLAB, Python, R or equivalent). apply your digitalisation experience in plastics processing and/or plastics recycling build professional networks and act as a thought leader in your area of expertise. Who we are looking for: You have a Master of Science degree in a relevant field or equivalent science experience. A doctoral degree is considered as an asset. You have strong expertise and experience in intelligent automation and data processing. For example experience with OPC-UA and programming in Python or MATLAB is especially relevant. You are interested in taking forward interdisciplinary transition of plastics processing towards data driven, model-based, machine learning supported and AI-ready system You have good communication skills in English and ability to build high value research collaboration in the area It’s an advantage if you also have some of the following: Experience with PLC systems, Beckhoff/TwinCAT, Siemens automation, databases, or related industrial data technologies Experience in plastics processing and/or plastics recycling Experience with EU and Business Finland projects Applied expertise in sensor technologies As a person, we hope that you are: Innovative, flexible and adaptable Proactive, efficient, solution-oriented and independent Good at working under pressure A team player with good collaboration skills. With VTT, you’ll enjoy: Visionary work in technology. Fascinating projects, excellent research environment. Great career opportunities, superb colleagues. Support for your well-being. Apply now and join our community of brilliant minds! Please send your CV and answer the short pre-screening questions together with your salary request via our recruitment system as soon as possible but at the latest by 25 November 2026. We will process applications as they come in and fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate. A security clearance procedure may be conducted during the recruitment …

items.desc: Campaign Automation Specialist About our Team Elsevier is a global provider of science and health information, serving more than 30 million scientists, students, and health and information professionals worldwide. Headquartered in Amsterdam, we employ more than 7,000 people across 24 countries and provide information and tools that help customers advance science and health, make critical decisions, improve productivity, and achieve better outcomes. Our Science, Technology and Medical (STM) Journals division manages an extensive portfolio of high-impact scientific journals, with responsibility for their reputation among authors and the quality of published content. More than 80 marketing professionals worldwide collaborate across the organisation to identify opportunities and deliver effective marketing strategies. Within STM Journals, the Email Marketing Operations team supports the set-up and deployment of data-driven email campaigns, primarily for content acquisition and journal author enablement, helping accelerate highly cited open access and subscription growth. The global team of ten covers email production and data management. About the Role We are seeking a Campaign Automation Specialist to support the STM Journals marketing organisation with the set-up and deployment of data-driven email campaigns. The role focuses mainly on content acquisition for Gold Open Access and hybrid journals and includes curating high volumes of target audience data from internal sources. You will improve operational efficiency by developing optimal data workflows and introducing automation where possible. Using a test-and-learn approach, you will continuously refine workflows in line with business objectives. The role reports directly to the Head of Campaign Management in STM Journal Marketing. Responsibilities Analyse and query large datasets using SQL/Python and tools such as AWS Athena, Knime and DBeaver. Develop scalable, reproducible workflows for data extraction, processing, ETL and email campaign segmentation. Partner with campaign owners to translate business objectives into technical requirements and effective audience segmentation strategies. Build and maintain target/content data and automated workflows for recurring STM Journals email campaigns. Set up, test and deploy email campaigns, including appropriate tracking for web traffic and attribution reporting. Develop strong knowledge of core databases and key STM Journals marketing data sources, advising marketers on optimal segmentation and data quality. Interpret complex data and present clear, concise insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Manage incoming campaign requests, assess production readiness and collaborate with analytics colleagues to improve shared knowledge and processes. Requirements University degree or equivalent in data analytics, marketing or a related discipline, with at least a few years experience in an analyst or marketing operations role. Experience in data-driven marketing, customer segmentation and handling large datasets, with a basic understanding of data protection standards. Proficiency with data and analytics tools such as Excel, Knime and Tableau. Experience building and executing email campaign workflows using a major deployment platform such as Salesforce or Adobe Campaign. Working knowledge of email and web analytics, A/B testing principles, and email/web technologies across browsers and platforms. Programming/coding skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL and Python. Strong organisation, prioritisation, problem-solving and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and multiple priorities. Strong written and verbal communication skills, stakeholder management capability, and an interest in learning new marketing technologies, tools and processes. What We Offer Competitive salary and flexible/hybrid working arrangements. Additional benefits, including memberships to Elsevier’s publications and discounts on books. Access to various training, coaching, and e-learning modules for long-term career development. Engagement in social responsibility programs that leverage knowledge and strengths to improve education, science, healthcare, and environmental sustainability. Work in a Way That Works for You We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals. Working Pattern Working flexible hours – flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. items.desc: Business Controller – iLottery Location: Krakow, Poland Reports to: VP Group Finance - EMEA At the heart of our organisation is a commitment to delivering innovative, high-quality outcomes that create lasting value for our customers and partners. We foster a collaborative culture grounded in accountability, continuous improvement, and partnership—core to how we operate and succeed. As we continue to evolve our global finance operating model, controllership is increasingly focused on ownership, insight, and business partnership , rather than transactional execution. Within this model, centralised Accounting Operations teams deliver scalable, standardised processes, while Business Controllers act as senior finance leaders accountable for financial outcomes, balance sheet integrity, and commercial insight . This role represents a pivotal opportunity to be the Business Controller for our Lotteries business, which is a key growth driver for Aristocrat, with complex multi-entity operations. You will manage the entire balance sheet and collaborate closely with senior colleagues to drive financial performance, oversee risk, and aid decision-making. You will be at the intersection of finance operations and commercial finance. You will bring challenge, insight, and judgement. You will draw on a centralised Accounting Operations team for transactional and close execution. For a finance leader who thrives in dynamic environments and enjoys combining technical depth with commercial thinking, this is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping a modern, forward-looking controllership function. What You'll Do Own the integrity, quality, and performance of the balance sheet for the Lotteries business. Provide end-to-end oversight of balance sheet movements, risks, and underlying drivers, including receivables collections. Review and challenge reconciliations, ensuring issues are identified, understood, and resolved. Lead month-end close review, including financial commentary, variance analysis, and business sign-off. Apply financial judgement across accruals, provisions, revenue recognition, joint venture accounting and complex transactions. Partner with senior team members to provide insight, challenge, and support strategic decision-making. Translate financial outcomes into clear insights, highlighting risks, opportunities, and performance drivers. Ensure alignment with accounting policies, internal controls, and governance requirements. Identify and proactively manage financial and balance sheet risks and exposures. Collaborate with D365 Accounting Operations and Revenue and Reconciliation teams to direct priorities and ensure high-quality outputs. Monitor important measures including working capital, balance sheet efficiency, and forecast accuracy. Drive continuous improvement through enhanced reporting, insight, and automation of finance processes. What We're Looking For Significant experience in controllership, finance business partnering, or senior accounting roles within a multinational organisation. Strong expertise in balance sheet management, financial accounting, and governance. Proven ability to apply financial judgement and provide commercial insight in complex environments. Experience working within centralised or shared service finance models. Strong knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting requirements. Proven stakeholder management and influencing capability across finance and business leadership. Experience with ERP platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) and close/reporting tools (e.g., BlackLine, IBM Planning Analytics). Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Continuous improvement approach with a focus on simplification, standardisation, and automation. Experience in automating processes with AI tools is highly advantageous. Degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; CPA, CA, ACCA or equivalent required. Why Aristocrat? Aristocrat is a world leader in gaming content and technology, and a top-tier publisher of free-to-play mobile games. Aristocrat has three operating business units, spanning regulated land-based gaming (Aristocrat Gaming), social casino (Product Madness), and regulated online real-money gaming (Aristocrat Interactive). Our team of over 7,300 employees worldwide is united by our company's mission to bring joy to life through the power of play. We deliver great performance for our B2B customers and bring joy to the lives of the millions of people who love to play our casino and mobile games. And while we focus on fun, we never forget our responsibilities. We strive to lead the way in responsible gameplay, and to lift the bar in company governance, employee wellbeing and sustainability. We’re a diverse business united by shared values and an inspiring mission to bring joy to life through the power of play. items.desc: Careers Technicians - Engineers Research Assistant - NanoElectrocatalysis and Sustainable Chemistry Back Apply Download PDF As a flagship research center in nanoscience and nanotechnology, our mission is to open and explore new frontiers of knowledge at the nanoscale and bring value to society in the form of new understanding, capabilities, and innovation, while inspiring and providing broad training to the next generations of researchers. Our values are Commitment, Collaboration and Transformation. Our research lines focus on the newly discovered physical and chemical properties that arise from the behaviour of matter at the nanoscale. ICN2 has been awarded the Severo Ochoa Center of Excellence distinction for three consecutive periods (2014-2018, 2018-2022 and 2023-2026). ICN2 comprises 20 Research Groups, 7 Technical Development and Support Units and Facilities, and 2 Research Platforms, covering different areas of nanoscience and nanotechnology. Job Title: Research Assistant Department: NanoElectrocatalysis and Sustainable Chemistry Description of Group/Project: The NanoElectrocatalysis and Sustainable Chemistry Group combines electrochemistry, materials science, and advanced in situ characterisation techniques to understand the fundamental processes governing electrocatalytic reactions and to develop novel materials for sustainable energy conversion and chemical production. The group focuses on elucidating the relationship between the structure, properties, and catalytic performance of electrocatalytic materials, with particular emphasis on understanding electrochemical interfaces and reaction mechanisms under operating conditions. We offer a stimulating working environment within an interdisciplinary and international research community. The Research Assistant will contribute to ongoing research activities focused on the in situ characterisation of electrocatalysts and electrochemical interfaces involved in the electrocatalytic reduction of nitrate and carbon dioxide. Main Tasks and responsibilities: The successful candidate will contribute to the experimental investigation of electrocatalysts and electrochemical interfaces for the electrocatalytic reduction of nitrate and carbon dioxide. The main tasks and responsibilities will include: Performing the in situ and operando characterisation of electrocatalytic materials and electrochemical interfaces using scanning electrochemical microscopy and vibrational spectroscopy. Conducting electrochemical experiments to investigate the activity, selectivity and behaviour of electrocatalysts during nitrate and carbon dioxide reduction reactions. Processing, analysing and interpreting experimental data, and contributing to the preparation of scientific reports, presentations and manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals. Contributing to the maintenance, optimisation and development of experimental setups and characterisation methodologies. Collaborating with researchers within the group and external research institutions and participating in scientific meetings and research discussions. Requirements: Education: Master's degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, nanoscience and nanotechnology, materials science, physics, or related areas with an academic level equivalent. Candidates currently pursuing doctoral studies in a relevant field will also be considered. Knowledge: Strong background in electrochemistry and electrochemical processes. Knowledge of electrocatalysis and electrochemical energy conversion. Knowledge of electrochemical scanning probe techniques for the characterisation of electrochemical reactions. Professional Experience: Previous laboratory experience in electrochemical experimentation and characterisation of electrocatalytic materials. Experience with electrochemical techniques and instrumentation, including the development and optimisation of experimental protocols. Experience in in situ or operando characterisation techniques, particularly scanning electrochemical microscopy and vibrational spectroscopy, will be highly valued. Experience in experimental data processing, analysis and interpretation. Relevant publications within electrochemistry are desirable. Personal Competences: Integrity, perseverance and resilience, innovation, teamwork and communication skills. Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English. Summary of conditions: Full-time work (37,5h/week). Contract Length: Temporary. Location: Bellaterra (Barcelona). Salary will depend on qualifications and demonstrated experience. Support for relocation issues. Life Insurance. Work-Life Balance and Flexibility with flexible work schedules. 28 holidays per year. Flexible compensation plan: tax advantages for contracting some products (health insurance, childcare, training, among others) Training activities: languages, mentoring programme, wellbeing programme. items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated post-doctoral fellow to join the Retrovirology and Clinical Studies Lab at IrsiCaixa as part of the IGTP, all located at Biomedical Campus Can Ruti in Badalona (Barcelona). The selected candidate will support ongoing scientific projects in a lab with a large trajectory in the study of infectious diseases. She/he will assist in the development of strategies for HIV eradication that will require the implementation of new molecular and cell culture techniques in the team. Besides, the candidate will conduct experiments in animal models to investigate biodistribution and viral inhibition of therapeutic agents, what will require the work in Biosafety level 3 (BSL-3) facilities. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES The tasks to be carried out are related to the support of the current research in the team: Technical activities: The persons should be able to coordinate and perform experiments related to cell culture, molecular biology, sample and blood processing, flow cytometry, ddPCR, use of BSL-2 and BSL-3 facilities, etc. Complementary activities: Lab organization, protocol development, analysis of the results of the different technologies, results reporting, etc. Maintenance activities: Support periodic maintenance of the lab organization and coordination of the samples collected by the group. Training activities: attendance to the group meetings and open to learn of the research topic and improve the skills. Open to present the results in meetings. Coordinating experiments and cohorts from the group and updating databases. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE PhD Biology or a related discipline. Experience with cellular and molecular biology techniques in HIV field. Experience in flow cytometry and primary cell cultures in HIV field. Certificate and experience working with animal models will be valued. English and Spanish language skills will be required. Experience in supporting scientific teams. Good organizational skills: tracking project data and report analysis results. Ability to work in a dynamic and international environment with good interpersonal skills. Excellent written and oral communication skills. International experience will be valued. WHAT WE OFFER Permanent contract (Ley de la ciencia 14/2011). Full-time working schedule. Date of incorporation: estimated start date: December 1st, 2026 Gross annual remuneration inherent to the square objected to this call, will be fixed based on the experience provided and the skills of the candidate, distributed in 12 payments. Flexible payment (childminding vouchers). 23 days holiday and 5 days for personal matters. Training capsules by the company. Be part of an excellent multidisciplinary research centre with the HRS4R badge. Location on the Can Ruti Campus, a first-class translational research environment in the Barcelona area, in a very stimulating scientific environment. The IGTP offers a supportive, friendly and collaborative ecosystem to promote professional development and help you achieve your research goals. items.desc: Who we are Mine Environment Management (MEM) is an award-winning specialist geoscience and environmental engineering consultancy headquartered in Wales, UK. In April, MEM joined Ecology Group, a growing group of ecological and environmental consultancies. This partnership brings continued investment in technology, professional development and long-term growth, while allowing MEM to retain the culture we have built since 2018: a highly specialised and motivated technical team working in a supportive, relaxed environment. As part of MEM, you will also have opportunities to collaborate with a wider network of specialists across the Group and further develop your expertise. We provide practical, commercially focused solutions for the global mining industry across the full mine life cycle, from planning and operations through to closure and regeneration. MEM was founded to apply sound scientific principles to the development of innovative solutions for managing mining environments and mine waste. Our team is currently delivering a range of innovative commercial and research projects internationally, often in partnership with specialist UK technical companies and universities. These projects span carbon sequestration, mine water quality assessment and treatment, tailings facility management, operational mine waste management and mine closure planning. The opportunity We are looking for an Environmental Geochemist who has the skill to turn complex laboratory results into clear technical reports. You will combine field-based geoscience expertise with geochemical modelling using specialised software. You will have the ability to process large datasets using statistical software or programming. We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience on hydrogeological projects where you have demonstrated your understanding of how rock types and structure in an area impact on groundwater occurrence and movement. The role is mainly desk based but also has the opportunity for international site work. Innovation is at the core of what we do. We boast a strong, proven track record in R&D. To support your professional growth, our leadership team actively encourages and sponsors our geoscientists to author scientific papers and present their findings at major global conferences. This is a hybrid role and can be based at our North Wales headquarters in Denbigh, our Research Hub in Cardiff or our international office in Sweden. There may also be opportunities to work from other Ecology Group offices across the UK. Key responsibilities Predictive geochemical modelling: Build and run advanced thermodynamic models to predict water quality from mine waste storage facilities and pit lakes. Systems and water balance simulation: Develop dynamic, risk-based models for water management and contaminant transport across full mine life cycles. Data pipeline automation: Write and maintain scripts that automate data workflows, connect modelling software and process large geological, climate and water datasets. Acid and metalliferous drainage: Plan and manage site investigations and environmental geochemistry risk assessments. Operational planning: Review geochemical drill-hole assay databases, block models and waste schedules to develop operational waste placement concepts and facility cover systems. Research, development and publications: Initiate and manage research and development projects including those relating to mine water treatment, with opportunities to prepare scientific papers and conference presentations. About you You will bring strong geological insight, confidence with computational tools and relevant post-graduate industry experience. We value competence, initiative and a passion for geoscience. You will hold at least a BSc in a geoscience-related discipline and have a minimum of three years’ post-graduate technical experience, ideally within a mining consultancy. Key skills Problem-solving: A strong, structured approach to technical challenges, including the ability to define the work required while accounting for uncertainty and risk. Independence: The initiative and self-management needed to deliver high-quality projects within agreed timescales. Communication: Strong formal and informal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex scientific and computational concepts clearly to a range of stakeholders. Technical writing: Excellent report-writing and technical proposal development skills. Required technical experience Mining geochemistry: Practical experience of mine waste characterisation studies, laboratory test-work programme design and waste storage facility design. items.desc: Enterprise Architect Strategic Leadership in Enterprise Architecture Overview Springer Nature (SN) is seeking to hire an Enterprise Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture team. As a key member of the team, you will provide thought leadership, strategic direction, and architectural expertise to ensure that our enterprise architecture principles, frameworks, and practices align with the organisation's overall business strategy. You will work across both business and technology domains, ensuring that architecture practices and decisions drive business transformation, enable scalability, and align with industry best practices. This role is pivotal in fostering a consensus-driven, collaborative environment, particularly in organisations with a low architecture mandate. As an Enterprise Architect, you will work closely with senior leaders, key stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to build the foundations for a robust and future-proof architecture. Your primary focus will be on establishing architecture frameworks, developing architectural principles, and leading cultural change within the organisation. In this role, you will: Work closely with the Chief Architect and other senior stakeholders to shape and drive the enterprise architecture strategy. Lead the development, governance, and application of architecture principles and standards across the organisation, ensuring alignment with business objectives and emerging technology trends. Support business and technical teams in defining and implementing architecture blueprints and metamodels. Champion the adoption of architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, or similar, and drive the alignment of these frameworks with business goals and strategies. Collaborate with leaders across the organisation to ensure the implementation of enterprise-wide architectural decisions. Act as a change agent to foster a culture of architecture in a consensus-driven decision-making environment, with a focus on building collaboration across technical and business teams. Provide strategic guidance on emerging technologies, platform architectures, and industry trends that can support and enhance business outcomes. What You Will Be Doing Defining and Implementing Architecture Frameworks Develop and promote enterprise architecture frameworks, principles, and standards that align with Springer Nature’s long-term strategic vision. Lead the development of business capability models and enterprise-wide metamodels to create a clear, consistent view of the organisation's architecture. Support the enterprise-wide adoption of architectural governance practices and work with stakeholders to ensure compliance with architectural standards. Supporting Strategic Business Change Work with senior stakeholders to identify business transformation opportunities where enterprise architecture can play a pivotal role in enabling change. Lead the development of architecture roadmaps to guide the organisation’s journey from its current state to future architectural visions. Collaborate with business leaders and product owners to ensure that architecture decisions are aligned with strategic business objectives. Cultural Change and Consensus Building Lead initiatives to improve architectural maturity within the organisation, especially in a consensus-driven, low-mandate environment. Foster a culture of architecture within the organisation by providing guidance and facilitating workshops that promote understanding and buy-in from all stakeholders. Encourage collaborative decision-making processes that consider both technical and business perspectives. Guiding Enterprise Architecture Practices Define and maintain a set of architecture principles that guide design and decision-making across the business. Work with teams across the organisation to ensure that solutions align with both business requirements and architectural standards. Provide guidance and oversight for enterprise architecture activities, ensuring compliance with agreed practices. Your Experience You have a strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks, principles, and metamodels. You are experienced in working in organisations with a low architecture mandate and a consensus-driven decision-making culture. You have been exposed to multiple technology environments and understand the challenges of aligning architecture with evolving business needs. You have practical experience in defining and implementing architecture blueprints and roadmaps. You have experience with industry-recognised architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, or similar. You are skilled in developing and communicating architectural principles, standards, and frameworks. Your Capabilities and Competencies You are a thought leader in enterprise architecture with the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional teams. The role combines strong analytical capability with a well-developed instinct for policy relevance: turning research questions into deliverable projects and turning findings into clear conclusions that decision-makers can use. We are recruiting for up to 4 roles under this advert, split between the Data & Empirical Research pillar, and the Modelling & Scenarios pillar. Please make clear which pillar you are most interested in. Job description The AI Economics Institute (AIEI) is a joint research organisation of HM Treasury and the Office for the Prime Minister and Cabinet (OPMC). The AIEI has been established to build and maintain the analytical capability needed to put the UK government at the forefront of understanding AIs economic impacts. Announced by the Chancellor in the March 2026 Mais Lecture and launched in June 2026, it is the first government-backed institute of its kind in the world. AI has the potential to substantially reshape the structure of firms, sectors, and labour markets. The opportunities are extraordinary. AI could drive productivity gains and unlock new sources of growth. At the same time, the transition also carries risks depending on the pace of technological development and how the economy adapts. The AIEI exists to build the data infrastructure, research capability and external relationships needed to assess these impacts rigorously and at pace, and to ensure the resulting evidence informs policy makers. The Institute will assess both opportunities and risks under a range of scenarios, examining how AI affects productivity, labour markets, firms, growth and the income distribution, with particular attention to how the gains are shared across regions, income groups, sectors and generations. The AIEI is not a policy-setting body. UK government departments remain responsible for policy decisions in response to AI. The Institutes role is to improve the quality and timeliness of the evidence and analysis on which those decisions rest. It focuses on priorities where it has a comparative advantage as a research institute at the heart of government, avoiding duplication of work that can happen equally well elsewhere, and engaging widely with academia, business and civil society to inform its work and contribute to public understanding. The AIEI is modelled on the AI Security Institute, particularly in its research focus, its approach to bringing in external talent, and its access to advanced tools. It is a small, high-calibre organisation, planning to grow to around 35 FTE by the end of its first year. It will bring together talented civil servants with Research Economists who have hands-on experience of delivering frontier economic research. It is chaired by Nobel Prize winning economist and former Chief Economist of the IMF, Simon Johnson. A world-first ambition is to link private sector data, including AI usage data, to government administrative data, providing a unique and rich data ecosystem for empirical research. The Institutes ambitions for developing world leading macroeconomic modelling capability are similarly high. The two research pillars The AIEIs research function is organised around two complementary pillars set out in the published prospectus. All four role types in this campaign are being recruited into one of these two pillars, depending on the specialism of the candidate: Data & Empirical Research - developing the data infrastructure, measurement frameworks and empirical research needed to establish an evidence-based picture of AIs economic effects as they develop, including causal analysis of AIs impacts on productivity, labour markets, firms and workers. Modelling & Scenarios - connecting potential pathways for AIs development and adoption to economy-wide outcomes, building cutting edge economic models and plausible but stretching scenarios, testing assumptions, and ensuring policy conclusions are robust to the uncertainty that remains. Analysts and Research Economists Each research pillar brings together two complementary types of role. In this recruitment campaign, we are hiring for both role types, at G6 and G7: Research …

items.desc: Job title: Research Assistant – Mental Health Mapping (INTERNAL POST) Department: Anthropology, Media and Gender Studies Contract Type: Casual – 12 weeks (14/12/[2026 and 14/05/2027) Grade:6 Salary: £22.34 – £22.87 per hour inclusive of London allowance and holiday pay Location:Centre for Anthropology and Mental Health Research in Action (CAMHRA) Hours: 15 hours per week, 180 hours total SOAS University of London is the leading Higher Education institution in Europe specialising in the study of Asia, Africa and the Near and Middle East. SOAS University of London is positioned to play a leading role in reimagining higher education globally, with a new strategic plan in place as the basis for the renewal and revitalisation of the School which commits SOAS to both student responsiveness and research intensity. SOAS is moving towards a new model of international partnerships which is responsive to the transnational character of our global challenges. A bout the Role CAMHRA already collaborates with SOAS researchers from Anthropology, Media and Gender Studies. However, we do not have a complete mapping of colleagues across other SOAS departments and schools who work on distress, wellbeing, recovery, displacement, spirituality, care and addiction, perhaps without labelling it as mental health research. A wider, more epistemically diverse network of researchers across SOAS will help to ensure CAMHRA’s sustainability as a research centre, and support future applications for inter-disciplinary mental health research funding. MAP-MH@SOAS will systematically identify SOAS researchers who are interested in collaborating with CAMHRA. It will also develop an approach for critically articulating the economic benefit of mental health research, an increasingly important requirement for UKRI funding. It will convene two half-day workshops with CAMHRA colleagues to test where collaboration is possible. WP1: Mapping (December 2026 – May 2027). A research assistant with a critical mental health research background, supervised by Harriet Mossop (CAMHRA R&D Officer), will identify SOAS researchers outside SAMG whose work includes mental health. A long-list will be produced from a systematic, AI-enabled review of researchers’ Worktribe research profiles using key words (distress, wellbeing, etc). A short-list will be compiled from publication abstracts and conversations with researchers. Outputs: (1) a directory of short-listed researchers giving each researcher's focus, career stage, region, department, methods, and appetite for collaboration. EDI data will be collected with permission. (2) A visual map ‘MAP-MH@SOAS’ of the cross-SOAS mental health research ecology. (3) A document explaining and mapping this methodology for RKE to use across other research fields. . About the Department CAMHRA, located in the Department of Anthropology, Media and Gender Studies, is funded by a five-year Research England Expanding Excellence grant to develop infrastructure for anthropological research into mental health; the first such infrastructural funding to be received by SOAS. CAMHRA’s discipline-specific research is gaining strong traction with mental health providers, community groups and funders; increasingly, the Centre is also bringing anthropological approaches to collaborative, interdisciplinary work, and embedding About you You can find further information on the key criteria for the role in the Job Description and Person Specification, along with a full list of duties and responsibilities, which can be found on the SOAS website What We Offer: We are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a comprehensive range of benefits designed to enhance your well-being and work-life balance: Generous Holiday Entitlement: Benefit from 44 days of holiday (30 days annual leave, plus bank holidays and 5 closure days over Christmas and Easter) to ensure ample time for rest and relaxation. Flexible Working Arrangements: We recognise the importance of flexibility and offer options to help you manage your professional and personal commitments effectively. Generous occupational pension scheme: To provide financial security for your future Learning and Development: We are dedicated to your professional growth and development and offer diverse learning and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. items.desc: Build the AI that helps small business owners understand their finances and work through their plans, inside their own bank’s app. Narrative builds AI relationship management for small business banking. Our product, Narrative Coach, sits inside a bank’s or lender’s app and gives each business owner the kind of attention that used to depend on having a relationship manager. We already work with several banks and lenders, and the AI we’ve built for them is award-winning. We’re looking for a product-focused AI developer, early in their career, who wants to build AI that people rely on. You’ll work closely with our AI experience lead, who shapes what Coach should do for an owner and how we judge whether it helped. Your part is to build it well, and to raise it early when part of the design doesn’t hold up once you see the data or how the model behaves. Coach works inside regulated institutions, so its answers have to be accurate, grounded in the owner’s own data and safe to show a customer. We’ll teach you the regulatory side of that work; prior experience in financial services isn’t needed. What you’ll work on Build and improve Coach’s AI features, including the insights and suggested actions owners see and the conversations they have with Coach, from prompt and retrieval design through to production code. Work with our AI experience lead to turn a design for how Coach should help an owner into something that works on real transaction data, and propose changes when the build shows the design needs them. Write evaluations for the features you build, so we can show both whether an answer is technically correct and whether an owner would find it useful. Build in the safeguards that regulated AI needs: answers grounded in the owner’s own data, guidance kept clear of financial advice, careful handling of personal data, and a clear point where a person takes over. Ship to production with the engineering team, working mainly in Python and TypeScript on Azure, with AI coding tools as a normal part of how we build. Look at how owners actually use what you’ve built, and bring what you learn into the next version. What we’re looking for Evidence that you’ve built and shipped software that uses large language models, whether at work, in research or in your own projects. A product focus: you judge your work by whether it helps the business owner using it, and you raise it when a specification won’t serve them well. Solid programming skills, ideally in Python, and a working understanding of how LLM applications fit together: prompting, retrieval, tool use, structured outputs and the ways each can fail. A habit of testing your own work, checking outputs against what should happen and looking for the cases where a system breaks. Clear writing about technical choices and trade-offs, so that colleagues outside engineering can follow your reasoning. This role suits someone in their first few years of building software, or someone who has recently finished a degree or master’s with substantial projects behind them. Experience with evaluation tools, Azure or a regulated industry would help. What success looks like In your first three months, you’ll understand how Coach works for an owner and for the bank behind it. You’ll have shipped improvements to at least one AI feature in production, and built the evaluations that show whether those improvements helped owners. As you build experience, you’ll take ownership of larger AI features from first design through to evaluation in production, with a learning plan you choose and agree with us. Pay and location €40,000 to €50,000, depending on experience, plus equity in Narrative. Full-time, hybrid working with three days a week in our office near the Harcourt Street Luas stop. Agreed time for learning, fortnightly progress reviews and regular one-to-ones. How to apply Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, a link to GitHub or any code you’re happy to share, and a short note about something you built with a language model: who it was for, how you checked it worked for them, and what you changed as a result. If you have a disability and need an adjustment to take part in the hiring process, such as extra time on an exercise, questions in advance or a different interview format, tell us at any stage.

items.desc: Wir bei der Schönhofer Sales and Engineering GmbH entwickeln technologisch anspruchsvolle Softwarelösungen, die komplexe Informationen verarbeiten, Systeme vernetzen und Menschen bei wichtigen Entscheidungen unterstützen. Künstliche Intelligenz eröffnet uns dabei völlig neue Möglichkeiten – von intelligenter Datenanalyse und Mustererkennung bis hin zu generativer KI und agentischen Systemen. Unsere besondere Herausforderung Viele unserer Lösungen müssen auch ohne Cloud-Anbindung und ohne Zugriff auf die leistungsfähigsten KI-Modelle funktionieren. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die technologische Neugier mit fundiertem Engineering verbindet und gemeinsam mit uns intelligente Software entwickelt, die auch unter anspruchsvollen Bedingungen überzeugt. Aufgaben Du entwickelst und integrierst KI-basierte Funktionen in unsere Softwareprodukte – von der ersten Idee und prototypischen Umsetzung bis zur produktiven Anwendung. Du konzipierst intelligente Lösungen auf Basis von Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multimodalen Modellen und agentischen Systemen. Du untersuchst Einsatzmöglichkeiten klassischer Machine-Learning- und Deep-Learning-Verfahren, beispielsweise für Mustererkennung, Klassifikation, Anomalieerkennung oder die intelligente Verarbeitung komplexer Datenströme. Du entwickelst KI-Lösungen für On-Premises- und teilweise vollständig abgeschottete Betriebsumgebungen, in denen externe KI-Dienste nicht zur Verfügung stehen. Du wählst geeignete KI-Modelle aus, evaluierst ihre Leistungsfähigkeit und entwickelst Ansätze, um auch mit kleineren oder spezialisierten Modellen überzeugende Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Du optimierst KI-basierte Lösungen hinsichtlich Qualität, Ressourcenbedarf, Latenz und Zuverlässigkeit und berücksichtigst dabei die verfügbaren Hardware- und Betriebsbedingungen. Du entwickelst Prototypen, Proofs of Concept und produktionsfähige KI-Komponenten und integrierst diese in bestehende Softwarearchitekturen, Datenplattformen und verteilte Systeme. Du entwickelst geeignete Evaluations- und Testverfahren, um Qualität, Robustheit, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Leistungsfähigkeit KI-basierter Lösungen systematisch zu bewerten. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Software Engineers, Architekten, Product Ownern und AI Platform Engineers zusammen und bringst deine Expertise in die Entwicklung neuer Produktfähigkeiten ein. Qualifikationen Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Künstlichen Intelligenz, Data Science, Mathematik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit fundierter praktischer Erfahrung. Du verfügst über sehr gute Software-Engineering-Kenntnisse, insbesondere in Python, sowie Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Integration und dem Testen komplexer Softwarelösungen. Du bringst praktische Erfahrung mit der Integration und Anwendung moderner KI-Modelle, insbesondere LLMs, generativer KI, RAG-Architekturen oder agentischen Systemen mit. Du hast ein solides Verständnis der Grundlagen von Machine Learning und Deep Learning, einschließlich Modelltraining, Datenaufbereitung, Evaluation und grundlegender statistischer Verfahren. Du konntest bereits Erfahrung mit gängigen KI- und ML-Frameworks wie PyTorch, Hugging Face, scikit-learn oder vergleichbaren Technologien sammeln. Du hast ein gutes Verständnis unterschiedlicher Modellarchitekturen und ihrer Stärken und Grenzen sowie die Fähigkeit, geeignete Modelle für konkrete technische und fachliche Anforderungen auszuwählen. Kenntnisse im Umgang mit lokal betriebenen KI-Modellen, Open-Weight-Modellen oder Verfahren zur Modelloptimierung, beispielsweise Quantisierung oder Fine-Tuning, sind von Vorteil. Ein gutes Verständnis moderner Softwarearchitekturen, APIs, verteilter Systeme und datengetriebener Anwendungen; Kenntnisse in Docker, Kubernetes oder Cloud-native-Technologien sind von Vorteil. Interesse an Themen wie Computer Vision, Zeitreihenanalyse, Sensorfusion oder multimodaler Informationsverarbeitung; praktische Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren dieser Bereiche ist ein Plus. Du verfügst über Erfahrung in der Bewertung von KI-Modellen hinsichtlich Qualität, Robustheit, Performance und ihrer Eignung für konkrete Anwendungsfälle. Du hast ein Verständnis für Informationssicherheit, Datenschutz und den Einsatz von KI in geschützten oder vollständig abgeschotteten Systemumgebungen. Dein analytisches Denken, technologische Neugier und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Problemstellungen eigenständig zu durchdringen und pragmatische Lösungen zu entwickeln, zeichnet dich aus. Du hast Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und der gemeinsamen Entwicklung innovativer Technologien. Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab. items.desc: In a perfect world there would be no credit. All credit is bad by nature and you do well in avoiding it as much as you can. In a perfect world, credit and the companies that provide it wouldn’t exist. We wouldn’t either. But we don’t live in a perfect world. From time to time, we all need a helping hand to make ends meet and to make dreams become a reality. From time to time, we all need a life-happens credit buffer. “Just make sure it’s a fair one.” Who we are Fairlo is a fintech active in Sweden and the UK, helping people access sustainable finances. Our edge comes from transparency and flexibility towards the customer, and from our in-house credit decision engine and the machine-learning models that power it. Where we are now Since launching in 2018 we’ve helped tens of thousands of customers access responsible credit when life happens. We have 50,000+ active users, a 4.7 Trustpilot rating from 4,500+ reviews and an incredibly low churn rate. Transparency and flexibility aren’t just the right thing to do; they’re a winning model. We’re a tight team of 50 in Stockholm, Crete and the UK, backed by some of Sweden’s most experienced investors. Our culture prizes kindness, courage, collaboration and common sense. Where we’re going In line with new legislation and our long-term vision, we’re entering a new chapter of growth on the road to becoming a bank. That means scaling responsibly and putting AI to work where it makes credit fairer: sharper risk decisions, faster underwriting and better customer outcomes, all while staying true to our mission of a fairer world, even when it comes to money. The role You’ll join the Credit team as we bring our decision engine fully under Credit’s ownership. You’ll own the models, data parsers and AI tooling that decide who we lend to, and how much, across two regulated markets. We build with AI every day. Our credit team ships with AI coding agents, and we use large language models to turn messy, unstructured data (bank statements, open banking transactions, customer documents) into signal our models can use. We want someone who is excited to push that further, and rigorous enough to do it in a regulated lender. What you’ll do Own projects end-to-end, from the first query to production and monitoring: Data and features. Analyse large datasets, engineer features and build robust data pipelines. Credit models. Develop, validate and improve ML models for risk, affordability and limit decisions. LLM-powered extraction. Use LLMs to parse and categorise unstructured financial data, with evaluation sets that prove it works. AI-assisted engineering. Use agents like Claude Code and Cursor to move faster, and help the team adopt what works. Responsible AI. Keep models explainable, fair and monitored, ready for regulators and auditors. Production. Use CI/CD for testing, deployment and monitoring of models in AWS. Collaboration. Work with risk, product and engineering to break complex problems into shippable steps. What we believe you bring Fluency in Python and SQL Experience taking ML models into production, not just notebooks Hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Snowflake Cortex or similar) in your daily work, and opinions on where they help and where they don’t Experience building with LLMs: prompting, structured extraction, retrieval or evaluation Experience running software in AWS, or a strong desire to learn Even better if you have Experience in banking, credit or another regulated industry Knowledge of model risk management, explainability or fairness testing Familiarity with the EU AI Act, which treats credit scoring as high-risk Joining Fairlo means Being part of building the financial world you would like to live in. Health insurance, pension at ITP level and a health and wellness allowance 30 days of vacation per year plus klämdagar off The possibility to use the Fairlo Cretan house for both work and vacation stays The possibility of bike leasing A hybrid working model with a top-location office in Stockholm Being part of a team that supports one another, has fun together and thrives Where you’ll work Mostly in our Stockholm office, with occasional travel to our tech hub in Crete and the UK. We offer a hybrid model, competitive benefits and, most importantly, a deeply supportive and purpose-driven culture.

Vos
items.desc: Dassault Systèmes a pour ambition stratégique de révolutionner les sciences de la vie, avec le développement du jumeau virtuel, et par conséquent de transformer la pratique médicale. Au sein du département Corporate Research & Sciences , vous intégrerez l'équipe "Medical Image Segmentation" spécialisée dans l'application des technologies d'apprentissage profond aux images médicales. Partie prenante du projet MEDITWIN, sa mission est de développer les méthodes de segmentation d'images médicales par apprentissage profond grâce à notre patrimoine de données médicales dans le but de servir de fondation à la construction de jumeaux virtuels du corps humain. Les différentes modalités d'imagerie (IRM, CT-scan, ultrasons, etc.) et les diverses structures anatomiques présentent une grande variabilité. Les jeux de données d'entraînement associés sont donc souvent plus restreints et hétérogènes que dans d'autres domaines de la vision par ordinateur. Une piste prometteuse consiste à concevoir des modèles universels, entraînés sur des données agrégées provenant de sources multiples couvrant des tâches de segmentation diverses. Si ces modèles bénéficient d'un volume de données plus important et de meilleures capacités de généralisation, certaines tâches peuvent toutefois entrer en concurrence au cours de l'entraînement, au détriment des performances globales. Le stage portera directement sur cette problématique. Il s'agira d'explorer comment une architecture modulaire s'appuyant sur un mécanisme de Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) peut permettre de tirer le meilleur parti des synergies entre les différentes tâches de segmentation lors d'un entraînement sur des données hétérogènes. Vos missions Vos missions incluront : Réaliser et présenter un état de l’art sur les thématiques abordées. Concevoir et innover en développant de nouvelles méthodes. Implémenter et évaluer les solutions retenues. Vous aurez ainsi la possibilité de mener de bout en bout un projet de recherche en bénéficiant d'un haut degré d'autonomie au sein d'un environnement dynamique animé par le partage de connaissances. Vos Qualifications Actuellement en Master 2 / Bac+5 en Ecole d’ingénieur ou Université, vous vous spécialisez en Intelligence Artificielle, Vision par Ordinateur, Informatique ou Mathématiques Appliquées et recherchez un stage entre 5 et 6 mois. Compétences techniques souhaitées : Parfaite maîtrise de Python et pratique courante de PyTorch. Bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel : maîtrise de Git et aisance dans un environnement Linux. Démarche Scientifique : Capacité éprouvée à lire, analyser et exploiter la littérature scientifique (état de l'art, articles de recherche). Goût prononcé pour la recherche appliquée et l'expérimentation. Compétences professionnelles souhaitées : Capacité à faire preuve d'initiative, à proposer des axes de recherche et à tester de nouvelles hypothèses. Aisance à restituer ses travaux de manière claire et structurée, et envie de contribuer au collectif. Maîtrise avancée de l'anglais (un niveau de français conversationnel est un plus). Atouts Première expérience académique ou projet significatif en Vision par Ordinateur et Deep Learning pour le médical. Pratique des outils standards de développement en deep learning (PyTorch Lightning, Hydra, MLflow, etc.). Une première immersion dans le monde de la recherche (projet de fin d'études, stage en laboratoire d'école/université ou contribution open source). Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement collaboratif et innovant Collaboration internationale Diversité des technologies, produits et solutions Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

items.desc: Contribuez à façonner l'avenir de la pratique médicale en participant au développement de la santé numérique. L'ambition stratégique de Dassault Systèmes est de révolutionner les sciences de la vie grâce au développement du Jumeau Virtuel, transformant ainsi la médecine de demain. Vous rejoindrez le département Corporate Research and Science, au sein d'une équipe dédiée au développement d'outils transversaux pilotés par l'IA pour la recherche médicale. Cet environnement dynamique offre une exposition à un large éventail de sujets de recherche pionniers ainsi que des opportunités d'apprentissage et de développement. Des modèles de deep learning sont largement utilisés pour la segmentation de réseaux vasculaires. Néanmoins, le maintien d’une continuité topologique pertinente représente un vrai challenge lorsque les images sont bruitées ou peu contrastées. Alors que la plupart des méthodes de segmentation vasculaire classiques reposent sur l'extraction de caractéristiques au niveau du pixel, l'hétérogénéité de l'imagerie entraîne souvent des ruptures de la ligne médiane des vaisseaux, des branches manquantes et des prédictions aberrantes. Ces limites motivent l'exploration de pipelines de pré- et post-traitements adaptés, de fonctions de coût sensibles à la topologie du réseau vasculaire et d'approches basées sur les graphes. Vos missions Ce stage vise à développer et implémenter un framework de segmentation vasculaire préservant au mieux la topologie du réseau, afin d'améliorer les performances de segmentation dans des réseaux vasculaires complexes et des configurations d'acquisition d'images très hétérogènes. Axes principaux : Pré-traitement d'images médicales. Évaluation comparative (benchmarking) et test de différentes méthodes de segmentation vasculaire basées sur le deep learning. Implémentation de nouvelles fonctions de coût spécifiquement adaptées aux contraintes topologiques de la segmentation vasculaire. Modélisation de réseaux vasculaires à l'aide d'approches introduisant des graphes. Post-traitement d'images médicales. Vos responsabilités : Réaliser et présenter un état de l'art de la littérature sur le sujet du stage. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre de nouvelles approches méthodologiques. Implémenter et évaluer les méthodes sélectionnées. Communiquer les résultats. Vous aurez l'opportunité de mener un projet de recherche autonome dans un environnement dynamique fondé sur le partage des connaissances et la collaboration entre pairs. Vos Qualifications Actuellement en Master 2 / Bac+5 en Ecole d’ingénieur ou Université, vous vous spécialisez en Mathématiques Appliquées, Vision par Ordinateur ou Traitement du Signal/d'Image, idéalement avec un accent sur l'Imagerie Médicale et recherchez un stage entre 5 et 6 mois. Compétences techniques souhaitées : Solide bagage théorique et expérience pratique de modèles de deep learning / computer vision. Bases solides en traitement d'images 2D/3D (ex. segmentation, extraction de features, filtrage et transformations géométriques). Maîtrise de Python ; expérience avec PyTorch fortement recommandée. Bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel (ex. environnements virtuels, gestion de versions avec Git, tests de code). Fortes capacités d'analyse et approche rigoureuse et structurée des problèmes techniques complexes. Une expérience en imagerie médicale est un plus. Compétences professionnelles souhaitées : Autonomie et proactivité Curiosité et envie d'apprendre. Motivation pour l'innovation et la recherche. Capacité à communiquer clairement et à valoriser son travail Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Möchtest du die Plattform bauen, die es den Entwickler:innen der Schweizerischen Post ermöglicht, sicher, nachvollziehbar und zu einem vertretbaren Preis mit KI-Agenten zu arbeiten? Dann bist du vielleicht genau die richtige Person für uns. Die IT der Schweizerischen Post AG verändert die Art und Weise, wie Software entwickelt wird: KI-Agenten übernehmen einen wachsenden Teil der Arbeit, während die Menschen die Ziele vorgeben, die Ergebnisse überprüfen und die Prozesse steuern. Gemeinsam mit dir bauen wir eine unternehmenstaugliche Plattform für KI-Agenten auf und skalieren sie aus Pilotteams auf unsere DevOps-Organisation. Das kannst du bewirken. Du erstellst die Plattform, auf der unsere KI-Agenten laufen, von der Agenten-Laufzeitumgebung sowie KI- und MCP-Gateways bis hin zur Identitäts- und Zugriffsverwaltung für Menschen und Agenten. Wo die Post bereits über geeignete Bausteine verfügt, integrierst du diese, statt parallele Lösungen zu entwickeln. Darüber hinaus setzt du Leitplanken, Richtlinien und Governance-Regeln in Code um und setzt sie zentral durch – vom Datenschutz bis hin zu den Zugriffsrechten der Agenten. Du richtest Kostenkontrollen, Kontingente und Alerts ein, damit die Nutzung transparent bleibt und Budgets eingehalten werden. Zudem definierst und automatisierst du Metriken, Baselines und Telemetrie, sodass wir aufzeigen können, was sich bei der Lieferung durch die Agenten ändert, und nicht nur, wie oft sie verwendet werden. Du stellst bewährte Large Language Models bereit und bindest die Plattform an unsere bestehenden SDLC-Tools an. Zudem sorgst du dafür, dass die Plattform zuverlässig und überprüfbar arbeitet, damit wir nachvollziehen können, welcher Agent was in wessen Auftrag getan hat. Das bringst du mit. Du verfügst über mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Software- oder Plattformentwicklung, beispielsweise mit Go, Python, Java oder TypeScript, und bringst solide Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code sowie CI/CD-Pipelines wie GitHub Actions mit. Zudem hast du Erfahrung mit APIs, Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement (OAuth/OIDC) sowie Container- oder Cloud-Plattformen wie Kubernetes oder AWS. Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsverständnis für Plattformen, auf denen KI-Agenten laufen, einschliesslich Geheimnisverwaltung, Berechtigungen, Netzwerkzugriffe, Ein- und Ausgabekontrollen und Datenschutz. Darüber hinaus verstehst du, wie KI-Agenten technisch funktionieren – von Modell-APIs über Tool-Aufrufe bis hin zu MCP – und weisst daher, welche Anforderungen eine entsprechende Plattform erfüllen muss. Du hast Erfahrung im pragmatischen Einsatz von GenAI-Tools in der praktischen Softwareentwicklung. Kenntnisse in Bereichen wie KI- und MCP-Gateways, Prompt-Firewalls, Policy as Code, FinOps, OpenTelemetry, Backstage und DORA-Metriken sind von Vorteil, können aber auch bei uns erworben werden. Du verfügst über sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Englischkenntnisse. Kenntnisse einer Landessprache sind von Vorteil. Du musst nicht jedes einzelne Kriterium erfüllen. items.card: The role This is a full-time, on-site role in Zurich for an exceptional engineer who wants to build the infrastructure behind real production AI systems. As a Founding Engineer focused on AI infrastructure or data engineering, you own and improve the systems that power Zenline’s agentic workflows, data pipelines, data collection and reusable tools. Our Forward Deployed Engineers work directly with retailers to build
items.desc: About Zenline AI Every product you buy is the result of a bunch of decisions. Most of them are still made in spreadsheets. At Zenline, we build AI agents that make these decisions for retailers, brands and manufacturers. Our goal is to move the physical product economy into the agentic era. Our team brings experience from Google, P&G, BCG, Amazon and ETH Zürich, and we are backed by Seedcamp, one of Europe’s leading early-stage funds. We build agent-native, so every new model release makes our agents better. Please don’t apply via LinkedIn. We only review proper applications sent by email to hellen@zenline.ch. The role This is a full-time, on-site role in Zurich for an exceptional engineer who wants to build the infrastructure behind real production AI systems. As a Founding Engineer focused on AI infrastructure or data engineering, you own and improve the systems that power Zenline’s agentic workflows, data pipelines, data collection and reusable tools. Our Forward Deployed Engineers work directly with retailers to build workflows that solve concrete business problems. Your job is to make sure the platform underneath is robust, extensible, observable and maintainable as those workflows scale across customers. You work across backend systems, agent orchestration, data infrastructure, efficient data processing, workflow execution, observability, testing, deployment reliability and the product surfaces that help teams build, debug and operate AI systems in production. What you’ll do Build and evolve our agentic workflow platform: improve the infrastructure that lets teams compose reusable tools, custom logic, data steps, LLM calls, evaluations and business-specific workflows into reliable production agents. Build high-quality AI infrastructure: implement reusable agent components, workflow tools, data-processing primitives and platform integrations that help Forward Deployed Engineers ship quickly without fragile one-off systems. Scale our data pipelines: make data collection, enrichment and processing faster, more reliable and easier to run in production. Design efficient data infrastructure: process large retail datasets efficiently, keep data flows understandable and give AI agents the right context at the right time. Work closely with Forward Deployed Engineers: understand the workflows built for customers, spot repeated patterns and turn them into durable platform capabilities. Move between product and platform: improve the workflow builder, harden backend and data infrastructure, refactor agent execution logic and improve developer ergonomics. Who we’re looking for You are a strong technical generalist with a deep (deep) interest in AI agents, data infrastructure, platform engineering and production-quality software. You enjoy building the layer that lets others move faster without the product becoming fragile. Experience: 2–4 years building high-quality software systems, ideally across backend, infrastructure, data-intensive systems, agent platforms or workflow-heavy products. Agentic AI expertise: proven experience building LLM-powered applications, agent workflows, tool-calling systems or workflow orchestration. Data infrastructure knowledge: experience designing or improving data pipelines, ETL workflows, batch jobs or other systems that process data efficiently and reliably. Platform mindset: you care about abstractions, reliability, maintainability, observability, testing and developer experience. Entrepreneurial ownership: you are comfortable with ambiguity and take responsibility for entire problem areas. Nice to have: agent frameworks, workflow engines, distributed systems, data warehouses, evaluation systems or business concepts like P&L statements and balance sheets. Career path This is a founding path. Within one to two years, as we scale, you can grow into a Tech Lead (owning a product area and guiding a team of engineers) or a Product Engineering Lead (at the intersection of product, customers and engineering). Your growth depends on the value you create for Zenline’s customers. What else you get Help shape Europe’s next generational AI company during its defining years. Full autonomy: a high degree of freedom and responsibility. Everyone at Zenline helps where it creates the most leverage. The skill of the decade: build agentic AI applications that run in production and change how enterprise teams work. Competitive salary, stock options and bonus. Zurich-based, in one of Europe’s most vibrant startup ecosystems. We help with your relocation. How to apply Send your CV, LinkedIn or GitHub to hellen@zenline.ch.

items.card: Your role and responsibilities We are looking for a Project Engineer to join our Engineering and System Expertise team within ABB Energy Industries in Vaasa. This is an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in generator protection and excitation systems while
items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
Engineering Manager 
 __
 Your role and responsibilities 
 We are looking for a Project Engineer to join our Engineering and System Expertise team within ABB Energy Industries in Vaasa. In this role, you will work with electrical systems related to power generation, with a particular focus on generator protection and excitation systems. 
 This is an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in generator protection and excitation systems while working on demanding energy industry projects. Supported by experienced colleagues, you will participate in customer projects from engineering and system configuration through testing and commissioning, gradually taking on broader technical responsibility. As your expertise grows, you will also contribute to technical solution development together with customers and the sales team. 
 The role combines office-based engineering with practical testing and commissioning activities at customer sites. It requires willingness and ability to travel about 30 days per year, mainly within Finland and Northern Europe. The work model for the role is hybrid and the initial onboarding and technical training will primarily take place in Vaasa. 
 You will be mainly accountable for: 
 Executing engineering, configuration and documentation activities related to generator protection and excitation systems. 
 Providing technical support for internal testing, factory acceptance testing, installation and commissioning activities, including participating in commissioning at customer sites. 
 Collaborating with Project Managers, Lead Engineers, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders to deliver technically sound and cost-effective solutions in accordance with contract, quality and safety requirements. 
 Supporting the sales team with technical advisory and defining suitable protection and excitation solutions in close cooperation with customers. 
 Qualifications for the role 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering field, such as electrical, automation, or power engineering. 
 Some work experience in electrical engineering, power generation, protection systems, excitation systems, commissioning or a related field. 
 Interest in power generation and a good understanding of electrical power systems. Knowledge or experience of generator protection, protection relays or excitation systems is considered a strong advantage. 
 Practical experience in engineering, configuration, testing or commissioning. Experience with protection relays, electrical CAD tools or power plant systems is an advantage. 
 Willingness and ability to travel and work at customer sites about 30 days per year. 
 A collaborative and customer-oriented mindset, combined with a willingness to learn and develop into a broader technical expert role. 
 Fluency in Finnish and English, both written and spoken. Swedish is considered an advantage. 
 Our team dynamics 
 You will join an experienced and supportive engineering team working with protection, excitation, automation and electrical systems for energy industry customers. The role provides an opportunity to develop your expertise through project work, internal training and practical commissioning assignments. 
 More about us 
 The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, 
 digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the 
 rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, 
 while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle. 
 Our culture and benefits reflect our values: courage, care, curiosity and collaboration. The most appreciated benefits according to our personnel are at the moment e.g. an annual performance bonus, employee share acquisition program, continuous learning opportunities, and other wellbeing and family benefits. 
 For more information, please contact Engineering Manager Tapio Karppi, +358 50 3342080. You can reach Tapio during the following call times: 26 November from 12:00 to 13:00 and 27 November from 12:30 to 13:30. Interested in joining the crew? Please apply for the position by …

As an ABB Robot Commissioning Programmer, you will be responsible for programming, testing, commissioning and optimizing robotic systems, ensuring a smooth start-up process and successful production ramp-up at customer sites.

 Programming ABB robots using RAPID and RobotStudio, developing and optimizing applications according to project specifications and customer requirements.
 Performing on-site commissioning, testing, troubleshooting and debugging activities to ensure the successful start-up and validation of robotic automation systems.
 Supporting the integration of robots with PLCs, HMIs, machine vision systems, industrial communication networks and safety devices in production environments.
 Collaborating with project managers, electrical and mechanical engineers, PLC programmers and customer teams to resolve technical issues and achieve project milestones.
 Driving cycle time improvements, process optimization and production monitoring activities to meet customer performance and quality targets.
