IT Link, expert des systèmes connectés Chez IT Link, cela fait 40 ans que nous misons sur la connexion des technologies, des objets et des personnes pour apporter des réponses aux grands défis actuels de notre société (environnement, santé, sécurité…). Nous accompagnons nos clients dans leurs projets d’innovation et de transformation , des technologies embarquées à l’application métier en passant par le cloud et la science des données. Pour cela, nous comptons sur nos 950 Linkers présent.e.s sur 15 agences réparties dans le monde (France, Benelux, Canada et Maroc). Description de l'offre Vous intégrerez le Centre de Compétence Fabrication, rattaché au pôle produit « Socles DevOps Architecture & Support ». Cette entité a pour vocation d'assurer le support et l'accompagnement des tribus et squads métier sur l'ensemble du cycle de fabrication des produits. Votre quotidien sera rythmé par l'accompagnement des équipes, le partage de bonnes pratiques et l'amélioration continue des outils et la mise en œuvre, l'adoption et l'amélioration des chaînes CI/CD et des socles d'Infrastructure as Code. Vous possédez une bonne compréhension du cycle de vie du développement logiciel et des pratiques d'intégration et de déploiement continus. items.desc: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant qu ’ingénieur(e) de développement , vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en formation, recherche et innovation affecté à l’Institut Henri FAYOL. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal. Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol. Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles. ✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre. A l’heure actuelle, face aux besoins croissants d’acteurs pour accompagner les transitions des entreprises et de leurs écosystèmes territoriaux et industriels, Mines Saint-Etienne, dans le cadre du projet Phygital financé par la région AURA, a décidé de massifier ses formations i) en s’appuyant sur des pratiques innovantes en direction de publics hétérogènes (formation initiale, formation tout au long de la vie, formation par la recherche), et ii) en se basant sur de nombreux cas d’usages technologiques (Intelligence Artificielle, Sciences des données, Jumeaux Numériques, Gestion de production, etc), démonstrateurs des enjeux actuels de l’industrie et des territoires du futur. Ces cas d’usages technologiques sont développés à ce jour sur ses plateformes informatiques et industrielles du laboratoire des transitions, et doivent être déployés à grande échelle : Dans ce cadre, vos différentes missions sont : Intégrer les nouveaux composants connectés (robots mobiles, bras robotiques, convoyeurs, capteurs et actionneurs divers) et assurer leur fonctionnement avec le reste du matériel, notamment en déployant des interfaces interactives pour faciliter leur utilisation. Aider à la conception de contenu pédagogique de douze modules définis comme prioritaire dans ce projet Phygital (Optimisation de systèmes de production, Instrumentation responsable pour le pilotage du territoire et de l’industrie, Système Information pour l’observation et le pilotage d’un territoire, Système Information pour le pilotage industrie (PLM/ERP/MES), Détection d'anomalies et maintenance prédictive, Jumeaux Numériques Flux et processus, Robotique de manipulation et de transitique, Assistance numérique opérateur, Cybersécurité, Intégration et ingénierie systèmes intelligents (couplage de différents modules pour constituer un système cyber-physique intelligent multifonction) en lien avec les plateformes et les logiciels développés). Faciliter la maintenance les logiciels et matériels pour l’exploitation des composants connectés. Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer enseignement, recherche et application concrète sera essentielle pour réussir, notamment avec les autres ingénieurs de développement intervenant dans le périmètre du laboratoire des transitions. Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de Master (Bac+5) ou équivalent et possédez : Une expérience confirmée en conception logicielle et/ou en intégration de systèmes Une bonne maîtrise de la programmation (notamment Python, C++ ou Java) Connaissances dans les technologies de l’IA Vos atouts supplémentaires : Connaissances …

Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information: www.mirakl.com. items.desc: About the Job We are looking for a Control Engineer (m/f/d) to bring locomotion control to our robot, from simulation to real hardware. You will own the full path from model to motor: identify the dynamics, design controllers, train reinforcement learning policies and make them run reliably on the real robot. The work spans simulation, real-time control and firmware. It has to hold up against model errors, sensor noise, latency and hardware that does not behave like the simulator. Responsibilities Locomotion Control: Design, implement and tune controllers for a robot, from joint-level torque and impedance control up to whole-body and locomotion control. Real-Time & Firmware Integration: Integrate controllers and policies into the real-time control stack and work on the firmware side (motor drivers, communication buses, safety limits) together with the hardware team. RL Policy Training: Train locomotion policies in simulation (e.g. Isaac Lab, MuJoCo), including reward design, curricula and domain randomization. Sim2Real Transfer: Deploy trained policies on the real robot and close the sim2real gap through actuator, latency and noise modeling and systematic hardware experiments. System Identification: Identify actuator and rigid-body dynamics (inertia, friction, motor models) from robot data and feed the results back into simulation and controllers. Testing & Validation: Build test setups and benchmarks in simulation and on hardware, and run reliability checks before demos and releases. Documentation: Document models, controllers and procedures so others can reproduce and extend them. Essential Skills Engineering Background: Degree in Robotics, Control Engineering, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or an equivalent qualification plus professional experience with comparable systems. Robot Dynamics & Control: Solid foundation in rigid-body dynamics and feedback control (e.g. torque/impedance control, MPC, whole-body control), applied on physical robots. Reinforcement Learning: Hands-on experience training RL policies for robot control in simulation (e.g. PPO with Isaac Lab or MuJoCo). Sim2Real: Experience transferring controllers or learned policies from simulation to real hardware and debugging the gap. C++ and Python: Professional experience writing C++ for real-time robot control on embedded targets, and Python for training, analysis and tooling. Hands-on Hardware Debugging: Comfortable working directly on real robots, reading logs and signals, and tracking problems across software, electronics and mechanics. Beneficial Skills Legged Robots: Experience with quadrupeds or humanoids, in locomotion or whole-body control. System Identification: Experience identifying robot or actuator dynamics (excitation trajectories, physically consistent parameter estimation, friction models). Firmware & Embedded: Experience with embedded C/C++, motor control (FOC), real-time systems (e.g. PREEMPT_RT, Xenomai) or field buses such as EtherCAT or CAN. ROS 2 & Middleware: Experience with ROS 2, ros2_control or DDS. Simulation Modeling: Experience building or tuning robot models in MuJoCo or Isaac Sim. Infrastructure: Docker, CI pipelines and GPU training setups. What we offer A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors. Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment. Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow. Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month. Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment About us Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics. Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

items.desc: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. What you will do Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective. Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect. Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice. Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact. Turn technical findings into short, clear advice that clients can understand and act on. Share what you learn with the team and actively pick up what others know. We work on problems together. Contribute to improving our approach, sharing ideas that make assessments faster, clearer, and more useful for clients. What you will need Hands on penetration testing experience and a solid grasp of pentest methodology, particularly for external infrastructure and web applications. The ability to think like an attacker, to look at a set of exposed assets and see where you would start and why. Good judgement about real world impact, so you can tell an interesting finding from an urgent one. The ability to explain technical findings to non technical readers, briefly and without losing accuracy. A collaborative way of working and a genuine interest in learning and growing with colleagues, not working as a solo player. Comfortable working across multiple client environments in parallel. Fluent English. Nice-to-have Certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, or CPTS. A proven bug bounty track record or other real world offensive security experience. Experience working with SMEs or mid market customers on security topics. What we offer A meaningful mission, protecting organisations across Europe from real world cyber threats. Work with top tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds. A remote friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats, for example in Spain, Portugal, or Italy. Thursday socials to stay connected. A generous time off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days. About Eye Security Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organisations across Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally, having secured our Series C funding of 60 million. We combine cutting edge technology with hands on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds, all united by a shared mission, to make enterprise grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players. At Eye, you will work on projects with an international footprint, solving real world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients. We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply or interview for this role, please inform the TA team.

Your focus will be on developing and standardizing technical solution concepts, optimizing cross-functional processes and interfaces, and advancing structures across the entire value chain. You will work closely with engineering, project management, sales, procurement, and service teams, as well as external suppliers and project partners. In this role, you will combine a deep technical understanding of systems with a process- and solution-oriented approach, translating requirements and project insights into standardized, reusable solutions. Your Responsibilities Advancing the hybrid business segment by identifying opportunities for technical and economic optimization and development. Developing and standardizing technical solution concepts for "wind + storage" and BESS projects, including electrical infrastructure, as well as control and metering concepts. Defining and harmonizing technical interfaces between wind turbines, battery storage systems, power conversion systems (PCS), wind farm control systems, energy management systems, and electrical infrastructure. Developing and establishing standards, structures, and processes for the planning, design, procurement, implementation, and operation of hybrid energy solutions. Analyzing and optimizing cross-functional processes and interfaces throughout the entire value chain, while coordinating collaboration between the relevant departments. Evaluating new technologies, system concepts, and approaches from both a technical and economic perspective, and participating in the selection and qualification of suitable components, suppliers, and system partners. • Supporting and coordinating cross-functional projects and pilot initiatives, including the transition of successful solutions into standardized processes and scalable business models. • Systematic translation of project and operational experience into technical standards, best practices, and sustainable process improvements. Establishment and further development of efficient data, documentation, and knowledge management structures, as well as support for the standardization of relevant business and SAP processes. Development of key performance indicators (KPIs) and decision-making foundations for the continuous improvement of technical solutions, processes, and structures within the hybrid business segment. Regular coordination and on-site collaboration with project teams, specialized departments, customers, and technical partners. Key Focus Areas of the Position Standardization of technical system concepts: Development and refinement of single-line diagrams (SLD), plant layouts, control, instrumentation, and communication concepts, as well as associated technical design specifications for Wind+Storage and BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) projects. Technical system integration and interfaces: Definition and harmonization of interfaces between wind turbines, BESS, power conversion systems (PCS), park controllers, energy management systems, and electrical infrastructure; coordination of technical responsibilities between internal departments and external partners. Standardization of BESS project execution: Development of uniform technical requirements, specifications, and processes for battery systems, medium-voltage (MV) skids, transformers, MV substations, auxiliary power supply, cabling, foundations, as well as noise mitigation and protection concepts. Supplier and partner integration: Technical evaluation and qualification of components, system solutions, and partners; development of standardized requirements and interfaces for the procurement and integration of E-BOP (electrical balance of plant), C-BOP (civil balance of plant), and other system components. • Quality assurance and technical documentation: Development and standardization of technical testing and acceptance protocols, including Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), plant certification, electrical parameter settings, and project-specific documentation requirements. • Process and organizational development: Optimizing cross-functional workflows and responsibilities, and establishing efficient structures for engineering, procurement, SAP, data, and knowledge management within the hybrid business. Scaling and continuous improvement: Identifying recurring technical and organizational challenges, and transforming insights gained from projects and pilot initiatives into standardized, cost-effective, and reusable solutions—with the goal of reducing project-specific effort and enhancing the scalability of the Wind+Storage business. Sie
items.desc: Referenz: 11421-2026 Researcher (m/w/d/x) im Bereich Wissensextraktion und kausale Modellierung in Saarbrücken oder Berlin Tätigkeitsbereich Wissenschaft Bereich Neuro-mechanistische Modellierung Standort Berlin, Saarbrücken Anstellungsart Vollzeit Vertragsart Befristet Wenn befristet, dann bis 31.12.2029 Im Zentrum des Forschungsbereichs der neuro-mechanistischen Modellierung stehen hybride Ansätze, die mechanistische und KI-basierte Modelle kombinieren. In den zugehörigen Forschungsprojekten sollen Lösungen für Probleme erarbeitet werden, die sowohl die hohe Modellkomplexität neuronaler Netze als auch die Integration mechanistischer Beschreibungen erfordern oder von den kombinierten Vorteilen besonders profitieren. So erlauben neuro-mechanistische Modelle im Gegensatz zu rein neuronalen Modellen die Integration von Domänenwissen und können auch dann sehr gute Ergebnisse erzielen, wenn nur moderate Datenmengen zur Verfügung stehen - was beispielsweise häufig in den Lebenswissenschaften ein Problem ist. Sie sind leichter interpretierbar und generalisieren häufig besser für unbekannte Eingaben. Der Forschungsbereich Neuro-Mechanistische Modellierung sucht eine*n Researcher oder Junior Researcher im Bereich Wissensextraktion und kausale Modellierung als Teil der Forschungsgruppe Kausale Modelle und Repräsentationen . Idealerweise bringen Sie eine starke informatische und statistische Ausbildung sowie Erfahrungen im Bereich maschinelle Sprachverarbeitung und/oder in der kausalen Modellierung wissenschaftlicher Hypothesen mit. Die Stelle ist Teil des Projekts EcoAIRE - AI-assisted hypothesis assessment in invasion biology and the restoration of freshwater ecosystems under fragmented and heterogeneous ecological evidence im Förderprogramm Kooperative Exzellenz der Leibniz-Gemeinschaft. Das Projekt verbindet die Expertise des DFKI in der künstlichen Intelligenz und kausalen Modellierung mit der Expertise des Leibniz-Informationszentrums Technik und Naturwissenschaften (TIB) auf dem Gebiet der wissenschaftlichen Wissensrepräsentation und dem ökologischen Fachwissen des Leibniz-Instituts für Gewässerökologie und Binnenfischerei (IGB). Die Stelle ist für die Dauer der Projektlaufzeit von drei Jahren befristet. Die Einstellung erfolgt vorbehaltlich der finalen Bewilligung der Mittel durch den Drittmittelgeber Leibniz-Gemeinschaft. Am DFKI liegt ihr Forschungsschwerpunkt auf der Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache zur Extraktion wissenschaftlicher und kausaler Informationen. Sie entwickeln Methoden, die wissenschaftliche Evidenz in strukturierte, maschinenverarbeitbare Repräsentationen von Hypothesen, Variablen, Kontextinformationen, Unsicherheiten und kausalen Zusammenhängen überführen. Dabei geht Ihre Forschung über die Extraktion einzelner Fakten hinaus: Sie modellieren, wie wissenschaftliche Befunde zusammenhängen, unter welchen Bedingungen wissenschaftliche Aussagen gelten und wie diese durch die Erhebung, Analyse und Simulation von Daten sowie durch empirische Studien überprüft werden können. Ihre Aufgaben Gemeinsam mit Wissenschaftler:innen der TIB und des IGB entwickeln Sie ein multimodales Rahmenwerk, das heterogene wissenschaftliche Wissensquellen - darunter Publikationen, Bilder, ergänzende Informationen, Datensätze und weitere Forschungsartefakte - in strukturierte Repräsentationen zur Hypothesenbewertung integriert und dabei die Herkunft der Informationen nachvollziehbar berücksichtigt. Sie entwickeln sprachmodellbasierte und agentenbasierte Methoden, um Hypothesen, Variablen, Kontextinformationen, Evidenz, Unsicherheiten sowie kausale oder mechanistische Zusammenhänge quellenübergreifend zu extrahieren, zu vereinheitlichen, aufeinander abzustimmen und zusammenzuführen. Sie erforschen kausale Ansätze für wissenschaftliches Schlussfolgern, um Interventionen zu simulieren und zu untersuchen, inwieweit sich Hypothesen auf veränderte Bedingungen übertragen lassen. Sie entwickeln Evaluationsrahmenwerke, die unterschiedliche Qualitätsaspekte der KI-gestützten Hypothesenbewertung erfassen. Dazu gehören Verfahren auf Grundlage fachlicher Expertenbewertungen sowie Ansätze, bei denen große Sprachmodelle als Bewertungsinstanz eingesetzt werden („LLM-as-a-judge“). items.desc: Part Time Fashion Advisor Location: CHANEL Dublin Brown Thomas Contract: Permanent 23 hours per week, 3 days in 7 CHANEL is committed to delivering the ultimate luxury experience across all client touchpoints. From our Fashion boutiques with our Fashion Advisors, to online on CHANEL.COM or via our client care teams, we endeavour to provide an elevated, seamless, and memorable client experience. YOUR ROLE @CHANEL: The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in creating desire through navigating the core of fashion trends and shaping the narrative of luxury. In this role you will utilise your strong interpersonal skills and connect with clients at all levels, effectively, creating a welcoming and engaging atmosphere. As a Fashion Advisor, you will collaborate closely with colleagues daily, contributing to a cohesive, collaborative team environment and elevating the standards of excellence. WHAT IMPACT YOU CAN CREATE@CHANEL: Cultivate genuine relationships to foster trust and ensure enduring loyalty from our clientele reflecting the essence of the brand. Tailor and offer personalised guidance that elevates our clients’ journey through showcasing an in depth understanding of individual preferences and lifestyles Maintain an organised approach when completing tasks, ensuring efficiency and attention to detail Foster a culture of collective brilliance and creativity within the boutique and champion the brand’s legacy of excellence through inspiring colleagues to uphold the highest standards of luxury service. WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE ROLE Ability to build authentic, lasting relationships through empathy and personalised service Strong awareness of trends and deep appreciation for Chanel’s heritage and style. Confident, elegant storytelling and interpersonal skills to engage clients meaningfully. Collaborative attitude to foster a positive, high-performing boutique environment. Organized, efficient, and committed to delivering excellence in every task. YOU ARE ENERGISED BY: A genuine love for establishing meaningful connections with new clients and contributing to exceptional client service while creating memorable experiences Exploring and learning about the ever-evolving world of fashion while demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of industry trends Being part of a creative and innovative environment where teamwork is valued and encouraged WHAT YOU WILL GAIN FROM THIS EXPERIENCE: Gaining deeper insights from a leading player in the luxury fashion market, understanding cultural nuances, consumer behaviour, and the latest developments shaping the industry. Acquiring hands-on experience with CRM systems, which are widely used in the fashion industry to manage client interactions and preferences effectively. Navigating challenges and finding creative solutions to meet clients' needs and exceed their expectations, building resilience and adaptability in the process. Contributing to the on-going and companywide vision of sustainability. Sustainability is one of CHANEL’s key performance drivers, embedded into our ways of working we require continued collective action from all employees to deliver on CHANEL’s House Sustainability Ambitions across our four key areas, Restoring Nature and Climate, Investing in Circularity, Advancing dignity and prosperity and Promoting the autonomy of women BENEFITS AT CHANEL Our employee benefits have been created to support you across your professional and personal life by offering you: Physical Wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance covering pre-existing medical conditions and ability to add family members, Online GP App with 24/7 appointments available within 24 hours and Cycle Scheme participation for a tax-exempt bike and/or accessories Financial Wellbeing: Pension, Life Assurance and Retail Discounts across multiple retailers including Supermarkets, Gyms, Days Out and 100s more. Mental Wellbeing: Employee Assistance Programmes and Other Support Lines Platforms: Multiple Platforms to support across Wellbeing Lifestyle: Arts & Culture Ticket Discounts across major London attractions, CHANEL Product Discounts and Employee Only Sales Employee Recognition: Service Awards Programme offering CHANEL Products, Retail Vouchers and Additional Holidays across milestones Benefits are eligibility dependant and subject to change at any time At Chanel, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.

items.desc: Who are we? Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries. People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden. Based in our Carrick On Shannon office, Howden Ireland are delighted to have a vacancy as a Associate Surety Broker that will be an integral part of our wider Howden Commercial team. About the Role: This is a career-track position for a recent graduate or more experienced individual seeking a different career path and who wants to build deep technical expertise in a specialist, relationship-driven corner of the Surety market and grow into a senior surety broking role. No prior surety experience is required. We will teach you the market. What we need from you is strong numeracy, genuine interest in how businesses are financed, and the diligence to get contractual detail right. You will join an experienced surety team placing bonds for construction, engineering, energy, infrastructure, waste and manufacturing clients across a panel of specialist surety insurers and banks. You will start by supporting senior brokers on submissions, wordings and renewals, and over time develop into a broker running your own client relationships, negotiating directly with underwriters and winning new business. Key Responsibilities: Collaborate with internal teams (finance, compliance and surety broking) to ensure accurate invoicing, efficient workflow, timely bond issuance and high client satisfaction Act as the main control point with the existing internal Finance Team for invoicing/client payments. Updating of data into the Acturis system Support existing Surety team with their preparation of bond submissions through input of data, scanning and issuing of documents. Learn and manage existing Non-Resident Director Bond requirements and Title Indemnity Bond portfolios. Ensure robust governance and compliance: adhere to internal procedures, regulatory requirements and delegated authorities; maintain high-quality file documentation; and support audits and risk reviews Reading and analysing statutory accounts and management information — net worth, working capital, gearing, liquidity, profitability, contract margins and cash flow — and learning to explain what they say about a client's ability to perform. Reviewing bond wordings against the underlying contract, identifying whether a bond is conditional (ABI form) or on-demand, and flagging onerous terms, expiry provisions and cross-references that create exposure for the client. Preparing submissions to surety underwriters: collating client financial statements, contract details, and bond wordings into a clear, well-argued presentation of the risk. Develop and maintain relationships with key surety underwriters and decision makers; monitor market appetite and trends; and proactively secure capacity for clients. Overtime ,lead placement, and negotiation of contract and commercial surety bonds (including performance, advance payment, retention, warehouse, duty deferment and specialist bonds), ensuring optimal terms, capacity and pricing. Overtime, originate new client relationships through targeted prospecting, referrals and surety engagement; and partner with colleagues to identify opportunities that convert into measurable pipeline and revenue Overtime, own day-to-day management of a surety client portfolio, acting as primary relationship lead and escalation point for service, technical and commercial issues About You: A degree in business, finance, economics or law. Applicants with a degree in another discipline will be considered where they can demonstrate equivalent quantitative grounding. Highly proficient in Microsoft Office package, particularly word and excel Strong numeracy and comfort working with financial statements — you do not need to be an accountant, but you should be able to read a balance sheet and profit and loss account and know why they matter. Excellent written and oral English. Part of the job is persuading an underwriter; unclear submissions get declined. Precision and attention to detail. A single word in a bond wording can shift the exposure materially. Well organised, able to manage multiple deadlines and keep accurate records. Confident, professional communication style — you will be speaking to finance directors and underwriters. Postgraduate degree in business, finance, economics or law Previous experience in surety, banking, credit insurance, trade finance or professional …

Con un portfolio di aziende clienti diversificato e progetti ad alto contenuto innovativo, avrai l’opportunità di lavorare su soluzioni all’avanguardia e di crescere in contesti tecnici stimolanti. Entrerai in un ambiente che valorizza il talento, favorisce la crescita continua e che ti permetterà di mettere in gioco le tue passioni professionali. items.desc: Italy Industrial Automation Forlì Hybrid Join TMC and take part in challenging instrumentation engineering projects within the Energy and Oil & Gas sectors, working on every phase of the project from basic design to commissioning. About The Member Company We are a global high-tech consultancy company with a team of entrepreneurial engineers, scientists, and digital experts from around the world. Together we form a fast-growing and proud community. We offer consultancy services to high-profile clients globally in diverse service areas, such as: Technology & Engineering Energy & Renewables Life sciences & Pharma Digital & IT About this vacancy We are looking for an Instrumentation Engineer with approximately 4-5 years of experience in engineering environments, preferably within the Energy, Oil & Gas or industrial plant engineering sectors. The ideal candidate combines a solid technical background in instrumentation and control systems with hands-on experience in detail engineering, acting as an interface between the instrumentation discipline, other engineering teams, suppliers and customers. The role offers an opportunity to grow within the discipline, taking on progressively broader responsibilities up to the technical coordination of the instrumentation scope of a project. Your main responsibilities will include: Developing the instrumentation engineering for Oil & Gas, Energy and industrial plants throughout the different phases of the project (basic design, detail design). Preparing and reviewing instrument data sheets, specifications, instrument lists, I/O lists, loop diagrams, wiring diagrams, hook-ups and cable schedules. Contributing to the development and review of P&IDs for the instrumentation and control parts. Selecting and sizing field instrumentation (flow, pressure, temperature and level instruments, control valves, on-off valves, safety valves), including for hazardous areas. Preparing technical requisitions and performing technical bid evaluations, issuing technical comments on supplier offers. Following suppliers and subcontractors from a technical perspective, reviewing vendor documentation and monitoring project milestones. Acting as an interface with other engineering disciplines (process, electrical, mechanical, piping, telecom) to ensure consistency of design. Supporting the definition of control and safety philosophies, including DCS, PLC and F&G system interfaces. Supporting FAT, SAT, pre-commissioning and commissioning activities, including the resolution of technical issues on site. Ensuring compliance with applicable standards (IEC, ISA, API, ATEX), customer requirements and company procedures. Monitoring progress of the instrumentation deliverables and reporting to the Project Manager or Lead Engineer on deadlines and potential issues. Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives related to engineering and project execution processes. What we expect from you Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Automation, Electronic, Electrical, Chemical or Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field (technical diploma with proven experience may be considered). Approximately 4-5 years of professional experience in instrumentation engineering or in technically complex industrial environments. Solid technical background developed in instrumentation design, commissioning or industrial projects. Knowledge of reference standards such as IEC, ISA, API and ATEX, and of hazardous area classification principles. Experience in Energy, Oil & Gas, EPC, Power Generation or industrial plant engineering is considered a strong plus. Ability to read and manage technical specifications, engineering documentation and project requirements. Familiarity with instrumentation design tools (e.g. INtools/SmartPlant Instrumentation, AutoCAD or similar) is appreciated. Basic knowledge of control systems (DCS, PLC, SIS) is appreciated. Good communication and stakeholder management skills. Problem-solving mindset and ability to work in multidisciplinary environments. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Availability for occasional business trips, including site activities, depending on project requirements. What you can expect from us La posizione prevede un contratto a tempo indeterminato e la retribuzione annua lorda (RAL) base offerta non sarà inferiore a € 38000, in linea con quanto previsto dal CCNL Commercio – Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi. TMC si impegna a proporre un pacchetto retributivo competitivo e, al termine del processo di selezione valutando le esperienze, competenze e qualifiche del/la candidato/a, potrà proporre una RAL finale superiore al livello sopra indicato. items.desc: Job Description Consultant – Hydrology & Hydraulics Milan-Rome, Italy, Europe We invite you to bring your skills and enthusiasm to our open, collaborative and empowering working environment. We work to create a sustainable future through inspiring projects and innovative solutions that set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing since 1945, where together we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies and people. You will be based in our Milan or Rome office within our Environment & Health division, collaborating across a multidisciplinary, international network. About the role We are seeking a Consultant to contribute to hydrology and hydraulic engineering projects for a broad range of clients. You will work alongside engineers, geologists, economists, environmental scientists, chemists and biologists on varied assignments for leading national and international organisations. Key responsibilities Undertake hydrological and hydraulic modelling of catchments, urban drainage systems and watercourses. Integrate modelling outputs into climate-related physical risk assessments, including flood and water-related risks, and adaptation planning, translating findings into resilient drainage, flood-management and adaptation solutions. Develop technically robust models and calculations, clearly documenting assumptions, methodologies and quality-control checks. Prepare technical reports covering hydrological assessments, hydraulic modelling and flood risk in Italian and English. Contribute to the preparation of technical and commercial proposals in Italian and English. Collaborate with colleagues across water, infrastructure and planning disciplines to develop efficient and sustainable solutions. Qualifications and experience Master’s degree in environmental engineering, civil engineering with a focus on hydraulics, or a closely related discipline. At least four years of relevant experience in hydrology or hydraulic engineering, meeting one of the following requirements: (i) at least four years of relevant professional experience; or (ii) a completed three-year PhD in hydrology or hydraulic engineering, together with at least one year of relevant professional experience. Experience gained in an engineering or environmental consultancy would be an advantage. Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex hydrological and hydraulic data and communicate technically sound conclusions. Native or full professional proficiency in Italian and professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in at least one relevant one and two-dimensional hydraulic modelling package, such as HEC-RAS or relevant MIKE+ modules, and experience with hydrological or urban drainage modelling tools, such as HEC-HMS or SWMM. Working knowledge of ArcGIS Pro or QGIS is also required. Experience with Python, R, MATLAB or statistical analysis tools would be an advantage. You will be highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities effectively while meeting agreed deadlines. You will demonstrate attention to detail, accuracy and technical rigour, together with a self-motivated, reliable and collaborative approach. This role offers the opportunity to work on a diverse portfolio of projects and to develop your technical and consulting skills within an international organisation from our Italian offices. Salary The gross annual salary for this role ranges from €33,000 to €38,000. Our Environment & Health division Ramboll develops innovative, scientifically sound solutions that help increase liveability by reducing pollution and restoring natural environments. As one of the world’s leading environmental and health consultancies, Ramboll is trusted by clients to manage their most challenging environmental, health and social issues. About Ramboll Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering and consultancy company with more than 18,000 experts operating across 35 countries. We are present in Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Romania, Spain, Portugal, Sweden, Switzerland, Austria, Ireland and the United Kingdom. Our experts are applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy and Management Consulting. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people-centred company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture. How to apply Apply online and attach your CV and cover letter, explaining your suitability for the role and your availability to start. Application deadline: 31 December 2026

items.desc: Disegnatore Junior – Ufficio Tecnico Entrare in Tubisteel significa trasformare un disegno in qualcosa di concreto Tubisteel Srl è specializzata nella produzione di tubi in acciaio inox e leghe speciali e nella realizzazione di particolari a disegno, in un contesto industriale strutturato dove precisione, competenza tecnica e collaborazione fanno parte del lavoro quotidiano. Nel nostro Ufficio Tecnico il disegno non è un'attività fine a sé stessa, ma il punto di partenza di un processo che porta alla realizzazione concreta di componenti e prodotti. Per questo cerchiamo persone che abbiano passione per il disegno tecnico, curiosità verso i processi produttivi e voglia di sviluppare le proprie competenze lavorando a stretto contatto con la produzione. Per rafforzare il nostro Ufficio Tecnico, siamo alla ricerca di un Disegnatore Tecnico Junior che si occuperà di disegno e modellazione 3D, sviluppo di particolari e preparazione della documentazione tecnica necessaria alla produzione. Per chi può essere interessante questa opportunità Questa posizione può essere adatta a te se: hai una formazione tecnica, preferibilmente in ambito meccanico conosci e sai utilizzare un software CAD 3D ti piace il disegno tecnico e vuoi approfondirne le applicazioni pratiche sei curioso di capire come un componente viene realmente costruito ti interessa lavorare sia al computer sia a contatto con la produzione sei una persona precisa, organizzata e attenta ai dettagli vuoi sviluppare competenze tecniche concrete e crescere professionalmente La ricerca è rivolta principalmente a profili junior che abbiano già acquisito le basi del disegno e della modellazione tridimensionale, anche attraverso il percorso scolastico o prime esperienze lavorative. Non cerchiamo necessariamente una persona con molti anni di esperienza, ma qualcuno che abbia buone basi tecniche e voglia di imparare. Cosa farai nel ruolo Nel concreto ti occuperai di: realizzazione e modifica di disegni tecnici 2D e modelli 3D sviluppo di particolari e componenti meccanici a disegno preparazione dei disegni esecutivi e della documentazione tecnica per la produzione verifica della correttezza e della fattibilità dei particolari da realizzare rilievi dimensionali e verifiche direttamente in officina confronto con i responsabili di produzione per individuare le soluzioni tecniche più adatte collaborazione con i colleghi dell'Ufficio Tecnico per lo sviluppo delle commesse Avrai la possibilità di seguire il passaggio dal modello tridimensionale al prodotto finito, confrontandoti direttamente con le persone che realizzano ciò che hai disegnato. items.card: you will work on: High-throughput PL screening: together with the HELIOS team, screen the photoluminescence of perovskite films prepared under varied conditions, to identify atomic structures with interesting properties that are stable in time. Correlative structural and optical mapping: combine 4D-STEM (spatially resolved electron diffraction) with PL and absorption measured on the same regions of films on TEM
items.desc: Work Activities The optical properties of halide perovskite thin films are set by the positions of their atoms, including defects. Local variations in crystal phase, grain orientation, and defect density govern the photoluminescence (PL) yield and spectrum and, ultimately, solar-cell efficiency and stability. Quantifying these atomic-scale variations currently requires transmission electron microscopy (TEM), which is slow and low-throughput compared with optical measurements. In this project we ask whether the atomic structure of a perovskite film, including its defects, can be inferred from its PL and absorption alone. If so, a fast, non-destructive optical measurement becomes a quantitative crystallographic probe. To find out, we combine two major AMOLF facilities: HELIOS, an AI-guided robotic platform for perovskite film deposition and characterization, and SHINE, a unique in situ TEM with laser excitation. The resulting optical and electron-diffraction data, acquired on exactly the same regions of the same films, are used to train a neural network that infers structure from light. As a postdoc on this project you will work on: High-throughput PL screening: together with the HELIOS team, screen the photoluminescence of perovskite films prepared under varied conditions, to identify atomic structures with interesting properties that are stable in time. Correlative structural and optical mapping: combine 4D-STEM (spatially resolved electron diffraction) with PL and absorption measured on the same regions of films on TEM grids. In situ TEM under laser excitation: reproduce transient or metastable states that do not survive ex situ transfer inside the SHINE TEM. You will work in the Hybrid Nanosystems group of Wiebke Albrecht at AMOLF, in close collaboration with the Nanoscale Solar Cells group of Erik Garnett. You will be part of the HELIOS team and join its weekly work discussions. Qualifications We invite applications from highly motivated candidates with a PhD in physics, materials science, nanoscience, or a related field, and a strong background in transmission electron microscopy, including STEM-based techniques such as 4D-STEM. Experience with TEM on halide perovskites or other beam-sensitive materials is a strong plus. Experience with optical spectroscopy, data analysis in Python, or machine learning is an advantage. We especially encourage individuals from underrepresented groups to apply. Work environment The Hybrid Nanosystems group, led by Wiebke Albrecht, uses light as a tool to probe, program, and reshape nanomaterials. By combining advanced electron microscopy, single-particle optical spectroscopy, and electromagnetic simulations, we uncover how the atomic-scale structure of nanoparticles governs their response to light, and how light can drive these structures to transform. The group runs AMOLF’s light-coupled in situ TEM facility. In this project you will collaborate closely with the Nanoscale Solar Cells group of Erik Garnett, which leads AMOLF’s robotic perovskite platform. Both groups are part of AMOLF’s LMPV–Sustainable Energy Materials department, where about 50 scientists work on semiconductors for solar energy conversion and photocatalysis, with weekly departmental colloquia. AMOLF is a national institute that is part of NWO-I and initiate and performs leading fundamental research on the physics of complex forms of matter, and to create new functional materials, in partnership with academia and industry. The institute is located at Amsterdam Science Park and currently employs about 140 researchers and 80 support employees. www.amolf.nl Working conditions The working atmosphere at the institute is largely determined by young, enthusiastic, mostly foreign employees. Communication is informal and runs through short lines of communication. The position is intended as full-time (40 hours / week, 12 months / year) appointment in the service of the Netherlands Foundation of Scientific Research Institutes (NWO-I) for the duration of 2 years, with the possibility of extension by one year. Salary is in scale 10 (CAO-OI) which starts at 4.552 Euro’s gross per month, and a range of employment benefits. AMOLF assists any new foreign Postdoc with housing and visa applications and compensates their transport costs and furnishing expenses. More information? items.desc: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. What you will do Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective. Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect. Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice. Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact. Turn technical findings into short, clear advice that clients can understand and act on. Share what you learn with the team and actively pick up what others know. We work on problems together. Contribute to improving our approach, sharing ideas that make assessments faster, clearer, and more useful for clients. What you will need Hands on penetration testing experience and a solid grasp of pentest methodology, particularly for external infrastructure and web applications. The ability to think like an attacker, to look at a set of exposed assets and see where you would start and why. Good judgement about real world impact, so you can tell an interesting finding from an urgent one. The ability to explain technical findings to non technical readers, briefly and without losing accuracy. A collaborative way of working and a genuine interest in learning and growing with colleagues, not working as a solo player. Comfortable working across multiple client environments in parallel. Fluent English. Nice-to-have Certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, or CPTS. A proven bug bounty track record or other real world offensive security experience. Experience working with SMEs or mid market customers on security topics. What we offer A meaningful mission, protecting organisations across Europe from real world cyber threats. Work with top tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds. A remote friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats, for example in Spain, Portugal, or Italy. Thursday socials to stay connected. A generous time off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days. About Eye Security Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organisations across Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally, having secured our Series C funding of 60 million. We combine cutting edge technology with hands on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds, all united by a shared mission, to make enterprise grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players. At Eye, you will work on projects with an international footprint, solving real world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients. We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply or interview for this role, please inform the TA team.

What You'll Do The Amsterdam A-C Career Development Specialist is responsible for running the career development (CD) and performance review processes for Associates to Consultants (A-Cs) in Amsterdam. This role provides advice and support to Career Development Advisors (CDAs) and coordinates the running of Career Development Committee meetings (CDCs) throughout the year. Highly proficient in Excel, Word and PowerPoint, and experienced numerate. Excellent English skills (verbal and written communication). items.desc: About Six Robotics At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our team of 90+ engineers, researchers, and defence specialists develops our autonomy and swarm platform, used by both government and industry. Working closely with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI) and end users, we move quickly from ideas to field deployment, solving problems where software meets the real world. The challenges we work on don’t come with existing playbooks. They demand deep technical thinking, close collaboration across disciplines, and the ability to learn quickly as both the technology and the company evolve. At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. If you’re excited about building systems that matter and growing alongside talented people that push boundaries every day, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact. About The Role Our engineers build faster than the lab can deliver. The backlog of test platforms and builds keeps growing, and the lab is a service supplier to every team at Six Robotics. Requests arrive through Jira, and the queue is never empty. We need someone who takes ownership of the lab, so that engineers get what they asked for, when they need it. The work is low volume and high complexity. One day you assemble a test platform, the next you manage inventory, support a design integration or help prepare a test flight. You will work with a wide range of tasks and with the engineers who depend on the result. In your first year, you will bring structure to the lab and take on more ownership of it. You will build up control of assets and inventory, and document your work so every build is reproducible. After 6–12 months, success looks like this: You deliver on incoming requests with predictability. You know what needs to be purchased, and when. The lab runs on clear routines, including follow-up of HSE procedures. Engineers trust the lab to deliver. What You Will Do Build and assemble drones and test platforms in the lab Handle incoming requests from internal teams via Jira and deliver on them Own asset management and inventory in the lab, including what needs to be purchased Keep the lab structured and follow up HSE routines Write procedures and document your work so builds can be reproduced Support design integration and give feedback on designs, and take part in testing and drone operations when needed What we are looking for We are looking for someone who likes building things and is careful in how they do it. This is a hands-on role at the centre of the lab, not a development role. You will mostly build, organise and deliver, with room to own more of the lab over time. It is a good fit if you want to see your work fly . Must haves No minimum years of experience required. We care more about what you have built than how long you have worked. Hands-on experience building or assembling physical hardware, such as drones, electronics or mechanical systems. Hobby projects count. A structured way of working, and a realistic sense of estimates. Precision and attention to detail in assembly and documentation Motivation to join a startup, take ownership and handle a wide range of tasks in a high-demand environment Nice to have Engineering education (preferably in electrical engineering or mechanical engineering) Experience from a professional lab Drone license Experience with 3D printing Membership in Makerspace. CAD modelling or/and CNC or machining experience are also valued, though none of this needs to be at a professional level. Why you should join Build at the edge of what’s possible: You’ll work on problems the industry hasn’t solved yet, alongside people who are pushing the boundaries of autonomy, AI, and robotics. Grow as fast as the company: We believe that chance favours those in motion. The role you’re hired into is just the starting point. As Six Robotics evolves, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your opportunities. Work with exceptional people: Surround yourself with people who raise your own standards. You’ll join a team of ambitious engineers and operators who care deeply about the quality of their work. Expectations are high, but so is the willingness to help each other improve. items.desc: Location Remote from Poland Experience Junior Hi there! If you’re looking for a high-impact position in an ambitious software house, we’ve got a match for you! We are looking for an Engineer to work with our customer. Our client provides an AI-powered enterprise-grade platform that helps large organizations improve operational efficiency without losing control over their internal data. The product acts as a secure layer on top of a company’s existing software (e.g. CRMs, communication tools, and document management systems) and serves three main purposes: Information Search: Enables employees to quickly find data scattered across different internal systems without having to move it. AI-Powered Insights: Analyzes company data and provides context-aware answers to support decision-making, while ensuring that confidential information is not exposed to public AI models. Process Automation: Reduces manual work and accelerates repetitive tasks across different departments (e.g. sales, finance, and operations). The key differentiator is full data sovereignty and privacy . Companies do not need to migrate their databases or replace their existing tools. Instead, AI comes to the data wherever it currently resides, ensuring that sensitive business information remains fully protected. You will be working with LLMs and many AI tools. ‍ Recruitment stages HR call (15 min.) Technical call with our team (+/-45 min.) Meeting with our Client (30 - 60 min.) What will be your responsibilities? Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines for Node.js and Python applications using GitHub Actions. Operate and maintain Kubernetes environments across cloud platforms, including AWS and GCP. Manage GitOps-based deployments with ArgoCD and automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code. Monitor application performance, availability, and resource usage, helping identify and resolve production issues. Support application teams with deployments, scaling, troubleshooting, and reliability improvements. Contribute to infrastructure security, high availability, and operational best practices. Document infrastructure configurations, processes, and technical solutions. Requirements Commercial experience in DevOps, Cloud, Platform Engineering - MUST HAVE! Good understanding of Linux, networking, and cloud infrastructure fundamentals. Practical knowledge of Kubernetes and Docker. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions, and familiarity with Git. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products , working alongside a team of test experts. Your role will combine: Daily quality assurance activities , including manual testing and verification of build artefacts. Forward-looking test automation , focusing on End-to-End (E2E) Business Processes. Exploring innovative approaches, including AI-powered testing , to continuously improve our QA processes. Working in a highly agile environment, collaborating with experts to drive product quality forward. Location : Hybrid working model – minimum 3 days per week in our Katowice office . Defect Management: Investigate and triage test failures, identify root causes, and work collaboratively to prevent recurring issues through effective quality controls. Documentation: Create and maintain clear, up-to-date documentation covering test strategies, frameworks, environments, and operational procedures. AI-Powered Test Automation: Explore and implement AI-driven solutions for test generation, coverage analysis, anomaly detection, and regression test optimisation. Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product owners, and DevOps colleagues in an Agile/Scrum environment to integrate quality practices throughout each sprint. Reporting & Improvement: Document findings, communicate observations, and recommend improvements to support the quality of future releases. Retesting & Validation: Coordinate testing activities following bug fixes, validate solutions, and track issues through to resolution. items.desc: Overview Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech. We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting. Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights. In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favourite sports teams and competitions. How do we add value? Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages. Sportsbooks can offer better predictions and more accurate odds. The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions. Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights. Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there. However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine. We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real-time data with our 40-year-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience! Responsibilities: The Accounts Payable Analyst will be responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely processing of supplier invoices, employee expense claims, and vendor-related transactions. The role supports the organization's financial controls by maintaining compliance with company policies, resolving invoice and payment queries, performing account reconciliations, and contributing to continuous process improvement initiatives within the Accounts Payable function. Review and process vendor invoices for the Stats Perform entities worldwide. Audit employee expense claims to ensure compliance with the T&E policy. Monitor invoices on hold, prepayments and open debit balances. Contact vendors and business owners to acquire invoice copies and Purchase Orders. Manage shared mailbox and resolve queries raised by vendors and internal stakeholders. Prepare month-end balance sheet reconciliations for assigned business units. Respond to audit queries. Collaborate with other AP Team Members to prioritize day-to-day tasks. Update Standard Operating Procedures and identify potential process improvements opportunities. Provide prompt resolution for bank access issues to support uninterrupted business operations Assist Bank Admin in gathering and submitting legal documentation to meet audit and KYC requirements Required Qualifications: University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration Very good command of spoken and written English Desired Qualifications: Proficiency in Microsoft Office, specifically Excel Familiarity with Oracle or other ERP systems would be an asset Understanding of accounting principles and AP workflows Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy Effective time management and task prioritization skills Work Model: Hybrid working model, with a combination of working from the office and remotely. Why work at Stats Perform? We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more! We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us. At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution. We take care of our colleagues We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules. We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all. We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values. With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

Profil kandydata Minimum 2–3 lata doświadczenia na stanowisku Analityka Biznesowego lub Biznesowo-Systemowego oraz znajomość specyfiki projektów z branży bankowej i finansowej. Praktyczna umiejętność modelowania procesów z wykorzystaniem notacji UML (znajomość BPMN będzie dodatkowym atutem). Biegła znajomość Jira oraz Confluence, a także praktyczna wiedza z zakresu inżynierii oprogramowania i pracy w metodyce Scrum (Agile). Znajomość narzędzi opartych o LLM i umiejętność ich praktycznego wykorzystania w codziennej pracy analityka (np. przy pozyskiwaniu wiedzy domenowej czy tworzeniu artefaktów analitycznych). Wysoko rozwinięte zdolności komunikacyjne, umiejętność samodzielnego facylitowania warsztatów z klientem, analityczne myślenie i dobra organizacja pracy własnej. Wykształcenie wyższe (preferowane kierunki techniczne lub pokrewne) oraz znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie umożliwiającym swobodną komunikację w projekcie (min. B2). Mile widziane: Doświadczenie w projektach z obszaru Mobile. Znajomość narzędzi do modelowania, np. Enterprise Architect. Kompetencje z obszaru analizy systemowej: podstawy SQL, wiedza o relacyjnych i nierelacyjnych bazach danych oraz zrozumienie architektury integracyjnej (REST, SOAP, znajomość Postman, Swagger lub SoapUI). Twoje zadania W tej roli będziesz kluczowym ogniwem między interesariuszami biznesowymi, a zespołem wytwórczym. Do Twoich głównych obowiązków należeć będzie: Samodzielne organizowanie i prowadzenie warsztatów oraz spotkań z interesariuszami w celu definiowania i priorytetyzacji wymagań biznesowych. Projektowanie nowych rozwiązań informatycznych oraz tworzenie specyfikacji funkcjonalnych – przygotowywanie User Stories, Use Cases, wymagań funkcjonalnych i niefunkcjonalnych oraz specyfikacji ekranów. Ścisła współpraca w zespole Scrumowym: z Product Ownerem – wsparcie w budowaniu i zarządzaniu Backlogiem produktu, z zespołem deweloperskim – prowadzenie spotkań typu Refinement i prezentacja wymagań, z zespołem UX/UI – współpraca przy projektowaniu makiet (m.in. w Figmie), z zespołem QA – wsparcie w przygotowaniu scenariuszy testowych. Dbanie o zgodność dostarczanych rozwiązań z założeniami biznesowymi, wsparcie podczas testów akceptacyjnych (UAT) oraz współpraca z pierwszą linią wsparcia (1st line support) po wdrożeniu. Dla Ciebie Prywatna opieka medyczna w Allianz - dostęp do specjalistów i badań diagnostycznych dla Ciebie i Twoich najbliższych. System kafeteryjny - możesz wybrać pełne dofinansowanie do karty Multisport czy przeznaczyć środki na kulturę, wypoczynek lub sport i zakupy. Możliwość pracy w modelu hybrydowym po okresie wdrożenia (2 dni pracy zdalnej, 3 dni pracy z biura). Możliwość korzystania z zaawansowanych narzędzi AI i Google Workspace. Udział w inicjatywach: Akademia AI oraz Gildia AI. Udział w międzynarodowych projektach realizowanych dla firm z sektora finansowego i ubezpieczeniowego. Profesjonalny rozwój zawodowy - możliwość ścieżki kariery na stanowiskach eksperckich technicznych, biznesowych i managerskich. Indywidualny plan szkoleń i konferencji. Przyjazna atmosfera pracy w zgranych zespołach, o co dbamy m.in. poprzez udział w imprezach integracyjnych czy wspólnych inicjatywach dla lokalnych społeczności. Możliwość udziału w akcjach i wydarzeniach promujących aktywny tryb życia.

items.desc: W firmie Carrier różnorodni pracownicy są naszą największą siłą i źródłem innowacji, ponieważ pracujemy jako jeden zespół na rzecz wspólnego celu. Detale Pracy Zapisz pracę Business Unit Carrier Job ID 30221564 POL2520: ul. Platynowa 131, Komorniki, 62-052, Poland O Carrier Carrier Global Corporation, światowy lider w dziedzinie inteligentnych rozwiązań klimatycznych i energetycznych, koncentruje się na tworzeniu innowacji, które zapewniają komfort, bezpieczeństwo i zrównoważony rozwój. Dzięki najnowocześniejszym rozwiązaniom w obszarze kontroli temperatury, jakości powietrza i transportu poprawiamy jakość życia, wspieramy kluczowe gałęzie przemysłu oraz zapewniamy bezpieczny transport żywności, leków ratujących życie i wielu innych produktów. Od czasu wynalezienia nowoczesnej klimatyzacji w 1902 roku działamy z jasno określonym celem: poprawiać jakość naszego życia i dbać o świat, który wspólnie tworzymy. Utrzymujemy pozycję lidera dzięki światowej klasy, inkluzywnemu zespołowi, który stawia klienta w centrum wszystkiego, co robimy. Więcej informacji można znaleźć na stronie internetowej Carrier lub w mediach społecznościowych @Carrier. Viessmann jest światowym liderem w dziedzinie zrównoważonych rozwiązań klimatycznych i energetycznych, zajmującym się tworzeniem przestrzeni życiowych dla przyszłych pokoleń. Obecnie, jako część grupy Carrier, firma Viessmann łączy innowacyjne technologie z silnym zaangażowaniem w ochronę środowiska, promując zrównoważony rozwój i komfort. Do głównych zadań osoby na tym stanowisku należeć będzie terminowe wykonywanie przeglądów, napraw, usuwanie awarii urządzeń oraz realizacja prac bezpiecznie i zgodnie z zasadami bezpieczeństwa Carrier. Opis stanowiska Dołącz do naszego zespołu serwisowego i wspieraj klientów w zakresie uruchamiania, konfiguracji oraz diagnostyki systemów automatyki dla pomp ciepła i instalacji HVAC. Na tym stanowisku będziesz odpowiadać za programowanie i konfigurację sterowników, wykonywanie pomiarów, usuwanie usterek oraz zapewnienie prawidłowej pracy urządzeń i instalacji. To idealna rola dla osoby, która lubi łączyć wiedzę techniczną z pracą w terenie i bezpośrednim wsparciem klientów. Obszar pracy: Cała Polska. Preferowane lokalizacje kandydatów: woj. Wielkopolskie / woj. Mazowieckie / woj. Podlaskie Za co będziesz odpowiadać projektowanie, montaż, uruchamianie i testowanie układów automatyki i sterowania instalacjami w oparciu o urządzenia marki Viessmann oraz Carrier konfigurację sterowników PLC, modułów komunikacyjnych, paneli HMI wykonywanie pomiarów, diagnostyka i usuwanie usterek opracowywanie dokumentacji technicznej projektowanej automatyki i szafy sterowniczej współpracę z działem sprzedaży, wsparcia projektowego i serwisu Czego oczekujemy wykształcenia wyższego (automatyka, elektrotechnika, mechatronika lub pokrewne) znajomości zasad działania oraz prawidłowej eksploatacji układów chłodniczych pomp ciepła znajomości jednego z systemów automatyki (Siemens, Beckhoff itp.) pozwalającej na realizację sterowania zgodnie z oczekiwaniami klienta oraz zapewniającą prawidłową pracę urządzeń i instalacji umiejętności czytania schematów elektrycznych i dokumentacji technicznej gotowości do wyjazdów służbowych na terenie całego kraju, prawo jazdy kat. B Mile widziane: znajomości produktów firmy Viessmann i Carrier, w szczególności z zakresu pomp ciepła uprawnień SEP, F-GAZ i pokrewne Zakres wynagrodzenia Wynagrodzenie roczne na tym stanowisku wynosi od 96 072 – 119 780 PLN brutto rocznie. Na wysokość wynagrodzenia w tym przedziale mogą wpływać m.in. umiejętności, wykształcenie, doświadczenie oraz inne indywidualne kwalifikacje wybranego kandydata. Benefity Oferujemy konkurencyjny pakiet całkowitego wynagrodzenia, który może obejmować dodatkowe świadczenia oraz inicjatywy wspierające dobrostan pracowników. Zakres świadczeń różni się w zależności od stanowiska i lokalizacji i ma na celu wspieranie zdrowia, bezpieczeństwa oraz sukcesu pracowników. Równe traktowanie w procesie rekrutacji Carrier zobowiązuje się do przestrzegania zasad równego traktowania oraz nie dyskryminacji. Wszyscy wykwalifikowani kandydaci będą brani pod uwagę w procesie rekrutacji bez względu na rasę, kolor skóry, religię, płeć, orientację seksualną, tożsamość płciową, pochodzenie narodowe, wiek, niepełnosprawność lub jakąkolwiek inną kategorię chronioną na mocy obowiązujących przepisów prawa. Jeśli potrzebujesz racjonalnego wsparcia w celu ukończenia procesu aplikacyjnego, udziału w rozmowie kwalifikacyjnej lub innego etapu rekrutacji, prosimy o kontakt pod adresem Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com. items.desc: Location Remote from Poland Experience Senior Hi there! If you’re seeking a high-impact role within an ambitious and fast-growing software house, you might have just found your perfect match! Our client operates a high-scale, AI-powered Intelligent Observability Platform serving complex, enterprise digital environments. We are hiring a Kubernetes Security & Networking Specialist to harden and secure service-to-service communication across large-scale Kubernetes clusters. You will focus on cloud-native network security, network policies, identity isolation, and eBPF-based tooling (Cilium) to safeguard multi-tenant data pipelines. Recruitment stages 1. Rozmowa z HR 2. Rozmowa techniczna (45-60 min.) 3. Spotkanie z klientem (45 min.) What will be your responsibilities? Design, implement, and maintain service-to-service security policies within production Kubernetes clusters using Cilium (or similar eBPF/CNI solutions). Enforce zero-trust network policies, identity-based access control, and TLS/mTLS encryption across microservices. Hardened EKS/Kubernetes cluster configurations, container security standards, and vulnerability management. Partner with client security, platform, and architecture teams to integrate security gates into CI/CD pipelines. Troubleshoot complex networking, CNI, and traffic isolation issues in regulated enterprise environments. Requirements Strong track record in K8s security, RBAC, network policies, and cluster hardening. Deep experience with Cilium, Calico, Tigera, or Service Mesh technologies (Istio/eBPF). Hands-on experience with AWS (EKS, IAM/IRSA, KMS, VPC) and Terraform. Familiarity with OIDC/SSO, secrets management, image scanning, and compliance controls. Willingness to participate in pre-scheduled evening alignment calls (17:00–21:00 CET) with US teams. 180 - 250 PLN netto per month - B2B gross per month - Employment Contract
