Viessmann jest światowym liderem w dziedzinie zrównoważonych rozwiązań klimatycznych i energetycznych, zajmującym się tworzeniem przestrzeni życiowych dla przyszłych pokoleń. Obecnie, jako część grupy Carrier, firma Viessmann łączy innowacyjne technologie z silnym zaangażowaniem w ochronę środowiska, promując zrównoważony rozwój i komfort. Do głównych zadań osoby na tym stanowisku należeć będzie terminowe wykonywanie przeglądów, napraw, usuwanie awarii urządzeń oraz realizacja prac bezpiecznie i zgodnie z zasadami bezpieczeństwa Carrier. Opis stanowiska Dołącz do naszego zespołu serwisowego i wspieraj klientów w zakresie uruchamiania, konfiguracji oraz diagnostyki systemów automatyki dla pomp ciepła i instalacji HVAC. Na tym stanowisku będziesz odpowiadać za programowanie i konfigurację sterowników, wykonywanie pomiarów, usuwanie usterek oraz zapewnienie prawidłowej pracy urządzeń i instalacji. Wielkopolskie / woj. Mazowieckie / woj. items.desc: About Fresha Fresha is the leading AI-powered operating system for the global beauty and wellness industry, giving businesses everything they need to run smarter, grow faster and build stronger client relationships. In May 2026, Fresha secured an $80M growth investment from KKR at a valuation of $1B , officially reaching unicorn status and bringing total funding raised to $285M. Already profitable, Fresha is using this investment to accelerate global expansion and drive the next generation of AI and product innovation. Today, Fresha operates at global scale, with offices across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. Our platform is trusted by 130,000+ beauty and wellness businesses across 120 countries , with more than 1.5 billion appointments booked to date. Our mission is simple: help beauty and wellness businesses grow by giving them the technology they need to attract clients, manage their operations and run their business in one place. We’re continuing to scale rapidly across markets, teams and products, making this an exciting time to join us. Role Overview Compliance (GRC) Engineer | 11th floor, Rondo 1, 00-124 Warsaw | Four days a week in office You'll join the Compliance team and report to the Head of Compliance. We want an engineer first, not a compliance expert: someone who understands regulation and builds systems that prove compliance continuously and automatically. You'll work closely with Security, Platform, IT and product engineering teams. This is our first GRC Engineer hire. We run GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001 and the UK NIS Regulations, and we're building PCI DSS Level 1 right now. SOC 2 Type II and the EU AI Act come next. Much evidence is still collected by hand. Your job is to make compliance run on code, so we're audit-ready every day, not just in audit season. Compliance should keep pace with business and engineering, never slow it down. AI is standard here. You get Claude, Codex or Cursor from day one. Use them to move fast, and own every output before it counts as audit evidence. What You'll Do Automate evidence: Build integrations that pull control evidence from cloud, identity, endpoint, CI/CD and HR systems into Sprinto, our compliance platform. Monitor controls continuously: Write checks that catch drift in access, encryption, logging, patching and change approval, and alert the owner. Ship compliance as code: Put guardrails in pipelines and infrastructure as code so non-compliant changes fail before production. Map once, comply many: Run one control set mapped to PCI DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR and NIS2. Own the platform: Keep Sprinto clean as the system of record. Fix broken integrations, controls and ownership. Build PCI DSS Level 1: We're building the programme now. Bake automation into controls, scope, cardholder data flows and network diagrams from day one, generated from source where possible. Make audits boring: Give auditors repeatable, automated evidence and lead technical walkthroughs. Work with engineering teams: Turn findings from Security, Platform and IT into fixes engineers can ship, as PRs and tickets. Report: Dashboards on control health, evidence freshness and audit readiness for leadership. Shape AI governance: Help build AI controls as the EU AI Act lands. Our compliance stack: Sprinto as the system of record for controls, evidence and training. In scope today: GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001 and the UK NIS Regulations. In build now: PCI DSS Level 1. Next: SOC 2 and the EU AI Act. What you'll automate against: Services in Ruby, Elixir and TypeScript, with Kafka, Postgres and Kubernetes, shipping around 3,000 deploys a week. What We're Looking For Experience: 3+ years as a software, platform, cloud, SRE or security engineer. Compliance automation experience is a strong plus. Code: Strong in Python, Go or similar. You've built and run production services and integrations, not just scripts. Cloud: Hands-on experience (AWS preferred): IAM, logging, and infrastructure as code such as Terraform. Frameworks: Familiar with at least one of PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or HIPAA. You don't need to be an expert, but you know what a control must prove. Compliance platforms: Experience with Sprinto, Vanta, Drata or similar, and their integrations. Delivery: CI/CD and git-based workflows (for example GitHub Actions). Evidence you can defend: You think about what happens when an integration silently stops or a check passes on the wrong data. You design for it rather than finding out at audit. AI in your workflow: You use AI tools day to day, know where they help and where they don't, and review what comes back before it ships. Clear writing: You can explain a control to an engineer and a risk to an exec. Ownership: You'll shape how a lean team works, not follow a playbook. items.desc: Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture. Role overview: The Data Steward supports the maintenance, quality, and governance of master and operational data across the organisation. Working under the guidance of the Data Steward Lead and Data Owners, this role focuses on day-to-day data validation, issue identification, and remediation support, helping ensure data is accurate, complete, and fit for use. The role focuses on commercial data domains, including consumer and pricing data, as well as customer and product master data. The role provides an excellent opportunity to build strong business and data foundations, develop knowledge of end-to-end data flows, and gain exposure to enterprise data management practices within a complex, multinational environment. The Data Steward acts as an operational bridge between business users and data governance teams, contributing to reliable reporting, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance. We are building a local team of four Data Stewards to strengthen our data capabilities and encourage close collaboration and knowledge sharing within the team. If you are looking for an opportunity to develop your data expertise and be part of a growing team, we would love to hear from yo u. Key responsibilities: Data Quality & Stewardship Support Perform routine data quality checks on assigned data domains to validate accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Support the review, validation, and correction of master data attributes, hierarchies, and mappings, primarily across Product, Customer, and Pricing data. Raise data quality issues clearly and promptly, logging defects and supporting remediation activities under supervision. Assist with monitoring data quality metrics and dashboards, escalating recurring or critical issues where appropriate. Collaboration & Business Engagement Work closely with Data Steward Lead, Senior Data Stewards, Data Owners, Business Process Owners, and Product Owners to understand data requirements and business rules. Support data-related queries from markets and operating units, ensuring responses are timely and traceable. Participate in data forums, working groups, or governance sessions, contributing insights and learning from experienced stakeholders. Data Standards & Documentation Assist in documenting data definitions, standards, business rules, and procedures as defined by Data Owners and governance teams. Help maintain data guidelines and playbooks to enable consistent and accurate data maintenance by business users. Support change adoption by ensuring data requirements are understood during new capability rollouts or enhancements. Tools, Systems & Learning Use enterprise data management tools (e.g., Informatica IDMC) to perform data reviews and basic analysis. Support validation of key data sources, such as SAP, Trade Promotion Management systems, sell-out/POS portals, and third-party data providers (e.g., NielsenIQ/IRI). Develop knowledge of end-to-end data flows supporting capabilities such as Customer Planning, Trade Promotions, and Net Revenue Management. items.desc: DESCRIPTION Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their product is delivered, from desktop to doorstep. Across the globe we have more than a thousand Fulfilment Centres, thousands of Delivery Stations, tens of thousands of machines, and hundreds of thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right product gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time. Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day. We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operation is built on the way teams bond and the work ethic that enables our business to run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world. Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network. Purpose of Job We are seeking a Refrigeration Specialist who will support the safety, performance, and operational continuity of refrigeration systems across the Amazon portfolio. This role focuses on monitoring, first level triage, work order accuracy, documentation, and coordination with local engineering teams and vendors. The Refrigeration Specialist will help ensure timely responses to alarms, high quality work order management, and adherence to refrigeration processes and compliance standards. We are seeking a junior specialist with solid technical fundamentals in refrigeration or HVAC and the ambition to grow into a more advanced Refrigeration role over time. Key job responsibilities Vendor and Ticket Management Ensure end to end accuracy of refrigeration work orders by validating asset selection, severity, and technical descriptions. Coordinate vendor dispatches according to established SOPs, follow up on ETAs and on site presence, and track service notes and FGAS documentation. Support the creation and progression of PRs/POs to facilitate repairs. Remote Monitoring and Alarm Resolution Monitor refrigeration alarms and temperature data through BMS and monitoring platforms. Identify anomalies and escalate following established triage SOPs. Support data collection and basic reporting to help senior engineers identify recurring issues and optimize system reliability. Documentation Maintenance Contribute to refrigeration documentation by adding case studies, SOP updates, workflows, and troubleshooting learnings to support AMOC and RME teams. Metrics Support Help prepare and validate refrigeration KPIs and dashboards, flagging data gaps and recurring issues for senior team members. Team Capability Share refrigeration knowledge to support shift handovers and team discussions. Help onboard new team members and reinforce correct triage and work order processes across shifts. Process and SOP Adherence Follow established refrigeration workflows and provide feedback to improve alarm handling, work order processes, and documentation. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Knowledge of generic mechanical room infrastructure such as chillers, cooler units, and fan controls Experience communicating technical details verbally and in writing Knowledge of MS-Office tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio Technical diploma, vocational certification, or equivalent qualification in refrigeration, HVAC, cooling systems, or a related technical field. Ability to read dashboards and flag basic trends related to system performance. Ability to work shifts in a 24/7 environment. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Knowledge of FGAS regulations and compliance requirements. Familiarity with natural refrigerant solutions (e.g., CO2, R290) and their safety, performance, and maintenance considerations. Hands on experience working with refrigeration, HVAC, or building maintenance systems. Proficiency in an additional language relevant to AMOC's operational footprint (e.g., Italian, German, French, Spanish). Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. This role focuses on monitoring, first level triage, work order accuracy, documentation, and coordination with local engineering teams and vendors. The Refrigeration Specialist will help ensure timely responses to alarms, high quality work order management, and adherence to refrigeration processes and compliance standards. Documentation Maintenance Contribute to refrigeration documentation by adding case studies, SOP updates, workflows, and troubleshooting learnings to support AMOC and RME teams. Metrics Support Help prepare and validate refrigeration KPIs and dashboards, flagging data gaps and recurring issues for senior team members. Team Capability Share refrigeration knowledge to support shift handovers and team discussions. Help onboard new team members and reinforce correct triage and work order processes across shifts. Process and SOP Adherence Follow established refrigeration workflows and provide feedback to improve alarm handling, work order processes, and documentation. Ability to read dashboards and flag basic trends related to system performance. Ability to work shifts in a 24/7 environment. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Knowledge of FGAS regulations and compliance requirements. Familiarity with natural refrigerant solutions (e.g., CO2, R290) and their safety, performance, and maintenance considerations. Hands on experience working with refrigeration, HVAC, or building maintenance systems. Proficiency in an additional language relevant to AMOC's operational footprint (e.g., Italian, German, French, Spanish). Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. items.desc: Vill du jobba med modern datateknik och bygga lösningar som ger verkligt affärsvärde? Som Data Engineer på QueensLab bygger du dataplattformar och dataflöden som hjälper våra kunder att få ut mer av sin information. Ditt arbete spänner från insamling och bearbetning av data till skalbara lösningar som gör analys, datadrivna beslut och AI möjliga. Hos oss möts teknik, AI och affärsförståelse i lösningar som fungerar i praktiken och gör skillnad för kunden. Om rollen I rollen samarbetar du tätt med kunder och kollegor i tvärfunktionella team för att designa, bygga och utveckla moderna datalösningar. Du lägger en stabil och skalbar grund för analys, maskininlärning och AI-baserade tjänster. Dataplattformar och dataflöden Designa och bygga skalbara datalösningar utifrån verksamhetens behov. Bygga och optimera pipelines som samlar in, transformerar och levererar data – i realtid såväl som i batch. Arbeta med integration, orkestrering och automatisering av dataflöden. Bygga lösningar som hanterar stora datamängder effektivt och tillförlitligt. Data för analys och AI Samarbeta med data scientists, arkitekter och utvecklare för att göra AI- och ML-lösningar möjliga. Utforma dataflöden och plattformar som gör data tillgänglig och användbar för analys och maskininlärning. Lägga grunden för datadrivna beslut och nya digitala tjänster. Kvalitet, prestanda och plattformar Se till att data håller hög kvalitet, är tillförlitlig och presterar väl. Jobba med molnplattformar, containerteknik och moderna utvecklingsflöden. Bidra till en datainfrastruktur som är robust, säker och redo för framtiden. Utvärdera och införa nya tekniker och arbetssätt som gör våra lösningar bättre. Teknikområden Hos oss arbetar du med moderna verktyg och tekniker inom data engineering, moln och DevOps. Några exempel: Programmering och databearbetning: Python och SQL. Molnplattformar: Azure, AWS och Google Cloud. Dataorkestrering och transformation: Databricks, Dagster, dbt och DLT. Databearbetning och infrastruktur: Docker, DuckDB och Kubernetes. Lagring och datahantering: MinIO, LakeFS och Snowflake. DevOps: CI/CD och Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Vilken teknik vi använder skiljer sig mellan uppdrag och förändras över tid. Du behöver inte kunna hela stacken – det viktiga är att du har en stabil grund, är nyfiken på nya verktyg och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med oss. Vem söker vi? Du har erfarenhet av data engineering eller angränsande områden och vill bygga moderna, tillförlitliga datalösningar. Du arbetar strukturerat och analytiskt och motiveras av tekniska utmaningar som gör skillnad för kunden. Erfarenhet av data engineering, dataplattformar eller utveckling av dataintensiva system. Goda kunskaper i Python, SQL eller liknande tekniker för databearbetning. Förståelse för dataflöden, datamodellering, transformation och integration. Erfarenhet av molnplattformar och moderna verktyg för att hantera data. Insikt i datakvalitet, prestanda, skalbarhet och tillförlitlighet. Vana att samarbeta med utvecklare, arkitekter, data scientists och kunder. Du kommunicerar väl och delar gärna med dig av det du kan. Som person Du är analytisk och strukturerad och tycker om att skapa ordning i komplex information. Du tar ansvar för dina lösningar, är nyfiken på ny teknik och drivs av att hitta smartare sätt att lösa problem. Du trivs i samarbete med andra och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap. Du är kvalitetsmedveten och pragmatisk – för dig är tillförlitlighet och kundnytta lika viktiga som själva tekniken. Därför QueensLab Hos QueensLab får du arbeta med modern teknik i uppdrag där data, AI och digital utveckling möts. Du får möjlighet att påverka tekniska lösningar, utforska nya verktyg och samarbeta med kompetenta kollegor för att skapa verkligt värde för våra kunder. Vi uppmuntrar kunskapsdelning, teknisk utveckling och nya idéer. AI är en naturlig del av våra arbetssätt – både i vår egen verksamhet och i de lösningar vi utvecklar tillsammans med våra kunder. Vill du bygga framtidens datalösningar tillsammans med oss? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig. items.desc: Chalmers strategi 2041 har ett tydligt mål: att kraftigt stärka Chalmers akademiska position, både nationellt och internationellt, och etablera Chalmers bland Europas främsta tekniska universitet. Genom att systematiskt bygga upp resurser för excellens och ge forskningsledande fakultet långsiktiga förutsättningar skapar vi möjligheter för forskning på högsta internationella nivå. Chalmers tekniska högskola söker en vicerektor för forskning och hållbar utveckling som ska leda Chalmers forskning mot strategins mål i en tid när artificiell intelligens och andra nya teknologier snabbt förändrar hur forskning bedrivs, organiseras och finansieras. Nuvarande vicerektors förordnande löper ut den 30 april 2027, och vi söker nu en efterträdare. Om oss Chalmers tekniska högskola strävar efter akademisk excellens och tar oss an samhällets och industrins utmaningar och behov. Vi erbjuder en kreativ och dynamisk miljö för forskning, utbildning, innovation och tillämpad vetenskap. Chalmers är ett forskningsintensivt tekniskt universitet med forskning och forskarutbildning vid tolv institutioner. Högskoleövergripande forskningsmiljöer och initiativ knyter samman verksamheten över institutionsgränserna. Beskrivning av uppdraget Som vicerektor för forskning och hållbar utveckling leder du utvecklingen av Chalmers forskning och forskarutbildning, med ett delegerat högskoleövergripande ansvar och ett självständigt mandat att driva, bereda och utveckla initiativ inom dessa områden. Du arbetar i nära samverkan med prorektor med ansvar för akademisk miljö och excellens, som bland annat ansvarar för strategisk fakultetsförnyelse, forskningsinfrastruktur och rekrytering av forskningsledande fakultet. Ansvarsgränssnitt och prioriteringar samordnas inom högskoleledningen. En viktig strategisk utvecklingsuppgift under mandatperioden är att leda Chalmers arbete med AI for science, alltså hur artificiell intelligens och datadrivna metoder förändrar forskningens frågeställningar, metoder och arbetssätt. Utvecklingen berör hela bredden av Chalmers forskning, inte bara datavetenskap, och dessa metoder blir en integrerad del av forskningen inom allt från materialforskning till samhällsbyggnad. Vi söker därför inte en person från en viss disciplin, utan en forskare som använder dessa metoder i sin egen forskning och kan leda utvecklingen inom hela Chalmers. Du ska vara den i Chalmers ledning som bär den frågan, följer utvecklingen i ett snabbt föränderligt forskningslandskap och omsätter den i strategiskt utvecklingsarbete och konkreta satsningar, arbetssätt och prioriteringar för Chalmers forskning, i linje med strategins mål. items.desc: Junior Systemutvecklare Om Samhall Samhall finns till för att skapa en mer inkluderande arbetsmarknad där alla ses som en tillgång. Vårt uppdrag är att skapa meningsfulla jobb för personer med funktionsnedsättning. Varje år anvisas ca 2 000 personer till oss från Arbetsförmedlingen och det vi gör är att erbjuda dem en stabil plattform att stå på och möjlighet att träna sina förmågor och utveckla sin kompetens. Vårt viktigaste mål är att 1 500 personer varje år ska lämna oss för ett arbete utanför Samhall. Oavsett var du jobbar i vår organisation är vårt uppdrag och våra mål högst närvarande. Övertygelsen om att alla människor har kompetens är en kompass och en drivkraft för oss alla. Vi tror att du som läser detta känner lika starkt för det som vi. Vi är 24 000 anställda, varav cirka 1500 chefer och specialister, med verksamhet över hela landet. Tillsammans arbetar vi för en mer inkluderande arbetsmarknad som gagnar individer, organisationer och samhället i stort. Nu söker vi två juniora systemutvecklare med placering på vårt kontor i Linköping eller Stockholm. Det här är början på din karriär. Erfarna kollegor handleder dig i två hantverk samtidigt: traditionell utveckling, som att läsa kod, felsöka och tolka loggar, och agentbaserat arbete, som att skriva tydliga instruktioner, granska resultatet och bygga enkla tester av det. Kom och gör skillnad tillsammans med oss! Om rollen Som systemutvecklare arbetar du i ett av produktteamen i Teknik, som är en enhet i avdelningen STT (Strategi, Tjänster och Teknik). Du rapporterar till funktionschefen för Systemutvecklare. Närmast samarbetar du med produktägaren och de andra utvecklarna i teamet, och med systemingenjörerna som bygger plattformen ni levererar på. Mycket av koden skrivs tillsammans med kodagenter som Claude Code, Codex, Cursor och Copilot. Du beskriver vad som ska byggas, granskar det agenterna tar fram och ansvarar för att det fungerar i produktion, oavsett vem eller vad som skrev raden. Våra system är i huvudsak skrivna i TypeScript och C#. Agenterna gör det lättare att arbeta i ett språk du inte kan sedan tidigare, så du lär dig det andra på jobbet. Det som räknas är att du förstår koden du checkar in. En del av arbetet är att flytta befintliga integrationer från Logic Apps och repon från Azure DevOps till GitHub. Det är sällan det roligaste, men det ger teamen en grund att bygga vidare på. Ditt team är placerat på flera olika orter, vilket innebär att en stor del av samarbetet sker digitalt. Du har alltid tillgång till en kontorsplats, men behöver också trivas med att arbeta och samarbeta med kollegor på distans. Vår riktning Samhall STT genomgår en teknisk transformation där ökad rådighet, datadrivet arbetssätt och autonoma team är centrala ledstjärnor. Vi rör oss från SaaS-first mot ökad egenutveckling, cloud native och datacentrisk arkitektur, med AI som en naturlig del av hur vi bygger och levererar. Vi bygger långsiktig förmåga genom moderna arbetssätt, tydligt produktansvar och ett starkt fokus på kvalitet, effekt och kontinuerlig förbättring. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Bidra till nya funktioner genom att beskriva vad som ska göras, granska kodagenternas förslag och rätta det som inte håller. Lära dig stacken, koden och verksamheten tillräckligt väl för att avgöra om en lösning löser rätt problem. Skriva och förbättra tester. Delta i kodgranskning av både kollegors och agenters kod. Vi söker dig som har Utbildning inom datavetenskap, systemvetenskap, egna projekt som visar vad du kan, eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet inom området. Grundläggande vana att läsa och skriva kod i minst ett modernt språk. Provat på att arbeta med kodagenter, gärna i egna projekt. Vana vid Git. Personliga egenskaper På Samhall utgår vi från våra gemensamma värderingar, som vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, samarbetar och utvecklas tillsammans. Vi söker dig som känner igen dig i våra värderingar och vill bidra till att omsätta dem i det dagliga arbetet. Jag gör mitt bästa. När något behöver göras tar du initiativ, och när något är oklart frågar du. Det en agent föreslår testar och granskar du innan det går vidare, och du står för det du levererar. Vi gör varandra bättre. I kodgranskningar ger du återkoppling som går att använda och tar emot den du själv får. Du delar information i tid, så att kollegor på andra orter inte behöver vänta på dig. Vi är nyfikna och lär nytt. Stöter du på något du inte förstår tar du reda på hur det fungerar. Du prövar nya arbetssätt inom våra gemensamma ramar och delar med dig av det du lär dig. Ansökan och övrig information Vill du bli en av oss? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! På Samhall arbetar människor med många olika bakgrunder och erfarenheter, det tror vi gör oss till en mer kreativ och rolig arbetsplats. Därför söker vi alltid efter personer som på olika sätt kan bidra till att bredda våra perspektiv. Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning Tjänstgöringsgrad: Heltid Befattningens placering: Linköping eller Stockholm …

items.desc: Kravanalytiker inom försäkring och finansiella tjänster Uppdragsbeskrivning Vi söker nu efter dig som är erfaren kravanalytiker till ett större verksamhets- och IT-initiativ inom försäkringsområdet. I rollen kommer du att arbeta brett med kravanalys genom hela utvecklingsprocessen. Arbetet omfattar bland annat behovsanalys, dialog med verksamhetsexperter, framtagning och kvalitetssäkring av krav samt löpande samarbete med utvecklingsteam, leverantörer och andra intressenter inom och utanför organisationen. Vi söker dig som har god förståelse för försäkringsbranschen, gärna med erfarenhet av livförsäkring och pensionslösningar. Du har en kombination av verksamhetsförståelse och teknisk kompetens och är van vid att omsätta komplexa verksamhetsbehov till tydliga och användbara krav. Erfarenhet av större systemförändringar, systemimplementationer och datamigreringar är meriterande. Det är särskilt intressant om du har arbetat med etablerade verksamhetssystem inom försäkrings- och pensionsområdet. Vi ser även gärna att du har erfarenhet av testarbete och kvalitetssäkring. Teamet arbetar utifrån ett T-format kompetenstänk, vilket innebär att du förväntas kunna bidra inom fler områden än ditt huvudsakliga kompetensområde. Arbetet bedrivs i ett agilt team där samarbete, kommunikation och eget ansvar är viktiga delar av vardagen. Krav på kompetens och erfarenhet Gedigen erfarenhet av kravanalys i komplexa IT- och verksamhetsmiljöer. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen, gärna inom livförsäkring och pension. Teknisk förståelse och förmåga att fungera som en länk mellan verksamhet och IT. Erfarenhet av dialog med verksamhetsexperter, utvecklingsteam och externa leverantörer. Erfarenhet av test och kvalitetssäkring. Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Erfarenhet av agilt arbetssätt. Meriterande Erfarenhet av större systemimplementationer och migreringsprojekt. Erfarenhet av systemlösningar för liv- och pensionsförsäkring. Erfarenhet av Lumera eller liknande plattformar. Att arbeta på Sylog Sedan starten 2002 har vi haft en tydlig vision: medarbetaren ska stå i centrum. Genom vår modell kombinerar vi friheten och självbestämmandet som förknippas med eget företagande med tryggheten i en fast anställning. Hos oss får du stor möjlighet att påverka din situation – från val av uppdrag och arbetssätt till arbetstid och kompetensutveckling. Vi värdesätter både din specialistkompetens och din personlighet och vill att du ska trivas, utvecklas och känna gemenskap med dina kollegor. Utöver spännande teknik och utmanande uppdrag skapar vi gemenskap genom bland annat after works, aktivitetsveckor, föreläsningar, konferenser och utbildningar. Vill du vara med och säkerställa kvaliteten i avancerade fysiska produkter? Då vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig!

items.desc: Organisation It-avdelningen Kommun Stockholm Län Stockholms län Utlyst 13 november 2026 Ansök senast 30 november 2026 Referensnummer A684.903/2026 Arbetsplatsbeskrivning Är du redo för en större uppgift? Polismyndigheten är Sveriges största myndighet med ca 40 000 medarbetare över hela landet. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till Polisens kritiska samhällsuppdrag – att öka tryggheten och minska brottsligheten i samhället. Våra system används dygnet runt, året om: som anställd på IT-avdelningen är du därför en integrerad del av den polisiära verksamheten. Till BBVS söker nu flera seniora systemutvecklare med inriktning Java, för placering i någon av våra utvecklingsgrupper. I vår enhet finns system som är kritiska det brottsutredande och brottsförebyggande uppdraget: vi ansvarar bland annat för hjärtat i polisens utredningsarbete, som ligger till grund för det moderna utredningsarbetet. Vi har också ansvar för katastrofsystem, fotbojor och avancerad finansiell inhämtning. I vår enhet får du därför arbeta med polisiära system med många användare och integrationer, där funktion, tillgänglighet, prestanda och säkerhet alltid står i fokus. Arbetsbeskrivning IT-miljön på polisens IT-avdelning är stor och komplex, vilket skapar en varierande och utmanande vardag där vi står inför en händelserik tid med mycket nyutveckling. De agila IT-teamen hos oss är tvärfunktionella och arbetar tillsammans kring utveckling, med uppdraget att skapa system i världsklass. Rollen som senior utvecklare innebär ett stort ansvar – inte bara för utveckling, utan även för driftplattform, teknik och arkitektur – vilket ger dig en unik möjlighet att påverka mer än i många andra stora organisationer. På vår IT-avdelning ansvarar alla grupper för hela produktens livscykel, det vill säga både nyutveckling, vidareutveckling och förvaltning. En arbetsdag kan innebära allt från att du deltar i behovs-/kravarbetet där du med dina idéer bidrar till lösningar till att du utvecklar nya förmågor, vårdar nuvarande system eller löser kritiska säkerhetsproblem. Här utmanas vi ständigt i att tänka nytt då vi har en komplex problemdomän med höga krav på tillgänglighet, tillförlitlighet och prestanda. Vi ser att du är en person som har förmågan att identifiera möjligheter och förbättringsområden i vår ständigt föränderliga miljö, uppmärksamma dessa och sedan ta ansvar att dessa omhändertas. Du är en nyfiken och drivande lagspelare som har lätt för att kommunicera och samarbeta. Vår målsättning är att leverera rätt sak i rätt tid och genom kunskapsdelning och gemensam rörelse framåt både inom teknik och arbetssätt ständigt utmana oss själva. För oss är det viktigt att du är rätt person och att du vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss. Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper. items.title: Junior IT Administrator Endpoint and Support
items.card: You will connect Windows endpoints, device enrolment and identity administration while ensuring that ticket handling and software deployment receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain. The environment rewards early questions, visible trade-offs and engineering discipline. Security and operability belong in the design.
items.desc: A partner company is strengthening its team, and Nordic Investin is recruiting a Junior IT Administrator Endpoint and Support. You want technical choices, delivery and production behaviour to reinforce each other, even when the constraints are difficult. The partner is strengthening its capability in responsive endpoint administration and practical user support. You will connect Windows endpoints, device enrolment and identity administration while ensuring that ticket handling and software deployment receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain. The environment rewards early questions, visible trade-offs and engineering discipline. Security and operability belong in the design. How you will work You will work with product, architecture, security, operations and domain colleagues. The partner values short feedback loops, evidence from real systems and direct communication. This role calls for strong foundations, curiosity and the discipline to learn quickly. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process. What you will do Own the practical direction for responsive endpoint administration and practical user support. Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for Windows endpoints and device enrolment. Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around identity administration. Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting ticket handling. Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve software deployment. Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through knowledge articles. What you will bring Relevant experience delivering responsive endpoint administration and practical user support in a demanding environment. Strong working knowledge of Windows endpoints and device enrolment. Practical experience applying identity administration and ticket handling. Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving software deployment. Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership. Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information. Experience that would add value Experience from growing companies and internal IT service teams. Exposure to knowledge articles in a cross-functional or multi-team environment. Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations. A background that can succeed here Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of responsive endpoint administration and practical user support is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement. What makes the opportunity interesting The role offers meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on responsive endpoint administration and practical user support gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures. The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision. The recruitment conversation Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you. How to apply Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.

items.desc: Join us to shape the future! Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. Working at Teamtailor means being part of a dynamic, fast-paced tech company that values impact and responsibility. Our workplace fosters an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully to the growth of the company. Building a diverse team with a wide range of experiences, skills, and backgrounds has always been central to Teamtailor’s mission, and it remains a strength today. We welcome all individuals who share our vision and are committed to contributing to our collective success. Join us in helping companies and people communicate in more meaningful ways to make life-changing decisions together. About the role! We are now looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data & Analytics team, based in Stockholm. Our Data & Analytics team helps teams across Teamtailor make better, more informed decisions through reliable and accessible data. As a Data Analyst, you'll play a key role in developing and improving our reporting and analytics capabilities, turning complex data into clear, actionable insights that support the business. We're also strengthening our data foundation and evolving how we approach analytics, so you'll have the opportunity to help shape our next generation of reporting, from improving existing dashboards to building new solutions on top of a scalable, trusted data foundation. You'll collaborate closely with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to Product, Finance and People, and report to our Director of Data & Analytics. This is a great role for someone a few years into their data career, ideally in SaaS, who enjoys both the technical work and the conversations with the people who use it. Key responsibilities! Reporting & Insights Build and maintain dashboards and reports that help teams track performance and make data-driven decisions. Turn business questions into clear analyses, and present findings in a way that leads to action. Keep our reporting landscape clean: review what exists, retire what's no longer used and document what stays. Make sure reporting builds on shared metric definitions, so teams see the same consistent and trusted numbers. Help modernize our BI environment, including migrating existing dashboards and developing new reporting solutions. Enabling the Business Help colleagues self-serve through documentation, training and well-built dashboards. Partner with teams across Teamtailor to define and refine the KPIs that matter most to them. Proactively spot trends, risks and opportunities in the data and bring them to the right people. Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their reporting needs and turn them into scalable, maintainable solutions. Data Modelling & Quality Contribute to building and improving data models and transformations using SQL and dbt, working closely with the wider data team. Spot data quality issues and help fix them at the source rather than in the dashboard. Requirements! Analytical & Business Skills 1 to 3 years of experience in a data analyst, BI developer, or similar role. Experience from a SaaS company, with a good grasp of metrics like ARR, churn and pipeline conversion. Strong analytical skills and a structured way of breaking down problems. Comfortable working with business stakeholders, understanding their needs, and explaining data to people who aren't data experts. Excellent communication skills in English, written and spoken. Technical Skills Solid SQL skills. Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports in a modern BI tool. A keen eye for detail and data quality. An understanding of data modelling concepts and how structured datasets support reliable reporting. Nice to have Experience with dbt or other data modelling and transformation work. Experience from cleaning up, migrating or restructuring an existing reporting setup. Familiarity with version control (Git). Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or similar. What we offer! The opportunity to work for a leading employer branding and recruitment platform. Professional growth in a fast-growing environment, with ongoing training & support.️ The opportunity to collaborate with a talented and supportive team. If this opportunity excites you, we look forward to receiving your application!

items.desc: We’re looking for a Product Owner – Machine Foundation to join our SW Platform organisation. We’re responsible for the machine platform that Epiroc’s mining and construction equipment runs on. In this role you’ll help shape the core software that every machine application relies on, from our Linux-based operating system to the base functionality and middleware that support it. Do you enjoy working close to technology, collaborating with people across teams and helping turn needs into clear priorities? Then we’d love to hear from you. Your mission As Product Owner you’re responsible for the Machine Foundation product stream. You work with two agile development teams: OS team: develops our Linux-based operating system, including the service OS and secure boot. Base & Middleware team: works with base functionality and middleware that support the applications running on our machines. You connect the teams with their stakeholders, mainly the internal teams that build on the platform. You’re responsible for the product backlog in Jira and the roadmap, and you shape what goes into the OS. By listening to stakeholders and understanding their needs, you help translate them into clear epics and user stories and support the teams in focusing on what creates the most value. You work closely with each team’s Scrum Master and Tech Lead, and you collaborate with our architects in the direction of the base and middleware areas. You work closely with the Chief Product Owner on the overall platform roadmap, take part in cross-team planning and contribute to release go/no-go decisions. Each team has about 5–8 members. You’ll report to a team manager in the SW Platform organization and be part of a supportive team where knowledge sharing and learning are encouraged. You’re familiar with agile ways of working such as Scrum and with tools like Jira. You have an interest in software development and enjoy discussions with developers and architects. It’s a plus if you have experience with embedded Linux, operating systems, middleware or platform software, for example in industrial, automotive or similar products. You speak Swedish and you’re fluent in English, both written and spoken. As a person, you’re structured, communicative and collaborative. You build trusting relationships with stakeholders, help the teams find focus and handle different perspectives with care. You enjoy working with people as much as with technology and like to keep learning together with others. We know that great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. The position plays a key role in enhancing engagement with a range of partners, with the overall aim of maximizing impact and value for money. items.desc: Work Schedule Environmental Conditions Job Description As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. Responsibilities Supporting the Production team in delivering the following: Equipment and process establishment Process documentation generation and approval. Supporting the implementation and delivery of effective, safe and compliant production manufacturing operations within the agreed organisation framework. Ensuring the process for products to be manufactured is set up and maintained in accordance with GMP, Standard Operating Procedures and other regulatory agency requirements. Involvement in the equipment and process establishment and validation phases on through into routine commercial manufacturing. Actively working with and supporting other members of the project team in delivering the project goals. Supporting the implementation of staff training and development programmes to assure competency (suitably qualified and experienced personnel) and support the achievement of objectives. Working as an effective member of the project team, liaising with other SMEs as appropriate to draw in expertise. Troubleshooting manufacturing, filling, inspection packaging processes to improve fields. Tracking improvements, preventing troubleshooting solutions to key stakeholders. EH&S: Understand emergency procedures and comply with safe systems of work. Ensure compliance with environment, health and safety rules, signage and instructions at all times. Ensure prompt reporting and investigation of all accidents, near misses and breaches of rules. Qualifications/Experience: To be actively participating in a Science or Engineering based degree. Ideally Pharmaceutical sciences, Biochemistry or Chemical Engineering. Aptitude for or working knowledge of mechanical and software operation desirable. Proactive approach to work with a willingness to do what needs to be done to deliver against milestones. Pragmatic / common sense approach to problem solving. Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

items.desc: Scientist Working days: Thursday to Monday (including weekends) Location: Chesterford Research Park, Cambridge, UK Join Lonza’s Cell Expression Systems Research & Development team in Cambridge as a Scientist, contributing to the development of innovative expression vectors and mammalian cell lines. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of biopharmaceutical research, supporting the development of technologies that help bring new medicines to patients. Working pattern: This is a fully site-based, 37.5-hour-per-week role, working five days from Thursday to Monday, including both weekend days. Working hours are 7.5 hours per day, with an 8.5-hour daily attendance period including a paid one-hour lunch break. An additional Shift premium is provided to recognise the weekend working pattern. This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. What you will get: An agile career and dynamic working culture. An inclusive and ethical workplace. Compensation programs that recognise high performance, including an additional stipend for the weekend working pattern. Opportunities to develop your scientific expertise and work with innovative technologies. A variety of benefits dependent on role and location. The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits. What you will do: Contribute to the execution of expression vector and mammalian cell line development activities, supporting multiple research and development projects. Perform routine and fed-batch mammalian CHO cell culture, ensuring consistent and reliable experimental execution. Operate, maintain and support the improvement of automated equipment and workflows, including the ambr15 and cell screening platforms, working collaboratively with colleagues. Carry out sample analysis using analytical instrumentation, including HPLC and Octet systems, to generate high-quality experimental data. Independently plan and execute laboratory activities following training, demonstrating flexibility, initiative and sound scientific judgement. Maintain accurate, timely and high-quality laboratory records, and prepare presentations and datasets to communicate experimental results, progress and future plans to project teams. Keep up to date with relevant scientific literature and contribute ideas and opinions to scientific discussions, supporting the development of new technologies and collaboration across multiple research teams. What we are looking for: A degree in a relevant life sciences discipline, such as Biotechnology, Biological Sciences, Biochemistry or a related subject. Experience in mammalian cell culture, ideally including CHO cell culture and routine or fed-batch processes. Experience with analytical techniques and instrumentation such as HPLC and Octet would be advantageous. An interest in laboratory automation and high-throughput workflows, with experience using platforms such as ambr15 or cell screening systems desirable. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage laboratory activities independently and prioritise tasks effectively. Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accurate scientific records and communicate experimental findings clearly. A collaborative and proactive approach, with the flexibility to work as part of a multidisciplinary team and contribute to scientific discussions. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

items.desc: Do you have some experience working within a laboratory environment or willing to learn ? If so, then this could be the opportunity for you! We are currently recruiting for a Lab Assistant to join our Toxicology team in Alderley Park. Providing essential operational support to the Toxicology Team. Role: Laboratory Assistant (Toxicology) Role Type: Permanent Salary: £25,000 Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours per week - Monday to Friday Location: Alderley Park, Macclesfield, SK10 4TG. Our Company Cyprotex vision is to be pioneers of innovative ADME-Tox partnerships, driving delivery of safer and more effective medicines. With state-of-the-art facilities and technical expertise, we specialise in in vitro and in silico ADME-Tox services, providing a wide range of assays tailored to our client’s needs. This includes in vitro screening to support discovery projects, regulatory studies to support preclinical and clinical development, specialist mechanistic in vitro human and animal toxicity models and PBPK/QSAR modelling expertise. As well as supporting clients directly, we have a strong focus on efficiencies and innovation. Our Alderley Park site is set in the heart of Cheshire surrounded by stunning 400-acre estate, open green spaces, sweeping viewpoints, all within easy reach of Merseyside and Greater Manchester, Staffordshire, and Shropshire. Easy access to public transport. Cyprotex is part of the Evotec Group, a global leader in research. With state-of-the-art facilities and technical expertise, we provide innovative and bespoke assurance tailored to each of our client’s needs. Due to continued business growth and success, we are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic individual to join our Toxicology team. In this laboratory support role, you will assist with routine laboratory tasks while learning from experienced team members. The Role As our Laboratory Assistant, you will join a friendly and supportive team that works closely together to deliver high-quality laboratory studies. Working alongside experienced scientists, you will provide practical support for a variety of projects, helping with routine laboratory activities and general laboratory housekeeping. Our Toxicology team works with a diverse range of clients, from academic researchers to global pharmaceutical and cosmetics companies, supporting studies that contribute to the development of safer and more effective medicines and consumer products. This role is ideally suited to someone looking to start or develop a career in laboratory science. As our business continues to grow, we are looking for an enthusiastic and reliable individual to support the team's activities and contribute to the continued success of the department. Cyprotex is committed to providing training, mentoring and development opportunities to help you build a successful career within our organisation. Key Responsibilities Support the day-to-day delivery of toxicology studies through the completion of routine laboratory activities and assigned tasks. Prepare, handle, label and store reagents, consumables, compounds and biological materials in accordance with established procedures. Support the maintenance of cell cultures and laboratory materials following standard operating procedures (SOPs). Perform routine equipment checks, calibrations, cleaning and maintenance activities to ensure equipment is fit for purpose. Accurately record laboratory data, observations and activities in laboratory documentation systems and electronic databases, including LIMS where applicable. Follow quality, safety and compliance procedures at all times, ensuring data integrity and traceability requirements are met. Maintain laboratory stocks, consumables and work areas, supporting effective laboratory organisation and housekeeping. Complete assigned activities to the required quality standards and within agreed timelines. Communicate progress, raise issues and seek guidance when required to support assay delivery and team objectives. Education, Qualifications and Experience GCSEs (or equivalent) in Science, English and Mathematics. Additional science qualifications (such as A-Levels, BTEC or equivalent) or relevant laboratory experience would be advantageous but are not essential, as full training will be provided. Experience of working in a laboratory, technical or other structured environment would be beneficial. Awareness of basic laboratory practices, including the safe handling of materials and use of laboratory equipment, would be desirable. Good attention to detail and the ability to follow written instructions, procedures and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Able to organise and prioritise routine tasks to meet agreed timelines and quality standards. Experience working within a regulated laboratory, pharmaceutical, CRO or similar environment would be advantageous but is not essential. Company Benefits Include Pension on completion (but not subject to) of your 3-month probationary period. …

We are looking for a Scientist to join our New Analytes team to help drive the development of novel sensing technologies. Working closely alongside our Senior Scientist and R&D Team, you will support and execute hands-on laboratory work, own development cycles and characterise
items.desc: About SAVA All the health information we need is within us. Just below the skin. SAVA is redefining the way people interact with their health by developing the most advanced biosensing technology science has to offer, capable of accessing bodily information in a painless, real-time and affordable way. The Role At Sava we are building a next-generation biosensor capable of tracking multiple biomarkers in real-time just beneath the skin. We are looking for a Scientist to join our New Analytes team to help drive the development of novel sensing technologies. Working closely alongside our Senior Scientist and R&D Team, you will support and execute hands-on laboratory work, own development cycles and characterise sensor performance. This is an ideal role for someone early in their career who wants hands-on-responsibility, strives for ownership of their work and is looking to develop a career within biosensing. If you want to see your practical work impact a real-world application, this role would be great fit for you. What You’ll Do You will support all lab based R&D activities designed to progress new sensor technologies from conceptualisation, towards clinical validation. In this role, you will report to the New Analytes Team Lead and will: Execute laboratory work as a core part of the role, contributing across sensor testing and routine QC activities Support sensor performance characterisation using electrochemical test methods Characterise novel sensing blend formulations using defined tools and QC instrumentation Contriubute to the development and updates to test protocols, QCIs, MPIs and SOPs to improve sensor reproducibility Support knowledge transfer by generating, analysing and reporting data Champion continuous improvement by identifying areas for improvements across routine testing, protocols and day-to-day lab activities What We’re Looking For BSc or MSc in chemistry, natural sciences, bioscience or a related discipline with a strong emphasis on practical laboratory based work. Hands-on experience working with enzymes and/or biosensors (e.g. through a research project, placement or industry role). Accurate, thorough lab record keeping and attention-to-detail A pragmatic attitude and quality first mindset to approaching problems Bonus Points For Working knowledge of potentiostats (e.g. Palmsense, Metrohm) Experience in a start-up or fast-growing company (prefferably Biotech/Medical device) Experience working with biosensors (enzymmatic, aptamer, ionophore) Why Sava Few people get to work on technology that could change how millions of people understand their own bodies. Here, you will. You’ll own real problems from your first week, work alongside people who are exceptional at what they do, and see your work go straight into the product. The problems are hard, the pace is fast and the work is often messy. If that’s what gets you out of bed in the morning, we’d love to hear from you.

Derbyshire Pathology provides pathology services for Royal Derby Hospital, Chesterfield Royal Hospital and Queen's Hospital, Burton (since October 2021) and is hosted by University Hospitals of Derby and Burton NHS Foundation. We are part of a modern laboratory within Derbyshire Pathology, a joint venture for Derby, Burton and Chesterfield so this post may require cross site working. If you are an experienced HCPC registered Biomedical Scientist/Specialist Biomedical Scientist and would relish a new challenge, then we would love to hear from you. This is an exciting time to become part of a diverse team. The laboratory is covered 24 hours every day and the successful candidate would be require to work weekends on rotational basis and participate in the on-call rota. To be eligible for a band 6 you will need to have completed the IBMS Specialist Diploma or be within a few months of completing this. We’re looking for a passionate and committed individual who shares our values and want to invest in continuously to improve and transform our services. To undertake the day to day sample processing and analytical clinical investigations for Microbiology to the agreed standard of timeliness and quality. Supervise Band 5 Biomedical Scientists and MLAs within their work area. To engage in training of staff. To fully participate in on-call and weekend duties. Familiarisation and understanding of ISO 15189 standards, Health & Safety requirements; audit and training/education techniques is essential. Experience of utilising transformation methodologies to drive change and improve service delivery is also desirable. Proactive individuals, with drive and dedication will excel in this post. Closing date of applications: 29 November 2026 Interview date: 11 December 2026 As a trusted organisation at the heart of our communities, we recognise the important role we can play in supporting the public, patients, our own people and local partners in achieving the best of health for the local population and the communities in which they live by providing Exceptional Care Together Our fundamental Values of Compassion, Openness and Excellence underpin how we intend to work as a Trust and the associated behaviours are becoming embedded in all aspects of how we work. In return we will offer: Development opportunities, both professional and leadership development On-going support from recruitment to when you join our team and beyond. Staff benefits including employee assistance programme, discounted gym membership, onsite fitness classes, car schemes Key Facts: We see on average 4810 OP appointments a day. We are the 4 th busiest Trauma & Orthopaedic outpatients department in England – an average of 2077 per week. An average of 1115 patients are seen in A&Es across our network every day – 3rd largest in the country. Our hospitals admit an average of 195 emergency patients daily. Last year we undertook almost 33,700 planned surgical operations in our 57 operating theatres. We are one of only 7 Trusts nationally with more than 50 operating theatres. We carry out more than 140 elective procedures each working day. UHDB is a research active University Hospital with a large and varied portfolio of clinical trials and research opportunities for all staff. Please see attached Job description and Person Specification. To apply please click APPLY FOR THIS JOB – this link will take you to the TRAC Recruitment Site. You will need to register if you do not already have an account. UHDB is committed to fair and transparent recruitment. We welcome authentic applications that reflect your own skills, experience and motivations for the role. While we understand that candidates may use AI tools for grammar, formatting or accessibility purposes, applications that appear to be substantially AI‑generated may be subject to additional review. If this applies to your submission, we will let you know and may ask for clarification. Please ensure your application accurately represents your experience and is written in your own words. items.desc: We are expanding and are looking for an experienced Specialist Biomedical Scientist (BMS) who is ready to advance their career aspirations in a supportive and collaborative environment. At SYNLAB Essex, we believe in building a strong, collaborative team where individuals are encouraged to grow with us, not just work for us. As a part of this team, you will play a critical role in delivering top-quality laboratory services. We operate a ‘hub and spoke’ model with non-urgent community samples being analysed at our off-site hub on the outskirts of Basildon and two acute laboratories providing essential services at the hospitals. With your exceptional skills and expertise, you will be an integral part of our team, providing essential support to our laboratory operations. Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity to advance your career and make a significant impact in the field of healthcare. Apply now and join us on this exciting journey. We offer ongoing training and mentorship to help you further develop your existing skill set and advance within our organisation (we happen to be the largest clinical diagnostics company in Europe!). We are proud to be the first lab in the UK to offer some of our BMS staff the opportunity to read bacterial cultures from home, using cutting-edge BD Kiestra Synapsys technology. This role is based at our Hub site in Essex. You will join our close-knit team of 25+ Biomedical Scientists (Bands 5–7), serving two general hospitals and the local GP community, and rotate through Kiestra TLA automation (MRSA and urogenital), manual bacteriology (CL3 and mycology), NAATs, urinalysis and serology. We are UKAS accredited and an IBMS training laboratory, offering ongoing training and mentorship across Registration, Specialist Portfolio, Certificate of Achievement and MSc/HSD routes, as part of Europe's largest clinical diagnostics company. Working at the Hub will give you exposure to a broad routine and specialist repertoire. This is a 24/7 service operating across a variety of shift patterns, all of which include a 1-hour unpaid lunch break: Routine Shift: 09:00 – 17:30 Early Shift: 08:00 – 16:30 Late Shift: 11:30 – 20:00 Weekend Shifts (Saturday – Sunday): 09:00 – 17:30 We also operate an on-call service Monday to Friday (20:00 – 08:00) and over the weekend starting from 17:30. This role is based at our purpose-built Hub laboratory at Bentalls, Basildon (SS14 3BY), Dobson House at Bentalls, Basildon (SS14 3BY) is easily accessible by car via the nearby A127 and A13 road networks also using public transport you can also reach the site via Basildon Station or by catching local bus routes. SYNLAB UK & Ireland work closely with clinicians, hospitals, occupational health providers and clinical researchers to deliver comprehensive pathology services. We thrive in diverse environments, which is mirrored in our workforce, clients, customers, suppliers, communities, and partners. We believe that an inclusive workplace culture is essential for attracting and retaining talented individuals, and for building a sustainable, high-performing workforce. Our staff are crucial to our mission of making a positive impact on healthcare. We foster a culture of continuous personal development, providing scientists and staff with the support and resources needed to acquire new skills and advance their careers through learning and development opportunities, coaching, and clear career pathways. SYNLAB UK & Ireland is committed to equal opportunities and does not unlawfully discriminate based on any status or condition protected by applicable UK employment law. Based off-site in Basildon, Essex, our purpose-built, state-of-the-art hub laboratory undertakes consolidated, harmonised, routine testing as well as an increasing range of specialist laboratory work. This leaves the hospital-based ‘Essential Service Laboratories’ – also run by SYNLAB – to focus on urgent clinical laboratory tests, which require a fast turnaround time Over 450 employees service a population of over 850’000 people locally, providing over 16 million tests annually. You will be a fundamental part of our close-knit Microbiology team, providing an efficient and effective service to two general hospitals and the local GP community. In this role, you will: Perform and interpret routine and specialist biomedical investigations. Provide professional leadership to Trainee BMS, Associate Practitioners, Laboratory technicians, and MLAs. Offer technical advice to clinicians on the appropriateness of tests and timescales. Rotate through all areas of Microbiology, including: Automation Laboratory – Kiestra TLA, MRSA, and Urogenital Sections Manual Bacteriology – CL3 Mycology, and Waste Management NAATs and urinalysis Serology What you will do/Key Responsibilities: Participate in and assist with clinical trials, the development of new tests and research & validation of equipment ensuring at all times compliance with all policies as required by regulatory …

This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to research supporting UK national security within a dynamic and inclusive environment. Collaborating with a team of behavioural scientists working on related topics. We welcome candidates who bring diverse perspectives, experiences, and approaches to their work. Experience in organisational psychology. UK Citizenship. A commitment to UK national security. Desirable Criteria: Experience of conducting different types of literature review. Experience of working in a research team. We value transferable skills and real-world experience as much as formal qualifications. Our benefits include: Generous employer contribution pension 29 days annual leave plus bank holidays, along with Christmas closure Ride to work and EV car scheme available For more information, please see University of Manchester Benefits. You can also find information on our Flexible and Hybrid working here. We are an open place of enquiry and challenge. We embrace and celebrate difference, diversity and debate, and we pride ourselves on being a place of education, learning and community where we are able, within the law, to question and test received wisdom, express new ideas and explore controversial or unpopular topics and opinions. Find out more from our Freedom of Speech Policy. items.desc: NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde (NHSGGC) is one of the largest healthcare systems in the United Kingdom, employing approximately 40,000 staff across a wide range of clinical and non-clinical professions and roles. We deliver acute hospital, primary, community and mental health services to a population of over 1.15 million people, and to a wider population of 2.2 million when regional and national services are included. The role: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Clinical Embryologist to join the Assisted Conception Service at Glasgow Royal Infirmary. As part of a highly skilled multidisciplinary team, you will play a key role in supporting individuals and families throughout their fertility journey while delivering specialist embryology and andrology services. Working within one of Scotland’s leading fertility centres, you will contribute to innovative reproductive treatments and scientific advancements. NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde offers a supportive working environment, excellent professional development opportunities, and the chance to make a meaningful difference to patient care every day. NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde (NHSGGC) may be able to provide visa sponsorship for certain roles, subject to the post meeting the relevant eligibility criteria. Sponsorship is not guaranteed and will be determined on a case-by-case basis following interview and during the pre-employment verification process. Applicants must state their current right to work in their application. Please see below for more details: Skilled Worker visa and Health and Care Worker visa Duration, Location, and Working Pattern: Full-time, fixed-term for 12 months You will be based at Glasgow Royal Infirmary Working Pattern: 5 days over 7 Key responsibilities: Perform specialist embryology and andrology procedures including IVF, ICSI, cryopreservation and embryo culture Assess fertilisation outcomes, embryo development and selection for transfer or cryopreservation Undertake embryo biopsy procedures and support preimplantation genetic testing services Communicate treatment outcomes and laboratory information to patients with sensitivity and professionalism Support the day-to-day management of laboratory services, quality systems and audit activities Train, supervise and support the development of trainee embryologists and support staff Contribute to service improvement initiatives, research activities and the maintenance of regulatory compliance Knowledge, training, qualifications and/or experience required to do the job: Honours degree in a life sciences subject with a minimum 2:1 classification MSc or equivalent postgraduate qualification in a relevant scientific discipline Postgraduate qualification in Clinical Embryology Registration with the Health and Care Professions Council as a Clinical Scientist, or working towards registration and close to attainment Significant clinical embryology experience within a regulated assisted conception environment Proven experience of Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI) techniques Experience of embryo biopsy procedures is desirable What we offer: We offer a wide range of supportive policies designed to enhance your employee journey, including a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme, Cycle to Work Scheme, bursary scheme and extensive learning and development opportunities. items.card: What you'll do Viasat operates 20 geosynchronous satellites from its US and UK based Satellite Control Centres. items.desc: About us At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space. We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action. What you'll do Viasat operates 20 geosynchronous satellites from its US and UK based Satellite Control Centres. An in-orbit spacecraft engineer is required to take a responsible position as part of the Spacecraft Engineering team who perform the on-station spacecraft operations, looking after the health and performance of the satellites for Viasat current and future satellite fleets operated from the US or London. The day-to-day Key Responsibilities: To define, plan and execute operations to manage the satellite configurations to maintain their health, safety and function and could include coordinating activities among several engineering groups both within and external to the department. To assess and report on satellite health and performance by daily monitoring of their status and monitoring of long-term trends in behaviour of on-board units. To respond under pressure to satellite contingency situations by assessing satellite status, performing the correct triage, identifying the remedial response and directing recovery operations according to a well-defined incident management process. To diagnose problems as quickly as possible, determine the underlying root cause of incidents and identify workarounds or permanent solutions to prevent reoccurrence with the spacecraft manufacturer using techniques such as 8D, 5 whys, fault tree/fishbone analysis to get to the root cause of a problem and then to be able to identify corrective and preventive measures. To maintain satellite operational products such as satellite telemetry and telecommand databases, including alarm limits, to support safe and efficient operations and to maintain the routine and contingency satellite control procedures and validate updates against the satellite simulator and maintain the satellite simulators to have a fully representative test bed. To develop and maintain the reference data sets and software applications including AI and analytics applications required by the Spacecraft Engineering Department to perform the satellite health and performance monitoring, operations planning, checking and reporting to ensure early detection of problems and anomaly characterization. To ensure any training plan and accreditation are up to date and when required, the provision of any training, definition of courseware and assessments are conducted accurately, effectively and efficiently. To work with other departments of Viasat Engineering and Viasat Global Services and spacecraft manufacturer engineering support teams to investigate anomalies and develop relevant operational solutions. To develop and distribute reports including reporting of technical analysis findings and recommendations, anomaly resolution and problem root cause analyses, periodic satellite health and performance reports, insurance reports and any other reports required for regulatory reasons. To work on new satellite programs on systems engineering, operations development, integration and validation activities and to support the Viasat Engineering Space Infrastructure procurement team with program reviews and support any launch and in-orbit tests of new satellites where required. Provide support in defining and developing satellite system and subsystem requirements for ground control system and networks for new satellite programs. This includes the development of test plans, conducting acceptance tests, planning and conducting ground to satellite compatibility tests (COMPAT/SVT) with the spacecraft manufacturer, and resolving issues. Provide any support required to Viasat Engineering Space Infrastructure procurement in evaluating spacecraft procurement proposals. To respond positively to any other requests that help achieve Viasat’s goals. Specific Conditions of the Role: The Spacecraft Engineer will be required to be part of an on-call roster and therefore should be available to provide on-call support during evenings and weekends. This may require the individual to travel to the Satellite Control Centre outside of office hours within a reasonable timeframe (within 90 mins commute). Working outside of office hours may also be required occasionally to support certain planned operations. Given the scope and responsibilities of this role, the successful candidate will need the required clearance and license approvals to access country specific export-controlled information export-controlled data.
