items.desc: Summary: Do you have knowledge of water process science? Can you interpret data and turn it into easy-to-understand information? Are you looking for a role that has variety? If the answer is yes, this is a chance to take the next step in your career… We want to be the water company people want to be supplied by and want to work for. In this role as a Process Scientist in our Water Quality department, you will be instrumental in the safe and efficient management of our water treatment works. A key aspect of the position is close collaboration with Distribution Technicians, providing them with expert guidance on water treatment procedures. Additionally, you will be responsible for detailed monitoring of data trends and the systematic investigation of anomalies. Your ability to apply a logical, methodical approach will enable you to effectively investigate water quality concerns and advise on the most appropriate corrective actions. Every day is different in this role - you’ll be carrying out a mix of data analysis and on-site investigation of water quality failures at our Kent water treatment sites. Your scientific background and water treatment experience will enable you to effectively troubleshoot and determine the root cause of these issues. You will also be responsible for technical report writing, including recommendations for compliance and investigation documentation; therefore, experience in technical report writing is preferred. You’re self-motivated, well organised and enjoy problem solving. We’re a friendly, open and collaborative team that will give you lots of encouragement to share your ideas and make a difference to the success of our growing Process Science team. This role is based at our Pembury office, with site visits around the Kent area and some home working. Standard working hours are 08:30 - 17:00 - you will also be put on a standby rota to cover out of hours support. Main responsibilities: Optimise the performance and maximise the efficiency of water treatment processes. Investigate the cause of compliance/operational water quality breaches. Provide a comprehensive report detailing the findings and conclusions of the investigation. Undertake water treatment works site process audits in a timely manner. Prepare technical reports with conclusions & recommendations as required. Provision of technical support and advice to the business. Provide standby Water Quality cover out of hours for the business. You'll need: Skills / Experience / Qualifications A degree in a Scientific subject or experience in a water-based role. Knowledge of water treatment processes. Technical report writing skills. items.desc: Company ALPINE RACING LIMITED Job Description We are looking for a motivated and technically capable Junior Aerodynamicist to join our Aerodynamics department. This role contributes to the aerodynamic development of the race car within a collaborative, fast‑paced environment. You will work closely with experienced aerodynamicists and a wider group of technical specialists, gaining exposure to CFD, wind tunnel and track‑side activities while developing strong foundations in aerodynamic theory and application. The Role Working within one of the aerodynamic development teams, you will support both conceptual and iterative development activities, applying aerodynamic fundamentals to real performance challenges. This role offers valuable hands‑on exposure to wind tunnel testing, giving the opportunity to build practical experience with industry‑standard techniques and technologies. Some shift work in the wind tunnel may be required, including occasional night and weekend shifts, providing insight into live testing operations. Key aspects of the role include: Creating high‑quality CAD surface geometry using CATIA 3DX, ensuring legality, compliance with departmental standards and practicality for full‑scale application. Setting up, running and analysing CFD simulations, producing clear and structured reports that explain key aerodynamic effects and flow structures. Preparing and supporting wind tunnel programmes, including job specifications, test follow‑up and post‑test analysis. Collaborating closely with colleagues across the aero department—such as model designers, surfacers, CFD methodology engineers, wind tunnel technicians and trackside aerodynamicists—to ensure effective delivery and correlation. Proactively developing your own skills and contributing to improvements in aerodynamic methodology and development processes. The Person We are seeking a high‑potential individual with a strong technical foundation and a collaborative mindset. You will be educated to at least Bachelor’s level in Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline with significant aerodynamic content, and have a solid understanding of fluid dynamics and aerodynamic fundamentals. You will also need: A structured, analytical approach to problem solving, with strong attention to detail. Good communication and team‑working skills, and the ability to work effectively across disciplines. A proactive and diligent attitude, with the ability to work to deadlines in a time‑critical environment. Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning, with an appreciation of the wider context of race‑car development. Training and ongoing support will be provided to ensure proficiency in the tools and techniques required for CAD, CFD, wind tunnel testing and data analysis. Please note, this vacancy does not meet the criteria for skilled worker sponsorship and therefore, we are unable to accept applications from candidates that cannot provide documentary evidence of right to work in the United Kingdom. Could you use your skills and experience to support the NHS to deliver great patient care? Great patient care needs great people to support clinical teams. That’s where you come in. We’re always looking for enthusiastic, responsive, and adaptable people to join our outstanding trust. This role is an important one as you’ll be using your knowledge, experience and expertise to provide support to our hard-working frontline NHS teams. We put patients first and we expect all of our colleagues to do the same, so although NHS experience isn’t a requirement for this role you’ll need to share our passion for delivering excellent patient care and keep that passion at the forefront of your professional activity at all times. The challenges come thick and fast in this role but you’ll know that your input is contributing to the excellent experience our patients and service users have every day. As part of this work, there will be a period of consultation which may result in changes affecting some services, teams and roles. items.desc: Your New Role We have an exciting opportunity for a Resourcing Business Partner to lead the next phase of our recruitment and talent strategy within Transport Infrastructure on a permanent basis. Reporting to the People Director and working closely with senior stakeholders, you will play a key role in supporting business growth through proactive talent pipelining, strategic talent acquisition, inclusive employment practices and targeted retention initiatives. You will build on the strong foundations of an established, high-performing function, evolving our approach from vacancy-led recruitment towards a more proactive, insight-led and commercially focused model for attracting, developing and retaining talent. What will the role offer? This is a broad and influential role with the opportunity to shape the future of resourcing, talent acquisition, inclusion and retention across the business unit. You will have the autonomy to develop sustainable talent pipelines, strengthen our employee value proposition and candidate experience, and use workforce insight to drive better hiring decisions, improve recruitment return on investment and ensure we have the skills and capability needed for the future. You will also lead key ED&I, social mobility and early careers priorities, creating meaningful routes into employment for underrepresented and disadvantaged communities while supporting our people to thrive and build lasting careers. The standard hours of work are 37.5 per week. We offer a range of flexible working practices, including hybrid, part-time and flexible working patterns. With a network of offices across the UK, we are open to discussing working arrangements that meet your needs and provide flexibility as your circumstances evolve. What you will be doing: Lead and deliver a proactive recruitment and resourcing strategy aligned to business growth and future workforce requirements, spanning executive search, early careers, ED&I and inclusive recruitment on both a UK and international scale. Build sustainable internal and external talent pipelines through strategic talent mapping, talent pooling and ongoing candidate engagement. Lead the shift from vacancy-led recruitment towards proactive, insight-led talent acquisition and workforce planning. Strengthen our employee value proposition, candidate experience and recruitment capability across the organisation. Use recruitment data, workforce insight and market intelligence to improve performance, manage costs and demonstrate commercial value and return on investment. Ensure recruitment resource and team capacity are aligned to business demand, creating an agile, commercially focused and high-performing function. Develop strategic partnerships and attraction approaches that broaden access to underrepresented and disadvantaged talent communities. Implement targeted retention initiatives, using workforce data, employee feedback and attrition trends to identify risks and measure impact. Partner with HR colleagues and people managers to embed sustainable retention practices and continually improve the employee experience. Lead, advise and develop managers in areas including pay transparency, inclusive recruitment and fair, consistent selection practices. Maintain knowledge of UK and international recruitment legislation and evolving employment requirements, ensuring recruitment practices remain compliant. Lead, develop and motivate a recruitment team of 10, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. Build trusted relationships with exec and senior stakeholders, using data, insight and external market intelligence to influence workforce and talent decisions. Identify and deliver opportunities to improve recruitment processes, technology and the wider candidate and talent experience. We want to hear from you if you have: Proven experience leading a talent acquisition function. Strong commercial awareness, with evidence of improving recruitment return on investment, and managing budgets. Demonstrable experience of proactive talent acquisition, talent pipelining and talent mapping. Experience developing and delivering ED&I, social mobility or inclusive employment initiatives. Experience designing, implementing and monitoring employee retention strategies or targeted engagement initiatives. A strong understanding of employee engagement, attrition analysis and talent development. Knowledge of UK recruitment legislation and the confidence to navigate international recruitment requirements. Strong leadership, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively at senior level. A data-led and analytical approach, with the ability to translate insight into practical action and measurable outcomes. A proactive, inclusive and people-focused mindset, balanced with sound commercial judgement. We welcome applications from a diverse range of candidates. If you have most but not all of these skills and …

Developing and maintaining
items.desc: For a quarter of a century, the Jellycat family have brought joy, wonder and playful fun to people of all ages, in every part of the world. Utterly original and in a class of their own, they are currently among the most loved and collected toys of their kind. How has this gentle tribe endeared themselves to so many? Perhaps it is their whimsical expressions. Or the deliciously soft fabrics. Or the beautiful way in which they sit in your hand. Whatever it is, there is something magical and unmistakeable about each one of them. Data sits at the heart of how we understand our customers, plan our stock and run our operations. The Data Engineer builds the foundation that makes this possible: a reliable, well governed data platform on Microsoft Fabric that brings together our eCommerce and wholesale data and makes it ready for analytics, reporting and machine learning. This is a hands on role with real ownership. You will take responsibility for defined areas of the platform, from ingestion through to modelled, trusted data, with guidance and support, widening your scope as the business and the platform grow. You'll be; Designing, building and maintaining scalable, reliable data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric that ingest data from D365 F&O, our eCommerce platform and other source systems. Developing and maintaining well-structured data models in OneLake using Delta tables, PySpark and SQL, following a medallion approach and dimensional modelling principles. Working closely with analytics engineers, data analysts, data scientists and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and turn them into reusable, well-documented datasets. Building data quality checks, testing and monitoring into pipelines so issues are caught early, as well as investigating and resolving data and pipeline issues promptly and addressing root causes. Following data governance standards, including clear data definitions, lineage, documentation and access controls. Using Git and CI/CD practices, such as Azure DevOps or GitHub, for version control, code review and the deployment of pipelines and notebooks. Monitoring and optimising pipeline performance and Fabric capacity usage, balancing speed, reliability and cost. Contributing to team standards, documentation and knowledge sharing. You'll have; Essential 2+ years’ proven experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role, working across areas such as data ingestion, transformation, modelling, data quality and performance optimisation. Strong hands-on proficiency across the core data engineering languages: PySpark : experience building and optimising Spark transformations at scale, ideally in notebook-based environments such as Fabric or Databricks. Python : experience with scripting and automation around data workflows, including API ingestion, testing and orchestration. SQL : experience writing queries and transformations, and modelling data in relational and warehouse environments. Hands on experience with a modern cloud data platform, such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory or Databricks, with a willingness to deepen your Fabric skills. A good understanding of data warehousing and Lakehouse concepts, including ELT patterns, dimensional modelling and medallion architecture. Experience using Git, including working through pull requests and code reviews. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with a methodical approach to debugging data issues. Clear communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues, independently and as part of a team. Desirable You’ll ideally also have: Experience with Microsoft Fabric components, such as: Data Factory, including pipelines and orchestration. Data Engineering, including Lakehouse, notebooks and Apache Spark. Data Warehouse, including SQL endpoints and schemas. Real-Time Intelligence, including KQL databases and event ingestion. OneLake and Delta tables, including security and governance within Fabric. An understanding of D365 F&O data structures, for example through Fabric Link or Synapse Link. Power BI knowledge, including semantic models and basic DAX, allowing you to collaborate effectively with analysts. Experience working with eCommerce, retail or wholesale data. Familiarity with data governance and cataloguing tools, such as Microsoft Purview. Exposure to streaming or real-time data technologies, such as Event Hubs or Kafka. Exposure to data science or machine learning workflows.

items.desc: Description We are Disturbia; a UK based fashion and lifestyle brand for the people who play on the outskirts of mainstream; we celebrate the unusual, the quirky and the people who are gloriously themselves. Our passions span folklore to psychodelia; magical fairytales to poison gardens, historic literature to witchcraft and all the other weird rabbit holes we can fall down. Over the last 20 years, our growing in-house team of creatives, do-ers, dreamers and makers have been creating distinctive products and delivering an exceptional experience for those of you who dare to stand out from the crowd. The spirit of our collections comes from the spirit inside our company. We’re a team of honest, humble, creatively minded souls across our offices in the North East and London. We all dream of the same goal; to grow a brand which enables millions of people to realise their unique selves . Our designs are informed and inspired by the outcast, the esoteric, and the occult- we're always spinning fashion trends on their head in new and unexpected ways. We stand for the other in society and always want to do right by our community - all while having a hell of a lot of fun in the process. We are a fast growing and dynamic environment; and we don’t believe it bureaucracy for bureaucracy sake – you won’t find pointless red tape around here. We value bright ideas and voices which want to be heard. If you want to do your best work and come and work in environment which reflects you true self, come and join us and make some magic. As Disturbia continues to grow, the need has arisen to hire a Retoucher to join our Brand team in London, with a primary focus on delivering high quality e-commerce imagery while also providing support to our content and creative teams where required. Our aesthetic is rooted in the whimsical, witchy, and esoteric — think celestial motifs, folk magic, alchemical symbols, dreamy botanicals, and vintage occult references. We're looking for someone who can partner with the E-Commerce Studio Production Manager to elevate our content across the whole of Disturbia. This role would suit an experienced, detail oriented retoucher who is highly organised, confident in taking ownership of processes and enjoys working collaboratively, with an interest in graphic design and creative direction. Key Responsibilities As Retoucher , you will be responsible for ensuring all e-commerce imagery meets Disturbia’s visual standards, maintaining consistency in colour, quality and overall presentation across both on-model and off-model photography. You will take ownership of retouching workflows, schedules and guidelines, as well as coordinating with freelance retouchers to ensure imagery is delivered accurately and on time. Alongside your core e-commerce responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to support the wider creative team with campaign imagery, graphic design projects, video editing and art direction where needed, helping to deliver a cohesive brand experience across all digital channels. Responsibilities Photographic Retouching: Apply expert-level retouching to all e-commerce and creative imagery, ensuring each image meets our high visual standards and aligns with the brand’s aesthetic. This includes product shots, model images, and lifestyle photography. Video Editing and Colour Grading: Edit and grade engaging short-form video content for digital marketing, social media, and product showcases. You’ll focus on fast-paced, attention-grabbing edits while maintaining a consistent brand tone. Collaboration: Work closely with photographers, videographers, designers, and marketing teams to ensure all visual content aligns with the brand’s strategy and goals. Contribute ideas in creative meetings and provide support where needed. Asset Optimization: Prepare final images and videos for various digital platforms, ensuring they are properly optimized for web use without compromising quality. Creative Problem-Solving: Bring fresh ideas and creative solutions to visual content challenges, keeping the brand’s digital presence vibrant, engaging, and on trend. Image quality control: Full ownership of Ecommerce & Creative imagery guidelines, making sure these are kept up to date for both on and off model imagery.[LA1] [VA2] Freelance Retoucher Management & Communication: Take full ownership of communication and coordination with all freelance retouchers, acting as their main point of contact. Ensure freelancers are provided with clear briefs, up-to-date templates, colour-matching references and retouching guidelines to maintain consistency across all imagery. Provide ongoing feedback, answer queries and proactively manage retouching standards to ensure all outsourced work meets brand expectations. Applications are invited for the appointment of a dynamic, enthusiastic, and committed Consultant Paediatrician at Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust, based at Wexham Park Hospital. In addition, the Paediatric Assessment Unit (PAU) offers a further seven assessment spaces . The service accepts admissions from a variety of sources, including direct referrals from the Emergency Department and direct admissions from General Practitioners. The successful applicants will be part of a team that offers support during the student social times as well as always approaching any task with a positive and hard-working ethos. Our Midday Supervisors go above and beyond to support students during the school day. We are looking for motivated and enthusiastic candidates to become part of this integral team at The Kings Heath Primary Academy. About the role Part-Time , Term -time role until 31st August 2027. To supervise and assist children during lunchtime, inside the school and in the playground, to ensure a safe and positive learning environment is maintained and that all children behave in an appropriate manner. The duties of a Midday assistant are to act as a member of the team, supervising pupils during the midday break and to sustain the welfare and safety of pupils during that break period, as directed by the senior midday supervisor/head-teacher. You are expected to keep matters concerning staff and children confidential, and to refer matters when necessary to the head-teacher. Organisation of the entry of the pupils into the dining room. To provide positive and firm control by implementing the school discipline/behaviour policy. To deal with cases of unruly or unsocial behaviour by pupils where appropriate, or report the incident immediately to the head-teacher or his/her nominated representative. To mop up and wipe spillage from the floor surfaces or meal tables, and ensure that the dining area is left in a tidy condition. Ensuring pupils keep out of areas that are out of bounds, and don't leave the school premises Effective supervising pupils in the dining hall and other parts of the school Deal with, record and make appropriate decisions concerning first aid incidents and illness to ensure maximum safety for the children during lunchtime. Check, monitor and resolve health and welfare issues, and where necessary refer these to appropriate members of staff. items.desc: Location: Edinburgh In this position, you’ll be based in the Edinburgh office for a minimum of three days a week, with the flexibility to work from home for some of your working week. Find out more about our flexible work culture at computershare.com/flex. We give you a world of potential Computershare has an exciting opportunity for a FinOps Analyst to join our established and evolving team in Edinburgh. Why is this role exciting when there are so many other positions in the market? Well, there are a few things that make this role stand out: You’ll join an established FinOps team with practices already in place and scope to help mature our reporting, tooling and ways of working, particularly across AI and hybrid cloud. We’re a global business, so you will continuously get exposure to different areas and development opportunities. We encourage flexible working, allowing you to work in the way that suits you best. Interested? Keep on reading to find out a bit more about what you’ll be doing, and the type of person that we’re looking for. A role you will love As one of our FinOps Analysts, you will help turn technology cost, consumption and performance data into actionable insight across a hybrid cloud environment, covering both public cloud, particularly Azure, and private cloud infrastructure. Building on established practices, you will strengthen reporting, allocation, forecasting and optimisation, with a significant focus on AI consumption, token economics and measurable business value. You will work closely with finance, engineering, operations and AI service owners to explain cost drivers, improve accountability and support informed investment decisions. This is a hands-on analytical role: maintaining trusted reporting and tooling while helping the team mature its data quality, automation, governance and optimisation capabilities. Some key responsibilities include: Develop and maintain actionable Power BI reports, semantic models and dashboards, alongside Grafana dashboards and third-party FinOps tooling. Analyse public and private cloud utilisation, capacity and cost to identify rightsizing, idle resource, commitment and workload-placement opportunities; track delivery and validate realised savings with service owners. Produce forecasts, budgets and scenario analysis across hybrid cloud and AI services, explaining demand, pricing and consumption changes and distinguishing cashable savings, cost avoidance and released capacity. Monitor cost allocation, tagging and policy compliance; highlight anomalies, ownership gaps and budget risks, and work with stakeholders to resolve them. Build AI cost and consumption reporting across model APIs, AI Platforms, copilots and agent services. Develop token economics reporting to measure input, output and cached token volumes and rates. Partner with AI and engineering teams to assess model and service options, provisioned versus consumption-based pricing and GPU utilisation where relevant, balancing cost with quality, latency and business outcomes. Apply FinOps to private cloud as well as public cloud, combining infrastructure, virtualisation, storage, licensing, support and capacity data into transparent cost models and reporting. What will you bring to the role? We are looking for someone who combines practical FinOps experience with strong reporting, data analysis and tooling skills. You will be confident translating complex cost and consumption data into clear recommendations, with an interest in AI economics and the ability to improve established practices. With this role being global and a key part of our team, we are looking for someone with prior experience in a similar role. You will need excellent communication skills to effectively provide clear verbal and written communications with internal stakeholders, their teams and the leadership team. Other key skills required for the role include: Proven experience in a FinOps or technology analytics role within a complex organisation, contributing to an established practice and its continued improvement. Strong public cloud service and cost optimisation knowledge, particularly Microsoft Azure, together with an understanding of private cloud cost drivers. Strong analytical and communication skills, producing accurate reporting and clear commentary for both technical and non-technical audiences. Hands-on experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and semantic models. Experience with Grafana dashboards and third-party FinOps platforms is highly desirable, alongside familiarity with the Microsoft FinOps toolkit. Practical understanding of AI cost and usage reporting and token economics, including input and output tokens, caching, model pricing, agent consumption. Excellent attention to detail, sound analytical judgement and a disciplined approach to data quality, reconciliation, documented assumptions and consistent reporting definitions. Knowledge of the FinOps Foundation Framework, active FinOps Certified …

The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting data solutions that enable trusted, timely, and accessible data across the organisation. The role supports Quilter's data strategy by delivering scalable, secure, and resilient data products and services that underpin reporting, analytics, regulatory obligations, operational processes, and digital capabilities. Working within Agile delivery teams, the Data Engineer collaborates with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Data Analysts, Architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to transform data requirements into high-quality engineering solutions. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical capability, a proactive approach to problem solving, a commitment to engineering excellence, and a focus on delivering business value through data. Key Accountabilities Data Solution Development Design, develop, test, and maintain data pipelines, integrations, and data products across the enterprise data platform. Build scalable and reusable solutions for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and consumption. Contribute to the delivery of analytical, operational, and regulatory data capabilities. Data Platform Engineering Develop and maintain solutions using Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Key Vault, and related Azure technologies. Support the ongoing enhancement of platform capabilities, standards, frameworks, and reusable components. Implement infrastructure and configuration changes through automated deployment processes. Contribute to platform modernisation initiatives and technology adoption activities. Engineering Standards & Quality Follow established engineering standards, coding practices, and architectural principles. Maintain source control and deployment processes using Azure DevOps and Git-based workflows. Create and maintain automated testing and validation processes. Participate in code reviews and peer reviews to promote quality, consistency, and knowledge sharing. Ensure solutions are appropriately documented and supportable. Data Governance, Security & Risk Management Apply data governance, security, privacy, and retention requirements throughout the engineering lifecycle. Ensure data solutions comply with internal policies, regulatory obligations, and security standards. Support implementation of role-based access controls, data classification requirements, and auditability standards. Contribute to maintaining accurate metadata, lineage, and data quality controls. Identify and escalate operational, security, and data risks where appropriate. Operational Support & Reliability Monitor and support production data products and services. Investigate and resolve incidents, defects, and performance-related issues. …

The post holder will supervise Catering Regeneration Assistants, coordinate daily catering operations and ensure that food regeneration, meal assembly, food safety and hygiene standards are consistently maintained. Investigate and respond appropriately to service issues, incidents, complaints and patient feedback. Support service improvements and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement within the Catering Department. Undertake any other duties commensurate with the grade and responsibilities of the post. By providing safe, nutritious, high-quality meals, our staff make a direct contribution to patient wellbeing and recovery. We support our colleagues through training, development opportunities and a culture that promotes health, wellbeing and work-life balance. This is an excellent opportunity to join a forward-thinking organisation and help deliver services that make a real difference to patients, visitors and staff. If a role or service relocates as part of a planned move, excess mileage will not be reimbursed. Travel from home to the new work base will be classed as a normal commute. items.desc: Company Description Work with Us. Change the World. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. Job Description Start here. Grow here. AECOM Lighting Design provides independent lighting design and consultancy services across a broad range of projects in the UK and internationally. We are seeking a motivated graduate to join our team, with a particular interest in exterior lighting, street lighting and associated electrical design. Your Role You will work alongside experienced Lighting/Electrical Designers and Engineers on projects ranging from public realm and landscape schemes to highways, transport and major infrastructure. The role combines creative lighting design with technical engineering, developing schemes from early concept and feasibility through detailed design, construction and commissioning. You do not need to arrive with specialist lighting experience. We are looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, an interest in light and the built environment, and an enthusiasm to learn. Training, mentoring and guidance will be provided throughout your development. The role would particularly suit a graduate from an Electrical or Building Services Engineering background who is interested in developing a career specialising in exterior lighting design. Key Responsibilities As part of AECOM's Lighting Design team, you will help: Develop lighting/electrical strategies and concept designs. Undertake lighting/Electrical calculations and technical assessments. Produce 2D/3D models, drawings, details and schedules. Support electrical calculations, cable sizing and distribution design. Develop electrical schematics and lighting control strategies. Prepare specifications and technical reports. Coordinate lighting and electrical designs with other disciplines. What You’ll Learn You will gain experience in: Designing lighting for public realm, highways, transport, landscape and infrastructure projects. Using specialist lighting/electrical calculation and modelling software. Developing electrical designs for exterior lighting installations, including distribution, protection, cable sizing and controls. Producing coordinated CAD/BIM drawings and technical design information. Applying relevant standards, guidance and client requirements to lighting and electrical design. Supporting projects through detailed design, construction and commissioning. Qualifications We are looking for candidates who: Are pursuing or have a degree in Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering or another relevant engineering or design discipline. Have a strong interest in lighting and the built environment. Possess good technical, analytical and problem-solving skills. Are eager to learn lighting, electrical design and modelling software. Have an interest in developing CAD and BIM skills. Can communicate technical information clearly and work effectively within a multidisciplinary team. Are proactive about their own learning and professional development. Previous experience with lighting or electrical design, DIALux evo, AGi32, Lighting Reality, AutoCAD, Revit or similar software is advantageous but not required. Additional Information Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected for an advanced offer start. Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades. If you have a portfolio, university project, dissertation or other work demonstrating your interest in lighting, electrical engineering or the built environment, please include this as part of your application. You must have permanent right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. Following extensive engagement, co‑design and investment in our clinical model, workforce and environment, this is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in supporting a modern, therapeutic CAMHS inpatient service through high‑quality medical and administrative support. About the Unit Our refreshed CAMHS inpatient service is built around: Purposeful admissions with early review points A structured, therapeutic 7‑day programme Strong multidisciplinary working between medical, nursing, therapy and support staff Trauma‑informed and autism‑aware practice Clear clinical governance and high standards of communication and documentation The Doctor's Assistant role is central to the smooth and effective running of the Consultant‑led medical service within the inpatient unit. Providing clear information and recommendations to customers and the office following visits. Ensuring all work is completed safely and in accordance with current gas safety legislation and industry standards. Fast forward to today, and we are recognised as one of the most innovative fintechs, headquartered in the heart of London. With a team of 220+ people across 4 offices in Italy and the UK, we are proudly backed and funded by major partners including Poste Italiane, Cabot Square Capital, United Ventures, and Allianz. items.desc: About us Newly Weds Foods is a leading, privately owned global food ingredients business and has been innovating since 1932. The European division is a market leader in the manufacture of coatings, seasonings and functional ingredient systems. Today, Newly Weds Foods is a world leader in food ingredient technology. A network of R&D, manufacturing and service facilities around the globe allows us to serve our customers’ needs in more than 68 countries. But despite our size and scope, we’ve continued to be an independent, family-owned business answerable only to the demands of our customers. That’s why we continue to invest in infrastructure, human resources and capacity to keep pace with our customers’ needs and expectations. The Role The HSE Advisor plays a key role in creating and sustaining a culture where safety, health, wellbeing and environmental responsibility are embedded into everyday operations. Working across manufacturing sites, the role partners with operational, engineering and site leadership teams to ensure that HSE standards support both legal compliance and operational excellence. The HSE Advisor acts as a visible and trusted advisor, providing practical coaching, challenge and guidance to managers and employees at all levels. Site Health, Safety & Environmental Responsibilities Act as a visible HSE presence throughout manufacturing, warehouse and engineering operations. Champion a proactive safety culture through coaching and behavioural observations. Lead and support risk assessments and incident investigations. Analyse HSE performance data and drive preventative actions. Support contractor safety management and permit-to-work compliance. Monitor environmental performance and sustainability initiatives. Safety Culture & Continuous Improvement Drive engagement in behavioural safety programmes. Facilitate safety campaigns and awareness programmes. Promote learning from incidents and near misses. Support continuous improvement projects delivering measurable HSE performance gains. Engineering & Technical Compliance Machine safety assessments and safeguarding compliance. LOTO programme compliance and improvement. Management of confined space activities and working at height controls. Support PUWER, fire risk and statutory compliance activities. Training & Capability Development Deliver HSE inductions, toolbox talks and awareness sessions. Coach leaders in visible safety leadership. Support competence assessment and training matrix management. Auditing and Compliance: Conduct internal HSE audits and inspections across Banbury and Corby sites. Support customer, insurance, SEDEX, BRCGS, environmental and external regulatory audits. Track audit findings through to completion and verify effectiveness of corrective actions. Assist with maintaining compliance against company standards and UK legislation. Monitor changes in legislation and communicate relevant updates to management teams. Work with managers to ensure compliance responsibilities are understood and implemented effectively. HSE Committee & Employee Engagement: Coordinate and participate in Health and Safety Committee meetings. Encourage employee engagement and consultation on HSE matters. Support safety initiatives, campaigns and awareness events. Assist in developing practical solutions that improve workplace safety and environmental performance. Administration & Reporting: Maintain HSE records, registers and compliance documentation. Prepare monthly KPI reports and performance summaries. Monitor and track corrective actions arising from incidents, audits and inspections. Maintain training and compliance records. Support corporate reporting requirements as required. Other: Support Group HSE initiatives and projects. Maintain continuing professional development and industry knowledge. Travel regularly between Banbury and Corby sites. Undertake additional duties commensurate with the role. Comply with all company policies and procedures Salary range £52,500 to £62,500.

We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe exceptional customer experiences are born from a deep understanding of user needs, powered by insightful data, and brought to life through thoughtful design. Our Experience Design & Research team is a dynamic, multidisciplinary group of Industrial Designers, UX/CX Designers, User Researchers, and Human Factors practitioners. We are at the forefront of understanding our users and translating those insights into impactful products and services. Now, as we embrace the transformative potential of Artificial Intelligence, we're excited to expand our team with creative minds who can help us redefine what's possible. Job Description As an Associate UX Designer, you will be a key contributor to our design team in Edinburgh. This role is a hands-on blend of user-centered design, prototyping, and foundational user research. It's a perfect opportunity for an early-career design professional or graduate who is passionate about creating intuitive experiences, learning from senior mentors, and growing their skill set within a dynamic product design environment. What You'll Do Deliver User-Centered Designs: Work closely with developers, Product Managers, and senior designers across teams to deliver user-friendly wireframes, user flows, and interface designs based on UX research. Support Design Strategy: Assist in translating user feedback and project goals into actionable design solutions that address user needs. Participate in Discovery: Support user research sessions, usability testing, and workshops to gather user insights and help analyze feedback. Prototype & Iterate: Rapidly turn concepts into interactive prototypes using modern design tools, iterating based on feedback from team members and users. Collaborate Across Disciplines: Partner with cross-functional team members in Product, Engineering, and Research to understand technical constraints and user needs. Communicate Design Rationale: Clearly present your design concepts and underlying decisions during team reviews and design critiques. Elevate Our Practice: Continuously refine and improve our team's design processes, methodologies, and collaborative practices. Basic Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in HCI, Design, Psychology, Computer Science (with a focus on AI/HCI), or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Previous experience in UX/UI design, product design, or a related field (internship experience included). A portfolio demonstrating user-centered design processes, wireframes, visual design, and problem-solving skills. Familiarity with design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or similar prototyping applications. Understanding of core user-centered design principles, wireframing, and basic usability research methods. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills (verbal, written, and visual), with the ability to distill complex information into clear, compelling narratives. Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools to rapidly visualize and test ideas. What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications) A foundational understanding of core AI concepts (e.g., Machine Learning, NLP, Generative AI), including their capabilities, limitations, and ethical considerations. Experience using AI tools to rapidly prototype experiences or visualize complex data. A passion for speculative design and exploring novel applications of emerging AI to envision future user experiences. Comfort navigating ambiguity and a proven ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Travel Requirements None Relocation Provided None Position Type New Grad Referral Payment Plan Yes Company Motorola Solutions UK Limited EEO Statement Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.  Compétences Préférées

 Pourquoi Nous

items.desc: Meritis est un cabinet de conseil, pilotage et développement IT fondé en 2007 présent à Paris, Sophia-Antipolis, Aix-en-Provence, Montpellier, Toulouse, Nantes... Et bientôt sur de nouveaux territoires ! Notre mission ? Connecter les meilleurs talents aux entreprises pour leur donner un temps d’avance. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans l’intégralité de leurs besoins en transformation numérique à travers de nombreux domaines d’expertises : Software Engineering, Finance, Pilotage de projets, Devops, Data, Cloud, Cybersécurité ou encore Agilité. Intervenant aussi bien dans les secteurs de la Banque, de l'Assurance, des Télécommunications que de l'Industrie ou des Transports, aujourd'hui 40% des entreprises du CAC40 sont clientes Meritis. Fort de nos valeurs d’exigence, d’humilité, de bienveillance et de proximité, nous comptons aujourd’hui plus de 900 collaborateurs. Nous mettons un point d’honneur à être proche de nos collaborateurs et à les accompagner de manière individualisée quelles que soient leurs fonctions dans l’entreprise. Certifiée Great Place To Work depuis 2013, notre conception du bien-être au travail va bien au-delà d'un simple label, ce sont nos collaborateurs qui en parlent le mieux : https://www.glassdoor.fr/Avis/Meritis-Avis-E1163008.htm. Description Du Poste Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Développeur IA pour accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de solutions innovantes autour de la Data et de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Vos principales missions seront : Concevoir et développer des pipelines de données; Participer au développement et à l'industrialisation de modèles d'IA et de Machine Learning ; Collaborer avec les équipes Data, Produit et Métiers afin de concevoir des solutions adaptées aux besoins utilisateurs ; Déployer et maintenir les solutions dans des environnements Cloud ; Optimiser les performances, la qualité et la fiabilité des données; Participer aux bonnes pratiques de développement, aux revues de code et à la documentation technique. Qualifications Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme Bac+5 en informatique, Data ou Intelligence Artificielle ; Vous disposez d'une première expérience sur des projets Data, IA ou IA Générative ; Vous maîtrisez Python et avez de bonnes connaissances en SQL ; Vous avez une expérience sur au moins une plateforme Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) ; Vous connaissez les concepts de Machine Learning et les problématiques de mise en production des modèles ; Une expérience dans le développement d'agents IA, de solutions basées sur les LLM ou les frameworks tels que LangChain, MLflow, Airflow ou Kubernetes constitue un atout ; Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre curiosité, votre rigueur et votre capacité à travailler en équipe ; Un niveau d'anglais professionnel est apprécié. Informations supplémentaires Devenir collaborateur Meritis c’est : Des parcours professionnels sur mesure (évolution de carrière, formations adaptées, mentoring…) ; Avoir le choix de sa mission et un accompagnement personnalisé tout au long de votre carrière ; Evoluer dans un environnement où l’apprentissage est favorisé : formations certifiantes, e-learning, meetUp, concours de code, parcours d’évolutions etc ; Faire partie de communautés d’experts qui partagent leurs savoirs et expériences au sein de nos centres de compétences ; Un environnement convivial avec de nombreux événements festifs (soirée annuelle, séminaires & teambuiding, déjeuners et afterworks…) ; "Meritis est engagée dans la Responsabilité Sociétale des Entreprises. Nous valorisons notre impact positif sur la société et l'environnement. Notre démarche RSE guide chacune de nos actions pour promouvoir l'équité, la durabilité et le bien-être de nos collaborateurs. Rejoignez-nous pour être partie prenante de cette démarche responsable, où chacun de nos talents contribue à construire un avenir meilleur. Nos différences sont nos atouts. C’est pourquoi Meritis s'implique en faveur de la diversité et de la non-discrimination. Tous nos métiers sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap."

items.desc: Siamo Humans.tech. Non siamo la solita consulenza. Affianchiamo product company e aziende che vogliono diventarlo. Creiamo prodotti per aziende come Airbnb , Amazon e Angelini che risolvono tematiche complesse e migliorano esperienze. Gestiamo i progetti end to end, dall’analisi all'architettura, dal codice alla delivery. È come lavorare dentro un team prodotto, solo che il team prodotto siamo noi. In 10 anni abbiamo lanciato oltre 700 prodotti digitali , lavoriamo per il 70% con clienti globali tra Europa e Stati Uniti , e abbiamo sedi a Frosinone e San Francisco. Siamo tra le 1000 aziende europee in più rapida crescita per Financial Times & Statista e tra le top 5 aziende per cui lavorare in Italia per la Gen Z secondo Great Place to Work 2026 . Lavoriamo con AI dal 2015, non da quando è diventata un trend. I nostri partner si chiamano OpenAI, Meta , AWS , Translated . Chi cerchiamo Non cerchiamo qualcuno che sappia sviluppare. Cerchiamo qualcuno che si annoi a farlo in modo ordinario. Una persona che voglia realizzare sistemi ad alto traffico, mantenerli e farli scalare. Una persona che voglia mettere in produzione prodotti, aiutando il team a chiudere i cerchi. Una persona AI-first: le feature del progetto le pensa con la sua testa, poi usa gli strumenti giusti per costruirle, riprogettarle, accelerarle. L'AI è leva, non scorciatoia. Una persona che sappia cogliere le opportunità che ha davanti, comprenderle e contestualizzarle senza creare frizione. Come ragioniamo, con chi lavorerai Lavoriamo per obiettivi e puntiamo all’eccellenza. La perfezione non esiste, ma questo non ci impedisce di inseguirla. Spingiamo ogni persona a superare i propri limiti, perché è così che nascono risultati oltre le aspettative. Entrerai in un team cross-funzionale: lavorerai con Software Engineer, ML/AI Engineer e Product Engineer, dentro la stessa stanza, fisica o virtuale che sia. Vogliamo che tu sappia fare le domande giuste e che abbia il pensiero critico per scavare dentro i problemi. Ci aspettiamo che tu porti le tue idee, “abbiamo sempre fatto così” non è una frase che ci appartiene. Cosa devi saper fare Hands-on ML: Python che funziona e si legge, con Git nel flusso quotidiano. Pandas e NumPy per pulire e preparare il dato: la qualità del dato non è un problema di qualcun altro. Hai addestrato modelli veri con PyTorch o TensorFlow su almeno un dominio (NLP o Computer Vision): parti da un’architettura esistente, la adatti, e quello che tocchi lo sai spiegare. ML fundamentals: conosci i principali algoritmi di ML, supervisionati e non, e sai quale serve per quale problema. Sai leggere le metriche per capire se un modello funziona davvero, non solo sui dati con cui l’hai allenato, e se va male sai da dove iniziare a cercare il problema. AI-orchestration: fai uso quotidiano di agentic coding tools, restando tu la mente. Professional English: non ci serve un C2, ma devi saper sostenere delle call in inglese. Cosa non troverai in Humans.tech Spec iper-dettagliate per partire: noi ti diamo le basi, e tu arrivi al risultato. Micro-management: ci piacciono persone che vogliono prendersi la responsabilità delle proprie scelte. Persone che guardano solo al loro pezzetto: qui la responsabilità del progetto è condivisa. Lentezza e indecisione: ci piace andare veloci e per farlo abbiamo bisogno di persone che prendano le redini della situazione. Come si lavora qui L'ibrido è la nostra modalità di lavoro: il team è di 70 persone, e stare nella stessa stanza accelera la crescita molto più di qualsiasi call. Se sei lontano e vuoi trasferirti a Frosinone, abbiamo pensato a un bonus relocation di € 3.000. Cosa c'è in ballo RAL compresa tra € 28.000 e € 32.000. Progetti su mercati internazionali. Full-ticket restaurant. Welfare fino a € 3.000: UnoBravo, Starting Finance, Corporate Benefit, Budget per formazione e Team building nazionali e internazionali. MacBook Pro di ultima generazione. Agentic tools per un valore di € 3.000/anno. Bonus legati a performance aziendali fino a € 5.000. Bonus relocation di € 3.000. E quando sei in ufficio, gli spazi sono pensati per starci bene: palestra attrezzata con spogliatoi e docce, simulatori professionali, bar, area relax, area ristoro e parcheggi dedicati. Plus che rendono la giornata sostenibile ➡️ guarda il video ⬅️ Come ci conosciamo Quattro step: Colloquio introduttivo (30 min): una chiacchierata telefonica. Colloquio con Product Engineer (30 min): uno scambio da dev a dev. Approfondimento HR (30 min): cultura, modalità di lavoro, benefit. Pair programming (90 min): si lavora insieme. Se stai aspettando il momento perfetto per candidarti: è ora. Scrivici. items.desc: Contexte et environnement de travail Renault poursuit son engagement envers les jeunes au travers de la formation par l’alternance et les stages. Cette politique volontariste positionne Renault comme un des contributeurs majeurs au développement de l’apprentissage en France. Dans le cadre de votre stage, vous serez suivi par le service Emploi, compétences et Politiques Jeunes et plus particulièrement au sein des relations écoles et de la marque employeur de Renault. L'équipe simulation usages clients du Groupe Moto Propulseur (GMP) intervient sur le dimensionnement de l'ensemble des organes électrifiés (e-powertrain, batterie et sous-ensembles) en se concentrant sur les aspects de prestations tels que l'agrément, la performance, la dépollution, l'acoustique, ainsi que la fiabilité et la durabilité. Dans ce cadre, l'équipe réalise des simulations et des traitements statistiques sur un grand nombre de véhicules et de kilomètres de roulage mesurés afin d'assurer la robustesse de nos calculs d'ingénierie vis-à-vis de l'usage en clientèle. Objectifs de stage L’objectif principal du stage est d’étudier et développer des approches de complétion de données multimodale pour le diagnostic de véhicules électriques dans des contextes de modalités manquantes ou incertaines. En pratique, les données issues des différents capteurs embarqués ne sont pas toujours disponibles simultanément : certaines modalités peuvent être absentes, dégradées ou incomplètes selon les conditions d’acquisition ou les contraintes opérationnelles. Le stage visera à explorer des méthodes récentes de complétion de données multimodale permettant de reconstruire ou d'estimer les modalités manquantes à partir des modalités disponibles. Une attention particulière sera portée à la prise en compte de l'incertitude associée à ces reconstructions afin d'améliorer la robustesse et la fiabilité des modèles de diagnostic. L'objectif est également de quantifier l'impact des mécanismes de complétion et d'estimation d'incertitude sur la qualité des prédictions. Vos missions Revue de l’état de l’art sur la complétion multimodale et les modalités manquantes en apprentissage multimodal. Étude des différentes stratégies de reconstruction de modalités manquantes. Implémentation et évaluation de modèles de complétion multimodale. Intégration de mécanismes de quantification de l’incertitude dans les modèles étudiés. Analyse comparative des performances dans différents scénarios de modalités manquantes. Validation expérimentale sur des données réelles issues de véhicules électriques. Rédaction d’un rapport technique et présentation des résultats. Qui êtes-vous ? Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs ou de Master 2 (Bac+5) en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle. Vous êtes spécialisé(e) en data science et modélisation numérique. Vous êtes reconnu(e) par vos bonnes connaissances en machine learning, en programmation Python et SQL, également par votre capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Vous aimez travailler en équipe, vous êtes curieux/se, autonome, rigueur/se et avoir un esprit critique. Vous souhaitez participer à l’aventure de l’automobile de demain ? Rejoignez-nous ! 🚗💡

items.desc: #STAGE #IA #IMAGES Mission RAGT Semences, leader en production et commercialisation de semences de grandes cultures et d'élevage, recrute un Stagiaire R&D en Machine Learning et Analyse d’Images f/h basé à son site des Molinières à proximité de Rodez. Contexte La caractérisation de la qualité des semences et l’évaluation des traitements appliqués reposent sur des analyses et des essais spécifiques visant à mesurer leurs effets sur la germination et la vigueur. Ces étapes de qualification sont chronophages et nécessitent un investissement important en temps. Afin de limiter la charge d’analyse tout en améliorant la précision des résultats, nous souhaitons automatiser le suivi de la croissance de nos semences en laboratoire dans un premier temps sur les semences de maïs. L’objectif de ce stage est de contribuer à la conception d’un outil de phénotypage de la germination des semences. Ce projet s’articulera autour de plusieurs étapes : la qualification de l’équipement, la validation du protocole expérimental, ainsi que le développement et l’entraînement d’un algorithme de traitement d’images. L’outil devra permettre l’acquisition automatisée d’images sur une période définie, ainsi que la détection et le suivi individuel de chaque semence au cours de la germination. Enfin, l’ensemble du dispositif devra être contrôlable via une interface utilisateur simple et intuitive. items.title: (Afstudeer)stage AI binnen mobiliteit en ontwerp
items.card: De toekomst vraagt om creatieve breinen en slimme oplossingen “Binnen ons team Mobiliteit zien we mooie mogelijkheden om onze ontwerpwerkzaamheden verder te ontwikkelen en te automatiseren. Wil jij jouw kennis van programmeren, data en AI inzetten voor een praktisch vraagstuk op het snijvlak van techniek en mobiliteit? Dan komen we graag met je in contact!” — Pascal Hettinga - teammanager Mobiliteit Werken bij Sweco
items.desc: De toekomst vraagt om creatieve breinen en slimme oplossingen “Binnen ons team Mobiliteit zien we mooie mogelijkheden om onze ontwerpwerkzaamheden verder te ontwikkelen en te automatiseren. Wil jij jouw kennis van programmeren, data en AI inzetten voor een praktisch vraagstuk op het snijvlak van techniek en mobiliteit? Dan komen we graag met je in contact!” — Pascal Hettinga - teammanager Mobiliteit Werken bij Sweco betekent dat je onderdeel wordt van het grootste architecten- en ingenieursnetwerk van Europa. Je hebt de kennis van ruim 24.000 collega's, met één druk op de knop, binnen handbereik. Team Mobiliteit werkt aan verkeerskundige, planologische en civieltechnische vraagstukken uit het hele land. Daarbij ligt een focus op het maken een aanpassen van ontwerptekeningen met Autodesk AutoCAD en Civil 3D. Denk aan ontwerpen voor verkeersmaatregelen, wegindelingen, kruispunten, parkeervoorzieningen, bebording en markeringen. Binnen die ontwerpprocessen kijken we continu hoe we dat slimmer kunnen inrichten. Verschillende (repeterende) werkzaamheden voeren we inmiddels geautomatiseerd uit via zelfgemaakte scripts. Hiermee ontstaat meer tijd voor advisering en samenwerking met de opdrachtgever. We willen daar graag de volgende stap in zetten. We willen onderzoeken wat er nog meer mogelijk is en wat de stip op de horizon is. Juist de combinatie van verkeerskundig inzicht en digitale kennis maakt deze opdracht interessant. Je richt je op het ontwikkelen en testen van mogelijkheden om verkeerskundige ontwerpwerkzaamheden binnen Autodesk AutoCAD en Civil 3D verder te automatiseren. Afhankelijk van jouw opleiding en interesses kun je daarbij denken aan programmeren, scripts, data science of toepassingen van artificial intelligence. Ook is er ruimte om verder te kijken naar toekomstige ontwikkelingen en mogelijkheden binnen dit vakgebied. De precieze invulling bepalen we graag samen, passend bij jouw studie en interesses. Je werkt samen met collega's uit het vakgebied en krijgt de kans om jouw kennis in de praktijk toe te passen in projecten en verder te ontwikkelen. Zo verbind je digitale technieken met verkeerskundig ontwerp en draag je bij aan de verbetering van onze werkprocessen en stukjes Nederland. Vertel ons bij je sollicitatie welk onderwerp of vraagstuk jou hierin bezighoudt en waarom. We denken graag met je mee over een passende stage- of afstudeeropdracht! Dit is wat jij meebrengt Een bachelor of master-opleiding studerend richting data science, AI, geo-informatie of een vergelijkbare richting; Interesse in programmeren en digitale ontwerptechnieken; Vindt de combinatie van techniek, data en mobiliteit interessant; Nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen; Vloeiende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Dit is wat we jou bieden Bij Sweco zit je goed. Dit mag je verwachten van een werkgever met het World-class Workplace label. Je ontvangt een ruime stagevergoeding van €750,- per maand en reiskostenvergoeding waar nodig. Daarnaast krijg je bij ons veel vrijheid en ruimte om je te kunnen ontwikkelen. Denk aan waar je werkt, hoe je je tijd indeelt, wat je nodig hebt om succesvol te kunnen zijn en toegang tot het grootste architecten- en ingenieursnetwerk van Europa. Deze periode is bij uitstek één om te ontdekken en te pionieren. Naast uitdagend werk, support en middelen pakken we bij Sweco ook graag uit als het gaat om ontspanning en lol. We willen graag dat je met veel plezier naar je werk gaat. Denk aan de dagelijkse Fika’s op kantoor, events op jouw vestiging, een jaarlijks terugkerend festival, ons sportaanbod, zomerbarbecues, activiteiten vanuit Jong Sweco en personeelsverenigingen. Solliciteer op deze functie Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct via de button ‘solliciteren’. We kijken uit naar je cv en motivatie! Neem bij inhoudelijke vragen of interesse in Sweco contact op met Pascal Hettinga, [functie manager] via +31 6 31 96 30 48 of pascal.hettinga@sweco.nl. Vragen over het sollicitatieproces kun je stellen aan Evelyn Jacobs via +31 6 20 88 53 99 of evelyn.jacobs@sweco.nl.

Vous travaillerez sur des données liées aux véhicules, aux
items.desc: - - - - - - - - - - - - 📍 Localisation : Lyon 🎓 Niveau d'études : Bac +3 à Bac +5 📅 Date de début : A partir de février 2027 ⏱️ Durée: 6 mois Au sein de l'entité Data Market de Michelin , vous contribuerez à la conception et au développement de solutions d'Intelligence Artificielle et de Machine Learning appliquées aux marchés automobile et pneumatique. Vous travaillerez sur des données liées aux véhicules, aux pneumatiques, aux ventes, au sell-in, au sell-out, aux stocks et aux canaux digitaux . La mission couvre l'ensemble du cycle de vie d'un projet IA, depuis la compréhension du besoin métier et la préparation des données jusqu'au développement, à l'évaluation et à l'industrialisation des modèles. Les projets pourront faire appel à différentes approches : Machine Learning, prévision (forecasting), NLP/LLM, Computer Vision, IA générative et agents IA . Un projet concret et clairement défini sera attribué au début du stage, en fonction du profil du stagiaire, de ses compétences et des priorités métier de l'équipe Data Market. Réalisations clés attendues Compréhension du besoin métier et des données (Business & Data Understanding) : comprendre et formaliser les besoins métier, identifier les sources de données pertinentes et évaluer leur qualité, leur pertinence et leurs limites. Préparation des données (Data Preparation) : collecter, nettoyer, transformer, enrichir, rapprocher et structurer les données afin de les rendre exploitables pour les analyses et les applications d'IA. Développement des modèles IA/ML (AI/ML Development) : sélectionner et mettre en œuvre les algorithmes et modèles appropriés en s'appuyant sur leurs fondements théoriques, leurs avantages et leurs limites, et documenter les choix méthodologiques. Évaluation et validation des modèles (Model Evaluation & Validation) : définir des métriques d'évaluation pertinentes, valider les performances des modèles au regard des exigences techniques et métier, et contribuer aux décisions de déploiement. Construction et industrialisation des pipelines IA (AI Pipeline & Industrialization) : construire, tester et automatiser des pipelines IA/ML reproductibles afin de permettre un déploiement fiable et évolutif des solutions. Analyse et visualisation (Analysis & Visualization) : analyser et interpréter les résultats, puis communiquer les enseignements obtenus à l'aide d'outils de visualisation et de reporting adaptés. Documentation et qualité (Documentation & Quality) : documenter les données, les analyses, les modèles et les pipelines, et participer aux revues techniques et métier afin de garantir la qualité des livrables. Exemples de projets Prévision du marché automobile, prévision des ventes et des stocks, classification et annotation de contenus multimédias, détection de la conformité des images sur les sites des distributeurs, enrichissement des référentiels véhicules, analyse des avis et évaluations clients par NLP,... - - - - - - - - - - - - Michelin entreprise engagée dans la mobilité durable et reconnue pour ses actions en faveur de l’expérience employé ! items.title: Ingénieur IA - Finance
items.card: VOUS ÊTES En tant qu’ Ingénieur IA opérationnel, vous serez au cœur de la conception et de la construction des composants qui constituent des systèmes d’IA avancés alimentant l’entreprise moderne. Il s’agit d’un rôle d’ingénierie profondément technique et pratique : vous consacrerez la majeure partie de votre temps à la conception détaillée, au développement, à l’intégration et aux tests de composants de systèmes
items.desc: VOUS ÊTES En tant qu’ Ingénieur IA opérationnel, vous serez au cœur de la conception et de la construction des composants qui constituent des systèmes d’IA avancés alimentant l’entreprise moderne. Il s’agit d’un rôle d’ingénierie profondément technique et pratique : vous consacrerez la majeure partie de votre temps à la conception détaillée, au développement, à l’intégration et aux tests de composants de systèmes d’IA couvrant le machine learning classique, l’IA générative et les systèmes agentiques, et vous les mettrez en œuvre dans le cadre de missions clients actives. Vous prendrez des spécifications détaillées d’architecture et de conception et les traduirez en composants logiciels fonctionnels, de qualité production. Cela signifie écrire un code propre et bien structuré, prendre des décisions de conception de bas niveau dans le cadre de votre périmètre assigné et veiller à ce que vos composants s’intègrent de manière fiable dans le système d’IA au sens large. Vous construirez et interconnecterez les différents éléments des systèmes d’agents IA, notamment la logique de chaque agent, les intégrations d’outils, les compétences et les composants de mémoire, et contribuerez au développement et à l’intégration de modèles fondamentaux et de modèles de ML classique dans des pipelines de bout en bout. Une curiosité pratique pour l’écosystème open source est essentielle dans ce rôle. Vous évaluerez, apprendrez et adopterez en permanence les bibliothèques et frameworks open source pertinents, notamment ceux couvrant l’orchestration d’agents, le stockage vectoriel, le déploiement de modèles et les pipelines de ML, en sélectionnant et en appliquant ceux qui conviennent le mieux au problème à résoudre. De même, vous configurerez, intégrerez et rendrez opérationnels des technologies d’IA et des services de plateforme tiers, en comprenant suffisamment en profondeur leurs capacités et leurs contraintes pour les faire fonctionner de manière fiable dans le contexte d’un système d’entreprise plus large. Vous concevrez des composants en tenant compte des exigences de niveau entreprise, en veillant à ce que votre travail respecte les exigences définies en matière de sécurité, d’observabilité, de gouvernance, de performance et de scalabilité. Vous rédigerez et maintiendrez les livrables techniques accompagnant votre travail d’ingénierie, notamment les documents de conception détaillée, les spécifications des composants et les contrats d’intégration, afin de garantir que votre travail soit bien documenté, testable et prêt à être transmis. Vous travaillerez en tant que praticien au sein d’équipes de delivery pluridisciplinaires aux côtés de data engineers, de ML engineers et de développeurs d’applications, en suivant les orientations des architectes lead et principaux, tout en contribuant de manière significative à la résolution de problèmes techniques et aux discussions de conception dans votre domaine. Ce rôle est une opportunité de développer une expertise pratique approfondie sur l’ensemble de la stack d’ingénierie IA, de renforcer de solides fondamentaux en ingénierie logicielle appliqués à des systèmes d’IA de pointe et d’évoluer, à terme, vers un rôle de lead engineer ou d’architecte. LE TRAVAIL Concevoir, construire et configurer des agents individuels, notamment leurs prompts, outils et compétences, et les intégrer dans des workflows multi-agents. Implémenter une logique d’orchestration des agents qui gère les transferts de tâches, la communication et la récupération après erreur. Construire des frameworks d’évaluation et des suites de tests qui mesurent la qualité des agents et des composants selon des indicateurs tels que la précision, la pertinence et la fidélité, et partager les résultats afin d’orienter les améliorations de conception. Intégrer des modèles fondamentaux dans des applications, en sélectionnant le modèle et le mode d’invocation appropriés pour chaque cas d’usage. Construire et exécuter des pipelines de fine-tuning de modèles, notamment la préparation des données et l’entraînement, afin d’adapter les modèles à des domaines métier spécifiques, en appliquant une connaissance pratique des architectures basées sur les transformers. Construire des pipelines d’ingestion qui analysent, segmentent, enrichissent et indexent du contenu d’entreprise non structuré à des fins de retrieval. Implémenter la génération d’embeddings, intégrer des bases de données vectorielles et développer des composants de retrieval, notamment des connecteurs et des adaptateurs qui traitent du contenu non structuré dans des pipelines RAG de bout en bout. Construire la logique qui assemble les prompts et gère les informations transmises au modèle dans sa fenêtre de contexte. Implémenter des composants de mémoire qui stockent et rappellent l’historique conversationnel ainsi que d’autres éléments de contexte pertinents. items.desc: Colas, filiale du groupe Bouygues a pour mission d’imaginer, de construire et d’entretenir des infrastructures de transport de façon responsable. Acteur mondial des travaux publics, implanté dans plus de 50 pays sur les cinq continents, Colas rassemble 64 000 collaborateurs engagés dans leur territoire pour relier les hommes et faciliter les échanges dans le monde d’aujourd’hui et de demain. Rejoignez Colas ! Venez contribuer concrètement au développement des territoires tout en bénéficiant d'un environnement de travail permettant à chaque collaborateur d'être soi-même, de s'exprimer et de progresser. Votre mission Au sein de la Direction Applications, Digital, Data & IA, notre mission est de valoriser les données du Groupe afin d'améliorer la connaissance de nos activités, d'accompagner les décisions stratégiques et de développer des solutions innovantes basées sur la Data et l'Intelligence Artificielle. Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire Data Science souhaitant acquérir une expérience concrète sur des projets à forte valeur ajoutée, avec la possibilité de poursuivre l'aventure en alternance à l'issue du stage. Vos principales responsabilités Data Science & Machine Learning Analyser et exploiter les données métier disponibles dans notre Data Lake. Réaliser des analyses statistiques afin d'identifier des tendances et produire des recommandations. Nettoyer, préparer et fiabiliser les données pour les rendre exploitables. Concevoir, entraîner et évaluer des modèles de Machine Learning répondant à des besoins métiers concrets. Participer à l'industrialisation et à l'amélioration continue des modèles développés. Intelligence Artificielle Générative Contribuer au développement de cas d'usage basés sur des modèles de langage (LLM) déployés sur Microsoft Azure. Participer à la création et à l'amélioration d'agents conversationnels destinés aux collaborateurs du Groupe. Data Engineering Accompagner les travaux de collecte, transformation et ingestion des données dans le Data Lake. Découvrir les bonnes pratiques de gestion et d'architecture des données à grande échelle. Innovation Participer à des expérimentations en vision par ordinateur à l'aide de technologies telles que YOLO. Découvrir et tester de nouvelles approches IA appliquées aux métiers du Groupe. Votre profil Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (école ingénieur ou université) en : Data Science Intelligence Artificielle Big Data Informatique Mathématiques appliquées ou domaine équivalent Vous Possédez Idéalement Des connaissances en analyse de données, statistiques et Machine Learning. Une première expérience sur Python et SQL. Une appétence pour les environnements Cloud et Data. Un esprit analytique et une forte curiosité technologique. De bonnes capacités de communication et de travail en équipe. items.desc: Contexte et environnement Le Centre de recherche TotalEnergies TRTG (TotalEnergies Recherche et Technologie Gonfreville) est un campus technologique situé en Normandie près du Havre, qui soutient les activités de TotalEnergies face aux défis énergétiques et climatiques. Nos experts y développent des solutions innovantes pour la nouvelle Branche One Tech. 🚀🔬 Nos collaborateurs travaillent chaque jour pour rendre l'énergie plus abordable, plus propre, plus fiable et accessible à tous. 🌍💡 Dans un contexte où les outils d'intelligence artificielle ouvrent de nouvelles perspectives pour l'optimisation des procédés industriels, nous souhaitons développer une nouvelle approche de modélisation capable de prédire le comportement d'une unité de réformage catalytique à partir des données d'exploitation disponibles. Le réformage catalytique est l'une des unités les plus stratégiques d'une raffinerie. Son pilotage repose sur une compréhension fine des mécanismes réactionnels, des paramètres opératoires et de leur impact sur les rendements et la qualité des produits. Activités 🎯 OBJECTIFS ET ACTIVIT É S DE LA MISSION : Au sein du département suivi à distance et modèles, vous participerez au développement d'un modèle prédictif permettant d'estimer les rendements et la qualité des produits d'une unité de réformage catalytique. ✅ Construire et structurer une base de données dédiée au procédé ; ✅ Développer et comparer des modèles de prédiction basés sur la modélisation procédé et le Machine Learning ; ✅ Analyser les résultats et évaluer les performances des différentes approches ; ✅ Contribuer au développement d'un outil robuste permettant d'optimiser le suivi et les performances de l'unité. Profil du candidat 🔥 LE PROFIL IDÉAL Vous préparez actuellement votre dernière année d'école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en génie des procédés, génie chimique, data science, intelligence artificielle ou informatique appliquée à l'industrie. 💡 Savoir-faire Bonnes connaissances en génie des procédés et en modélisation de procédés industriels ; Capacité à exploiter et interpréter des données industrielles complexes ; Intérêt pour les problématiques industrielles et l'optimisation des performances. 🚀 Savoir-être Rigueur et sens de l'organisation ; Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse ; Persévérance face à des problématiques complexes ; Bon relationnel et capacité à travailler avec différents interlocuteurs techniques. 💻 Compétences informatiques Connaissances en analyse de données et en intelligence artificielle / Machine Learning ; Bonne maîtrise d'Excel et des outils de traitement de données ; Maîtrise des outils informatiques et de programmation. 🔬 Vous souhaitez appliquer vos connaissances en génie des procédés et en intelligence artificielle à un projet industriel à fort enjeu ? Rejoignez-nous et participez au développement de solutions innovantes pour optimiser les performances de nos unités.
