items.desc: About Us For the past 10 years, omni:us has been pioneering AI for insurance. Long before AI became a boardroom priority, we were already applying it to one of the industry's hardest environments: complex, data-heavy, highly regulated insurance operations. Today, our technology is used to understand claims, automate work, support complex decisions and run entire process steps at scale. We combine advanced AI, deep insurance expertise and production-grade engineering to turn what is technically possible into systems insurers can actually operate. We are not exploring what AI might mean for insurance. We have spent a decade building it. Our focus now is on agentic and generative AI : AI agents that read and understand insurance documents, reason over policies and claim files, use tools and data sources, and either complete work on their own or assist human experts in their daily work. As part of adesso, we take that experience further: combining omni:us' focus, speed and AI depth with the reach, implementation strength and enterprise access of one of Europe's leading IT service providers. The next chapter of AI in insurance is already underway. At omni:us, you help build it from the inside. About the Role We're looking for a Data Scientist to design, build and evaluate generative and agentic AI solutions for insurance automation and assistance. You'll turn LLMs and multimodal models into reliable systems: agents that handle claims and service workflows from end to end, and assistants that support claims handlers, underwriters and service teams with summaries, recommendations and answers grounded in the customer's data. You will work at the point where cutting-edge AI meets real operational complexity. The technology you develop does not stay in a lab, a paper or a prototype. It goes into production, handles real insurance processes and creates measurable impact. This role suits someone who cares as much about evaluation and reliability as about new ideas, and who wants to see their work make a real difference for clients. Key Responsibilities Design and build LLM-based agents and assistants for insurance workflows such as claims intake and triage, coverage checks, document and correspondence processing, fraud indicators, and case summarisation. Develop agentic workflows that combine LLMs with tools, APIs, business rules and retrieval over policies, claim files and knowledge bases (RAG), including multi-step reasoning and human-in-the-loop handover. Apply and adapt multimodal models for extracting information from complex insurance documents (forms, invoices, reports, emails, images). Build robust evaluation frameworks for generative and agentic systems: test sets, automated and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, accuracy and hallucination metrics, cost and latency tracking, and monitoring in production. Work on prompt and context engineering, and where it pays off, fine-tuning or distilling models for specific insurance tasks. Design guardrails for safe, explainable and auditable AI decisions, in line with regulatory requirements such as GDPR and the EU AI Act. Collaborate with product managers, engineers and insurance domain experts to bring solutions into production and measure their business impact. Stay up to date with developments in generative and agentic AI, assess new models and frameworks, and bring the useful ones into our products. Document approaches, experiments and results for internal use and for communication with clients. What We're Looking For Bachelor or Master degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in data science or machine learning, with a proven track record of delivering AI solutions to production. Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs (e.g. RAG, tool use / function calling, structured outputs, agents). Experience in the insurance or financial industry is a plus but not required. Strong Python skills and experience with ML/DL libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face or scikit-learn. Experience with LLM APIs and agent frameworks or protocols (e.g. LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Model Context Protocol, or similar). Good understanding of how to evaluate and monitor generative AI systems, including dealing with hallucinations, non-determinism and cost. Familiarity with NLP, document understanding and/or multimodal models. Solid understanding of data engineering concepts (ETL, databases, vector stores). Experience with Linux (bash, Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) is beneficial Proficiency in German and English (written and spoken). Ability to work with and analyze multilingual data effectively. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a pragmatic, product-oriented mindset. Excellent communication skills for working with technical teams, domain experts and clients. Self-driven and detail-oriented, with a healthy scepticism towards hype and a passion for what actually works. What We …

items.desc: Beschrijving van de vacature Jouw functie Ben jij technisch sterk, werk je graag zelfstandig én in teamverband, en haal je voldoening uit het maken van unieke prototypeonderdelen? Dan is de functie van Prototype Operator – CNC Frezen binnen het team New Manufacturing Technologies bij Atlas Copco Group in Wilrijk misschien wel jouw volgende uitdaging. Als Prototype Operator ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vervaardigen van prototypeonderdelen voor de nieuwste generaties Atlas Copco-producten. Je ontvangt een technische tekening of 3D-model en bepaalt zelfstandig de meest efficiënte bewerkingsstrategie om het onderdeel volgens de vereiste kwaliteitsnormen af te werken. Je programmeert CNC-machines, voert de bewerkingen uit en controleert je werk met de juiste meetmiddelen. Jouw verantwoordelijkheid gaat verder dan het bedienen van een machine. Je hebt rechtstreeks contact met interne klanten, denkt mee over technische oplossingen en speelt flexibel in op wijzigende prioriteiten of ontwerpaanpassingen. Samen met collega-operatoren, designers en manufacturing engineers werk je in een zelfsturend team waar autonomie, samenwerking en kennisdeling centraal staan. Jouw dagelijkse werkzaamheden Je analyseert technische tekeningen en 3D-modellen en bepaalt zelfstandig de benodigde bewerkingsstappen. Je voert CNC-freesbewerkingen uit, met draai-frezen als hoofdactiviteit.Je programmeert machines rechtstreeks aan de CNC-machine of via de CAM-software Hypermill.J Je kiest de meest geschikte bewerkingsstrategie om kwaliteit, efficiëntie en levertermijnen te garanderen.Je controleert afmetingen en toleranties met meetmiddelen zoals micrometers, kalibers en meetklokken. Je onderhoudt rechtstreeks contact met interne klanten en verwerkt wijzigingen of aanpassingen op een flexibele manier. Je levert kwalitatieve onderdelen binnen de afgesproken timing. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's, designers en manufacturing engineers binnen een zelfsturend team. Je ondersteunt continu verbeteringsinitiatieven rond kwaliteit, efficiëntie en nieuwe productietechnologieën. Je draagt actief bij aan een veilige, georganiseerde en professionele werkomgeving. Jouw vaardigheden en ervaring Je hebt ervaring met CNC-frezen. Ervaring met andere verspaningstechnieken is een pluspunt. Je hebt ervaring met het gebruik van standaard meettoestellen en kwaliteitscontroles.Je kunt technische tekeningen interpreteren en vertalen naar een machineprogramma. Je werkt vlot met digitale tools zoals Microsoft Teams en Outlook.Kennis van Hypermill of andere CAM-software is een belangrijke troef. Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels.Je bent bereid om bijkomende technologieën en bewerkingsprocessen aan te leren. Je bent bereid te werken in een flexibel tweeploegensysteem. Jouw beloning en arbeidsvoorwaarden Bij Atlas Copco Group zetten we ons in voor een eerlijke en gelijkwaardige beloning. De beloning wordt bepaald op basis van de functie en de bijbehorende verantwoordelijkheden, zonder onderscheid naar gender, ras, etniciteit, religie, fysieke mogelijkheden, seksuele geaardheid, burgerlijke staat of enig ander beschermd kenmerk. Ons beloningsaanbod is lokaal relevant, competitief en afgestemd op de verwachtingen van huidig en toekomstig talent. De uiteindelijke verloning wordt bepaald op basis van objectieve en genderneutrale criteria, waaronder, maar niet beperkt tot, de kwalificaties, ervaring en vaardigheden die tijdens het selectieproces worden aangetoond. Naast een competitief salaris bieden wij een uitgebreid onboardingprogramma, inclusief begeleiding door een persoonlijke peter of meter. Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot wereldwijde carrièremogelijkheden binnen Atlas Copco Group. Wij bieden een aantrekkelijk verlonings- en voordelenpakket, waaronder een hospitalisatieverzekering, groepsverzekering, maaltijdcheques en een cafetariaplan voor auto- en fietslease . Naast verloning geloven we dat een waardevolle loopbaan draait om kansen om te leren, te groeien, bij te dragen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen in een omgeving die gebouwd is op vertrouwen, samenwerking en continue verbetering. Jouw werklocatie en werktijden Deze functie is gebaseerd op onze productielocatie in Wilrijk, België . Je werkt in een flexibel 3-ploegensysteem . De functie wordt volledig on site uitgevoerd en kan vroege en late shifts omvatten. Waarom het fijn is om bij ons te werken Je maakt deel uit van een productieteam dat er trots op is om het werk in één keer goed te doen. Je werkt met hoogwaardige tools en processen en leert van ervaren collega’s. Veiligheid, kwaliteit en teamwork zijn voor ons belangrijk, en we waarderen goed werk. Je krijgt training op de werkplek en duidelijke stappen voor je verdere ontwikkeling. Er zijn mogelijkheden om nieuwe taken, tools en technologieën te leren. Je werkt in een team waarin jouw bijdrage telt, elke dag. We bieden stabiele arbeidsomstandigheden en, een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé. Onze managers handelen eerlijk en steunen …

items.desc: Be part of our beating heart Brussels Airport wil bekend staan als een van de beste luchthavens ter wereld, een volledig verbonden economische hub voor mensen en bedrijven, het kloppende hart van Europa, waar klanten, innovatie en duurzaamheid centraal staan. Wil jij de luchthaven van vandaag en morgen helpen vormgeven? Stop met dromen en kom ons team versterken! Om ons departement Technology & Infrastructure te versterken, zijn we op zoek naar een Data Analyst. OVER HET TEAM Je komt terecht in het Data & Analytics-team, waar we samen van data een betrouwbare troef voor de hele organisatie maken. Met moderne technologieën zoals Snowflake ontwikkelen we dataproducten en inzichten die teams op de hele luchthaven ondersteunen. Samenwerking staat centraal in onze aanpak. Je werkt nauw samen met stakeholders uit de business en helpt hen complexe uitdagingen om te zetten in waardevolle dataoplossingen. Tegelijk draag je bij aan een schaalbaar en toekomstbestendig datalandschap. We combineren sterke technische expertise met een pragmatische businessgerichte aanpak en zetten moderne technologieën, waaronder AI-ondersteunde tools, in om meer impact te creëren. JOUW ROL Als schakel tussen business en technologie: Breng je businessbehoeften in kaart en bevraag je ze kritisch Vertaal je behoeften naar heldere functionele analyses Definieer en valideer je dataoplossingen en dashboards Waak je over de datakwaliteit en de meerwaarde voor de business Bouw je sterke relaties op met stakeholders Ondersteun je gebruikers en verbeter je bestaande oplossingen voortdurend Draag je bij aan een robuust, veilig en toekomstbestendig datalandschap WAT MAAKT DEZE ROL ANDERS? De rol van Data Analyst evolueert snel. Moderne AI-ondersteunde tools helpen steeds vaker bij het schrijven van query’s, documentatie en bepaalde analysetaken. Jouw grootste meerwaarde ligt daarom in het begrijpen van de business, het stellen van de juiste vragen, het afstemmen van verwachtingen met stakeholders en het maken van doordachte keuzes over het ontwerp van dataoplossingen. Een sterke technische basis blijft essentieel, maar je succes in deze rol hangt evenzeer af van je vermogen om mensen, data en businessdoelstellingen met elkaar te verbinden. JOUW PROFIEL Ervaring als Data Analyst, BI Analyst of in een vergelijkbare rol Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om snel te begrijpen hoe een bedrijf werkt en wat de besluitvorming bepaalt Goede kennis van SQL en datamodellering Ervaring met BI-tools zoals Sigma, Tableau of Power BI Ervaring met Snowflake of een ander clouddataplatform is een pluspunt Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en sterk in stakeholdermanagement Je voelt je thuis in een Agile-werkomgeving Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Engels; Nederlands en/of Frans zijn een pluspunt Nieuwsgierig, kritisch en leergierig Gaat je hart al sneller slaan? Bij Brussels Airport werk je in een wereld op zich, vol nieuwe kansen en spannende uitdagingen. Je komt terecht in een unieke en inspirerende omgeving die je talenten vleugels geeft. Wat je ervaring helemaal bijzonder maakt? Ons nieuwe Compass-gebouw met zijn prachtige panorama, ideaal uitgerust om op een hybride en flexibele manier samen te werken, waar je kan rekenen op een aantrekkelijk aanbod van extralegale voordelen voor werknemers. Daarnaast bouwen we aan een duurzame omgeving waar we met de fiets, bus of elektrische auto naartoe komen en waar we zelfs een eigen treinstation hebben. Wat wil je nog meer? Volg het ritme van ons hart Kan je niet wachten om jezelf te overstijgen bij Brussels Airport Company? Stuur snel jouw CV en motivatiebrief via de daarvoor bestemde link. En wie weet, misschien verwelkomen we jou heel binnenkort op onze bruisende luchthaven in het hart van Europa!

Join our Food Biochemistry team in Brabrand and help develop enzyme solutions that enable healthier foods and more sustainable production processes across bakery, brewing, dairy, and plant-based applications. As a Laboratory Technician in our Food Biochemistry group, you will play an important role in developing and evaluating innovative enzyme solutions for the food industry. Working closely with scientists and cross-functional project teams, you will perform laboratory experiments, generate high-quality data, and contribute to the assessment of enzyme performance in food applications. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your technical expertise while supporting innovations that enable healthier foods and more sustainable production processes for customers around the world. The role is based in Brabrand, Denmark (onsite role) and is offered as a 6-month temporary position. IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products. At our Health & Biosciences business unit, we harness the power of science and nature to create innovative ingredient and biotechnology solutions that improve products, support sustainability, and help customers address evolving consumer needs around the world. Evaluate enzyme performance in food model systems across a range of food applications. Generate, analyze, and interpret experimental data to support project objectives. Prepare clear and accurate reports, summaries, and technical documentation. Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory equipment while following established procedures. Collaborate with scientists, technicians, and cross-functional project teams in a global environment. Contribute to the development of enzyme solutions for bakery, brewing, dairy, and plant-based food applications. Ensure high standards of laboratory quality, safety, and data integrity. Support innovation projects that help create healthier foods and more sustainable production processes. What Makes You the Right Fit Completed education as a Laboratory Technician or equivalent laboratory-based technical qualification. Knowledge of biochemistry and laboratory techniques. Ability to communicate and document scientific work effectively in English. Comfort working with data analysis, reporting, and laboratory documentation. Experience using laboratory software, data systems, or other IT tools is an advantage. Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality results. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment. Willingness to learn new scientific disciplines, technologies, and ways of working. How Would You Stand Out? Experience or academic exposure to enzymology and/or protein chemistry. Hands-on experience with enzyme characterization, food biochemistry, or protein chemistry techniques. Previous experience working in a food, biotechnology, enzyme, or life sciences laboratory environment. Demonstrated ability to proactively solve problems and adapt in a dynamic, project-driven setting. Why Choose Us? Join a highly skilled international team with deep expertise in enzymology, biochemistry, and food applications. Work on technologies that help deliver healthier foods and more sustainable solutions to the global food industry. We encourage interested candidates to apply early, as we are keen to welcome the successful candidate to the team at the earliest opportunity. We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. items.desc: Er du skarp på detaljen og evner samtidig at se den store sammenhæng? Vil du arbejde med data fra avancerede sensorsystemer? Har du erfaring med og interesse for analyse og bearbejdning af elektroniske signaler, og kunne du tænke dig at gøre en forskel for Danmarks sikkerhed? Så er du måske vores nye kollega. Du får indflydelse og plads til at udvikle dig Forsvarets Efterretningstjeneste (FE) leder efter tekniske specialister til nyoprettede teams i afdelingen for elektronisk indhentning. Opgaverne i teamet er at bidrage til FE’s taktiske og operative varsling af nationale myndigheder og beslutningstagere. Kerneopgaverne i enheden vil være indsamling, analyse eller bearbejdning af elektroniske signaler, herunder produktionsdrift og -vedligehold, system- og dataflowovervågning, teknisk signalanalyse, datahåndtering, udvikling mm. Afhængigt af hvilken baggrund du kommer med, kan der være forskel på, hvilke dele af den samlede opgaveportefølje i teamet, du kommer til at arbejde med. Du vil få mulighed for at sætte dit præg på den løbende videreudvikling af arbejdsområdet og strukturen i teamet, herunder bidrage til implementering, integration og automatisering af it-systemer til brug for opgaveløsningen. Og så bliver du en integreret del af udviklingen i enheden. Din kontaktflade vil omfatte flere forskellige enheder og faggrupper i FE og Forsvaret samt hos udenlandske partnere. Du skal være indstillet på, at der vil være uddannelse og kurser i både ind- og udland. De fleste er af kortere varighed i nogle uger ad gangen. Du og din baggrund er vigtig Det er et krav, at du har en relevant civil eller militær uddannelse på akademisk eller teknisk niveau. Det kan være du er ingeniør, data scientist, datamatiker, programmør, eller lignende. Hvis du har en militær baggrund, kan du bl.a. have opbygget en lignende teknisk forståelse og erfaring. Derudover forestiller vi os, at du kan arbejde struktureret og selvstændigt samtidigt med, at du trives i et til tider hektisk miljø og besidder en fleksibel tilgang til opgaveløsningen. Det falder dig naturligt at være en del af et team, og du udveksler gerne idéer og sparre med dine kolleger. Vi ser det som en fordel, hvis du har opbygget teknisk viden og erfaring inden for it-programmering og dataforståelse samt interesse eller erfaring med analyse og bearbejdning af elektroniske signaler. Erfaring fra Forsvaret vil ligeledes være en fordel. Du bliver en del af en afdeling med spændende opgaver, som vægter faglighed, fleksibilitet og stor frihed i opgaveløsningen højt. Vi kommer fra vidt forskellige baggrunde, men fælles for os er, at vi brænder for opgaven og for at gøre en forskel for Danmarks sikkerhed. Din daglige arbejdsplads vil være på Amager indtil, vi flytter til Østerbro. Din nye arbejdsplads Forsvarets Efterretningstjeneste (FE) er Danmarks udenrigsefterretningstjeneste og arbejder – hemmeligt og åbent – for at beskytte Danmark og danske interesser i en foranderlig verden. Du vil blive del af en helt særlig organisation, hvor vi står sammen om, at løse en vigtig opgave. Mange af dine kommende kolleger brænder for at gøre en forskel, og vi har et stærkt fagligt og socialt sammenhold. Da vi ikke kan tale særlig meget om vores arbejde med venner og familie, så skabes der et helt særligt bånd til dine kolleger. Hos os er det ikke så nemt at tage arbejdet med hjem, da vi arbejder med fortrolige oplysninger. Til gengæld tilbyder vi en høj grad af fleksibilitet i planlægningen af din arbejdstid, og når du ikke er på arbejde, har du helt fri. Vi har et stort fokus på det sociale sammenhold, som understøttes af forskellige arrangementer som for eksempel fredagsbar og brætspilscafé. Du har også mulighed for at tilmelde dig forskellige faglige fora, som går på tværs af organisationen. Vi har desuden en idrætsforening, hvor du kan dyrke forskellige typer motion i selskab med dine kollegaer. Som ansat i FE er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Det er et krav, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele din ansættelse. Som i resten af Forsvaret har du pligt til kortvarig udsendelse til udlandet, hvis behovet opstår. Du kan læse mere om FE på vores hjemmeside www.fe-ddis.dk. Din lønpakke afhænger af dine kvalifikationer For både civile og militære ansøgere gælder løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og den relevante faglige organisation, afhængig af din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund. Derudover har du mulighed for at forhandle løntillæg efter kvalifikationer. Den gennemsnitlige arbejdstid er 37 timer om ugen inklusiv betalt frokostpause. Til stillingen hører en pensionsordning, som FE betaler. Militære ansøgere Stillingen kan besættes af flere militære niveauer, da vi er i gang med at opbygge et nyt team. Opgaverne differentieres alt efter din erfaring og rang. Stillingen kan besættes af en Kaptajn/kaptajnløjtnant (M321) efter gældende protokollat til overenskomst for akademikere i staten om officerer …

Your role Orion is looking for a curious and collaborative chemical biologist to join the Hit Finding team in the Structural Biology and Discovery Technologies unit. The position is designed for a scientist who wants to apply chemical and biological thinking to practical drug-discovery questions and grow alongside experienced colleagues. Willingness to broaden your expertise into complementary sciences such as biochemistry, biophysics and molecular pharmacology is pivotal for this role. You will work alongside our Chemical Biology Lead and Chemistry Leads, supporting the development of modality strategies and project-specific hit-finding strategies. The role combines scientific analysis, assay understanding, chemical-tool thinking, assay and compound data interpretation and collaboration with internal experts and external research partners. Much of our experimental work, including protein production and biochemical, biophysical and structural-biology activities, is carried out through partner networks. You will therefore help translate scientific questions into well-designed experimental packages, follow their execution, review the resulting data and contribute to clear recommendations for project teams. Responsibilities Support Chemical Biology and Chemistry Leads in developing target- and project-specific modality and hit-finding strategies. Gather and integrate information on target proteins, ligands, chemical tools, assay options, and relevant literature to support early project decisions. Contribute to the design of biochemical and biophysical assay cascades for hit finding, validation, and mechanism-of-action studies. Help define appropriate protein constructs, reference compounds, controls, orthogonal methods, and success criteria together with internal specialists and external partners. Participate in scientific discussions with CROs and other partners, review study plans and data, and help identify follow-up experiments. Contribute to the selection, design and use of chemical and biological tools for assessing target engagement, functional mechanisms and modality feasibility. Contribute to defining the structural biology questions that require answering for defining the modality strategy Help analyze assay data and make decisions on screening hits Help maintain shared project knowledge and ensure effective information flow between Hit Finding, therapy-area scientists, medicinal chemistry, structural biology, modeling and external partners. The position is full-time and based in Espoo, Finland. Collaboration with colleagues at Orion’s other research sites, particularly Turku, and with external partners is an important part of the role. Travel between sites and to partner meetings may therefore be required. The role reports to the Head of Hit Finding. What you can expect from us You will join a highly collaborative scientific environment where your work supports real project decisions and the discovery of new therapeutic opportunities. You will work alongside experienced colleagues across chemistry, chemical biology, structural biology, protein science, modeling and therapeutic-area research, with room to develop your scientific breadth and take increasing ownership as your experience grows. At Orion Pharma, your work creates true impact and well-being for our customers, patients and society at large. Our culture of friendliness, respect, mutual appreciation and diversity creates a safe working environment where you can strive for excellence. We offer a wealth of career paths and development opportunities that support the development of innovative solutions and improving the quality of life. Please visit our website to find further information about our values and Orion as an employer https://www.orionpharma.com/careers/working-with-us/ . What are we looking for? Here, customers squeeze, smell, try and test from opening to closing. And behind every store that makes you stop and say "wow" is someone who knows the difference between a good store and a great one. That's where you come in. About the role We're now looking for a Visual Merchandiser to our team at Lyko Forum in Helsinki. You'll be employed in the store and your main focus is the visual side of the Beauty Playground: making sure it's inspiring, selling and always looking its best. But this isn't just about making things look good. You'll play a key part in driving the store's results, by making sure we have the right products in the right place and that our campaigns actually deliver. You'll work closely with the Store Manager and Assistant Store Manager, and you'll be part of the store's management team. Since you're part of the store team, you'll also jump in on the sales floor and meet our customers when needed. items.desc: EUCLIDE INDUSTRIE est un groupe industriel qui accompagne et propose à ses clients des solutions globales, performantes et compétitives de la conception à la fabrication d’ensembles mécaniques, prototypes, petites séries et équipements clés en main. Capable de développer des pièces techniques et des ensembles complexes, nous sommes une véritable référence parmi les sous-traitants industriels et nous intervenons pour les secteurs de l’aéronautique, la défense, l’énergie, le médical, les biens d’équipement, l’outillage ou encore le ferroviaire. Le groupe fédère trois Business Units spécialisées et agiles : EUCLIDE Care, spécialisée Médical, maîtrisant les procédés d’usinage, d’électroérosion et finition sur des ensembles de petite dimension ; EUCLIDE Solution orientée outillage, défense, biens d’équipement et ferroviaire, maîtrisant les procédés chaudronnerie jusqu’à 20T, usinage électroérosion sur des ensembles de petite dimension ; EUCLIDE Vaillant orientée aéronautique, défense, biens d’équipement maîtrisant les procédés d’usinage sur des ensembles de grande dimension. Donnez du sens aux données et accélérez la transformation d'un groupe industriel. Chez Euclide Industrie, nos processus sont digitalisés depuis plusieurs années. ERP, outils métiers, données de production, reporting, Microsoft 365, automatisation, intelligence artificielle : nous poursuivons notre transformation pour rendre nos sites toujours plus performants. Pour accompagner cette évolution, nous recherchons un(e) Responsable ERP & Transformation Digitale capable de comprendre les besoins du terrain, de faire évoluer nos outils et de transformer les données en leviers de performance. Rattaché(e) à la Direction Financière, vous êtes le référent des applications métiers du groupe et de la gestion des données associées. Vous intervenez au cœur de nos activités industrielles pour : Comprendre les flux de production et les besoins des utilisateurs ; Faire évoluer les outils métiers au service de la performance opérationnelle ; Structurer et valoriser les données de l'entreprise ; Accompagner le développement des usages Microsoft 365 et de l'intelligence artificielle. Véritable interface entre les ateliers, les fonctions support, les directions et les partenaires externes, vous accompagnez nos 5 sites dans leurs projets de digitalisation. Vous encadrez un Développeur et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec notre Administrateur Système et Réseau. Vos missions principales Piloter les outils métiers Administrer et faire évoluer nos applications métiers (ERP, BI, RH et finance). Participer à la gouvernance des données du groupe. Construire un environnement numérique cohérent reliant données, documents et processus métiers. Accompagner la transformation digitale Développer les usages Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Copilot). Identifier les opportunités d'automatisation. Expérimenter les usages de l'intelligence artificielle au service des métiers. Former et accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'adoption des nouveaux outils. Ingénieur en systèmes d'information, informatique industrielle ou génie industriel, vous justifiez d'au moins 5 années d'expérience en environnement industriel. Vous connaissez les réalités d'un site de production et maîtrisez les outils qui structurent les flux industriels : ERP / GPAO ; MES ; BI et reporting ; Gestion documentaire ; Données métiers. Vous savez dialoguer aussi bien avec un responsable de production qu'avec un membre de direction et transformer un besoin opérationnel en solution concrète. Vos atouts Solide connaissance des ERP industriels. Compréhension des flux de production et des organisations multi-sites. Expérience en gestion et exploitation des données métiers. Maîtrise de Microsoft 365 et des outils collaboratifs. Connaissance de Power BI, SQL ou Power Platform appréciée. Curiosité pour les sujets liés à l'automatisation et à l'intelligence artificielle. Notre environnement Sylob, Nibelis, Lucanet, Power BI, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, GEDIX (MES), NX, TopSolid et Mastercam. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un poste clé au cœur de la transformation numérique du groupe. Une forte proximité avec les équipes terrain et les directions. Des projets concrets avec un impact direct sur la performance des sites. Une grande autonomie et un périmètre d'action varié. L'opportunité de construire les futurs usages autour de la donnée, de l'automatisation et de l'intelligence artificielle.

items.desc: About VitVio VitVio is building AI-powered tools to simplify and streamline operating room workflows, so surgical teams can focus on what really matters—patient care. Our platform uses computer vision and context-aware AI to understand actions happening in the OR in real time. From automatically logging surgical stages to coordinating team readiness, we take on the administrative load so clinical staff don’t have to.‍ Our team has experience founding and scaling leading companies in adjacent industries. We're growing quickly, backed by top-tier investors, and working with some of the most respected hospitals in the US and Europe. About the Opportunity We're looking for a Fullstack Software Engineer who is a frontend specialist to join our experienced engineering team. This role blends deep technical work on the frontend with people leadership and offers the chance to build tools used directly in surgical care. This role is remote-first, and open to candidates based in Europe and the US, we prioritize talent over everything else. Some international travel is required to visit hospitals, observe workflows, and co-design with clinical users. What You’ll Do Like all our engineers, you will work across the stack on systems used by hospital staff in high-stakes environments. From RFD to deployment, you’ll take ownership of features, propose creative improvements, and ship clean, reliable code with confidence. As a frontend specialist, we will lean on you to define our frontend strategy to maintain high iteration speed while supporting a wide range of devices. You will ensure high quality in the frontend while facilitating contributions from all engineers. In your first 6 months, you will: Work closely with our design team to implement our design system Modularise the frontend code to make it testable and mobile-ready Mentor good frontend habits to onboard software team to the structures you are putting in place Deliver weekly enhancements or fixes with high quality and near-zero regressions Contribute to product development through structured feedback, prototyping, and testing Own and ship projects end-to-end across our product and machine learning teams You’ll work across a diverse stack: Frontend : React, TypeScript Backend : Elixir (Phoenix), C++ Infrastructure : GCP, GitHub Actions, NixOS Data : Postgres, ETL pipelines APIs : GraphQL, REST, integrations with healthcare systems (e.g. HL7/FHIR) Although we are looking for extensive frontend and mobile experience, we don’t expect you to have deep experience in each tool and language — but we’re looking for curiosity and adaptability. We support engineers in learning new tools as needed. So, if you don’t have experience with some of the tech above, no problem, we’d still love you to apply! You Might Be a Great Fit If You… You have architected and implemented highly maintainable and reliable web apps that work across devices You have built and maintained design systems Are a well-rounded engineer with experience and interest across the stack (our philosophy is for all engineers to contribute to all repositories) Are known for clean, reliable code and proactive communication Take the initiative: when something’s broken, you fix it or raise it Think in systems and edge cases, but you move quickly and pragmatically Thrive in team settings that value candid discussions, curiosity, and mutual respect Include the word ‘reactor’ in your application (to let us know you’ve read this) Find purpose in building software that solves real problems for real people We don’t expect you to know all of our stack or match every bullet here — we care more about how you think, learn, and collaborate. Benefits Early-Stage Equity Competitive salary Company laptop along with tools you need to succeed Learning & development budget Offsites and team-building events Flexible PTO Hiring Process Review: Submit your application First Call (30 min): A call with our CTO to talk through your current/past experience, your motivations and tell you more about VitVio. Meet with our CEO (30 min): You’ll speak to our CEO to see if the magic is there. Coding Interview (90 mins): You’ll be working with two of our team members through a coding exercise. Career Deep Dive (90 mins): Our CTO will go with you through your achievements and learnings of your career so far. Design Interview (90 mins): You’ll be showing us how you are working with designers and how you have solved design challenges in the past Offer

Votre Mission : En tant que Machine Learning Platform Engineer (MLOps Engineer), vous intervenez au sein des équipes Data & IA de nos clients afin d’industrialiser, déployer et exploiter des solutions de Machine Learning à grande échelle. À la croisée des mondes Data Science, Data Engineering et DevOps, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la mise en production des modèles et la fiabilisation des plateformes ML. Concrètement, vous allez : Industrialiser les pipelines Machine Learning en automatisant les phases d’entraînement, de validation et de déploiement des modèles. Mettre en place des chaînes CI/CD/CT garantissant des mises en production fiables, reproductibles et sans intervention manuelle. Déployer et servir les modèles en production via des APIs temps réel, traitements batch ou architectures streaming. Containeriser les applications avec Docker et orchestrer les déploiements sur Kubernetes. Assurer le versioning des modèles, la gestion des environnements, ainsi que les mécanismes de rollback. Mettre en place le monitoring des modèles et des données afin de détecter les phénomènes de Data Drift et Model Drift. Surveiller les performances opérationnelles des modèles : latence, disponibilité, qualité des prédictions et consommation des ressources. Automatiser les stratégies de ré-entraînement en fonction des indicateurs de performance et des seuils métiers. Garantir la reproductibilité des expérimentations en versionnant les données, features, modèles et métriques. Optimiser les infrastructures de calcul et les coûts d’exploitation des plateformes ML (CPU, GPU, autoscaling, cloud). Mettre en œuvre les bonnes pratiques DevOps et SRE : tests automatisés, observabilité, alerting et gestion des incidents. Collaborer étroitement avec les Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Engineers et équipes Cloud/DevOps. Participer à l’amélioration continue des plateformes Data & IA et à la définition des standards MLOps. Qui êtes-vous ? Vous disposez d’une expérience significative en MLOps, Machine Learning Engineering, Data Engineering ou DevOps appliqué à la Data. Vous maîtrisez Python ainsi que les pratiques d’industrialisation des modèles de Machine Learning. Vous avez une expérience concrète des environnements Kubernetes et Docker. Vous avez déjà déployé et maintenu des modèles de Machine Learning en production. Vous maîtrisez les concepts de CI/CD et l’automatisation des pipelines de déploiement. Vous êtes familier des problématiques de monitoring, d’observabilité et de gouvernance des modèles. Vous comprenez les enjeux liés au Cloud, à l’optimisation des coûts et à la scalabilité des plateformes Data. Vous appréciez travailler dans des environnements complexes nécessitant une forte collaboration transverse. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre autonomie et votre capacité à résoudre des problématiques techniques à fort impact. La maîtrise de l’anglais professionnel constitue un réel atout. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un terrain de jeu pour progresser : Formations, certifications, coaching technique, communautés d’expertise (Data, Cloud, DevOps, IA…), participation à des projets innovants autour du Machine Learning, de l’IA Générative, des plateformes Data et de l’industrialisation des modèles. Un cadre de travail motivant : Projets stratégiques auprès de grands comptes, événements internes réguliers, afterworks, ateliers techniques, participation à des conférences et salons spécialisés (Big Data & AI Paris, Devoxx, Kubernetes Community Days, Data + AI Summit…). Un engagement RSE fort : Ecovadis Gold, signataire de la Charte pour la diversité, du Pacte des Nations Unies, et mise en place du mécénat de compétences. Votre futur process de recrutement : Entretien RH avec une de nos chargées de recrutement Test technique (échange avec un expert Data/Cloud ou étude de cas MLOps) Entretien final avec un de nos managers Chez Astrelya, nous construisons des solutions innovantes… mais surtout, nous construisons des parcours humains. Prêt(e) à rejoindre l’aventure ? Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. #recrutement #mlops #machinelearning #machinelearningengineer #platformengineering #kubernetes #docker #mlflow #cloud #devops #dataengineering #data #ia #artificialintelligence #astrelya

items.desc: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. Your Role As a PMO Operations Specialist , you'll play a central role in building and running the operational foundation of our growing Project Management Office (PMO). Working closely with the PMO Lead, you'll turn newly developed processes into practical, well-documented ways of working that are consistently adopted across dozens of active initiatives. You'll own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the PMO, from weekly project reporting and portfolio data quality to project lead onboarding, training, and process improvement. You'll work across teams, including scientists, engineers, and project leads, helping make project management processes simple, effective, and accessible to everyone. This is an opportunity to join the PMO during its early development and make a meaningful impact on how Focused Energy plans, tracks, and delivers its most important initiatives. You'll bring structure to complexity, ensure important details don't fall through the cracks, and help build a scalable foundation for the company's continued growth. What You'll Do Own the PMO Operating Rhythm: Coordinate and manage the weekly project reporting cycle across dozens of active initiatives, ensuring timely updates, accurate information, and consistent visibility into project progress. Drive Portfolio Data Quality: Monitor project information, identify missing or inconsistent data, follow up with project leads, and ensure leadership and teams can rely on accurate portfolio reporting. Make PMO Processes Work in Practice: Translate newly designed PMO processes into simple, documented, and usable workflows that can be adopted consistently by project leads and non-PM colleagues. Lead Project Onboarding and Training: Coordinate onboarding for new project leads and deliver training on PMO processes, tools, reporting expectations, and ways of working to build confidence and self-sufficiency. Improve Processes and Efficiency: Identify recurring manual tasks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement, helping streamline workflows and flag opportunities for automation. Drive Improvement Initiatives: Partner with the PMO Lead on selected PMO improvement projects, taking ownership of execution, coordination, documentation, and follow-through. items.desc: Cabot Corporation (NYSE: CBT) is a leading global specialty chemicals and performance materials company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, USA. Our businesses deliver a broad range of products and solutions to customers in every corner of the globe, serving the transportation, infrastructure, environment and consumer industry sectors. We bring the power of innovative chemistry to solve customers' challenges today while preparing them to meet tomorrow’s needs. Our commitment to innovation is driven by a passion to advance our customers' businesses through our deep understanding of their applications and the global trends that impact their operations. If you do not meet every requirement, or your experience is slightly different than what we have listed, we still encourage you to apply! Die Cabot Aerogel GmbH stellt am Standort Frankfurt, Industriepark Höchst in einer verfahrenstechnischen Anlage Aerogel her. Hierbei handelt es sich um ein zukunftsweisendes Material, das auf Grund seiner hervorragenden Dämmeigenschaften in vielen neuartigen und nachhaltigen Produkten Verwendung findet. Der Einsatz von Aerogel ist unser Beitrag zur Gestaltung einer energie- und ressourceneffizienten Zukunft. Unser Werk gehört zur Cabot Corporation, einem global ausgerichteten Unternehmen mit Sitz in Boston, Massachusetts (USA). Cabot betreibt 40 Produktions-Standorte in 20 Ländern und beschäftigt weltweit ca. 4.500 Mitarbeiter. Für unseren Standort Frankfurt suchen wir einen Process Engineer (m/w/d) mit besonderem Interesse an Prozessoptimierung und Prozesssicherheit. In dieser Position erhalten Sie die Möglichkeit, die verfahrenstechnischen Prozesse unserer Aerogel-Produktion kennenzulernen und sich gezielt in die Bereiche Prozessoptimierung, Projektunterstützung und Prozesssicherheit einzuarbeiten. Dabei übernehmen Sie schrittweise mehr Verantwortung und entwickeln sich zum verfahrenstechnischen Experten für die kontinuierliche Verbesserung und den sicheren Betrieb unserer Produktionsanlage. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören: Analyse von Prozessdaten zur Untersuchung von Abweichungen und Ermittlung von Optimierungspotenzialen Identifikation und konzeptionelle Ausarbeitung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung von Durchsatz, Anlagenstabilität und Herstellkosten Verfahrenstechnische Unterstützung von Investitions- und Änderungsprojekten von der Planung bis zur Inbetriebnahme Spezifikation von Änderungen der Programmierung des Prozessleitsystems Umsetzung der Cabot-Prozesssicherheitsstandards am Standort Koordination von Ursachenanalysen (RCA) sowie eigenständige Durchführung ausgewählter Analysen einschließlich Nachverfolgung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen Koordination des Alarmmanagements einschließlich der Umsetzung und Nachverfolgung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen Mitwirkung bei PHAs (HAZOPs) und Durchführung von Sicherheitsgesprächen Weiterentwicklung von technischen Standards und Arbeitsprozessen Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SHE, Produktion und Instandhaltung zur Unterstützung eines reibungslosen Betriebs Ihr Profil: Master-Abschluss in den Fachrichtungen Verfahrenstechnik / Chemieingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Sie verfügen über ein fundiertes verfahrenstechnisches Grundwissen und überzeugen durch analytisches Denkvermögen, Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und die Bereitschaft, sich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Erste praktische Erfahrungen, beispielsweise durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder eine erste berufliche Tätigkeit, sind von Vorteil. Weitere fachliche und persönliche Anforderungen: Ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein Problemlösungsorientierung Selbständige Arbeitsweise Kommunikationsstärke Deutsch: fließend in Wort und Schrift Englisch: sehr gute Kenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Wir bieten Ihnen: Vielseitige Aufgaben in einem innovativen Arbeitsumfeld Ein motivierendes Arbeitsklima mit einem kollegialen Team Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten Eine unbefristete Festanstellung Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Zusatzleistungen (Altersvorsorge, Sachbezugskarte) sowie einen Leistungsbonus At Cabot, we bring the power of innovative chemistry and a spirit of partnership with our customers to advance solutions that will enable a sustainable future. Our strength in research and development is a major reason why we have been an industry leader for more than 135 years in products such as reinforcing and specialty carbons, battery materials, aerogel, fumed metal oxides, inkjet colorants, masterbatches and conductive compounds. Our employees around the world are united by our shared purpose: Creating materials that improve daily life and enable a more sustainable future. Through our corporate strategy, “Creating for Tomorrow,” we are focused on our core strengths to lead in performance and sustainability – today and into the future.

items.desc: Build Europe's semiconductor future with us! You will drive the exciting greenfield setup of our brand-new local FA laboratory – overseeing the move-in, installation, and qualification of cutting-edge analytical equipment. Once operational, you will run advanced electron microscopes to analyze defect samples, support production tool qualifications, and troubleshoot process issues. This is a unique opportunity to blend high-level material science with practical, hands-on diagnostics to maximize the reliability of our products! Job Responsibilities 1. Lab Establishment: Lead the physical setup of the local Dresden FA Lab, including the installation, qualification, and initial calibration of advanced analytical instruments. 2. Physical Failure Analysis: Apply hands-on expertise using advanced microscopy and sputtering systems (including TEM, SEM, and FIB) to perform high-resolution sample characterization. 3. Root-Cause Investigation: Support fab engineers in diagnosing defect, yield, and reliability failures by providing timely, high-quality sample analyses. 4. Team Coordination: Train and functionally guide FA lab technicians in running routine sample preparation, standard monitoring, and continuous improvement tasks. 5. Process Improvement: Build and document specialized local knowledge regarding material structures, defect physics, and packaging failure mechanisms. 6. Production Continuity: Deliver on-duty laboratory coverage during holidays and occasional planned weekend overtime (approximately once per month) to support critical production issues. Are you passionate about investigating the microscopic root causes of complex technical challenges? As a Failure Analysis Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you will be the lead detective of our semiconductor fabrication facility in Dresden. Your profile Must-Have: 1. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Material Science, Physics, Nanotechnology, Electrical/Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. 2. Hands-on Experience: Minimum of 1 year of practical experience operating advanced microscopy tools (such as SEM, TEM, or FIB). Note: Relevant master's thesis work, university research projects, or internships will be fully considered for ambitious fresh graduates. 3. Problem-Solving Mindset: A structured, detail-oriented approach to analysis with a passion for troubleshooting and technical forensics. 4. Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required. 5. Flexibility: Adaptability to evolving tasks in a dynamic startup/greenfield environment, and a readiness to support occasional weekend/holiday standby shifts. Nice-to-Have: 1. Prior experience in semiconductor failure analysis, wafer manufacturing, or cleanroom environments. 2. Knowledge of basic chemistry/etching processes for physical sample preparation. 3. Basic communication skills in German and/or Mandarin. Reasons to join ESMC Why Join ESMC? 1. Help build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe. 2. Work in a highly international environment with colleagues across Europe, Taiwan and the US. 3. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures. 4. Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration. 5. International onboarding including 9 months of training in Taiwan. More information Please apply with your English resume! About us Each journey starts with a first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation, and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and other sites around the world. Behind the world’s most advanced technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust (ICIC). We create a work environment that promotes diversity, ignites passion and enables you to reach your full potential. At ESMC, we welcome applications from all people, regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual identity.

items.desc: Nuclear fusion represents the ultimate clean energy solution. We are reviving a promising 1980s magnetic confinement reactor architecture, with a unique plasma stabilization mechanism. Modern technology resolves the historical power limitations of the concept, enabling stable, steady-state confinement and paving the way for scalable fusion power. We’re looking for a technical co-founder to the venture. This role presents an extraordinary opportunity to translate core scientific objectives into robust, operable, and scalable fusion hardware, while steering a high-impact commercial venture onto the global stage. The aim is to spin the company out of DSV over the coming months. Requirements As Chief Technology Officer, you will lead the technology and engineering roadmap, own the overall system architecture and subsystem integration. You will lead the translation of scientific requirements into safe, operable and progressively more capable fusion systems, from experimental machines toward a neutron source and eventual power plant. Key Responsibilities: Lead the technology and engineering roadmap. Own the architecture and integration of the experimental platform and supporting systems. Translate scientific objectives into engineering requirements, specifications and test plans. Lead the design, construction, commissioning and operation of experimental hardware. Direct the progression from research platform to neutron-source and reactor systems. Lead integrated reactor engineering and design optimization within the scientific envelope defined by the CSO. Ownership & Accountability: Own the system architecture, engineering integrity and demonstrated performance of the company’s integrated technology systems. Define engineering requirements, interfaces, operating envelopes and acceptance criteria. Own integration across relevant subsystems, including magnets, heating, vacuum, power, thermal management, structures, diagnostics, controls and data acquisition. Lead engineering trade-offs across performance, safety, reliability, cost, schedule, maintainability and scalability. Own design reviews, configuration management, engineering change control and technical decision records. Direct procurement, supplier selection, fabrication, assembly, installation and commissioning. Establish procedures for commissioning, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting and system modification. Own operational readiness, machine protection, engineering safety and facility reliability. Establish a rigorous test, failure-investigation and corrective-action culture that converts technical setbacks into verified design improvements. Build and lead a lean engineering capability spanning internal contributors, contractors, suppliers and partners, while retaining system-level accountability. Jointly with the CSO, provide technical sign-off on experimental configurations, major development milestones and decisions at the science/engineering interface. Maintain an accurate, decision-ready view of engineering progress, cost, schedule, dependencies and technical risks for the CEO and founding team. Support external communications, fundraising, grant applications and technical due diligence when engineering expertise is required. Experience Demonstrated end-to-end leadership in the design, integration, commissioning or operation of a complex first-of-a-kind physical system, with direct responsibility for multidisciplinary interfaces and technical performance. Experience with a fusion device, plasma experiment, accelerator, neutron source or comparably complex scientific or industrial facility. Deep expertise in at least one relevant engineering domain such as magnet systems, RF or microwave heating, high vacuum, high-power electrical systems, cryogenics, controls or thermal management; combined with sufficient breadth to lead integration across the wider system. Strong systems-engineering capability across requirements, architecture, interfaces, verification, configuration control and staged technology maturation. Track record of resolving multidisciplinary integration failures under real cost and schedule constraints. Experience designing for safe operation, reliability and maintainability in complex experimental or first-of-a-kind systems. Demonstrated ability to incorporate safety and regulatory requirements into system architecture and engineering decisions from an early stage. Ability to lead multidisciplinary engineers, technicians, suppliers and specialist contractors. Ability to translate evolving scientific requirements into practical, testable and adaptable engineering solutions. Ability to communicate engineering decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. items.desc: Join SE3 Labs as a UI/UX Software Engineer Design and build intuitive, high-performance interfaces for autonomous systems, turning complex operational capabilities into software that people can use confidently in the real world. About SE3 SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today. We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our future, help us build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands. Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field About the Role As a UI/UX Software Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll take ownership of how our software looks, feels and performs. Your core challenge is to build one coherent interface system that works across many contexts: different devices, screen sizes, plugins and product features, from large command displays to small field devices with limited computing power. You’ll combine UX/UI design with hands-on front-end development, working closely with our software team. From integrating 3D visualisations to building interfaces for military personnel in the field, you’ll help shape a product from the ground up and see the direct impact of your work. What You’ll Work On Coherent UI System & Front-End Architecture: Design and build a modular, well-structured front-end and a consistent design language that spans our whole product range. Make it easy to add new plugins and features, and to run on different systems and devices, without losing consistency or maintainability. UX/UI Design & Implementation: Work with the team to understand user needs, design and wireframe interfaces, and turn them into working software. Own both the user experience and the code that brings it to life. Multi-Device & Performance: Build interfaces that adapt across small screens, tablets and large displays, and stay responsive on resource-constrained hardware. Identify bottlenecks, optimise rendering and deliver a smooth experience without relying on high-end devices. 3D Visualisation Integration: Integrate 3D visualisations into the user interface so that they work smoothly alongside other features, including on devices with limited computing resources. Plugin & Feature Interfaces: Build reusable UI components for different plugins and product features, so that third parties and internal teams can extend the platform in a consistent way. Usability for Operational Environments: Help design interfaces for military personnel working in demanding conditions. Consider intuitive workflows, clear information hierarchy and established conventions such as NATO symbology. Learn from real user feedback and improve continuously. Collaboration & Product Evolution: Work closely with the software team to understand customer needs and translate them into design and engineering decisions. Help shape how the interface evolves as the product grows, and look for ways to simplify workflows and make new capabilities easier to understand. Your Profile You enjoy building a coherent system rather than a single screen: one design language and one component structure that works across many plugins, systems and devices. You bring hands-on experience designing and implementing user interfaces for software products, with a focus on intuitive, usable experiences across different devices and screen sizes. You have built structured, responsive and maintainable front-end applications, not just static designs or isolated prototypes, and you know how to organise code into reusable components and modular structures. You can move between UX/UI design and software development, turning wireframes and requirements into working interfaces and making informed decisions about both usability and implementation. You care about performance as well as appearance, and you work methodically to improve the experience across different hardware. You work well with engineers and other stakeholders, explore different approaches and turn ideas into practical solutions. You take initiative, enjoy open-ended problems and want to help build and shape a product rather than maintain an established interface. You’re interested in software for real-world use, where clarity, reliability and ease of use matter as much as visual design. You’re happy to work on-site with the team in Munich. Especially Valued Bonus Skills 3D Visualisation: Experience integrating interactive 3D visualisations into software interfaces, particularly using Unreal Engine or similar technologies. items.desc: Join SE3 Labs as UAV Software and Controls Engineer Lead the autonomy stack of our systems. Starting from custom firmware all the way to GCS plugins. About SE3 SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models (LLMs). We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence. Now, we’re building the physical platform to bring Spatial AI to life. That means high-performance, real-world robotic systems (starting with UAVs), and we’re looking for a skilled, hands-on engineer who’s ready to bring these machines into the real world. About the Role As Drone Software and Controls Engineer , you will be working on the full-stack avionics development of our UAV fleet. From selecting the components to tuning and configuring the UAV, all the way to GCS development and autonomy orchestration. You will be the brain behind the fleet. You will be in the middle of the software and hardware team, mastering the integration of the two fields and bringing the final product to life. What You’ll Work On Architecture & Plan: Define and develop schematics for communication and integration of the software stack across all our systems. How does UAV A get a position from UGV B? How does Payload 1 inform UAV C that it needs to land? Prototype & Iterate: Build, rework, and test hardware with speed and precision, both in simulation and in flight. Develop better simulations and tools for faster iteration. Optimize & Troubleshoot: Analyse the full flow of information via simulation and real-world testing, including UAV to UAV, UAV to GCS or UAV to payload. Document with Purpose: Keep clear records of requirements, tradeoffs, test results, tuning procedures, and implementation rationale Validate in the Loop: Support hardware-in-the-loop and environmental validation workflows to ensure rugged, reliable implementations. Your Profile You hold a B.Sc. or higher in Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience in avionics development, from component selection and firmware design to full system integration You’re confident with lab equipment (multimeters, scopes, spectrum analyzers, near-field probes) and use them to diagnose and debug with purpose You have a deep understanding of Autonomy principles and know how to develop and deal with low level issues in a UAV fleet. You’ve worked with PX4 and ArduPilot and know where to go in the code to get what you need. You’re experienced with QGC and know how to customise it to your will. You’re familiar with hardware-in-the-loop and environmental testing, and understand how designs fail in the wild You speak fluent English ; German is a strong plus Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfection. You iterate until it works. You love building things that last and love making them fly majestically.. Especially Valued Bonus Skills Architecture and software development skills. ArduPilot, PX4, or QGC open source contributor. Flying License A1-A3 Experience with multi-vehicle coordination. Perks & Benefits Real Ownership: Get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth Our Process Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other Technical Interview (45 min) : (We will deep diver into your experience and the role) Coding Interview(1 hr): (with our external coding partners) One site trial/case (1.5h) : let’s build and test a system together with our hardware team Team Dinner / Lunch : Meet the team and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides.

items.desc: Join SE3 Labs as UAV Test & Field Engineer Help us get our autonomous systems airborne and pushed to their limits. Turn advanced designs into robust, field-proven, real-world solutions. Early team, deep tech, high impact. About SE3 SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models (LLMs). We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defense. Now, we’re building the physical platform to bring Spatial AI to life. That means high-performance, real-world robotic systems (starting with UAVs) and we’re looking for a hands-on operator who’s ready to fly, demonstrate and perfect these machines with us. About the Role As our UAV Test & Field Engineer , you’ll play a key role in getting and keeping our fleet of autonomous drones in the air. Working as part of our development team, you will bring new drones to life where hardware and software come together and test their capabilities systematically in the real world. Your contribution will determine how well we understand our technology and define the path of our future development. What You’ll Work On Integrate & Checkout: Work hand-in-hand with our hardware & software developers and technicians to complete integration and get new UAVs to flight readiness. Launch and Fly: Operate and fine-tune drones from backpackable quadcopters to three meter wingspan fixed-wings (eVTOL & catapult launch). Test Strategy: You own qualification and development flight testing, from structure and organization over execution in the field to data processing and documentation. Improve & Suggest: Spot bugs and design flaws, propose & evaluate improvements, and help us move faster and build better. Demonstrate & Train: Introduce our systems to partners and end users on our test-base and in the field across Europe. Your Profile You’ve completed a Bachelors in Aerospace Engineering, Robotics or another relevant technical field You bring hands-on experience assembling, tuning and operating drones: 3+ years professionally or equivalent in racing / competition / enthusiast projects You are intimate with Q Ground Control, Ardupilot or PX4 You bring a responsible and structured approach to mission-planning, airspace coordination, etc. You’re skilled in troubleshooting drones and electronics You care about precision, quality and a systematic problem-solving approach You are proactive, willing to improvise and have a strong sense of ownership Conversational English is a must ; German is a strong plus Driving license class B, BE is a plus Especially Valued Bonus Skills Data analysis skills (log interpretation, root cause-, frequency domain analysis) You are familiar with using a command line and basic scripting Experience running environmental tests like vibration, EMI or thermal, ideally MIL-Spec Regulatory experience (EASA SORA or similar frameworks) Good understanding of sensors, signal chains, and testing setups Familiarity with CAD and 3D printing Completed military basic training and/or understanding of army processes Perks & Benefits Make your passion your job: If you love drones, you will relish this role AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge Real Ownership: Get early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy, Greece and Spain Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth Our Process Intro Call (20 min): Let’s get to know each other (conducted by our Talent Team) Technical Interview (45 min) : We dive deeper into your technical experience and problem-solving (with Francisco, our Founding Drone Engineer) Onsite Trial/Case (2 hrs): We’ll test and troubleshoot something together, just like on the job (together with our Hardware Team) Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides (can be integrated into the Onsite to accommodate long journeys)

items.desc: Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust. About SE3 SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence. Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions. We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads. About the Role As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer , you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy. This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team. The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better. What You’ll Work On Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system. Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows. Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized. Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system. Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable. Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab. Your Profile Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches. You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field. You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems. You are proficient in using CAD software, creating wiring diagrams, building …

items.desc: Athens, Greece | Full time | Home-based | R1579648 Overview IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle. IQVIA has two teams focused exclusively on amplifying the patient’s voice and enhancing their experiences across their health journey: the Patient-Centered Solutions and Connected Technologies (PACT) team, and the Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient and Site Strategy (ILS & PASS) team. These teams work closely together to generate patient experience data (PED) through clinical outcome assessments (COAs; including digital health technologies), qualitative research, and patient preference research. The ILS & PASS team has a small group dedicated to thought leadership and COA instrument development. This “science team” is focused on (a) ensuring that sound scientific principles permeate through the research completed by the PACT and ILS & PASS teams, and (b) leading the development, validation, and qualification of COA instruments to collect reliable and interpretable data from patients in medicines development and routine clinical care. The ILS & PASS science team comprises dedicated qualitative scientists and COA development scientists. Role & Responsibilities The Statistical Programmer will be expected to: (1) Empirically develop scoring rules & program scoring algorithms for existing COA measures For instruments being added to IQVIA ILS library, generate standard scoring documentation, and program simulation datasets, Data Quality Evaluation (DQE), and scoring of domains on these datasets Implement new statistical features in the random generation of data, to simulate real-world instrument data with certain psychometric properties Implement new, more advanced statistical capabilities in user tools (Insights Hub, PROCore) Work cross-functionally with non-statisticians/psychometricians in the PACT and ILS & PASS teams (2) Provide programming support for the development of new COA measures & endpoints Program classical and modern psychometric analyses and analyses of meaningful thresholds Program high frequency and continuous DHT data collaborate with data scientists to support algorithm validation, and verification of digital measure performance across diverse datasets and devices. Connecting to databases with SAS/R, and programming with validation/QC in a regulated environment would be an advantage. Candidates should demonstrate: (a) excellent written and oral communication skills including grammatical/technical writing skills; (b) critical attention and accuracy with details; and (c) strong individual initiative, organizing skills, and commitment to quality. Candidates must be able to: (a) work within a team environment, and to establish and maintain effective working relationships; (b) confidently communicate with, and effectively present information to, internal and external teams; and (c) work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and projects. Candidates should have extensive familiarity and demonstrable experience with AI tools and their application to the topics mentioned above.
