BNP Paribas, the European leader in banking and financial services in Europe, operates in 64 countries and has nearly 180,000 employees. The Group is structured around three operating divisions. Its business lines cooperate closely, as part of our integrated model, to meet the needs of all our clients in a coordinated manner: Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) , connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities; Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS) , brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses; Investment & Protection Services (IPS) , combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate. Our presence in Portugal In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centres providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates. Diversity and Inclusion Commitment BNP Paribas´ ambition is to cultivate an open and responsive environment for all that encourages collaboration and interaction. We demonstrate our commitment by actively contributing to the Group’s Diversity and Inclusion strategy and goals, in line with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As part of our local Corporate and Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal is committed to: Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees; Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard. To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society. Remote Working Conditions At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices. Commitment towards work/life balance Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life. To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page. Please note that only applications submitted in English will be considered. items.desc: Bilbao Posted 1 day ago At SATLANTIS, we develop advanced optical and space technologies with one purpose: solving global challenges from above. From our headquarters in Leioa (Bizkaia, Spain), we lead innovation in high-resolution Earth observation, satellite missions, and cutting-edge space systems. We are now offering the opportunity to join our Space Systems department as a Space Thermal & System Engineer, where you will contribute to the design, analysis, and verification of thermal architectures that ensure the performance, reliability, and mission success of our optical payloads and satellites. What’s in it for you Mission-driven engineering: You will contribute directly to the thermal design, performance, and reliability of systems that operate in real space missions, supporting Earth observation, strategic applications, and scientific exploration. Challenging, diverse projects: You will work on thermal design, simulations, satellite-level systems engineering, AIT, and mission-related activities, gaining hands-on experience across the full lifecycle of space systems. Growth and autonomy: You will learn from experienced engineers while gradually taking ownership of key thermal and system activities, with the trust and support to grow at your own pace. Flexible working hours: You will organize your schedule within a culture of autonomy and responsibility. Private health insurance: You will have access to comprehensive medical coverage that supports your wellbeing. Dynamic and collaborative environment: You will join a multidisciplinary team where learning, curiosity, and innovation are part of everyday work. Campus benefits: You will work within the UPV/EHU campus in Leioa, with access to facilities, services, and a vibrant research environment. Your mission As a Space Thermal & System Engineer, your purpose will be to design and validate the thermal architecture that ensures our payloads and satellites operate reliably across all mission phases. Your work will be essential to guaranteeing system performance, supporting spacecraft design, and enabling the success of multiple ongoing and future missions. You will also contribute to system-level engineering, satellite design, AIT activities, operational planning, and flight dynamics, gaining exposure to the full space engineering cycle. Tasks and responsibilities Primary focus: Thermal Architecture Design: define specific components, establish thermal budgets, select passive/active thermal control systems, and perform preliminary calculations. Component Selection: choose elements such as MLI/SLI, radiators, heaters, thermistors, thermal straps, heat pipes, cryocoolers, cold blocks, thermal interface materials, insulation materials, coatings, and paints. Detailed Design & Calculations: carry out design activities and thermal calculations from component level to top-level assembly. Simulation Analysis: interpret thermo-mechanical simulations and propose modifications or new solutions accordingly. Test Planning & Verification: prepare, support, and validate tests to verify thermal design performance. Documentation: generate preliminary investigation reports, detailed design reports, and PDR/CDR presentations. Thermal Simulations: perform simulations independently using ESATAN/ESARAD and transfer results to FEMAP. Secondary focus: Satellite & Mission Design: contribute to the definition and analysis of satellite missions. Systems Engineering: support system-level integration and coordination activities. Project Management: participate in planning, tracking, and execution of project milestones. Satellite Operations: provide input for satellite operation strategies and processes. AIT Engineering: collaborate in Assembly, Integration, and Testing activities. Flight Dynamics: contribute to mission analysis and flight dynamics engineering tasks. What will set you up for success Foundations in thermal design and analysis: Your knowledge in thermal modelling, simulations, or thermo-mechanical behaviour will help you contribute from day one and deepen your expertise as you face new engineering challenges. Hands-on attitude and problem-solving mindset: Your ability to approach complex technical problems with initiative, creativity, and persistence will allow you to excel in multidisciplinary space projects. Engineering background that supports growth: A degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or related engineering fields will give you the technical base to understand spacecraft systems and evolve into more complex responsibilities. Collaborative communication and adaptability: Your ability to work with different teams, contribute openly, and adapt to new tasks will help you thrive in an environment where responsibilities evolve with experience. Fluency in English: Speaking and writing English confidently will allow you to collaborate effectively in international contexts, share findings, and participate in design reviews. Basic programming knowledge: Familiarity with …

Long Description At AkzoNobel, we are looking for a Material Planner to join our Supply Chain team for the Decorative Paint Business Unit in Barcelona and play a key role in ensuring the availability of materials for our operations. Review the 12-week material outlook to ensure optimal stocking levels, considering storage constraints Ensure master data correctness & housekeeping of MRP & transactional data. Proactively manage supplier relationships by directly engaging to confirm supply, resolve issues, and ensure alignment with requirements. Anticipate supply risks through capacity checks, long lead-time component planning and demand analysis; implement preventive mitigation actions. Identify root causes of recurring supply issues & drive improvement actions along with key stakeholders to enhance performance. Monitor and optimize inventory flow (inflow vs outflow), ensuring healthy stock rotation and preventing excess or obsolete stock. Actively manage and reduce SLOB, including stock held at suppliers, ensuring stock depletion before switching materials. Quantify and communicate material risks in terms of service (OTIF) and volume impact to support prioritization. Ensure structured, complete, and timely communication of risks and actions, supporting governance forums (e.g. Gatekeeping meetings, Supply Reviews) Support projects and process improvement to enhance performance and efficiency of the required material planning activities. From museums in Mexico to sports competitions in Australia, your initial core task will be to make sure Fever gathers insightful, actionable post-experience feedback from attendees all over the world. This role is perfect for someone with a sharp eye for detail who feels comfortable working with broad and diverse groups of stakeholders. It carries a significant operational component: you'll keep our Post-Experience Survey running, gathering requirements from project teams, deploying surveys efficiently with our internal tools, and packaging and sharing the results. Once that's covered, you'll take on other projects and grow into a researcher who plans and runs studies with the right mix of qualitative and quantitative methods, and turns findings into clear, actionable insights that drive real product and business decisions. What you'll do Manage our proprietary post-experience feedback system, the core engine behind the insights the Experiences research team delivers to stakeholders across the company to track the quality and performance of our events. Engage with dozens of teams to understand the business questions that matter, and design post-experience feedback that answers them. Make sure feedback requests from colleagues and partners are delivered on time and accurately, while maintaining quality and comparability standards. Track live launches of our most strategic IPs and manage incoming requests for survey customisation. Oversee the set-up of new surveys, rigorously maintaining quality across all surveys launched globally in multiple languages. Work with partner teams such as Data and CRM to keep the feedback system and its related tools (e.g., data visualisation, email outreach campaigns) running smoothly. Deliver results to stakeholders through visualisation tools, helping them understand the relevant findings. Support partner-facing teams with analysis and storytelling, explaining methodology and how to interpret results. This means keeping oversight of dozens, sometimes hundreds, of Fever experiences every month. About you Must have skills: 2–3 years of professional experience. A proven track record in a role where attention to detail is key. Comfort keeping track of several groups of people at once and responding in a timely, professional way. You use AI tools where they help, and you own the accuracy of every output. It would be nice if you: Are comfortable communicating visually, making charts, slides, etc. Are proficient in at least one analysis tool or language (e.g., Excel, SPSS, SQL). Have previous experience in survey management, or in research more broadly. Speak both English and Spanish, and other languages too. Your growth trajectory In your first 3 months you'll get to know the post-experience feedback system inside out: how surveys are set up and deployed, the project teams that rely on them, and the partner teams you'll work with, such as Data and CRM. You'll take over day-to-day operations alongside the team and build up coverage across the experiences running each month. Between months 3 and 6 you'll reach the level of coverage we need, and start working on other projects. That's when you'll develop other core User Research skills, such as data analysis and presentation, other methods of data collection, and project definition. items.desc: Hey there! We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission. What You'll Do: Own Zendesk configuration: triggers, automations, SLAs, routing, macros, forms and permissions, keeping the instance clean and well documented. Design routing and escalation flows across email, messaging, live chat and voice, so every request reaches the right person. Build and maintain Explore dashboards with clear, agreed KPIs, giving agents and leads self-serve performance views. Analyse ticket trends to spot root causes and opportunities to improve how we operate. Simplify agents' daily work through smarter workflows, automation and integrations, and train the team on tools. Support QA and workforce management with reliable tools, data and forecasting. Test new tools and AI features, measure their impact and track the return on what we invest in. Act as the main contact with Zendesk and other vendors. Lead support enhancement projects from start to finish when needed, working with Product, Engineering and Data from requirements to rollout. Who You Are: Must have 3+ years of hands-on Zendesk administration, ideally in a multi-brand setup. Strong Zendesk Explore skills. Proven experience managing projects end to end , from scoping to rollout and measurement. Background in support or CX operations. Analytical, tech-curious and quick to learn new tools. Fluent English and Spanish. Nice to have Experience with Zendesk AI, QA or Workforce Management. Zendesk Admin or Explore certifications. APIs, webhooks or automation tools (Make, Zapier); basic scripting. SQL or a BI tool. Experience with Airtable, Jira, Slack workflows or a CRM. B2B, marketplace or live-entertainment background. Why You'll Love It Here: Attractive compensation package with room to grow. 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher. Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax-exempt). Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance. Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes. Private health & dental insurance with Cigna: 100% covered by Fever. You can also add your family members via flexible remuneration. Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan. Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons. Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location. Snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available at the office. Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment. Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey. items.desc: Är du en erfaren C++-utvecklare som brinner för teknik och avancerad mjukvaruutveckling? Vill du arbeta nära den fysiska produkten och se resultatet av din kod i verkliga, högteknologiska fordon? Då kan det här vara en spännande möjlighet för dig! Din framtida utmaning Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med kvalificerad problemlösning och utveckling av inbyggd programvara i avancerade fordonsprojekt. Du blir en del av ett mindre, kompetent team med korta beslutsvägar och stora möjligheter att påverka både tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt. I rollen arbetar du med hela utvecklingskedjan, från tidig design och arkitektur till implementation, testning och färdig produkt. Du utvecklar robusta mjukvarulösningar, arbetar med realtidsfunktionalitet och optimerar prestanda och resursanvändning. Du samarbetar nära kollegor inom både mjukvara och hårdvara, där kodgranskning, kvalitet och teknisk problemlösning är naturliga delar av vardagen. En särskilt spännande del av arbetet är närheten till den färdiga produkten. Eftersom verksamheten är samlad på plats får du möjlighet att själv testa och verifiera din programvara direkt i fordonen. Den du är Vi söker dig som har ett genuint teknikintresse och trivs med att arbeta med komplexa system där kvalitet, prestanda och tillförlitlighet är avgörande. Du har erfarenhet av C++ och en god förståelse för programmeringens grunder, exempelvis felsökning. Vi ser gärna att du har: Minst fem års erfarenhet av programmering (inkl. studier/hobby), främst i C++ Akademisk examen inom datavetenskap eller motsvarande Goda baskunskaper inom programmering, inklusive debugging och minneshantering Vana av Git och Linux. Det är extra intressant om du har erfarenhet av inbyggda system, realtidssystem eller utveckling av säkerhetskritiska produkter. Även kunskaper inom exempelvis multitrådning, nätverkskommunikation, Computer Vision, rendering, videokodning, maskininlärning eller spelmotorer är meriterande. Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och har lätt för att sätta dig in i komplexa tekniska sammanhang. Du uppskattar att arbeta självständigt, tar gärna ansvar från idé till färdig lösning och trivs samtidigt med att utveckla idéer tillsammans med andra. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Vad du blir en del av Ett viktigt och spännande jobb i ett företag i stark långsiktig tillväxt! Hos oss kommer du att ha kul på jobbet och ingen dag kommer att vara den andra lik! Du kommer att få vara med när produkten blir till från idé till dess att den rullar ut till kund. Du kommer att få jobba med framtidens teknik i ett globalt företag där du har stora möjligheter till kompetens & karriärutveckling. BAE Systems levererar några av världens mest avancerade, teknikledande lösningar inom försvar, flyg och säkerhet. Vi har 100 000 kvalificerade medarbetare i mer än 40 länder. Genom att vi arbetar tillsammans med kunder och lokala partners, levererar vi produkter och tjänster med militär kapacitet, som skyddar människor och den nationella säkerheten samt säkrar viktig information och infrastruktur. BAE Systems Hägglunds fokuserar på utveckling, tillverkning, integration och support av ett brett spektrum av militära fordon till kunder över hela världen. Våra främsta produkter är medeltunga stridsfordon (CV90), bepansrade terrängfordon (BvS10), stöd och support samt elhybrida drivsystem för den civila marknaden. Pålitlig, Innovativ och Djärv är ledorden för vår verksamhet. items.desc: Job Title IT Product Owner – Network Services, Lund Job Description Do you want to own the network services that keep a global company connected? As IT Product Owner – Network Services, you'll be responsible for how our network services are delivered from start to finish: service levels, suppliers, budget, lifecycle and continuous improvement. You'll combine technical depth with a strong service mindset. The role is based at our headquarters in Lund. Who is your future team? You'll join the IT Network team within our Infrastructure & IT Operations department. The team makes sure Axis' network infrastructure supports our position as the world leader in network video. You'll work closely with colleagues across the business, Infrastructure & IT Operations and Information Systems. They are skilled, dedicated people who share a passion for technology, innovation and doing great work together. What you'll do here as IT Product Owner – Network Services You'll own Axis' network services and make sure they deliver what the business needs, today and in the future. You'll connect the business, our network team and our suppliers, and your technical depth will let you have real discussions with all of them. The role has no direct reports, but it involves significant informal leadership: you'll guide and coordinate fellow engineers and set clear priorities for the service. In this role, you will: Make sure our network services meet agreed service level objectives (SLOs), and follow up on how the services perform Act as the escalation point for incidents and problems, drive improvements based on what we learn, and manage risks in line with our security policies and standards Manage suppliers and contracts and follow up on their delivery Build strong relationships with the business and internal stakeholders, and turn their needs into clear priorities and requirements Own the backlog and priorities, and drive agile ways of working together with the team Plan the lifecycle and roadmap of our network services, taking dependencies on other technology areas into account Who are you? Driven, structured and solution-oriented, and you enjoy the place where service delivery, business and technology meet. Close enough to operations to understand how our services actually perform. Have the overview to plan ahead and see the bigger picture, and you know when to dive into the details. A clear and confident communicator who naturally takes the lead in collaborative settings. You explain complex technical topics in a structured, easy-to-follow way, both verbally and in writing. Genuinely interested in what stakeholders need, and you turn it into clear requirements, priorities and decision support. You share your knowledge and help the people around you learn. We'd love to hear that you have: Solid technical knowledge of networking, such as routing, switching and network security, deep enough to lead discussions with teams, stakeholders and suppliers Experience of leading improvement or development initiatives for IT services or infrastructure A proven ability to guide and coordinate technical teams without formal managerial authority Excellent communication skills in English, written and spoken Bonus points if you also bring: Swedish language skills Familiarity with financial planning for IT services, such as cost of ownership and forecasting Experience of leading contractual discussions with suppliers What Axis has to offer We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal “fika” chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle. To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: Axis Career Hub Life at Axis blog Engineering at Axis blog Innovation at Axis Ready to Act? Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications. We go through applications continuously so don’t wait – send in your application today! In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Joel Cedergren at joel.cedergren@axis.com Type of Employment Permanent Employment Posting End Date …

The role also includes system ownership of Adobe Commerce/Magento, with responsibility for balancing new development with platform maintenance, security, quality and stability. You will join an international environment where collaboration, openness and learning from different perspectives are central to how we work. What you will be up to Own and prioritise the team’s backlog based on business needs and team capacity Translate business needs into clear requirements and realistic delivery plans Coordinate the day-to-day work of a distributed development team Facilitate planning, refinement, follow-ups and retrospectives Create alignment with stakeholders around priorities, timelines and dependencies Act as system owner for Adobe Commerce/Magento Ensure maintenance, security, incidents and technical improvements are included in planning Collaborate closely with the AEM team, architects and other dependent teams Good fit if you have A couple of years of relevant experience as a Product Owner or in a similar digital product or technical delivery role Experience owning and prioritising a software or digital product backlog Experience working closely with distributed development teams The ability to turn business needs into clear requirements and priorities Enough technical understanding to discuss integrations, APIs, releases, security and dependencies with technical colleagues Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills A structured, thoughtful and pragmatic approach Nice to have / technologies and areas we work with E-commerce and digital customer journeys Adobe Commerce/Magento Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) APIs and enterprise integrations System or application ownership Technical project management Platform lifecycle, security and incident management Jira, Azure DevOps, Scrum or Kanban Retail, DTC or subscription businesses You do not need experience in every area. We value curiosity, relevant experience and a willingness to learn. Should I apply? You may enjoy this role if several of these resonate with you: You enjoy bringing clarity and structure to complex topics You like connecting people across business and technology You listen to different perspectives and help turn them into shared priorities You enjoy working closely with development teams and technical specialists You are comfortable balancing customer needs with technical quality and long-term platform health You value collaboration, knowledge sharing and learning from others FAQ Do I need Adobe Commerce/Magento experience? No. It is valuable, but experience with another complex digital or e-commerce platform can be equally relevant. Do I need to be a developer? No. You should be comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, releases, dependencies and technical considerations, but you will work alongside developers and architects who provide deep technical expertise. Is this a strategic Product Manager role? Not primarily. The role is close to the development team and combines product ownership, delivery coordination and system ownership. What is the main challenge? Finding the right balance between new functionality, stakeholder needs, security, maintenance and the long-term health of the platform. Bottom line If you enjoy connecting people, business and technology, this is an opportunity to take broad ownership of an enterprise e-commerce platform while working closely with an experienced international team. You will help create clear priorities, support effective delivery and contribute to an e-commerce platform that continues to develop in a secure, reliable and sustainable way. About Verisure Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to a portfolio of ~6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, with a team of more than 30,000 colleagues. For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered a strong financial performance: Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million (46% margin) and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million (25% margin). This performance builds on the Company's track record of resilient, uninterrupted growth over the long term and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model. Verisure is majority owned by Hellman & Friedman LLC, a leading private equity investment firm. Beginning October 8th, 2025, Verisure is listed on the Nasdaq Stockholm Stock Exchange. With €3.1 …

Strong working knowledge of Windows endpoints and device enrolment. Practical experience applying identity administration and ticket handling. Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information. Experience that would add value Experience from growing companies and internal IT service teams. items.desc: Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries. The position As a Clinical Evaluator at Cambio, you will play an important role in ensuring that our medical devices are supported by robust clinical evidence and meet applicable requirements for clinical safety and performance. You will independently plan and conduct clinical evaluations while working closely with a cross-functional Clinical Evaluation Team combining expertise in the device, its intended use and the relevant clinical area. You will collaborate with colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Risk Management, Post-Market Surveillance, R&D, Product Management and Marketing. The role gives you the opportunity to work across the medical device lifecycle and contribute to both regulatory compliance and the continued development of our clinical evaluation processes. Your responsibilities will include: Plan, conduct and maintain clinical evaluations throughout the medical device lifecycle Develop and maintain Clinical Evaluation Plans and Clinical Evaluation Reports Conduct systematic literature reviews and critically assess clinical data and scientific evidence Evaluate clinical safety, performance and benefit-risk, integrating evidence from risk management, verification and validation, usability and other relevant activities Monitor emerging clinical evidence, identify residual clinical uncertainties and recommend, develop and conduct appropriate Post-Market Clinical Follow-up activities Support regulatory submissions and interactions with notified bodies We offer: The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art medical software that helps shape the future of healthcare Challenging and evolving clinical work as new technologies, including AI, raise the bar for clinical evidence, safety and performance The chance to influence how clinical evaluations are conducted at Cambio and contribute to the continued development of our clinical strategy About you You have a strong scientific and analytical mindset and are comfortable working with complex clinical information and turning it into clear, well-founded conclusions. You are quality-conscious and attentive to detail, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of your responsibilities. At the same time, you enjoy working as part of a team and collaborating with people from different areas of expertise. You are a clear and adaptable communicator, able to explain complex topics in a simple and understandable way depending on your audience. At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care and Together, and it is important that you recognize yourself in these values. Requirements Experience working with clinical evaluation of medical devices, either leading or contributing to the clinical evaluation process Experience working with the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR) and relevant guidance documents Experience in systematic literature reviews and critical appraisal of clinical and scientific data Good understanding of clinical safety, performance and benefit-risk assessment Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and good communication skills in Swedish It's a bonus if you Have experience working with medical device software Have experience with Post-Market Surveillance (PMS), Post-Market Clinical Follow-up (PMCF) or risk management Have experience with clinical research methodology, clinical investigation design or biostatistics Have experience assessing state of the art, benchmark devices or equivalence Have experience with scientific literature databases such as Embase or Medline Additional information: Place of employment : Linköping or Stockholm Scope : Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office) Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link. We look forward to receiving your application! Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life . Read more about us here! Vår plattform hjälper researrangörer att automatisera manuellt arbete och ge sina kunder bättre service. Produkten används redan av kunder och vi utvecklar den hela tiden. Nu söker vi ytterligare en Customer & Product Specialist som ska arbeta med både kundsupport och produktutveckling. Du får en kollega i samma roll och arbetar tätt med grundaren, som byggt SaaS-bolag tidigare, och med utvecklingsteamet. Det ger dig en bred inblick i hur ett SaaS-bolag drivs, från kundproblem och produktbeslut till AI och testning. Du har några års arbetslivserfarenhet, gärna från kundnära roller som support, customer success, kundservice eller implementation. Vi bryr oss mer om hur du tänker och hur snabbt du lär dig än om vilken titel du har haft. Det här kommer du att göra Ge kunderna snabb och personlig support Hjälpa nya kunder att komma igång med plattformen Felsöka tillsammans med utvecklingsteamet och följa ärendet tills det är löst Testa nya funktioner innan de släpps och se när något är onödigt krångligt för användaren Beskriva förbättringar så att utvecklarna kan arbeta vidare med dem Skriva hjälpmaterial och spela in korta instruktionsvideor Använda AI som arbetsverktyg för research, dokumentation, testning och analys Det här behöver du Du har erfarenhet av kundnära arbete, gärna i en digital eller teknisk miljö. Du lär dig nya system snabbt och tycker att teknik är spännande. Du behöver inte kunna programmera. Du gillar att hjälpa människor och vill lösa problemet själv istället för att bara skicka det vidare. Du använder redan AI-verktyg som ChatGPT eller Claude i ditt arbete eller i egna projekt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är ett plus om du har erfarenhet från ett SaaS-bolag eller annan mjukvaruprodukt har byggt eller automatiserat något med verktyg som Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Lovable eller Google AI Studio har arbetat med API: er eller integrationer och vill förstå hur de fungerar är intresserad av resebranschen Så arbetar vi Artigan är ett litet bolag med korta beslutsvägar. Vi testar, lär oss och förbättrar i korta steg och AI är en naturlig del av hur vi arbetar. Dagarna är varierade: en supportfråga, ett kundmöte och ett funktionstest kan rymmas på samma dag. Du får stort eget ansvar och stöd från dina kollegor när du behöver det. Med utvecklingsteamet samarbetar vi dagligen på engelska. Praktiskt Placering: vårt kontor centralt i Göteborg, med viss möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån Anställning: tillsvidare på heltid, med sex månaders provanställning Förmåner: tjänstepension, försäkringar, friskvård och en egen budget för din utveckling Lön: sätts utifrån din erfarenhet och vad du tillför Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan nu Så söker du Skicka ditt CV och svara på frågan i ansökan om hur du har använt AI nyligen. Om Artigan Artigan är ett svenskt AI-first-bolag som bygger moderna SaaS-, app- och webblösningar för resebranschen. Vår plattform hjälper researrangörer att automatisera sådant som annars kräver mycket manuellt arbete, ge sina kunder bättre service och arbeta smartare. Vi är ett litet team, gillar korta beslutsvägar, och tror att kombinationen av bra produktförståelse, nära kundkontakt och modern AI kan förändra hur en hel bransch arbetar.

Monitor industry and marketplace developments, including regulatory developments and promote a market-leading approach to capital and liquidity management within EME and Life. Lead and develop a team of Treasury professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. Build strong relationships across Group, regional, and local teams. What you bring Significant experience within insurance finance, treasury, capital management, corporate finance or related disciplines. Strong understanding of insurance balance sheets and value drivers. Experience working with insurance regulatory capital frameworks and capital management processes. Commercially minded with strong strategic judgements. Strong communicator with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Solution-oriented, pragmatic and comfortable operating in a dynamic environment. Able to challenge constructively and influence without using formal authority You belong here. items.desc: Vacancy details Argentina|Costa Rica|MexicoArgentina|Costa Rica|Mexico RemoteRemote Recruiter Nataliia Olkhovska Nataliia Olkhovska n.olkhovska@svitla.com Role overview Svitla Systems Inc. is looking for a Cloud and Platform Engineer for the AI Pod for a full-time position (40 hours per week) in LATAM. Svitla’s Forward Deployed AI Engineering Pod is a small, senior team that works inside our client’s environment to take the client’s AI workflows into production one Workflow at a time, measuring the business result of each. The client pays a fixed monthly fee for working capability, not hours or headcount, and directs which Workflow the Pod works on. Each Workflow runs through Discover, Foundation, Build, Prove (shadow mode against live outcomes), and Operate (handover with runbooks, evaluation harness, and training), adapted from CRISP-DM, with the client’s own engineers shadowing throughout. The Pod has up to five people in any month. Three Continuous Roles stay with the client for the whole engagement so that accountability never changes hands: the Outcome Lead, the Forward Deployed Technical Lead, and the Cloud and Platform Engineer. Specialist Bench roles (for example, agent and MCP engineering, data and semantic engineering, integration, document AI, evaluation, security architecture, data science, and adoption) rotate in as the active Workflow requires. The initial term is three months, then month to month for as long as the backlog holds Workflows the client wants in production. Continuous Role people are Svitla’s reusable core: they carry what they learn to the next Pod, reuse Svitla’s connectors, evaluation harnesses, governance patterns, and deployment templates, and improve them. As the Cloud and Platform Engineer, you will own identity, deployment, and operations for the Pod. You will stand up and run the environments, infrastructure as code, pipelines, secrets, least-privilege access, observability, audit logging, and cost visibility inside the client’s cloud, and you will secure the early security and DevOps sign-offs that let a Workflow move from shadow mode to production without surprises. Requirements Experience running ML or LLM workloads in production on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including deployment pipelines, monitoring, and incident handling. Strong experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD (Terraform or equivalent, GitHub Actions or equivalent, and containers and Kubernetes or a managed equivalent), with examples of environments built from scratch. Hands-on experience with identity and access management: IAM policies, service accounts or workload identities, secrets management, and least-privilege design, with an audit or compliance review passed. Working knowledge of a modern data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar) and of how governed access (catalogs, row and column security) is enforced. Experience with observability for AI systems: tracing, logging, evaluation metrics, and cost telemetry, not only uptime. Enough Python and scripting to automate the platform and to read the Pod’s application code. A security mindset: threat modeling, network boundaries, data classification, and encryption as default settings rather than add-ons. Clear, concise runbooks and handover documentation. Will be a plus Experience with Google Cloud with Databricks, Azure OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock. Experience deploying and securing MCP servers, vector databases, or agent runtimes. FinOps practice and cost optimization for AI workloads. Experience preparing SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOX, or PCI evidence. Responsibilities Stand up the Pod’s environments in the client’s cloud during Month 1: repositories, CI/CD, and dev, shadow, and production paths, all as infrastructure as code that the client keeps. Implement least-privilege access for people and agents: every agent is an identity with its own credentials, scopes, and joining and leaving controls, and reaches data only through the governed semantic layer and MCP surface. Own secrets management, key rotation, and the no-data-leaves-the-environment rule, including model provider and third-party API access. Build reproducible pipelines for data, model, prompt, and agent artifacts, with versioning and rollback. Put observability in from the first increment: tracing (for example, LangSmith or OpenTelemetry), evaluation and drift signals, audit logging of every agent action, and dashboards that the client’s operations team can read. Make run cost visible: model, API, compute, and storage cost per Workflow, reported monthly for the Value Ledger. Get the early security, compliance, and DevOps sign-offs from the client (architecture review, access review, and SOC 2 or regulatory evidence) so that the Prove gate is not blocked by a late finding. Write the runbook and the operations handover for each Workflow, and train the client’s team to run it. Maintain and improve Svitla’s reusable deployment templates, governance …

items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an enthusiastic, organised and highly motivated individual to join the Radiopharmacy team at The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust, Sutton as a Band 4 Radiopharmacy Administrator – Clinical Trials. Our licensed Radiopharmacy, holding both MS 'Specials' and MIA(IMP) authorisations, manufactures and supplies a range of diagnostic and therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals to The Royal Marsden and external healthcare providers. This is a 30-month fixed-term post, funded through the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NiHR), with funding secured until 31 March 2029. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting the efficient set-up and delivery of molecular radiotherapy clinical trials. The aim is an average of 150 days from contract to first patient dosed. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams across the Trust and external partners, you will provide essential administrative and coordination support to help streamline trial processes, maintain accurate records and support the development of clinical trials education and training. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to innovative cancer research and help establish The Royal Marsden as a regional and national centre of excellence for radiopharmaceutical clinical trials. You will work closely with Nuclear Medicine, Physics, the Drug Development Unit, the Institute of Cancer Research, Sponsors and The Royal Marsden School. You will also work alongside experienced Radiopharmacy Scientists and Technicians, providing vital support to the wider Clinical trials and Radiopharmacy programme. We are looking for a proactive, adaptable and detail-oriented individual who enjoys working in a busy, multidisciplinary environment and has a strong commitment to delivering a high-quality service. Previous experience in a hospital, pharmacy, healthcare or administrative setting would be advantageous. An NVQ qualification in Pharmacy Practice or Pharmaceutical Science, knowledge of medical terminology, oncology or clinical trials, and current GCP training would also be desirable. You will join a friendly, supportive and experienced multidisciplinary team committed to delivering safe, effective and innovative cancer care. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop your knowledge and experience of clinical trials while making a meaningful contribution to cancer research and patient outcomes. Informal enquiries For an informal discussion, please contact Ajaaz Hussain, Senior Radiopharmaceutical Scientist on 0208 661 3292 or email Ajaaz.Hussain@rmh.nhs.uk. The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust is a world-leading cancer centre. Our role is to offer our patients the best cancer care available anywhere in the world, and to continue to make a global contribution to finding better ways of diagnosing and treating cancer. We employ over 4,500 staff in a diverse range of careers including nursing, medical, science, radiography, pharmacy, occupational therapy, finance and administrative services. We have two hospitals – one in Chelsea, London, and one in Sutton, Surrey – as well as a Medical Daycare Unit in Kingston Hospital. At The Royal Marsden, we deal with cancer every day, so we understand how valuable life is. When people entrust their lives to us, they have the right to demand the very best. That's why the pursuit of excellence lies at the heart of everything we do. At the heart of the hospital is our dedicated team. We offer a stimulating and dynamic working environment, a wide range of staff benefits, learning and development opportunities and clear career pathways. There are opportunities to work flexibly across a range of areas and specialities and we welcome flexible working requests from point of hire to support employees work life balance. We are looking for employees who aspire to excellence, share our values and can play a crucial role in our on-going achievements. Maintain accurate and up-to-date clinical trial documentation, pharmacy site files, databases and electronic records, ensuring information is readily accessible and appropriately archived. items.desc: Applications are open for a Teaching Laboratory Technician – Thermal post, at the Department of Physics, Oxford University. Oxford Physics is one of the largest and most eminent departments in Europe – pursuing forefront research alongside training the next generation of leaders in Physics. The Oxford Physics teaching laboratories broadly cover General Physics (Mechanics), Optics, Solid State Physics, Electronics, Electrostatics and Magnetism, Atmospheric Physics, Particle Physics, Nuclear Physics and Biophysics. As part of the degree course, we teach hands-on science to around 540 students across three years, with students moving between laboratories each term. We build and upgrade experiments between terms to keep the course relevant to our goal of training the next generation of leading scientists. We seek a versatile member of staff who will have particular responsibility, with minimal supervision, for the routine operation of one or two of the experimental areas during term time including maintaining and repairing equipment, assisting with experiments, projects, outreach events, and ensuring health and safety standards are observed. The role will also include broader duties and interactions with the other technicians, students, and demonstrators in the laboratory. The successful applicant must have a qualification to level 6 in the National Qualification Framework (e.g. NVQ level 6/ degree/graduate diploma) in engineering, physics, or similar, or relevant experience in lieu of these qualifications. Proven ability to troubleshoot and repair physics - or similar - laboratory experiments, ideally in an educational environment is essential, as well as proven levels of software literacy. Experience of scientific programming packages, e.g. Python or MATLAB would be desirable. This temporary role will be based in the Thermal and Condensed Matter Physics laboratories. The successful candidate will be required to assist with a relocation of those teaching labs. Start date no later than February 2027. For informal queries please contact Dr Jenny Barnes – jenny.barnes@physics.ox.ac.uk This is a full-time post, fixed term until 31 December 2027 The closing date for applications is noon on Friday, 4 December 2026 You will be required to upload a CV, Details of two referees and Supporting Statement as part of your online application. Others will need practical fixes to the systems we run today. You’ll lead security design and help teams put it into practice. Translate, explain, and prioritise - Work with the business and engineering teams to make sure that business understands the security work that needs to be done, and engineering’s prioritisation matches the business needs. Improve cloud and identity security - Work with the Cloud team on access permissions, service identities, account and project structure, networking and logging across AWS and GCP. Make secure approaches easier to use. Work with Development and DevEx teams to build reusable designs, infrastructure modules and automated checks that fit how teams develop and deploy software. Follow up on actions and make any remaining risks clear to the people responsible for accepting them. Protect sensitive data - Help establish what data we hold, where it moves and who can access it. Design appropriate controls for access, encryption, secrets, retention and deletion. Support detection and incident response - Work with SecOps and Infrastructure teams on logging and the capabilities needed to investigate, contain and recover from incidents. Feed what we learn back into our designs. Advise the Workplace team. Help with security architecture for employee access, laptops and mobile devices, working with the teams that manage those services. items.desc: Job Description Are You Ready to Make an Impact at RSSL? Join Our Mission to Transform Lives Through Science, Innovation and Collaboration RSSL (Reading Scientific Services Ltd) is a leading scientific services company providing analytical testing, consultancy, and training to the food, drink, pharmaceutical, and consumer goods industries. A wholly owned subsidiary of Mondelēz International, we combine deep scientific expertise with practical industry knowledge. Our Training & Consultancy division delivers specialist food safety, allergen management, microbiology, regulatory, and FMCG manufacturing compliance services - both as tailored consultancy for individual client challenges and as structured training programmes for teams at every level. We work with businesses of all sizes, from start-ups navigating regulation for the first time to established manufacturers strengthening their systems. RSSL manages all client relationships and administration, so our consultants focus on what they do best: delivering expert advice and training. Purpose of the Role To provide expert consultancy and training to RSSL's food industry clients on applied microbiology in FMCG manufacturing environments, HACCP system design and verification, and BRC Global Standard for Food Safety compliance. This consultant will also support the commercial function by contributing technical content to bids, helping scope quotations, and writing specifications for training and consultancy projects. Essential Experience Extensive experience in food safety / technical roles within FMCG food manufacturing environments (not solely laboratory, retail, or regulatory) Hands-on ownership or management of HACCP systems in a manufacturing setting, including leading HACCP team meetings, conducting hazard analyses, and validating critical control points Practical applied microbiology experience: environmental monitoring programme design, shelf-life determination, challenge testing, microbiological specification setting, and root-cause investigation of micro failures Direct experience with BRCGS Global Standard for Food Safety at a practitioner level - system design, implementation, gap analysis, and supporting sites through certification audits (not just audit awareness) Demonstrated experience of working across multiple product categories or manufacturing environments (e.g., ambient, chilled, frozen, high-care/high-risk) Training delivery experience: proven ability to design and deliver HACCP training (Levels 2–4), BRC interpretation workshops, food safety culture sessions, or internal auditor training to audiences ranging from factory-floor operatives to senior management Commercial and bid-writing capability: experience contributing technical content to proposals, tenders, or consultancy quotations. Able to scope a piece of work, estimate effort, and write a clear specification Desirable Experience Experience in a consultancy or advisory capacity (not solely in-house roles) - evidence of working across multiple client sites or business units BRC Lead Auditor status or significant experience conducting BRC-related audits Familiarity with retailer Codes of Practice (major UK and European retailers) Experience with food safety culture assessments and improvement programmes Incident management and crisis response experience (product recalls, contamination events) Experience developing training course materials and curricula for food safety programmes Understanding of GFSI-benchmarked schemes beyond BRC (FSSC 22000, SQF, IFS) to broaden the consultancy offering Qualifications Degree in food science, microbiology, or a closely related discipline (essential) HACCP Level 4 / Advanced HACCP qualification (essential) Lead Auditor qualification - BRCGS, FSSC 22000, or equivalent (highly desirable) Recognised training qualification (e.g., PTLLS/Award in Education & Training, or equivalent) (desirable) Chartered Scientist (CSci) or Registered Scientist (RSci) status (desirable) MSc or PhD in food microbiology or food safety (desirable) More about this role What RSSL Offers the Consultant Zero admin, pure delivery: RSSL manages the entire commercial and administrative cycle - client acquisition, all client communications and relationship management, invoicing, billing, credit control, and debt collection. The consultant simply delivers the work and takes their day rate. No chasing clients, no unpaid invoices, no business development overhead, no paperwork Access to a pipeline of food industry clients through RSSL's established brand and active sales function - the consultant does not need to find their own leads Full support from RSSL's internal team for bid coordination, project logistics, and scheduling Opportunity to build a portfolio of work across diverse food manufacturing sectors Association with the RSSL brand - a respected name in analytical and consultancy services Flexibility of zero-hours engagement - fits alongside other consultancy commitments …

items.desc: About The Web Visions The Web Visions is an IT services and web development company. We provide website design, website development, online shopping solutions, custom software and digital marketing services. We work with businesses from different industries to provide reliable and high-quality digital solutions. We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented IT Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer / Software Tester to join our team. The successful candidate will help us check our websites and software, find problems and make sure everything works properly before it is delivered to clients. Job Overview The successful candidate will be responsible for checking websites, software and online shopping platforms to make sure they work correctly and meet the required standards. You will work closely with developers, designers and project managers to find problems, report errors and check that they have been fixed. The ideal candidate should have experience in software testing, good problem-solving skills and an interest in maintaining the quality of websites and software. Key Responsibilities Check websites, software and online shopping platforms to make sure everything works correctly. Prepare and carry out manual and automated software tests. Test websites built using WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce and other platforms. Find, record and report errors or problems in websites and software. Work with developers to help identify and fix problems. Check websites on different browsers, computers, tablets and mobile phones. Test website pages, menus, contact forms, registration forms and online payment systems. Check that online shopping features, including shopping carts and payment options, work properly. Test website updates and new features before they are made available to customers. Check website speed, appearance and ease of use. Prepare simple testing reports and keep records of identified problems. Make sure websites and software meet the agreed requirements. Suggest ways to improve website quality and testing procedures. Work with team members to make sure projects are completed to the required standard. Essential Skills and Qualifications A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related subject, or equivalent relevant work experience. Previous experience in software testing, quality checking or a similar IT role. Good understanding of how websites and software work. Experience in checking websites and finding errors or problems. Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Experience testing websites and online shopping platforms. Ability to prepare testing reports and record problems clearly. Experience using tools such as Jira, Trello or similar software to record and manage tasks. Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Excellent attention to detail. Good written and spoken communication skills. Ability to work well with developers, designers and other team members. Ability to manage tasks and complete work within agreed deadlines. Desirable Skills Experience using automated testing tools such as Selenium, Cypress or Playwright. Knowledge of testing website connections and online services. Basic knowledge of databases. Experience working in a team using Agile or similar working methods. Experience with WordPress, Shopify and WooCommerce. Understanding of website security and accessibility. Relevant software testing qualifications, such as ISTQB, would be an advantage. Key Expectations The successful candidate will be expected to: Make sure websites and software work correctly. Find and report problems before websites or software are released. Help improve the quality of our websites and digital services. Check that websites work properly on different devices and browsers. Work closely with other team members to resolve problems. Help deliver reliable and user-friendly websites and software to clients. Why Join The Web Visions? Opportunity to work on different website development and IT projects. Friendly and supportive working environment. Opportunities to learn new skills and develop professionally. Experience working with different website and online shopping platforms. Opportunity to contribute to projects for businesses across different industries. How to Apply Interested candidates are invited to send their CV and details of their relevant experience in software testing and quality assurance. Website: https://thewebvisions.com Email: hr@thewebvisions.com Pay: £42,000.00 per year Benefits: On-site parking Work Location: In person

Public Affairs Adviser (Parliamentary) Join a team where Purpose is at the heart of everything we do, Ambition drives us to be the best we can be, Respect shapes our culture and Trust builds our foundation. Contract: Permanent Salary: £42,445 - £45,000 Location: London Reporting to: Senior Public Affairs Manager Working hours: 35 hours per week - full time. Where possible, we are open to considering flexible working patterns. Please let us know in your application your desired working pattern. By joining our team, you'll enjoy the best of both worlds – hybrid working and the collaboration of a great office environment. Our permanent hybrid policy sees us all working at least four days across a fortnight in the office. As well as extensive opportunities for personal and career development. About Us: The Financial Ombudsman Service is an independent, not-for-profit organisation that plays a vital role in UK financial services. Every day we help resolve disputes between consumers, or small businesses, and their financial service providers. As our Public Affairs Adviser (Parliamentary), you’ll help strengthen our relationships and influence across Parliament and government. Working within our Public Affairs team, you’ll engage with Ministers, parliamentarians, policymakers and other key stakeholders to build understanding of our work, share our insight and support our strategic priorities. What You’ll Do: Build relationships and support engagement with Ministers, parliamentarians, policymakers and other key stakeholders. Monitor political, legislative and financial services developments, providing briefings and insight to colleagues and senior leaders. Represent the organisation externally, respond to stakeholder enquiries and contribute to government and regulatory consultations. Identify opportunities to influence policy and strengthen engagement, supporting our wider strategic priorities and objectives. To be considered for this role, you’ll need to show us that you’ve got the skills and capabilities. You’ll have to meet the following minimum criteria: Minimum Criteria – Stakeholder engagement: Demonstrable experience engaging with MPs/parliamentarians, government departments, regulators or senior policymakers. Public affairs / policy experience: Professional experience in public affairs, parliamentary affairs, government relations or policy, with evidence of monitoring or responding to political, legislative or regulatory developments. Evidence-based policy: Experience using data, research or evidence to develop policy recommendations, consultation responses, briefings or advice for senior stakeholders. Written communication: Evidence of producing senior-level briefings, parliamentary materials, consultation responses, policy papers or stakeholder communications, translating complex information into clear messaging. Why You'll Love Working With Us: We are a values led organisation. Our values define our culture, influence our decisions, and underpin our vision and strategy. They set out how we play our PART through Purpose, Ambition, Respect and Trust. You can learn more about our values here: https://www.financial-ombudsman.org.uk/who-we-are/aims-values Flexibility : Work your way — remote, hybrid, or in-office Wellbeing : [Health plan, gym memberships, mental health support] Growth : We invest in your future with [courses, mentorship, promotions] Culture : Diverse. Inclusive. Collaborative. Fun. We pride ourselves on our reward package, and it reflects the importance of the work our people do. We offer highly competitive and transparent pay and benefits, bringing together base salary, generous non-contributory pensions , private healthcare and a wide range of other benefits including: 25 days holiday entitlement, with the option to buy up to 15 days extra or sell up to 5 days (all figures are full-time equivalent) Various Family Friendly Policies, including enhanced maternity pay, carers and dependants leave Employer provided benefits such as Private medical insurance, Income protection, Critical illness cover, Life assurance cover, to name a few Choice of voluntary benefits including Technology scheme, Dental cover, Travel insurance amongst others Gym membership discounts, a fully equipped on-site wellness centre open 24/7 in London only, and remote classes Designed to be flexible across different life stages, our approach goes beyond a one size fits all model - recognising contribution and supporting wellbeing. Let’s Make This Easy. We are looking for an enthusiastic and organised Stroke Rehabilitation Assistant to join our professional service. We’re a close team but we’re never exclusive, if you can bring a professional approach and fresh ideas we would love to hear from you. items.desc: We are currently seeking an experienced Children and Young People's Mental Health Services (CYPMHS) Clinician, at Band 7 to work via a Bank Contract, based in Welwyn for our CAMHS Services. You will be joining our Temporary Staffing Team within HPFT - Hertfordshire Partnership University NHS Foundation Trust. This is a 6-month role primarily focused on undertaking the Duty Clinician function, ensuring a responsive and safe service for children and young people accessing the team. The post holder will provide clinical support, manage urgent referrals and enquiries, and maintain service continuity in the absence of allocated staff. HPFT provides services for service users with mental health, learning disability and children’s and adolescent mental health problems. Applicants should have some experience of working in a healthcare setting. HPFT has a range of healthcare settings across the County and therefore access to a car would be beneficial unless you have a disability as defined by the Equality Act 2010 which prevents you from driving All applicants need to hold a valid Professional Registration and can evidence this. To undertake the Duty Clinician role, responding to urgent referrals, queries, and requests for support from children, young people, families, carers and professionals. To provide timely triage, risk assessment and clinical decision-making for children and young people presenting with emotional, behavioural, psychological or mental health difficulties. To manage and respond to welfare calls and wellbeing checks, ensuring appropriate follow-up and escalation where concerns are identified. To maintain contact with children, young people and families when their allocated clinician is unavailable, ensuring continuity of care and effective communication. To undertake telephone, virtual or face-to-face contacts with children, young people, carers and professionals as required to support safe and effective service delivery. Hertfordshire Partnership University NHS Foundation Trust (HPFT) is rated by the Care Quality Commission as an Outstanding provider of mental health and learning disability services. Feedback from our staff about working for the Trust is very positive and, in the NHS national staff survey, we regularly see a high percentage of staff saying their role makes a difference to our service users and that they would recommend the Trust as a place to work. Our people tell us they feel supported though a great development, wellbeing and work-life balance offer and a highly compassionate, values-driven culture. We are equally proud of our staff, who live our values of being welcoming, kind, positive, respectful and professional so that together we provide great care and great outcomes for our service users and carers. Assess risk and implement appropriate risk management plans, taking account of individual, family and environmental factors. Provide consultation and advice to colleagues, professionals and partner agencies regarding the mental health needs of children and young people. Work as an active member of the multidisciplinary team, contributing to service delivery in line with Children and Young People's Improving Access to Psychological Therapies (CYP-IAPT) principles and evidence-based practice. Carry out assessments and brief interventions where appropriate, supporting immediate clinical needs and facilitating access to ongoing care. Work collaboratively with colleagues across the multidisciplinary team and external agencies to ensure coordinated care and effective communication. Act as a role model in the delivery of care, maintaining professional standards and upholding public confidence in the service Please see JD attached for further information and responsibilities required

items.desc: We are seeking an experienced and enthusiastic oncology nurse to join our Medical Day Unit as a Band 7 Practice Educator. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate educator to support the development of registered nurses, nursing associates, healthcare support workers and students within a specialist cancer setting. The successful candidate will have significant oncology experience, expert knowledge of Systemic Anti-Cancer Therapy (SACT), and an understanding of clinical trials and research practice. You will act as a clinical role model, delivering education, supporting competency development, and promoting evidence-based care across the unit. You will be passionate about teaching in the clinical environment, supporting staff to achieve competencies in areas such as SACT administration, medicines management, venepuncture and cannulation, while fostering a culture of learning, professional development and continuous improvement. Plan, deliver, document, and evaluate high-quality, evidence-based nursing care in a safe and efficient manner, working collaboratively with the shift coordinator to meet individual patient needs. Develop enhanced knowledge and understanding of the holistic needs of patients with cancer, including the range of treatment modalities provided within the unit. Gain insight into the responsibilities involved in coordinating a clinical shift, working under the guidance and supervision of the Ward Sister/Charge Nurse to support effective ward management. This role aligns with ACCEND capabilities for registered practitioners in cancer care. The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust is a world-leading cancer centre. Our role is to offer our patients the best cancer care available anywhere in the world, and to continue to make a global contribution to finding better ways of diagnosing and treating cancer. We employ over 4,500 staff in a diverse range of careers including nursing, medical, science, radiography, pharmacy, occupational therapy, finance and administrative services. We have two hospitals – one in Chelsea, London, and one in Sutton, Surrey – as well as a Medical Daycare Unit in Kingston Hospital. At The Royal Marsden, we deal with cancer every day, so we understand how valuable life is. When people entrust their lives to us, they have the right to demand the very best. That's why the pursuit of excellence lies at the heart of everything we do. At the heart of the hospital is our dedicated team. We offer a stimulating and dynamic working environment, a wide range of staff benefits, learning and development opportunities and clear career pathways. There are opportunities to work flexibly across a range of areas and specialities and we welcome flexible working requests from point of hire to support employees work life balance. We are looking for employees who aspire to excellence, share our values and can play a crucial role in our on-going achievements. For further information on this role, please see the attached detailed Job Description and Person Specification: Act as a role model and coach in clinical practice, particularly for junior nursing staff. Regularly assessing and reviewing progress towards competence and giving feedback to staff. Work clinically alongside staff to ensure clinical competency and development needs are met e.g. SACT/Venepuncture/Cannulation The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust 5. Maintain accurate and up to date records on staff training and support. Ensure newly appointed staff nurses have been introduced to the information technology available in clinical areas to enable them to access information about relevant Trust policies and procedures. Ensuring that staff nurses are aware of the location of unit based learning resources, and knows how to access evidence to inform their practice. To support nurses new to the Trust in achieving their competence in Medicines Management (IV/Oral & CD) and SACT administration. To facilitate teaching throughout the clinical area and ensure all content is up to date and evidence based.

items.desc: The closing date is 29th Nov 2026 Anticipated Interview date(s) 01/09./2026 Job summary The post holder will be a Registered Nurse/registered paramedic, with a broad general experience as a qualified professional. The successful candidate will act as an autonomous practitioner, within their boundaries of clinical practice with the freedom to make clinical decisions based wholly on their experience, knowledge, and analytical skills. They will require excellent communication skills and can work in a multidisciplinary environment under pressure. As a Clinical Supervisor, you will oversee each shift, providing shift management and clinical support to a team of Nurses, Therapist's, Senior Healthcare Support Workers, Assistant Practitioners, Paramedics and along with the Therapists, will have team responsibility for the caseload management of the patients. A key part of the role will be to liaise closely with other agencies and discharge or transfer the patient to other community services to maintain patient flow and prevent avoidable hospital admissions. The service responds to patients through Primary care/Ambulance service/A+E and other health-care professionals. Rapid Response is part of the Urgent Community Response Agenda which means the team responds to referrals with a 2-hour response, this is part of the new Urgent Community Response agenda. Main duties, tasks & skills required Rapid Response is a service which aims to meet patients' urgent care needs at home by providing urgent clinical, therapy or support interventions to keep a patient in their place of residence, which is key in improving patient outcomes, preventing avoidable hospital admissions and delivering NHS strategic priorities. The service is part of the new Urgent Community Response agenda and will respond within two hours of a referral to meet the UCR national guidelines. Part of the UCR agenda is to respond to non-injured patients who have fallen within two hours of referral. In line with national rollout of the two-hour standard, the UCR service is provided 8am to 8pm, seven days a week across Somerset. The Rapid Response service is provided between 8am to 11pm. The UCR service requires the submission of data returns to the Community Services Data Set to demonstrate the achievement of the two-hour standard. The team is made up of Admin, Healthcare Support Workers, Student Nurses/Occupational Therapists/Physio Therapists, Trainee Nursing Associates, Assistant Practitioners, Trainee Assistant Practitioners, Rehab Assistants, Paramedics, Registered Nurses, Occupational Therapists and Physiotherapists. Rapid Response has greater connections with the multidisciplinary networks such as Hospital at Home (ACP's), GPs, Health Coaches, Voluntary Sector, Social Care, Mental Health teams, Acute Colleagues, Community Nursing and Rehab Teams, Palliative care colleagues, Care agencies, ACPs, 111 OOHs and SWAST. About us At Somerset NHS Foundation Trust , we're committed to supporting our employees with a range of benefits designed to enhance your professional and personal life. We offer: Flexible working options to help you balance work and life NHS pension scheme for long-term financial security Generous annual leave allowance to recharge and relax A strong focus on career development to help you grow and achieve your potential Additionally, you'll gain access to our Blue Light Card , unlocking exclusive discounts on shopping, dining, and leisure activities, as well as NHS-specific perks to support you both inside and outside of work. We are proud to foster a diverse, skilled, and inclusive workforce , and we encourage applications from all backgrounds. Why Somerset? Somerset offers the perfect blend of idyllic countryside, outstanding areas of natural beauty , and breathtaking coastlines , with vibrant cities like Bristol , Bath , and Exeter just a short drive away - and only two hours to London . The region is home to excellent educational facilities , and with affordable housing compared to other parts of the country, it's a great place to build both your career and your future. Somerset truly has it all - the peaceful countryside and cosmopolitan city life, with something for everyone to enjoy.
