As a MLOps Engineer at Global, you’ll build the operational infrastructure that brings AI and ML models into production. You’ll own the platforms, pipelines and processes that let our Data
items.desc: Accepting Applications Until 4 December 2026 Job Description Your New Role MLOps Engineer Global:IQ is the team building our new intelligence platform, turning first-party and partner data into smarter, data-led media plans across Global’s audio and Outdoor inventory. As a MLOps Engineer at Global, you’ll build the operational infrastructure that brings AI and ML models into production. You’ll own the platforms, pipelines and processes that let our Data Science teams deploy, monitor, retrain and govern models reliably at scale—from the ground up. Key Responsibilities ML Infrastructure & Deployment (40%): Build automated pipelines for model training, validation and deployment, plus model registries, feature stores and inference services, with self-serve tooling for Data Science teams. Model Monitoring & Operations (30%): Implement monitoring, alerting and automated recovery for ML workloads—covering latency, data quality and drift—and own rollback, rollout and incident response. MLOps Governance & Best Practice (20%): Establish controls for model lineage, reproducibility and audit trails, and introduce ML-specific CI/CD, testing and release automation. Collaboration & Enablement (10%): Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering and Product, and mentor junior engineers to raise operational standards. What You Will Love About This Role Think Big: This is a true AI-driven product—ML isn’t a feature, it’s the product, and your infrastructure directly enables business value. Own It: You’re not maintaining legacy systems—you’re establishing the MLOps patterns and standards that will scale for years. Keep it Simple: You’ll build pragmatic, reusable patterns that keep ML systems reliable and maintainable without over-engineering. Better Together: Global:IQ is a tight collaboration between technical and commercial teams. What Success Looks Like In Your First Few Months, You’ll Have Defined a clear operating model between MLOps and the teams developing models. Delivered an end-to-end MLOps path for at least one production use case, from model handoff through deployment, monitoring and rollback. Established baseline standards for model versioning, environment management and deployment. Implemented monitoring and alerting across operational health, data quality and model performance. What You’ll Need MLOps experience: You’ve operationalised ML models in production, owning deployment, monitoring and lifecycle management. Strong programming: Production-quality, testable Python. Cloud expertise: Deep AWS knowledge (SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Step Functions); Snowflake a plus. MLOps tooling: Experiment tracking and registries, workflow orchestration, model serving and feature stores. CI/CD & IaC: ML-specific CI/CD, Terraform, Docker and test automation. Cross-disciplinary communication: You translate between Data Science and Engineering and explain trade-offs to any audience.

Je vertaalt complexe wensen van klanten naar technische architecturen en concrete AI-toepassingen. Je bent bedreven in het implementeren van LLMs, AI-agents, RAG-technieken, en zorgt dat AI-oplossingen betrouwbaar en beheersbaar in productie draaien. Daarnaast beheers je backend development en infrastructuurkennis, met een voorkeur voor Azure en Supabase. Frontend ervaring is een plus, maar geen vereiste. items.desc: Amsterdam or Antwerp – As a Backend Engineer within the GenAI Platform team, you help build the foundation that enables AI products across DPG Media. You design and develop scalable backend solutions that support identity, access management and platform insights for a growing portfolio of AI services. Ready to make an impact on the future of AI at DPG Media? Read on! What will you do? As a Backend Engineer, you take ownership of the platform capabilities that enable teams across DPG Media to securely use and manage AI products. You build backend services that unify user, access, usage and cost data while making architectural decisions that support the platform's continued growth. Your work ensures that new products and teams can be onboarded efficiently and consistently. You do this by: li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Defining how users, roles and permissions are managed centrally and applied consistently across every product on the GenAI Platform. Building backend services that collect, combine and expose usage, cost and user data for the platform portal and reporting. Designing scalable platform architecture that continues to perform as the number of products grows. Defining how platform resources are described so new products and teams can be added through configuration instead of custom development. Who are we? We are a small team that builds and operates the GenAI Platform used across DPG Media. The platform runs on Kubernetes and provides teams throughout the organisation with access to AI products, ranging from workflow automation to model hosting. What makes you the ideal candidate? For this role, we are looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical expertise with ownership and a pragmatic mindset. You are proactive, analytical and enjoy building scalable platform solutions. In addition, you bring: li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Around 5 years of backend engineering experience, including designing systems yourself. Proficiency in at least one backend language. We work with Go, TypeScript and Python, and you are willing to work across these technologies. Experience integrating third-party APIs and combining data from multiple sources into one consistent view. Hands-on experience with OAuth2/OIDC, role-based access models and running services on Kubernetes. Experience adding metrics and alerts to the services you build. Additional experience with Go, Kubernetes controllers or operators, declarative reconcile-based systems, usage metering, FinOps data, Terraform or GenAI systems is considered an advantage. How do you work? You take ownership of your work from design through delivery and beyond. You focus on delivering practical solutions first and continuously improve them. You proactively identify opportunities for improvement, clearly explain your reasoning and remain open to alternative perspectives. You think ahead when making design decisions and build with long-term scalability in mind. Our stack li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Languages: Go for the platform control plane, TypeScript and Python for services and APIs. Platform: Kubernetes (EKS) on AWS, Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD. Observability: Grafana, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry. CI/CD: GitHub Actions. At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we invite you to apply for this position. It is precisely through the differences between colleagues that surprising insights and innovative solutions emerge. And that fits very well with us as an organisation. We are curious about who you are and what qualities and experience you bring. Want to know more about our inclusive working environment, click here! What do we offer? At DPG Media, you will work in an inspiring environment that is constantly evolving. You will collaborate with colleagues who think in possibilities and you will have every opportunity to continue developing yourself through your work and the DPG Academy. li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> 💰 A competitive salary based on your work experience. 📝 A 36-hour work week in the Netherlands or a 38-hour work week in Belgium. 💰 8% holiday allowance and 4% personal choice budget. 💰 Annual profit sharing based on DPG Media's performance. 🎓 Opportunities to develop yourself both on the job and through the DPG Academy / DPG Campus. 🎉 The possibility to personalise your cultural public holidays. 🏢 Hybrid working, with office days agreed together with your team. Even more reasons to join DPG Media At DPG Media, we work for more than 90 leading news brands, magazines, television programmes, radio stations and online services such as Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM and many more. As part of the Specialized Enforcement Operations (SEO) team, the Brazil Market Specialist will be an adaptable critical thinker focused on a range of high-priority, complex, and regulatory enforcement challenges that require specialized support, including local context, market knowledge, policy comprehension, and social and language insights. items.desc:
Your future starts here 
 Du gestaltest Zukunftsthemen wie Cloud Security, Secure by Design, AI Governance und die Weiterentwicklung von Managementsystemen wie ISMS nach ISO 27001. In einem interdisziplinären Team berätst und begleitest du mittelgrosse bis grosse Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung massgeschneiderter Sicherheitsstrategien, Governance-Modelle sowie Risiko- und Sicherheitskonzepte. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Risiko- und Schwachstellenanalysen – auch in Cloud-Umgebungen – sowie auf der Entwicklung moderner Sicherheitsarchitekturen. Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering, Projektleitung, Sales und Product Management zusammen und unterstützt die Angebotserstellung von der technischen Machbarkeit bis zum Business Case.
 Du unterstützt die Kundschaft als Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) mit Fokus auf AI Governance, Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen (DSFA), Informationssicherheits-Managementsysteme (ISMS) und Business Continuity Management (BCM) 
 Du entwickelst Security-Konzepte, Architekturen und Massnahmenpläne 
 Du führst Risiko- und Schwachstellenanalysen durch, inklusive Cloud-Umgebungen, Zero-Trust-Architekturen und moderner Angriffsszenarien 
 Du erstellst kundenspezifische Angebote von der technischen Machbarkeit bis zum Business Case 
 Du arbeitest an spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Projekten für namhafte Kundschaft 
 Deine Skills 
 Abschluss (Uni/FH) in Informatik, IT-Security oder Cybersecurity 
 Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch (C1) in Wort und Schrift 
 Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in IT-Security-Beratung oder Security Assessments 
 Mindestens eine relevante Zertifizierung, zum Beispiel CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CISA, GIAC oder ISO 27001/42001 Implementer 
 Kenntnisse in Zero-Trust, SIEM/SOAR und DevSecOps von Vorteil 
 Freude daran, komplexe technische Themen klar und überzeugend gegenüber Führungskräften und Fachabteilungen zu kommunizieren 
 Fähigkeit, flexibel zwischen technischer Expertise, strategischer Beratung und praxistauglicher Umsetzung zu wechseln 
 Erste Erfahrung in der Leitung von Security-Projekten oder Teilprojekten, in denen du Verantwortung übernimmst und den Überblick behältst 
 Als Teil unseres Teams hast du Zugang zu fortschrittlichsten technologischen Entwicklungen und kannst aktiv dazu beitragen, diese in die Dienstleistungen der Bankenbranche zu integrieren. Wir bieten eine flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung im Rahmen der Kundenbedürfnisse, um eine gute Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben zu ermöglichen. Als Mitarbeitende*r von Swisscom kannst du dich auf eine Vielzahl von attraktiven Leistungen freuen, die deine Arbeitserfahrung bereichern werden. Dazu gehören ein angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld, finanzielle Vorteile und spannende Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung. Benefits .

items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
Sales Manager 
 __
 Bouw mee aan de toekomst van industrie, energie en automatisering 
 De industrie staat voor grote uitdagingen. Bedrijven moeten efficiënter, duurzamer en flexibeler opereren, terwijl de energietransitie en digitalisering in hoog tempo doorgaan. Bij ABB helpen we onze klanten deze uitdagingen om te zetten in kansen.
 Als Business Developer Automation speel jij een sleutelrol in deze transformatie. Je gaat primair aan de slag met het Automation portfolio van ABB en werkt nauw samen met de product managers op het gebied Autonomous Operations, Terminals & Logistics en Energy Systems. Je werkt op het snijvlak van technologie, commercie en strategie en helpt klanten hun bedrijfsvoering slimmer, duurzamer en toekomstbestendig te maken.
 Dit is een rol voor iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van nieuwe business, het opbouwen van relaties op alle niveau’s en het creëren van commerciële kansen rondom innovatieve technologieën.
 Wat ga je doen? 
 In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het identificeren, ontwikkelen en realiseren van nieuwe commerciële kansen binnen de Nederlandse markt.
 Je:
 Krijgt energie van netwerken, bijvoorbeeld door aanwezig te zijn op evenementen met als doel om leads te genereren.
 Bouwt een sterke pipeline van strategische opportunities en begeleidt deze van eerste contact tot concrete business.
 Bouwt relaties op met klanten, partners en besluitvormers op alle niveau’s.
 Positioneert ABB als strategische partner op het gebied van automatisering, elektrificatie en energiebeheer.
 Signaleert marktontwikkelingen en vertaalt deze naar concrete businesskansen.
 Eigent de waardeproposities persoonlijk toe die aansluiten bij de uitdagingen van de klanten en partners en weet deze op een overtuigende wijze over te brengen.
 Werkt nauw samen met Product Management, Solutions Architects, Operations en Service. Dit in Nederland maar ook met de ABB collega’s in buitenland.
 Organiseert en begeleidt klantworkshops, strategische gesprekken en businesscases.
 Draagt actief bij aan de verdere groei van ABB binnen de strategische programma's Autonomous Operations en Energy Systems.
 Waarom deze functie? 
 Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van:
 Strategische impact 
Je werkt aan de belangrijkste groeiprogramma's van ABB binnen Nederland.
 Innovatieve technologie 
Je bevindt je in het hart van ontwikkelingen op het gebied van automatisering, digitalisering, elektrificatie en energiebeheer.
 Ondernemerschap 
Je krijgt de ruimte om nieuwe kansen te ontdekken, te ontwikkelen en om te zetten in resultaat.
 Zichtbaarheid 
Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met klanten, partners, managementteams en interne stakeholders.
 Maatschappelijke relevantie 
Je helpt klanten hun energieverbruik te optimaliseren, hun prestaties te verbeteren en hun duurzaamheidsdoelen te realiseren.
 Wat breng jij mee? 
 Je bent een ondernemende business developer die technologie begrijpt én kansen weet om te zetten in concrete business.
 Daarnaast heb je:
 Een afgeronde hbo- of WO opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Engineering, Elektrotechniek, Automatisering, Energy Systems of Bedrijfskunde.
 Ervaring binnen business development, sales, key accountmanagement, productmanagement of een vergelijkbare commerciële rol.
 Affiniteit met industriële automatisering, elektrificatie, energiebeheer of digitale oplossingen.
 Ervaring met het opbouwen van relaties op senior management- en directieniveau.
 Een sterk commercieel inzicht en het vermogen om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar waardevolle oplossingen.
 Uitstekende stakeholdermanagement- en samenwerkingsvaardigheden.
 Goede beheersing van zowel Nederlands als Engels.
 Wat heeft ABB jou te bieden? 
 Een verantwoordelijke, sprankelende fulltime baan mét impact bij de internationale marktleider op het gebied van elektrotechniek en automatisering. Verder bieden we jou een:
 • salaris op basis van jouw opleiding en ervaring (Cao metaalelektro).
 • bonusregeling.
 • 13e maand.
 • auto van de zaak.
 • 27 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen.
 • goede pensioenregeling.
 • opleidingen en cursussen om jouw talenten verder te ontwikkelen.
 • telefoon en laptop van de zaak.
 • fietsplan en bijdrage aan je sportabonnement.
 Interesse? 
Registreer uw CV en solliciteer online via www.abb.nl door te klikken op “Carrière”. Voor vragen over de vacature kan u terecht bij Jacqueline Pereboom, tel. 010-4078214 of via e-mail soll@nl.abb.com.
 Over ABB Energy Industries 
 Binnen Energy Industries helpen we klanten hun prestaties, betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en duurzaamheid te verbeteren door middel van automatisering, digitalisering, elektrificatie en lifecycle-oplossingen.

 eine abgeschlossene Chemieverfahrenstechnik-Lehre o.ä.

 Warum Novartis? 
 Unser Vorsatz ist es, die Medizin neu zu gestalten, um Menschenleben zu verbessern und zu verlängern. Unsere Vision ist es, das wertvollste und vertrauenswürdigste Pharmaunternehmen der Welt zu werden. Wie wir das erreichen werden? Mit unseren Mitarbeitern. Es sind unsere Mitarbeiter, die uns tagtäglich dazu antreiben, unsere Ziele zu erreichen. Werden Sie Teil dieser Mission und dieses großartigen Teams! Erfahren Sie hier mehr: https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture 
 Stellen Sie sich vor, was Sie bei Novartis tun könnten!
 Was wir bieten: 
 Erwartete jährliche Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position: 48,483.00 - 73,500.00 EUR€ (auf Vollzeitbasis). 
 Das angebotene Grundgehalt wird auf Basis geschlechtsneutraler Kriterien festgelegt, wie relevanter Fähigkeiten, Kompetenzen und Erfahrung, im Einklang mit der Vergütungspolitik von Novartis, und wird nach Einstieg regelmäßig überprüft.

 Die Vorteile, Teil unseres Teams zu sein, gehen weit über das Grundgehalt und variable Vergütung hinaus. Wir bieten zudem eine Vielzahl wettbewerbsfähiger Zusatzleistungen, um Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung zu fördern, darunter Versicherungsangebote, Altersvorsorge, Wellbeing-Angebote sowie globale Anerkennungsprogramme. Darüber hinaus ermöglichen wir – wo möglich – flexible und hybride Arbeitsmodelle sowie mindestens 14 Wochen bezahlte Elternzeit.
 Neben einem marktgerechten Grundgehalt bieten wir ein attraktives Bonus/Incentive Programm, eine moderne Firmenpension, Kinderbetreuungseinrichtungen, Aus- und Weiterbildungsprogramme und weltweite Karrieremöglichkeiten innerhalb der Novartis Gruppe.
 Engagement für Vielfalt und Inklusion: 
 Novartis setzt sich dafür ein, ein herausragendes, integratives Arbeitsumfeld und vielfältige Teams aufzubauen, die die Patient:innen und Gemeinschaften, denen wir dienen, repräsentieren.
 Unterstützungen für BewerberInnen mit Behinderungen: 
 Wenn Sie aufgrund einer Erkrankung, einer körperlichen Behinderung oder eines neurodiversen Zustandes eine Unterstützung bei unterschiedlichen Teilen des Rekrutierungsprozesses benötigen, wenden Sie sich bitte an disabilities.austria@novartis.com und teilen Sie uns die Art Ihrer Anfrage sowie Ihre Kontaktinformationen mit. Unsere Unterstützung umfasst die Beratung zu geeigneten Positionen sowie die Begleitung bei allen Phasen des Bewerbungsprozesses. Das österreichische Gesetz sieht die Möglichkeit vor, die örtliche Behindertenvertrauensperson (BVP) in das Bewerbungsverfahren einzubeziehen. Wenn Sie dies wünschen, teilen Sie uns dies bitte vorab als Vermerk in Ihrem Lebenslauf mit.
 Warum Novartis: Menschen mit Krankheiten und ihre Familien zu unterstützen, erfordert mehr als nur innovative Wissenschaft. Es braucht eine Gemeinschaft von klugen, engagierten Menschen wie Ihnen, die zusammenarbeiten, sich gegenseitig unterstützen und inspirieren. Gemeinsam schaffen wir Durchbrüche, die das Leben von Patientinnen und Patienten nachhaltig verbessern. items.desc:
See German version below 
 Introduction to the job
 At our Berlin site, our employees manufacture key components for ASML lithography systems. As part of our precision manufacturing team, you support the production of optical components, assemblies, and systems made of glass, glass-ceramics, and ceramics for our high-tech small-batch, single-part, and prototype production.
 As a Strategic Space Planning Engineer, you will shape the long-term development of production and laboratory facilities across the entire campus. The role focuses on analyzing future space requirements , developing and evaluating different planning scenarios, and creating sustainable concepts to support growth, transformation, and evolving business needs. You will operate in an environment characterized by continuous change and long-term strategic decision-making.
 The emphasis of this role is on strategic space and site planning rather than the operational planning or optimization of day-to-day manufacturing processes, such as material flow planning or cycle time improvements.
 Role and responsibilities
 As a Strategic Space Planning Engineer, you will:
 Own and further develop the long-term space planning process for cross-functional space demand planning across manufacturing, research, and development areas.
 Coordinate annual planning cycles with business stakeholders and translate future requirements into an integrated space development plan.
 Analyze, model, validate, and interpret complex data to enable sustainable planning decisions.
 Conduct scenario analyses and feasibility assessments to evaluate future space requirements and development options.
 Develop, challenge, and optimize space and layout concepts to support long-term campus objectives.
 Evaluate the effectiveness of implemented planning measures, identify improvement opportunities, and continuously enhance planning approaches and processes.
 Prepare decision-making materials and recommendations for senior stakeholders and contribute to the long-term strategic development of factory and campus planning.
 Education and experience
 Degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Factory Planning, or a comparable technical discipline.
 Several years of experience planning and developing space concepts and space requirements within a manufacturing environment.
 Strong knowledge of demand planning, scenario modeling, and data-driven decision-making processes.
 Experience analyzing large datasets, evaluating data quality, and translating analytical findings into robust planning recommendations.
 Good understanding of industrial facilities, technical infrastructure, and the spatial requirements of technical equipment and organizational functions.
 Experience working with planning and visualization tools, including CAD-based environments.
 Professional proficiency in German and English.
 Skills
 The role requires strategic thinking, analytical strength, and the ability to bring together different business requirements. To thrive in this role, you will need the following skills:
 Strategic mindset with a focus on long-term space and site development.
 Analytical and data-driven approach to complex challenges.
 Ability to quickly identify relationships, dependencies, and implications.
 Confident communication with a wide range of stakeholder groups.
 Ability to balance competing priorities and interests.
 Strong ownership and a structured way of working.
 Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to learn.
 Other information
 What we offer 
 Job with bright future prospects at an innovation leader in the semiconductor industry in Berlin Neukölln
 Remuneration according to company collective agreement (with IG Metall) including 13th monthly salary and variable remuneration components
 Collective working time: 35 hours/week
 Flexible arrangement of your daily working hours (depending on the work area)
 30 days of vacation
 Reimbursement of moving expenses for you and your family (starting from 100 km distance)
 Participation in the Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP)
 Specific advanced training and development opportunities
 Access to organized childcare and vacation care
 Comprehensive health and well-being programs
 Mobility benefits to support your commute: company transit pass, parking card, and bike purchase program
 Diversity and inclusion 
 ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that diversity and inclusion is a driving force in the success of our company.

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
Le site GE HeathCare de Buc, centre d’excellence européen en imagerie médicale, rassemble environ 2000 personnes qui travaillent à la conception et la fabrication du summum de la high tech en termes d’imagerie. Au sein de l’équipe Génération des Rayons X (XRayGen), nous façonnons l'avenir de la génération des rayons X avec innovation et expertise technique. Rejoignez-nous en tant qu'Ingénieur(e) d’Intégration Logiciel. Vous serez responsable de l'intégration de composants logiciels embarqués, assurant la cohérence et la fiabilité du sous-système au regard des exigences spécifiées nécessaires à piloter les tubes RX, cœur du dispositif d’imagerie médicale. 
 Job Description 
 Responsabilités principales
 · Vérification sous-système : Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie et le processus de vérification du sous-système à partir des exigences et de son architecture. S’assurer de la couverture des exigences et de la traçabilité entre exigences, méthodes de vérification, procédures d’essai et résultats.
 · Processus et procédures de vérification : Définir, améliorer et maintenir les processus, plans, procédures et protocoles de vérification nécessaires à la démonstration de conformité du sous-système. Garantir leur robustesse, leur reproductibilité et leur adéquation avec les exigences à vérifier.
 · Exécution et suivi de la vérification : Préparer, planifier, coordonner et exécuter les campagnes de vérification. Suivre leur avancement, analyser les résultats et écarts, assurer leur traçabilité et piloter les actions nécessaires à leur résolution en collaboration avec les équipes de développement et les experts techniques.
 · Validation et qualification des moyens de vérification : Définir et mettre en œuvre les activités nécessaires à la qualification des moyens d’essai, outils, bancs de test et méthodes de mesure utilisés pour la vérification. S’assurer que les moyens de vérification sont adaptés à leur usage et permettent d’obtenir des résultats fiables et reproductibles.
 · Intégration sous-système : Élaborer et exécuter les plans d’essai fonctionnels et de performance en s’appuyant sur une bonne compréhension de l’architecture, des interfaces et des spécifications du sous-système. Identifier, caractériser et résoudre de manière proactive les problèmes d’intégration.
 · Intégration système : Anticiper les risques d’intégration système en établissant et exécutant, avec les équipes de conception système, des plans de réduction des risques techniques . Contribuer à la préparation et à l’intégration du sous-système dans les systèmes d’imagerie.
 · Gestion des anomalies et dépannage : Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes rencontrés pendant les phases d’intégration et de vérification. Structurer l’analyse des anomalies, identifier leurs causes racines et coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes concernées.
 · Documentation : Créer et maintenir une documentation rigoureuse des stratégies et plans de vérification, procédures d’essai, résultats, rapports de vérification et éléments de traçabilité , ainsi que des processus d’intégration du sous-système.
 · Collaboration : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de Systems Engineering et de développement logiciel, électronique et mécanique afin de comprendre les exigences, préparer l’intégration et la vérification, et contribuer à garantir la qualité du produit final.
 · Amélioration continue : Identifier et déployer des améliorations des processus, méthodes et outils d’intégration et de vérification. Rester informé des meilleures pratiques et des nouvelles technologies applicables à la génération des rayons X, aux méthodes de test et à l’analyse de données.
 · Encadrement et leadership technique : Apporter un leadership technique sur les activités de vérification et d’intégration , partager les bonnes pratiques et accompagner les membres plus juniors de l’équipe dans la préparation, l’exécution et l’analyse des activités de test.
 Qualifications de base et éducation
 Ce poste nécessite une expérience en ingénierie système, intégration et vérification de systèmes complexes , idéalement dans le domaine de l’imagerie médicale ou des dispositifs médicaux.
 Diplôme d’ingénieur ou Master en génie électrique, génie informatique, génie mécanique, ingénierie système ou dans un domaine connexe.
 Expérience
 Expérience significative dans l’intégration et la vérification de systèmes ou sous-systèmes embarqués complexes , idéalement dans le domaine médical.
 Expérience dans la définition et l’exécution de stratégies, plans et procédures de vérification .
 Expérience dans la gestion de campagnes de vérification , depuis leur préparation jusqu’à l’analyse et la documentation des résultats.
 Expérience pratique des méthodologies de développement système, notamment cycle en V et Agile .
 Bonne compréhension de la gestion des exigences et de la traçabilité entre exigences et activités de vérification .

items.desc:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life 
At Medtronic, we strive without reserve for the greatest possible reliability and quality in our products and processes. To help ensure our patients safety and health, we closely monitor and report on our products’ performance. The Technical Services department in Heerlen is responsible for addressing clinical/technical product inquiries for Europe, Middle East and Africa. 
The Technical Service Specialist is responsible for providing remote technical support (phone, e-mail) for the Neuromodulation and Pelvic Health Operating Units. This includes device functionality evaluation, device application advice, troubleshooting and initiate required escalations when needed. 
We invite both experienced professionals and recent graduates to apply for this position.
 Primary Responsibilities: 
 Provide world class technical support to our customers.
 Serve as a technical liaison between our stakeholders and the strategic operating unit in the USA.
 Has in-depth knowledge of all relevant products.
 On-call availability between 7AM-7PM (availability rotates between colleagues).
 Performs technical activities requiring considerable judgement and may have ownership of projects.
 Responsible for ensuring all documentation/system entries are fully complete.
 Provide training to internal and external customers.
 Connects easily with the stakeholders and is customer focused.
 Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in (biomedical/electrical/mechanical) engineering, or health related degree with demonstrated technical skills.
 Fluency in English and Dutch is a must. Fluency in another European language (French, Spanish, Italian or German) is a distinct advantage.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills that are balanced with speed and effectiveness.
 Preferred Qualifications:

Are you a Site Reliability Engineer looking for more than your next technical role? 
 At EMBL-EBI, you’ll help build and evolve the platforms that make vital scientific data accessible to researchers around the world, while developing your skills, broadening your technical expertise and building a long-term career in infrastructure engineering. 
 We’re looking for an engineer with a solid foundation in Kubernetes, Linux, automation and production services who is keen to take the next step. You’ll join a team investing in its future, with opportunities to take on increasing responsibility as your skills and experience grow. 
 About the Team 
 You’ll join the Applications Group , working within the Web Applications Platform Team. Led by David Ocaña, Head of Applications – Web Hosting & DB, the group sits at the intersection of IT infrastructure and scientific services, helping teams deliver the web applications and databases that underpin EMBL-EBI’s research resources. 
 Our platforms support services used by the global scientific community, including resources such as Ensembl, UniProt and Expression Atlas. With billions of requests handled each month, reliability, scalability, security and performance are fundamental to what we do.

Working closely with colleagues across Infrastructure and Operations, you’ll help shape how these platforms are designed, managed and improved.

 Just as importantly, we want to invest in your development 
 This role is designed for someone who has established their technical foundations and is ready to grow. As you build expertise and demonstrate increasing ownership, there is scope to progress towards a senior engineering role, with greater autonomy and opportunities to guide colleagues, and potentially towards a more strategic coordination role over time. Your development will be supported by practical experience, collaboration and the opportunity to take on progressively more complex challenges.

 You’ll help build, operate and improve the platforms that host EMBL-EBI’s public-facing scientific web services. This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll develop your expertise in production infrastructure, automation, monitoring and service reliability, while contributing to a team-wide programme of continuous improvement. 
 Your responsibilities will grow with you: from delivering reliable technical solutions and improving day-to-day operations to taking greater ownership of projects, helping shape engineering practices and supporting the wider team as your experience develops.

 Automate and simplify operations: Develop and improve automation, configuration management and deployment processes to reduce manual effort and improve consistency. 
 Develop our monitoring capabilities: Work with tools such as Prometheus and Elasticsearch to improve infrastructure monitoring, observability and insight into service performance.

 Collaborate across teams: Work with colleagues in Applications, Infrastructure and Operations to solve problems, share knowledge and deliver improvements. 
 Grow your technical ownership: Take increasing responsibility for tasks and projects, contribute to prioritisation and, as your experience develops, help guide technical decisions and support colleagues.

Job Description: 
 In order to support our Gust Engineer Team, Airbus is looking for a 
 Junior Gust Loads Engineer (d/f/m) 
 Are you passionate about aircraft physics? 
Are you keen to master the way we compute external loads acting on the vehicle due to manoeuvres, flight in turbulence, landing impact, ground-handling?
Do you like to work in an empowered manner? 
Do you enjoy connecting people and collaborating with many different interfaces? 
This job will give you the opportunity to work internationally with several internal flight physics departments and with teams located in Europe and India. 
 We are a team of multicultural and passionate engineers who perform the gust calculations for overall aircraft design for all aircraft types. Our team is involved from a very early design stage until certification and also in-service support. We are responsible for running build model activities such as finite element modelling, creating mass and aerodynamics models. We perform gust loads calculation, including failure cases, and deliver to internal interfaces. On top, we are deeply involved in research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, model based system engineering, automation and machine learning. 
 Your location 
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

 As Gust Engineer, you will contribute to: 
 Optimize the global design of Airbus products during the concept phases 
 Contributing in building Aerodynamic/Mass/Finite Element model based using Airbus in-house tools 
 Compute gust loads based on CS25 requirements 
 Develop key competences in the areas of loads and aeroelastics along with the required methods and tools 
 Actively support us as a new member of our team on our journey 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 You have a Master degree or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent 
 You have experience in Gust and Aeroelastic modelisation and analysis 
 You have experience in overall aircraft design and basic competencies in flight loads calculation and flight mechanics 
 You have experience in aeroelasticity methods and are experienced in coding using Python and/or Matlab

 The Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) Programmer / Metrologist is responsible for precision dimensional inspection, quality verification, and metrological analysis of manufactured parts, tooling, and assemblies. Operating within quality assurance, machining, and tooling operational environments, this role ensures all components strictly conform to 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, and Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) standards. 
 HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM 
 1. Equipment Setup & CMM Operation 
 Machine Preparation: Calibrate, configure, and qualify CMM probes, styli, and sensor systems prior to measurement runs. 
 Part Loading & Fixturing: Securely position and align complex parts, jigs, and tooling fixtures on the CMM granite bed using precision work-holding equipment. 
 Inspection Execution: Run manual, semi-automated, and fully automated CNC/DCC measurement programs to verify linear, angular, and complex geometric features. 
 2. CMM Programming & Metrology Setup 
 Program Execution & Editing: Load, edit, and optimize existing CMM routines (or generate programs using reverse engineering solutions) using industry-standard metrology software (e.g.,LK Camio, PC-DMIS, ZEISS CALYPSO, SA, PolyWorks, or Renishaw MODUS). 
 CAD Alignment: Align physical components to 3D CAD models using standard reference frame methods (3-2-1, iterative, or datum target alignments). 
 3. Data Analysis & Quality Control 
 Dimensional Inspection: Compare measured data against 2D blueprints, engineering specs, and GD&T limits. 
 Non-Conformance Reporting (NCR): Identify, flag, and document dimensional out-of-tolerance conditions; isolate defective components and collaborate with quality/process engineering for root-cause analysis. 
 Documentation & Reporting: Produce clear inspection reports, First Article Inspection (FAI) sheets, and Statistical Process Control (SPC) documentation for compliance tracking. 
 4. Maintenance & Calibration Support 
 Routine Care: Perform daily operational checks, clean granite reference surfaces, check pneumatic/air bearing supply lines, and maintain standard equipment hygiene. 
 Calibration Audits: Assist with periodic machine recalibration, artifact calibration, and gauge R&R (Repeatability & Reproducibility) studies.

 GD&T & Blueprint Reading - Strong proficiency in ASME Y14.5 / ISO 1101 standards, technical drawings, datum structures, and feature control frames. 
 Metrology Tools : Hands-on experience with CMMs, plus manual precision tools (micrometers, height gauges, bore gauges, dial indicators, gauge blocks). 
 Software Proficiency : Familiarity with CMM software (PC-DMIS, Calypso,LK Camio, SA, etc.) and CAD viewing/modeling environments (CATIA). 
 Mathematical Aptitude: Sound understanding of spatial geometry, trigonometry, and coordinate transformation systems.

 Ready to help shape the future of flight? As a DMU (Digital Mock-Up) Data Integrator at Airbus, you will be at the heart of our virtual aircraft development. items.desc:
Job Description: 
 In order to support the Solar Array Quality team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Quality Inspector – Solar Array (d/f/m) 
 Within Airbus Defence and Space in Ottobrunn, our Solar Array Quality team ensures that space hardware meets the highest quality and safety standards before heading into orbit. 
 In this role, you will act as a key contributor to product integrity across assembly, integration, and testing (AIT) activities. You will conduct incoming, in-process, and final inspections on semi-automated and automated production lines, ensuring complete compliance with customer requirements and quality assurance standards. 
 This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks. 
 Your location 
 Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? 
 The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Perform incoming, kitting, in-process, and final inspections on components, solar cell assemblies, coupons, and photovoltaic assemblies (PVA) according to established procedures. 
 Act as a guardian of conformity during assembly, integration, and testing (AIT), executing critical process surveillance, four-eyes checks, and formal sign-offs/stampings. 
 Conduct electro-luminescence (ELM) and photoluminescence (PLM) analysis, key inspection points (KIP), mandatory inspection points (MIP), and quality delegation surveillance. 
 Record, document, and manage non-conformances (NCRs/ORs) within the quality management database (NC CAPA) in close coordination with operations and product assurance. 
 Establish comprehensive inspection reports, daily operation record sheets, and support the maintenance of flight hardware end item data packages (EIDP). 
 Provide go/no-go decisions for activities presenting potential risks to personnel or hardware in alignment with production leadership. 
 Support quality documentation, internal flash audits, and occasional off-site inspection campaigns as needed (occasionally abroad). 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 You have vocational training or a technical degree in mechanical, electrical, or aerospace engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 You have proven professional experience in quality assurance, quality inspection, or manufacturing operations . 
 You have a solid technical understanding of manufacturing processes and quality standards; prior experience with space hardware, solar arrays, or cleanroom environments is advantageous. 
 You have experience with non-conformance management, inspection protocols, and standard documentation procedures. 
 You are reliable, possess strong integrity, with great attention to details, and enjoy problem solving 
 You have a good working knowledge of standard IT tools including SAP and MS Office applications. 
 You have proven professional working proficiency in German and English to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams. 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 
 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

Job Description:

 Degree in mechanical engineering and high technical interests

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a Central Functions Controller has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space in Getafe (Madrid). 
 The selected candidate will join the Central Functions F&C team, acting as the strategic Finance Business Partner for central functions across Airbus Defence and Space. Our international team steers financial performance and planning for central functions supporting more than 2,500 professionals across our four European home countries. Based in Getafe, you will be responsible of the financial steering for the Spanish perimeter, partnering directly with executive stakeholders and department heads to drive cost efficiency, optimize resource allocation, and support data-driven business decisions in a high-impact, multicultural aerospace environment. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 The jobholder will be responsible for: 
 Manage Planning & Budgeting Cycles: Drive the annual budgeting and forecasting for costs, headcount, workload and statistical key figures across Spanish central functions in close alignment with the divisional Financial Business Partner of each function 
 Act as a local Business Partner: Collaborate with and challenge local management and department heads to optimize financial performance and align functional strategies with company targets. 
 Analyze & Steer Performance: Deliver monthly performance tracking, identify variances against budget/forecasts, conduct root-cause analysis, and recommend actionable corrective measures to improve cost competitiveness and operational efficiency. 
 Drive Decision Support & Financial Modeling: Build robust financial models and business cases to evaluate organizational changes and operational initiatives, ensuring clear visibility into financial risks and opportunities. 
 Streamline Financial Governance & Processes: Coordinate closing activities alongside General Accounting, Cost Accounting, and the wider European Controlling network, ensuring compliance, financial integrity, and data consistency. 
 Champion Continuous Improvement: Support the enhancement and automation of controlling dashboards and reporting tools to increase transparency and accelerate management reporting. 
 Candidates must meet all legal and professional requirements for the role.

 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Industrial Management, or a related field. 
 Experience: 3 to 5+ years of proven experience in Financial Controlling, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), or Business Partnering—ideally within an international, matrixed, or industrial organization.

 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, large dataset handling)

 Strong foundation in management accounting, cost allocation, and variance analysis. 
 Soft Skills: High business acumen with the assertiveness and diplomatic skills needed to challenge senior stakeholders constructively. 
 Strong emotional intelligence, conflict management, and relationship-building capabilities in cross-functional, multicultural environments. 
 Analytical rigor with the ability to translate complex numerical data into clear, actionable business insights.

Job Description: 
 Wir suchen
 (Senior) Full-Stack Software Engineer (d/m/w) – AI-based Autonomy Hub 
 Um die Zukunft autonomer Systeme zu gestalten, bündelt Airbus seine Stärken in den Bereichen Künstliche Intelligenz und Autonomie. Zu diesem Zweck etablieren wir ein neues, agiles Kompetenz- und Entwicklungszentrum am traditionsreichen Technologiestandort von Tesat in Backnang. In diesem Umfeld, das jahrzehntelange Expertise in der Raumfahrttechnologie mit der Dynamik eines Startups verbindet, entwickeln wir die nächste Generation von KI-gestützten Verteidigungs- und Dual-Use-Anwendungen.
 Als Full-Stack Software Engineer sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, unsere KI-Modelle in eine funktionale, intuitive und performante Anwendung zu überführen. Sie bauen sowohl den robusten Maschinenraum im Backend als auch eine anspruchsvolle Anwendung im Frontend. Ihre Arbeit macht unsere komplexe Technologie für den Nutzer handhabbar und schafft eine autonome Systemlösung.
 Ihre Vorteile 
 Die einmalige Gelegenheit, die Zukunft autonomer Systeme bei einem weltweit führenden Luft- und Raumfahrtunternehmen zu gestalten
 Ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld, das die Innovationskraft eines Startups mit der Expertise eines etablierten Technologiestandorts verbindet
 Ein Team von brillanten Köpfen, die gemeinsam an einer großen Vision für Europas technologische Souveränität arbeiten
 Ein attraktives Gehalt, flexible Arbeitszeiten und exzellente Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung innerhalb des Airbus-Konzerns
 Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (bis zu 40% mobiles Arbeiten) 
 Ihre Rolle 
 Sie sind der Entwickler unseres gesamten Anwendungsökosystems – vom Backend bis zum Cockpit. 
 Als (Senior) Full-Stack-Softwareentwickler sind Sie für die (Architektur und) Entwicklung der (geschäftskritischen) Anwendungen verantwortlich, die unsere KI zum Leben erwecken. Sie sind für den gesamten technischen Stack zuständig, vom Entwurf robuster Backend-Microservices bis hin zur Entwicklung anspruchsvoller (autonomer) Anwendungen am Edge. Ihre Arbeit verwandelt komplexe KI-Technologie in ein handhabbares und leistungsstarkes Werkzeug und schafft so die autonome Softwareanwendung.
 Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Backend & API Entwicklung (& Architektur): Entwurf und Implementierung skalierbarer Microservices und robuster APIs (REST, gRPC) zur Anbindung unserer KI-Modelle
 Edge Application Development: Implementierung komplexer, datenintensiver Edge-Anwendungen unter Verwendung moderner C++-Frameworks.
 Datenbankmanagement: Entwurf von Datenmodellen und Verwaltung unserer SQL- und NoSQL-Datenbanken
 Datenvisualisierung: Entwicklung interaktiver Kartenansichten und Visualisierungen zur Darstellung von Echtzeit-Lagebildern

Do you love creating elegant solutions to highly complex challenges? Do you intrinsically see the importance in every detail? As part of our Silicon Technologies group, you’ll help design and manufacture our next-generation, high-performance, power-efficient GPU. You’ll ensure Apple products and services can seamlessly and efficiently handle the tasks that make them beloved by millions. Circuit design and simulation background a plus, but not required.
Experience with global timing verification, SPICE simulation/analysis, and Physical Design Verification Flows.

Don’t see a job posting that matches your background and interests?  Let us know how you think you can contribute to our team.  We are always on the lookout for talented and passionate people whose vision and skills can augment our own.
 
About us
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 
Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. 

 
About this posting
This page is for general application inquiries.  We review these applications regularly to determine if your skills correspond with any current needs in our team:  we will get back to you if they do.
 
 
We are an international team that is working to solve problems with a global impact:  to facilitate efficient communication and collaboration, proficiency in English is a requirement for all roles.

items.desc:
Mission 
 Le laboratoire de recherche photovoltaïque (PVlab) est spécialisé dans la fabrication et la fiabilité de cellules et de panneaux solaires. Afin de renforcer son équipe, le PVlab recherche un.e technicien.ne ou un.e ingénieur.e motivé.e pour soutenir la recherche dans l’énergie renouvelable. En tant que membre de l’équipe technique, vous travaillerez au support et au développement des équipements scientifiques du laboratoire et contribuerez au développement de nouvelles technologies pour le photovoltaïque.
 Principales tâches et responsabilités 
 Au sein de notre équipe, vous apporterez un soutien technique à différents projets. Vos responsabilités comprendront notamment :
 Support technique aux collaborateurs du groupe
 Entretien des équipements scientifiques (PVD, PECVD, etc..)
 Analyse des défauts des équipements et correction de ceux-ci
 Maintenance des infrastructures du laboratoire (gaz spéciaux, eau DI)
 Développement d’équipements pour la recherche
 Profil 
 Vous êtes un·e professionnel·le motivé·e, fiable et curieux·se, qui apprécie l’apprentissage de nouvelles techniques et le travail au sein d’une équipe de recherche collaborative. Vous adoptez une approche critique dans votre travail et êtes capable de travailler de manière autonome une fois formé·e.
 Vous devez disposer des qualifications suivantes :
 Une formation en électronique, automation ou mécanique et des connaissances dans les autres domaines
 Un niveau de formation de technicien ES ou d’ingénieur HES
 La capacité à organiser votre travail, à gérer plusieurs tâches de façon autonome
 Une maitrise de l’anglais, niveau B2 ou supérieur
 Une expérience ou des connaissances dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants constituerait un atout :
 Technique du vide
 Programmation de PLC
 Hautes fréquences (HF et VHF)
 Une formation aux techniques mentionnées ci-dessus sera proposée dans le cadre de la prise de fonction. Nous accordons une importance particulière à la motivation, la fiabilité, la curiosité ainsi qu’à l’esprit d’équipe et à la volonté de contribuer activement aux activités du laboratoire.
 Nous offrons 
 À l'EPFL, nous avons la conviction que chacun et chacune peut accomplir de grandes choses lorsqu'il ou elle évolue dans un environnement bienveillant, respectueux et propice à la réussite. En rejoignant notre institution, vous contribuerez à façonner l'avenir de la société grâce à l'éducation, la recherche et l'innovation.
 Nous offrons:
 D’excellentes conditions de travail au sein d’une équipe internationale, multidisciplinaire et à la pointe de la technologie, avec un accès à des infrastructures de haut niveau
 Un groupe de recherche jeune, dynamique, flexible et stimulant
 Une rémunération et des prestations sociales compétitives
 Un environnement culturel riche, des cours de formation continue, l’accès à ces infrastructures sportives, un abonnement CFF demi-tarif.
 Au-delà de votre activité professionnelle, nos campus accueillent une communauté dynamique dans un cadre unique, porté par de nombreuses initiatives en faveur de l’égalité, de l’inclusion, de la diversité, du bien-être et de la durabilité. Tout au long de l’année, un programme varié d’activités culturelles, sportives et communautaires vient également renforcer la vie du campus.

items.desc:
Description courte
 Notre mission est de concevoir et de développer des interventions innovantes visant à restaurer les fonctions motrices à la suite d’atteintes du système nerveux central, en particulier des lésions de la moelle épinière, et de traduire nos découvertes scientifiques en applications cliniques susceptibles d’améliorer la qualité de vie des personnes présentant des déficiences motrices.
 Pour en savoir plus sur notre mission et nos activités de recherche, nous vous invitons à consulter le site de .NeuroRestore : www.neurorestore.swiss .
 Mission 
 L’unité du Professeur Grégoire Courtine est à la recherche d’un·e technicien·ne spécialisé·e en comportement animal pour rejoindre son équipe de recherche à Genève.
 vous participerez à des projets de recherche innovants dans le domaine des neurosciences et des neurotechnologies.
 Vous serez principalement responsable de la réalisation et du suivi d'expériences comportementales sur des modèles rongeurs, notamment dans le cadre de recherches sur les lésions de la moelle épinière et la récupération des fonctions motrices.
 Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les scientifiques et les étudiants du laboratoire, dans un environnement multidisciplinaire utilisant des technologies de pointe.
 Principales tâches et responsabilités 
 Réaliser des expériences comportementales sur des rongeurs, comprenant leur entraînement et l'enregistrement de leurs performances lors de différentes tâches motrices.
 Assurer la réhabilitation quotidienne de rongeurs présentant des lésions de la moelle épinière, notamment à l'aide de dispositifs robotiques, de stimulations électriques et d'approches pharmacologiques.
 Assurer le suivi des animaux et veiller à leur bien-être tout au long des protocoles expérimentaux.
 Participer à la gestion et au suivi des lignées transgéniques du laboratoire.
 Apporter un soutien technique aux scientifiques et aux étudiants dans la réalisation de leurs projets de recherche.
 Contribuer à l'organisation, au bon fonctionnement et à la maintenance générale du laboratoire.
 Profil 
 Formation dans le domaine de la physiologie, des neurosciences, de la biologie ou dans un domaine jugé équivalent.
 Bonnes connaissances et aisance dans la manipulation des animaux de laboratoire, en particulier des rongeurs.
 Intérêt marqué pour la recherche expérimentale et les neurosciences.
 Bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais.
 Personne patiente, rigoureuse, flexible et organisée, disposant d'un bon sens de l'observation.
 Bonnes capacités relationnelles, esprit d'équipe et aptitude à s'adapter à un environnement de recherche multidisciplinaire.
 Nous offrons 
 Un contrat à durée déterminée d'une année, renouvelable.
 Un environnement de recherche stimulant, dynamique et multidisciplinaire.
 L'opportunité de contribuer à des projets scientifiques innovants dans le domaine des neurotechnologies et de la récupération motrice.
 Une collaboration étroite avec des équipes scientifiques utilisant des technologies de pointe.
 Des conditions de travail et une rémunération conformes aux standards de l'EPFL.

items.card: you will work at the intersection of finance and manufacturing , partnering closely with Plant Management and colleagues across production, logistics, engineering and other functions. You will turn financial and operational data into insights that support better decisions, stronger performance and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on controlling role where you can build a broad understanding of our
items.desc:
Your contribution to something big 
 Do you enjoy understanding what really drives performance in a manufacturing business, rather than simply reporting the numbers? 
 As our Plant Controller, you will work at the intersection of finance and manufacturing , partnering closely with Plant Management and colleagues across production, logistics, engineering and other functions.
 You will turn financial and operational data into insights that support better decisions, stronger performance and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on controlling role where you can build a broad understanding of our manufacturing operation and have a real impact on how we manage costs, investments and performance.
 Your key responsibilities 
 Business partnering: Act as a financial partner to Plant Management and cost center owners. Provide analysis, challenge assumptions and translate financial performance into clear insights and actions.
 Planning & forecasting: Drive key parts of our business planning, budgeting and forecasting processes, including cost centers, Capex, production volumes, headcount and product costs.
 Manufacturing performance: Analyze manufacturing costs, productivity and operational deviations. Work with the organization to understand root causes and identify appropriate countermeasures.
 Product costing: Lead Planned Product Cost (PPC) calculations, follow Actual Product Costs (APC) and analyze the operational and financial drivers behind deviations.
 Investments, assets & inventory: Support investment planning and follow-up, fixed asset management, inventory valuation, physical stocktaking and continuous inventory control.
 Reporting & continuous improvement: Drive monthly and annual plant performance reporting while continuously improving our processes, reporting, dashboards and use of SAP and other digital tools.
What distinguishes you 
 You have a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a comparable field, together with experience in controlling, financial analysis or a related finance role.
 Experience from manufacturing or another industrial environment is particularly valuable.
 We are looking for someone with:
 Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial and operational data
 Experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost accounting or operational reporting
 Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel
 Experience working with ERP systems. SAP experience, particularly within controlling or manufacturing processes, is an advantage
 Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage, but not a requirement 
 Experience with product costing, Power BI, automation or other data-analysis tools is an advantage, but you do not need to tick every box . We value your ability to learn, understand the business and turn data into meaningful insights.
 Who you are 
 You are curious about the business behind the numbers . When you see a deviation, your instinct is not simply to report it. You want to understand why it happened, what is driving it and what we can do about it .
 You are comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions and collaborating across functions to find solutions. You can explain financial concepts clearly to colleagues outside Finance and combine strong analytical thinking with a practical mindset.
 You take ownership of your work, build strong relationships and are motivated by understanding how a manufacturing business works and how Finance can help make it better.
Why join us in Tranås? 
 In Tranås, more than 600 associates work across manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a more sustainable future.
 For a Plant Controller, this creates an exciting environment where you can see the connection between the numbers, the decisions and what actually happens in the factory .
 The role gives you broad exposure to manufacturing finance, product costing, investments and operational performance, while working within the international Bosch organization. It is an opportunity to deepen your controlling expertise, influence the business and continue developing your career.
 At Bosch, we value openness, trust and different perspectives, and we want our associates to have opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.
 What we offer 
 Competitive compensation
 Pension, insurance and other benefits in accordance with our collective agreement
 Flexible working hours and hybrid working possibilities where compatible with the role
 Employee discounts on Bosch products
 Development opportunities within an international Bosch organization
 Regular presence at our Tranås site is an important part of the role because of the close collaboration with our manufacturing organization.
 If you enjoy combining finance, manufacturing and problem-solving, we would like to hear from you.

About this opportunity
 The Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Market Area is a vibrant hub of innovation, technology, and collaboration. At its core, our Networks organization plays a pivotal role in driving thought leadership and delivering exceptional value in a fast-changing, increasingly data-driven environment, where business realities vary across diverse markets and countries.
 We are looking for a Network Build & NSI (Network Solution Introduction) Solution Architect for Customer Unit SEE (South Europe and Eurasia), with primary focus on delivery execution within the RAN Life Cycle Services (LCS) portfolio and additionally support in rollout integration activities.
 The role serves as the technical authority for NSI activities, driving the integration, validation and introduction of new RAN solutions, software releases and functionalities into live customer networks while ensuring delivery excellence and operational stability.
 The scope also extends to the practical implementation context surrounding solution introduction, including site and infrastructure readiness, special coverage and mission-critical deployment scenarios, and the interaction between radio, energy, transport and IP connectivity.
 What you will do: 
 Deliver Network Solution Introduction activities under the RAN Life Cycle Services portfolio, with primary accountability for delivery quality, technical readiness and repeatable execution.
 Drive RAN software onboarding through controlled and increasingly automated processes covering software supply, validation, deployment readiness and lifecycle continuity.
 Deliver, validate and deploy newly introduced technology and solutions for customers, tailored to their specific needs and environment.
 Coordinate validation in lab, first-node implementation, pilot or golden-cluster activities, hardware introduction and continuous software-upgrade readiness, ensuring a controlled handover to industrialized rollout.
 Prepare and maintain delivery methods, technical procedures, checklists, acceptance criteria, reusable templates and troubleshooting guidance to secure first-time-right execution
 Provide expert support for configuration, scripting, node troubleshooting, observability, investigation, CSR opening and technical recommendations for deployment teams.
 Support rollout integration activities
 Lead the technical development of RAN and network infrastructure solutions for customer opportunities and delivery projects
 Support implementation partners and ASPs through technical guidance, mentoring, training and operational best practices.
 Uphold high standards of Ethics, Compliance, Integrity, information security, quality and EHS in all delivery activities.

 Competence 
 Knowledge of Network Solution Introduction and the RAN Life Cycle Services portfolio, including RAN Solution Assistance, Lab Services, RAN SW Onboarding and Automated Testing Services.
 Experience in introducing new or updated RAN hardware, software, functionalities and features into live or customer-representative environments.
 Experience with lab validation, test strategy and execution, first-node implementation, pilot or golden-cluster activities, hardware introduction and software lifecycle management.
 Troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, configuration, scripting, observability and technical reporting capabilities.
 Knowledge of Ericsson Networks products and services across Purpose-built RAN and Open/Cloud RAN scenarios.
 Understanding of end-to-end RAN implementation, including site engineering, power and battery systems, transport and IP connectivity, and how these domains interact with solution-introduction activities.
 Familiarity with special coverage solutions, including DAS, indoor and transportation environments, mission-critical deployments, technical audits and field acceptance practices.
 Ability to work effectively across local, regional and global teams in a complex matrix organization without formal line-manager authority.
 Understanding of Health & Safety operational processes, quality requirements, information security and relevant legal obligations
 Fluent English and Greek.
 Experiences 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
 Experience in telecom networks, with substantial experience in RAN
 Proven delivery track record in complex, multi-stakeholder or multi-country environments.
 Experience working as a technical specialist, Solution Introduction Engineer, Solution Architect or equivalent delivery-oriented role, preferably with exposure to site engineering, infrastructure implementation, special coverage or mission-critical communications.
 Ability to clearly present technical results and use evidence-based technical insights to influence decisions, align stakeholders, and drive resolution of complex delivery challenges.

items.desc:
Csúcstechnológiás autógyártás nekünk. Inspiráló és innovatív munkahely neked.
 A BMW Groupnál minden a szenvedéllyel kezdődik. Ez teszi a munkát hivatássá. Ez ösztönöz minket arra, hogy folyamatosan újragondoljuk a mobilitást, és innovatív ötleteket vigyünk az utakra. A közös projektek iránti lelkesedés erős csapattá kovácsol bennünket, ahol minden vélemény értéket képvisel. Csak akkor tudjuk együtt formálni a jövőt, ha a szakértelem, a magas színvonalú folyamatok és a munkavégzés öröme találkozik. A BMW Group egyedi vállalati kultúrájához minden munkatárs hozzájárulhat saját tudásával és egyéni képességeivel. Olyan kollégákat keresünk, akik ugyanolyan szenvedélyesen végzik a munkájukat, mint mi. Szakértelmed, tudásod, motivációd és egyéniséged visz bennünket előre.
 Mint Készjármű-logisztikai specialista a BMW Group debreceni gyárában kulcsszerepet tölthetsz be abban a küldetésünkben, hogy újragondoljuk az autókról alkotott elképzeléseinket.
 Mi vár Rád? 
 Járműkiszállítás - Gondoskodsz arról, hogy minden elkészült jármű a megfelelő helyre és a megfelelő időben kerüljön kiszállításra, a termékminőség megőrzése mellett.
 Koordináció - Koordinálod a járműkiszállítási területhez kapcsolódó folyamatokat, beleértve a tárolást, karbantartást és szállítást.
 Szolgáltatóirányítás - Irányítod és koordinálod a szolgáltató partnert a stabil járműelosztási folyamat biztosítása érdekében.
 Minőségbiztosítás - Kialakítod és működteted a folyamatokhoz kapcsolódó minőségmenedzsment rendszert.
 Monitoring - Nyomon követed és ellenőrzöd a készletszinteket, eltéréseket és költségeket.
 Mit várunk tőled? 
 Iskolai végzettség - Felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel, preferáltan gazdasági, logisztikai vagy ellátásilánc-menedzsment területen szereztél diplomát.
 Szakmai tapasztalat - Legalább 5 éves tapasztalod van logisztikai működésben; előnyt jelent a külső logisztikai szolgáltatókkal való együttműködésben, illetve szolgáltatóirányításban szerzett gyakorlat.
 Minőségirányítás - Ismered a minőségirányítási rendszereket, az EHS jellegű témák és belső auditok ismerete előnyt jelent. Az ISO 9000 és az AEO rendszer ismerete további előny.
 Személyiség - Proaktív és strukturált gondolkodásmód jellemző Rád, valamint nyitottság a nemzetközi együttműködésre.
 Nyelvtudás - Magabiztos magyar és angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel.
 Mit kínálunk? 
 Célunk, hogy munkatársainkat motiváljuk és teljesítményüket elismerjük, ezért juttatási csomagunk az alapbéren felül az alábbi elemekből áll: 
 Bérfejlesztés – évente, teljesítményértékelés alapján.

items.card: Responsibilities Conduct cutting-edge research in AI security and privacy by proposing, exploring, and evaluating new ideas. Develop and implement prototypes to validate concepts and demonstrate real-world applicability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security and privacy solutions into products and services. Publish findings and present insights to internal stakeholders and external
items.desc:
Overview 
 The Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) works to protect customers and Microsoft from current and emerging threats to security and privacy. Within MSRC, our AI Vulnerabilities and Mitigations team analyzes all reported security vulnerabilities in Microsoft’s AI and agentic systems and develops new mitigations through deep research. 
 Some of our team’s recent research and collaborations include: 
 The Nine Dimensions of Prompt Injection Attacks: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.04672 
 Securing AI Agents with Information-Flow Control (NeurIPS’26): https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23643 
 VerifiableFL: Verifiable Claims for Federated Learning using Exclaves (SoCC’26): https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.10537 
 LLMail-Inject: A Dataset from a Realistic Adaptive Prompt Injection Challenge (EMNLP’26): https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09956 
 Optimizing Agent Planning for Security and Autonomy (ICLR’26) https://openreview.net/forum?id=g0aVCDY3gS 
 Implicit Memory as a Hidden Channel in LLMs (SaTML’26): https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.08563 
 Highlight & Summarize: RAG without the Jailbreaks: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.02872 
 The Hawthorne effect in reasoning models: Evaluating and steering test awareness (NeurIPS’25): https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.14617 
 TaskTracker: Catching LLM Task Drift with Activation Deltas (SaTML’25): https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.00799 
 We are looking for research interns to work with us on projects such as: identifying new classes of vulnerabilities in AI or agentic AI systems; detecting vulnerabilities in real systems; automating security vulnerability response using agents; and developing new mitigations that can be deployed at scale. 
 Our team is uniquely placed to solve real-world security and privacy challenges, through cutting-edge scientific research, informed by vulnerability data from production systems. 
 Contract Length: 12 weeks 
 Location: Cambridge, UK 
 Responsibilities 
 Conduct cutting-edge research  in AI security and privacy by proposing, exploring, and evaluating new ideas. 
 Develop and implement prototypes  to validate concepts and demonstrate real-world applicability. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams  to integrate security and privacy solutions into products and services. 
 Publish findings and present insights  to internal stakeholders and external conferences to advance industry knowledge. 
 Qualifications 
 Required/Minimum Qualifications:     
 Students enrolled in a PhD program or outstanding undergraduate/master’s students with research experience (e.g., published research papers). 
 Preferred/Additional Qualifications: 
 One or more papers at top security conferences (e.g., USENIX, CCS, S&P, NDSS) or papers focusing on security, safety, or privacy at top machine learning conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR). 
 The base pay for this internship is £ 4,853.00 per month. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. 
 Find additional benefits and pay information here:
 https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/interns-corporate-pay.html 
 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Overview 
 Are you insatiably curious, deeply passionate about the realm of Cloud & Data solutions, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a dynamic environment? If so, we invite you to join our team as a Digital Cloud & Data Solution Engineer for mid-market customers at Microsoft. Here, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, working on cutting-edge projects that leverage the latest cloud and data technologies to drive meaningful impact. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. 
 Microsoft is transforming the developer experience for cloud-native and data-driven applications across the development lifecycle. With seamless integration across Azure services, we’re leading the way in enabling scalable, secure, and intelligent solutions. 
 As a Digital Solution Engineer (DSE) for Cloud & AI Data, you will play a pivotal role in helping UK and Ireland enterprises unlock the full potential of Microsoft’s cloud database and analytics stack across every stage of deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering leaders and platform teams to accelerate the Azure SQL and Fabric Data Platform, including Cloud & AI Databases and Analytics, through hands-on engagements like Proof of Concepts, hackathons, and architecture workshops. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their data platform and realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform, all while enjoying flexible work opportunities.

In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their data platform and realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform.

Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
