items.desc: Konsert Strategy & IP is a leading consultancy at the intersection of business strategy, technology and intellectual property. Founded in Gothenburg in 2006, we work with some of the world's largest technology-intensive companies, close to the leaders who decide where to compete and how to win through technology and IP. Since 2024 we have been part of the international Rouse Group. Like every consultancy, we are adapting to an environment that AI is reshaping. Much of the research, analysis and preparation that used to fill a project team's weeks can now be done by machines. Our clients face the same shift from the other side. Their strategy, technology and IP functions are under a clear mandate to work faster and leaner with AI. But today's landscape of point tools depends on the user to supply the context, and without it the tools speed up the doing without improving the thinking. What clients still need is sound judgment, grounded in the right context. That is where the real value of AI lies: not in faster work, but in better, more reliable and more impactful decisions. So rather than defend the old consultancy model, we are rebuilding ours around that: consultants who work inside our clients' organizations, supported by an AI platform that holds the client's context. That platform is Sapivia. We are now growing our in-house tech team, to make sure we have the capabilities under our own roof to take Sapivia to the next level. What we are building: Sapivia Sapivia is Konsert's AI platform. At its core is the context layer: a client-specific knowledge graph that holds the context every decision depends on. How the business, its technology and its intellectual property connect, what depends on what, and the reasoning behind the decisions already made. We have built that picture for clients by hand for twenty years; Sapivia captures it, keeps it alive and makes it available to people and AI alike. Our consultants build the context layer together with the client. The client's own people, Konsert's forward-deployed strategists and the AI tools the client already uses can then reason and act on the same picture, one that grows richer over time. Sapivia is already in use with clients, starting in IP, where the need is sharpest. But the same picture answers the questions every technology company has to ask: which technologies matter, where to compete and how to turn knowledge into advantage. That is where we are taking it next. The Konsert tech core team We are building a small tech core team: a handful of engineers with complementary skills. The team is led by a Tech Lead and sits in Gothenburg, next to the consultants who deploy Sapivia with clients. Build work happens in close collaboration with those consultants, several of whom spend part of their time in the team, so the domain expertise and the client's reality are in the room when we build. We work in an agile way with shared ownership: everyone is close to the users, effort goes where it is needed, and the team ships several times a week and owns the result together. Development runs in close alignment with Konsert's leadership team, with short paths to user input and quick decisions. The tech core team has a central voice in how Sapivia is shaped. Around this core, we scale with external developers and the Rouse Group's technology organization. Questions we are working on right now Giving AI the right context is only the start. Turning that context into decisions that large companies can rely on raises questions that few teams have answered yet. These are some of the ones we are working on now. They are open questions, not tickets, and you will help answer them. How do we assure the quality of AI responses at scale, when the right answer is often a matter of judgment? How do we best combine deep domain knowledge with what the models already know? How do we make a rich, connected body of knowledge feel simple and intuitive to work with? How do we give large organizations precise control over who sees what, across regions, teams and many users? How do we shorten the path from prototype to production code, while keeping the freedom to experiment? The role: Fullstack Developer - Frontend focus You bring the frontend depth to the core team. Sapivia's users are experts working with a lot of connected information at once, and the interfaces are where the context layer and the AI become usable. You shape how Sapivia's frontends, each built for a different group of users, are structured, tested and shipped, work closely with the rest of the team on APIs and data, and pick up backend work when that is what moves the product forward. Department Overview The Internal Medicine Innovation Centre (IMIC) is home to innovative early-stage research focused on translating scientific discoveries into potential life-changing medicines. Our collaborative and supportive team of scientists are responsible for turning promising peptide candidates into safe, stable and effective medicines. This includes characterising the physicochemical properties of the peptide, designing and optimising formulations suitable for clinical use (for example, injectable solutions), and conducting stability studies to understand how the drug substance and drug product behave over time and under different storage conditions. Our work generates the data needed to put innovative peptides onto the path of candidate selection and beyond. What can I achieve and what will I be responsible for whilst completing a placement at Pfizer? As a chemistry undergraduate you will join a small team of formulation scientists and analytical chemists responsible for advancing peptide drug candidates and support these hands-on in their research activities and daily laboratory activities to generate high-quality data that supports Pfizer’s therapeutic pipeline. You will work with an experienced scientist who will provide day-to-day guidance, with the aim of enabling you to contribute with a decreasing level of supervision as your experience and independence increases. During your year with us in Peptide Drug Discovery & Development you will: Contribute to the formulation development of synthetic peptide drug candidates, including preparing and evaluating formulations and assessing the impact of pH, buffers and excipients on solubility and stability. Gain an appreciation of accepted practices, including good documentation practice and quality standards, to ensure safe, compliant and productive working in the laboratory. Attain a working knowledge of state-of-the-art analytical techniques used to characterise peptides, including hands-on high/ultra-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC/UPLC), and biophysical methods for assessing aggregation and physical stability. Set up and monitor solubility screening studies on peptide candidates. Set up, monitor and analyse stability studies on peptide candidates, and gain an understanding of common peptide degradation pathways (e.g. oxidation, deamidation, hydrolysis and aggregation) and how they are controlled. Increase your knowledge of both practical and theoretical aspects of peptide chemistry, pharmaceutics and the drug development process. Potentially have the opportunity to use a range of automated and high-throughput equipment for formulation screening and sample analysis to help improve your efficiency. Be trained and expected to run in vitro potency assays for biologics. Become familiar with searching scientific literature and internal databases to design and plan experiments and interpret data. Gain experience of working as a lab member in a research team, contributing to general operational and routine tasks. Participate in team meetings, scientific discussions, and technical training to build your knowledge, communication skills and professional network. What other opportunities and benefits do Pfizer offer? Professional mentorship : Build your network and learn from scientific experts across Pfizer’s Global Research & Development organisation. Volunteering : Use up to 5 days of paid volunteering leave per year to support a cause that matters to you. When can I start? Placements will start on 1st September 2027 and will run for 12 months. items.desc: About the job you’re considering We are seeking experienced Data Engineers to join our growing team within a large, long-standing public-sector partnership. In this pivotal role, you will contribute to data acquisition, preparation and management projects, helping to modernise services and deliver secure, reliable data products at scale. This is an exciting opportunity to shape engineering design, grow capability across our teams, and deliver real value for our clients. Your role Design and implement robust, secure and performant data integration solutions (batch and/or near-real-time). Build, operate and improve data pipelines (ingestion, transformation, curation) with monitoring, alerting and SLAs. Collaborate with product teams and client stakeholders to refine requirements and align decisions to NFRs (cost, performance, security). Support incident resolution and ensure service continuity. Share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and contribute to Capgemini’s engineering communities of practice. Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and work cross-functionally with engineers, analysts and business teams. Your skills and experience Strong SQL and hands-on experience with data modelling. Hands-on with ETL/ELT tooling (at least one of Talend, Pentaho DI, Informatica, AWS Glue, or SAS). Experience with databases/data platforms (ideally Oracle or Cloudera). Knowledge of cloud platforms (ideally AWS). Good experience with programming/scripting languages (e.g. Python, Bash). Strong grasp of data engineering fundamentals, including integration, transformation, orchestration, and version control. Excellent client-facing and consultancy skills. Your security clearance To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements. Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process. What does ‘Get The Future You Want ‘ mean for you? You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way. You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. Why you should consider Capgemini Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is. About Capgemini Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organisations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

items.desc: We Are Sparta Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders. Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has. We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market. At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done. Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies. LNG Commodity Owner, Sparta Commodities Singapore, Geneva or London LNG moves on netbacks, shipping and a handful of hubs that rarely agree with each other. Plenty of people write about that. We want the person who builds the system that connects all the pieces of the puzzle, and then puts it in front of traders and makes it sell. Sparta is building the data platform that energy traders, analysts and commercial teams use to make faster, better decisions. We cover forward curves, price assessments, market intelligence and trade flows across the global energy complex. LNG is our next vertical, and we want an exceptional builder to lead it. The role This is a builder's seat. It isn't just an analyst position, a sales role or a thought-leadership seat. You will be leading the development of Sparta's LNG offering, from the first netback model to the AI analyst that puts together a forward view on LNG markets autonomously, working with our engineering, product, data and commercial teams. You will set the direction and stay hands-on: prototyping, testing and shipping with the team, not handing over a spec and waiting. Building on its own is not enough. The job is to build a product LNG desks will pay for, which means time with clients is as much a part of the role as time in the code. We are looking for someone who knows LNG deeply: JKM, TTF and Henry Hub relationships, netbacks and delivered economics, shipping and regasification costs, cargo arbitrage between basins and contract structures. Your job is to turn that knowledge into products. Expect a good part of your week to be hands-on with AI coding tools: prototyping a pricing model in Python, standing up a data pipeline, creating market-leading knowledge graphs that an AI agent follows and testing its answers against desk judgement. The rest goes on working with engineers to harden, scale and ship what the team builds. The role reports to our Head of Commodities. What you'll do Building products, data pipelines and AI agents (~55% of role) Lead the design and build of Sparta's LNG product set: netbacks, arbitrage routes, delivered price curves and the analytical tools that sit on top of them Build the LNG expert inside Leonidas with our AI engineers: the tools it calls, the domain rules it follows and the knowledge base behind them Build automated products with the team: a daily LNG brief autonomously written by AI analyst, alerts on the curves and spreads that matter, and the quality checks that catch errors before clients see them Build evaluation sets that test the AI against desk judgement, and keep them passing as the product changes Build the data pipelines behind the vertical with data and engineering colleagues: price inputs, freight and regas assumptions, vessel and terminal data, route onboarding and automated data quality checks Ship to production with engineering through our normal process (pull requests, code review, tests, CI), and hold the bar on scale, security and reliability Owning the LNG vertical (~25% of role) Own the LNG vertical end to end: what we build, how well it works and how it performs commercially Set and sequence the LNG roadmap with product and technology, so clients get something useful early and more every few weeks Write the rules: the LNG conventions, definitions and desk judgement that every Sparta product and agent follows Lead the people working on LNG across product, engineering and data: set priorities, unblock them and raise the bar on quality Be the person the business comes to for any LNG decision …

Collaborate with an integrated group of subsurface professionals across a play/basin and lead/prospect scale. Partner with the Assets team to ensure end-to-end delivery of projects, reducing handover and cycle time. items.desc: Hybrid Working Pattern - 3 days (Mon, Tue, Thurs) per week from Tower Bridge office Who We Are Zoopla is one of the UK’s most instantly recognisable property brands. In fact, we’re known and loved by over 91% of the nation (and we’re working hard on the other 9%). Our mission is to help the nation make better home decisions - by connecting everyone to their home and giving them personalised insights to help with moving, managing or financing. Over 50 million people visit Zoopla every month to access exclusive data and information on every UK property, search over 500,000 homes for sale and rent, find the best agents and secure the latest mortgage deals. We’re a growing, dynamic team that embraces innovation and isn’t afraid to push the boundaries. We’re only just starting our journey to redefine the digital property landscape, with much more to explore and achieve. Join us, and transform the way the nation makes home decisions. The Role As a Full-Stack Engineer at Zoopla, you will work to build and enhance features for our property marketplace that connects consumers and customers. If you enjoy being in a commercially driven organisation where the systems you touch may be used by millions of people in the UK we have something for you. While we have a diverse set of technologies and services running here at Zoopla, we don't expect you to know all of them and would love to hear from you if you have experience in just a few of them. What we value more is the ability to work in a cross functional team to problem solve and a willingness to sometimes jump into unfamiliar code to achieve your goals. On the frontend you’ll work with React, React Native Nx and TypeScript. On the backend it's Node.js, Next.js, and GraphQL, all written in TypeScript, but also Golang and Python. Our data stores include both SQL and NoSQL, and our systems run on AWS. AI tools have cut the time to build from days to hours in many cases. We want engineers who use that speed to test bold ideas, prototype new approaches, and ship the ones that work. You will work across the full stack to do it. Requirements What we’re looking for in Zoopla Engineers: You’re skilled in TypeScript and have built both sides of a product: UIs in React or React Native, and backend services and APIs in Node.js (REST or GraphQL) backed by SQL or NoSQL databases. Nice to have: Python, Golang. You’ve designed and shipped systems that real users depend on. You choose the right architecture, weigh trade-offs (scale, cost, complexity, speed to ship), and write down your decisions. You can lead a design discussion and take feedback. You practise your engineering craft: maintainable code, code review, pair programming, and test coverage. You build products that are stable, scalable, secure, observable, and performant. You’ve worked with cloud infrastructure and know your way around Terraform (or equivalent) and AWS. We want engineers with a DevOps mentality. You’re commercially driven and you spot opportunities to improve the product. You care about delighting users. You work closely with colleagues across the business and understand how your work ties to business goals. You’re accountable for performance, playing your part in achieving team goals and ensuring your contribution positively impacts overall success. You are proactive and can work autonomously in a fast-paced agile team, alongside data, product and design. You take ownership of outcomes and respond to change without missing a beat. You deeply make use of AI. You keep up with new tools and techniques, and you actively use them in your work. We take diversity and inclusion seriously, and to succeed here, you should too! All qualified applicants will be considered, without regard to race, colour, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, disability, health, qualifications, or time unemployed. Where you’ll be At Zoopla, we embrace hybrid working but emphasise the importance of also spending time together. You’ll have the opportunity to work remotely (at home) for two days per week with Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays as all-Zoopla days in the office together. Our home in Tower Bridge is a buzzing hub for collaborative and individual working, with areas to socialise and exercise - within easy reach of London Bridge, Tower Hill and Bermondsey stations. On our doorstep there are plenty of great food spots including a new indoor street food market and landscaped areas to sit by the riverside. Benefits Our hybrid setup means you’ll join us in the Tower Bridge office 3 days each week 25 days annual leave + additional leave benefits Including extra days for length of service, plus other leave perks Cycle to work and electric car schemes Free Calm App membership Enhanced Parental leave Fertility Treatment Financial Support Group Income Protection and private medical insurance Gym on-site in London 7.5% pension contribution by the company Discretionary annual bonus up to 10% of base salary

items.desc: DESCRIPTION The Data Center Builder Tools team is looking for a seasoned, self-directed Software Development Engineer (SDE II) to help define AWS next generation real-time middleware and controls platform that powers industrial control systems across AWS Data Centers worldwide. Contribute to Amazon's vision of developing the safest, most secure, reliable, and efficient data centers on Earth. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will set the technical direction for the software that sits between industrial hardware and the cloud, a unified, real-time data plane that lets control applications, device drivers, and cloud services exchange data reliably on industrial computing hardware. This is deep systems work at the boundary of software and hardware: you will own the architecture of the controls, the communication layer, and the protocol and cloud integrations that the entire platform is built on, and you will be the engineer others turn to for the hardest problems in real-time, distributed, and embedded systems. Key job responsibilities As an SDE II on this team, you are a technical leader accountable for the architecture and long-term health of the controls and middleware platform, not just individual components. You will operate across multiple workstreams and teams, make the consequential design decisions, and remain deeply hands-on where it matters most. Your primary responsibilities will include: Architecting the platform, not just components: owning the end-to-end design of the controls and real-time middleware across embedded/edge controllers and the cloud, making the durable decisions on type systems, serialization, memory layout, schema evolution, and communication patterns that everything else depends on. Owning real-time correctness at system scale: reasoning about latency budgets, throughput, determinism, and failure modes across a distributed system adjacent to physical control loops, and setting the standards that keep those guarantees intact as the system grows. Raising the engineering bar broadly: establishing standards for testing (unit, integration, and on-hardware validation), performance benchmarking, operational excellence, and code quality, and holding the team to them through design and code review. Growing engineers: mentoring Junior SDEs, developing their technical judgment, and contributing as a strong interviewer and bar raiser in hiring. De-risking the hardest problems: personally diving into the highest-ambiguity, highest-impact technical challenges (new protocol integrations, performance-critical paths, cross-language data exchange) and bringing them to a proven, maintainable end state. The ideal candidate is a software engineer with a track record of owning the architecture of complex software systems and delivering them to production. You have depth across several of: real-time or embedded systems, industrial automation platforms and hardware protocols, distributed systems, middleware/messaging (pub/sub, RPC), and cloud communication and the breadth to reason about how all of these fit together into a coherent platform. You are comfortable working close to the metal (memory, concurrency, serialization, timing) and setting direction at the system and organizational level. You influence beyond your own team, make sound decisions under ambiguity and hardware/timing constraints, and lift the engineers around you. Experience with Rust, C/C++, or Python, and with technologies such as industrial automation platforms, OPC-UA, DDS/Zenoh or similar real-time middleware, is a strong advantage. A day in the life AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. About the team The Data Center Builder Tools team develops tooling for device frameworks, and device lifecycle management in AWS Data Centers. This includes both frontend and backend services use by internal development teams and on-site customers. Our tools power the industrial controls systems deployed in our data centers. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful …

items.desc: Role: ServiceNow Lead Technical Developer(L3/L4) Location: London (Hybrid) Employment: Full time Security Clearance: SC Cleared or SC Eligible Role Overview: The ServiceNow AMS Technical Consultant will acquire detailed technical and operational knowledge of the delivered ServiceNow solution, participate directly in cutover and Day-1 readiness, and ensure that the platform can be supported effectively following go-live. The role will work alongside the Development team rather than waiting for a post-go-live handover. The Technical Consultant will progressively assume responsibility through structured knowledge transfer, shadowing, reverse shadowing, technical validation and practical participation in programme activities. Following go-live, the Technical Consultant will provide hands-on L3/L4 support, troubleshoot incidents and defects, implement approved fixes and minor enhancements, and serve as the ServiceNow technical authority within the wider AMS service. Key Responsibilities: 1. Early AMS Onboarding: Join the AMS service before production go-live and work alongside the existing ServiceNow Development team. Develop a detailed technical understanding of the delivered ServiceNow solution. Establish the ServiceNow technical support capability within the wider AMS operating model. 2. Knowledge Transition Participate actively in technical and functional knowledge-transition sessions. Review the platform architecture, configuration, data model, security model, workflows and operational dependencies. 3. Cutover Planning and Execution Work directly with the Development and Programme Cutover teams to plan ServiceNow cutover activities. Review the ServiceNow cutover plan and validate technical steps, dependencies, owners and timings. 4. Day-1 Readiness Own the technical elements of ServiceNow Day-1 support readiness. Validate that the production platform and delivered capabilities are available and functioning as expected. Confirm readiness of technical support procedures, operational documentation and escalation pathways. 5. Go-Live, Hypercare and Early Life Support Provide hands-on ServiceNow technical support throughout go-live. Monitor platform behaviour and investigate technical or functional issues. Participate in Hypercare command-centre and triage activities. 6. Hands-on ServiceNow Technical Support Provide L3/L4 technical support for the ServiceNow platform and supported capabilities. Work directly in ServiceNow to diagnose and resolve incidents, defects and configuration issues. 7. Defect and Problem Resolution Triage newly identified production defects. Assess technical impact, severity, priority and potential workarounds. Perform root-cause analysis for recurring or high-impact issues. 8. Application Maintenance and Minor Enhancements Assess ServiceNow maintenance requests and minor enhancements. Clarify technical requirements with process owners and business stakeholders. Provide technical feasibility, complexity and effort input. 9. CMDB and Foundation Data Support Provide hands-on technical support for CMDB and Foundation Data. Investigate data-quality issues, failed updates and configuration-record discrepancies. 10. Collaboration Across the AMS Service Work within the combined AMS service covering ServiceNow, Workday and other programme workstreams. Collaborate with other AMS technical resources to diagnose cross-platform issues. Essential Experience: Extensive hands-on ServiceNow configuration, implementation, administration or production-support experience. Recent experience working directly within the ServiceNow platform. Experience providing L3 or L4 technical support for production ServiceNow environments. Experience participating in ServiceNow cutover, go-live, Hypercare or Early Life Support. Experience transitioning ServiceNow solutions from Development into AMS or BAU support. Experience completing structured Knowledge Transition, shadowing and reverse-shadowing activities. Strong ServiceNow troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis capability. Experience diagnosing issues across workflows, scripts, data, roles, access, forms, catalogues and user interfaces. Experience implementing configuration fixes and minor enhancements. Experience supporting releases, deployments and production validation. Experience creating technical runbooks, support procedures and knowledge articles. Experience working with Development, Architecture, Testing and Service Management teams. Experience operating in an SLA-driven application-support environment. Ability to work independently during critical cutover and production-support activities. Experience in Government, Public Sector, Defence or another regulated environment. Qualifications and Certifications ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, or equivalent demonstrable hands-on platform expertise. ITIL v4 Foundation, or equivalent practical service-management experience.

items.desc: Job Description : Young People's Work Coach, Ockley, Surrey. About Amber The Amber Foundation provides supported accommodation and a structured programme for homeless, unemployed and disadvantaged young people aged 18 to 30. Residents may experience multiple disadvantage, including homelessness, unemployment, substance misuse, mental health difficulties and offending histories. Our residential centres provide 24-hour support alongside a full-time programme covering employability, independent living, health and wellbeing, and personal development. We help young people build the skills, confidence and resilience needed to move into paid employment and safe, sustainable accommodat ion Location: Farm Place, Stane Street, Ockley, Surrey, RH5 5NG Responsible to: Senior Team Leader and Service Manager Contract: Full-time, permanent Salary: £30,283.47 per annum Hours: Monday to Friday, 9.00am to 5.30pm, plus one overnight shift per month and on-call responsibility one week in five, included in the salary Purpose of the role The Young People’s Work Coach leads a team of residents through Amber’s programme, taking responsibility for purposeful support and measurable progress towards paid employment and independent living. A central responsibility is to proactively engage employers and create paid employment opportunities for young people who may struggle to access standard recruitment processes. The Work Coach builds relationships with recruitment decision makers, understands employers’ needs, promotes residents’ potential and agrees practical routes into interviews, job offers and employment. The role requires initiative, persistence and confident employer engagement alongside compassionate support, positive challenge and clear professional boundaries. Education, training, work experience and volunteering should address identified barriers and provide purposeful steps towards paid work. Success is assessed through opportunities created and young people securing and sustaining suitable employment alongside stable accommodation. Key responsibilities. Creating employment opportunities with employers · Proactively identify, approach and visit local and regional employers, developing relationships with owners, managers and recruitment decision makers who can offer paid work. · Understand employers’ staffing needs, skills requirements and recruitment barriers, and identify how residents’ strengths, interests and potential can meet those needs. · Confidently promote Amber and its young people, challenge stereotypes constructively and persuade employers to consider residents who may otherwise be overlooked. · Work with employers to create routes into entry-level jobs, apprenticeships and other suitable paid roles, including supported interviews and adjustments to recruitment processes where appropriate. · Seek concrete commitments from employer engagement, including interviews, suitable vacancies and recruitment opportunities, and follow these through to job offers and starts. · Develop safe, structured work experience with employers, agreeing its purpose, supervision, feedback and potential route towards paid employment. · Agree practical preparation, workplace support and reasonable adjustments with employers and residents, sharing personal information only as appropriate and in line with Amber’s procedures. · Maintain an organised record of employer contacts, recruitment needs, opportunities, agreed actions and follow-up, coordinating with colleagues to make opportunities available to suitable residents. · Respond promptly to employer concerns and maintain contact after a resident starts work to support successful and sustained employment. · Review which employer relationships are producing opportunities and jobs, adapt unsuccessful approaches and continue developing new partnerships. Securing and sustaining paid employment · Make paid employment a central intended outcome of each resident’s stay, establishing aspirations, strengths, experience, qualifications and barriers from induction. · Agree an ambitious, realistic employment pathway with each resident, with clear actions, responsibilities and review dates in their support and action plan. · Actively identify suitable vacancies and opportunities, match residents to employers and help secure interviews and paid work. · Provide practical support with job searches, applications, CVs, cover letters, interview preparation, workplace expectations, travel and starting work. · Motivate and positively challenge residents to complete agreed actions, address disengagement promptly and adapt support to individual needs. · Arrange relevant education, vocational training, work experience and volunteering where these build skills, confidence, routine and references needed for paid work. · Build links with colleges, training providers, Jobcentre Plus, DWP partnership teams, local authorities and employment services to maximise access to appropriate support and schemes. · Support …

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Data Modeller to help shape how HSBC defines, organises and connects business terms across the Group. You’ll build high-quality glossaries, taxonomies and ontologies that create a shared semantic layer - so our data can be understood consistently and used by AI to answer questions across teams, faster and with more confidence. A move across the business allows you to continue to access tailored professional development opportunities, and our fantastic benefits packages. In this role you’ll: Drive high-quality content within the HSBC Business Information Model (HBIM), with a focus on the Group Business Glossary, Taxonomy of Business Terms, and Group Data Categories (high-level groupings of terms) Curate and maintain coherent taxonomies and authoritative definitions, ensuring business terms are clear, consistent, unambiguous, and organised into navigable hierarchies and relationships Support the Group ownership operating model by enabling a framework where t he business owns the terms, while you provide the modelling expertise, standards, and governance to keep content high quality and reusable “Join the dots” across teams/domains to help build a shared semantic layer that supports cross-boundary understanding and consistency Contribute to ontology development (the layer between taxonomies) to enable AI to query and reason across multiple teams, products and datasets - turning terminology into a connected, machine-interpretable knowledge layer Apply industry standards and components to strengthen semantic consistency and interoperability (e.g., SKOS, PROV-O, DCAT, OWL Time, ORG, Dublin Core; awareness of FIBO/BIAN) Embrace AI-enabled ways of working to accelerate modelling, metadata management and quality - using modern tooling to help HSBC make better, faster decisions from our data Engage stakeholders confidently, translating semantic concepts for technical and non-technical audiences, and contributing to forums and working groups To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements: Demonstrable experience in business glossary curation, taxonomy design, and/or ontology modelling, with a clear understanding of how these enable AI and data interoperability Strong data analysis capability and attention to detail, able to deliver in a fast-paced environment Confidence working in an operating model where the business owns definitions, and you partner to ensure quality, consistency, and adoption Practical experience with data and/or semantic modelling and metadata practices; Collibra experience is useful but not essential (tooling matters less than the modelling fundamentals) Exposure to APIs and automation/integration thinking; some hands-on Python experience (AI-assisted development is welcomed) Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain semantic modelling concepts clearly A genuine interest in cutting-edge tooling and AI for Data & Tech, leveraging HSBC’s owned data to improve decision-making speed and quality Financial Services experience is beneficial Opening up a world of opportunity Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role. items.desc: Our Values In line with our One Coventry Values, we want to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organisation that encourages diversity in all respects, including diversity of thinking. We particularly welcome applicants from minority ethnic, LGBT+, disabled and neurodiverse communities to make a real difference to our residents so that equity and respect remains at the heart of everything we do. Our Values are: Open and fair: We are fair, open, and transparent. Nurture and develop: We help and encourage everyone to be their best and do their best. Engage and empower: We talk and listen to others, working together as one. Create and innovate: We embrace new ways of working to continuously improve. Own and be accountable: We work together to deliver the best services for our residents. Value and respect: We put diversity and inclusion at the heart of all we do. We value diverse perspectives and experiences and are striving to create a workplace culture that is inclusive, is accepting of all and is free from discrimination and bias. The Housing and Homelessness Service is a very busy environment and faces several challenges to meet the housing needs of citizens of Coventry. The team have grown significantly during the last 12 months and this reflects the fact that Housing & Homelessness are now a key council priority. The team are responsible for the delivery of the following service functions: Provision of the statutory homeless service Provision of temporary accommodation Management of the housing register Co-ordination of support to citizens rough sleeping Commissioning of homeless services, and Responsibility for housing strategy The Council has a strategic vision that is clearly set out in both the Housing & Homelessness and the Rough Sleeping Strategies which were both approved in 2019. By becoming part of an expanding team who are focused on preventing households from becoming homeless as well as providing tailored support and interventions when someone does become homeless this is a fantastic opportunity to make a real difference to some of the most vulnerable people in our city. What is the job role? We are recruiting an Accommodation Officer to join our Move On Team. The role involves managing a caseload of families living in temporary accommodation, with a particular focus on supporting households who have experienced extended stays in temporary accommodation to secure settled, permanent housing. You will take a proactive and person-centred approach, working closely with households to understand the barriers preventing them from moving on, whether these relate to affordability, housing history, support needs, employment, or other challenges. You will identify solutions, coordinate support, and work with partners to remove obstacles and help families successfully transition into sustainable accommodation. You will work with private landlords to negotiate and secure appropriate housing that meets service needs. Foster partnerships with internal and external stakeholders to enhance collaborative opportunities. Serve as the main contact for landlords, promoting the service with agents and providers. Visit households facing housing difficulties, offering support and mediation to prevent homelessness. This post is exempted under the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and as such appointment to this post will be conditional upon the receipt of a satisfactory response to a check of police records via Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS). All candidates must have the Right to Work in the UK. We are currently not offering sponsorship for this role. Who are we looking for? We are looking for a motivated and proactive individual who is passionate about helping families achieve sustainable housing outcomes. You will have experience working with vulnerable households and be confident managing a varied caseload whilst building positive and constructive relationships with residents and partner agencies. The successful candidate will be able to: Identify and understand the barriers preventing households from moving on from temporary accommodation. Develop practical solutions to overcome challenges relating to affordability, support needs, tenancy history, employment, welfare benefits, or access to suitable housing. Build trust and engage effectively with households who may be reluctant or anxious about moving. Work collaboratively with internal teams, housing providers, landlords, support services, and other partners to secure positive outcomes. Manage competing priorities and maintain accurate records in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrate resilience, persistence, and a solution-focused approach when dealing with complex cases. Support the development of retail media reporting, benchmarks and best practices, helping identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness. We offer a leading portfolio of crop protection solutions for plant and soil health, as well as digital solutions that transform the decision-making capabilities of farmers. Our 17,900 employees serve to advance agriculture in more than 90 countries around the world. Syngenta Crop Protection is headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, and is part of the Syngenta Group. No matter what your position, you will have a vital role in safely feeding the world and taking care of our planet. Join us and help shape the future of agriculture! items.desc: Job Introduction We are Forestry England. We live and breathe forests. Job title – Species Recovery Officer Salary – £35,039 Contract type – Fixed Term Appointment until March 2029 (with the possibility of extension or permanency but no guarantee) Hours – 37 hours per week Vacancy closes – Monday 30th November 2026, 23:58 Join us. We're foresters, professionals and experts. We are a passionate team who love to share our enthusiasm and want to make a positive difference for you and the environment. Together, we’re using our scale and expertise to grow the nation’s forests for everyone. We’re already adapting our landscapes for tomorrow, and getting stuff done today, like creating amazing places and experiences for you to enjoy. We're providing vital homes for wildlife, making our air cleaner to breathe and producing sustainable timber . What you’ll do… We’re looking for a Species Recovery Officer to lead the development and delivery of species recovery projects in Yorkshire, with an initial focus on the North East Yorkshire pine marten recovery project. Working at the forefront of nature recovery, you will help shape and deliver projects that support the recovery of influential species and contribute to the restoration of natural processes across our landscapes. Working closely with Forestry England’s national Forest Wilding Programme, ecologists, foresters, researchers and delivery partners, you will lead projects through feasibility, planning and implementation stages and, where projects proceed, support release and post-release monitoring. You will be responsible for project planning, = budget management, procurement and contract management, commissioning specialist studies, and ensuring projects are delivered in line with national and international best practice for species recovery and conservation translocations. Successful species recovery depends as much on people as it does on ecology. A significant part of the role will involve engaging with landowners, local communities, interest groups, regulators and partner organisations. You will build and maintain trusted relationships, understand differing perspectives and help ensure that project development is informed by evidence, local knowledge and stakeholder input. Experience of applying social science, behaviour change, conflict resolution or human-wildlife coexistence approaches will be particularly valuable. Alongside the pine marten project, you will help develop and deliver other priority species recovery initiatives for Forestry England, including projects focused on species such as Northern hairy wood ants and fungi. Working within Yorkshire’s Nature Recovery Team and alongside colleagues across England, you will contribute to innovative approaches to nature recovery, develop effective partnerships, support funding and reporting requirements, and help shape the future of species recovery in the nation’s forests. This is an exciting opportunity to play a leading role in species recovery, helping deliver lasting change across some of England’s most important landscapes. Please see the job description below for more information and details about what we need from you. Where you’ll work… The post will initially be based at Forestry England’s Yorkshire Office in Pickering. It will move to the Dalby Forest Office in early 2028. Regular travel around Forestry England’s estate in Yorkshire will be required. There will be occasional trips outside of Yorkshire for Forestry England-wide meetings, which may require an overnight stay. Benefits… Alongside your salary, Forestry England contributes an average of 28.97% towards your pension. You will become a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension Scheme. 25 days holiday a year, raising by one day every year’s service, up to 30 days (pro-rated for part time employees) plus additional days off such as bank holidays. STaR is our employee benefits scheme offering discounts on everyday supermarket shopping, as well as other things such as hotel stays clothes, mobile phones, other electrical items, medical and car insurance, holidays, gym discounts, household bills, Headspace wellbeing app. free parking at Forestry England sites and free entry to our National Arboretums at Westonbirt and Bedgebury. a commitment to lifelong learning through career development. Forestry England will support your career development in a variety of ways, including continual professional development, support for individual learning plans and sponsored membership of professional bodies. Read more about the benefits on the Forestry England website. How to apply… We cannot accept applications via email. Please follow the steps outlined below. Any CVs and/or personal statements sent outside the system will not be considered for shortlisting. You will be asked to write a 200 word statement on your relevant experience and career history, along with a personal statement of no more than 500 words. You will be assessed on both …

Prioritised, actionable backlog (in Jira or equivalent tooling) featuring structured epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data contract mappings. We therefore welcome discussions on all forms of flexible working. We also have three high quality subsidised day nurseries. Working closely with academic and Professional Services colleagues, the RSDP supports the development and delivery of research strategies, facilitates high-quality, typically high-value, multi-disciplinary and complex funding applications, and contributes to a seamless end-to-end research support service. Reporting to the Head of Research Strategy and Development, the RSDP operates within a collaborative, matrix environment across the RSSD and College Hubs. The role combines strategic insight with hands-on delivery, supporting both the development of major research initiatives and the continuous improvement of research systems, processes, and performance. The RSDP is part of a wider community of research professionals, working in close partnership with Research Support, Post Award, Research Governance, and other specialist teams to ensure a coordinated and effective approach to research from concept development through to award management.  ● Да определяш сам дали да извършваш задачите си, в комфортната среда на офисa или от вкъщи;
 ● Да определяш сам кога да изпълняваш задачите, за които си нает като ти управляваш и планираш началото и края на работния си ден;
 ● Да определяш сам месечно си възнаграждение (Фиксирано твърдо месечно възнаграждение с допълнителна атрактивна бонусна система на база постигнати резултати и без ограничения за максималното допълнително възнаграждение).
 В теб търсим
 ● Опит в продажбите и администрирането на автомобилни застраховки;
 ● Комуникираш свободно с колеги и клиенти;
 ● Ориентиран си към продажбите;
 ● Имаш позитивна нагласа, проактивност и готовност за нови предизвикателства;
 ● Владеенето на английски език ще се счита за предимство. 
 При нас ще откриеш
 ● Позицията е на граждански договор и има твърдо възнаграждение плюс бонуси; ● С възможност за хибридно или изцяло дистанционно извършване на дейности; 
 ● Работа в динамична работна среда, заобиколена от млад и сплотен екип; 
 ● Възможност за кариерно израстване.

 Das „ UniCredit Graduate Program “ ist Dein Start in eine spannende und abwechslungsreiche Karriere in einem der führenden Finanzinstitute Europas.
 In Deinem 15 - monatigen rotationsbasierten Traineeprogramm lernst Du das Unternehmen ganzheitlich kennen. Du arbeitest in einem zukunftsorientierten und internationalen Umfeld, in dem Du lernen, Dich entfalten und gleichzeitig mit Deinen Ideen etwas bewirken kannst - getreu unserem gemeinsamen Ziel "Empowering Communities to Progress".
 Das erwartet Dich bei uns
 Gestalte die Zukunft des Firmenkundengeschäfts mit – Als Trainee im Corporate Banking unserer Bank erlebst Du das Ergebnis unseres Handelns hautnah mit.
 Die HypoVereinsbank ist ein etablierter Player im Firmenkundengeschäft. Unser Kundenportfolio umfasst dabei klassische Familienunternehmen bis hin zu kapitalmarktaffinen Unternehmen.
 Während Deiner Zeit als Trainee bereiten wir Dich umfassend darauf vor, verschiedene Geschäftsmodelle und Marktentwicklungen zu analysieren. Darüber hinaus wirst Du lernen, Pitches vorzubereiten und Kundentermine durchzuführen. Dabei entwickelst Du innovative Lösungen und Finanzierungsstrukturen für unsere Kund:innen. Um die besten Ergebnisse zu erzielen, wirst Du in teamübergreifender Zusammenarbeit mit Spezialist:innen arbeiten und lernst unsere Bank ganzheitlich kennen. 
 Das macht Dein Traineeprogramm aus: 
 Rotationen – Du bist Gestalter Deines Traineeprogramms und konzipierst nach dem Onboarding in Deiner Homebase einen individuellen Rotationsplan, der Dir vielseitige Einblicke in die gesamte Bank ermöglicht.
 Trainings mit Seeblick – Entfalte Dein Potenzial in regelmäßigen Workshops im Bereich Bilanz- und Unternehmensanalyse direkt am schönen Ammersee.
 Networking – Werde in die HVB-Community aufgenommen und kreiere Dein Netzwerk durch Trainee-Events und der direkten Interaktion mit dem Management.
 Das bringst Du mit
 Du passt perfekt zu uns und unserer Kultur, wenn Du Dich mit den Werten Integrity, Ownership und Caring identifizierst und zugleich über ein agiles Mindset, Neugierde und proaktives unternehmerisches Denken verfügst.
 Darüber hinaus bringst du Folgendes mit:
 Du befindest Dich in den letzten Zügen Deines wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen Bachelor- oder Masterstudiums mit guten akademischen Leistungen, bzw. hast Dein Studium innerhalb der letzten 2 Jahre absolviert
 Du vereinst starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit Spaß am Kund:innen Kontakt
 Du hast bereits erste Praxiserfahrung im Bereich Banking & Finance sammeln können
 Deine Deutsch (C2) - und Englischkenntnisse sind sehr gut
 Wir bauen auf Dein positives Mindset: Du bringst eine Hands-on-Mentalität mit und gestaltest den Wandel mit innovativen Ideen
 Bewirb Dich jetzt & Make a Difference! 
 Das bieten wir Dir
 #ComeAndStay – Bei uns erhältst Du ab Tag 1 einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag. 
 #GrowAndExcel – In Deinem individuell gestalteten, abwechslungsreichen Traineeprogramm entwickelst Du Dich kontinuierlich weiter. Durch eine steile Lernkurve, umfangreiche Qualifizierungsangebote, strategische Entwicklungsprogramme und persönliches Mentoring bereiten wir Dich auf Deine Zielposition vor und geben Deiner Karriere eine nachhaltige Perspektive.
 #EnjoyNetworking – Tauche in ein Netzwerk voller Möglichkeiten ein und knüpfe Kontakte in alle Bereiche und Divisionen der Bank – auch international. Werde Teil unserer globalen Trainee-Community und entdecke die Vielfalt der UniCredit. Dein Alltag wird durch zahlreiche inspirierende lokale und globale Events, regelmäßige Stammtische und spannende Begegnungen mit dem Management bereichert.
 #DesignYourWorkingLife – Digitalisierung und Flexibilität prägen unsere moderne Arbeitswelt. Gestalte Deinen Arbeitsalltag so, wie er am besten zu Dir passt: Ob im Office, remote in ganz Deutschland oder aus dem EU-Ausland. Du möchtest länger verreisen? Dann nimm ein Sabbatical und entdecke mit uns die Möglichkeiten von New Work.
 #LiveOurCulture – Wir erledigen unsere Arbeit nicht einfach, sondern erleben und gestalten sie gemeinsam. Als echtes Team kommunizieren wir auf Augenhöhe #GernPerDu, schätzen jede Meinung und sind davon überzeugt, dass Erfolg auf People Empowerment beruht.
 #ThinkEuropean – Wir zählen nicht nur zu den größten Finanzinstituten Deutschlands, sondern sind als Teil …

 Chceš vyvíjet elektroniku, která se skutečně dostane do průmyslu?
 Rád rozebíráš elektroniku, abys pochopil, jak je navržená? My ji navrhujeme od první myšlenky až po sériovou výrobu. 
 Patříš mezi lidi, které zajímá, jak vzniká elektronika uvnitř průmyslových zařízení a jak se ze schématu stane skutečná deska plošných spojů? Pak možná hledáme právě tebe.
 Přidej se k našemu R&D týmu v Trutnově a podílej se na návrhu PCB pro produkty Siemens SIRIUS pro průmyslovou automatizaci.
 Na čem budeš pracovat 
 • Navrhovat layout desek plošných spojů (PCB). 
 • Převádět elektronická schémata do fyzického návrhu PCB. 
 • Řešit rozmístění součástek, vedení spojů a návrhová pravidla. 
 • Spolupracovat s HW vývojáři při návrhu elektroniky a optimalizaci PCB. 
 • Připravovat výrobní data a technickou dokumentaci. 
 • Podílet se na kontrole a revizi PCB návrhů. 
 • Spolupracovat při oživování prototypů, EMC zkouškách a řešení problémů. 
 • Komunikovat s HW/FW vývojáři, konstruktéry a výrobou. 
 • Poznávat moderní vývojové postupy včetně využití AI nástrojů.
 Co od tebe očekáváme 
 • Základní znalost návrhu desek plošných spojů a principů PCB layoutu. 
 • Výhodou je zkušenost s některým nástrojem pro návrh PCB, například Siemens Xpedition, Altium Designer, OrCAD nebo KiCad.
 • Základní orientaci v elektronických schématech a elektronických součástkách. 
 • Základní znalost analogové nebo digitální elektroniky. 
 • Chuť učit se nové věci a hledat technická řešení. 
 • Technickou zvídavost, pečlivost a samostatnost. 
 • Schopnost komunikovat v angličtině.
 Co nabízíme 
 • Možnost učit se PCB design od zkušených kolegů a HW vývojářů. 
 • Práci na reálných průmyslových produktech. 
 • Přístup k moderně vybaveným laboratořím. 
 • Zapojení do vývoje od elektronického schématu přes PCB až po sériovou výrobu. 
 • Práci s moderními návrhovými nástroji včetně AI asistentů. 
 • Kariérní růst v oblasti PCB designu, elektroniky, EMC nebo HW vývoje. 
 • Přátelský tým a stabilní zázemí společnosti Siemens. 
 • Velký prostor pro odborný růst.
 Proč právě k nám? 
 V Trutnově nevyvíjíme jen jednotlivé části elektroniky. Vyvíjíme kompletní produkty. Uvidíš celý proces od elektronického návrhu a PCB layoutu přes prototyp a testování až po sériovou výrobu. Díky tomu pochopíš nejen jak PCB navrhnout, ale také proč se navrhuje právě daným způsobem a jak jeho návrh ovlivňuje výsledný produkt.
 Další benefity: 
 Více času na odpočinek 
 5 týdnů dovolené.
 Možnost neplaceného volna pro odpočinek nebo cestování.
 Flexibilní pracovní doba a možnost home-office s příspěvkem na jeho náklady.
 Individuální rozpočet na benefity.
 Minimálně 34 000 Kč ročně na benefity z oblastí finance, pohoda a zdraví.
 Moje finance 
 Příspěvek na penzijní/životní pojištění nebo DIP.
 Zaměstnanecký akciový program.
 Moje pohoda 
 Cafeterie, e-stravenky nebo firemní stravování.
 Zvýhodněné nabídky pro zaměstnance.
 Moje zdraví 
 MultiSport karta.
 Nadstandardní zdravotní péče a krizová podpora.
 Společnost Siemens je zaměstnavatelem podporujícím rovné příležitosti. Zasazujeme se o rovné pracovní příležitosti bez ohledu na rasu, barvu pleti, původ, náboženství, pohlaví, sexuální orientaci, věk, občanství, rodinný stav, zdravotní postižení nebo genderovou identitu. Jsme odhodláni vytvořit tým, který bude reprezentovat nejrůznější prostředí, perspektivy a dovednosti. Objevte náš zajímavý svět Siemens na www.siemens.com

 A Siemens Mobility Kft. K+F központjában, a XI. kerületi Infoparkban olyan projekteken dolgozunk, melyek biztosítják a zavartalan, fenntartható, megbízható és biztonságos közlekedést. 
 Tudj meg többet a cégünkről: www.siemens.hu/mobility 
 A projektről: Az IIC/OMC alrendszer a Siemens által kifejlesztett SIMIS W/SIMIS D elektronikus biztosítóberendezés fontos komponense. A SIMIS berendezés az EN50128 szabvány alapján készült, SIL4-es szintű biztonságkritikus rendszer. Magas megbízhatóság, rendelkezésreállás, és flexibilitás jellemzi alacsony karbantartási és működtetési költségekkel.
 Az IIC/OMC (Interlocking and Interface Component/Overhead Management Component) alrendszer tartalmazza a központi Interlocking funkcionalitást, biztosítja a kompatibilis interface-eket a csatlakoztatandó biztosító elemek számára, diagnosztikai üzeneteket generál, hiba- és állapotüzeneteket továbbít a többi komponens felé.
 A csapat tagjaként az alábbi feladatok várnak rád: 
 Részvétel IIC/OMC és MOC biztonságkritikus rendszer fejlesztésében, verifikálásában és tesztelésében.
 Dokumentációkészítés német és angol nyelven.
 Biztonságkritikus szoftver lévén, az ezzel kapcsolatos folyamatok betartása, tesztelési és dokumentációs feladatok ellátása.
 Együttműködés külföldi és belföldi csapattagokkal.
 Te vagy az ideális jelölt, ha: 
 Van felsőfokú végzettséged informatikus vagy közlekedés/járműmérnöki területen.
 Rendelkezel minimum 3 év C++ verifikálói/tesztelői tapasztalattal (nem manuális tesztelés).
 Tudsz C++-ban kódot olvasni, automatizált tesztet írni.
 Magabiztosan használod a német nyelvet mind szóban, mind írásban.
 Magabiztosan használod az angol nyelvet mind szóban, mind írásban.
 Szisztematikus, strukturált gondolkodásmód és cselekvés jellemez.
 Képes vagy önálló munkavégzésre és elkötelezett vagy egy hosszútávú termékfejlesztésben.
 A pályázásod során előnyt jelenthet, amennyiben: 
 Jártas vagy az alábbi témákban: Jira/RTC, Git, Agilis fejlesztési folyamatok.
 Alapfokú CENELEC szabványok (50128, 50129) ismerete.
 Megszerezted az ISTQB® Certified Tester Foundation Level képesítést.
 Mi az, amit mi biztosítunk? 
 Családbarát munkahelyet, kötetlen munkaidővel, rugalmas hozzáállással.
 Stresszmentes környezetet, ahol nagy hangsúlyt kap a work-life balance.
 Fejlődési lehetőségeket, egyéni tréning kerettel, kidolgozott karrierúttal.
 Fontos számunkra az egészséged, többek közt élet- és egészségbiztosítással óvunk.
 Ergonomikus munkakörnyezetet biztosítunk számodra, ezzel is kényelmessé téve az irodai munkavégzést.
 A felsoroltak mellett egy több mint 20 elemből álló béren kívüli juttatási csomaggal várunk.

 Műszaki dokumentáció: A műszaki dokumentáció elkészítése és gondozása, elsősorban a hardverfejlesztés területén (a tervezéstől egészen a végső revízióig).
 Műszaki rajzolás és hardvertervezés: Műszaki rajzok, hardvertervek, kábellisták és elrendezési rajzok (helyszín- és épülettervek, telepítési tervek stb.) precíz elkészítése modern CAE-/CAD-rendszerek használatával.
 CAE-adminisztráció: A CAE-könyvtárak kezelése és adminisztrációja, valamint az alkalmazott CAE-rendszerek felügyelete.
 Átfogó- és integrációs mérnöki feladatok: Támogatás az átfogó mérnöki és integrációs feladatokban a vasúti villamosítás területén.
 Te vagy az ideális jelölt, ha: 
 Befejezett műszaki végzettséggel (technikus, okleveles műszaki rajzoló) vagy azzal egyenértékű képesítéssel rendelkezel.
 Gyakorlati tapasztalatod van a műszaki rajzolás terén, különös tekintettel a hardvertervezésre és az épülettervekre.
 Alapos és biztos felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel az elterjedt eszközökben, mint például az AutoCAD, az EPLAN és/vagy az Engineering Base.
 Tárgyalóképes, folyékony német nyelvtudással rendelkezel (B2+), valamint kommunikációképes angol nyelvtudásod van legalább B1 szinten.
 Strukturált és alapos munkavégzés jellemez, magas szintű precizitással a műszaki dokumentációk és részletes tervek készítése során.
 Proaktivitás és felelősségtudat mutatkozik meg a CAE-adminisztrációs feladatok és a könyvtárak önálló kezelése, gondozása terén.
 Csapatjátékos hozzáállással biztosítod a hatékony együttműködést a nemzetközi mérnöki és más projekttagokkal.
 A pályázásod során előnyt jelenthet, amennyiben: 
 Specifikus műszaki háttérrel/mély ismeretekkel rendelkezel a villamosítás területén.
 Van tapasztalatod a vasúti infrastruktúra terén vagy hasonló ipari nagyprojektekben.
 Kiterjedt ismeretekkel rendelkezel a mérnöki adatbázisok és CAE-könyvtárak adminisztrációjában.
 Mi az, amit mi biztosítunk? 
 Családbarát munkahelyet, kötetlen munkaidővel, rugalmas hozzáállással.
 Stresszmentes környezetet, ahol nagy hangsúlyt kap a work-life balance.
 Fejlődési lehetőségeket, egyéni tréning kerettel, kidolgozott karrierúttal.
 Fontos számunkra az egészséged, többek közt élet- és egészségbiztosítással óvunk.
 Ergonomikus munkakörnyezetet biztosítunk számodra, ezzel is kényelmessé téve az irodai munkavégzést.

 About the Role 
 As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will contribute directly to the development and lifecycle support of electric motors for demanding industrial applications. At our motor factory in Oradea, you will help shape platform architectures, improve product quality, and industrialize robust, scalable mechanical solutions. The role provides a high level of ownership and close collaboration within a global R&D network. 
 Your Responsibilities 
 Develop mechanical components and assemblies for electric motors; add platform elements and modular building blocks where required by the assignment, while meeting performance, cost, and manufacturability targets. 
 Lead improvements in product and component quality , conducting structured analyses (e.g., root cause, design reviews) and driving corrective actions. 
 Identify and implement cost‑reduction opportunities , ensuring an optimal balance between technical performance, manufacturability, and reliability. 
 Ensure Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Automation (DfA) in close cooperation with Manufacturing Technology and industrialization engineers. 
 Act as a key technical interface for suppliers, Sales, Product Management, and customer engineering teams, supporting technically demanding customer requirements. 
 Collaborate closely with Quality, Logistics, Manufacturing Technology, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Controlling throughout the product lifecycle. 
 Ensure complete documentation, validation, and release of mechanical designs in accordance with internal standards and industrial development processes. 
 Contribute to the platformization and standardization of mechanical solutions , ensuring reuse and scalability across the motor portfolio. 
 What You Bring 
 Education & Experience 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics (required). 
 Experience in motor design, rotating machinery, or precision mechanics (preferred). 
 Proven experience with mechanical CAD tools (mandatory); Siemens NX preferred. 
 Technical Skills 
 Strong knowledge of materials, thermal behavior and cooling, ISO GPS tolerancing, and mechanical design principles , plus a basic understanding of FEM. 
 Mandatory exposure to platform architectures and industrial product development standards (e.g., requirements engineering, validation processes, release cycles). 
 Familiarity with the following tools / environments: 
 NX for mechanical design
 Teamcenter for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) 
 Polarion for requirements and process management
 Simcenter or comparable simulation tools 
 Languages 
 Romanian and English — fluent
 German — considered a plus
 Soft Skills 
 Strong ownership & accountability for product quality and deliverables. 
 Effective cross-functional communication with factory functions and global R&D teams. 
 Structured problem-solving mindset and hands-on approach. 
 Travel 
 10-20% travel expected after the initial onboarding and training phase (e.g., to Germany or suppliers). 
 What We Offer 
 Work directly in the motor factory , enabling fast feedback loops between design and manufacturing. 
 High customer involvement and exposure to demanding technical requirements. 
 Collaboration within international R&D and engineering networks . 
 Opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of mechanical components and assemblies throughout the product lifecycle.

 About the Role
 We are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the development and lifecycle care of electric motors. You will work in a factory‑embedded R&D environment, combining electromagnetic design, simulation, data evaluation, and hands‑on collaboration with testing, production, and mechanical engineering. 
 The role requires strong physics understanding, data‑driven thinking, and motivation to deepen expertise in industrial motor development. It is ideal for an engineer with several years of experience who wants to strengthen both technical depth and cross‑functional collaboration skills. 
 Your Responsibilities
 Motor Design & Simulation
 Contribute to the electromagnetic and electrical design of servo, linear, and torque motors 
 Perform and interpret simulations (electromagnetic, thermal, loss, behavior under load) using internal or commercial tools 
 Support parameter sensitivity studies, robustness evaluations, and component trade‑offs 
 Data Analysis & Product Performance
 Analyze test data, measurement results, and production feedback to identify improvement potentials 
 Participate in root-cause analysis for electrical performance deviations or robustness issues 
 Support continuous improvement of motor characteristics, efficiency, and stability 
 Development Process & Cross-Functional Work 
 Contribute to requirements definition, documentation, and validation according to industrial development standards 
 Collaborate closely with mechanical engineering, manufacturing technology, production, and quality to ensure DfM/DfA alignment 
 Assist in the introduction of platform elements, variant development, and lifecycle enhancements 
 What You Bring
 Education & Experience
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Mechatronics, or similar (mandatory) 
 Experience in electric motor design (practical project or industry exposure required) 
 Several years of engineering experience — mid-level—suitable for handling independent tasks with support available when needed 
 Technical Skills
 Solid understanding of electromagnetic principles, motor physics, materials, and losses 
 Experience with electromagnetic and thermal simulations (Simcenter, Ansys, JMAG, MotorSolve or similar tools) 
 Strong data affinity: ability to evaluate measurements, trends, and physical correlations 
 Familiarity with:
 Teamcenter (PLM)
 Polarion (requirements/processes)
 Simcenter environments
 Understanding of motor testing and interpretation of characteristic curves 
 Soft Skills
 Analytical, physics‑driven problem solver 
 Collaborative and comfortable working in a factory + R&D hybrid setup 
 Clear communicator with an interest in learning and deepening expertise over time 
 Structured, reliable, and proactive
 Languages
 Romanian & English — fluent
 German — an advantage
 What We Offer
 A role embedded directly in the motor factory, enabling rapid learning and fast feedback cycles 
 Exposure to electric motor technologies 
 Opportunity to develop strong simulation and data analysis skills 
 Collaboration with global R&D teams and visibility across international projects 
 A supportive environment for technical growth and long-term career development

items.desc: Data Scientist: byg AI-løsninger, der bliver brugt Er du nyuddannet eller har du et par års erfaring, og vil du se dine AI-løsninger blive brugt i virkeligheden? Hos Todai, et AI-only konsulenthus, bliver du en del af Solution Teamet. Du arbejder tæt på kunden og vokser ind i rollen som konsulent, hvor du omsætter data og AI til løsninger, der skaber værdi i praksis. Om Todai Todai arbejder kun med AI. Vi hjælper virksomheder med alt fra at komme i gang med AI til at bygge og drifte løsninger, der kører i hverdagen. Vi arbejder bl.a. med prædiktiv AI og LLM'er, nogle gange som selvstændige projekter og andre gange kombineret i samme løsning. Vores kunder spænder fra nogle af Danmarks største virksomheder til virksomheder med under 100 ansatte. For dig betyder det, at du arbejder med AI hver dag, ofte på flere kundeprojekter ad gangen, og hele tiden bliver udfordret med nyt. Føler du dig ikke allerede som AI-ekspert, kommer du hurtigt til det i et team, hvor alle deler ud af deres viden. Vi sidder oftest sammen på kontoret i Carlsberg Byen, fordi vi lærer mest, når vi deler erfaringer på tværs af projekterne. Vi har en flad struktur og frihed under ansvar, og vi værner om vores imødekommende kultur med god stemning og plads til både det personlige og det uformelle. Det skal du lave Forestil dig, at du sidder hos en kunde, og de fortæller om et problem, som de har slået sig på i årevis. Måske skal en produktion forudsiges bedre, eller måske drukner medarbejderne i dokumenter. Din opgave er at forstå forretningen godt nok til at se, hvor AI kan gøre en forskel – og finde den løsning, der giver mest værdi for kundens tid og budget. Du tester idéer, smider dem væk, der ikke holder, og bygger videre på dem, der gør. Nogle gange bliver det en prædiktiv model, andre gange en LLM-løsning, og ofte en kombination. Du står ikke alene med det. Du arbejder i teams på tværs af Todai sammen med andre data scientists, software engineers og vores Adoption-team, og undervejs lærer du også software engineering. Sammen sørger I for, at løsningen ikke bare virker i en demo, men kører og bliver brugt. Når løsningen er bygget, er vi ikke færdige. Vi klæder kunden på til at tage den til sig. Det gælder både kundens teknikere og de brugere, der skal have glæde af den i hverdagen. Og så bruger vi selv AI til alt, hvad vi kan. Vi bliver ved med at finde nye måder at arbejde smartere på. Vi tror, du er en, der forstår data og ser mønstre hurtigt, men som er lige så nysgerrig på mennesker og forretning som på teknik. Du starter hellere, tester og forbedrer end at vente på den perfekte løsning, og du låser dig ikke fast på din første idé. For dig er kvalitet en løsning, der virker i praksis og skaber værdi for kunden. Du tror på, at der findes en løsning, og du tager andre med på vejen. Du tør stille spørgsmål og sige det, der skal siges, og du synes, det er lige så sjovt at forklare en løsning som at bygge den. Og så bruger du allerede AI til at gøre dit eget arbejde bedre, bare fordi du ikke kan lade være. Du har En kandidatgrad i data science, machine learning eller et beslægtet felt, gerne som nyuddannet eller med et par års erfaring Erfaring med machine learning, LLM'er/GenAI Erfaring fra studiejob og gerne projekter, hvor du har arbejdet med AI og selv har bygget noget, fx en agent, en RAG-løsning eller en anden AI-applikation Lyst til at være en del af et team, hvor ingen uger er ens, og hvor du trives med at skifte mellem kunder, brancher og opgaver Krav Du taler og skriver flydende dansk og engelsk Det her er ikke noget for dig, hvis du trives bedst med at fordybe dig i ét projekt ad gangen du foretrækker at få en færdig kravspecifikation frem for selv at lave kravene sammen med dine kollegaer og kunden Det får du Faglig sparring hver dag med erfarne kollegaer på tværs af data science, software engineering og adoption Ansvar og kundekontakt, med en fast makker ved din side de første måneder Mange forskellige AI-projekter på tværs af brancher og virksomheder, så du lærer hurtigt Fri adgang til de nyeste AI-værktøjer i dit daglige arbejde Fast løn efter kvalifikationer, pension og sundhedsforsikring Ansøgning Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til job@todai.ai. Vi holder samtaler løbende, så søg gerne hurtigst muligt. I ansøgningen vil vi gerne høre om noget, du har bygget med AI. Fortæl os på 5 til 10 linjer: Hvad var problemet, hvad byggede du, og hvad ville du gøre anderledes i dag? Du må gerne bruge AI til din ansøgning. Vi gør selv det samme.
