items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are fearless in both decision and action. And we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. 
 In the Small Molecule Research department (SMR) in Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), we generate molecular insights, and drive the discovery and development of small molecules from initial starting points to clinical candidates across the pRED discovery portfolio. In the Compound Library Enhancement and Logistics (CLEL) team, we supply research samples for all SMR portfolio projects and serve as the custodians of the Roche Corporate Compound Collection. Using state-of-the-art automation platforms and digital workflows, our mission is to enable drug discovery projects with the supply of proprietary chemical space and the timely delivery of research samples that can be subjected to biological assays. 
 As the CLEL team is spearheading novel digital processes and AI-augmented drug discovery workflows, we are seeking an analytical and forward-thinking scientist to join our team in the Roche Innovation Center Basel and contribute to the exploration and implementation of next-generation end-to-end sample logistics workflows. 
 The position: 
 In this role, you will focus on building the next-generation workflow engines that track, plan, and securely connect decisions across our entire automated IT infrastructure. You will serve as a key business analyst, modernizing legacy systems, eliminating static steps, and replacing them with fully automated, FAIR-compliant, interoperable workflows and data foundations built for scalable automation and AI that keep the drug discovery path moving at maximum velocity. 
 This role will deliver efficiency gains by lowering business process overhead and improve coordination. It will also increase visibility and develop new planning capabilities leading to better decisions on investments and strategic resource planning, resulting in streamlined sample delivery and data processes. 
 Specifically, you will: 
 Scope, design and engineer an interconnected next-generation business workflow engine capable of mapping, tracking, and capturing decisions and data across automated business processes. 
 Develop solutions to lower technical barriers for sample, data and information transfer, as well as decision-making at the interface of internal or external stakeholder-facing systems. 
 Support compliance workflows in sample and data management ( i.e. sample decisions, documentation), as well as overhaul automated compound QC workflows towards AI-assisted data analysis pipelines. 
 Partner with automation engineers and laboratory staff to generate business dashboards and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and interface effectiveness to key stakeholders. 
 Shape and drive our ongoing transition to AI-based software development: build and maintain tools together with AI coding assistants, and establish the practices (review, testing, documentation) that keep AI-generated solutions reliable and future-oriented. 
 Design and implement agentic workflows in which AI agents carry out multi-step tasks such as data analysis, issue diagnosis and routine operations, with clear human oversight and safeguards for operational systems and data. 
 Act as expert point of contact for operational workflows: shape the evolution of our system landscape, develop solutions with emerging AI technologies, and contribute to the architecture of future tools. 
 Who you are: 
 You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking to be part of a dynamic and cutting-edge organization where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and tasks. You are interested in making an impact by providing solutions, reducing complexity and connecting essential elements of the drug discovery process and are passionate about applying state-of-the-art technology and science to the biopharmaceutical industry.

items.desc:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 
Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.

About the role:
We are looking for a manufacturing systems engineer to own the production process and make it ready for a significant scaleup. You will work closely with our engineering and production team in Zürich to make our production more reliable and scalable.
This role is very hands-on and you will spend a lot of your time on the shop floor solving issues and improving production hand in hand with assembly technicians. You will be building out a world class production system to support a rapidly growing supply base.
What you will do:
Own how our product is built from start to finish
 Create and maintain production process documentation, both for internal and external manufacturing
 Improve workstation layout, flow design and tooling from incoming goods to product shipping
 Support make vs buy decisions and supplier selection
 Support new product introduction from development to production
 Close DFM feedback loop to improve manufacturability
What we're looking for:
A university degree in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics Engineering or equivalent practical experience
 3+ years experience in manufacturing / process engineering in mid volume manufacturing
 Taken a product from prototype to repeatable series production before
 CAD knowledge for designing fixtures and reviewing designs
 Solid understanding of mechanical and electrical systems
 Good command of English, both written and spoken
 Willing to travel ~20% internationally to support external manufacturing
Beneficial experience :
ERP / MRP Systems
 BOM management
 GD&T
 Python for test automation and production tooling
 Agentic tools for writing code and automating workflows
 Off-highway, agricultural, mining or other harsh-environment equipment
This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.

items.desc: En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 13, 2026, 2:36PM Durée du contrat : 6 mois 1. Objectif général Concevoir, instrumenter et évaluer un dispositif qui détecte, quantifie et atténue l'érosion du jugement autonome d'un opérateur supervisant un agent IA 2. Livrables techniques Livrable 1 : État de l'art ciblé (≈ 4 semaines) Systèmes agentiques (LangGraph, patterns human-in-the-loop, interrupts, checkpoints) Boucles de rétroaction humain–IA (Glickman & Sharot, 2024) Synthèse sous forme de matrice : biais → comportement observable → indicateur mesurable Livrable 2 : Indicateurs Définir et coder des indicateurs clés en Python (à partir de logs de navigation) pour mesurer le niveau de confiance, de suivi ou de dérive de l'opérateur face aux recommandations de l'IA. Livrable 3 : Banc d'expérimentation Développer et enrichir un banc d'expérimentation (extension d'un agent LangGraph existant) pour simuler des scénarios d'anomalies et évaluer les réactions de l'opérateur (simulé par LLM ou avec de vrais utilisateurs). Livrable 4 : Mécanismes de préservation du jugement (≈ 6 semaines) Prototyper des mécanismes intelligents de préservation du jugement, en adaptant par exemple le niveau d’assistance ou l’affichage des explications de l'IA en temps réel. Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (École d'ingénieur ou Master universitaire) en Informatique, Intelligence Artificielle ou Sciences Cognitives, et vous recherchez un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois à partir de février 2027. Vos hard skills : Bonne maîtrise du langage Python et appétence pour le développement de pipelines logiciels. Intérêt marqué ou première expérience avec les architectures d'IA agentique (concept de graphes, LangGraph, orchestrations LLM). Sensibilité à la conception d'interfaces ou à l'analyse de données (IHM, logs, parcours utilisateur). Vos soft skills : Au-delà de la technique, nous recherchons une personnalité curieuse, autonome et dotée d’un excellent esprit critique. Votre goût pour l'exploration scientifique, votre rigueur méthodologique et votre envie de relever des défis technologiques complexes vous permettront de vous épanouir pleinement dans cette mission. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement dynamique, avec une équipe composée d’un mixte de compétences (chercheurs, chefs de projet, développeur, architectes ergonomes et designers). Le stage est l’occasion de mettre en pratique les acquis de votre formation en intégrant une équipe pluridisciplinaire. L'indemnité mensuelle brute de stage proposée est comprise entre 1 000 et 1 500 euros selon votre niveau d'études en cours. A cela s'ajoutent l'accès aux Activités Sociales et Culturelles proposées par votre Comité Social et Economique, l'accès subventionné au restaurant d'entreprise ou aux titres restaurant, ainsi que la prise en charge à hauteur de 50% de votre abonnement aux transports en commun. Notre mission : imaginer et développer les futurs services qui simplifieront la collaboration et le travail au quotidien. Vous intégrerez une équipe de passionnés qui mêle recherche, exploration et développement de solutions concrètes, dans une ambiance curieuse et stimulante. items.desc: Who we are AUSTRIACARD is a global applied technology company and a trusted provider of identity and payment solutions, with a strategic focus on digital transformation powered by proprietary technology and AI capabilities. Headquartered in Vienna, Austria, we combine manufacturing hubs across Europe and the US with a global sales network, enabling us to stay close to our customers and remain committed to service excellence worldwide. About the Role We are seeking a Support Engineer to be the main point of contact for customers using the GaiaB appliance. GaiaB is a sovereign enterprise AI platform that empowers your workforce through integrated, agentic intelligence. Deploy it as an appliance, as a service from AUSTRIACARD’s European sovereign cloud, or on your own infrastructure, with no per-token fees and your data under your control. As a Support Engineer, you will guide and support customers through onboarding, setup, and day-to-day use of the platform. You will troubleshoot issues, assist users in refining prompts and interpreting reports, manage and prioritize support requests, collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to drive resolutions, and contribute to support documentation and service enhancements based on customer feedback. Key Responsibilities Be a point of contact for customers using our GenAI and data analytics products. Learn how customers use our products and guide them through setup, onboarding, and everyday tasks. Help users refine prompts and investigate unexpected AI responses by reviewing the instructions, context, and expected results. Help users interpret dashboards and reports and investigate discrepancies by checking metrics, filters, and date ranges. Log and prioritize support requests, reproduce issues where possible, and escalate complex cases with clear steps and evidence. Work with product and engineering teams to resolve issues and keep customers informed. Update support guides and FAQs and share recurring customer feedback with the product team. Required Skills Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools, such as LLMs and AI assistants. Ability to write clear prompts and refine them based on the results. Ability to assess AI responses for accuracy and relevance. Ability to read dashboards and reports and understand basic metrics. A structured approach to problem-solving and attention to detail. Ability to organize support requests, follow through, and know when to ask for help. Eagerness to learn new technologies, share what you learn, and work with technical and nontechnical teams. Clear communication and empathy when helping customers. Nice to have Previous experience in customer support, a help desk, or product onboarding. Basic Python or SQL skills, or experience with analytics BI tools such as Apache Superset or similar. Familiarity with AI agents, knowledge bases, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Basic exposure to APIs, application logs, or DevOps tools such as Docker or Kubernetes. Familiarity with GenAI technologies like Langfuse, LiteLLM, or vLLM. What You'll Get Continuous learning and development through the AUSTRIACARD Academy. Prospects for professional growth both locally and globally in a multinational company. Exposure to innovative AI and cutting-edge technologies. Ticket Restaurant on a monthly basis. Private Life and Medical Insurance coverage. Salary Range: €25.000 - 35.000 gross annually, depending on experience and qualifications Austriacard is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, or any other legally protected status.

items.desc: Introductie Onderwijs verzorgen en onderzoek uitvoeren verandert snel. Dit betekent grote ambitieuze programma’s, continue vernieuwing, veel en juiste informatievoorziening en het leveren van uitstekende kwaliteit. Generatieve AI biedt nieuwe mogelijkheden voor onderwijs, onderzoek en bedrijfsvoering. Binnen Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam ontwikkelen we AI-diensten waarmee medewerkers en studenten deze technologie effectief, veilig en verantwoord kunnen inzetten. Binnen de dienst EDIS bouwen we aan een team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het ontwikkelen, beschikbaar stellen en beheren van AI-toepassingen. We zoeken een Application Specialist die gebruikers helpt om o.a. de mogelijkheden van AI optimaal te benutten en zorgt dat onze (AI-)diensten aansluiten op hun behoeften. Functieomschrijving Je komt te werken binnen het domein Generic IT Services van de dienst EDIS van de EUR. Als Application Specialist speel je een cruciale rol bij het ondersteunen van gebruikers bij het effectief en verantwoord inzetten van diensten die gebruikt kunnen worden voor o.a. het werken met generatieve AI. Het grootste gedeelte van jouw werkzaamheden is het helpen van het realiseren van AI-usecases, configureren AI-assistenten en kennisbronnen en je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de geleverde diensten. Je werkt nauw samen met de ontwikkelaars en engineers binnen het team, die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de technische ontwikkeling van het platform en de applicaties. Je combineert kennis van AI-technologie met inzicht in gebruikersbehoeften en zorgt ervoor dat nieuwe mogelijkheden worden vertaald naar praktische en betrouwbare toepassingen. De belangrijkste werkzaamheden: AI-usecases realiseren: gebruikers begeleiden bij het formuleren van hun behoeften en deze vertalen naar functionele AI-oplossingen. RAG-kennisbronnen beheren: opzetten, configureren en onderhouden van kennisbronnen en datasets, inclusief documentselectie, metadata, actualiteit en toegangsrechten. Kwaliteit bewaken: testen en beoordelen van AI-antwoorden op juistheid, relevantie, betrouwbaarheid en bruikbaarheid en verbeteringen doorvoeren binnen de beschikbare functionaliteit. AI-diensten beheren: verzorgen van functionele configuraties, autorisaties, gebruikersbeheer en het analyseren en oplossen van functionele problemen. Gebruikers ondersteunen: adviseren, begeleiden en trainen van medewerkers en teams bij het effectief en verantwoord inzetten van generatieve AI. Doorontwikkeling stimuleren: gebruikersfeedback verzamelen, verbeterkansen signaleren en functionele wensen afstemmen met de ontwikkelaars en engineers. Gebruik monitoren: analyseren van gebruik, incidenten en gebruikerservaringen en op basis daarvan verbeteringen voorstellen. Veilig en verantwoord gebruik borgen: toepassen van richtlijnen voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging, datakwaliteit en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Kennis vastleggen en delen: documenteren van configuraties, werkwijzen en gebruikersinstructies en bijdragen aan kennisdeling binnen het team. Functie-eisen Je beschikt over HBO werk- en denkniveau en hebt affiniteit met generatieve AI en digitale dienstverlening. Je bent analytisch, technisch nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om samen met gebruikers praktische oplossingen te realiseren. Daarnaast breng je mee: Ervaring met het configureren, implementeren of beheren van applicaties of digitale diensten. Kennis van en bij voorkeur praktijkervaring met generatieve AI, LLM's en chatbotplatformen. Ervaring met prompting en het configureren van AI-assistenten of vergelijkbare toepassingen. Kennis van of affiniteit met RAG en het gebruik van kennisbronnen binnen AI-toepassingen. Basiskennis van informatiebeveiliging, privacy en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Het vermogen om gebruikerswensen te vertalen naar functionele oplossingen en verbeteringen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling. Het is een pre als je ervaring hebt met: Azure OpenAI of vergelijkbare generatieve AI-platformen. Het configureren van AI-workflows en custom chatbots. RAG-oplossingen en het beheren van kennisbronnen. Het testen en evalueren van de kwaliteit van LLM-antwoorden. ITIL-processen en Agile/Scrum-werkwijzen. Competenties Analytisch: je doorgrondt gebruikersvragen en vertaalt deze naar praktische oplossingen. Nieuwsgierig: je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen AI en onderzoekt hoe deze kunnen worden toegepast. Klantgericht: je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en helpt hen verder. Kwaliteitsbewust: je hebt oog voor betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en continuïteit. Samenwerkingsgericht: je werkt effectief samen met gebruikers, ontwikkelaars en andere specialisten. Zelfstandig: je neemt initiatief, stelt prioriteiten en draagt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werkzaamheden. Pragmatisch: je zoekt naar haalbare oplossingen binnen de mogelijkheden van de beschikbare AI-diensten. Arbeidsvoorwaarden We bieden je een internationaal georiënteerde en afwisselende baan in een enthousiast team, met uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden …

items.desc: IS THIS YOU? Have you ever had an idea so exciting that you spent the weekend building it? Is your AI setup today different from the one you had three months ago? Does it bother you more when a user gets stuck than when a test fails? Then you know the feeling. Your tools keep getting better, your ideas keep getting bigger, and you want to see them in people’s hands. At Myner, you don’t wait for the next quarter - you ship it next week. ABOUT MYNER Endless room to build. Myner is building the world’s first global consumer omni-panel: a unified, always-on stream of what people buy, consume, watch and think. Under that one sentence sits a lot of engineering: We mine . The Myner app turns receipts and surveys into data, and scrapers pull in various external sources. We refine . Pipelines, data lakes and quality checks turn messy raw signal into data brands bet their budgets on. We craft . Our experimentation engine turns ideas into working products in days, and we hack on them side by side with big-brand executives. We improve the workshop . The AI-native harness and infrastructure we all build with, rebuilt as fast as the models move. Early on, you’ll touch all of it. Later, you go deep wherever it pulls you, and when that stops being fun, there’s always another seam to work. THE ROLE Build it with AI. Ship it. Own it. You join a small, senior team of product and engineering builders who use AI as the default, not the demo. You own features end to end — from the intent to production — wherever they live: the Myner app, the data pipelines or the agents brands work with. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Ship end-to-end features — UI, APIs, data pipelines and the agents that connect them. Build and harden the agentic workflows that turn panel data into Marketing Flywheels clients act on. Turn ambiguous client problems into working prototypes in days, then into production systems. Set the bar for how the team builds with AI — tooling, evals, review practices and speed. WHAT YOU BRING 4+ years of shipping production software, with real ownership of what you built. Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents and LLM APIs — and the shipped work to show for it. You’ve shipped production code in more than one language, and you pick up a new one easily. Product judgment and an eye for UX. You care how it feels to use, not just whether the code is clean. Clear written and spoken English. You blend in, make decisions and document with ease using English. BONUS POINTS Evals, RAG or multi-agent systems running in production. A background in data platforms, analytics or consumer research. Founding or early-stage startup experience. NOT A FIT Prefer deep tech and research over building with users. Coding manually rather than taking an AI-first approach Lack experience building systems that scale and stay secure. Value the steady rhythm of a large team over dynamic iteration Get frustrated when plans change and some work ends up unused. TEAMWORK Team is remote-first with weekly + as-needed meetings with optional monthly meet-ups in Budapest. Team is small by design to create maximum leverage with loads of AI harnesses that we're always improving. Focus is on delivery over hours. We care about what you ship, not when you work. HOW WE HIRE 4 steps. 3 hours. 2 weeks. Our process is crisp and concise, built to give you a clear answer fast. Informational Interview 30 MIN A direct conversation about the role, the team and what you're looking for. Bring your questions. Online Assessment 30 MIN A brief skill and personality assessment that helps us evaluate your fit and guides our next interview. Team Interview 90 MIN Work through real problems with the people you will build alongside. Founder Finale 30 MIN Meet the founder & CEO. Talk ambition, ownership, culture and Myner's future. Great candidates complete the entire process within 2 weeks of submitting their resume. READY TO FLY? Apply now. Compensation Range: €48K - €58.8K

items.desc: AWS Cloud Engineer | S3 | Data & AI Domain | Milton Keynes Country: United Kingdom IT STARTS HERE Santander ( www.santander.com ) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation , and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together , we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation , and the courage to challenge what’s possible. This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference . Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper . We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management. The Data & AI Domain at Santander is responsible for setting the strategic direction for data, analytics, and artificial intelligence across the organisation. It ensures that data is managed as a trusted enterprise asset and that advanced technologies are applied responsibly, securely, and effectively to create value for customers and the business. THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE The Data & AI Domain is looking for a AWS Cloud Engineer based out of Milton Keynes . In this role, you will be responsible for engineering, operating, and evolving the AWS data lake platform, including the cloud infrastructure, shared services, and data engineering applications that sit on top of it. You will work closely with data engineering, analytics, security, and architecture teams to ensure the platform is secure, resilient, cost‑effective, and scalable, enabling teams to deliver data products safely and efficiently. This is a hands‑on engineering role, focused on building and running cloud platforms rather than line management. The difference you’ll make: Support the engineering, operation, reliability and continuous improvement of Santander's AWS data lake. Build, configure and support AWS platform capabilities using services such as S3, IAM, VPC, KMS, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Glue, Athena, EMR, Lambda and Step Functions, following approved designs and standards. Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code for AWS environments and reusable platform components, with guidance from experienced engineers. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation that support safe, repeatable and controlled platform changes. Apply approved cloud security controls, including least-privilege access, encryption, network isolation, secrets management and policy enforcement. Provide operational support for Spark, batch and, where required, streaming workloads running on the platform. Support platform resilience through monitoring, alerting, incident response, problem investigation and maintenance of operational runbooks. Identify opportunities to improve performance, capacity and cloud cost, escalating recommendations through the appropriate engineering channels. Work with Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Architecture and Risk teams to deliver platform changes in line with Santander standards and regulatory expectations. We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for: Deliver assigned AWS data lake platform changes and operational activities to agreed quality, control and timescale expectations. Follow regulatory requirements, the Santander Operational Risk Framework and internal technology standards, raising risks or control gaps promptly. Configure and support secure multi-account AWS environments in line with approved architecture and engineering patterns. Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules and reusable components, contributing to consistent delivery across teams. Use CI/CD and release controls to promote infrastructure and platform changes safely across development, test and production. Monitor platform health, performance and cost, using observability tooling to identify issues, investigate causes and support improvement actions. Help identify and remediate technology obsolescence, platform risks, resilience gaps and operational control weaknesses, escalating complex issues when required. Work with Enterprise Architecture, Data Architecture, Security, Risk and Data Engineering to deliver changes aligned with approved architectures and standards. WHAT YOU’LL BRING Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring. The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Professional Experience AWS Platform Engineering: Proven experience engineering, operating, and evolving secure, resilient, and …

These tools range from CLI tools written in Bash to a medium-sized Ruby on Rails
items.desc: About Nutrient At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission-critical. Your Role at Nutrient… As an Internal Tools Engineer with a strong focus on backend development, you will work on our applications, which power a lot of internal and external needs of the company, from product builds and licensing workflows to revenue analysis and operational management across Engineering, Sales, Product, and Finance. These tools range from CLI tools written in Bash to a medium-sized Ruby on Rails application that provides our internal as well as customer-facing interface and connects to a variety of 3rd party systems, and serves AI agents via an MCP server. Our primary tech stack: Rails, Postgres, Terraform/AWS. We are looking for an excellent collaborator who can solve problems independently and hold themselves to their own high standards. You will report directly to the COO and work as part of a small internal tools team, partnering closely with Engineering, Security and our go-to-market teams. If this is you, we want to hear from you. What You’ll Work On… Build and extend our core internal platform, a Ruby on Rails application for customer and license management, including the customer-facing features and release automation built on top of it. Build and maintain reliable integrations between that platform and the business systems our teams depend on (CRM, support, project management and BI), so reporting and AI agents work from data people can trust. Design and run the MCP servers and APIs that give AI agents governed access to company data and workflows: tool design, authentication and permission scoping, rate limits, observability, and evals that catch regressions. Turn requests from Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product and Finance into working tools and automations, and help decide which ones are worth building. Own security and compliance for the systems you run: SOC 2 evidence, penetration-test findings, and dependency and vulnerability updates. Work as part of a small internal tools team: review each other’s code, share ownership of systems, and keep each other unblocked. Be a manager of one, spending your time on whatever is most valuable at the moment. What You’ll Bring... A background in software engineering with a proven track record of independently driving projects from inception to completion. Strong backend web development experience in a production framework (Ruby on Rails, Node, Python, Go or similar), plus shell scripting. Deep understanding of databases and SQL (PostgreSQL). Experience with managing and deploying backend services, including familiarity with containerization technologies and cloud platforms (Docker, Terraform, AWS). Hands-on experience building with LLMs in production: tool use and function calling, MCP, context engineering, and using evals and transcript review to find and fix real problems. Nice to have: Experience designing systems for AI agents as users: clear tool schemas and descriptions, OAuth-based authentication and data scoping, and observability for model and tool calls. API or integration work with Salesforce, Zendesk, Linear or similar business systems. Experience with SOC 2 or other security compliance work. Who Thrives Here… At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills. We’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are: Collaborators: You work openly, listen actively, and put team success first. Hungry Learners: Rapid learning fuels your progress and career growth. Curious Thinkers: You dig into the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right. Self-Starters: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities. Owners: You take responsibility for outcomes and always look for ways to improve what’s in your control. Doers: You focus on results, not activity, and want to know how your work moved the goal. Why You’ll Love Working Here… At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centered on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact. A small team, not a solo seat: you’ll have teammates to review your work and think through hard problems with. Your users are right next to you: the people who use what you build are our leadership team and colleagues in every function, so you see the impact of your work right away. Systems that matter: licensing, release builds, and a data platform that our reporting and AI agents depend on every day. Fully remote and async-first: minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and …

items.desc: Company NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Role Description You’ll join our forward deployment engineering team as a Test Automation / Integration Release Engineer, working directly inside customer projects to make sure the software we ship holds up where it matters: integrated into live customer environments, running on real platforms, under real operational conditions. You’ll own test automation, CI/CD quality gates, and the use of AI agents and copilots to scale test coverage and catch regressions fast. You don’t need to be a hardware or embedded specialist, but you should be comfortable enough with the edge/embedded side of the stack to understand how your tests interact with real hardware, spot when a failure is software versus hardware, and work credibly with the engineers who own that layer. Day-to-day Responsibilities Work embedded within a customer project as part of our forward deployment engineering team, owning software quality and test automation directly within that environment. Build and mature automated test suites and CI/CD quality gates to support rapid, reliable delivery cycles for software deployed to customer platforms. Use AI agents and copilots to scale QA coverage: generate test cases, automate triage, and accelerate regression testing. Work with hardware/embedded engineers to understand how software integrates with the underlying platform, enough to triage whether an issue is software or hardware, without needing to own the hardware layer yourself. Diagnose and help resolve integration and quality issues directly within the customer environment, closing the loop quickly between what’s seen in deployment and what gets fixed upstream. Take direct ownership of quality issues as they surface. Prioritise, investigate, and dive into solving problems directly rather than waiting for someone else to do it. Qualifications & Experience Solid experience in software QA/test engineering for complex systems, including test automation and CI/CD quality practices. Practical experience using agentic AI tools or copilots to generate tests, automate workflows, or otherwise improve testing efficiency. Basic working understanding of embedded, edge, or hardware-integrated systems — enough to reason about software/hardware interaction. Willingness and ability to work embedded within customer projects. A proactive “get-it-done” attitude with a preference for diving in and building clean solutions, often with limited direct support. Proficiency in Python with working knowledge of CI/CD and modern build infrastructure tooling. Strong communication skills, comfortable working directly with customer stakeholders as well as internal engineering teams. Why join NestAI At NestAI, you’ll build meaningful, real-world technology as part of a world-class team of engineers, scientists, and experienced professionals. You’ll work on systems where reliability genuinely matters, contribute to Europe’s security and resilience, and solve problems that demand depth, trust, and craftsmanship. If you want to build with purpose - and with leading experts in the field - you’ve come to the right place. What we offer We offer a growing set of practical benefits to support your work and wellbeing, day to day: Occupational healthcare (currently provided by Mehiläinen) Epassi Flex benefit (sports, culture, commuting, wellbeing) Lunch benefit (25% tax-free coverage) Regular team lunches and all-hands events Your choice of Mac or PC Holiday allowance (50% of holiday salary) Phone benefit according to company policy (subscription and device) We are continuously developing and expanding our benefits as we grow. Practicalities Employment is subject to applicable security screening (including SUPO, where required). NestAI is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants based on their skills, experience, and potential.

items.desc: A l’IRT Saint Exupéry nous réalisons des projets de Recherche en Technologie collaboratifs, principalement pour les secteurs aéronautique et spatial. Créé et cofinancé par l’Etat, notre mission est d’accélérer la recherche technologique française au profit de l’écosystème national, en créant un pont entre le monde académique et l’industrie. Ici, tu travailleras dans un environnement collaboratif avec des équipes issues du monde académique, industriel, du personnel détaché par de grands groupes, des chercheurs ou encore des doctorants. Notre force c’est le niveau d’expertise de nos collaborateurs et nos plateformes technologiques différenciantes : https://storage.net-fs.com/hosting/6834310/4/ Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Prend part à des projets de recherche innovants Vis ta passion pour la technologie : la liberté d’innover et l’esprit pionnier sont omniprésents à l’IRT. Développe-toi dans un environnement collaboratif intégré, multiculturel, stimulant et bienveillant. Quelques-uns de nos avantages : Un environnement éthique engagée: la prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux, sociaux, économiques et éthiques dans leurs activités via un Gender Equality Plan et une politique R.S.E. ambitieuse. Un CSE dynamique : clubs, activités, offre culturelle Tickets restaurants mutuelle et prévoyance La prise en charge des déplacements éco-responsables (75% de ton abonnement transports en commun) ainsi qu'une prime mobilité douce La possibilité de télétravailler jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine. Saches que l’IRT Saint Exupéry s’engage pour la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures à ce poste seront étudiées sans différence de traitement liée au sexe, à l’âge, à la nationalité ou tout autre critère discriminant. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Description du poste Missions : CDD 9 mois renouvelable Au sein de l’axe Technologies Numériques de l’IRT Saint Exupéry, vous contribuerez au développement de technologies innovantes de planification de mission et de prise de décision autonome pour des systèmes distribués de satellites et de drones (aériens, de surface et sous-marins), pour des applications civiles et de défense. Vous aurez la responsabilité d’élaborer des méthodes de planification de mission partiellement décentralisées, adaptées aux contraintes des systèmes embarqués, permettant à plusieurs plateformes de coordonner leurs actions et d’adapter dynamiquement leurs missions à l’évolution du contexte opérationnel, sous de fortes contraintes de ressources, de communication et de fiabilité. Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du processus de recherche et développement, depuis l’analyse des cas d’usage jusqu’à la conception, l’implémentation et l’évaluation des solutions algorithmiques, en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs et experts mis à disposition par les partenaires industriels du projet. Vos missions principales seront les suivantes : Analyser les cas d’usage industriels, formaliser les problèmes de planification associés et caractériser les objectifs de mission, les contraintes opérationnelles et les critères de performance, en coordination avec les experts des partenaires. Réaliser un état de l’art des approches algorithmiques existantes, notamment en optimisation et intelligence artificielle, et identifier les pistes les plus prometteuses au regard des besoins industriels. Adapter et développer les solutions algorithmiques retenues pour l’allocation et l’ordonnancement de tâches, la coopération entre plateformes et la replanification dynamique des missions, notamment face à l’apparition d’événements imprévus ou à l’évolution des priorités opérationnelles. Veiller à la robustesse et à l’efficacité des solutions développées, en tenant compte des contraintes des systèmes embarqués et distribués, notamment les ressources de calcul limitées, les communications intermittentes ou indisponibles, et la connaissance partielle de l’état du système. Contribuer à la constitution de scénarios et de jeux de données d’entrée représentatifs, puis réaliser des expérimentations, des campagnes d’évaluation et des analyses de performances afin de comparer les approches étudiées et de caractériser les solutions développées. Contribuer à la conception et à la réalisation de démonstrateurs technologiques intégrant les briques algorithmiques développées, en collaboration avec le reste de l’équipe projet. Assurer la valorisation des travaux réalisés au travers de livrables techniques, publications scientifiques, démonstrations et échanges avec les partenaires industriels et académiques. Participer à la définition des orientations scientifiques et techniques des projets et contribuer à la rédaction de propositions techniques pour de nouveaux programmes de recherche et prestations. Profil recherché Profil : Formation Bac+5 à Bac+8 (Ingénieur, Master ou Doctorat) en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, recherche opérationnelle, optimisation ou intelligence artificielle. items.desc: Job Description We are seeking a curious and technically sharp FinOps & Product Analytics Engineer to join our DevOps & Cloud Platform team. In this role, you will build the data foundation and AI-powered tooling that turns operational data into clear, actionable insight for engineering, product, and finance stakeholders across Intapp. We are starting with FinOps — cloud cost, cost allocation, anomaly detection, and usage visibility — but this role is designed to grow. As we expand into product usage analytics and additional data domains, you will help shape how we ingest, model, and surface that data through both AI-powered chat and dashboards. Subject matter experts guide the requirements; your job is to build the “how”: reliable data models, AI-powered reporting tools, and analytics layers that teams actually rely on. About Intapp: Intapp, based in Silicon Valley, is a leader in Vertical AI SaaS company, collaborating with over 2,550 professional and financial services firms globally. With 20+ years of industry expertise, Intapp's "Intelligence Applied" approach is transforming how businesses operate and leverages a strategic partner with Microsoft in delivering industry cloud solutions. The company culture promotes accountability, responsibility, and growth in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment. Since going public in 2021, Intapp has expanded to over 1,600 employees globally with development centers in Palo Alto, Charlotte, Belfast, Berlin, and Lisbon. What You Will Do: Design and maintain analytical data models — schemas, views, and aggregations — that correctly represent FinOps data including cloud cost, cost allocation, anomaly signals, infrastructure usage, and unit economics, with additional domains to follow. Build ingestion and normalization pipelines that clean and unify data from heterogeneous sources — AWS and Azure billing, SaaS platforms, product telemetry, and internal systems — into a consistent, queryable analytical layer. Develop AI-powered reporting skills in Python using MCP (Model Context Protocol) that return structured, reliable answers to stakeholder questions — covering cost anomalies, team-level spend breakdowns, usage trends, and more as new domains come online. Implement prompt engineering and output validation layers that make AI-generated answers trustworthy — handling empty results, ambiguous time ranges, and conflicting data gracefully. Build and maintain dashboards in Metabase covering FinOps metrics (showback, chargeback, anomaly signals, unit costs) and expanding to additional domains as the platform grows. Collaborate with FinOps experts, product managers, and other domain leads to translate requirements into accurate data models and query patterns that reflect how the underlying data actually behaves. Help evaluate and contribute to architecture decisions as new data domains and source systems are brought into the platform. Document data models, AI skill patterns, and pipeline logic so the broader team can understand, extend, and trust what you build. Continuously improve data quality, query performance, and AI output reliability as the platform scales in volume, variety, and scope. What You Will Need: Strong SQL skills — complex aggregations, window functions, joins across large datasets, and the instinct to investigate when a number looks wrong before shipping. Python proficiency — clean, maintainable scripts for data transformation, normalization, and tooling (not just notebooks). Experience with analytical or columnar databases — such as ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redshift, DuckDB, or similar. Demonstrated experience building with an LLM API (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) — you understand tool use, structured outputs, and what it takes to make AI responses consistent and reliable. Ability to work from well-defined requirements: translating a subject matter expert’s question into a data model and query that accurately answers it. Comfort in a greenfield environment — able to make sound architectural decisions when patterns are still being established. Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar function-calling / tool-use patterns for LLMs (preferred). What you will gain at Intapp: Our culture at Intapp emphasizes accountability, responsibility, and growth. We support each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, approachability, and teamwork. We’re committed to creating a modern work environment that’s connected yet flexible, supporting both professional success and work-life balance. In return for your passion, commitment, and collaborative approach, we offer: Attractive compensation – including competitive base pay and performance-based variable pay. Equity/Stock in Intapp.Opportunity to travel to other development centers for product training and cross-site collaboration. One-time home office stipend. Generous paid parental leave (including adoptive leave), marriage leave, bereavement leave, carer's leave, and paid …

items.desc: Want to know how a leading workplace experience and facility management company is powered by technology? At ISS Tech Team, we create smarter workplace experiences through technology. Our Global Technology Solutions team builds digital solutions, from sensors and IoT devices to data, analytics and AI-driven capabilities, that support our ISS A/S operations across Cleaning, Workplace, Food and Technical Services. With tech hubs in Copenhagen, Warsaw, and Porto, and teams collaborating across more than 30 countries, our ISS Tech team develops our digital solutions that have a real impact on both our customers and our people. Location: Porto, Portugal Work regime: Hybrid The Job Role as Senior Software Engineer (PHP): We build the platform people use to order and pay for food and services at work. It sounds simple. It is not. Behind it are three apps, a PHP backend that moves real money in real time, native integrations with payment terminals, printers, scales and scanners, and a long list of payment, identity and workplace systems that all have to agree with each other. Every receipt has to be right, in every country, under every local fiscal rule. And it runs in production for some of the largest organisations in the world, so when you ship something, people use it the same day. As a Full Stack Developer you will build and maintain features across the apps, the PHP backend and the integrations, working from specs and shipping tested code that goes straight to real users. You will go deep on payments, authentication, device integration and multi-country configuration, with senior engineers around you who review carefully and want you to grow. If you have started building with AI and specs and want to get properly good at it, this is a good place to do that. What you’ll do: Start from the spec. We write down what we are building before we build it, and you will help turn product ideas into clear specs and acceptance criteria that product, QA and your AI tools can all work from. Build with AI as a normal part of your day. Coding assistants and agents help us move faster on implementation, tests, refactoring and docs, and you own the result as if you had typed every line yourself. Help us get better at this. Context files, prompt and spec libraries, automated reviews, the guardrails that keep us fast without getting sloppy. We are figuring it out together and your ideas count. Keep the fundamentals strong. AI does not replace good engineering, it amplifies it. Clean code, design patterns, domain-driven design, SOLID, sensible boundaries and tests you can trust are what make the AI output worth shipping. Work on our Angular and Ionic apps (TypeScript, RxJS, SCSS). Three apps, shared libraries, per-customer configuration, theming, and the local and fiscal rules of every country we run in. Make the apps talk to real hardware: barcode scanners, NFC, card readers, printers, scales and POS peripherals through Capacitor and native plugins, and ship them with Android Studio and Xcode. Build on our PHP backend: Slim, PHP-DI, JWT middleware, mPDF, the Google API client, and the endpoints behind authentication, payments, printing and push notifications. Shape the data model in MySQL/MariaDB, write the SQL, and ship schema changes and migrations without anyone noticing. Join design discussions, document what you build, and take part in code reviews on both sides. Key qualifications: Must have : A degree in Computer Science or similar, or the experience that makes it irrelevant. 3+ years building software professionally, with real production experience in Angular and TypeScript. You use AI coding assistants and agents in your actual work, and you review, test and own what they produce. You have worked from specs, acceptance criteria or API contracts and kept the code aligned with them. Solid foundations in clean code, design patterns and object-oriented design, and an interest in domain-driven design and good architecture. The tools change, the fundamentals do not. Hands-on PHP and experience building or consuming REST APIs. Working knowledge of JWT, OAuth2/OIDC and SSO. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD and automated testing. English proficiency, both written and spoken. Nice have : Ionic, Capacitor or Cordova, and any experience with native plugins or hardware (barcode, NFC, printers, card readers, POS). Payment provider or terminal integrations (Adyen, PineLabs, NETS or similar) and async notification handling. Slim, PHP-DI, JWT middleware, mPDF or the Google API client. Firebase Cloud Messaging, SCIM or enterprise identity providers. Multi-tenant or white-label apps, runtime configuration, theming, internationalisation. Jasmine/Karma, Cypress, ESLint, or Java API test automation. Curiosity about agentic development workflows and LLM features in products. Personal skills: You are curious, you like learning, and feedback from reviews and pairing makes you better rather than defensive. You communicate clearly and work well with …

items.title: 2026_156_POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER
items.card: JOB DESCRIPTION The Endocrinology and Nutrition Unit group is seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Endocrinology and Nutrition Unit at the Germans Trias i Pujol Research Institute (IGTP) to work for Dr. Elena Valassi. The position will focus on translational research in metabolism and neuroendocrinology, investigating the molecular mechanisms of myopathy in acromegaly and Cushing’s
items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION The Endocrinology and Nutrition Unit group is seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Endocrinology and Nutrition Unit at the Germans Trias i Pujol Research Institute (IGTP) to work for Dr. Elena Valassi. The position will focus on translational research in metabolism and neuroendocrinology, investigating the molecular mechanisms of myopathy in acromegaly and Cushing’s syndrome, and disease progression in Cushing’s disease, with a major focus on personalized medicine. The successful candidate will participate in multidisciplinary research combining experimental molecular biology, functional studies and computational approaches. The research will involve both laboratory-based experimental work (wet lab) and the integration and analysis of multi-omics and clinical datasets (dry-lab), with the ultimate goal of identifying novel biomarkers and advancing precision medicine in neuroendocrinology. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES The selected candidate will contribute to the development and coordination of translational research projects in neuroendocrinology and metabolism, with responsibilities including: Experimental research and wet-lab activities: Design and perform experimental studies using human tumour samples and cellular models to investigate the molecular mechanisms disease progression and treatment response. Perform molecular biology techniques, including DNA/RNA extraction, gene expression analysis, PCR-based assays and epigenetic characterisation. Develop and conduct in vitro functional experiments, including cell culture, hormonal stimulation and molecular analysis of cellular responses. Coordinate sample processing, experimental workflows and molecular characterisation of biological specimens. Contribute to the development and optimisation of new experimental approaches and molecular assays. Multi-omics and computational research: Analyse and integrate multi-omics datasets, including transcriptomics, DNA methylation, genomic and spatial transcriptomics data. Identify molecular signatures and candidate biomarkers associated with tumour behaviour, disease progression and therapeutic response. Apply bioinformatics, statistical and machine learning approaches to develop predictive models and support precision medicine strategies. Integrate molecular findings with clinical and phenotypic information from well-characterised patient cohorts. Scientific coordination and dissemination Coordinate and contribute to national and international research projects and collaborative networks. Participate in the preparation of research proposals, grant applications and scientific reports. Prepare manuscripts for publication in international peer-reviewed journals and present research findings at national and international conferences. Supervise and mentor students and junior researchers involved in the research projects. Establish collaborations with clinical departments, research groups and national and international institutions. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE a) Required level of education: PhD in Medicine b) Languages: Good command of English, Catalan and Spanish (written and spoken). c) Specific knowledge: Strong background in molecular biology and translational biomedical research. Knowledge of experimental techniques in molecular and cellular biology. Experience with molecular characterisation of human tissue samples. Knowledge of gene expression analysis, epigenetics and molecular mechanisms of disease. Familiarity with omics technologies, including transcriptomics, genomics and/or DNA methylation analysis. Advanced bioinformatics and statistical analysis skills. d) Personal skills: Scientific independence, critical thinking and problem-solving abilities. Ability to design, coordinate and execute experimental research projects. Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple research activities. Excellent teamwork and communication skills. Scientific writing skills and ability to disseminate research findings. Proactive attitude and motivation to develop new research lines. e) Required experience: At least 5 years of previous postdoctoral or equivalent research experience in endocrinology. Demonstrated experience in experimental molecular biology and laboratory-based research. Experience in programming and managing clinical databases (RedCap). Proven scientific productivity, including publications in peer-reviewed international journals. Proven experience in conducting clinical trials in personalized medicine in the field of endocrinology f) Valuable: Involvement in the Spanish Society of Endocrinology and Nutrition (SEEN). Experience with primary human tissue samples, biobanks and clinical cohorts. Experience in cell culture and functional in vitro studies, including hormonal stimulation and molecular characterisation of cellular responses. Experience in epigenetic regulation and DNA methylation profiling. Experience in next-generation sequencing (NGS), RNA sequencing …

items.desc: We’re looking for a Product Owner – AI & Test Engineering to join our SW Platform organization. We’re responsible for the machine platform that Epiroc’s mining and construction equipment runs on. In this role, AI is at the heart of what you do. You’ll help shape how software developers across all of Epiroc use AI in their daily work, and how AI changes the way we test and verify our software. Are you curious about how AI is changing software development? Do you enjoy collaborating with people across teams and helping turn needs into clear priorities? Would you like to help build something new from the start, with an impact across the whole company? Then we’d love to hear from you. A stream in the making AI & Test Engineering is a new product stream in our platform organisation. The teams are being built right now, and their setup, size and exact scope aren’t finalised yet. As Product Owner, you’ll have a real opportunity to influence how the stream takes shape, together with the teams, your manager and the Chief Product Owner. Your mission As Product Owner you’re responsible for the AI & Test Engineering product stream, where AI is the main focus. The stream is planned to cover two areas: AI Software Factory: exploring and introducing AI-supported, agentic ways of working across the software development lifecycle, for all software developers at Epiroc. AI-driven Test & Integration: using AI to rethink how we test and integrate platform software, together with test frameworks, simulation, a software-defined lab and system testing. You connect the teams with their stakeholders. For the AI Software Factory, these are software developers and development teams across Epiroc’s divisions and sites. For Test & Integration, they are mainly the internal teams that develop and deliver on the platform. You’re responsible for the product backlog in Jira and the roadmap. By listening to stakeholders and understanding their needs, you help translate them into clear epics and user stories and support the teams in focusing on what creates the most value. You keep up with how AI in software development is evolving and help turn new possibilities into practical value for developers and testers. You work closely with the Scrum Masters and Tech Leads, collaborate with our architects and work closely with the Chief Product Owner on the overall platform roadmap. You also take part in cross-team planning together with the other product streams. You’ll report to a team manager in the SW Platform organization and be part of a supportive team where knowledge sharing and learning are encouraged. Your profile You have experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role, for example product manager, test lead, technical project lead or requirements owner, in a software development environment. You have a genuine interest in AI and how it can support software development and testing, and you may already use AI tools in your own work. You’re familiar with agile ways of working such as Scrum and with tools like Jira. You enjoy working with a broad range of stakeholders and helping new ways of working spread across an organization. It’s a plus if you have experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development, AI in testing, test automation, CI/CD or simulation. You speak Swedish and you’re fluent in English, both written and spoken. As a person, you’re curious, structured, communicative and collaborative. You’re comfortable when not everything is decided yet, and you enjoy helping to create structure together with others. You build trusting relationships with stakeholders, help the teams find focus and like to keep learning. We know that great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this role sounds interesting, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds and believe diverse teams build better products. Location The role is based in Örebro, Sweden. We work hybrid, with at least three days a week in the office. Application and contacts Please send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 27th of November. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media. For questions about the position please contact recruiting manager: Adam Eneqvist, adam.eneqvist@epiroc.com For questions about the process, please contact: Recruitment specialist Dana Galova, dana.galova@epiroc.com Life at Epiroc By joining our team, you can expect an atmosphere of creativity, innovation, and workplace diversity. You will be a part of a group of skilled and helpful colleagues who live by our core values: Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation. We work in a global environment with over …

items.desc: Vill du vara med och bygga och förvalta en av Sveriges mest verksamhetskritiska försäkringsplattformar? Vi söker nu en System Engineer till vårt Infrastrukturteam. Hos oss får du arbeta med modern teknik, avancerade plattformar och affärskritiska system där kvalitet, säkerhet och stabilitet står i fokus. Följ med oss på vår digitala och agila förändringsresa in i framtiden där du får vara med och göra skillnad! Det här gör du som System Engineer på Folksam Som System Engineer hos oss kommer du att: Utveckla, förvalta och vidareutveckla vår tekniska plattform och infrastruktur. Arbeta med automatisering, CI/CD, monitorering och tekniska förbättringsinitiativ. Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, säkerhet och driftsstabilitet i våra miljöer. Arbeta med databasplattformar och bidra till prestandaoptimering, felsökning och förvaltning av affärskritiska databaser. Delta i incident-, problem- och förändringshantering samt driva långsiktiga förbättringar. Utforska och implementera AI- och agentic AI-lösningar för att automatisera operativa processer, effektivisera felsökning och stärka den tekniska förvaltningen. Bidra till utvecklingen av intelligenta och självstyrande arbetsflöden där AI används för analys, beslutsstöd och automatisering inom drift och plattformsförvaltning. Samarbeta nära utvecklingsteam, leverantör och andra tekniska specialister för att skapa robusta och hållbara lösningar. Bidra till tekniska vägval och arkitekturella beslut som får betydelse för hela verksamheten. Vi arbetar bland annat med: Microsoft Azure Red Hat OpenShift GitLab Terraform, Helm och ArgoCD HashiCorp Vault JFrog Artifactory och Xray Elastic (ELK) för monitorering och logghantering Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Server Management Studio och Powershell Du får möjlighet att arbeta i en tekniknära roll där både djup teknisk kompetens och förmåga att se helheten värdesätts. Teamet ansvarar för den tekniska plattformen bakom Folksams sakförsäkringssystem och spelar en central roll i vår fortsatta digitalisering och modernisering. Du blir en viktig del av ett kompetent team med stort ansvar och goda möjligheter att påverka både lösningar och arbetssätt. Nyfiken på att läsa mer vad vår IT-avdelning jobbar med? Gå in och läs här! Är du den vi söker? Nu söker vi dig som: Har flerårig erfarenhet av drift, förvaltning eller utveckling av tekniska plattformar. Har god kunskap inom Microsoft SQL Server och databashantering. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av: Microsoft SQL Server, databasadministration och prestandaoptimering. Automatisering, skriptning och infrastrukturell utveckling. Kubernetes, OpenShift eller andra moderna plattformar. CI/CD och DevOps-arbetssätt. Versionshanterad infrastruktur och Infrastructure as Code. Monitorerings- och logghanteringsplattformar. Säkerhetsarbete i reglerade verksamheter. Agila arbetssätt och tvärfunktionella team. Som person trivs du med att analysera, felsöka och lösa komplexa tekniska problem. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och tar ansvar för att driva uppgifter i mål. Du ser lärande och kompetensutveckling som en naturlig del av arbetet. Vi jobbar teambaserat så vi ser att du tycker om att samarbeta med andra och är kommunikativ. Här kan du göra skillnad Välkommen till Folksam – här driver du viktiga frågor framåt. Från de avgörande detaljerna till de stora perspektiven, med fokus på att förenkla våra kunders vardag. Det gör att du bidrar till något större, oavsett roll. Här finns det många roliga, utvecklande jobb och du har goda chanser till en spännande karriär. Vi tror på ett hållbart arbetsliv och jobbar aktivt med inkludering och mångfald. Våra moderna kontor bjuder in till samarbete och lärande, här får vi saker att hända! Du har flexibiliteten att kunna varva arbete på kontoret med att jobba hemifrån, utifrån verksamhetens behov. Läs mer om livet på Folksam på folksam.se/jobb-och-karriar. Så söker du jobbet Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan redan idag, dock senast 27 november 2026. Vill du veta mer om jobbet är du välkommen att kontakta gruppchef Mattias Sahlström, 070-831 63 26. Här kan du läsa mer om vilka bakgrundskontroller som kan vara aktuella i den här rekryteringen. Fackliga representanter: Akademikerföreningen Per Hansson 070-831 60 67 Forena Per Karlsson 072-230 20 91 och Handels Mikael Carlsson 070-831 51 32 Kundägda Folksamgruppen erbjuder sedan 1908 försäkringar och sparande som ger trygghet i livets alla skeden. items.desc: About Nutrient At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission-critical. Your Role at Nutrient… As an Internal Tools Engineer with a strong focus on backend development, you will work on our applications, which power a lot of internal and external needs of the company, from product builds and licensing workflows to revenue analysis and operational management across Engineering, Sales, Product, and Finance. These tools range from CLI tools written in Bash to a medium-sized Ruby on Rails application that provides our internal as well as customer-facing interface and connects to a variety of 3rd party systems, and serves AI agents via an MCP server. Our primary tech stack: Rails, Postgres, Terraform/AWS. We are looking for an excellent collaborator who can solve problems independently and hold themselves to their own high standards. You will report directly to the COO and work as part of a small internal tools team, partnering closely with Engineering, Security and our go-to-market teams. If this is you, we want to hear from you. What You’ll Work On… Build and extend our core internal platform, a Ruby on Rails application for customer and license management, including the customer-facing features and release automation built on top of it. Build and maintain reliable integrations between that platform and the business systems our teams depend on (CRM, support, project management and BI), so reporting and AI agents work from data people can trust. Design and run the MCP servers and APIs that give AI agents governed access to company data and workflows: tool design, authentication and permission scoping, rate limits, observability, and evals that catch regressions. Turn requests from Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product and Finance into working tools and automations, and help decide which ones are worth building. Own security and compliance for the systems you run: SOC 2 evidence, penetration-test findings, and dependency and vulnerability updates. Work as part of a small internal tools team: review each other’s code, share ownership of systems, and keep each other unblocked. Be a manager of one, spending your time on whatever is most valuable at the moment. What You’ll Bring... A background in software engineering with a proven track record of independently driving projects from inception to completion. Strong backend web development experience in a production framework (Ruby on Rails, Node, Python, Go or similar), plus shell scripting. Deep understanding of databases and SQL (PostgreSQL). Experience with managing and deploying backend services, including familiarity with containerization technologies and cloud platforms (Docker, Terraform, AWS). Hands-on experience building with LLMs in production: tool use and function calling, MCP, context engineering, and using evals and transcript review to find and fix real problems. Nice to have: Experience designing systems for AI agents as users: clear tool schemas and descriptions, OAuth-based authentication and data scoping, and observability for model and tool calls. API or integration work with Salesforce, Zendesk, Linear or similar business systems. Experience with SOC 2 or other security compliance work. Who Thrives Here… At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills. We’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are: Collaborators: You work openly, listen actively, and put team success first. Hungry Learners: Rapid learning fuels your progress and career growth. Curious Thinkers: You dig into the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right. Self-Starters: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities. Owners: You take responsibility for outcomes and always look for ways to improve what’s in your control. Doers: You focus on results, not activity, and want to know how your work moved the goal. Why You’ll Love Working Here… At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centered on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact. A small team, not a solo seat: you’ll have teammates to review your work and think through hard problems with. Your users are right next to you: the people who use what you build are our leadership team and colleagues in every function, so you see the impact of your work right away. Systems that matter: licensing, release builds, and a data platform that our reporting and AI agents depend on every day. Fully remote and async-first: minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and …

items.desc: About WPP Production We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. About WPP WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com. A Hybrid working model We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. What does a Creative Activation Specialist do at WPP Production? The Creative Activation Specialist helps Jaguar Land Rover's central campaign ideas work harder in markets, media placements and cultural contexts around the world. Working within a specialist team alongside a designer and writer, the role expands central assets into locally relevant, channel-effective creative while retaining the integrity and consistency of the global campaign. This is a strategically curious and hands-on role. The Creative Activation Specialist considers the audience, media environment, time of year, local zeitgeist and value of each placement before recommending how the creative should respond. The work can range from shaping a 15-second film into an effective 10-second edit to reimagining campaign assets for an airport takeover or other distinctive media opportunity. The role combines fast creative thinking with practical making. It requires someone who can work directly in source files, collaborate across global and local teams, and remain obsessed with effectiveness by asking how the work performed and applying those learnings to future activation. Key Responsibilities Expand central JLR campaign assets into effective market and channel executions while protecting the original idea, brand consistency and Modern Luxury standards. Develop creative recommendations informed by the audience, media placement, local culture, seasonality, market context and campaign objective, ensuring activation is more than resizing or mechanical versioning. Work as part of a three-person activation team with a designer and writer, collaborating closely to shape coherent visual, verbal and channel-specific solutions. Create and adapt source files, layouts, storyboards and motion or film executions, including duration changes and reframing that preserve meaning, pace and impact. Respond creatively to high-value and non-standard media opportunities, including premium large-format out-of-home and airport takeovers, making the best possible use of scale, environment, dwell time and viewing behaviour. Partner with the Creative Craft Lead, central creative teams, media partners and local-market stakeholders to understand briefs, challenge assumptions and find practical solutions at pace. Use available performance data and market feedback to understand how activation work performed, identifycreative learnings and improve future recommendations. Contribute proactive ideas across a diverse global pipeline, balancing multiple markets and deadlines while maintaining craft, accuracy and attention to detail. Requirements A strong emerging creative portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking, hands-on making and the ability to extend campaign ideas across different media and formats. Experience adapting integrated campaign assets for digital, social, film, out-of-home and other channel requirements without losing the central creative idea. An audience-aware and culturally curious mindset, with the ability to consider local context, seasonality, behaviourand media environment when developing recommendations. Confidence working directly with source files and common creative software, making thoughtful amendments to layouts, imagery, copy and motion assets with strong attention to detail. A genuine interest in creative effectiveness, measurement and optimisation, with the curiosity to ask how work performed and translate evidence into better future activation. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work constructively with designers, writers, creative leaders, producers, media teams and market stakeholders across cultures and time zones. The ability to …
