items.desc: Job Description Who we are ADC is a Boutique Data and AI consultancy with offices in the Netherlands, Sweden, and Denmark, and an award-winning data design studio (CLEVER°FRANKE) embedded in the group. We help organisations turn data and AI into real impact, leading a mission to accelerate the responsible use of Data and AI. We bring the full data value chain under one roof: from strategy and engineering to analytics, data science, and design . This way, we turn complex data into clear roadmaps, scalable foundations, AI-powered tools, and experiences people actually enjoy using. Data & AI Engineering opportunities Are you interested in applying your Data and/or AI engineering expertise to real business challenges? We are always looking for talented professionals to join our teams and drive things forward. How This Connects To Our Current Work Our teams are actively working across the following areas: Data engineering: designing, building and maintaining scalable data pipelines that turn complex, high-volume datasets into reliable, production-ready foundations for analytics, models and AI. Generative AI and agentic systems: developing custom AI systems such as agentic workflows, RAG-based systems and domain-specific AI assistants. MLOps and model monitoring: building end-to-end AI pipelines and monitoring frameworks that keep models performing at their best, managing drift and retraining needs. Data and AI in regulated environments: building solutions where data quality, traceability and reproducibility are essential, helping clients upgrade their data infrastructure and stay audit-ready. Credit risk analytics: supporting model development and validation for frameworks such as IRB and IFRS 9, and connecting regulatory risk models to strategic business outcomes. We build these solutions with technologies such as Python and Docker, on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. What You Bring At ADC, we’re not just consultants: we’re leading experts in Data & AI, using our expertise in AI, Data, Cloud Engineering and Financial Risk Management. What unites us is a shared way of working: breaking down complex challenges to change how organisations operate. We don’t expect you to have everything on this list. What matters is where you can add value now and where you want to grow. Experience in data engineering, AI engineering or data science, ideally gained in consulting or project-based work A quantitative academic background, such as AI, Econometrics, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Quantitative Finance or a related field Hands-on experience with Python and one or more cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) A strong grasp of the modern GenAI landscape (LLMs, RAG, embeddings and vector search, tool/function calling, agentic patterns, and protocols like MCP) and the judgment to know when to apply each Experience or interest in financial services, and its regulatory context The ability to communicate with anyone in the room, breaking down complex ideas for technical and non-technical audiences A proactive and entrepreneurial mindset: you’re eager to solve problems, innovate and drive change A collaborative spirit: you believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives and supporting each other to raise the bar Fluency in English and Dutch, both written and spoken We welcome applications from all seniority levels, from junior professionals to experienced specialists and senior consultants. What’s In It For You At ADC, you’re part of the collective from day one. We want you to grow, experiment, and shape your own path while working on projects that matter. That means: Impact you can point to: You’ll see your work in action and our projects change how organisations make decisions Real responsibility, real support: You’ll work alongside experienced experts from the start, learning by doing with mentorship and feedback built in The freedom to try new things: Spot a better way to build something? A smarter process? We want people who challenge the status quo Collective Week: Once a year, we go on a workation with the whole ADC team. We work on pro bono projects, explore new ideas, and make the kind of memories you’ll want to talk about Ownership opportunities: We offer a competitive salary and bonus structure, plus the opportunity to invest in the company and become a co-owner once specific conditions are met. We mean it when we say collective A vibrant culture: Daily lunches, Friday drinks, sports, social events: a culture you’ll notice from day one What To Do Next If you believe in building with heart, thrive on collaboration, and want to grow with a team that challenges and supports you, we want to meet you! items.desc: Le département Transformation, Data et IA de l’Inspection Générale du groupe Crédit Agricole porte la stratégie Data et IA de la Ligne Métier Audit Inspection, qui rassemble 1 400 collaborateurs en France et à l’international. Vous explorerez des solutions capables de rechercher, croiser et restituer efficacement des informations issues de sources internes et externes. Vous serez amené à : concevoir des systèmes de recherche et de génération augmentée, performants et économes en ressources étendre ces dispositifs à des contenus multimodaux, en privilégiant des architectures frugales évaluer l’intérêt du fine-tuning de grands modèles de langage pour répondre à des besoins d’audit spécifiques comparer différentes approches afin d’identifier les meilleurs compromis entre précision, performance et consommation de ressources Vous étudierez la manière dont des systèmes autonomes ou semi-autonomes peuvent accompagner les équipes dans la réalisation de leurs travaux. Vos expérimentations couvriront notamment : la conception d’agents intelligents spécialisés dans l’automatisation de tâches d’audit l’exploration d’architectures multi-agents adaptées à des processus complexes le développement d’agents conversationnels maîtrisant les contextes et usages propres aux métiers de l’inspection l’évaluation de leur pertinence sur des cas d’usage concrets Vous participerez à l’identification des technologies susceptibles de faire évoluer durablement les méthodes d’audit. LangChain, Chain-of-thought. Gracias a su enfoque internacional, TECH tiene presencia en más de 150 países y ha sido reconocida en dos ocasiones por el Financial Times como una de las 250 compañías con mayor crecimiento en Europa en los últimos años. Esto le ha permitido ser distinguida por la revista Forbes como ‘la mejor universidad digital del mundo‘ y convertirse en la universidad oficial de la NBA, ofreciendo programas exclusivos impartidos por destacados directivos, entrenadores y exjugadores de la principal liga de baloncesto del mundo. Además, cuenta con un claustro docente ivy league, al nivel de Harvard o Stanford. Sus más de 6.000 profesores trabajan en las mejores compañías, organizaciones e instituciones del mundo. Las mayores multinacionales (Amazon, Apple, Google, Nike…), los mejores hospitales (Clínica Mayo, MD. Anderson…) o las mejores instituciones deportivas (Boston Celtics, Dallas Cowboys…) prestan a sus mejores profesionales para dirigir los programas académicos de TECH. items.desc: Job Description Context CLIENT (Brussels public transport operator) is building several employee- and customer-facing AI services, serving our customers and employees across the organization. These range from retrieval-based assistants to AI agents that call tools and business systems on behalf of users. The AI services are built and run on our CLIENT AI Platform . The first services go live from December 2026, and more will follow in 2027. Your role We are recruiting a Medior AI Engineer to join the AI Center of Excellence (Digital Innovatin & AI - delivery team) and own the Run phase of our AI services in production. You take over each service from the Senior AI Engineers who built it, and you keep it reliable, measured, secure and cost-efficient over time. You will work alongside CLIENT’s internal AI Platform Architect , two Senior AI Engineers (Build) , the business and content owners of each service, and CLIENT’s IT operations teams. The AI Platform runs on a hybrid operating model: managed Azure services ( Microsoft Foundry with the OpenAI model family for LLM and embeddings, Azure AI Search , Azure API Management , Azure AI Content Safety ) combined with self-hosted open-source components on AKS (agent orchestration in Python with LangChain , ingestion pipeline), with MLflow on Databricks for evaluation and tracing ( OpenTelemetry ). The Digital Innovation / AI CoE team owns Infrastructure-as-Code for all application-scoped Azure resources, using Terraform and Azure DevOps pipelines. What you will deliver Activities will vary from service to service. Typically you will: operate the AI services in production: monitor availability, latency and errors, handle incidents and service requests, analyse root causes, then fix or escalate ; keep answer quality under control: run and maintain evaluation sets (golden sets) with business content owners, track answer quality, non-answer rate and user feedback, and detect and investigate quality regressions ; operate the ingestion pipelines: incremental refresh, failed documents, index health, and onboarding of new content sources or business domains within existing connectors ; operate agent integrations: monitor tool and integration calls to business systems, handle failures and timeouts, and review action logs and exceptions for agents that act on users’ behalf ; manage change safely: model version upgrades and retirements, prompt and configuration changes, dependency and security updates, each validated against the evaluation sets before release ; follow run cost: token consumption and cost per service, alerting on drift and proposing optimisations ; maintain the Terraform , Helm and Azure DevOps artefacts, and keep the DEV , TST , ACC and PROD environments consistent ; apply data protection rules: trace retention, erasure and access restrictions, as defined in each service’s data protection impact assessment ; maintain runbooks and documentation, and report service health to service owners and the AI CoE on a regular basis ; deliver small enhancements and fixes; structural changes and new features stay with the Build team.

items.desc: The Synthetic Data Research team is building Ipsos’ next-generation platform for synthetic data and generative AI, turning cutting-edge methods into practical tools that can be used safely and confidently across the business. We focus on two core products: Data Augmentation Workbench: a self-serve internal platform that enables teams to train models and generate synthetic data through secure APIs and streamlined workflows, with evaluation and governance built in from day one. Digital Twins: agentic, respondent-grounded LLM “synthetic panellists” designed to simulate behaviours and survey responses, supported by rigorous validation, privacy safeguards, and strong auditability. Our work sits at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, privacy, and market research methodology . We collaborate with leading academic institutions (including Stanford University ) to ensure our approach is scientifically robust while remaining focused on real-world impact. Ultimately, our goal is to deliver data collection efficiencies, new product innovation, and defensible scientific frameworks that can scale to thousands of colleagues and clients. We’re a cross-disciplinary group, bringing together market researchers, mathematicians, computer scientists, data scientists, and data engineers, to build capabilities that shape how insights are created in the future. How you’ll make an impact: You’ll turn research-grade prototypes into a dependable, governed ML service on GCP . Your work will define how quickly we can iterate on synthetic generation approaches without sacrificing reproducibility, security, or methodological rigor. In practice, you will: Enable Reliable AI: Your pipelines will provide the clean, structured data required to train our core generative models. By ensuring data availability and reliability, you directly support the accuracy and fairness of our machine learning outputs. Power LLM Applications: By building robust vector indexing and retrieval (RAG) infrastructure, you will provide our LLM-based synthetic personas with the context and grounding they need to operate effectively and hallucinate less. items.desc: Über YLAB Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden. Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene. Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten. Warum YLAB Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard. Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt. Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt. Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch. Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden. Was wir bieten Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht. Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst. Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt. Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln. Über die Rolle Onoo hört zu, denkt mit und antwortet kindgerecht. Dahinter stecken Spracherkennung, ein kuratierter Wissensraum und eine mehrstufige Safety-Pipeline. Der Prototyp funktioniert, der Launch ist 2027. Jetzt bauen wir die Pipeline, die Millionen Kinderfragen aushält. Du bist unsere erste dedizierte AI/ML-Stelle, mit Platz am Gründertisch. Du arbeitest direkt mit Lennard (CEO, Product & AI) und entscheidest mit, wie unser Stack aussieht. Vom Modell-Routing bis zum Latenzbudget auf dem Gerät. Was dich erwartet: echte Edge-Cases wie Kinderstimmen, Dialekte und Quatschfragen, dazu harte Grenzen bei Latenz, Kosten und Datenschutz. Und die Verantwortung, dass jede Antwort sicher ist, bevor sie ein Kind erreicht. Wie du uns helfen kannst Du baust und betreibst unsere Sprach-Pipeline: Spracherkennung für Kinderstimmen, Dialogführung, Sprachausgabe. Schnell genug fürs Wohnzimmer. Du orchestrierst Sprachmodelle provider-agnostisch: Routing, Prompting, Evals, Kostenkontrolle. Du entwickelst unsere Safety-Layer weiter: Klassifikatoren, Guardrails, mehrstufige Prüfungen vor jeder Antwort. Du baust Evaluations-Sets aus echten Kinderfragen und misst, was „gut erklärt“ heißt. Du bringst Modelle in Produktion: EU-Hosting, Monitoring, Fallbacks, saubere Degradation. Du arbeitest eng mit Research und Pädagogik, damit Erkenntnisse im Produkt landen. Du hältst unseren Stack einfach. Lieber ein robuster Pfad als fünf halbe. Melde dich, wenn: Du hast 3+ Jahre ML/AI in Produktion gebracht, nicht nur in Notebooks. Du kennst dich mit LLM-Pipelines aus: Prompting, RAG, Evals, Latenz- und Kosten-Tuning. Audio/Speech (ASR/TTS) ist für dich kein Neuland. Oder du hast Lust, dich reinzubeißen. Python ist dein Zuhause und TypeScript schreckt dich nicht. Du triffst lieber Entscheidungen, als auf fertige Specs zu warten. Datenschutz und Safety sind für dich Teil des Designs, keine Checkliste. Du willst, dass deine Arbeit im Kinderzimmer ankommt und nicht im Backlog. Eher nicht, wenn: du nur Modelle trainieren willst und Produktion dich langweilt. Oder wenn du erst loslegst, wenn Anforderungen, Team und Prozesse fertig sind.

Si l'innovation vous passionne et que l'humain vous anime, si vous êtes prêt à vous couper en quatre pour nos clients tout en restant entier, et si vous aimez vous challenger au travail tout en profitant de votre temps libre, nous sommes impatients de vous rencontrer pour construire ensemble la santé et le bien-être de demain. Vos responsabilités En tant que Data Scientist, vous transformez les données et les technologies d’IA en solutions concrètes, utiles et responsables pour répondre aux enjeux métiers de l’entreprise. Vous concevez et développez des solutions Data & IA répondant à des besoins métiers concrets, en exploitant des données structurées et non structurées et des technologies telles que le Machine Learning, les LLM, le RAG, la compréhension documentaire et les agents IA. Vous transformez les expérimentations en solutions opérationnelles, en évaluant leur qualité, leur fiabilité et leur valeur métier, puis en les rendant robustes, maintenables et scalables. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes produit et data — Product Owners, Data Engineers, Data Analysts, développeurs RPA et autres experts — afin de traduire les problématiques métier en solutions Data & IA efficaces. Vous collaborez avec les équipes architecture, DevOps, sécurité, privacy et métier pour garantir un déploiement responsable et efficace, avec les niveaux appropriés de sécurité, de conformité, de monitoring et de supervision humaine. Vous explorez les nouvelles technologies et capacités en IA, identifiez celles qui peuvent réellement créer de la valeur et transformez les opportunités pertinentes en expérimentations et solutions concrètes. Vous partagez vos connaissances et challengez les idées, en contribuant activement à une culture d’équipe collaborative, orientée apprentissage et amélioration continue. Vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire où l’expertise, la curiosité et l’envie de construire des solutions utiles comptent autant que la technologie — avec, idéalement, quelques conversations qui n’ont absolument rien à voir avec l’IA. Vous combinez un solide esprit analytique avec un réel intérêt pour la data, le software et l’IA. Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience pratique dans la conception et le développement de solutions Data & IA, idéalement en tant que Data Scientist, ML Engineer ou AI Engineer. Vous avez notamment travaillé avec des données non structurées (textes, documents, images) et utilisé des LLM pour répondre à des problématiques métiers concrètes. Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux du Machine Learning et de l’IA et savez choisir l’approche la plus pertinente en fonction du problème : Machine Learning traditionnel, IA générative ou solutions plus simples. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les approches modernes de l’IA générative, notamment le prompt engineering, le RAG, les sorties structurées, l’utilisation d’outils et les workflows agentiques. Une expérience en évaluation, guardrails, human-in-the-loop ou LLMOps constitue un atout. Vous maîtrisez Python et êtes capable de développer des solutions prêtes pour la production, au-delà du simple prototype. Vous avez une expérience du déploiement et de l’exploitation de workloads IA sur AWS. Des connaissances en SQL, API, CI/CD et développement cloud-native sont un plus. Vous êtes attentif à la qualité et à la fiabilité des solutions : vous savez évaluer si une solution IA fonctionne réellement, la tester, la monitorer et l’améliorer dans le temps. Vous êtes autonome, proactif et collaboratif, et appréciez de travailler avec des profils variés : Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Product Owners, architectes, experts métier et autres profils techniques. Vous savez challenger une approche et proposer des alternatives pertinentes. items.desc: 📍 Milan | Hybrid (2–3 days in the office) · 💼 Permanent contract, CCNL Commercio | Gross annual salary €42,000 + €1,000 net welfare About us iMamma is Italy's no. 1 app for women trying to conceive, expecting mothers and new parents: over 130,000 monthly active users, with content, tools and a very active community. We have just rebuilt the app from scratch in React Native, and we are bringing the tools that matter in-house: data, analytics, CRM, customer service. We are a small team, and AI is how we work every day, not an experiment. The role You join the tech team and work closely with the Product & Growth team. We are not looking for someone who waits for the ticket: we are looking for someone who takes ownership of the platform (app, backoffice, services and data), understands why something should be built, takes it to production and watches how users actually use it. At the start you report to our interim CTO; over time you take on more and more responsibility, and we will evaluate a possible promotion to tech lead. What you will do Build with AI agents Use agents as your default way of building: write the brief, run work in parallel, review and verify the result. Build your own workflows around the agents, and use AI across the whole job, not just for writing code (analysis, testing, documentation, debugging). Product Read user feedback and data, understand the problem and suggest the simplest way to solve it. Run small experiments with real users and decide based on the results. Platform Work across the whole stack: mobile app, backoffice, APIs and services, data. Take things all the way to production and look after them after release. How we measure your work: what reaches production and how often, the impact of features on users, the quality and stability of the platform. Who we are looking for AI-first : agents are already your default way of building, and you can tell us how you use them. This weighs the most. Product-minded : you always ask why you are building something, and you like testing ideas against data and real users. Ownership and hunger : you want the whole platform, you take things all the way, and you want to grow into the tech lead role. Roughly 2–5 years of experience as a developer, with products shipped to production. Fluent Italian and English. You live in or near Milan and are looking for an employment contract: we do not consider freelance (partita IVA) collaborations. Nice to have Experience with TypeScript, React Native, Vue, Node.js and AWS (a plus, not a requirement). A degree in data science or equivalent (a plus, not a requirement). Experience with consumer apps, health products or communities. What we offer Permanent contract, CCNL Commercio, 14 monthly payments, gross annual salary €42,000 + €1,000 net in company welfare benefits. Hybrid: 2–3 days a week in our Milan office. A new, modern codebase, built from day one to work with AI. A product used every day by thousands of women, and a small team where what you build reaches users within days. A concrete path to the tech lead role. How we hire 30-minute video call → practical task (a small feature to build with your own agents: we want to see how you guide them and how you verify the result) → technical interview with our interim CTO → final meeting. If you have something to show us (GitHub, a side project, one of your agent workflows), put it in your CV.

items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Help us use generative AI to understand and modernize a life sciences application. How can AI help engineers understand an established software application and build its next generation? In this internship, you’ll explore that question through a practical software engineering project. You’ll investigate an existing life sciences application, organize knowledge about how it works, and use that knowledge to help AI agents support software modernization. You’ll then apply your approach to a focused feature and contribute to a working proof of concept. The project You’ll explore how to bring together information from source code, documentation, tests, and other engineering materials. Using techniques such as static analysis, knowledge graphs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and generative AI, you’ll help create a structured view of the application and its behavior. You’ll use this knowledge to help AI agents answer questions, identify the impact of changes, and support development. To demonstrate the approach, you’ll help modernize a session setup feature, following it from the user interface through configuration, application logic, validation, and data storage. Your profile You are a bachelor’s graduate, a master’s student, or a master’s graduate in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, or a related field. You have: A solid foundation in programming and software engineering; experience with C# is a plus. An understanding of software architecture and object-oriented design. Familiarity with version control, debugging, and testing. An interest in generative AI and its use in software development. Curiosity and problem-solving skills to explore an unfamiliar codebase. Good communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with others. What You’ll Gain You’ll gain hands-on experience applying AI to a real software engineering challenge. You’ll learn how to investigate a complex life sciences application and contribute to a proof of concept for modernizing it. Appy today!

Sie schulen Mitarbeitende im wirksamen und sicheren Umgang mit KI-Werkzeugen. Bei uns kennt jeder jeden. Viele verschiedene Charaktere. Jeder darf so sein wie er ist. Wir beschäftigen uns mit den Technikthemen der Zukunft. Ein sicherer und spannender Arbeitsplatz zugleich. Cada proyecto es un negocio nuevo que entender. Al mismo tiempo formarás parte de Jungle , un ecosistema de más de 750 perfiles creativos, estratégicos y tecnológicos. Tu día a día Tu tiempo se reparte entre entender el negocio del cliente y construir la solución con tus propias manos: Entender el negocio Discovery de procesos: entrevistar a equipos de cliente, mapear su proceso actual (AS-IS) e identificar dónde la IA ahorra tiempo, reduce errores o mejora decisiones. Diseño de la solución: traducir el problema en un flujo concreto (qué entra, qué decide la IA, qué revisa una persona, qué sale) y priorizar por impacto y viabilidad. Business case y medición: estimar horas ahorradas, coste y retorno, y definir los KPIs para seguir el uso después de la entrega. Construir la solución Workflows y agentes low-code: construir automatizaciones con IA en herramientas como n8n, Make o Power Automate, conectadas a las herramientas del cliente (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, CRM, ERP). Prototipos y apps internas: montar en pocos días prototipos funcionales con herramientas como Lovable o Claude, con datos reales, para validar con el cliente. Du sitzt mit den Menschen zusammen, deren Arbeit sich durch Deine Lösung verändert, und bleibst, bis sie läuft. Qualifikation Was wir suchen Studium im MINT-Bereich oder ein vergleichbar tiefer technischer Werdegang Ein KI-System, das Du selbst gebaut hast und zeigen kannst, z. B. eine RAG-Pipeline, einen Agenten oder eine technisch verantwortete Automatisierung Fundiertes Verständnis von LLMs, Retrieval und Agentic AI, Cloud und lokalem Betrieb, inklusive der Grenzen Sicherer Umgang mit Code (z. B. Python), APIs und Datenanbindung 3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in technischer Umsetzung; Kundenkontakt oder Beratungserfahrung ist ein Plus Freude an Workshops und daran, Technik verständlich zu erklären Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch Wohnsitz in Deutschland und Bereitschaft zu Kundenterminen vor Ort (üblicherweise 2–4 Tage im Monat im DACH-Raum) Was wir bieten Mandatsverantwortung ab dem ersten Projekt, ohne Layer über dir Fachlicher Austausch mit der KI-Elite in Deutschland - in unserem Team bist du immer am Zahn der Zeit Moderner Tech-Stack und Raum zur Vertestung Sichtbarkeit als Experte über unsere KI-Business-Coaching-Community und TÜV-SÜD-Kooperation Voll-remote möglich— Teamtage und Kundenworkshops vor Ort, üblicherweise 2-4 Tage/Monat im DACH-Raum Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege Marktgerechtes Gehalt bei schnellen Wachstumsmöglichkeiten Bewerbung: Bring Dein Projekt mit! Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und bring uns Dein Projekt mit ! At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design. 
 As the Product Owner (Martech & AI) , you will own the backlog and end-to-end delivery for a dedicated marketing technology or AI product area within Global Digital Marketing. You will translate the agreed product strategy into a prioritized backlog, defining clear requirements and acceptance criteria for every item while setting the release sequence and deciding what makes the cut. Guiding a delivery squad through refinement, sprint planning, and release, you will ultimately sign off on each increment against acceptance criteria before it goes live in production. Because this product area runs on platforms owned by business partners, your ownership focuses specifically on the backlog, requirements, and roadmap execution for the capabilities built on top of them, rather than the underlying platforms or their engineering.

You will hold final release approval and full accountability for what ships; when a delivered capability falls short of expected outcomes, you will diagnose the root cause and resolve the underlying requirement, configuration, or process issue. In this capacity, you will own the business-partner relationship for your product area—managing expectations around capability, feasibility, and sequencing, while escalating scope or funding decisions to the right stakeholders alongside their delivery impacts. To anticipate dependencies before they become delays, you will bring deep specialist expertise in product ownership paired with broad working knowledge across marketing automation, CRM and sales enablement, content and asset operations, data and measurement, and applied AI. Finally, you will take a leading role within large, global cross-functional and cross-chapter squads, actively coaching colleagues to help build their skills and domain expertise.

 Champion responsible AI and data governance: Embed data privacy, regulatory compliance, and human-review controls directly into product requirements so our AI and marketing solutions scale safely and ethically.
 Diagnose, optimize, and scale: Monitor product adoption and performance post-launch, conducting root-cause analyses when outcomes fall short and iterating on requirements or processes to maximize value.
 Elevate team capability: Represent your product area in global transformation initiatives and coach fellow product owners on backlog structure, prioritization frameworks, and agile best practices.

 You possess deep expertise in at least one enterprise MarTech or content platform (such as Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce, or enterprise DAM/CMS solutions) alongside broad familiarity with CRM, data/attribution, and applied AI in marketing.

items.desc:
Lieu : Palaiseau, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
Thales Research&Technology, notre centre de recherche dans les domaines matériels, et CortAIx Labs, notre centre de recherche en IA et digital ont pour mission de proposer des innovations de ruptures, de maintenir et d’accroitre l’avance technologique et d’en assurer la compétitivité pour le groupe. 
 Au sein d’un centre de commandement et de conduite des opérations (C2), les états-majors traitent en flux continu des données volumineuses, asynchrones et hétérogènes.
 La fonction critique du C2 est d'assurer la conscience de situation (Situation Awareness — SA) au sens des trois niveaux d'Endsley : Perception L1 (repérer les entités), Compréhension L2 (croiser les indices pour donner du sens) et Projection L3 (anticiper la manœuvre ennemie).
 Les architectures combinant modèles de langage (LLM) et agents autonomes constituent un levier d'aide à la décision majeur pour décharger l'opérateur. Toutefois, un risque opérationnel critique demeure : le canal textuel produit par l'agent est insuffisant pour évaluer sa fiabilité. Un LLM peut formuler une réponse parfaitement claire, fluide et affirmative, tout en s'étant laissé intoxiquer par un leurre adverse ou en ayant négligé une contradiction fondamentale.
 Le stage étudie comment sécuriser ce flux d'aide à la décision grâce à la synergie de trois composants :
 Le RAG tactique (La mémoire opérationnelle) : 
 L'Agent LLM (Le moteur de raisonnement) : 
 Le J-Space / J-lens (La sonde d'audit interne) : 
 Issue des recherches en interprétabilité mécanistique (Anthropic), la technique du Jacobian lens (J-lens) permet de projeter les activations résiduelles des couches intermédiaires du LLM dans son vocabulaire. Ce J-space agit comme une mémoire de travail latente. Lorsque le modèle traite simultanément le rapport du drone (menace) et le leurre (absence d'ennemi), ses couches médianes calculent mathématiquement la contradiction logicielle (« conflit », « leurre », « fausse piste »). L'outil écoute ces signaux silencieux pour déclencher un avertissement indépendant de la réponse textuelle.
 Vos missions
 L'objectif principal est de construire un démonstrateur de détection passive d'incohérences tactiques dans l'espace latent du modèle :
 Corpus tactique de test (Mois 1) : Modéliser un jeu de 40 à 50 scénarios tactiques courts au format militaire standard (SITREP, INTSUM, radio), intégrant des cas cohérents, des contradictions temporelles et des intoxications informationnelles directes. 
 Chaîne Agent-RAG minimale (Mois 2) : Mettre en œuvre une base vectorielle simple (ex. FAISS / ChromaDB) pour le RAG. 
 Connecter un modèle à poids ouverts compact et performant (ex. LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct ou Mistral-8B) configuré avec un schéma d'appel d'outils déterministe (Tool-calling). 
 Instrumenter l'extraction des tenseurs du flux résiduel (residual stream) lors du passage des données conflictuelles. 
 Audit latent & Détection par J-Space (Mois 3-4) : Implémenter une référence classique (baseline) : projection directe (logit lens) et sondes linéaires (probes) sur les couches médianes. 
 Déployer l'opérateur J-lens simplifié sur les couches critiques identifiées pour projeter les activations sur des concepts clés (vrai, faux, doute, conflit). 
 Comparer l'efficacité du J-space face aux sondes linéaires pour déceler un conflit de sources non résolu. 
 Indicateur de confiance opérationnel & Synthèse (Mois 5-6) : Définir une métrique de divergence : mesurer l'écart entre le niveau de confiance affiché dans le texte émis et la présence de tokens d'alerte dans l'espace latent. 
 Livrer un démonstrateur logiciel épuré (API de scoring ou script de visualisation) applicable aux scénarios C2. 
 Rédiger le mémoire de stage et une note technique de synthèse valorisable en R&T.

 Vous avez pour ambition de réaliser votre stage au sein de Thales ?

 Solides compétences en programmation (Python, PyTorch ou TensorFlow).

items.card: you will play a key role in defining, designing, validating, documenting, and releasing innovative electronic hardware solutions for advanced powertrain applications. Your work will contribute to electronic control units for passenger and commercial vehicles developed for leading OEMs worldwide. In your role you will: Design and develop automotive electronic hardware solutions from concept through series production.
items.desc:
We are currently looking for an Electronics Hardware Design Engineer – Automotive Powertrain to join our team. 
 As an Electronics Hardware Design Engineer – Automotive Powertrain within our Hardware Development and Testing Group, you will play a key role in defining, designing, validating, documenting, and releasing innovative electronic hardware solutions for advanced powertrain applications. Your work will contribute to electronic control units for passenger and commercial vehicles developed for leading OEMs worldwide. 
 In your role you will: 
 Design and develop automotive electronic hardware solutions from concept through series production. 
 Create hardware architectures and detailed circuit designs for powertrain-related electronic systems. 
 Select and evaluate electronic components considering cost, performance, reliability, availability, and automotive qualification requirements. 
 Design analog, digital, mixed-signal, power supply, and communication circuits. 
 Develop solutions utilizing automotive microcontrollers, gate drivers, power semiconductors, and protection circuits. 
 Define test cases and execute design-validation activities, collaborating with dedicated testing teams to improve coverage and efficiency. 
 Develop and maintain hardware documentation in accordance with Automotive SPICE processes. 
 Support released designs throughout series production by evaluating supplier change notifications and managing component changes, discontinuations, and obsolescence risks. 
 Tools and technologies: 
 Circuit and system simulation tools such as LTspice, PSpice, MATLAB, Simulink or similar. 
 Schematic capture and PCB layout using Altium, Zuken, KiCad or similar tools. 
 Laboratory instrumentation (oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, power analyzers, logic analyzers, climatic chambers and related laboratory equipment).
Minimum five years of experience in automotive electronics hardware design. 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a comparable technical field. 
 Proven experience developing automotive electronic control units (ECUs). 
 Experience across the complete product development lifecycle, from concept to series production. 
 Strong knowledge of: 
 Analog and digital circuit design. 
 Power electronics fundamentals. 
 Microcontroller-based systems. 
 Automotive communication interfaces (CAN, LIN, SPI, UART, I²C). 
 Signal conditioning circuits. 
 Power supply architectures. 
 Protection and diagnostics concepts. 
 Automotive development processes and standards, including Automotive SPICE, ISO 26262, and relevant hardware quality processes. 
 Soft skills: 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
 Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within global multidisciplinary teams. 
 Structured and detail-oriented working style. 
 Proactive mindset with a strong focus on quality and customer satisfaction. 
 Ability to mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical knowledge sharing. 
 Languages: English proficiency is required. 
 Nice to have: 
 Experience in high-voltage electronics hardware design. 
 Experience with battery management systems.

 Your work-life balance is valuable to us, so we offer you:
 25 Days of annual leave , because work-life balance is essential to us. 
 Flexible working hours. 
 Your health and well-being is important to us, so we have you covered:
 Medical subscription;
 Accident insurance;
 Sport activities and well-being initiatives.

 Technical and soft skills trainings;
 Access to e-learning platforms;
 Local and Global career development programs;

 Bookster subscription.

 Annual bonus;
 Lunch discounts.

items.desc:
You will build the foundational data infrastructure that powers cutting-edge AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems, workflows, and emerging agentic architectures.
 You will design and maintain scalable data pipelines, manage secure data environments, and prepare data for AI-driven systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients. You’ll tackle real-world challenges by contributing to the development of next-generation AI systems and grow as a technologist by working alongside diverse experts across industries.
 You will design and build the scalable, reproducible data components essential for machine learning, agentic, and autonomous AI systems. You’ll assess data landscapes, apply data quality fundamentals, and prepare data for AI solutions. Additionally, you’ll learn to translate simple hypotheses into engineered features, manage secure data environments, and contribute to R&D initiatives focused on innovating and scaling next-generation AI capabilities.
 Your work will help solve some of the most complex and high-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across McKinsey’s QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you’ll help develop innovative AI capabilities and scalable enterprise solutions. You’ll help build robust data foundations for scalable, production-ready AI systems. Your contributions will directly support the firm’s ability to accelerate AI adoption, solve complex business problems at scale, and enable clients to achieve meaningful, lasting impact.
 Based in the London or Munich office, you will be part of QuantumBlack Labs and the Robotics and Physical AI team, a group of engineers, scientists, product managers, and machine learning specialists building a first of its kind physics AI capability that accelerates and scales how the world designs and builds physical systems.
 Advanced graduate degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in computational mechanics, materials science, mechanical/aerospace/nuclear engineering, computational physics, or a closely related engineering or physical science field required; significant industry or national laboratory experience in applied simulation or scientific machine learning may apply
 2+ years of relevant professional experience building and deploying data solutions
 Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data engineering and experience writing robust, production-grade code, including deploying code across environments
 Proven experience building end-to-end data pipelines and platforms for Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence, covering data preparation, embeddings generation, vector search, and system integration using modern frameworks (Spark, dbt, LangChain)
 A strong foundation in system design, data storage, and reliability with commonly used data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, PSQL, etc.) and data engineering tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark, dbt, etc.)
 Hands-on experience with MLOps/LLMOps principles, including CI/CD for data workflows, automated agent evaluation (LangSmith, Opik, Langfuse), and infrastructure as code (Terraform)
 Experience building systems with different data formats (structured vs unstructured) and data processing methods (streaming vs batch) and deploying across major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
 Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.
 Commercial client-facing or senior stakeholder management experience is beneficial.
 Experience using coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) is a plus.
 Ability to travel to and work in varying environments that may be challenging and/or not accessible (e.g., manufacturing facilities, etc.) 
 Business level language fluency skills, both verbal and written, in English and German (for Munich), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

items.title: Medical Operations - Netherlands
items.card: About the Role We’re building the clinical co-pilot of the future - empowering clinicians, enhancing care delivery, and scaling impact. As part of our Global Medical Operations team , you’ll play a pivotal role in rolling out Tandem’s AI clinical operating system to some of the most influential healthcare organisations worldwide. This is a highly visible, global role where you’ll engage directly with executives,
items.desc:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
 About the Role
 We’re building the clinical co-pilot of the future - empowering clinicians, enhancing care delivery, and scaling impact. As part of our Global Medical Operations team , you’ll play a pivotal role in rolling out Tandem’s AI clinical operating system to some of the most influential healthcare organisations worldwide.
 This is a highly visible, global role where you’ll engage directly with executives, medical leaders, and end-users. You’ll bring clinical insight into how our tools are implemented on the ground - from onboarding new organisations and refining workflows to shaping the product through continuous feedback. You’ll be at the forefront of transforming healthcare delivery, ensuring Tandem becomes an indispensable part of daily patient care for clinicians across the globe.
 What You Will Do
 Lead live product demos for prospective clients and support global commercial efforts.
 Design and adapt workflows and templates for diverse markets and large-scale customers.
 Partner with product, engineering, and commercial teams to deliver smooth rollouts and seamless workflow integration.
 Represent Tandem at international conferences, workshops, and customer events.
 Guide clinicians through onboarding, training, and day-to-day support.
 Troubleshoot and solve problems to ensure clinicians get maximum value from Tandem.
 Build templates and prompts, contributing to the ongoing evolution of Tandem’s AI assistant.
 Manage clinical safety incidents and optimise internal operations for safe scaling.
 What You Bring
 Clinical experience in healthcare (e.g. general practice, hospital, private practice).
 Exposure to consulting, corporate, or startup environments.
 A passion for technology, AI, and their potential to transform care.
 Strong communication skills - equally comfortable with executives, engineers, and frontline clinicians.
 Organisational strength and a process-driven mindset.
 Ownership, curiosity, and initiative in a fast-paced environment.
 Flexibility to travel up to 25% and step in during critical moments.
 Fluency in Dutch and English
 Bonus Points
 Experience with prompting or large language models (LLMs).
 Background in healthtech or SaaS.
 Familiarity with EU clinical safety or digital health regulations.
 Track record in implementation projects or customer rollouts.
 Location
 We believe great ideas thrive when we connect in person. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Leiden with occasional travel to meet the core team in Stockholm and clinicians across the country as needed.
 How to Apply
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
 Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
 Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
 First interview with our NL Country Director
 Follow up interview with of our NL Medical Operations team lead
 Working Day - Join us in the Leiden office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.
 Culture at Tandem
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

items.desc: Job description Vill du arbeta med stora och komplexa datamängder och omvandla dem till insikter som gör verklig skillnad? Vi söker en nyfiken och tekniskt driven Data Engineer som vill bygga skalbara datalösningar, identifiera mönster i data och skapa rätt förutsättningar för avancerad analys, maskininlärning och AI. Du kommer att arbeta nära andra data scientists, utvecklare, systemingenjörer och verksamhetsexperter för att omvandla data från olika system och källor till strukturerad, tillgänglig och användbar information. En del av våra uppdragsgivare kräver svenskt medborgarskap och fullständiga kunskaper i svenska, så det är ett krav. Som Data Engineer får du ett tekniskt helhetsansvar för att samla in, bearbeta, strukturera och tillgängliggöra stora datamängder. Du arbetar med både strukturerad och ostrukturerad data och utvecklar lösningar som ska fungera stabilt i produktionsmiljö. Olika arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat att vara: Designa, utveckla och underhålla skalbara datapipelines. Bearbeta stora mängder strukturerad och ostrukturerad data. Utveckla ETL- och ELT-flöden från flera interna och externa datakällor. Identifiera mönster, avvikelser, trender och samband i komplexa dataset. Skapa datamodeller och data products för analys-, AI- och verksamhetsbehov. Arbeta med batchbearbetning och strömmande data i nära realtid. Säkerställa datakvalitet, spårbarhet, tillgänglighet och informationssäkerhet. Optimera dataflöden med fokus på prestanda, skalbarhet och kostnad. Samarbeta med data scientists kring machine learning, prediktiv analys och AI-lösningar. Bidra till arkitektur, tekniska vägval och moderna arbetssätt inom DataOps och MLOps. Bygga en effektivare verktygskedja med hjälp av AI, samt säkerställa högre SW kvalitet Basic qualifications Vi söker dig som har Relevant högskole-, civilingenjörsexamen eller Lic/PhD inom datateknik, IT, matematik, teknisk fysik eller mekatronik. Några års erfarenhet av data engineering, backendutveckling eller utveckling av dataplattformar. Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL. Erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure och Databricks. Erfarenhet av Apache Spark eller PySpark för distribuerad bearbetning av stora datamängder. God förståelse för ETL/ELT, datapipelines, datamodellering samt data lakes och data warehouses. Erfarenhet av att arbeta med stora, komplexa och heterogena dataset. Förmåga att analysera data och identifiera mönster, avvikelser och förbättringsmöjligheter. Erfarenhet av Git, CI/CD och automatiserade leveransflöden. God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska. Preferred additional skills, personal traits and experience Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av något av följande: Machine learning, deep learning eller generativ AI. Azure Machine Learning eller MLflow. LLM-applikationer, RAG-lösningar eller AI-agenter. LangChain, LlamaIndex eller motsvarande AI-ramverk. Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Kafka eller Informatica. Kubernetes, Docker och Infrastructure as Code. MLOps, modellövervakning och driftsättning av ML-modeller. Realtidsdata, IoT-data, telematik eller industriella dataströmmar. Grafana, Power BI eller andra verktyg för visualisering och analys. Data mesh, data products och distribuerade dataarkitekturer. Arbete med data i fordonsindustrin, tillverkningsindustrin, försvarsindustrin eller andra tekniskt komplexa miljöer. Du är analytisk, strukturerad och nyfiken på vad som döljer sig i stora datamängder. Du nöjer dig inte med att flytta data från en plats till en annan, utan vill förstå informationen, upptäcka mönster och skapa lösningar som ger mätbar verksamhetsnytta. Du trivs i komplexa tekniska miljöer, tar ansvar från idé och arkitektur till implementering och drift och har förmåga att förklara tekniska samband för både tekniska och icke-tekniska intressenter. We offer Är du redo att omvandla stora datamängder till värdefulla insikter och framtidens intelligenta lösningar? Skicka in din ansökan och berätta hur du har arbetat med datapipelines, avancerad analys och moderna molnbaserade dataplattformar. More information Peter Hedberg, +70 3402246 peter.hedberg@sigmatechnology.com Position Data Engineer med fokus på Big Data, AI och avancerad analys Company Sigma Technology Embedded Solutions Location Göteborg, Sweden Competence area Software development, Digitalisation Publication date 2026-11-10 Expiration date 2027-01-29 Contact Peter Hedberg, peter.hedberg@sigmatechnology.com, +703402246 Apply

items.desc: It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks. This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS! Tasks As Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d) located in Germany, you will be the technical lead for developing NVISO's Cyber Exposure offering. You will define how Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation work together through clear processes and responsibilities, and guide the technical decisions that make the service work for our clients. You will be the expert clients and colleagues turn to for the complete picture: which assets matter, where they are exposed, who needs to act and whether remediation has worked. You will design the processes, integrations and reporting that connect these questions, lead complex customer engagements and help other consultants deliver the service. You will advise on hardening and help clients establish ownership, remediation targets and a process that fits their IT operations. You will also shape what we build next. Starting from our existing Vulnerability Management capabilities, you will develop the technical roadmap towards Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and assess where Attack Surface analysis, exposure validation and Quantum Readiness belong in the offering. This gives you room to propose solutions, build prototypes and test them with clients before turning them into repeatable services. Typical responsibilities include: Defining the technical architecture and delivery approach for the Cyber Exposure offering, connecting Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation, with clear roles and governance; Leading technical delivery on customer engagements, advising on remediation and hardening, resolving design and integration problems and reviewing the quality of our work; Linking vulnerability findings to asset inventories, CMDBs, cloud environments, business services and owners, and resolving gaps in coverage and data quality; Designing remediation processes with owners, priorities, SLAs, escalation, risk acceptance and closure checks, aligned with Change Management and supported by ITSM, Patch Management and other remediation solutions; Building reporting that shows clients their exposure and remediation progress, with clear priorities for technical teams and reliable measures of coverage, ageing, SLA performance and accepted risk for management; Advising on secure configurations and hardening baselines for infrastructure and cloud environments, reducing unnecessary exposure and proposing compensating controls when patching is not immediately possible; Keeping up with developments in Exposure Management and evaluating AI and agentic solutions through targeted pilots to improve existing approaches to prioritization, remediation guidance and reporting. You will test accuracy and usefulness, protect client data and define human oversight, including approval before AI recommendations trigger remediation actions; Turning client needs into service packages, technical standards and delivery methods, coaching consultants and providing technical input for proposals and scoping; Developing the service roadmap and evaluating new capabilities through pilots, including CTEM, Attack Surface analysis and cryptographic discovery, Crypto Agility and Post Quantum Cryptography migration planning. You will help decide which capabilities are ready to become services and what we need to deliver them well. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship; Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience; Strong practical experience in Vulnerability Management, including scanning platforms, prioritization based on asset criticality and exploitability, and remediation processes, with the ability to guide technical decisions on customer engagements; Understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking and cloud environments, with practical experience advising on secure configurations, hardening baselines and compensating controls; Experience connecting security findings with asset inventories, CMDBs or Asset Management platforms, including ownership mapping and improving data quality; Experience designing security dashboards and management reports that make priorities, progress and data limitations clear; Experience designing remediation processes across security and IT teams, including ownership, SLAs, exceptions and Change Management. We are seeking a Scientist to enhance our exploitation of in-situ observations. You will contribute to observation
items.desc: Your role The exploitation of observations sits at the core of ECMWF’s global forecasting and environmental services. They are used to generate initial conditions for accurate forecasts of weather and atmospheric composition, the latter as part of the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS). We are seeking a Scientist to enhance our exploitation of in-situ observations. You will contribute to observation quality evaluation, assimilation methodology development, and seek to enhance our systems with Machine Learning techniques. You will play a key role in advancing ECMWF’s operational forecasting systems and contribute to research projects (JOHN and IM4CA) under the Horizon Europe EU framework. About the Active Sensing Team This role is in the Active Sensing Team of the Earth System Assimilation Section, part of ECMWF’s Research Department. It has responsibility for the exploitation of in-situ (surface-based, aircraft, balloon) measurements and active satellite systems (RADAR and GNSS). In this particular role, the successful candidate will also work closely with colleagues specializing in atmospheric composition, data assimilation, machine learning and operational evaluation. Your responsibilities You will: Work closely with the Observations team in the Forecast & Services Department to establish the real-time observation ingest and data flow for new observation streams, both for meteorological parameters and atmospheric composition, particularly for greenhouse gases in the framework of the JOHN and IM4CA projects Adapt the existing ECMWF systems to make additional use of these new observations in a research context and evaluate the impact on analyses and forecasts Where appropriate, migrate observations from research use to deployment in ECMWF’s operational systems used to produce weather and atmospheric composition predictions What we are looking for We are looking for someone who brings solid scientific expertise with the assimilation of observations in Earth system prediction systems. You understand data assimilation principles and have the technical expertise needed to contribute to advancing our operational forecasting systems. You will bring: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect theoretical understanding with practical data assimilation development A rigorous and proactive approach to improving methods and code An ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues across different areas, supported by clear communication skills Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work when timelines are constrained An ability to efficiently document your work Your profile Education An advanced university degree, or equivalent professional experience, in a relevant field Essential Experience and Knowledge Demonstrated experience with atmospheric data assimilation methodologies, such as variational methods, Kalman Filters, or data driven machine learning approaches A broad understanding of satellite and in-situ observations of the atmosphere Experience working with and maintaining large collaborative scientific codes, as well as agentic coding tools Desirable Experience and Knowledge Experience with NWP and / or atmospheric composition data assimilation Experience coding and conducting experiments in high-performance computing environments Knowledge of tools and processes for software management and software quality Candidates must be able to work effectively in English. A good knowledge of one of the Centre’s other working languages (French or German) is an advantage. If you feel that you have the motivation and many of the skills for this role but don't meet precisely all of the criteria listed above, we still encourage you to apply. About the projects The IM4CA project IM4CA (https://im4ca.eu/) is a large Horizon Europe project with 27 partners focused on improving our understanding of regional and global sources and sinks of atmospheric methane in the past, present, and future. ECMWF’s role is to use the knowledge and datasets on methane sources and sinks that become available during the project to improve the representation of methane in the operational CAMS greenhouse gas services. The JOHN project The JOHN (https://john-project.eu/) project will support the implementation of WMO’s Global Greenhouse Gas Watch (G3W) by assessing and improving the global greenhouse gas observing system, exploring emerging technologies, and developing priorities for future investment and monitoring. One of ECMWF’s roles is to adapt the CAMS data assimilation system to allow for the assimilation of in situ observations of atmospheric composition species. The exploitation of radiocarbon observations in the IFS - with focus on Europe - will also be assessed. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS! Tasks As Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d) located in Germany, you will be the technical lead for developing NVISO's Cyber Exposure offering. You will define how Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation work together through clear processes and responsibilities, and guide the technical decisions that make the service work for our clients. You will be the expert clients and colleagues turn to for the complete picture: which assets matter, where they are exposed, who needs to act and whether remediation has worked. You will design the processes, integrations and reporting that connect these questions, lead complex customer engagements and help other consultants deliver the service. You will advise on hardening and help clients establish ownership, remediation targets and a process that fits their IT operations. You will also shape what we build next. Starting from our existing Vulnerability Management capabilities, you will develop the technical roadmap towards Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and assess where Attack Surface analysis, exposure validation and Quantum Readiness belong in the offering. This gives you room to propose solutions, build prototypes and test them with clients before turning them into repeatable services. Typical responsibilities include: Defining the technical architecture and delivery approach for the Cyber Exposure offering, connecting Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation, with clear roles and governance; Leading technical delivery on customer engagements, advising on remediation and hardening, resolving design and integration problems and reviewing the quality of our work; Linking vulnerability findings to asset inventories, CMDBs, cloud environments, business services and owners, and resolving gaps in coverage and data quality; Designing remediation processes with owners, priorities, SLAs, escalation, risk acceptance and closure checks, aligned with Change Management and supported by ITSM, Patch Management and other remediation solutions; Building reporting that shows clients their exposure and remediation progress, with clear priorities for technical teams and reliable measures of coverage, ageing, SLA performance and accepted risk for management; Advising on secure configurations and hardening baselines for infrastructure and cloud environments, reducing unnecessary exposure and proposing compensating controls when patching is not immediately possible; Keeping up with developments in Exposure Management and evaluating AI and agentic solutions through targeted pilots to improve existing approaches to prioritization, remediation guidance and reporting. You will test accuracy and usefulness, protect client data and define human oversight, including approval before AI recommendations trigger remediation actions; Turning client needs into service packages, technical standards and delivery methods, coaching consultants and providing technical input for proposals and scoping; Developing the service roadmap and evaluating new capabilities through pilots, including CTEM, Attack Surface analysis and cryptographic discovery, Crypto Agility and Post Quantum Cryptography migration planning. You will help decide which capabilities are ready to become services and what we need to deliver them well. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship; Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience; Strong practical experience in Vulnerability Management, including scanning platforms, prioritization based on asset criticality and exploitability, and remediation processes, with the ability to guide technical decisions on customer engagements; Understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking and cloud environments, with practical experience advising on secure configurations, hardening baselines and compensating controls; Experience connecting security findings with asset inventories, CMDBs or Asset Management platforms, including ownership mapping and improving data quality; Experience designing security dashboards and management reports that make priorities, progress and data limitations clear; Experience designing remediation processes across security and IT teams, including ownership, SLAs, exceptions and Change Management. Familiarity with ITSM and remediation platforms is expected; scripting and API skills are an advantage; Ability to design a solution …

items.desc: Ready for a challenge? Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe. About this role We’re setting up a new team focusing on the developer and agentic experience, as well as the enablement of a new Data and Machine Learning Platform within JET (Mobius). Within the past year we’ve built new Data & ML Platforms on AWS and now we want to double down on the experience of these. You’ll work closely with Product and our Data & ML Platform teams to improve the user and agentic experience of our platforms, as well as upskilling and enabling new users of the platforms. This is a brand new team within our space, so we’re looking for someone excited to contribute to the culture and vision of the team, as well as help shape the data mentality across our product and technology department. Whilst this is a developer platform role for internal platforms, it also includes enabling users to use the data platform correctly through sharing knowledge of data transformation. Part of this role will include working with Product Engineering teams directly, as a practitioner who builds alongside them and transfers capability in the process. Deep Data Engineering knowledge is not required for this role, but you should be comfortable picking it up quickly and working alongside data engineers as a peer. This isn't a pure platform engineering role and it isn't a pure data engineering role. It sits at the intersection of platform, experience, and enablement - and the best candidates will find that intersection exciting rather than uncomfortable. We also don’t expect you to know everything on this list just yet, but a desire to learn and develop your skills is needed. These are some of the key components to the position: Contribute to the backlog, picking up improvements to onboarding tooling, documentation improvements, and the overall developer experience of our Data & ML Platforms Support changes to the agentic interface layer, making the platform accessible to AI agents as first-class users Pair with engineers on embed engagements, working directly alongside product engineering teams to deliver data engineering work Participate in knowledge transfer sessions, learning how to help product engineers understand how to use the platform and why Participate in shaping ways of working, engagement playbooks, and reusable patterns as the team matures Learn from senior engineers across the team and the broader Data & ML Platform pillar, with a clear path to taking on more ownership as you grow What will you bring to the team? You’re comfortable working in other people’s code bases, exploring new components - bonus points if you’ve worked in an innersource environment before You're curious and communicative, you ask good questions and can explain what you're thinking clearly, even when you're still figuring it out Some experience building on cloud-native platforms such as AWS, GCP or Azure. Exposure to Kubernetes is nice to have but not required. An interest in developer experience and internal platforms, you've thought about what makes tools easy or frustrating to use, even if you haven't built one professionally. Familiarity with GitOps and CI/CD systems and understand the principles of reliable, automated delivery pipelines. Curiosity about data engineering concepts (streaming, batch processing, data storage systems). You don't need experience here; the desire to learn it matters more than having it already At JET, this is how we play Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side. At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again. Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition. items.desc: Numer referencyjny: ERP/SEE/1025037 Lokalizacje: Kraków, Bielsko-Biała, Katowice, Lublin, Łódź, Poznań, Warszawa, Wrocław, Gliwice, Rzeszów, Tarnów Doświadczenie: Senior Wyobraź sobie, że aplikacja, której jakości pilnujesz, rozlicza płace tysięcy pracowników, prowadzi księgowość, magazyny i produkcję firm, które każdego dnia napędzają polską gospodarkę. Że jeden przeoczony błąd w kalkulacji to nie kolejne zgłoszenie w backlogu, tylko faktura, przelew czy deklaracja, na której ktoś naprawdę polega. I wyobraź sobie, że coraz większą część kodu tej aplikacji współtworzy już Agentic AI, a to Ty mówisz ostatnie słowo, czy wszystko działa tak, jak powinno. Tak właśnie wygląda ta rola. Jako Quality Engineering Expert w naszym zespole staniesz na czele inżynierii jakości nowej generacji: weryfikacji i automatyzacji systemów, w których kod powstaje we współpracy ludzi i agentów AI. Twoim celem będzie dbanie o to, by aplikacje klasy ERP, które budują stabilność polskiej gospodarki, były bezwzględnie stabilne, deterministyczne i zgodne z regułami biznesowymi. Pracujesz w zwinnych zespołach i konwojach, w paradygmacie AI-native: wykorzystujesz agentów do wielokrotnego przyspieszenia procesu QA, a jednocześnie jesteś kluczową instancją weryfikującą to, co wygenerowały modele. Nie będziesz tu odhaczać scenariuszy – będziesz współtworzyć to, jak wygląda Quality Assurance w epoce sztucznej inteligencji. Jeśli ciekawi Cię, gdzie AI naprawdę pomaga, a gdzie potrafi się pomylić, i lubisz to sprawdzać – szukamy właśnie Ciebie. Profil stanowiska Posiadasz min. 5 letnie doświadczenie w testowaniu złożonych aplikacji biznesowych (mile widziane systemy klasy ERP/CRM). Biegłość w budowaniu frameworków testowych E2E i API (np. Playwright, REST-assured) Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi AI w wytwarzaniu oprogramowania (np. Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, frameworki do automatyzacji oparte o LLM) i chęć eksperymentowania z nimi na co dzień. Doświadczenie w testach wydajnościowych i obciążeniowych systemów przetwarzających duże wolumeny danych transakcyjnyc. Wybitnie analityczne i krytyczne myślenie – umiejętność precyzyjnego wychwytywania halucynacji, cichych błędów logicznych i anomalii ukrytych w z pozoru nienagannym kodzie wygenerowanym przez AI. Twoje zadania Weryfikacja determinizmu i logiki biznesowej aplikacji klasy ERP: Skrupulatna walidacja spójności danych biznesowych – testowanie, czy nowa aplikacja generuje w 100% identyczne rezultaty kalkulacyjne i transakcyjne co legacy core. Testy regresyjne i integracyjne w trybie hyper-delivery: Utrzymanie stabilności architektury w warunkach błyskawicznego tempa dostarczania funkcji przez nasze zespoły i konwoje. Audyt UX/UI & Design System: Weryfikacja zgodności interfejsów tworzonych przez modele z przyjętym Design Systemem i standardami dostępności. Automatyzacja AI-Native: Tworzenie zaawansowanych frameworków testowych (E2E, API) z wykorzystaniem agentów AI do generowania kodu testów. Nadzór nad kodem generowanym przez AI: Wyłapywanie edge-cases, nieoptymalnych struktur danych oraz potencjalnych luk logicznych i bezpieczeństwa powstałych w procesie generowania kodu. Dla Ciebie Prywatna opieka medyczna w Allianz - dostęp do specjalistów i badań diagnostycznych dla Ciebie i Twoich najbliższych. System kafeteryjny - możesz wybrać pełne dofinansowanie do karty Multisport czy przeznaczyć środki na kulturę, wypoczynek lub sport i zakupy. Możliwość pracy w modelu hybrydowym po okresie wdrożenia (2 dni pracy zdalnej, 3 dni pracy z biura). Możliwość korzystania z zaawansowanych narzędzi AI i Google Workspace. Współpraca z różnymi zespołami kompetencyjnymi, która pozwoli Ci na poznanie nowych technologii i poszerzenie wiedzy w obszarze IT. Profesjonalny rozwój zawodowy, realny wpływ na podejmowane decyzje biznesowe. Udogodnienia dla rowerzystów/ rowerzystek (stojaki, szatnie, rowerownie, stacja naprawcza), a dla tych, co do pracy docierają samochodem – naziemny i podziemny parking (Kraków) .
