Job Description As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division. WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth. Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership. About the Role We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to help ensure the reliability of the WTW ResQ insurance reserving product across its desktop application lifecycle. The role covers functional and regression testing, GUI testing, integration testing and support for releases and production fixes. The QA Engineer will act as an independent quality advocate within the engineering team, using evidence, product knowledge and customer perspective to constructively challenge requirements, assumptions and implementation decisions. They will help the team deliver features that provide the strongest quality and customer outcomes, rather than limiting QA to validating completed work. Key Responsibilities Create and maintain test scenarios based on product requirements, customer workflows, identified risks and observed behaviour Perform functional, regression, integration and GUI testing for desktop application changes. Engage early in feature discovery and refinement, helping the team identify risk, ambiguity, edge cases and customer-impacting behaviours before development is completed. Verify application behaviour across relevant configurations and supported versions. Test workflows involving application interfaces, data and integrations. Support testing of packaging, installers, deployment and release candidates. Record defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, and supporting evidence. Work closely with engineers to investigate defects, challenge incomplete or insufficient fixes. Provide an evidence-based quality assessment for release readiness, clearly communicating unresolved risks and constructively challenging release decisions where the available evidence does not support an acceptable level of quality. Contribute to post-release validation and learning. Help identify opportunities to improve test coverage and make quality checks repeatable. Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge transfer and product documentation. Use approved agentic coding tools to draft test scenarios, derive boundary cases from requirements, suggest regression areas, generate test data ideas and summarize defect patterns; validate suggestions before using them. Collaborate with the team to ensure sustainable run of scrum ceremonies, including when needed, planning, estimation, refinement, reviews and retrospectives; facilitate follow-up and help resolve blockers. Qualifications Experience in software quality assurance for business applications. Practical experience with functional and regression testing. Experience testing desktop applications and GUI workflows. Ability to create clear test cases and defect reports. Understanding of software development and release processes. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and effective collaboration with developers and stakeholders. Ability to use AI-generated test ideas and other AI outputs critically, verifying them against application behaviour and available evidence. At least 3 years of practical experience in the IT industry. Desirable Experience testing WPF applications. Experience with Ranorex GUI test automation. Familiarity with SQL Server and validating application data. Exposure to integration testing, COM interfaces, SignalR or MassTransit. Experience with Azure DevOps and Git-based delivery workflows. items.desc: IS THIS YOU? Is full ownership of an app the perfect next step in your growth trajectory? Do you feel like AI is giving product managers superhuman powers? Then you know the feeling. You move faster than the organization around you, and you are done waiting for permission. At Myner, you don't need permission to run ahead - you have the agency to fly instead. ABOUT MYNER Stop waiting. Start growing. Myner is building the world’s first global consumer omni-panel: a unified, always-on stream of what people buy, consume, watch and think. Myner transforms that data into the fuel that powers our Agentic Flywheels for consumer brands — always-on, continuous loops that both create and validate new product concepts, marketing campaign ideas and more. Legacy market research delivers studies and reports; Myner delivers breakout sales growth. Finally, our founder-CEO has already built and exited a unicorn in this industry and his plans for Myner are even more ambitious. Get yourself ready for explosive growth! THE MYNER APP The Myner app (https://mynerapp.com) is where consumers share their data with us, with their full consent, and get rewarded for it. They scan receipts, answer surveys and complete small missions, and every contribution pays off: they can cash out in money, crypto or even physical gold. So yes, they can literally turn their data into gold. The app plays out as a Wild West gold rush game, and it's built to be fun to come back to, not a chore. We're live in the US today on our way to building a global panel. As Product Owner, your customers are the people using the app: you make sure they enjoy it, trust it and feel rewarded for every contribution. THE ROLE Drive the growth and success of the Myner app. You will own the product experience for everyone who uses the app. You decide what gets built and when. WHAT YOU WILL OWN The app is our primary data source: it is foundational to everything we do as a company, and everything we build for clients depends on the quality of our panel. This is NOT a utilitarian app, it's intentionally a game first. Designing flows and experiences that make data collection feel like play is at the heart of owning this product. Product drives engineering: you decide what gets built and when, so roadmap creation and prioritization is where you make the biggest difference. You build, too: this is an AI-first company, so you build your own tools, experiments and AI harnesses (with help where needed). You don't just move tickets and wait for developers. You bring product ideas to life, and engineering makes sure they scale. Scope management is a skill: you know when to extend and when to cut. Cutting corners is fine, but they can bite back as we scale, so you need a strong sense of which ones to cut. Measure everything: we see immediately how people react to new features and iterate fast. Today we release a meaningful app version every 2–3 weeks, and expect just 1–2 as the engineering team grows. Support is part of the product: you own and manage customer support for our panelists, with the access and tooling to serve them well. The app store rating is one of your core KPIs, and it's shared across teams. Growth is yours: you are responsible for managing our agency partner to drive new user acquisition, along with all internal efforts to manage and improve user retention. WHAT YOU BRING Builder: you have built products people use, and you have something to show us. Cross-functional mindset: you work across teams naturally and never build walls around your own area. Good judgment and taste: you make sound decisions, care how things look and feel, and are highly regarded for this special talent. AI-first: you use AI every day in your work, from research to specs to prototypes. Data-driven: you trust what the numbers show, and a single bad review doesn't throw you off course. Gamification: you have worked on gamified products, not necessarily mobile, but more than leaderboards and streaks. Prioritization: you know what matters now, say no easily, and are comfortable cutting corners when it's the right call. Communicator: you explain things clearly, inside the team and to everyone else. English: near-native is the level we're looking for, where you can express yourself without problems. Self-managed: you plan your own time; make commitments and meet your own deadlines. Team lead: you have led teams of engineers and designers before. NOT A FIT Department walls: you prefer owning your own area over working cross-functionally. Here, the app, the data, engineering, user support and client needs all connect. Feature factory: you'd rather ship features than measure their impact. We decide based on data, not opinions. No eye for UI / UX: you leave the look and feel to designers. In this role, taste and judgment on UI and UX are essential. Pace: you prefer the rhythm of a large enterprise. We are a startup that tries things quickly and iterates a lot. Change: you get frustrated when plans …

Advise the Data Engineering, Data Science and Development teams on choosing algorithms, data modeling techniques and analytics strategies. Take part in code reviews and make sure the solutions you deliver are high quality and robust. Keep up to date with the third-party solutions that complement the GenAI ecosystem, and make sure the team knows about them. What we need to see from you: Solid knowledge of data architecture, including data models, storage, and efficient pipelines. Experience designing conversational and agentic architectures, integrating Gemini Enterprise and voice channels with ADK on Agent Engine. Hands-on experience with Apigee as an MCP Gateway, including API Management, Model Context Protocol (MCP), security, auditing, and access control. Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Entra ID, and Nexthink. Proven experience with the Google Cloud AI ecosystem, including Vertex AI, Gemini, and Dialogflow CX / CX Agent Studio. Python experience and the ability to translate ambiguous client needs into clear technical architectures and roadmaps. Effective communication skills, adapting to audiences from CISOs to business teams. Nice to have: Experience with ITSM, identity and observability platforms (ServiceNow, Microsoft Entra ID, Nexthink). Knowledge of semantic search (AI Search / Embeddings) and analytics (BigQuery + Looker). Here, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, explore new possibilities, and build a career that’s uniquely yours, while helping shape what’s next in technology. Accommodations: SoftwareOne welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you require reasonable adjustments at any point during the recruitment process, email us at reasonable.accommodations@softwareone.com. Please include the role for which you are applying and your country location. Someone from our organization that is not part of the decision-making process will be in touch to discuss your specific needs and we will make every effort to accommodate you. Any information shared will be stored securely and treated in the strictest of confidence in line with GDPR. Our clients span different industries and sizes, from some of the world's biggest brands to fast-growing smaller businesses. We give engineers real technical ownership. You'll be the technical lead on
items.desc: About the role You'll design and deliver the data pipelines and platforms that drive our clients' decision-making, working directly with them to turn business questions into production-ready systems on Google Cloud. Our clients span different industries and sizes, from some of the world's biggest brands to fast-growing smaller businesses. We give engineers real technical ownership. You'll be the technical lead on your own projects and client accounts, trusted to make the calls and own the outcome. You'll also be part of an engineering team that reviews each other's work and pitches in across projects. On your accounts, you'll work day to day with fifty-five's consultants and data scientists. You'll combine strong SQL, Python and cloud engineering with sound technical judgement, using AI tools to build faster and to a higher standard while keeping full ownership of what you deliver. What you'll do Design, build and operate scalable data pipelines, data models and end-to-end solution architectures on GCP (BigQuery, Python, dbt, Airflow, Dataform), balancing reliability, maintainability, performance and cost. Own technical delivery on your projects and accounts, from scoping to production: making the design decisions, managing risks and dependencies, and communicating trade-offs clearly. Own the quality of what we deliver, with rigorous validation, automated testing, observability and data-quality controls built into production pipelines, and lead the diagnosis and fix when production issues come up. Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex to build faster and improve testing, checking their output critically and staying accountable for the result. Share what works with the team as demos, docs and reusable patterns. Work with clients, consulting and data science teams to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions and turn business needs into pragmatic designs, and explain your reasoning to technical and non-technical people. Raise the team's engineering standards through design and code reviews, strong testing practices and clear documentation. What you'll bring Excellent SQL and strong Python skills. Proven experience designing, building and operating reliable data pipelines, data models and cloud platforms (GCP preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome), with transformation and orchestration tooling such as dbt, Airflow or Dataform. Strong software engineering practices: Git-based workflows, code review, automated testing and CI/CD. Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools in your day-to-day work, and the judgement to know when to rely on them and when to verify. The ability to break down ambiguous problems, see the business challenge behind a task, make well-reasoned decisions, and prototype and pitch ideas for what we could build for clients. Excellent client-facing communication and confidence leading delivery independently: running several client projects at once and re-prioritising as client needs change, solo or within a larger project team. Desirable experience Infrastructure as code (Terraform), cloud IAM, and secure handling of client data. Applied data science (exploratory or statistical analysis), and dashboarding tools such as Looker or Power BI. Marketing platforms and an understanding of marketing data. About the company Part of The Brandtech Group, fifty-five is a data company helping brands collect, analyse and activate their data across paid, earned and owned channels to increase their marketing ROI and improve customer acquisition and retention. Headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Hong Kong, New York and Shanghai, fifty-five is a certified Google Partner company and was named by Deloitte as one of the fastest-growing tech firms in Europe, thanks to its unique technology approach combining talent with software and service expertise. If this sounds like you, please get in touch! We look forward to meeting you. In return, we are pleased to offer you the following benefits: Being part of a multicultural, dynamic and fast-growing team Continuous (and certified) training on the digital ecosystem and technologies (initial training for all new employees, followed by recurring training sessions) Private medical coverage through AXA Transport for London monthly travel card allowance The flexibility to work remotely for part of the week 25 days holiday per year, in addition to UK bank and public holidays Company pension plan Company-sponsored sporting and social activities Monthly Codecademy subscription - reimbursable upon completion of chosen training path fifty-five encourages diversity and is committed to guaranteeing equal treatment of all applications, regardless of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, state of health or political or religious opinion.

items.desc: About Digital Futures Digital Futures is an AI services and software company that specialises in accelerating AI transformation and enabling AI governance for enterprise and government. The Role Digital Futures is mobilising a forward-deployed team to work alongside Anthropic's Applied AI team, embedding directly with a strategic client to accelerate enterprise adoption of Claude. You will collaborate closely with business and technology teams to ship production AI applications that solve real-world problems, working hands-on with users and delivery teams inside the client's environment and iterating quickly based on their feedback. This is a hands-on build role, not an advisory one. Using Claude Code and the Claude API, you will design, build and evaluate agentic systems that make sense of complex workflows and legacy data, and own the quality of what they produce. Governance is integrated from day one, with every output evidenced and validated by domain specialists, and you will capture repeatable deployment patterns so that capability can be scaled and transferred to client teams. We expect our forward-deployed engineers to operate autonomously, thrive under ambiguity and maintain high standards of safety and reliability in regulated environments. Key Responsibilities Agent design and build Design and build the five discovery agents (requirements, estate, lineage, data quality and documentation) using Claude Code and the Claude API, delivering artefacts such as MCP servers, sub-agents and agent skills under read-only, governed and logged access. Engineer agents that trace transformation chains through SAS, SQL, Hive, Spark and shell code, infer field semantics from code, naming, constraints and usage, and detect where source, derivation or meaning changed over time. Contribute to joint architecture reviews with the bank's data platform and security teams and Anthropic's Applied AI team, covering agent design and the evaluation plan, and present early test results at architecture checkpoints. Evaluation and quality Build the evaluation harness: ground-truth sets from specialist-validated entries, calibrated confidence scoring, failure analysis and regression testing as corrections accumulate. Ensure every generated entry carries evidence links, provenance, a confidence score and a named reviewer, written to the evidence store and audit log. Use data profiles (null rates, value distributions by period) to test inferences against the data itself, reducing entries that are plausible but wrong. Close the loop with weekly specialist validation sessions, so that corrections feed back into the agents' working context and accuracy improves throughout the engagement. Reuse and capability transfer Package the agents, evaluation harness and playbook as a reusable toolkit that applies to further entities and data stores with minimal change, codifying repeatable deployment patterns with Anthropic's Applied AI team. Pair with the bank's engineers, transferring capability so that future data stores can be addressed by bank teams with Digital Futures support rather than dependence. Experience and Profile Production experience building agentic systems with large language models, with demonstrable depth in Claude Code and the Claude API, including tool use, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), sub-agents and agent skills. Evaluation of LLM output where accuracy is material: harness design, ground-truth construction, confidence calibration and systematic failure analysis. Experience building systems whose output is validated, evidenced knowledge rather than code, with feedback loops that make them more accurate as specialists review them. Delivery experience in enterprise financial services, ideally a Tier 1 bank, including working within security tollgates, change control and third-party access constraints. Fluency reading legacy data code (SAS, SQL, HiveQL, PySpark, shell and scheduler scripts) well enough to reason about derivation logic and its history. Python to production standard and a disciplined Git-based workflow. Experience with data lineage tooling, knowledge graphs or graph databases is desirable. A previous forward-deployed or client-embedded engineering role, with the autonomy to thrive under ambiguity in complex organisations. The ability to explain design choices, limitations and residual risk clearly to model risk, security and senior stakeholders. Benefits We offer a competitive salary. items.desc: 🎾 BreakPointCRM is building the execution layer for AI-native sports clubs. Sports clubs still run on fragmented systems: manual follow-ups, disparate messaging apps, disconnected spreadsheets, and inefficient booking processes. AI has entered the space, but mostly as a disconnected tool sitting outside the real work. That is not enough. The real shift is turning club management into an AI-native engine: where CRM, commercial automation, and multi-channel communications are connected in one controlled layer, allowing clubs to retain players, automate tasks, and drive revenue through agentic AI and advanced analytics. BreakPointCRM is building that layer. Our platform gives clubs a workspace where agents can manage inbound leads, track player engagement, orchestrate communications, and operate seamlessly under human supervision. We are hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to build the infrastructure behind that. What you’ll build You will work directly with the core team to build agentic and core engineering infrastructure for real commercial workflows. This means: Developing core platform features using Next.js (App Router) and Node. Designing large-scale AI agents leveraging LLMs like Gemini. Building robust agentic systems, vector databases, and Model Context Protocols (MCPs) with custom tools. Designing and integrating external APIs and serverless architectures. Optimizing multi-tenant system performance and scalability for rapid growth across the EU and USA. Collaborating on product UI decisions to implement critical UX friendly flows. This is not a normal full-stack role. Expect uncertainty. The frontend and product surface matter, but the biggest need is infrastructure and execution speed: data models, systems engineering, deployment, and systems thinking. Your job is to accelerate our technical velocity and push the boundaries of AI-driven racket sport marketing automation. What we are looking for You might be a fit if you: Are excellent at TypeScript, Next.js, and modern system architecture. Have built real software on SQL databases, ideally PostgreSQL and AWS RDS. Understand REST APIs, serverless computing, and CI/CD pipelines. Have designed end-to-end AI agents incorporating memory, RAG, and custom tools. Use AI coding tools aggressively in your own workflow (Claude Code, Codex, Herdr, etc.) but do not confuse speed with sloppiness. Possess a creator's mindset with the initiative to deploy and iterate ideas rapidly. Have about a year of professional experience, preferably in a fast-paced startup environment. Care deeply about sports and technological innovation. Are a problem solver who owns their work end-to-end while being autonomous. You do not need to be a professional athlete. You do need to care about understanding complex commercial workflows deeply enough to automate them responsibly. Our stack We currently work with: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare Workers, AWS, Drizzle, Docker, and Vercel AI SDK. You do not need to have used every tool. You need to be able to reason from first principles and learn fast. How we work BreakPointCRM is a dynamic, intense company built around leverage. We believe the future of sports club management won't be bloated software suites. It will be powered by people with extreme ownership using breakpoint to do the work of much larger racket clubs. We value autonomy, proactivity, and attention to detail. We offer a flexible, hybrid environment (Based in Madrid, with office space in Barrio de Salamanca) where you will have high-impact participation in technical decisions. Why join You will join at the moment where BreakPointCRM is moving into rapid deployment: real clubs, real workflows, real infrastructure problems, real opportunity. If we are right, every serious racket sport club in the world will need an intelligent CRM layer to drive their business. We are building it. How to Apply Send felix@breakpointcrm.com : Something hard you have built. The most complex system you have owned or designed. A short note on how you currently use AI in your engineering workflow. Anything that shows unusual agency or a strong technical mindset.

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it's a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe. About This Role As a Data Scientist – AI Engineering, you will help build and run the AI agents that support the people who keep our delivery network moving. These are production, user-facing agents that help users resolve issues and take actions in real time, across multiple markets and languages. Your mission is to make these agents measurably better and safe to change. You will build, evaluate, and monitor LLM-powered agents end to end: from designing agent behaviour and tools, to building the evaluation harness that tells us whether a change is an improvement, to the observability that tells us how the agent behaves in production. You will work closely with Product, Backend Engineers, Operations colleagues, and the other Data Scientists on the team. These are some of the key components to the position: Agent Development: Build and improve components of our agent systems — prompts and workflows, tool use, and handover to humans. Translate operational requirements into agent behaviour that is reliable and testable. Agent Evaluation: Build and maintain evaluation suites for agents: datasets built from real conversations and scenarios, LLM-as-a-judge and deterministic metrics, and end-to-end tests of tool-using agents. Run offline experiments to compare models, prompts, and agent designs, and use the results to make clear ship / don't-ship recommendations. Help move us towards automated and well-grounded online evaluation. Observability & Monitoring: Instrument agents with tracing, structured logging, and quality metrics. Build and maintain dashboards and alerts covering quality, latency, cost, and failure modes. Analyse production traces and historical conversations to find regressions and the next best improvement. Production Standards: Ship agent changes safely — well-tested Python, code review, version control. Be mindful of production rules, data privacy and security. Data Analysis: Use SQL and Python to analyse large volumes of conversation and operational data, define and track quality and business metrics, and quantify the impact of agent changes. Actionable Insights: Translate evaluation and monitoring results into clear recommendations for the team and stakeholders, using data visualisation where it helps. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with Backend Engineers, Operations and Product to expand what our agents can do, and contribute to a growing internal community of people building user-facing agents at JET. Process Improvement: Spot opportunities to automate evaluation, testing and release workflows, and make contributions to them. What will you bring to the team? Hands-on experience building and shipping user-facing AI agents in production — LLM-based systems that real users interact with, where reliability, latency, safety and graceful handover to humans matter. Practical experience with agent evaluation: building evaluation datasets, defining metrics, using LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing agents, and running offline and online experiments to compare prompts, models or agent designs. Practical experience with agent observability and monitoring: tracing and debugging multi-step agent runs, defining quality/cost/latency signals, and building dashboards and alerts for LLM systems in production (e.g. OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or similar tooling). Experience with agent frameworks (e.g. Google ADK, LangGraph, or similar), tool use / MCP, and multi-step or multi-agent designs. Strong Python and SQL; good software engineering habits — typing, linting, unit tests, Git, CI/CD, code review. A solid data science foundation: statistics, experiment design, and the ability to reason about whether an observed change is a real improvement. Comfortable working independently on well-defined problems, knowing when to ask for guidance, and communicating results clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: experience with feature flags and staged rollouts, containerised deployments (Docker/Kubernetes). At JET, This Is How We Play Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. items.desc: Lieu : Sophia Antipolis, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Au coeur de la Silicon Valley de la région PACA, notre site regroupe nos activités développe des sonars de pointe équipant les sous-marins et les bâtiments de surface ainsi que des activités de services numériques. Pionnier dans le domaine des produits de simulation, le site mobilise une expertise approfondie en acoustique et en traitement du signal. Sur le site de Thales DMS Sophia Antipolis , vous serez intégré à la Direction des Offres et vous serez rattaché au Responsable Performance des Offres. Nous recherchons un stagiaire ingénieur pour concevoir un Proof of Concept (POC) visant à capitaliser les données des offres passées afin de fédérer ces informations et les rendre exploitables pour des modèles prédictifs ou des assistants IA. Vous Serez Intégré(e) à La Direction Des Offres Et Collaborerez Avec Les Développeurs De Thales AI Companion Pour Extraire et structurer les données des offres précédentes Automatiser la génération de documents types (ex : registres de risques, matrices de conformité, plannings, etc.) Tester des solutions pour la future mise en œuvre des outils d’analyse prédictive. Vos Principales Missions Seront Les Suivantes Comprendre l’écosystème de Thales et les besoins Cartographier les outils existants : Identifier les sources de données (ex : Appels d’Offres, documents d’analyses des offres, modèles documentaires Chorus, synthèses des devis) et leurs formats. Analyser les limites des outils actuels (ex : silos de données, manque de standardisation). Recueillir les besoins : Échanger avec les Responsables des Offres pour cerner leurs attentes (ex : "Comment réutiliser les Retours d'Expérience ?", "Quels documents prioriser ?"). 2 . Développer un POC de capitalisation Extraire et structurer les données : Automatiser l’extraction des informations clés depuis les documents (ex : registres de risques, déclinaisons du contrat aux package, matrices de conformité, chiffrages). Nettoyer et normaliser les données pour les rendre exploitables (ex : format JSON, base de données vectorielle). Créer des assistants IA : Développer des connecteurs pour Thales AI Companion afin de générer automatiquement des documents types (ex : registres de risques, matrices de conformité). Tester des prompts optimisés pour COPILOT afin d’améliorer la qualité des réponses (ex : "Quels sont les risques récurrents pour ce client ?"). 3 . Préparer l’industrialisation Valider la faisabilité : Tester la compatibilité des solutions avec les workflows de développement IA. Identifier les verrous (ex : confidentialité des données, maintenance des modèles). Documenter et recommander : Rédiger un guide utilisateur et un manuel technique pour les outils développés. Proposer une roadmap pour une généralisation (ex : intégration dans Thales AI Companion, formation des équipes). items.desc: JOB TITLE: MEDIOR AI ENGINEER — LLMOPS & RUN FOR AI AGENTS AND RAG (AZURE / KUBERNETES) LOCATION: BRUSSEL BELGIUM LANGUAGES REQUIRED: DUTCH,FRENCH,ENGLISH CONTRACT DURATION:04/01/2027 - 31/12/2027 WORK MODE: HYBRID MODE(FULL TIME 2- 3 DAYS ONSITE PER WEEK) JOB DESCRIPTION Context Client (Brussels public transport operator) is building several employees- and customer-facing AI services, serving our customers and employees across the organization. These range from retrieval-based assistants to AI agents that call tools and business systems on behalf of users. The AI services are built and run on our STIB AI Platform. The first services go live from December 2026, and more will follow in 2027. Your Roles and Responsibilities We are recruiting a Medior AI Engineer to join the AI Centre of Excellence (Digital Innovating & AI - delivery team) and own the Run phase of our AI services in production. You take over each service from the Senior AI Engineers who built it, and you keep it reliable, measured, secure and cost-efficient over time. You will work alongside STIB’s internal AI Platform Architect, two Senior AI Engineers (Build), the business and content owners of each service, and client's IT operations teams. The AI Platform runs on a hybrid operating model: managed Azure services (Microsoft Foundry with the OpenAI model family for LLM and embeddings, Azure AI Search, Azure API Management, Azure AI Content Safety) combined with self-hosted open-source components on AKS (agent orchestration in Python with Lang Chain, ingestion pipeline), with MLflow on Databricks for evaluation and tracing (Open Telemetry). The Digital Innovation / AI CoE team owns Infrastructure-as-Code for all application-scoped Azure resources, using Terraform and Azure DevOps pipelines. What you will deliver Activities will vary from service to service. Typically, you will: operate the AI services in production: monitor availability, latency and errors, handle incidents and service requests, analyse root causes, then fix or escalate keep answer quality under control: run and maintain evaluation sets (golden sets) with business content owners, track answer quality, non-answer rate and user feedback, and detect and investigate quality regressions operate the ingestion pipelines: incremental refresh, failed documents, index health, and onboarding of new content sources or business domains within existing connectors operate agent integrations: monitor tool and integration calls to business systems, handle failures and timeouts, and review action logs and exceptions for agents that act on users’ behalf manage change safely: model version upgrades and retirements, prompt and configuration changes, dependency and security updates, each validated against the evaluation sets before release follow run cost: token consumption and cost per service, alerting on drift and proposing optimisations maintain the Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps artefacts, and keep the DEV, TST, ACC and PROD environments consistent apply data protection rules: trace retention, erasure and access restrictions, as defined in each service’s data protection impact assessment maintain runbooks and documentation, and report service health to service owners and the AI CoE on a regular basis deliver small enhancements and fixes; structural changes and new features stay with the Build team. SKILLS Azure DevOps Azure Kubernetes Service - AKS Azure OpenAI Service Lang Chain LLM / Large Language Models Python RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Terraform Vector databases Questions Have you personally operated or supported an LLM application (RAG, agent or document processing) in production for at least 6 months? (if answer to Q1 is “Yes”) Please describe the application, its user volume, what you monitored, and your role in incidents and changes. Maximum 200 words. Have you personally investigated a quality issue or incident in an LLM application or AI agent using traces or logs? (if answer to Q2 is “Yes”) Please describe one case: the symptom, how it was detected, the root cause, the fix, and what you changed to prevent it from happening again. Maximum 200 words. Have you run or maintained evaluations of an LLM application, for example re-running test sets after a model or prompt change? (if answer to Q3 is “Yes”) Please describe the metrics, how the test sets were maintained, and how the results influenced release decisions. Maximum 200 words. Have you personally deployed changes to Kubernetes workloads (manifests or Helm charts) and Terraform code through CI/CD pipelines on Azure? (if answer to Q4 is “Yes”) Please give one concrete example. Maximum 150 words. This role requires on-site presence in Brussels 2 to 3 days per week. Are you willing and able to commit to this schedule?

items.desc: Introductie Onderwijs verzorgen en onderzoek uitvoeren verandert snel. Dit betekent grote ambitieuze programma’s, continue vernieuwing, veel en juiste informatievoorziening en het leveren van uitstekende kwaliteit. Generatieve AI biedt nieuwe mogelijkheden voor onderwijs, onderzoek en bedrijfsvoering. Binnen Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam ontwikkelen we AI-diensten waarmee medewerkers en studenten deze technologie effectief, veilig en verantwoord kunnen inzetten. Binnen de dienst EDIS bouwen we aan een team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het ontwikkelen, beschikbaar stellen en beheren van AI-toepassingen. We zoeken een Application Specialist die gebruikers helpt om o.a. de mogelijkheden van AI optimaal te benutten en zorgt dat onze (AI-)diensten aansluiten op hun behoeften. Functieomschrijving Je komt te werken binnen het domein Generic IT Services van de dienst EDIS van de EUR. Als Application Specialist speel je een cruciale rol bij het ondersteunen van gebruikers bij het effectief en verantwoord inzetten van diensten die gebruikt kunnen worden voor o.a. het werken met generatieve AI. Het grootste gedeelte van jouw werkzaamheden is het helpen van het realiseren van AI-usecases, configureren AI-assistenten en kennisbronnen en je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de geleverde diensten. Je werkt nauw samen met de ontwikkelaars en engineers binnen het team, die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de technische ontwikkeling van het platform en de applicaties. Je combineert kennis van AI-technologie met inzicht in gebruikersbehoeften en zorgt ervoor dat nieuwe mogelijkheden worden vertaald naar praktische en betrouwbare toepassingen. De belangrijkste werkzaamheden: AI-usecases realiseren: gebruikers begeleiden bij het formuleren van hun behoeften en deze vertalen naar functionele AI-oplossingen. RAG-kennisbronnen beheren: opzetten, configureren en onderhouden van kennisbronnen en datasets, inclusief documentselectie, metadata, actualiteit en toegangsrechten. Kwaliteit bewaken: testen en beoordelen van AI-antwoorden op juistheid, relevantie, betrouwbaarheid en bruikbaarheid en verbeteringen doorvoeren binnen de beschikbare functionaliteit. AI-diensten beheren: verzorgen van functionele configuraties, autorisaties, gebruikersbeheer en het analyseren en oplossen van functionele problemen. Gebruikers ondersteunen: adviseren, begeleiden en trainen van medewerkers en teams bij het effectief en verantwoord inzetten van generatieve AI. Doorontwikkeling stimuleren: gebruikersfeedback verzamelen, verbeterkansen signaleren en functionele wensen afstemmen met de ontwikkelaars en engineers. Gebruik monitoren: analyseren van gebruik, incidenten en gebruikerservaringen en op basis daarvan verbeteringen voorstellen. Veilig en verantwoord gebruik borgen: toepassen van richtlijnen voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging, datakwaliteit en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Kennis vastleggen en delen: documenteren van configuraties, werkwijzen en gebruikersinstructies en bijdragen aan kennisdeling binnen het team. Functie-eisen Je beschikt over HBO werk- en denkniveau en hebt affiniteit met generatieve AI en digitale dienstverlening. Je bent analytisch, technisch nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om samen met gebruikers praktische oplossingen te realiseren. Daarnaast breng je mee: Ervaring met het configureren, implementeren of beheren van applicaties of digitale diensten. Kennis van en bij voorkeur praktijkervaring met generatieve AI, LLM's en chatbotplatformen. Ervaring met prompting en het configureren van AI-assistenten of vergelijkbare toepassingen. Kennis van of affiniteit met RAG en het gebruik van kennisbronnen binnen AI-toepassingen. Basiskennis van informatiebeveiliging, privacy en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Het vermogen om gebruikerswensen te vertalen naar functionele oplossingen en verbeteringen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling. Het is een pre als je ervaring hebt met: Azure OpenAI of vergelijkbare generatieve AI-platformen. Het configureren van AI-workflows en custom chatbots. RAG-oplossingen en het beheren van kennisbronnen. Het testen en evalueren van de kwaliteit van LLM-antwoorden. ITIL-processen en Agile/Scrum-werkwijzen. Competenties Analytisch: je doorgrondt gebruikersvragen en vertaalt deze naar praktische oplossingen. Nieuwsgierig: je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen AI en onderzoekt hoe deze kunnen worden toegepast. Klantgericht: je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en helpt hen verder. Kwaliteitsbewust: je hebt oog voor betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en continuïteit. Samenwerkingsgericht: je werkt effectief samen met gebruikers, ontwikkelaars en andere specialisten. Zelfstandig: je neemt initiatief, stelt prioriteiten en draagt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werkzaamheden. Pragmatisch: je zoekt naar haalbare oplossingen binnen de mogelijkheden van de beschikbare AI-diensten. Arbeidsvoorwaarden We bieden je een internationaal georiënteerde en afwisselende baan in een enthousiast team, met uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden …

items.desc: About DocHeart DocHeart is building the Operational Control Layer for Logistics. Logistics operations are complex. Work is spread across emails, documents, operational systems and people, while exceptions and changing circumstances are part of everyday reality. DocHeart brings this together in one intelligent operational layer that understands what is happening, organizes the work and helps teams take the right action. We combine AI, workflow automation and human decision-making to help logistics companies run their operations with more control and significantly less manual work. We are building a scalable logistics coordination platform, not a collection of customer-specific automations. We are an early-stage startup with real customers across Europe, and we build the product while we scale. The upside: a lot of ownership, direct contact with customers and product decisions, short feedback loops, and real influence on how our technology and our company develop. It is also genuinely early: priorities shift, specs are often something you shape yourself, and you will sometimes improve on something we built fast last quarter. If you want to build the product and the company at the same time, you will love it here. The role We are looking for a software engineer who turns real customer problems into product that logistics teams depend on every day. This is deliberately a combined role: you do customer implementations and you build the product. Roughly speaking, part of your time goes into getting DocHeart live and working inside a customer's operation, and part goes into turning what you learn there into platform capabilities. The two feed each other, and that is the point, not a compromise. You will work across customer implementations and the DocHeart platform, building backend capabilities, integrations, workflow logic and document-processing functionality. A requirement may start with one customer, but your job is to understand how it should fit into the wider platform and how we avoid solving the same problem again for the next one. We use AI coding agents extensively, and what great engineering looks like with them is still being invented. You will help define it here. With Claude Code and similar tools you will ship far more than a traditional team would, and the technical judgement you add on top is what turns that speed into something customers can rely on. You delegate execution to an agent and keep the judgement, the architecture and the ownership yourself. That combination is the craft, and it is a new one. What you will work on Python backend services and APIs Workflow and dossier logic Document ingestion, extraction and validation Integrations with customer systems Asynchronous processing and failure handling Reusable product capabilities emerging from customer implementations Testing, debugging and production issues Improving existing architecture as the platform scales How we work Own the result You take a problem through to production. You care about the whole arc: edge cases, failure scenarios, testing, maintainability and what happens after deployment. When something breaks, you treat it as a chance to make the system permanently better. Get the most out of AI Coding agents are part of your normal development workflow. You are good at giving them context, breaking down problems, directing their work and reading what comes back. You have an eye for the strong abstraction, the right assumption and the simplest design that holds, and you steer the agent towards it. And you can talk anyone through the result: why the implementation is right, which assumptions it rests on, how it was tested and what you would watch after release. See the whole system You are fluent in APIs, databases, asynchronous systems and application architecture, so you can see where a change lands across the whole platform. You enjoy the moment two customer requirements turn out to be one capability, because that is where a single well-built feature starts paying off for every customer after it. And you have the instinct for which small change deserves a second look before it goes out. Bring a growth mindset The tooling, the product and the craft are all moving fast, and that is the fun part. You look for feedback rather than wait for it, pick up unfamiliar domains and systems quickly, and treat every customer implementation as a chance to get sharper. We will invest in your growth, and we expect you to make the team better as you go. Ship fast, ship proud We love engineers who move quickly and get working software in front of real users. You have a feel for which shortcuts buy real speed, you build things you are happy to put your name on, and you get a kick out of seeing your work used in a live operation the same week. Here, momentum and quality are the same skill. Your background 3–7 years of professional software engineering experience Strong Python and backend development experience Experience building APIs and …

items.desc: Pourquoi a-t-on besoin de vous ? Vous contribuerez au développement, à l’industrialisation et au déploiement à grande échelle de solutions d’Intelligence Artificielle pour les différents métiers et pays du Groupe. Au Sein De L’équipe, Vous Occuperez Le Rôle De Data Scientist (H/F). À Ce Titre, Vous Aurez Les Responsabilités Suivantes Concevoir et développer des solutions d’IA répondant aux besoins métiers, en utilisant des techniques avancées de Machine Learning, NLP, Deep Learning et Generative AI. Participer à la conception fonctionnelle et technique des solutions IA, en collaboration avec les Tech Leads et les différentes équipes IT intervenant dans le projet (CRM, ERP, plateformes IA, etc.). Développer, tester et améliorer les modèles et algorithmes, en portant une attention particulière à leur performance, leur robustesse et leur capacité à être industrialisés. S’appuyer sur les fondations et standards technologiques du Groupe, notamment ceux portés par l’équipe AI Foundations (Group IT), en favorisant la réutilisation des composants et assets existants. Contribuer à la création de composants IA réutilisables et au passage à l’échelle des solutions dans plusieurs pays ou métiers. Participer à l’industrialisation et à la mise en production des solutions en collaboration avec les équipes techniques concernées. Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l’intégration, le déploiement et l’adoption des solutions développées. Contribuer au suivi et à l’amélioration continue des produits IA en production, ainsi qu’à la mise en place de leur support. Selon les produits et votre expérience, vous pouvez être amené(e)€ à avoir le rôle de « Technical Product Owner » pour les produits IA construits. En complément de ces missions, une réelle appétence pour la compréhension des enjeux métiers, la gestion de projet et le travail avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires sera fortement appréciée. Notre équipe ayant vocation à travailler avec des interlocuteurs internes basés en France comme à l’international, la maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, est indispensable. Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ? Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieurs ou d’une formation scientifique de haut niveau (École Polytechnique, Centrale, Mines, ENS ou équivalent). 3 à 5 ans minimum dans des fonctions de Data Scientist, avec une expérience démontrée dans le développement et l’industrialisation de solutions d’IA. Excellente maîtrise du Machine Learning, des statistiques, des probabilités et de la modélisation prédictive et descriptive. Solide maîtrise de Python et SQL, avec une expérience pratique des frameworks modernes de Machine Learning et d’IA (par exemple scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch). Bonne maîtrise des approches Generative AI / LLM, notamment RAG, agents et évaluation des modèles. Expérience d’un environnement Cloud et capacité à travailler avec des data pipelines et des architectures data/AI industrialisées. Bonne maîtrise des pratiques de développement logiciel : Git, CI/CD, tests, versioning et bonnes pratiques de code. Bonne compréhension des architectures IT, APIs, intégration des solutions, sécurité et contraintes d’entreprise. Capacité à développer des visualisations et dashboards permettant de transformer les résultats analytiques en insights exploitables. Excellentes capacités de communication, avec la faculté d’expliquer simplement des sujets complexes aussi bien à des équipes Data/IT qu’à des responsables opérationnels ou des dirigeants. Profil structuré, autonome, pragmatique et capable de travailler efficacement dans des équipes multidisciplinaires. Forte orientation business et impact, avec la capacité à partir d’un besoin métier, identifier l’approche AI adaptée et contribuer à sa transformation en une solution créatrice de valeur. On vous en dit plus sur nous Saint-Gobain est un leader mondial de la construction durable. Présent dans 81 pays avec 162 000 collaborateurs, le Groupe conçoit, produit et distribue des matériaux et services pour les marchés de la construction. Ses solutions, développées dans une dynamique d’innovation permanente, contribuent à la rénovation des bâtiments, à la construction légère et à la décarbonation de la construction et de l’industrie. Saint-Gobain est guidé par sa raison d’être: «Making the world a better home». Dans le cadre de l’ambition portée par la Chief AI Officer Groupe, Saint-Gobain renforce sa capacité à développer, industrialiser et déployer à grande échelle des solutions d’IA. Les AI Factories régionales et le Group IT travaillent de manière complémentaire pour assurer cette capacité de développement, en combinant la proximité avec les besoins des pays et des métiers et la mutualisation à l’échelle du Groupe. Ensemble, ils contribuent à transformer les cas d’usage transformationnels prioritaires en solutions robustes, réutilisables et déployables à grande échelle. Want hoe zorg je ervoor dat AI-oplossingen niet alleen slim zijn, maar ook betrouwbaar, veilig en verantwoord? Als AI Quality Engineer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol. Je combineert jouw kennis van Quality Engineering met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen Generative AI en Agentic AI en werkt aan innovatieve projecten waarin kwaliteit, governance en vertrouwen in AI centraal staan. Samen met je collega’s binnen onze Core Quality Engineering community zorg je ervoor dat AI-oplossingen niet alleen technisch goed functioneren, maar ook voldoen aan eisen op het gebied van betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, compliance en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Zo help je organisaties de kansen van AI optimaal te benutten, met oog voor de risico’s. Waarom jij het verschil maakt Als AI Quality Engineer ontwerp en implementeer je AI-ondersteunde test- en kwaliteitsoplossingen. Je ontwikkelt en optimaliseert onder andere AI-agents, prompts, promptflows en guardrails. Daarbij pas je Context Engineering toe om AI-oplossingen steeds verder te verbeteren. Je test en valideert AI-oplossingen op betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, robuustheid en mogelijke bias. Ook voer je risicoanalyses uit voor AI en GenAI-toepassingen en beoordeel je AI-gedreven bedrijfsprocessen op kwaliteit, effectiviteit en beheersbaarheid. Daarnaast evalueer je Retrieval Augmented Generation-oplossingen, databronnen en kennisbanken op juistheid, volledigheid en actualiteit. Je automatiseert testprocessen met GenAI-tools en AI-gedreven testdesign, valideert AI-guardrails en toetst oplossingen aan compliance, security en Responsible AI-richtlijnen. Je draagt bij aan de observability van AI-systemen en adviseert klanten over Quality Engineering, AI-governance en de verantwoorde toepassing van AI binnen softwareontwikkeling en bedrijfsprocessen. Zo maak je direct impact: je helpt organisaties niet alleen om de mogelijkheden van AI optimaal te benutten, maar ook om erop te kunnen vertrouwen. items.title: Software Engineer, Agentic Systems Engineering - ThousandEyes
items.card: You will have the opportunity to experiment with emerging technologies, learn from real-world usage, and turn promising ideas into reliable tools used by engineering teams across the organization. Your Impact As a Software Engineer You Will Design, build, test, and operate AI-powered tools and services for software developers. Develop agentic workflows, reusable skills, tool integrations, and orchestration
items.desc: Please note that we operate a hybrid working model and this role will require you to work from our offices in Oeiras at least 2 days a week. Meet the Team Cisco ThousandEyes is a Digital Experience Assurance platform that empowers organizations to deliver flawless digital experiences across every network—even those they don’t own. Powered by AI and an unmatched set of cloud, internet, and enterprise network telemetry, ThousandEyes enables IT teams to proactively detect, diagnose, and remediate issues before they affect end-user experiences. ThousandEyes is deeply integrated across the Cisco technology portfolio and beyond, delivering AI-powered assurance insights within Cisco’s Networking, Security, Collaboration, and Observability products. Our team develops internal AI-powered tools that help software engineers work more effectively across the development lifecycle. We build agentic workflows, reusable skills, integrations, and supporting platforms that make it easier for developers to understand complex codebases, implement changes, improve quality, and automate repetitive engineering tasks. We are a collaborative, product-minded engineering team working at the intersection of software development, developer experience, and applied AI. You will have the opportunity to experiment with emerging technologies, learn from real-world usage, and turn promising ideas into reliable tools used by engineering teams across the organization. Your Impact As a Software Engineer You Will Design, build, test, and operate AI-powered tools and services for software developers. Develop agentic workflows, reusable skills, tool integrations, and orchestration capabilities. Integrate AI tools with source control, CI/CD systems, issue trackers, documentation platforms, and internal developer environments. Build backend services and APIs that are secure, observable, reliable, and easy to maintain. Apply software engineering practices to manage the non-deterministic nature of AI systems, including evaluation, testing, monitoring, and feedback loops. Work directly with developers to understand their workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and iterate based on real-world feedback. Contribute to technical design discussions and help evolve the architecture of our AI development platform. Improve engineering processes, documentation, and operational practices across the team. Minimum Qualifications Software development experience using Python. Experience designing, building, testing, and operating backend services or developer-facing tools. Hands-on experience designing and implementing APIs within distributed software architectures. Practical experience using or developing with large language models, AI coding tools, or agentic AI systems. Experience working with Git, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery workflows. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional team. Experience developing AI agents, reusable skills, tool-calling integrations, prompts, evaluation frameworks, or agent harnesses. Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, context management, and model evaluation. Experience building internal developer platforms, command-line tools, IDE integrations, or engineering productivity tooling. Knowledge of Kotlin, Java, Go or TypeScript. Understanding of Kubernetes, containers, and modern cloud deployment practices. Experience with observability, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices. Familiarity with relational, document-based, or vector datastores. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

items.title: Data Engineer / IA
items.card: Vos missions : Écouter & cadrer : vous aidez les équipes Data et métier de nos clients à clarifier et formaliser leurs besoins (BI, ML, GenAI…) et à les traduire en exigences techniques. Construire & optimiser : vous concevez, développez et optimisez les pipelines de données dans le cloud, avec les outils et frameworks adaptés aux contraintes du client : volumétries, fréquence d'ingestion, streaming, sécurité,
items.desc: Professional French is a mandatory requirement for all members of the Kiiro teams. Chez Kiiro , nous accompagnons nos clients, de la scale-up aux grands comptes, dans la valorisation de leurs données. En tant que Data Engineer , vous construisez les fondations de nos clients : vous cadrez, vous développez, vous industrialisez, vous transmettez. Vous ne serez pas seul.e : rejoignez une équipe Data habituée au travail à distance, et vous vous appuyez sur nos partenariats Databricks et AWS . Vos missions : Écouter & cadrer : vous aidez les équipes Data et métier de nos clients à clarifier et formaliser leurs besoins (BI, ML, GenAI…) et à les traduire en exigences techniques. Construire & optimiser : vous concevez, développez et optimisez les pipelines de données dans le cloud, avec les outils et frameworks adaptés aux contraintes du client : volumétries, fréquence d'ingestion, streaming, sécurité, gouvernance. Migrer & moderniser : vous mettez en place ou aidez à la migration de datalakes / data warehouses / lakehouses vers des plateformes Cloud ou SaaS (Databricks en tête !). Rendre la donnée exploitable par l'IA : vous construisez les fondations dont les cas d'usage GenAI et ML ont besoin : qualité et fraîcheur des données, catalogue et lineage, exposition de corpus pour du RAG, recherche vectorielle, feature stores, pipelines d'inférence temps réel ou batch. Industrialiser : vous faites passer les produits à composante Data Science / GenAI du notebook à la production : tests, monitoring, coûts maîtrisés, traçabilité des données consommées par les modèles, gestion des accès aux corpus sensibles. Fiabiliser : vous collaborez avec les équipes de développement et d'architecture pour garantir l'intégrité, la qualité et la sécurité des données. Rester en veille & évangéliser : l'écosystème bouge très rapidement. Vous partagez ce qui mérite vraiment d'être adopté, en interne comme chez le client 🦸‍♂️ Côté interne : Partenariats : vous soutenez nos partenariats Databricks & AWS. Diffusion de la culture Data & IA : webinars, événements en présentiel co-animés avec nos partenaires, publication d'articles. Environnement technique (non exhaustif) : Plateformes Data : AWS, Databricks (principalement), mais aussi Snowflake, BigQuery, et on-premises (Hadoop, Cloudera) BDD : PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra… Langages : Python, SQL ETL/ELT & orchestration : dbt, Fivetran, Airbyte, Dagster… IA & ML : Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker, Mosaic AI, MLflow, frameworks d'orchestration LLM (LangChain, LlamaIndex), bases vectorielles (pgvector, OpenSearch, Qdrant) Nous sommes partenaires Databricks et AWS, et nous cherchons des personnes qui ont de l'appétence pour ces technologies mais restent ouvertes sur le reste de l'écosystème ! items.desc: About DocHeart DocHeart is building the Operational Control Layer for Logistics. Logistics operations are complex. Work is spread across emails, documents, operational systems and people, while exceptions and changing circumstances are part of everyday reality. DocHeart brings this together in one intelligent operational layer that understands what is happening, organizes the work and helps teams take the right action. We combine AI, workflow automation and human decision-making to help logistics companies run their operations with more control and significantly less manual work. We are building a scalable logistics coordination platform, not a collection of customer-specific automations. We are an early-stage startup with real customers across Europe, and we build the product while we scale. The upside: a lot of ownership, direct contact with customers and product decisions, short feedback loops, and real influence on how our technology and our company develop. It is also genuinely early: priorities shift, specs are often something you shape yourself, and you will sometimes improve on something we built fast last quarter. If you want to build the product and the company at the same time, you will love it here. The role We are looking for a software engineer who turns real customer problems into product that logistics teams depend on every day. This is deliberately a combined role: you do customer implementations and you build the product. Roughly speaking, part of your time goes into getting DocHeart live and working inside a customer's operation, and part goes into turning what you learn there into platform capabilities. The two feed each other, and that is the point, not a compromise. You will work across customer implementations and the DocHeart platform, building backend capabilities, integrations, workflow logic and document-processing functionality. A requirement may start with one customer, but your job is to understand how it should fit into the wider platform and how we avoid solving the same problem again for the next one. We use AI coding agents extensively, and what great engineering looks like with them is still being invented. You will help define it here. With Claude Code and similar tools you will ship far more than a traditional team would, and the technical judgement you add on top is what turns that speed into something customers can rely on. You delegate execution to an agent and keep the judgement, the architecture and the ownership yourself. That combination is the craft, and it is a new one. What you will work on Python backend services and APIs Workflow and dossier logic Document ingestion, extraction and validation Integrations with customer systems Asynchronous processing and failure handling Reusable product capabilities emerging from customer implementations Testing, debugging and production issues Improving existing architecture as the platform scales How we work Own the result You take a problem through to production. You care about the whole arc: edge cases, failure scenarios, testing, maintainability and what happens after deployment. When something breaks, you treat it as a chance to make the system permanently better. Get the most out of AI Coding agents are part of your normal development workflow. You are good at giving them context, breaking down problems, directing their work and reading what comes back. You have an eye for the strong abstraction, the right assumption and the simplest design that holds, and you steer the agent towards it. And you can talk anyone through the result: why the implementation is right, which assumptions it rests on, how it was tested and what you would watch after release. See the whole system You are fluent in APIs, databases, asynchronous systems and application architecture, so you can see where a change lands across the whole platform. You enjoy the moment two customer requirements turn out to be one capability, because that is where a single well-built feature starts paying off for every customer after it. And you have the instinct for which small change deserves a second look before it goes out. Bring a growth mindset The tooling, the product and the craft are all moving fast, and that is the fun part. You look for feedback rather than wait for it, pick up unfamiliar domains and systems quickly, and treat every customer implementation as a chance to get sharper. We will invest in your growth, and we expect you to make the team better as you go. Ship fast, ship proud We love engineers who move quickly and get working software in front of real users. You have a feel for which shortcuts buy real speed, you build things you are happy to put your name on, and you get a kick out of seeing your work used in a live operation the same week. Here, momentum and quality are the same skill. items.desc: Data & AI Engineer | Hasselt | Vast contract Voor een internationale softwareorganisatie zoeken we een ervaren Data & AI Engineer die de data- en AI-fundering mee wil opbouwen. Een datalake ontwerpen en bouwen volgens een medallion-architectuur. Data governance inrichten: toegangsbeheer, lineage, catalogisering, datakwaliteit en retentie. Predictieve ML-modellen ontwikkelen, trainen, evalueren en verpakken voor productie. Datasets voorbereiden voor RAG, AI agents en LLM fine-tuning. Ervaring met predictieve ML-modellen die in productie worden gebruikt. Ervaring met datavoorbereiding voor RAG of AI agents. Sterke Python- en SQL-skills en ervaring binnen een clouddataomgeving. Een zelfstandige aanpak en het vermogen om technische keuzes helder uit te leggen. Technologie: Databricks, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, AWS, Python, SQL en ML/MLOps-tooling. Een vaste interne functie met een contract van onbepaalde duur, ruime autonomie en opleidingsmogelijkheden. items.title: AI/ML Internship: Self-Improving AI Agents for Cybersecurity, SEAR
items.card: In this role, you will contribute to this effort: building on existing work towards creating agents and methods that design, evaluate, and improve their own harness. Apple's Security Engineering & Architecture organization is responsible for the security of every Apple product. AI is rapidly changing how cybersecurity work gets done. When it comes to securing more than a billion devices running the world's most
items.desc:
AI agents have reached the point where they find real vulnerabilities in software. How well they do depends heavily on the harness around the model: its tools, scaffolding, model choice, memory, and orchestration. Hand-tuning these harnesses does not scale, and agents that improve their own harnesses are still largely unexplored especially for security-related tasks. In this role, you will contribute to this effort: building on existing work towards creating agents and methods that design, evaluate, and improve their own harness.
Apple's Security Engineering & Architecture organization is responsible for the security of every Apple product. AI is rapidly changing how cybersecurity work gets done. When it comes to securing more than a billion devices running the world's most sophisticated operating systems, that means ensuring that we make full use of AI's capabilities while maintaining high-quality standards. This internship focuses on developing methods for automatically improving AI agents for security tasks.
During this internship, you will work with some of the best security researchers in the world to apply AI to real-world security problems and to develop new AI methods. We are looking for students in AI/ML with an interest in agentic AI who want to take on the hard, open problems that cybersecurity offers. No prior experience in cybersecurity is required.
Security tasks are a distinctive setting for agentic self-improvement. (a) Success is highly verifiable but rare. (b) The search space is vast and the horizons are extremely long. (c) They are grounded in real-life codebases that constantly evolve. These properties make security both a demanding test and a rich source of signal for continuously improving agents automatically. While base models provide the basis of an agent's capability, the harness around them has a large effect on many of the required attributes.
The goal of this internship is to experiment with new self-improvement methods on real-world security problems. You will study how to automatically improve harnesses on cost, performance, robustness, and how to feed-in signals from the software development lifecycle into that process. Novel ideas will be required to tackle these challenges. Code and the agent's environment constantly evolve: fixes for past issues may not lead to future ones, and the harness must keep evolving. Because agents are non-deterministic and successes are sparse, telling signal from noise is both critical and hard. Solving these challenges calls for novel techniques that draw on state-of-the-art LLM research, active learning, black-box optimization, software engineering practice, and program analysis.
Currently doing a degree in one of the following fields: machine learning, AI, software engineering, computer science, security, or a related field.
Experience building, experimenting with, and evaluating agentic AI systems (e.g., with LangChain, LangGraph, OpenHands SDK, Pi).
Strong software engineering skills in Python, and experience with agentic coding.
Autonomous drive, a collaborative mindset, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
Experience with building and evaluating agentic software-related tasks (e.g., vulnerability research), agentic self-improvement, or memory.
Knowledge of statistics and black-box optimization methods.

Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Framatome recherche actuellement des profils : Les équipes de Framatome conçoivent et fournissent des équipements, des services et du combustible pour les centrales nucléaires. Depuis plus de 60 ans, Framatome répond aux enjeux majeurs des opérateurs électriciens du monde entier, grâce à un portefeuille complet de solutions et de services. Nos activités permettent d’améliorer la disponibilité et la compétitivité de leurs installations, tout en renforçant leurs conditions de sûreté. Les métiers de Framatome s’articulent autour de 5 grands pôles : La conception de centrales, La fourniture de la chaudière nucléaire, La conception et la fabrication des composants et des combustibles, L’intégration des systèmes de contrôle-commande, La prise en charge et la maintenance de tous types de réacteurs nucléaires. Nos 23000 salariés participent chaque jour à la fourniture d’un mix-énergétique bas-carbone toujours plus sûr, plus propre et plus économique. \n\n Au sein du service Contrats & Projets France, vous intégrerez l’équipe Quality Events, en charge du traitement des événements qualité et des non-conformités de fabrication affectant les produits combustibles destinés à l’industrie nucléaire. Le traitement de ces événements nécessite de collecter et d’analyser des informations techniques provenant de différents interlocuteurs, d’identifier et formaliser les causes des événements, puis de constituer des dossiers de traitement structurés et argumentés à destination notamment des clients. Dans un contexte de développement de l’utilisation de l’Intelligence Artificielle et des outils numériques au service de la Qualité, l’équipe dispose déjà de premiers outils d’assistance à la rédaction basés sur l’IA. L’objectif du stage sera d’accompagner l’équipe Quality Events dans l’amélioration, la fiabilisation et le déploiement de ces outils afin d’automatiser autant que possible certaines étapes de constitution et de rédaction des dossiers d’analyse des événements qualité, tout en garantissant la pertinence et la qualité des documents produits. À ce titre, en collaboration étroite avec les membres de l’équipe Quality Events, vous serez amené(e) à : vous familiariser avec le processus de traitement des événements qualité et des non-conformités produit ; comprendre la structure, le contenu et les exigences associés aux dossiers d’analyse des événements qualité ; analyser les pratiques actuelles de collecte d’informations, d’analyse et de rédaction des dossiers ; prendre en main, évaluer les outils d’IA déjà existants au sein de l’équipe ; identifier leurs limites et proposer des améliorations permettant d’accroître la pertinence, la fiabilité et la qualité rédactionnelle des contenus générés ; travailler sur l’optimisation des instructions données aux outils d’IA (prompt engineering), notamment pour obtenir des documents techniques structurés, factuels et adaptés aux exigences du domaine nucléaire ; développer ou contribuer au développement de nouveaux outils informatiques d’aide à l’analyse et à la rédaction ; tester les solutions sur des cas représentatifs ou des événements qualité déjà traités et comparer les résultats obtenus avec les dossiers de référence ; proposer des méthodologies permettant de fiabiliser et standardiser l’utilisation des outils par les membres de l’équipe ; contribuer à la génération, la relecture et l’amélioration de documents techniques en français et en anglais ; formaliser les bonnes pratiques d’utilisation et accompagner leur appropriation par l’équipe. Vous préparez une formation de niveau Bac+4 / Bac+5, en école d’ingénieur ou cursus universitaire, avec une orientation qualité, génie industriel, mécanique, matériaux, procédés ou domaine technique équivalent. Une première sensibilisation à la qualité industrielle, à l’analyse des causes ou aux problématiques de non-conformité constitue un atout.
