items.desc: We are looking for an Earth Observation Solutions Engineer to join TERMA's team supporting EUMETSAT's Destination Earth Data Lake (DEDL) service in Darmstadt, Germany. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to one of Europe's most ambitious digital initiatives, working at the intersection of Earth Observation, cloud technologies, data engineering and Artificial Intelligence. About Destination Earth and the Data Lake: Destination Earth (DestinE) is a flagship initiative of the European Union aimed at developing highly accurate digital replicas of our planet. These Digital Twins will help monitor, simulate and predict interactions between natural phenomena and human activities, supporting better-informed decisions on climate change and environmental challenges. As part of this initiative, EUMETSAT is responsible for the Destination Earth Data Lake (DEDL), which provides federated access to data and digital twin services, alongside advanced cloud computing and AI/ML capabilities for users across Europe. The Role: As an Earth Observation Solutions Engineer, you will play a key role in the evolution of the DEDL architecture, data services and AI/ML capabilities. Working closely with EUMETSAT's technical teams and the wider DestinE community, you will help improve data access and interoperability, develop AI/ML-ready data pipelines and enable scalable processing across cloud and High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments. Your main responsibilities will include: Assessing and improving DEDL architecture, data flows, services and integration mechanisms. Supporting data federation, API standardisation, metadata harmonisation and interoperability. Contributing to the integration and validation of AI/ML services, platforms and demonstrators. Developing reproducible, AI/ML-ready data pipelines using Earth Observation and climate datasets. Supporting MLOps workflows, including data orchestration, experiment tracking, model management and deployment. Enabling scalable processing across cloud and HPC environments, including distributed computing and GPU resources. Advising users and data scientists on EO data access and AI/ML workflows. Preparing technical documentation, code examples and service reports, while collaborating with customer technical teams. What You Bring: A university degree (or equivalent) in Remote Sensing, Geoscience, Computer Science, Physics or a related field. At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on experience with satellite EO, EUMETSAT, Copernicus or meteorological data. Strong Python programming skills and experience with scientific data-processing libraries such as Xarray, Dask and GDAL. Good knowledge of EO data formats and standards, including NetCDF, GRIB, Zarr, COG, STAC and OGC. Experience with cloud platforms, data lakes, distributed data architectures and data federation. Practical experience in data engineering and preparing datasets for AI/ML applications. Familiarity with MLOps tools such as Airflow, MLflow and Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies. Experience with containerised environments, particularly Docker and Kubernetes. Understanding of HPC, distributed processing and scalable computing. Strong communication, technical documentation and stakeholder-management skills. Excellent command of English. Desirable Experience: Experience with Destination Earth (DestinE) and the DEDL service portfolio (HDA, ISLET, STACK and HOOK). Familiarity with AI Factories, Data Labs and Digital Twin environments. Experience with Slurm-based HPC, GPU orchestration and hybrid cloud infrastructures. Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD and end-to-end system integration. Experience with LLM-based applications, AI agents and MCP implementations. Previous involvement in ESA, EUMETSAT, Copernicus or European Commission projects. Working Location: This is a full-time position based at EUMETSAT's premises in Darmstadt, Germany , offering the opportunity to work directly within an international and highly specialised technical environment. What can Terma offer: At Terma, we consider skilled employees, enthusiasm and job satisfaction as the very foundation of our success and as a prerequisite for the development of the “best-in-class” solutions that Terma provides. We lead the way in applying new technology, offering a wide range of growth opportunities for each individual and emphasizing mutual respect across the board in our workplace. Terma offers you a pleasant working environment at the customer site, where you will be able to take on challenging tasks and responsibilities in a highly professional company. items.desc: Benvenuti in Fruttital Srl , azienda leader in Italia nella distribuzione di prodotti ortofrutticoli freschi di qualità eccellente. Siamo parte del Gruppo Orsero e il nostro mondo è vivace , sfidante e ricco di connessioni internazionali . Il Gruppo Orsero opera in tutta l'Europa mediterranea generando un fatturato di 1,7 miliardi di euro. Per il nostro team business solution siamo alla ricerca di un/una AI Solutions Engineer , che contribuirà allo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative basate sull'intelligenza artificiale, integrando modelli linguistici, dati aziendali e applicazioni software a supporto dei processi di business. Lavorerai allo sviluppo di soluzioni digitali e applicazioni AI-driven, contribuendo a rendere i dati e le tecnologie sempre più accessibili e utili per il business. In particolare, ti occuperai di : Progettare e sviluppare agenti AI, automazioni e assistenti intelligenti basati su modelli linguistici (LLM, es. Claude), integrandoli con i dati e i sistemi aziendali; Sviluppare e mantenere server MCP (Model Context Protocol), per consentire agli strumenti AI di interagire con il modello semantico e le informazioni aziendali; Collaborare con il team Data alla definizione del modello semantico, contribuendo alla strutturazione di metriche, definizioni e regole di calcolo; Testare e validare le risposte generate dagli strumenti AI, verificandone l'accuratezza e la coerenza rispetto ai dati e ai report ufficiali; Progettare e sviluppare applicazioni web full stack a supporto dei processi aziendali, occupandoti sia del front-end sia del back-end; Implementare servizi e API REST per l'integrazione tra applicazioni e sistemi, utilizzando tecnologie quali Node.js, .NET, Java o Python; Integrare le soluzioni sviluppate con i sistemi aziendali esistenti, tra cui ERP, gestionali HR e piattaforme di terze parti; Seguire l'intero ciclo di vita del software, dalla raccolta dei requisiti alla progettazione, sviluppo, test e rilascio, garantendo qualità del codice, documentazione, sicurezza e performance. Requirements Il/la candidato/a ideale ha maturato 2-3 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software , preferibilmente in ambito full stack o back-end, ed è interessato/a ad approfondire le applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale nei processi aziendali. In particolare, sono richieste: Esperienza nello sviluppo software e nella progettazione di applicazioni; Familiarità con l'utilizzo di modelli linguistici tramite API (es. Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), con particolare riferimento a prompt engineering, tool use e valutazione delle risposte; Buona conoscenza di Python o TypeScript e di almeno un framework front-end moderno (React, Angular o Vue); Conoscenza dei database relazionali, in particolare SQL Server e linguaggio T-SQL, e dei principi di progettazione delle API REST; Conoscenza di base dell'ambiente cloud Azure, con particolare riferimento ad Azure Functions e Blob Storage; Familiarità con sistemi di versionamento del codice (Git e TFVC) e strumenti di sviluppo assistito dall'intelligenza artificiale (es. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code). Costituiscono titolo preferenziale: Conoscenza del protocollo MCP (Model Context Protocol); Esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni basate su LLM e nell'integrazione di strumenti AI con sistemi e dati aziendali. Completano il profilo capacità di problem solving, curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie, autonomia operativa e predisposizione alla collaborazione e al lavoro in team. Benefits Inserimento in un contesto internazionale e dinamico, all'interno di un Gruppo in continua evoluzione; Opportunità di lavorare su progetti innovativi legati all'intelligenza artificiale e alla trasformazione digitale; Possibilità di contribuire concretamente allo sviluppo di nuove soluzioni tecnologiche a supporto del business; Orario di lavoro dal lunedì al venerdì; Possibilità di lavorare in modalità smart working. Sede di lavoro: Milano, Verona o Albenga. Range retributivo: 32.000€ - 42.000€ Il range retributivo non rispecchia pienamente le tue aspettative? Non lasciare che questo ti fermi: candidati comunque! Valuteremo con interesse il tuo profilo. Sei pronto/a a entrare nel mondo #FruitAdventurers? Il Gruppo Orsero promuove le pari opportunità e accoglie con favore le candidature di tutte le persone, nel rispetto del D.lgs. 198/2006. Le selezioni sono aperte a candidati e candidate di ogni età, genere, orientamento sessuale, origine, disabilità e convinzione personale.

items.desc: We are looking for a AWX Platform Engineer to join Ziggo Tech Services in Amsterdam, Netherlands. About the Role Help shape a modern, secure and increasingly AI-enabled digital workplace. As an AWX Platform Engineer, you will combine hands-on platform engineering with an automation-first mindset, improving the services employees rely on while reducing repetitive administration and making workplace technology simpler and more effective. Working across Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Freshworks, Atlassian Jira Cloud and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, you will engineer reliable solutions, strengthen governance and security, troubleshoot complex issues and turn emerging AI and agentic concepts into well-controlled production services. You will collaborate with Service Desk, Security, Infrastructure and business technology teams across a varied enterprise environment. What will you be doing? Administer, support and continuously improve Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Teams. Build reusable automation and integrations using PowerShell, Power Automate, APIs and the wider Power Platform. Administer and enhance Freshworks and Atlassian Jira Cloud, covering workflows, permissions, automation, integrations and reporting. Support Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, including security policies, monitoring, alert investigation, onboarding and vulnerability reduction. Identify practical opportunities for AI agents, Microsoft 365 Copilot and workflow automation to improve employee experience and operational efficiency. Use operational data, root cause analysis, documentation and platform lifecycle planning to drive continual service improvement. We tend to look for people with: Essential skills and abilities: Strong practical administration experience across Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Teams. Good knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, identity and access management, permissions, governance and policy management. Strong PowerShell skills, with practical experience of Power Automate, APIs and operational automation. Experience with Power Apps, Power Platform governance, environment management and troubleshooting. Practical experience of IT service management, including incident, request, problem and change management, and administering an ITSM platform. Desirable skills and abilities: Experience administering Atlassian Jira Cloud and designing scalable project, workflow, permission and reporting configurations. Knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Purview, Conditional Access and Zero Trust principles. Experience with Microsoft Graph API, Azure Automation, PowerShell 7, Dataverse or Power Platform application lifecycle management. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI agents or agentic workflows. Experience with Freshworks automation, integrations or endpoint vulnerability management. Who we are Ziggo Tech Services (ZTS), part of Ziggo Group and Liberty Global, is the technology engine behind Liberty Global's connectivity and entertainment platforms across Europe. Our experts design, build and operate the Connectivity, Entertainment, Cloud, Network, IT and digital workplace platforms that support millions of customers and enable some of Europe's leading telecommunications brands. Combining deep technical expertise with a culture of innovation, ZTS offers the opportunity to work on complex challenges, cutting-edge technologies, AI innovation and solutions that have real impact at international scale. Join us and help shape the future of connectivity, entertainment and digital experiences across Europe. We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone is respected, supported and able to perform at their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and circumstances and will provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process where requested.

items.desc: Who are we At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet. We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers. Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4 The role: Help shaping the future of digital products that advance science and knowledge! At Frontiers, we build digital products used by researchers, institutions, and partners worldwide. We are looking for an experienced Interaction Designer to join our Madrid team and take ownership of end-to-end user experiences — from first sketch to shipped product and beyond. You will work at the intersection of design, research, and strategy, turning complex problems into clear, intuitive experiences that deliver real value for users and the business. You will be responsible for planning, designing, and refining the user experience of our digital products throughout the full product lifecycle. Key Responsibilities: Plan, design, and refine the user experience for digital products across the full product lifecycle. Lead end-to-end interaction design, translating ideas and requirements into user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity interfaces using tools such as Figma. Advocate for and implement user-centred design principles, ensuring consistent and scalable solutions. Conduct user research using qualitative and quantitative methods, analyse findings, and iterate designs based on evidence and user feedback. Facilitate workshops with stakeholders to clarify product and user needs. Work closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders, acting as a change agent for user-centred design within the team. Deliver high-quality design and research outputs independently and support the broader UX team. Requirements 3–5 years' experience in interaction design, UX, or frontend development. Relevant education background in Interaction Design, User Experience, Psychology, Ergonomics, or a comparable field. Strong skills and experience in interaction design, user research methods. Ability to plan and organize user research sessions from recruitment to reporting. Proficient in Figma for interface design and prototyping. Familiar with basic web technologies (HTML, CSS) to collaborate effectively with engineers. Excellent communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus. Collaborative and proactive, with the ability to work both in the team and independently. Learning mindset: open to learning from colleagues, stakeholders, and users. Benefits We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support) Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision) Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

items.desc: We're looking for a Student Digital Designer with an AI Focus to join our Hive student lab and explore what happens when great design, curious minds and AI come together. Hive is Humblebee's multidisciplinary student lab. It's a place to experiment, challenge assumptions, learn by doing and turn promising ideas into digital services people actually want to use. This time, we're putting AI at the heart of what we build. Not just as a tool to help us work faster, but as part of the service itself. Think intelligent features, AI-powered experiences and agents that can take on meaningful tasks and create real value for users. We're looking for someone who loves exploring ideas, understanding people and making things tangible. Someone who sees design as more than making things look good, and is curious about how AI creates new possibilities for products, services and interactions. Someone who enjoys moving between user insights, creative exploration and hands-on prototyping to shape experiences that feel useful, intuitive and delightful. Sound like your kind of challenge? What is Hive about? Together with a partner company, the Hive team will explore an opportunity space, uncover real user needs and identify where an AI-powered digital service could make a difference. You'll be part of a small student team consisting of Software AI Engineers, Designers with an AI focus and AI tools. Together you'll combine technical exploration, user insights and creative thinking to take an idea from the first question to a tangible, testable service. The goal isn't to add AI just because we can. It's to find the right problems to solve and design the right experiences around them. What will you be doing? At Humblebee, we believe in learning by doing. You'll be involved throughout the process, from exploring early ideas to designing and testing a working digital service. Here's what that might look like: Explore the problem. Work with the team to understand users, their needs and the opportunities worth pursuing. Imagine new possibilities. Explore how AI can create new ways for people to interact with digital services. Think beyond traditional interfaces and challenge what a digital experience could look like when AI becomes part of it. Design AI-powered experiences. Shape how people interact with intelligent features, LLMs and AI agents. Explore how to make AI-powered services feel useful, understandable, trustworthy and intuitive. Prototype with AI. Use AI tools as a natural part of your design process. Experiment with AI-assisted prototyping, generate ideas, explore different directions and bring concepts to life faster than ever. Make ideas tangible. Move between sketches, user flows, wireframes and interactive prototypes. Work closely with Software AI Engineers to explore what's technically possible and turn promising ideas into working experiences. Prototype, test and iterate. Get ideas into users' hands early, learn from what happens and keep improving what you design. Create something delightful. We care about the details. The goal isn't just to make something that works, but to create a useful, intuitive and well-crafted digital experience that people enjoy using. You won't be expected to know everything from day one. But we do hope you're curious, willing to experiment and excited to explore what design can become in an AI-driven world. Who are you? You might be a student in interaction design, UX/UI design, service design or product design . What matters most is that you have a good understanding of design principles, an interest in UI design and design systems, a passion for understanding people, and a genuine curiosity about AI. We want someone who's genuinely interested in how AI is changing the way we design digital services and what new possibilities that creates. You enjoy experimenting, making ideas tangible and learning by doing. You're comfortable not having all the answers and see prototyping as a way to think, explore and learn. You won't be doing it alone You'll work right in the heart of the Humblebee office, surrounded by people who design, build and rethink digital services every day. You'll also get a personal mentor from our team of experienced Humblebees, matched to your skills. You'll have room to experiment, make mistakes, ask questions and learn from people who are just as curious about the future of digital products as you are. The practical stuff Period: January 25 - May 28. Location: Our office in Gothenburg. Time commitment: In previous Hive projects, students have dedicated 80% of their time to the project and used the remaining 20% to work on their thesis. If you're looking to connect your studies or thesis to a real-world project, we're open to exploring how that could work. Compensation: Please note that this is an unpaid internship. Humblebee is a multilingual company, so please send your application in English. We're looking forward to meeting you and seeing what we could design …

items.desc: Build products that make installations easier What should we build next, and will it actually make life easier for the people using it? As a Product Engineer at Done.green, you’ll help answer those questions and turn the answers into working features. Done.green builds technology that makes sustainable energy installations easier, including EV chargers and home batteries. Our platform is serving customers from brands such as Tesla, Volvo and Charge Amps in Sweden, and we’re expanding into more countries. At the heart of our operations is our Flutter app, used by both customers and installers to manage installations. We’re looking for an engineer with a strong product sense and technical foundation who enjoys understanding people & business and building products with AI agents. You’ll work across our stack, with the Flutter app as your main focus and area of ownership. You might be a recent graduate with projects to show, or have a few years of experience as an engineer. Your role You’ll take features from the first conversation with a user through to release and follow-up. That means you’ll: Talk directly with customers and installers. Work alongside our operations team to understand where we can help users and what would make their experience easier. Find the problem behind the feature request. Build and ship across the stack. Use AI agents inside our software factory to deliver complete features, from the app experience to backend logic and internal tools. Apply your technical judgment to guide the work, review the results and make sure the pieces work together. Own the app experience. Make our Flutter app clearer and easier to use for both customers and installers, while making changes elsewhere in the platform when that’s what solving the problem requires. Improve the factory . Inspect agent threads, evaluate new models & work with our engineering lead to improve our software factory. Think beyond the next release. Connect product decisions to our business goals and longer-term strategy as we grow across markets. You’ll join a tight development team and work closely with Alek Åström, co-founder of Done, Frederik, our VP of Engineering, and our operations team, who speak with customers and installers every day. Building with our software factory We’re investing heavily in an internal software factory, currently built around T3 Code and Paperclip. Our aim is to let agents handle more of the repetitive development work, giving us more time to understand problems and design better solutions. As writing code becomes faster, deciding what to build becomes even more important. Your contribution will be to define useful features, care about the details of the user experience and make sound technical and product decisions. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand, question and improve what the agents build across the stack. You’ll also help us improve how we work with the Software Factory, alongside Frederik, who leads its development. We think you’ll thrive if you Have a strong foundation in software development and enjoy working across the stack to solve a problem. Have hands-on experience building mobile apps, through work, studies or your own projects. We use Flutter, but you don’t need to be a Flutter specialist. Are curious about agentic AI development and want to get good at directing agents, evaluating their output and understanding the systems they work in. Enjoy talking to users, asking follow-up questions and understanding their day-to-day problems. Care about UX and can turn a messy workflow into something clear and easy to use. Think creatively about user value while considering what makes sense for the business over time. This is a mid-level role but we are also open to junior engineers. Show us something you’ve built and how you thought about the people using it. Our stack App: Flutter and Dart for iOS, Android and web across mobile and desktop. Backend: Firebase / Google Cloud, Firestore and TypeScript + Effect + Node.js Cloud Functions. Backoffice: React with Tanstack and MaterialUI Software Factory: T3 Code, Paperclip, CodeRabbit, Blacksmith with an evolving agentic development workflow. The app is your primary product responsibility, and you’ll use the whole stack to deliver the right solution. What you’ll get Ownership of features and direct contact with the people using them. Close collaboration with the founders, experienced engineers and operations. The chance to help shape both our product and how we build software. Stock options as part of the compensation Apply Tell us briefly why this role appeals to you and show us something you’ve built. What problem were you trying to solve, what did you choose to build, and why? We’d love to hear what you learned from the people using it and, if you used AI agents, how you guided and checked their work.

items.desc: Clinical Data Reviewer Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress. Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape. Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need. Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know: Why Syneos Health We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program. We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life. Job Responsibilities Must have CRA experience in various Therapeutical areas. Oncology would be an advantage The Clinical Reviewer (CR) is a specialized role that performs clinical review, typically ahead of significant project milestones (interim analysis, study closeout, submission etc.). The studies supported by the CR are often, but not exclusively, comparative safety and efficacy (Phase 3) trials with large, multi-faceted data sets. The review tasks performed by this role include both point-to-point clinical review checks and interpretive analysis such as reviewing data for submission, highlighting errors, raising queries etc. from a clinical perspective. The CR will work as an extension of the clinician/clinical scientist and will be responsible for the clinical review of one or more studies with the ability to move easily from project to project as necessary. This requires that the CR be knowledgeable about the therapeutic area under investigation, expected effects of the investigational drug and concomitant medications, and possess sufficient clinical knowledge to assess if data is scientifically and clinically valid. Working alongside senior architects and engineers — and increasingly leading your own workstreams — you apply proven skills in coding, testing, configuring, deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting AI systems and the infrastructure they run on. Deploy AI systems, models, and data pipelines into production, defining and improving the processes and best practices others follow. Lead container orchestration and model serving using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and model deployment frameworks. Integrate AI models and systems into existing enterprise systems, ensuring interoperability, security, and regulatory compliance. Own AI monitoring and infrastructure health across InfraOps and MLOps, tracking performance, reliability, and utilization, and driving remediation. Independently troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across the computational stack — hardware, networking, software, and models — and lead root-cause analysis. items.desc: Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work. Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual. Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate. A bit about us: We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on. Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision. We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date. We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster. Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one. Role Overview We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to own the security of Orbital's product: the AI agent our customers use, the platform it runs on, and how we build both. Our customers are law firms and real estate businesses. They trust us with confidential transaction documents, and they ask hard questions about how we protect them. Our product is an AI agent that reads those documents, calls tools and runs code on a lawyer's behalf. That brings the usual cloud security work and a newer set of risks: prompt injection, agents acting on untrusted input, and attackers using AI to move faster than before. You'll be our first in-house product security engineer, taking on work we have so far relied on contractors for. You'll build security into the product rather than review it from outside: you'll decide how we rate a vulnerability and how fast we act on it, build the automated systems that find and fix issues before an attacker does, and set the security bar that engineering builds to. You'll work alongside our product engineers, with the authority to require changes across teams on security grounds, independent of any one team's delivery deadlines. An information security lead will own company-wide policy, compliance and customer assurance, and you'll work closely with them. You won't start from zero. Our AWS environment follows the Well-Architected Framework, with GuardDuty, Security Hub, encryption at rest and scoped credentials in place, and we hold SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments to our customers. What we need is someone to own it, find the gaps, and raise the standard as the company and the threat landscape grow. You'll get a chance to Build an automated security harness. Put agents to work on our product: continuous red-team and blue-team loops that probe the agent, the platform and our code, find vulnerabilities, and propose or ship the fix. Manual review should be justified when required and automatic harness improvement is expected. Own vulnerability management end to end. Define how we classify severity and the response time each level demands, so a critical CVE gets fixed the same day. Automate patching, dependency and image scanning, and make sure findings reach an owner and get closed. Secure an AI agent in production. Threat-model how our agent handles untrusted documents, emails and web content, and the tools and sandboxes it uses. Design defences against prompt injection and data exfiltration, and test them. Make security part of how we build. Review designs and changes that touch authentication, tenant isolation, secrets and data handling. Turn recurring findings into automated checks so the protection holds without depending on someone remembering. Respond to security incidents. Lead the technical response when something goes wrong: containment, investigation and the fix. Build the technical side of our breach playbooks with our information security lead, and run the review afterwards. Choose and run our security tooling. Evaluate and roll out a cloud security platform (such as Wiz) and the detection, alerting and logging we need across AWS and Azure. As our only product security specialist, use tooling and AI agents to cover more …

items.desc: Développement et évaluation d’un Virtual Companion scientifique basé sur les LLMs et les systèmes agentiques Les avancées récentes des modèles de langage à grande échelle (LLMs) et des systèmes d’intelligence artificielle agentique ouvrent de nouvelles perspectives pour l’assistance aux activités scientifiques. Au-delà des assistants conversationnels classiques, les agents d’IA sont désormais capables de raisonner sur des problèmes complexes, rechercher et analyser des informations, utiliser des outils logiciels, exploiter différentes sources de données et coordonner plusieurs tâches afin d’atteindre un objectif. Dans ce contexte émerge le concept de Virtual Companion scientifique, un partenaire numérique capable de collaborer avec un chercheur tout au long d’un processus scientifique : exploration de l’état de l’art, analyse de publications et de données, formulation d’hypothèses, préparation d’expériences, utilisation d’outils scientifiques, interprétation des résultats et génération de synthèses ou de recommandations. Un tel système doit cependant aller au-delà de la simple interaction avec un LLM. Il nécessite notamment des mécanismes de raisonnement, de planification, de mémoire, d’accès aux outils et aux données, d’orchestration de tâches et d’interaction humain–IA , tout en assurant la traçabilité et la fiabilité des résultats produits. Objectifs du stage L’objectif principal du stage est d’étudier, concevoir et développer un prototype de Virtual Companion scientifique capable d’assister un utilisateur dans la réalisation de différentes tâches liées à une démarche de recherche scientifique. Le stage visera dans un premier temps à analyser l’état de l’art des agents scientifiques basés sur les LLMs et des nouvelles architectures agentiques. Cette étude permettra d’identifier les principales capacités nécessaires à un Virtual Companion scientifique ainsi que les architectures et technologies permettant de les implémenter. Dans un second temps, vous proposerez et développerez une architecture permettant au Virtual Companion de comprendre un objectif scientifique, décomposer un problème en différentes tâches, rechercher et exploiter des informations, utiliser des outils ou des données et interagir avec le chercheur lorsque son expertise ou sa validation est nécessaire. Enfin, le prototype développé sera évalué sur plusieurs scénarios représentatifs d'activités scientifiques afin d’étudier sa pertinence, sa fiabilité, son autonomie et la qualité de la collaboration entre l’humain et le système. Vos missions État de l’art Étudier les approches récentes autour des LLMs, des agents autonomes, des AI Scientists et des systèmes de type AI Co-Scientist. Analyser les architectures agentiques permettant le raisonnement, la planification, la mémoire et l’utilisation d’outils. Étudier les approches multi-agents et les mécanismes de coordination entre plusieurs agents spécialisés. Identifier les méthodes permettant l’intégration du chercheur dans la boucle de décision ainsi que les mécanismes de traçabilité et d’explicabilité. Conception du Virtual Companion scientifique Identifier les principales fonctions nécessaires à l’accompagnement d’une démarche scientifique. Définir une architecture permettant de combiner LLMs, mémoire, outils, données scientifiques et mécanismes d’orchestration. Définir les interactions entre le Virtual Companion, les éventuels agents spécialisés et le chercheur. Mettre en place des mécanismes permettant au système de solliciter la validation ou l’expertise humaine lorsque nécessaire. Développement d’un prototype Implémenter le Virtual Companion scientifique à l’aide de technologies récentes basées sur les LLMs et les systèmes agentiques. Intégrer différentes capacités telles que la recherche documentaire, l’analyse d’informations, la génération d’hypothèses, l’utilisation d’outils ou l’analyse de résultats. Développer des mécanismes de mémoire et de gestion du contexte permettant au système de suivre une activité scientifique sur plusieurs étapes. Permettre au Virtual Companion d’orchestrer plusieurs tâches ou agents spécialisés selon le problème traité. Expérimentation et évaluation Définir plusieurs scénarios scientifiques permettant d’évaluer le prototype. Comparer différentes architectures ou stratégies d’orchestration. Évaluer notamment la qualité des résultats, la robustesse, le coût, le temps d’exécution, la traçabilité et le niveau d’intervention humaine nécessaire. Identifier les limites du système et proposer des pistes d’amélioration. Résultats attendus À l’issue du stage, les principaux résultats attendus sont : un état de l’art des Virtual Companions scientifiques et des systèmes agentiques appliqués aux activités de recherche ; une architecture de référence décrivant les différentes capacités du Virtual Companion et leurs interactions ; un prototype fonctionnel démontrant plusieurs capacités d’assistance scientifique ; plusieurs scénarios expérimentaux permettant d’évaluer …

items.desc: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Omniwatt Energy ist die Strom-Unit von Enpal und macht saubere Energie für jeden Haushalt zugänglich – vom günstigsten Stromtarif Deutschlands bis hin zu intelligenten Energielösungen, die Erzeugung, Speicherung und Verbrauch optimal vernetzen. Mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und einem schnell wachsenden Kundenstamm bauen wir ein Team, das den deutschen Energiemarkt aktiv mitgestaltet. Dabei verbinden wir Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Skalierung eines Marktführers – über alle Bereiche hinweg, von Operations und Technologie über Finance und Customer Support bis hin zu Produktentwicklung. Deine Aufgaben Als Praktikant:in im Tech Venture Development bei Enpal Energy arbeitest du an einer zentralen Frage: Wie können wir unser Geschäft mit smarter Technologie skalieren? Im Mittelpunkt steht unser Virtual Power Plant. Wir vernetzen Haushalte mit ihren Solaranlagen, Speichern und Wärmepumpen zu einem intelligenten Kraftwerk und handeln ihren Strom smart am Energiemarkt. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Ops und Tech. Dabei bringst du AI-Lösungen, die unser virtuelles Kraftwerk skalierbar machen, vom Prototyp in den echten Betrieb. Eigene Projekte: Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für eigene Projekte, von der Problemanalyse über die Lösungsfindung bis zum Go-live. AI Agents & Automatisierung: Du übersetzt Business Needs in konkrete Lösungen. Du baust Agents, Workflows und Automatisierungen mit No-Code-, Low-Code- und AI-Tools und bringst sie in den Betrieb. Impact messbar machen: Du bereitest Daten auf, baust Dashboards und lieferst damit die Grundlage für Entscheidungen. Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen, unter anderem Ops und Tech, und treibst Initiativen über Teamgrenzen hinweg voran. Dein Profil Du studierst an der Schnittstelle von Business und Tech, z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder hast in Studium und Praktika beide Welten kennengelernt. Du hast mindestens ein relevantes Praktikum abgeschlossen, z. B. in einem Start-up, in der Beratung oder im Venture Building. Du arbeitest gern mit Tools wie Claude, Cursor, Airtable, Make, n8n, Power BI, Snowflake oder SQL oder arbeitest dich schnell in neue Technologien ein. Du denkst analytisch und findest pragmatische Lösungen, die auf Fakten beruhen. Du übernimmst Ownership und wartest nicht auf perfekte Rahmenbedingungen. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du bist mindestens 4 Monate verfügbar. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. items.desc: Date Posted: 2026-10-20 Country: France Location: FR-OCC-BLAGNAC-BAT CASS ~ 4 Ave Didier Daurat ~ DAURAT Position Role Type: Unspecified Avec 80 000 salariés répartis sur plus de 250 sites dans le monde et un chiffre d’affaires de 26, 2 milliards de dollars, Collins Aerospace se positionne en leader sur le marché des solutions de technologies avancées et intelligentes pour l’industrie mondiale de l’aéronautique et de la défense. Chez Collins nous redéfinissons l’aérospatial ! Présente en France depuis 1959, Collins Aerospace Avionics et Mission Systems en France conçoit, développe et produit des solutions innovantes et de hautes intégrités pour ses clients des secteurs aéronautique et défense. Centre d’excellence du groupe Collins Aerospace dans les domaines de l’avionique (conduite de vol, communication et navigation, sécurité des vols) et des solutions de communications (des très basses fréquences aux communications satellitaires), Collins Aerospace Avionics et Mission Systems en France accompagne ses clients en Europe et dans le monde tout au long du cycle de vie des produits ; depuis les phases de Recherche et Développement (R&D), jusqu’à leur exploitation, en s’appuyant sur l’expertise de ses équipes d’ingénierie, de gestion de programmes, de production, de distribution et de maintenance. Missions : Utilisation de l’Intelligence Artificielle (IA) dans les activités de certification avionique. Dans le domaine de l’aéronautique, le développement de systèmes et équipements avioniques est soumis à des standards (DO-178C pour le logiciel/software, DO-254 pour le matériel/hardware, ARP-4754B pour les systèmes), définis comme moyens de conformité acceptables aux exigences règlementaires internationales. Les processus décrits dans ces standards nécessitent la production, la vérification et la justification de nombreux documents techniques (plans, spécifications, rapports de vérification, etc.). Les activités et les démonstrations de conformité sont rassemblées dans des résumés de conformité (Accomplishment Summaries), documents soumis pour approbation aux autorités de certification compétentes. Il est donc très important d’apporter beaucoup d’attention à la rédaction de ces documents. Cependant, le travail de synthèse est lourd et long, compte tenu de la grande quantité d’informations à récolter, trier, analyser, et valider. L’émergence de l’intelligence artificielle (IA) ouvre de nouvelles perspectives pour soutenir ces activités en automatisant certaines tâches de compilation, d’analyse et de vérification documentaire, tout en maintenant les exigences de traçabilité et de rigueur règlementaire. L’objectif du stage est d’étudier et de prototyper des outils d’assistance basés sur l’IA générative augmentée par récupération (RAG) pour faciliter les activités de certification avionique. Parmi les nombreux sujets que l’on peut imaginer, un des axes proposés sera d’étudier la compilation automatique d’un résumé de conformité (Accomplishment Summary) en exploitant des modèles d’IA pour identifier, extraire et synthétiser les informations clés issues de multiples sources documentaires (plans, rapports, matrices de traçabilité, revues, etc.). Le stage s’organisera en différentes phases : Phase 1 : L’analyse des besoins et contraintes de certification avionique. Phase 2 : L’identification des cas d’usage pertinents pour l’IA générative. Phase 3 : Le développement d’un prototype d’outil d’assistance à la rédaction du résumé de conformité, incluant la mise en place de l’environnement ainsi que de la base documentaire associée. Phase 4 : L’évaluation des performances et des limites de l’approche. Phase 5 : La formalisation des résultats sous forme d’un manuel utilisateur détaillé et la présentation des résultats à l’ensemble du service. Durée du stage : 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027 en présentiel sur le site de Blagnac Profil : Master Formation : Ecole d’ingénieur en informatique Compétences clés : Compétences en développement Logiciel, langages de Scripting (Python) et en solutions d’IA en local (TensorFlow, Pytorch, Ollama, ...). Compétences dans la manipulation de Large Language Models (LLM) et en traitement du langage naturel (NLP). Connaissance conseillée du contexte aéronautique, des systèmes embarqués et des processus de certification avionique (DO-178C, DO-254, ARP-4754B). Esprit d’analyse, curiosité technologique, autonomie, capacité à travailler en équipe. What You Will Do Discover and prioritize: Work directly with assurance teams to understand complex business challenges, assess digitalization potential and independently identify and prioritize software, data and AI use cases with clear business value Shape the digital landscape: Translate functional needs from Audit, Internal Controls, Enterprise Risk Management and Project Excellence into scalable solution concepts and actively shape the strategic digitalization and technology landscape for FIN A. Engineer solutions end to end: Take technical ownership from solution design and architecture through development and integration to productive deployment, ensuring secure, scalable, maintainable and user-centered solutions. Build with modern technologies: Lead and coordinate the development of modular applications, interfaces and data flows using technologies such as Python, Snowflake, Azure cloud and low-code platforms such as Mendix. Shape and apply AI strategically: Co-create the AI strategy for FIN A and translate it into practice by designing and introducing GenAI applications, AI agents and agentic workflows with appropriate governance, guardrails and control mechanisms. Move solutions into production: Drive validated prototypes and MVPs towards production-ready solutions together with Product Owners and DevSecOps partners, making sound technical decisions and actively managing dependencies, risks and trade-offs. Design for scale and reuse: Define reusable solution patterns and components that can be transferred across assurance teams and integrated sustainably into the existing application landscape. Drive adoption and measurable impact: Enable data- and AI-driven transformation across FIN A, measure delivered business value, continuously improve solutions and systematically transfer knowledge and capabilities to assurance teams. What You Bring Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a can-do mindset and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar assurance processes, practitioner needs and business contexts, and translate them into meaningful opportunities and solutions A master's degree in computer science, business informatics, data science, engineering or a comparable field. At least 5+ years of hands-on experience in software development, data engineering, analytics or AI engineering, ideally in an enterprise environment. Strong expertise in several relevant technologies, such as Python, Azure cloud &AI stack, Snowflake, Mendix or comparable platforms. Practical experience building and introducing GenAI applications, AI agents or agentic workflows. A sound understanding of software architecture, data models, testing, version control, DevSecOps and lifecycle management. A strong ownership mind set and confidence working directly with auditors and other assurance practitioners, and communicating technical options, decisions and trade-offs clearly to Product Owners and management. Experience with audit, risk, controls or comparable assurance processes is an advantage. Alternatively, you can demonstrate strong process expertise and the ability to build assurance knowledge quickly. Curiosity, ownership and a strong willingness to learn in a continuously evolving technology environment. Business-fluent German and English. What Success Looks Like Measurable improvements in assurance quality, coverage, productivity or risk transparency Solutions that move beyond prototypes, are used in production and are continuously improved. Secure, scalable and reusable software, data and AI components. Strong user adoption and sustainable capability building across assurance teams.

items.desc: Vil du udvikle AI-løsninger til millioner af brugere? Så er du måske vores nye kollega. I Jyske Bank arbejder vi bl.a. med at udvikle og integrere AI i vores digitale løsninger på tværs af netbank, mobilbank og vores websites. Vi ser ikke AI som et lag mellem mennesker, men som en teknologi, der kan forbedre relationen og øge kundeværdien. Vi søger en AI-udvikler med solid erfaring, som får en central rolle i udviklingen af vores udviklingsteams. Hver måned anvender flere millioner mennesker Jyske Banks digitale services. Derfor har vi brug for endnu en kollega, der kan være med til at sikre, at vores løsninger ikke bare fungerer – men bliver endnu mere intelligente og skaber værdi for vores kunder. Jobbet – til dagligt I det daglige vil du være en del af et af vores AI-teams, hvor vi arbejder med at udvikle og implementere intelligente løsninger, der understøtter både kunder og rådgivere. Du får en central rolle i design, udvikling og implementering af den generative del af projekterne. Du bidrager både til tekniske beslutninger, eksperimenter, produktionssætning og hjælper med at omsætte forretningsbehov til løsninger, der skaber værdi for kunder og rådgivere. Du kommer blandt andet til at: Designe og implementere AI-løsninger baseret på LLM’er, RAG og AI-agenter. Udvikle og evaluere prompts, guardrails og AI-assisterede beslutningsmodeller. Etablere framework for AI-evaluering, kvalitetssikring og måling af AI-output. Integrere AI-løsninger med eksisterende API'er, datakilder og procesværktøjer. Facilitere discovery af use cases og afklaring af business value vs. teknisk feasibility. Sparre med Full-stack udviklere, UX’ere, arkitekter, forretningsspecialister og vores andre enheder, der arbejder med AI. Området og afdelingen I det daglige vil du være i vores område Digital Salg og Relation i Silkeborg, hvor vi arbejder med digitalt salg, innovation og udvikling i vores kundevendte digitale kanaler – net- og mobilbank og vores websites. Der arbejdes ikke bare med hver kanal, men også alle de services, applikationer og systemer, der binder dem sammen og beriger dem. Afdelingen i området er ”Digital Innovation”, der samarbejder med forskellige udviklings- og strategiske enheder i banken om at forbedre og udvikle vores digitale univers. Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt team, hvor AI-specialister, softwareudviklere, UX-designere og forretningsspecialister arbejder tæt sammen. Teamet forener solid teknisk kunnen med en nysgerrig og eksperimenterende tilgang, så idéer hurtigt bliver til konkrete løsninger med tydelig forretningsværdi. Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du har: Erfaring med sikkerhed, compliance og governance omkring AI Erfaring med agentiske AI-løsninger Erfaring med dokumentanalyse og kvalitetskontroller Erfaring med cloud-native arkitektur Minimum 5 års erfaring med softwareudvikling Personlige egenskaber: Kan omsætte komplekse teknologier til konkrete forretningsmæssige gevinster Pragmatisk og leveranceorienteret Dygtig facilitator og sparringspartner Trives i tværfaglige teams og arbejder med kompetenceforankring Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med: Azure OpenAI, OpenAI eller tilsvarende enterprise LLM-platforme. RAG-arkitektur Store dataplatforme som Databricks, Google BigQuery eller lignende Agentic AI / Agent-arkitekturer Context Engineering – Caching strategier, memory management og tokenoptimering Privacy og regulering angående sikker håndtering af data i AI-løsninger Du har praktisk erfaring med cloud services og backend udvikling AI-evaluering og teststrategier Ansøgning I Jyske Bank koncernen mener vi, at diversitet skaber bedre beslutninger og relationer samt et mere varieret arbejdsmiljø. Vi arbejder aktivt for inklusion og lige muligheder og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge. Ansøgningsfristen er den 25 november. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet. HR-partner Line Elkjær Poulsen og leder Nisaani Karunaharan vil tage sig af ansøgningerne. Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV og en kort motivation for, hvorfor netop denne rolle tiltaler dig.

items.desc: About Digital Futures Digital Futures is an AI services and software company that specialises in accelerating AI transformation and enabling AI governance for enterprise and government. The Role We are looking for an experienced consultant who can design the architecture, build working systems, and take them from demo to a scaled, governed deployment inside a regulated financial institution. This is a hands-on build role, not an advisory one. The successful candidate will combine practical agentic AI engineering with knowledge graph and entity-resolution experience, and will be comfortable operating within a bank’s control environment. Key Responsibilities Architecture design - Design and deploy agentic AI workflows to automate investment sourcing, market research, due diligence and document generation. - Design and maintain a venture intelligence knowledge graph covering companies, founders, investors and transactions. - Define AI architecture, data governance, provenance and quality standards across internal and external data sources. Agent development - Develop AI agents to analyse companies, markets and investment opportunities using structured and unstructured data. - Build automated diligence workflows that extract, validate and synthesise information from pitch decks, financials, research reports and industry databases. - Develop portfolio intelligence capabilities to monitor performance, financing activity, competitive developments and strategic risks. - Integrate with approved internal and external data sources, including CRM, market data and portfolio management platforms. Production and governance - Deploy and optimise RAG, agent orchestration and knowledge graph services within the bank’s approved technology environment. - Implement monitoring and evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, quality, cost and operational performance. - Ensure solutions are secure, auditable and reproducible. Experience and Profile - Strong experience in software, AI or data engineering, including the design and delivery of production-grade solutions. - Proven track record of building and deploying agentic AI systems in production environments. - Strong Python development and API integration experience. - Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic search and retrieval systems. - Familiarity with MCP and related tool integration standards. - Experience deploying solutions on AWS or GCP. Benefits We offer a competitive salary. Our benefits package is designed to support your wellbeing and development. This includes: - Group Life Assurance - Virtual GP and Online Physiotherapy - Confidential Helpline/Employee Assistance Programme - Wellbeing Studio & Digital Gym - Discounted shopping cards, e-vouchers & cashback offers - Percentage discounts & savings on brands online & in store - Statutory pension contribution - salary exchange scheme - 30 days annual leave, including UK Bank Holidays Why Join Us Digital Futures consultants deliver solutions across the full data and AI transformation lifecycle, from strategy, analytics and engineering through to adoption, governance and assurance. We’re focused on creating opportunity in the age of AI. Joining Digital Futures means joining an organisation making a real impact in delivering an AI-first future, at whatever stage of your career.

items.desc: Hey du! Du möchtest nicht einfach mit bestehenden Anwendungen arbeiten, sondern moderne AI-gestützte Lösungen von Grund auf mitgestalten? Du hast Lust, deine technische Expertise einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dabei maßgeblich zu prägen, wie wir AI zukünftig sinnvoll in unseren Anwendungen und Prozessen einsetzen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Bei ambelin dreht sich alles um unsere Mieterinnen und Mieter. Unser Ziel ist es, Wohnen neu und vor allem mieterorientiert zu denken. Wir wollen sicherstellen, dass alle, die bei uns wohnen, das Gefühl haben, sich auf uns verlassen zu können – jederzeit. Mieterzufriedenheit ist für uns nicht nur ein Schlagwort, sondern unsere Mission. Unseren Mieterinnen und Mietern ist es insbesondere wichtig, dass wir Anliegen effizienter bearbeiten, schneller auf Fragen reagieren und noch bessere Lösungen bieten. Damit wir unsere Mission weiter vorantreiben können, möchten wir Prozesse mithilfe von AI schneller und intelligenter aufbauen. Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als AI Software Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du gemeinsam mit unseren internen und externen Umsetzungsstakeholdern moderne Anwendungen und AI-gestützte Lösungen über den gesamten Lifecycle – von der Konzeption und Architektur über die Entwicklung bis hin zum produktiven Einsatz und der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung. Du hast die Möglichkeit, neue Ideen einzubringen und mitzugestalten, wie wir beispielsweise LLMs, AI Agents und andere AI-Technologien sinnvoll in unsere Produkte und Prozesse integrieren. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Levin , unserem Head of Technology, vor Ort in Berlin zusammen und hast die Möglichkeit, perspektivisch die technische Ownership für unsere AI-gestützten Anwendungen und deren Architektur zu übernehmen. DEINE MISSION: Du entwickelst neue Anwendungen und Lösungen auf Basis unserer zentralen Datenplattform , gestaltest deren Architektur und begleitest sie von der Idee bis zum skalierbaren, produktiven Betrieb. Du konzipierst AI-gestützte Lösungen , zum Beispiel mit LLMs, RAG-Systemen oder AI Agents. Du arbeitest hands-on an der Backend- und Integrationsentwicklung und entwickelst unsere Anwendungen gemeinsam mit internen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie externen Engineering-Partnerinnen und Partnern weiter. Du hinterfragst und prüfst technische Konzepte, Architekturentscheidungen und Aufwandsschätzungen unserer externen Stakeholdern und sorgst für eine technisch saubere Umsetzung. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Anwendungen zuverlässig und nachhaltig betrieben werden – mit automatisierten Tests, Code Reviews, CI/CD, Monitoring und guter Dokumentation . Du behältst Themen wie Sicherheit, Datenschutz, Zugriffskontrolle im Blick und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern in technische Lösungen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, gestaltest unsere technische Architektur und den Einsatz von AI aktiv mit und baust perspektivisch gemeinsam mit uns internes Engineering-Know-how auf. DAS BRINGST DU MIT: Du hast mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und hast Anwendungen bereits über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg mitentwickelt und produktiv betrieben . Du hast bereits Anwendungen oder Features mit AI entwickelt und produktiv eingesetzt – zum Beispiel mit LLMs, RAG, AI Agents oder vergleichbaren Technologien. Du verstehst nicht nur, wie man ein AI-Modell anbindet, sondern kannst AI-Lösungen sinnvoll in eine skalierbare und sichere Anwendungsarchitektur integrieren . Du bringst praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-nativer Entwicklung mit, idealerweise auf Microsoft Azure. Du kennst dich mit Themen wie Deployment, CI/CD, Testing, Monitoring, Security und dem zuverlässigen Betrieb von Anwendungen aus. Du fühlst dich in der Backend-Entwicklung zu Hause und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung mit Python sowie dem Design und der Entwicklung von APIs und Integrationen mit. Du kannst technische Konzepte und Architekturentscheidungen kritisch hinterfragen und deine Empfehlungen verständlich begründen. Du arbeitest gerne hands-on, übernimmst Verantwortung und hast gleichzeitig Lust, technische Themen strategisch mitzugestalten. Du kannst gut mit externen Entwicklungsstakeholdern zusammenarbeiten und behältst dabei Qualität, Architektur und langfristige Wartbarkeit im Blick. Du hast bereits mit modernen Frontend-Technologien gearbeitet, zum Beispiel TypeScript oder einem modernen Framework . Du kennst Workflow-Enablement-Tools und hast Erfahrung darin, technische Lösungen auch für andere Teams gut nutzbar zu machen. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (mind. B2 Niveau) und Englisch und kannst dich auch mit internationalen bzw. englischsprachigen Projektbeteiligten souverän zu technischen Themen abstimmen. Du wohnst in Berlin oder Umgebung , da bei uns viel im direkten Austausch vor Ort passiert. DAS BIETEN WIR: ambelin - ein Zuhause zum Wohlfühlen, das gilt nicht nur für unsere Mieter und Mieterinnen. items.desc: KI-Systeme bauen, integrieren und beim Mittelstand zum Laufen bringen. Du baust KI-Systeme, die wirklich laufen – RAG-Pipelines, Agenten, Automatisierungen. Und Du willst nicht im Backlog eines Produktteams verschwinden, sondern direkt beim Kunden sehen, was deine Lösung bewirkt. Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer bei Neurawork bist Du die technische Instanz in unseren Kundenprojekten im Mittelstand: Du verstehst die Prozesse des Kunden, entwirfst die Architektur, integrierst unsere Standardprodukte tief in seine Systemlandschaft und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende etwas produktiv läuft – nicht nur auf Folien existiert. Weil Du technisch weißt, wovon du sprichst, berätst du Kunden auf Augenhöhe – bis in die Geschäftsführung. Wir arbeiten nach unserem eigenen Operational-AI-Vorgehensmodell. Wir sind keine Automation-Agentur und keine Custom-Softwareentwickler: Wir setzen auf standardisierte Produkte als Hebel und passen sie bis zur vollständigen Integration an. Wir kreieren echten, messbaren Mehrwert – und stehen dafür ein. items.desc: Founded in Switzerland in 1968, Zühlke is owned by its partners and located across Europe and Asia. We are a global transformation partner, with engineering and innovation in our DNA. We're trusted to help clients envision and build their businesses for the future – to run smarter today while adapting for tomorrow’s markets, customers, and communities. Our multidisciplinary teams specialise in tech strategy and business innovation, digital solutions and applications, and device and systems engineering. We excel in complex, regulated spaces including health and finance, connecting strategy, tech implementation, and operational services to help clients become more effective, resilient businesses. If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey. The Role Zühlke is building its AI Factory: a production line for software in which AI agents turn an approved requirement into a verified change. People set the target, agents do the work, people assure the result. No agent approves, merges or deploys. Every quality gate produces evidence, and a named person decides. As an Agentic Software Engineer you join the core team that builds this system, takes it into client projects and pushes it to production. You own the outcome: what you build is used by client teams and delivers the value it was built for. You design the agents, the workflows that connect them and the gates that check their output. That includes the harness the agents work in and the loops that run until a gate lets the result pass. You will also build agents and agentic workflows beyond software delivery, for clients and for Zühlke itself. Tools and models change every few weeks in this field. We build on standard interfaces so that components can be swapped, and we expect you to enjoy that pace. How You Will Make an Impact Design and build multi-agent workflows with clear hand-offs, durable state and explicit failure handling. Engineer agent loops that refine, plan, implement and review until an independent, default-fail evaluator lets the result pass. You define stop conditions, retry budgets and which model runs which step. Engineer the context agents work with: tools and knowledge access over code, documentation and domain, using MCP. Engineer agent harnesses: instruction files (AGENTS.md), skills, custom agents, hooks and CI checks, each concern in the right layer. Rules that must always hold go into tests and hooks, not into prompts. Implement spec-driven development with traceability from requirement to code and test. Build quality gates that run deterministic checks first, then evals and AI judgement, and end with a human decision backed by evidence. The checker is never the producer: a separate test agent writes hidden acceptance tests. Harden agents against prompt injection and run them in isolated sandboxes with least-privilege access. Make agent behaviour observable and auditable: an audit trail of agent decisions, cost per task and lead-time metrics. This trail is the evidence that governance rules such as the EU AI Act ask for, from human oversight to logging. Work directly with client teams to take agents, harnesses and loops into their projects and push them to production. Own the value after go-live: agree with the client what a capability should deliver, measure whether teams use it and whether it delivers, and close the gap when it does not. What Is Important to Us At least seven years of professional software engineering, with a track record of owning code quality in production systems. You have built a working agentic system yourself, at work or in your free time, and use it to build software. In our selection process you demo it to the team, as a repository or live. Hands-on experience with agent orchestration: multi-agent workflows, hand-offs, state and failure handling. Experience with agent frameworks such as Claude Agent SDK, Azure AI Foundry or LangGraph. Experience with context engineering and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Experience with evals as quality gates and with guardrails against prompt injection, and with tracing agent runs in tools such as Langfuse. Working knowledge of responsible AI and AI governance, for example the EU AI Act obligations on human oversight, logging and documentation. Harness engineering for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or OpenAI Codex: you have written instruction files, skills, custom agents and hooks that a team relies on. Loop engineering: you have built agent loops with an independent evaluator, stop conditions and cost limits, and you can explain why a loop failed. Strong programming skills in Python or TypeScript; Java or .NET is a plus. Solid CI/CD and Git practice. Experience with GitLab, containers and Kubernetes is a plus. You write clean, tested, well-structured code. Prototypes that only work in a demo are not enough for …

items.desc: Labhouse is a Barcelona-based startup studio building AI-powered mobile apps used by hundreds of thousands of people worldwide. Our products, including Invoice Fly and Summary AI, are designed to make everyday tasks faster, smarter, and simpler through a subscription model that puts the user first. We were founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos, the duo behind SocialPoint (acquired by Take-Two Interactive), and we operate with the mindset of a product company: small teams, high ownership, and a relentless focus on building things that matter. Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below. About the Role: We’re bringing AI Agents into Summary AI and Invoice Fly, and you’ll be the one building them from scratch. This isn’t a role where you join an existing system and pick up tickets. You’ll own the whole cycle: decide what to build, design the architecture, implement it, measure how it performs with real users, and keep iterating until it works. These won’t be thin wrappers around an LLM. You will build multi-agent systems that do real work for millions of users, and you’ll build the foundation underneath them: orchestration, tool use, context management, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls. What You’ll Do Design and build our agent architecture from the ground up. Ship agentic features into Summary AI and Invoice Fly. Set up evaluations to measure quality, catch failures, and guide improvements. Iterate quickly based on real usage and data. Track the latest models, tools, and techniques, and bring the best ones into our products. About You: You have 5+ years of experience building production systems. You’ve built agents that real people use, and you know what it takes to make them reliable. You take full ownership, from a blank page to production and beyond. You make the architecture decisions yourself and see them through. You know how to evaluate AI systems, not just build them, and you use data to decide what to fix next. You keep up with AI. You try new models and tools as they come out, and you know which ones are worth adopting. You ship fast and iterate, without lowering the bar on quality. You communicate clearly with everyone you work with. You explain technical tradeoffs clearly, listen to what each team needs, and keep everyone aligned. Problem-solving and product focus: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges. Eye for detail and a product-first mindset, with a passion for creating exceptional user experiences. Self-driven, entrepreneurial attitude with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership of projects. Excellent communication skills. Nice to Have: Experience with subscription apps or mobile products Contributions to open-source AI tooling What we Offer: Remote work from anywhere in Spain. If you are based in Barcelona, we would love for you to join us at the office (Barcelona Tech City) at least two days a week. Flexible working hours. High-end equipment for your development. Permanent contract with competitive compensation. A young and top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment. Opportunity to lead, grow, and take on big challenges. Hiring Process Initial Interview: Meet with our Talent Acquisition Lead to discuss your background and fit for the role. We’ll also ask you to share your proudest projects. Hiring Manager Interview: A deep dive into your experience. Technical Assessment: Showcase your expertise through a practical task. Final Interview: A conversation with our leadership team to align on vision and expectations. Offer: Join our team and lead the development of our future-shaping apps! You should Know: Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them. Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

items.desc: À propos YoYo Mobility est une plateforme B2B de déplacements d'entreprise : tous les transports terrestres — taxi, VTC, autopartage, transports en commun, trottinettes, vélos — dans une seule application (iOS, Android, Web). Travel managers et équipes finance pilotent politiques de voyage, budgets, reporting et empreinte carbone ; nos clients réduisent leurs frais de déplacement jusqu'à 25 %. Des centaines d'entreprises clientes, des centaines de milliers de trajets par an. Nous recherchons avant tout un·e excellent·e architecte qui conçoit et construit des systèmes concrètement — en s'appuyant sur Claude (Claude Code) comme principal outil de développement. Vos missions – Transformer les besoins métier en solutions fonctionnelles, testées et observables — du cadrage à la production et au suivi des métriques. – Porter l'architecture de la plateforme micro-services (~45 services) : commandes, tarification, politiques et limites, paiements, intégrations des fournisseurs de mobilité, API publique B2B. – Concevoir le traitement événementiel, la montée en charge, la résilience et l'observabilité des composants à forte charge. – Structurer un processus de développement assisté par IA : spécifications, plans, revues et tests avec Claude ; définir les standards de l'équipe. – Prendre et documenter les décisions d'architecture, mener les revues de code, faire évoluer l'infrastructure et la CI/CD. Stack clé – Backend : Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, monorepo Nx – Données : PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, Redis – Messaging / temps réel : Kafka, RabbitMQ, WebSocket (Centrifugo) – Frontend : React, TypeScript, MobX – Infrastructure : Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Docker, GitHub Actions, multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, Selectel) – Observabilité : Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Sentry – Développement : Claude Code Profil recherché – 10 ans d'expérience minimum dans la conception de systèmes à forte charge ; expérience en tant qu'architecte ou lead engineer. – Maîtrise des systèmes distribués : cohérence, idempotence, files de messages, cache, sharding, mode dégradé. – Solide backend Node.js/TypeScript, SQL avancé. – Kubernetes, CI/CD, observabilité (métriques, logs, traces, alertes). – Pratique du développement avec Claude / agents LLM : savoir rédiger des spécifications et valider le résultat. – Français — obligatoire ; anglais ou russe — au choix. – Autorisation de travail en France. Pour postuler Exercice : concevez une messagerie web (backend + frontend). Aucune implémentation n'est demandée. Dans un dépôt GitHub public, publiez : – la spécification du service ; – PROMPT.md — les prompts avec lesquels vous avez généré et affiné la spécification, dans l'ordre d'utilisation et sans retouche ; – en option — un plan de réalisation. Envoyez votre CV et le lien vers le dépôt à kz@yoyomobility.fr. Offre complète (FR / EN / RU) : https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yJTlXfMCOszvKY-xIFN5mJ1TZjhGkxuS/view Lieu du poste : Télétravail
