items.desc: Since 2014, Wiremind has established itself as a tech company transforming the transport and events industries with a 360° approach combining user experience (UX), software and artificial intelligence (AI) . Our expertise lies primarily in optimizing and distributing our clients’ capacity . We work on a wide range of projects such as demand forecasting and ticket pricing, 3D optimization of air freight or competitor price scraping . Our applications are go-to tools for companies such as SNCF, United Airlines, Qatar Airways or PSG , which use them to visualize, analyze and optimize their capacity. Dynamic and ambitious, we are committed to preserving our technical DNA, the true engine of our success. Self-financed for more than 10 years, we have just raised our first funds to accelerate. The company is mainly made up of engineers and experts and keeps developing its business model based on Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions. As a Software Engineer, you will join the team behind Cayzn , our Revenue Management solution. To give you an idea of its scale: Every year, more than 300 million passengers travel by train, plane or bus at a price driven by Cayzn. Behind the scenes, our machine learning models recommend prices, and our systems execute 28 million business rules and process more than 2 million pricing decisions every day. This is the system you will work on, in production. Permanent contract (CDI) · Hybrid: 2 days of remote work per week · ASAP Your missions As a Software Engineer , you will take part in the development of new Cayzn features. With the support of our Product Experts and Data Scientists, you will help solve the business and technical challenges faced by our clients, mainly railway companies, airlines and bus operators. In practice, even though no two days are alike, you will: Develop new features for our users , with a strong focus on code quality, alongside senior developers. Take part in maintenance, application monitoring and infrastructure management : you own what you ship, all the way to production. Reduce technical debt , propose new solutions and challenge architecture choices to continuously improve the codebase. Exchange daily with our product team to share your ideas for improving Cayzn and deepen your understanding of our clients’ needs. Your first projects could be #1 – Make the pricing pipeline cheaper to run: "Cut the memory and CPU cost of the nightly pricing pipeline. A recent project removed redundant price history and reduced worker memory by 30–40% on our largest clients, measured in production." #2 – Let revenue managers steer the optimisation. "Give revenue managers control over the price recommendations of each train: a target booking curve, a fixed strategy, or steering applied at the next optimisation run. The work goes from the database model through the optimisation engine to the API." #3 – Bring bookings into the analytics in real time. "Stream bookings and ancillary sales into our ClickHouse data warehouse, so that clients' dashboards refresh during the day instead of after the nightly batch." Our tech stack Backend: Python, SQLAlchemy, Remoulade, Flask Frontend: TypeScript, Angular, NGRX, D3.js, Next.js Databases and storage: PostgreSQL (several terabytes), Elasticsearch, Redis, Clickhouse Continuous integration and delivery: GitLab, ArgoCD Infrastructure: Kubernetes Monitoring and operations: Prometheus/Grafana and Kibana Some figures: ~13 commits merged per day, ~ production release per week, 20 isolated client environments in production (81 environments in total) on Kubernetes, all deployed using GitLab and ArgoCD." Your profile At least one internship in backend development in a production environment You have solid experience with Python (or another backend language) and a good command of relational databases. You write clean, tested and maintainable code, and you enjoy evolving an existing codebase. You already use AI in your development workflow and are curious to push its use further. You can take an ambiguous topic and move it forward autonomously. You can clearly explain a technical concept to a non-specialist, as you will work closely with complex business domains (pricing, distribution). What will make the difference: experience with high-volume systems, an interest in design and UX, or open source contributions you are proud of. Our benefits By joining us, you will be part of: A historically self-financed startup with a strong tech identity, which has just raised its first funds to accelerate its growth! Beautiful 800 m² offices in the heart of Paris, boulevard Poissonnière Attractive compensation, indexed on performance A caring and stimulating team that encourages skills development through initiative and autonomy A learning-friendly environment with growth opportunities ‍ You will also benefit from: A hybrid policy: 2 days of remote work per week and the possibility to occasionally work from abroad Access to WellPass at a preferential rate …

items.desc: About Furnishings UK Furnishings UK Ltd is a Bradford-based flooring and furnishings business established in 2012. With Yorkshire roots and UK-wide supply, the company imports, wholesales and supplies a wide range of products – including vinyl, LVT, SPC, wood and laminate flooring, carpet tiles and rugs – to trade, wholesale and retail (home) customers. As the business grows across several sales channels, locations and product categories, Furnishings UK is investing in data and business intelligence to support faster, better-informed commercial decisions. Role Purpose Furnishings UK is seeking an experienced Data Analyst to own the analysis of store data at every level of the business. The core purpose of this role is to manage Multi-Level Store Data Analysis – building a single, reliable view of performance that runs from individual product lines (SKUs) and categories, through each store, warehouse and sales channel (trade, wholesale and retail/online), up to regional and company-wide results. The successful candidate will design the data model, dashboards and reporting framework that allow directors and store/branch managers to compare performance across levels, spot trends early, manage stock efficiently and grow revenue and margin. Category & SKU Level: Track performance of product categories (vinyl, LVT, SPC, wood, laminate, carpet tiles, rugs and furnishings) and individual SKUs, identifying best sellers, slow movers and margin leakage. Regional & Company Level: Roll store-level results up into regional and company-wide views so senior management can compare locations and channels on a like-for-like basis. Drill-Down Reporting: Build hierarchical data models that let users move from company totals down to store, category and SKU detail in a few clicks. Benchmarking: Set KPIs and targets for every level and run variance analysis (actual vs target, period vs period, store vs store). 2. Produce a monthly management Indicators Report and weekly store performance packs for directors and store managers. Replace manual spreadsheet reporting with automated, refreshable reports to reduce reporting time and errors. 3. Inventory, Forecasting & Commercial Analysis Build demand and revenue forecasting models (Python / Excel) by store, category and season to guide purchasing and import planning. Analyse stock levels, stock turn, ageing stock and stock transfers between locations to reduce overstock and stock-outs. Carry out pricing, discount, margin and ROI analysis for trade and retail customers, promotions and supplier ranges. Prepare business cases and recommendations that translate data into clear revenue and cost-saving opportunities. 4. items.desc: Contexte Au sein de Schneider Electric Europe Operations, le département Projets & Services Industrie (DPSI) réunit 250 collaborateurs aux expertises variées, répartis sur dix sites en France. Sa mission : accompagner les clients industriels B2B dans la conception et la réalisation de projets et services complexes et sur mesure , adaptés à leurs enjeux de modernisation et de performance industrielle. Parmi ces projets, la migration d’automates Schneider Electric représente un véritable enjeu technique. Pour établir les chiffrages nécessaires à ces transformations, les équipes s’appuient aujourd’hui sur l’expertise acquise au fil des projets et sur de nombreuses données historiques. Ces informations sont toutefois dispersées entre plusieurs supports : fichiers Excel, Teams/SharePoint, checklists et documentation technique. Cette approche soulève plusieurs enjeux : des délais de réalisation des offres parfois importants ; des données d’entrée pouvant être incomplètes ; des estimations qui peuvent varier selon les experts et les hypothèses retenues ; des formats de livrables hétérogènes ; la nécessité de mieux capitaliser et sécuriser les connaissances internes. L'objectif du stage est d'étudier comment l'Intelligence Artificielle, et notamment les approches RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), peuvent permettre de capitaliser sur cette expertise et d'améliorer la fiabilité et la rapidité des chiffrages de projets de migration d'automates. Vos missions Accompagné(e) par les équipes techniques et les experts métier, vous aurez pour mission de concevoir et prototyper une solution permettant d'exploiter les données et connaissances existantes pour assister les équipes dans leurs futurs chiffrages. Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : comprendre le processus actuel de chiffrage d'une migration d'automates et identifier les informations déterminantes ; recenser, structurer et qualifier les différentes sources de données disponibles : historiques de chiffrage, fichiers Excel, checklists de migration, documentation technique, données Teams/SharePoint, etc. ; étudier les approches d'IA générative adaptées au besoin, notamment les architectures RAG ; concevoir un modèle de données permettant de capitaliser sur les projets et chiffrages passés ; développer un prototype d'assistant IA capable de rechercher et exploiter les cas similaires ; proposer une estimation ou une aide à la génération du chiffrage à partir des données fournies ; mettre en place un indicateur de confiance, permettant de qualifier la fiabilité d'une proposition selon la complétude et la qualité des données d'entrée ; comparer les résultats de la solution aux estimations réalisées par des experts ; prendre en compte les contraintes de confidentialité, cybersécurité et hébergement des données ; documenter l'architecture proposée et les résultats obtenus afin de préparer une éventuelle industrialisation de la solution. Les défis techniques Ce stage permettra de travailler sur un cas d'usage concret à la croisée de plusieurs domaines : IA générative & Data Large Language Models (LLM) Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) recherche sémantique et embeddings structuration et préparation de données évaluation de réponses générées par l'IA estimation d'un niveau de confiance Développement & Architecture Python APIs bases de données / bases vectorielles Microsoft 365, Teams et/ou SharePoint environnement Copilot selon les outils disponibles et autorisés Industrie automatisme industriel migration d'automates compréhension de données techniques et commerciales processus de chiffrage et génération de devis Profil recherché Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 , en école d'ingénieur ou Master, avec une spécialisation en : Intelligence Artificielle / Data Science ; informatique / génie logiciel ; systèmes industriels / automatisme avec une forte appétence pour l'IA. Vous avez idéalement : de bonnes bases en Python et manipulation de données ; une première compréhension des LLM, de l'IA générative ou des architectures RAG ; un intérêt pour les problématiques d'architecture logicielle et de cybersécurité ; une capacité à comprendre et structurer un problème métier complexe ; de la curiosité pour les environnements industriels. Une connaissance des automates programmables ou des environnements Schneider Electric constitue un plus, mais l'expertise en automatisme n'est pas nécessairement un prérequis : le stage se fera en interaction avec des experts métier. items.card: Responsibilities Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model development, and evaluation using structured and unstructured datasets Design and build prototypes of agentic AI systems, including multi-step workflows that use tools and reason across tasks Apply and experiment with LLM techniques such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool and function calling, fine-tuning, and agent harness design
items.desc: At JPMorgan Chase, AI is transforming how we operate on a global scale. We invest over $18 billion annually in technology, including innovation, data, and security, to shape the future for our clients, communities, and employees. Housed within The Chief Data & Analytics Office (CDAO), the Machine Learning Center of Excellence (MLCOE) creates and deploys AI and machine learning solutions for complex business challenges across flagship AI deployments at the firm. Our solutions power financial products, boost productivity, and strengthen risk management across the firm. Job Responsibilities Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model development, and evaluation using structured and unstructured datasets Design and build prototypes of agentic AI systems, including multi-step workflows that use tools and reason across tasks Apply and experiment with LLM techniques such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool and function calling, fine-tuning, and agent harness design Develop evaluation frameworks to measure the quality, reliability, and safety of LLM and agent outputs Collaborate with mentors, business stakeholders, and engineers to turn business problems into AI solutions and help move them toward production Document methodology, assumptions, and results so work can be reproduced, and present findings and key learnings to technical and business audiences Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Currently enrolled in a PhD or MS program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Operations Research, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028 Solid background in large language models and agentic AI, natural language processing, speech recognition, or personalization/recommendation, with familiarity with current state-of-the-art methods Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and machine learning, including the ability to design experiments and define metrics that reflect business goals Hands-on exposure to modern LLM application patterns such as prompting, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step or agentic workflows Strong Python skills, including deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow), the Hugging Face ecosystem, and core data libraries (NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn) Clear written and spoken communication for both technical and business audiences, and the ability to work both independently and on a team Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Experience building LLM-powered prototypes that connect models to tools, APIs, documents, databases, or search systems, using frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel Experience with fine-tuning or post-training (e.g., TRL) and with building evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent outputs Published research in agentic AI, NLP, speech, reinforcement learning, etc., at a major conference or journal Ability to write and debug production-quality code Familiarity with the financial services industry As a Summer Associate within MLCOE, you will apply advanced LLM and agentic AI methods to complex problems in areas such as natural language processing, question answering, speech recognition and understanding, reinforcement learning, post-training, and recommendation systems. Working alongside MLCOE mentors, business experts, and technologists, you will own a research project from start to finish. This role offers hands-on experience solving real business problems at scale while learning from experienced AI researchers and engineers. Our Summer Associate Internship Program begins in June, depending on your academic calendar. Your professional growth and development will be supported throughout the internship program via project work related to your academic and professional interests, mentorship, an engaging speaker series with our senior leaders, and more. Your project will have a direct impact on JPMorgan’s businesses, will be integrated into our product pipelines, or be part of published research in top AI conferences. Full-time employment offers may be extended upon successful completion of the program within our hybrid work model.

items.desc: An Introduction Our vision? “To advance the world through the power of people and Microsoft.” Every day, our people use the latest Microsoft technologies to help organizations transform, innovate, and create new possibilities. Within our Data & AI practice, we explore how AI and and modern data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric can improve both the solutions we deliver to our clients and the way we work internally. During this two-month internship, you will apply these technologies to a real internal challenge and explore how repetitive and knowledge-intensive administrative processes can become smarter, faster, and more efficient. Come Join Us Avanade is an international IT consultancy where people and technology come together. As an intern, you will become part of our Data & AI practice and work alongside consultants and technical specialists on a real AI and automation challenge. You will have the opportunity to experiment with emerging Microsoft technologies, learn from experienced professionals, and turn your ideas into a tangible working prototype. You will also become part of Avanade's broader intern community, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, learning, and personal development are key. During your internship, you will experience how Data & AI solutions evolve from an initial business challenge into a designed, developed, tested, and demonstrated solution. What You’ll Do Our consultants work with a variety of internal administrative and knowledge-intensive processes. These activities can involve collecting information from different sources, analyzing documents, searching for existing knowledge, completing templates, asking stakeholders for missing information, and transforming unstructured input into structured deliverables. During this two-month internship, your challenge will be to explore: How can AI & modern data platforms make internal administrative processes faster, smarter, and more consistent? You will design and develop an AI-Powered Internal Business Assistant, focusing on at least one concrete internal use case. Instead of simply answering questions like a traditional chatbot, the assistant should help users complete an actual business process. This could include understanding what the user wants to achieve, gathering the required information, asking relevant questions, retrieving appropriate knowledge or templates, identifying missing information, and generating a structured result ready for human review. Examples Of Potential Use Cases Include SOW Creation: Guide consultants in creating consistent Statements of Work using the appropriate delivery model and template. RFP Analysis: Analyze RFPs and structure key requirements, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and clarification points. Proposal & Opportunity Support: Transform opportunity information into structured input for proposals and solutioning activities. Other Internal Admin Processes: Automate repetitive internal activities where Data, AI, and automation can reduce manual effort. Together with the Data & AI practice, you will select and scope a suitable use case that can be developed into an end-to-end MVP within the two-month internship. Depending on your solution design, you may explore technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Microsoft 365,Python, Git, and Azure DevOps. At the end of the internship, you will demonstrate your working prototype, share your findings, and provide recommendations on how the solution could potentially be extended to other internal processes. Qualifications Skills and experiences: You are a Bachelor's or Master's student looking for a challenging two-month internship in Data & AI, software engineering, or IT consulting; You have a strong interest in Data, Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Large Language Models, and AI Agents; You are interested in modern data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric and the broader Microsoft Data & AI ecosystem; You are interested in understanding and automating business processes; You have basic programming or software development skills, preferably with some experience in Python; You are curious about technologies and concepts such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, agentic AI, data platforms, and workflow automation; You enjoy translating a real business challenge into a practical technical solution; You are comfortable experimenting with new technologies and turning ideas into a working prototype within a focused timeframe; Experience with all listed technologies is not required. Curiosity, problem-solving skills, and a willingness to learn are key. About You You have strong communication skills in English; knowledge of Dutch is considered an advantage; You are analytical, curious, proactive, and solution-oriented; You are comfortable working independently while actively collaborating with colleagues and subject-matter experts; You enjoy exploring new technologies and finding …

items.desc: You sit with the business, not behind it. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you’ll work side by side with our clients’ teams, find the problems worth solving, and ship AI products that solve them in weeks, not quarters. Part of the job is telling clients honestly what makes sense and what doesn’t, and explaining why. You own the whole path: from the first conversation with a business owner, through scoping, estimating, and budgeting the work, to a working prototype and a product in real use. Can’t remember how to derive the backpropagation formula? Last saw a partial derivative in your second year at university? Don’t worry, nobody here will ask you to prove your loss function is differentiable. In this role, success means business impact. You’ll use foundation models, APIs, and modern AI frameworks to build products that solve real problems. You’ll prototype quickly, put things in front of users early, and use what you learn to decide what to build next. The AI landscape changes every few months, so you’ll need to pick up new tools and approaches as fast as they appear and judge which ones matter. You’ll have a lot of autonomy and real influence. We’re looking for someone who spots opportunities, proposes solutions, and drives them forward without waiting to be told what to do. You’ll also help shape the strategy and growth of our AI business unit, so what you learn on projects will directly influence where we go next. What We Offer AI Grant – Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you a dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else. AI Center of Excellence – Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily. Your tools, your choice – Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you. Real project variety – From generative AI for legal document compliance, through agentic systems in manufacturing environments, to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored. Conference and speaking support – Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better – we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses. Your tasks Working closely with client business teams to turn their ideas into concrete, buildable product concepts Prototyping rapidly, testing with real users, and deciding what to scale, pivot, or drop Scoping, estimating and budgeting projects, including identifying key risks and mitigation strategies, and clearly communicating to clients what is worth building and what is not Building and shipping LLM-powered products, including assistants, agentic workflows and integrations with business systems Bringing a product perspective by defining success metrics, prioritising by business value and measuring real impact Proactively proposing solutions and keeping up with new models and tools as the landscape evolves Contributing to the strategy and growth of the AI business unit, from service offerings to reusable solutions Requirements At least 4 years in software engineering, including shipping LLM-based applications that real users rely on Pragmatic Python skills and hands-on experience with LLM APIs, RAG, tool calling, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent) Daily, practical use of AI software development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor A product mindset focused on MVPs, user feedback, and measurable outcomes Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders Experience scoping and estimating software or AI projects, including effort, cost, and risk A self-starter attitude with an ability to take ownership, work with minimal supervision, and learn new technologies fast Advanced level of Polish and English Residency in Poland Nice to have Frontend skills for quick prototypes and demos (e.g., React, Streamlit, Gradio) Startup, product company, or founder experience Background in a specific business domain (financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, public sector) Working knowledge of a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) Job no. items.desc: Description de l'entreprise À propos d’Inetum Inetum est un leader européen des services numériques. Pour les entreprises, les acteurs publics et la société dans son ensemble, les 26 000 consultants et spécialistes du groupe œuvrent chaque jour pour créer un impact digital concret : des solutions qui contribuent à la performance, à l’innovation et au bien commun. Présent dans 19 pays au plus près des territoires, et avec ses grands partenaires éditeurs de logiciels, Inetum accompagne les organisations dans leurs enjeux de transformation digitale avec proximité, flexibilité et responsabilité. Porté par sa raison d’être, Inetum défend une vision d’une technologie utile et maîtrisée, capable de révéler le plein potentiel des organisations et de la société : « Let’s make tech right ». En 2025, le groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 2,2 milliards d’euros. Plus d’informations sur : www.inetum.com Description du poste Pour notre agence de Nantes, nous recherchons un(e) Business Analyst IA pour intervenir sur des projets innovants autour de l’intelligence artificielle générative et de la gestion des connaissances. Vous jouerez un rôle central à l’interface entre les équipes métiers et les équipes techniques, en accompagnant la conception, l’évolution et l’amélioration continue de solutions intégrant des technologies d’IA générative. Vous contribuerez également à la structuration et à la gouvernance des connaissances afin de garantir la qualité et la pertinence des services délivrés aux utilisateurs. Vos Missions En tant qu’acteur clé de l’équipe projet, vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie fonctionnel : Recueillir, analyser et formaliser les besoins métiers. Accompagner le Product Owner dans le cadrage et la priorisation des demandes. Rédiger les User Stories, règles de gestion et critères d’acceptation. Assurer l’interface fonctionnelle entre les équipes métiers et les équipes techniques. Préparer et exécuter les tests fonctionnels en garantissant la qualité des livrables. Contribuer au déploiement des solutions et à l’accompagnement des utilisateurs. Participer à la gouvernance et à l’amélioration continue des connaissances exploitées par les solutions d’IA. Maintenir la documentation fonctionnelle et animer les démonstrations auprès des parties prenantes. Qualifications Vous justifiez d’une expérience significative en Business Analysis au sein d’environnements Agile et avez l’habitude de faire le lien entre les équipes métiers et techniques. Vous maîtrisez le recueil et la formalisation des besoins, la rédaction d’User Stories ainsi que la préparation et le suivi des tests fonctionnels. Vous possédez une bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à l’ IA générative , aux LLM , aux architectures RAG et aux problématiques de Knowledge Management . À l’aise avec des outils tels que Jira , Confluence , ALM Octane ou ServiceNow , vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre esprit d’analyse, votre rigueur, votre autonomie et votre capacité à accompagner les utilisateurs dans des contextes de transformation innovants. Informations complémentaires L'évolution Professionnelle Au Sein D'Inetum Chez Inetum, nous croyons en votre développement et nous vous accompagnons à chaque étape grâce à : Des formations et certifications régulières pour rester à la pointe des technologies, Du temps dédié à la montée en compétence sur de nouvelles solutions. Ce Que Nous Offrons Un environnement technologique stimulant et des projets stratégiques. Une équipe experte et collaborative, où vos compétences seront valorisées. Accompagnement personnalisé par Inetum pour booster votre carrière. Les Avantages Inetum Qui Font La Différence ✅ Congés & RTT : 27 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de RTT 1 jour supplémentaire tous les 5 ans d’ancienneté Congés exceptionnels (dont 1 jour pour déménagement) 💙 Santé & Bien-être Mutuelle premium (65 % pris en charge) Affiliation gratuite des enfants + option conjoint Téléconsultation médicale gratuite Prévoyance complète 🚲 Mobilité Remboursement transport en commun à 50 % Indemnité vélo jusqu’à 200 €/an 💰 Avantages Financiers Participation + Plan d’Épargne Groupe Action logement (aide pour achat, travaux, location) 🏡 Télétravail Dispositif en place depuis 2011 Indemnité mensuelle de 15 € 3 jours de télétravail / semaine 🍽 Tickets Restaurant 9 € par jour travaillé (60 % pris en charge par l'employeur) 🤝 Cooptation Prime de 500 € à 1500 € 🎉 Vie D’entreprise Activités sociales & culturelles Événements festifs d’équipe

items.desc: Informazioni sull'offerta di lavoro Cerchiamo un Forward Deployed Engineer freelance per portare in produzione, presso grandi aziende, soluzioni di sviluppo software basate su agenti AI, collegandole ai sistemi, ai dati e ai processi del cliente. Milano, ibrido, con giornate presso i clienti. Attività previste • Raccogliere requisiti, vincoli e decisioni da documenti, riunioni e codice esistente e tradurli in specifiche su cui gli agenti AI possono lavorare • Configurare i workflow degli agenti per ogni repository: pianificazione, implementazione, test, code review e punti di approvazione delle persone • Collegare gli agenti ai sistemi del cliente tramite API REST, webhook e Model Context Protocol (MCP), nel rispetto di sicurezza, permessi e governance dei dati • Scrivere e rivedere codice di produzione con strumenti di sviluppo AI-assisted • Monitorare esecuzioni, qualità del codice e costi dei modelli, e rendicontare al cliente • Affiancare sviluppatori e analisti del cliente mentre imparano a lavorare con gli agenti Conoscenze richieste • Almeno 3 anni di sviluppo software, con almeno un sistema AI, dati o di integrazione portato in produzione • TypeScript/JavaScript, Python o Java • Esperienza pratica con LLM: agenti, prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG • Progettazione di API e pattern di integrazione • Strumenti di sviluppo AI-assisted (Claude Code, Codex o Cursor), Git, CI/CD e Docker • Capacità di dialogare con responsabili IT e team tecnici • Autonomia nella gestione delle attività • Disponibilità a lavorare presso la sede del cliente quando il progetto lo richiede Costituiranno un titolo preferenziale conoscenze di: Model Context Protocol (MCP) · sicurezza enterprise (IAM, OAuth, audit log) · Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Copilot Studio, Vertex AI o Bedrock · AWS, GCP, Snowflake o Databricks · esperienza in banche, assicurazioni o pubblica amministrazione Lingue • Italiano fluente • Inglese tecnico Condizioni • Contratto: collaborazione in partita IVA • Durata: inizialmente 6 mesi, con possibilità di proroga • Sede: Milano, ibrido, con giornate presso i clienti • Impegno: full time • Avvio: da concordare Il processo di selezione Il processo di selezione prevede di rispondere solo alle candidature compatibili, di solito entro 48 ore dall'invio. Dopodiché si svolgerà un colloquio conoscitivo e successivamente potranno esserci uno o due colloqui di approfondimento tecnico. Ti preghiamo di indicare nel CV anche un'indicazione del rate richiesto

items.desc: Client - Global Investment Bank Role - Lead AI Engineer Day Rate - £700 (Inside IR35) Employment Type - 6 Month Contract (Rolling) Working Pattern - 4 Days in Office Location - Central London Bonhill Partners are currently supporting a Global Investment Bank in their search for an Agentic AI Engineer. Responsibilities Design, develop and implement Generative AI solutions using established engineering principles and architectural best practices. Build and optimise Large Language Model (LLM) applications for scalable, reliable production environments. Develop AI-driven applications incorporating retrieval-based architectures, intelligent automation and autonomous agent capabilities. Work closely with technical architects, cloud engineering teams and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable and maintainable AI solutions. Design and implement effective prompt engineering techniques and data retrieval strategies to enhance model accuracy and performance. Conduct functional, unit and integration testing to ensure solution quality, reliability and successful deployment. Identify and resolve technical issues, optimise application performance and support production releases. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation covering application design, development processes, configurations and deployment procedures. Monitor deployed AI solutions, evaluate model performance and implement continuous improvements. Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise technology standards, security requirements and architectural guidelines. Requirements Strong programming experience in Python, with hands-on development of Generative AI applications using modern AI development frameworks and agent orchestration technologies. Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, MLOps practices and automated deployment processes for AI and machine learning solutions. Knowledge of model development, fine-tuning, evaluation and optimisation of Large Language Models (LLMs). Strong understanding of prompt engineering techniques, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures and enterprise knowledge retrieval solutions. Experience with model performance monitoring, evaluation, troubleshooting and continuous optimisation. Experience designing, developing and deploying REST APIs and integrating AI applications with enterprise systems through API management platforms. Hands-on experience with cloud-based infrastructure and services supporting AI application development, deployment, hosting and serverless computing. Familiarity with cloud-based AI, data and analytics services, including LLM platforms, cognitive services, vector search, NoSQL databases, data lakes and enterprise data governance solutions. Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise productivity platforms, business applications and organisational data sources. Strong understanding of emerging LLM integration standards, interoperability protocols and agent-to-agent communication frameworks. If this is of interest please attach a copy of your cv and we will be happy to set up an intial chat

items.title: Project Engineer - Electrical (w/m/d)
items.card: Your Role & Responsibilities: Do you enjoy turning complex plant requirements into clear, reliable electrical designs? As a Project Engineer Electrical at ABB, you will be the technical reference for electrical engineering on small and mid-sized projects, from database planning and cabinet design through to on-site commissioning, bringing care for quality and safety, courage to challenge ideas, and curiosity to
items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
Engineering Manager 
 __
 Your Role & Responsibilities: 
 Do you enjoy turning complex plant requirements into clear, reliable electrical designs? As a Project Engineer Electrical at ABB, you will be the technical reference for electrical engineering on small and mid-sized projects, from database planning and cabinet design through to on-site commissioning, bringing care for quality and safety, courage to challenge ideas, and curiosity to improve how we work. You will join a welcoming, collaborative team of colleagues who look out for each other, from lunch walks and coffee breaks to yearly team events.
 The work model for this role is: on-site with 8 home office days per month and 40% obligatory travel.
 Design and maintain electrical documentation in EPLAN, including database planning, control cabinet planning, and automated generation of electrical schematics, completing the remaining schematics yourself
 Act as design authority for low-to-medium complexity electrical engineering, delivering to contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements and cybersecurity policies
 Support installation, testing and on-site commissioning, and coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain and project managers from contract to project closure
 Work flexibly between the office, home office and project sites, with approx. 40% travel within Austria (currently including Vorarlberg) with pool cars available at your disposal
 Our team dynamics: 
 Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.
 What it takes to Run what runs the world: 
 An electrical engineering qualification such as a HTL diploma with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a completed apprenticeship with approx. 10 years of practical experience or equivalent
 Advanced hands-on experience with EPLAN Electric P8
 Experience in plant engineering (Anlagenbau) and EMSR design, ideally in mechanically led plant projects
 Experience in power generation, such as power plants or hydropower plants is a strong advantage
 Written and spoken German and English at B2 level or higher
 We offer a full range of benefits to help you thrive at work and beyond: 
 Work-Life Balance – Flexible working models, including flextime and hybrid options, to support your personal and professional life.
 Health & Well-being – Access to various health measures, a Global Employee Assistance Program , and a gender-neutral parental leave policy .
 Financial Perks – Participation in the Global Employee Shareholder Acquisition Program (ESAP) and meal allowances.
 Career Growth – Extensive training opportunities and structured development programs to help you advance.
 Inclusive Culture – An international work environment that encourages collaboration and innovation.
 The minimum compensation, in accordance with the electrical and electronics industry collective agreement, is 3.800 EUR monthly for a full-time position as of May 2026. We are happy to speak in person about your compensation package in accordance with your qualifications and experience.
 More about us: 
 The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.
 Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.
 Run What Runs the World.
 #ABBcareers #LI-Hybrid #RunwithABB #Runwhatrunstheworld
 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
 Ready to make an impact?

Vos missions : Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui développe des satellites scientifiques et d'observation de la Terre de nouvelle génération. Au sein du département d'ingénierie mécanique et thermique, vous serez
items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Ingénieur Conception Mécanique et Intégration d'Instruments Spatiaux (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Bureau d'Études Satellites basé à Toulouse , France. 
 Vos missions : 
 Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui développe des satellites scientifiques et d'observation de la Terre de nouvelle génération. Au sein du département d'ingénierie mécanique et thermique, vous serez impliqué(e) dans les études d'aménagement et d'intégration physique des charges utiles optiques et radiofréquences, visant à garantir l'optimisation architecturale et le respect des exigences de vol spatial. 
 Vos responsabilités : 
 1. Architecture mécanique et études d'aménagement (Accommodation) 
 Piloter les études d'implantation spatiale des instruments (optiques et radiofréquences) en tenant compte des contraintes de masse, de volume, thermiques et opérationnelles. 
 Définir et optimiser l'agencement des équipements : placement des boîtiers, cheminement des faisceaux de câblage (harness) et intégration des sous-ensembles optiques de précision. 
 Définir et gérer les interfaces mécaniques et thermiques entre la plateforme du satellite et les différents sous-systèmes. 
 2. Justification technique, tolérancement et industrialisation 
 Réaliser les analyses d'évaluation de masse, centrage et inertie (MCI) ainsi que les chaînes de cotes et tolérancements pour garantir la faisabilité industrielle. 
 Rédiger la documentation technique de référence : dossiers de conception, rapports d'aménagement et documents de contrôle d'interfaces (ICD - Interface Control Document ). 
 Présenter et défendre les solutions techniques lors des revues formelles de conception face aux clients et partenaires institutionnels. 
 3. Coordination métier et pilotage transversal 
 Assurer l'interface technique avec les spécialistes des autres disciplines (thermique, électrique, calcul de structures) et les équipes d'assemblage, intégration et essais (AIT - Assembly, Integration and Testing ). 
 Encadrer techniquement les lots de travaux sous-traités ( Work Packages ) dans le respect des jalons du projet. 
 Garantir le suivi des coûts, des plannings et de la qualité des livrables selon les processus du bureau d'études et de la continuité numérique (DDMS - Digital Design, Manufacturing and Services ). 
 Votre profil : 
 OBLIGATOIRE : 
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l’IGI 1300 du 9 Août 2021 (§1.2.2.1). 
 Compétences et expérience : 
 Expérience : Expérience professionnelle avérée d'au moins 5 ans en conception mécanique, architecture physique ou intégration d'équipements / instruments complexes. 
 Formation : Compétences avancées en génie mécanique, aérospatial ou mécatronique. 
 Outils de CAO & Méthodes : Maîtrise avancée des outils de Conception Assistée par Ordinateur (notamment la suite logicielle 3DEXPERIENCE / CATIA) et pratique de la gestion de configuration. La connaissance des méthodes de conception numérique d'Airbus (DDMS) est un plus. 
 Environnement spatial : Solide compréhension des contraintes d'environnement sévères (vibrations au lancement, cyclage thermique sous vide, radiations, propreté optique). 
 Aptitudes relationnelles : Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, capacité à fédérer des interlocuteurs pluridisciplinaires et aisance dans la restitution technique. 
 Langues : Maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais professionnel (animation de revues techniques et rédaction de livrables internationaux). 
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! 
 Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : 
 Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites.

Au sein de notre département de conception
items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Architecte de système de communication satellite (h/f) pour rejoindre notre Département des Systèmes d'Information et Logiciels basé à Elancourt , France.
 Vos missions :
 Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui développe des solutions logicielles critiques pour la planification et la gestion de missions satellitaires. Au sein de notre département de conception logicielle, vous serez impliqué(e) dans la définition de l'architecture de systèmes de gestion des communications satellitaires.
 Vous devrez interagir au quotidien avec les équipes de développement logiciel pour participer au choix techniques d'implémentation et d'architecture logicielle.
 Vos responsabilités :
 Analyse fonctionnelle et traitement des exigences systèmes dans un cycle en V.
 Suivi et compte-rendu de l'avancement du projet.
 Définir l'architecture technique des systèmes de planification et de gestion d'infrastructures de réseaux de télécommunication SatCom.
 Concevoir les interfaces entre les différents modules logiciels et les systèmes externes.
 Assurer la cohérence, la maintenabilité et la sécurité (cybersécurité et classification des données) des systèmes sur tout leur cycle de vie.
 Lors de la phase de développement, vous serez en support de l’équipe de développement pour les orienter dans leurs choix fonctionnels et techniques.
 Votre profil :
 OBLIGATOIRE : 
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l’IGI 1300 du 9 Août 2021 (§1.2.2.1). 
 Compétences et expérience : 
 Minimum 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en tant qu'Architecte Logiciel.
 Maîtrise des architectures distribuées, des microservices et des interfaces de programmation (API REST/SOAP).
 Compréhension des méthodologies de travail agiles (Scrum, SAFe) et des bases de données (relationnelles ou NoSQL).
 Anglais et Français : excellente capacité de communication écrite et orale.
 Une expérience sur des solutions OSS/BSS serait un plus
 Votre environnement de travail :
 A deux pas du Château de Versailles et située à proximité de Paris, Elancourt est une ville dynamique, faisant partie de l'agglomération de Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines. Job Description: 
 Chez Airbus Atlantic, on façonne l’aéronautique de demain ! 
 Nous vous proposons de rejoindre Airbus Atlantic , leader industriel mondial en matière d'aérostructures, de sièges pilotes et de fauteuils passagers de classe affaires et de première classe. Nous innovons sans cesse pour définir de nouveaux standards d’excellence industrielle. Nous préparons le futur pour une industrie aérospatiale compétitive et durable. 
 Etes-vous notre prochain Chargé d’Affaires Outillages (All Gender) ? 
 🎯 Votre mission 
 Au sein de notre site de Rochefort , vous intégrerez le pôle Série du Bureau d'Études Outillages (BEO) au sein du département Manufacturing Engineering (ME) . 
 Votre quotidien ? Accompagner l'évolution et la modernisation de notre outil industriel en étant l'interface privilégiée de la Production sur les sujets relatifs aux outillages série tous programmes (grilles de perçage, bâtis d'assemblage, lignes d'assemblage…). 
 Piloter et coordonner (80 % de votre activité) : Assurer le support technique privilégié d'une unité de production cliente. Vous pilotez l'ensemble des activités outillages sur votre périmètre, coordonnez un pôle de chargés d'affaires externes (gestion du plan de charge et répartition des sollicitations) et assurez le suivi de l'avancement des sujets auprès de la Production (Reporting). 
 Concevoir et déployer (20 % de votre activité) : À partir d'une expression de besoin, définir et proposer des solutions outillages. Vous rédigez les cahiers des charges, suivez l'avancement auprès des clients internes et garantissez la conformité des équipements au regard des normes en vigueur (directive machine 2006/42/CE, levage, moyens d'accès, sécurité, ergonomie). 
 Collaborer et capitaliser : Apporter un support technique aux chargés d'affaires du Bureau d'Études Outillages Projet dans le cadre de duplications. Grâce à votre proximité quotidienne avec les équipes Production et Préparation, vous assurez le retour d'expérience sur les améliorations et sécurisations des équipements. 
 Garantir la conformité documentaire : Assurer la mise à jour, la conformité et l'archivage de la liasse technique des postes placés sous votre responsabilité. 
 🛠️ Votre profil (Ce qui fera la différence) 
 Vous bénéficiez de plusieurs années d'expérience (3 à 5 ans minimum) dans l'industrie — idéalement dans le secteur aéronautique ou un environnement industriel exigeant — avec une forte composante en conception d'outillages et/ou de machines spéciales. 
 Vous possédez de solides connaissances en conception mécanique, matériaux et procédés de fabrication, ainsi qu'en métrologie appliquée à l'environnement aéronautique. 
 Vous maîtrisez la directive machine 2006/42/CE et son application en conception, ainsi que les enjeux liés à la sécurité et à la qualité en production aéronautique. 
 Vous êtes reconnu pour vos compétences en gestion de projet (garant de la qualité, des coûts et des délais). 
 Vous êtes à l'aise dans les logiciels de Conception Assistée par Ordinateur (CATIA V5 de préférence). 
 Anglais ? Bien sûr, le ciel n'a pas de frontières ! 
 Vous avez le goût du terrain (environnement d'atelier d'assemblage d'aérostructures) et êtes reconnu pour votre curiosité, votre dynamisme et votre sens du service client envers la Production. 
 Vous savez prioriser vos actions et gérer la charge de travail avec une vision globale du service, tout en faisant preuve d'excellentes capacités de communication et de négociation. 
 Vous avez à cœur le travail d'équipe ainsi que le respect strict des règles éthiques, des processus (fabrication, achats) et des réglementations en vigueur (prévention, sécurité). 
 Poste non cadre 
 💎 Notre entreprise 
 Boostez votre carrière : Un accompagnement sur-mesure et mobilité interne boostée. 
 Équilibre vie pro/vie perso : Bénéficiez de 6 semaines de congés payés et de RTT. 
 Package attractif : Plan d’épargne salariale, actionnariat salarié et une mutuelle individuelle ou familiale. 
 Engagement au quotidien : Incitation financière à la mobilité durable (vélo, covoiturage, transports) et opportunité de participer à des projets caritatifs et sociaux stimulants. 
 Qualité de vie : Restaurant d’entreprise et un CSE dynamique (loisirs, culture, vacances). 
 Culture inclusive : La diversité fait partie de notre ADN. 
 ✈️ Le site de Rochefort 
 Rochefort : Le site Airbus Atlantic de Rochefort est spécialisé dans l'assemblage d'éléments de fuselage pour les familles A320, A330, A350, A400M, F8X et G7500. Il produit aussi des sièges pilotes pour les avions commerciaux tous programmes confondus, les avions d’affaires, les avions militaires et les hélicoptères civils et militaires. Enfin, il conçoit et fabrique des fauteuils passagers Première Classe et Classe Affaires commercialisés sous la marque STELIA Aerospace.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Digital Board Designer (f/m) to join our Electronics Products Department , in the Avionics and Simulation Products domain. 
 This position is based in Toulouse, France . 
 Avionics and Simulation domain is an in-house avionics equipment and simulators supplier. This domain deals with avionics technologies, one of the fastest growing sectors in aircraft systems thanks to innovative approaches. 
 One of the pillars of this organization is the Electronics Product Departement. Its mission is to design, to develop, to industrialize, to manufacture, to maintain and to support the critical embedded products (e.g. Flight Controls, Flight Warning, Communication, Maintenance equipments) for all Airbus aircrafts. 
 Within the hardware detailed design team, you will be involved in the design and the verification of digital boards , embedding programmable logic device such as FPGA, or microprocessor. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you: 
 ● Financial rewards : Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 ● Work / Life Balance : Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
 ● Wellbeing / Health : Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 ● Individual development : Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national 
 and international mobility. 
 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. 
 Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 
 Your challenges: 
 ● Responsible for digital boards development (whole V-cycle) : design, check of the final board physical design, board tuning on 1st prototype, then verification tests; 
 ● Within the hardware detailed design team: mentor junior digital boards designers and to review other boards design (role of peer); 
 ● Perform in-depth investigations on legacy equipments on request; 
 ● Contribute to electronics R&D; 
 ● Being accountable for schedule and quality of deliverables . 
 Your boarding pass: 
 ● Master degree in Engineering, specialized in Electronics, together with a solid and proven experience in digital boards design & tests ( at least 15 years, with several boards designed ); 
 ● Relevant experience of FPGA, high-speed buses, multi-core processing; 
 ● Tools: Matlab/Simulink, MathCAD, LTSpice, Zuken CR8000 (or other board design tool); 
 ● Language skills (mandatory): advanced level of French, intermediate level of English 
 This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities. 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 
 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

items.desc:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life 
 Are you a highly motivated capital equipment business developer who knows the world of the operating theatre inside out? Do you understand minimally invasive surgery and have the ability to convince both surgeons and hospital budget holders on high-impact decisions regarding medical capital equipment purchases? Are you energized by a highly competitive environment? 
 A Medtronic Surgical Robotics Business Developer is responsible for selling the Medtronic Hugo™ Robotic-Assisted Surgery System to a selected list of our existing hospital clients. This requires several talents, including the ability to build a coalition of supporters within each hospital, strong client engagement and problem-solving skills, the energy to persevere through long and complex sales cycles, and a natural eagerness and drive to bring opportunities to closure. 
 Responsibilities may include the following, and other duties may be assigned: 
 Be out in the field and travel frequently to meet with clients and colleagues. Occasionally work from home or from one of our many offices across EMEA 
 Engage with surgical teams to assess opportunities for the expansion of robotic-assisted surgery 
 Engage with C-suite executive decision-makers involved in complex innovation projects and large technology adoption plans 
 Support surgical teams in leading hospitals to enhance and augment their clinical strategy through the use of the Medtronic Hugo™ Surgical Robotic System 
 Convince surgical teams of the benefits offered by the Medtronic Hugo™ Surgical Robotic System, including improved outcomes, benefits to patients, faster recovery, advanced surgical techniques, superior 3D high-resolution imaging during surgery, digital surgical solutions, ease of use for surgical teams, OR efficiency, and cost-effectiveness 
 Engage and convince budget holders and executives in leading hospitals by jointly developing business cases, total cost of ownership (TCO) comparisons, and cost-per-procedure analyses to support informed decisions regarding the purchase and use of the Medtronic Hugo™ Surgical Robotic System 
 Be a proven, positive, and successful collaborator within a matrix organization, managing relationships and delivering outcomes in a multi-stakeholder environment 
 Demonstrate a strong appetite for learning and development, with an interest in technological advancements in healthcare 
 Required Knowledge and Experience: 
 Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience leading negotiations and selling complex medical devices or capital equipment, with a proven track record of success 
 Bachelor's degree 
 Native-level Finnish/Danish/Norwegian and proficiency in English 
 You are a winner, but in the right way. You play by the rules, do not cut corners ethically, and respect and adhere to company policies 
 Maintain active networks in the field of surgery and operating theatres, with a network of surgeons with whom you connect regularly 
 Operating room experience 
 Travel/in-field requirement: 70%+ of the time 
 Physical Job Requirements 
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

items.desc:
Location: Huizen, Netherlands 
 About the team 
 The Solution Engineering Team in Huizen (10 fte) performs all system engineering activities for the realization of the successful SOTAS product portfolio. SOTAS is the IT infrastructure and communication solution that is installed in Military Vehicles. It supports the crew with all their communication- and situational awareness needs. To strengthen our group, we are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Solution Engineer.
 About your future job: 
 As a solution engineer, you will work within a multidisciplinary team on the consultancy, design, development and validation of highly complex military systems.
 These systems are built on very reliable electronic hardware with a growing dominant embedded software content.
 You will be part of a team with system architects and engineers and sometimes supported by software and hardware architects, representatives of customers, suppliers of subsystems and other parties involved.
 The main tasks are: 
 After gradually developing a deep understanding of our product portfolio and the domain of our customer, you are able to trade off solutions and capture the design and requirements in system engineering models and requirement management tools.
 While recognizing in our team a strong focus on working together, you will frequently meet with your team to discuss your solution, to learn from each other and to discuss the progress as you strive for continuous improvement. In addition you will discuss your solutions with the customer consultants especially in relation to other systems in the vehicle.
 You will perform the operational and system analyses of the system;
 You will define the functional, non-functional behavior and interfaces of the system and products, in order to define the work for the Software and Hardware development teams or the 3rd party subcontractors.
 Why you'd be a good match 
 A completed degree in Electronic, Software, Aeronautical Engineering, or a similar field is required.
 At least 5 years of experience in an R&D or system engineering department, developing products with electronics, embedded software, and application software is expected.
 Experience in a domain where reliability, availability, and security are critical—such as avionics, telecom, or medical—is required, with preferred experience in the defense industry.
 Strong communication skills, a structured working style, and the ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams are essential.
 A high level of creativity, initiative, pragmatism, and persuasiveness is highly valued.
 Affinity with agile development, model-based system engineering, and the ways AI can enhance system engineering is desirable.
 Fluency in spoken and written English is required - Dutch is preferred.
 What's in it for you 
 A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.
 Room for personal and professional growth within our organisation, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.
 Valuable international collaboration with coworkers from 68 different countries around the globe.
 A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work life balance.
 You can usually work where and when you want to be able to do your work as well and efficiently as possible. Within Thales we implement hybrid working, where you can, for example, work from home two days a week if your role allows it.
 A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalise your employment conditions: for instance, you can trade days off for internet costs, our bicycle plan, company fitness and relocation costs.
 40 days off per year (PTO).

About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Ads Solutions team partners closely with advertisers to deeply understand their businesses and needs, helping inform the development of products and solutions that drive meaningful revenue growth and long-term success on the platform—while maintaining strong standards for user trust and platform integrity.

About the Role

This role is focused on driving new and expanded advertising revenue and ensuring successful business results for advertisers. You will own the full sales cycle — from prospecting to deal closure, developing long-term commercial partnerships to help advertisers achieve their business objectives while ensuring a strong and responsible experience on our platform.

You’ll work closely with Customer Success Managers and key cross-functional partners to ensure advertisers achieve successful outcomes after the sale, while maintaining primary ownership of revenue growth and commercial strategy.

This role is based in our Paris office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Prospect, qualify, and close new advertising opportunities, leading the full sales cycle from initial engagement through contract execution.

 - Own and achieve a defined revenue target within an assigned territory or vertical.

 - Build and maintain relationships with senior-level advertising decision-makers, delivering strategic guidance and actively gathering their feedback.

 - Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements.

 - Quantify opportunities through clear, data-driven business cases aligned to advertiser objectives.

 - Lead cross-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Policy, and Operations to support complex deals.

 - Partner with Customer Success Managers to ensure seamless post-sale transitions and coordinated expansion strategies.

 - Maintain rigorous pipeline management and accurate revenue forecasting.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 10+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, or client-facing strategy and consulting roles.

 - Have 3+ years of experience as proven advisor influencing executives and clients.

 - Have experience owning revenue targets and closing complex deals.

 - Can build structured business cases and influencing senior stakeholders (internally and externally).

 - Have strong verbal and written communication skills.

 - Can operate in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

 - Understand the client’s business and priorities to define success metrics and align on partnership goals.

 - Translate analytical insights into compelling commercial narratives.

items.title: Member of Technical Staff (Site Reliability Engineer, Crawler)
items.card: Responsibilities - Operate and optimize Kubernetes workloads and supporting infrastructure for crawler services, including fetching and rendering fleets. - Build and maintain infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines, with safe rollouts, validation, and fast rollback. - Define SLOs and build monitoring, alerting, and observability for availability, latency, throughput, and resource saturation. - Own capacity
items.desc:
Keeping a crawler running is not the same as keeping it productive. Queues can grow while servers look healthy, and a small change can become a fleet-wide bottleneck. On Perplexity's Crawler team, you'll improve throughput, plan capacity, and build operational reliability through safer deployments, better observability, and durable fixes.



Responsibilities

 - Operate and optimize Kubernetes workloads and supporting infrastructure for crawler services, including fetching and rendering fleets.

 - Build and maintain infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines, with safe rollouts, validation, and fast rollback.

 - Define SLOs and build monitoring, alerting, and observability for availability, latency, throughput, and resource saturation.

 - Own capacity planning and resource efficiency; diagnose queue backlogs, network failures, and resource bottlenecks with service owners.

 - Participate in the team's on-call rotation, lead incident response, and turn blameless postmortems into durable reliability improvements.

 - Write production software to automate diagnosis and routine remediation, with validation and approval gates for high-impact actions.



Qualifications

 - 5+ years of experience in SRE, production engineering, or infrastructure-heavy backend roles, with strong programming skills in Python, C++, Rust, or Go.

 - Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, production Kubernetes, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and automated deployment workflows.

 - Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP, and load balancing.

 - Experience building observability with tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana, and using SLOs to guide reliability improvements.

 - Proven experience diagnosing distributed-system failures, leading production incidents, and improving system performance or resource efficiency.



Nice to have

 - Experience operating web crawlers, search infrastructure, or browser fleets at scale.

 - Experience with distributed queues, backpressure, workload isolation, or multi-region recovery.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Field marketing is at the heart of how we build demand, foster community, deepen customer relationships, and accelerate growth. We are looking for a highly motivated, self-starter Field Marketing Manager to build the engine that fills the funnel for our Southern Europe GTM team, focused on two to three priority industries: healthcare, financial services, telco, and retail and e-commerce.

Your expertise in industry-led field marketing strategy, regional program execution, and GTM partnership will be pivotal in creating the moments that bring enterprise buyers to the table, from executive dinners and roadshows to industry conferences, roundtables, and account-based programs aimed at named buying committees. Collaborating closely with the Southern European GTM team and the broader marketing team, you will own every stage of the field motion, from territory and account strategy through budgeting, on-site execution, and post-program pipeline attribution.

ElevenAgents is being evaluated today by customer experience and contact center leaders at the largest health systems, banks, carriers, and retailers in Southern Europe. Your ability to think like a marketer, act like a salesperson, and run multiple industry programs at once will ensure we get in front of them first.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build the engine that fills the funnel for your industries, a repeatable program mix that creates net new pipeline quarter over quarter

 - Develop and execute the Southern Europe field plan for two to three industries, from territory and account strategy through budget, execution, and attribution

 - Partner with Enterprise and Strategic account executives on named account lists. Agree the targets, fill the room, drive the follow-up.

 - Design the program mix: executive dinners, industry conferences, roadshows, roundtables, customer advisory sessions, and 1:few account-based plays

 - Create the vertical narrative with Product Marketing. Invite copy, talk tracks, and follow-up sequences that speak to a healthcare, banking, telco, or retail buyer, not a generic one.

 - Manage event budgets and timelines, and report pipeline created and cost per opportunity, program by program

This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 (Senior) Product Pricing Strategist 
 As Adyen continues to expand and deepen our product suite, we are looking for a (Senior) Product Pricing Strategist to help us develop and implement the best monetization, packaging and pricing strategies. You will work closely together with different teams such as Product Management, Commercial Strategy and Finance. Your work will be instrumental in continuing to drive Adyen’s growth and you’ll play a major role in shaping the future of Adyen.
 You will be part of our Global Commercial Pricing & Monetization team which helps define the best value-based pricing and monetization strategies and provides price guidance to the commercial organization. In addition, we enable all commercial teams in creating the best commercial price proposals by providing them with means such as tools, insights and training. Finally, we monitor price developments to be able to spot trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
 What you will do 
 You develop and execute monetization strategies for key new and existing payment products to drive sustainable margin growth.
 Partner with global leadership and cross-functional teams (Product, Commercial Strategy, Finance) to align monetization strategies with business objectives and market trends.
 Analyze market conditions, competitor pricing, and internal data to recommend packaging and pricing models.
 Track and report on margin performance and price developments, spotting trends and opportunities for optimization.
 Work on continuous improvement projects to refine pricing models, enhance margin growth, and stay competitive in the market.
 Provide input on new product launches, helping to set initial pricing and discounting strategies and making adjustments based on market feedback and performance
 Who you are 
 You have a proven track record in a pricing, monetization, or commercial strategy role (typically 5+ years of experience for Senior).
 You know how to translate pricing and monetization strategy into commercial execution—from model design through to rollout and adoption.
 You manage competing priorities well in a fast-paced environment and take initiative to spot and solve commercial problems.
 You communicate clearly, build strong cross-functional relationships across a global company, and use data to influence and push back on senior stakeholders when needed.
 You take end-to-end ownership of projects, driving deliverables forward while keeping key partners aligned.
 Experience in the B2B technology, payments, or fintech sector is not required but preferred. 
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

 What’s next?

Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.
