 Why this role matters 
 The Quality Management System (QMS) Specialist/engineer is responsible for implementation of the ICEYEs Quality Management System in our Valencia production unit to ensure consistent delivery of products and services that meet customer, regulatory, and industry standards. In this role you will partner closely with production, supply chain, Health and safety teams to ensure that our processes are aligned with business goals and embedded into daily practices.
 This role will report to the Global Quality Management System (QMS) manager and operate as a standalone position within the Spain facility.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.
 As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring including oil-spill detection, and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.
 ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Given the significant workload involving dual-use items, this is a key position responsible for cooperating with customs agencies and carriers to ensure seamless import/export clearance and
items.desc:
Role Highlights 
 Title: Freight & Customs Clearance Specialist
 Department: Global Manufacturing Organization (Logistics)
 Reports to: Head of MAITE, Optics / Logistics Manager
 Location: Warsaw, Poland
 Type of Contract: Permanent
 Working model: On-site
 Security Clearance: Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 About the role 
 ICEYE is looking for a Freight & Customs Clearance Specialist to manage international freight forwarding, customs compliance, and logistics operations supporting our manufacturing activities in Warsaw, Poland. Given the significant workload involving dual-use items, this is a key position responsible for cooperating with customs agencies and carriers to ensure seamless import/export clearance and timely deliveries.
 You will manage end-to-end inbound and outbound freight flows, execute international trade compliance (including ITAR, EAR, and dual-use export controls), coordinate customs brokerage services, and oversee shipping documentation. You will work closely with Procurement, Production Planning, Quality, and external logistics partners to ensure all shipments arrive on schedule while adhering to compliance and budget requirements.
 What you will do 
 Oversee inbound and outbound logistics, including air, sea, and road freight forwarding, customs clearance, and carrier coordination.
 Execute full compliance with international trade regulations, dual-use items, ITAR, and EAR export controls.
 Manage relationships and operational workflows with external customs agencies (such as Customs Support Group/Rusak Business Services) and freight forwarders (such as Gebrüder Weiss).
 Prepare, verify, and archive essential shipping and customs documentation (e.g., AWB, SAD/ZC429, commercial invoices, DSK declarations).
 Ensure proper tariff classification (HS/CN codes), valuation, and origin determination for satellite components and specialized aerospace equipment.
 Monitor freight costs, duty payments, and customs duty guarantees, driving cost optimization and efficiency in transport activities.
 Coordinate specialized handling, shock-sensitive packaging, and transport requirements for high-value space hardware in accordance with AS9100 and ECSS standards.
 Mitigate logistics risks, supply disruptions, and customs delays through proactive tracking and contingency planning.
 What we're looking for 
 Must haves: 
 3–5 years of hands-on experience in international freight forwarding, customs clearance, and shipping operations.
 Proven experience working in a structured production environment (Aerospace, Defense, Automotive, or Electronics).
 Strong expertise in customs procedures, EORI, SAD/ZC429, tariff classification, and dual-use item regulations.
 Experience handling international trade controls (ITAR, EAR, export licenses).
 Proficiency with ERP systems and WMS workflows.
 Strong command of MS Excel / Google Sheets for reporting and freight tracking.
 Fluency in English and Polish (essential for daily communication with local customs authorities and international stakeholders).
 Certification for dangerous goods transport by road, sea, and air (ADR, IMDG, IATA)
 Application Process 
 Screening with Talent Team
 Hiring Manager Interview
 Technical Case / Assessment
 Final Interview

 At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. items.desc:
Mission Delivery Engineer Greece 
 Department: Missions Line of Business
 Location: ICEYE Athens, Greece
 Reports to: Mission Delivery Engineer Team Lead
 Employment type: Permanent
 Working type: Hybrid (3 days / week in office)
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening 
 Why This Role Matters 
 As a Mission Delivery Engineer you will support the delivery of complex Satellite Mission programs end-to-end with deep technical ownership, ensuring customer success, on-time execution, and scalable delivery excellence.
 You will work across the Portfolio focusing on the technical thread of customer missions—from requirements capture through system acceptance and delivery—acting as the technical authority/interface between the customer and ICEYE's engineering, product, and operations teams. Your role bridges program governance and system engineering: ensuring mission requirements are understood, flowed down, tracked, and validated, while maintaining configuration control and driving cross-functional technical alignment throughout the program lifecycle.
 This role directly contributes to ICEYE's ambition to become the leading provider of space-based ISR infrastructure by scaling reliable, high-impact mission delivery globally.
 The role will be based in Athens at the ICEYE facility. Travel to customer sites is required.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Expected Outcomes & Requirements 
 Outcomes 
 Customer technical requirements are accurately captured, baselined, and flowed down to engineering teams, ensuring all mission commitments are fully traceable from contract to delivery.
 Customers experience a consistent, high-trust technical partnership, with a single accountable interface that understands their systems and operational needs throughout the program lifecycle.
 System integration, verification, and validation activities are planned and executed rigorously, ensuring all delivered capabilities are compliant with mission and contractual requirements.
 Configuration and interface control is maintained across all mission segments—satellite, ground, networks, and user interfaces—minimising risk from upgrades, changes, and inter-system dependencies.
 Technical risks, discrepancies, and gaps are identified early, escalated effectively and resolved proactively through structured coordination across software, hardware, operations, and QA teams.
 Cross-functional technical teams operate in alignment, with clear ownership and system-level perspective maintained across all reviews, delivery milestones, and readiness checks.
 Technical documentation—including CONOPS, ICDs, verification matrices, mission analysis, and acceptance reports—is delivered on time and kept current with the actual system implementation.

 5+ years' experience delivering complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs in advanced technology environments (e.g. space, defence, telecom, automotive, IT)
 Proven ability to own the technical customer interface, managing senior stakeholders and translating operational requirements into engineering deliverables
 Hands-on experience with requirements management, traceability, and configuration control across hardware, software, and system-level domains
 Demonstrated involvement in system integration, verification and validation (V&V) planning and execution, including acceptance testing campaigns
 Strong cross-functional technical coordination skills across engineering, product, and operations disciplines
 Experience of carrying out analysis and mission design using software packages such as STK, SaVoir, MONTE or GMAT
 Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences, including formal reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, DRR)
 Degree in engineering, systems engineering, computer science, or a related technical field
 Must have or be able to obtain required security clearances

 Experience in Earth Observation (EO), SAR, or remote sensing
 Background in space mission systems or satellite ground segment development
 Experience working with government or defence customers on classified or sovereign programs

items.desc: About us Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ About the role At Ruby Labs we are looking for an AI Engineer (Strong Middle / Senior level) to own and drive the quality, reliability and evolution of our AI systems in production. This is a high-ownership role. You will be responsible for end-to-end delivery of AI features, production stability of AI systems, and data-driven experimentation using tools like Langfuse and Cloudflare AI gateway for model routing. Increasingly, this includes agentic, tool-using AI systems: defining clean tool contracts (including MCP-based tools) and orchestrating how AI interacts with internal services, search and background pipelines. The stack is TypeScript end to end: Node.js and Hono services on Cloudflare Workers with Durable Objects and Containers, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch. Models from several providers run behind an AI gateway, with prompts, traces and evaluations in Langfuse. Key Responsibilities AI Systems Ownership & Feature Delivery Take ownership of major AI features and LLM workflows and deliver them to production within agreed timelines. Own AI output quality, structure and predictability across user-facing AI interactions, with consistent structured output across different LLMs for the same request type. Integrate and orchestrate multiple LLM providers through an AI gateway, managing model selection, fallback strategies and cost optimisation. Design and orchestrate tool-using and agentic AI workflows: clean tool contracts (including MCP-based tools), function-calling interfaces and reliable AI-to-system integrations. Build and maintain multi-step LLM workflows and RAG pipelines (indexing, embeddings, retrieval, re-ranking) for reasoning, context reuse and search. Prompt Engineering, Evaluation & Experimentation Design and manage production prompt systems with dynamic prompting, context injection, and conditional logic. Own prompt management, the release of LLM experiments and Langfuse-based evaluation pipelines: test datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, output scoring. Run A/B tests across models and prompts, analyse the results and present the data-driven impact of AI features and experiments. Deep-debug LLM chains using Langfuse traces: identify bottlenecks, optimise for cost, latency and context-window usage, and root-cause hallucinations and logic errors. Code Quality & Production Reliability Write clean, scalable and maintainable TypeScript across the Node.js / Cloudflare Workers stack. Build reliable backend logic for AI systems: request and output validation, error handling, fallback flows for malformed or low-quality model responses, and reliable tool execution. Ensure high code quality through tests (including validation and fallback paths for AI output), code reviews and clear engineering standards. Monitor AI system metrics, quality signals, latency and release health, and resolve production issues with a documented root cause. Document prompt designs, model and routing choices, evaluation results and architectural decisions, so others can pick up the work. Qualifications 4+ years of backend/fullstack software engineering experience, with production-grade TypeScript/Node.js. 1+ year of AI/LLM systems in production with real users, not only side projects or experiments. Daily use of AI-centred development tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar). Deep hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or similar) in production: structured output, function calling, streaming, token and cost control. Experience with agentic AI, multi-step orchestration, tool-based workflows (function calling / tool execution) or RAG pipelines (indexing, retrieval, re-ranking). Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tools (Langfuse, LangSmith or similar). Experience with AI gateways and model routing (OpenRouter, Cloudflare AI Gateway or equivalent). Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and caching (Redis, KV or similar). Exceptional ownership and personal responsibility for engineering quality and delivery. Nice to have Evaluation frameworks (LLM-as-a-judge, RAGAS) and building test datasets. MCP (Model Context Protocol): building MCP servers/clients or designing tool contracts for AI agents. Edge/serverless runtimes (Cloudflare Workers) and their services: KV, Durable Objects, Queues, R2, Containers. Search engines and vector search (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, pgvector), embeddings. items.desc: Appunite is moving from selling engineering hours to owning outcomes, and AI is a big part of that shift. Clients come to us with a business problem and a hunch that AI can solve it. Someone has to sit with them, figure out what’s really worth building, prove it works and get the first version into production. That’s this role. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pre-sales one. You’ll run the technical side of discovery: workshops, stakeholder interviews and reviews of the client’s systems, data and integrations. You’ll build prototypes that answer the key questions before the client commits, then shape the solution, the estimate and the technical part of the offer. Once a project is signed, you’ll lead the first phase of delivery and hand it over to an engineer you’ve prepared to take it from there. You’ll also build the practice. That means turning real projects into our AI discovery and delivery playbook and training engineers until they can run discovery on their own. What we offer Salary: 28 500 - 35 000 PLN net/month B2B - depending on your experience Remote first approach Ownership of the service Appunite is building it’s core offer around AI coding tools as the default way of working, not an experiment 5+ years in software engineering, with regular, direct client work in recent years, including scoping or presales. You’ve designed and shipped at least one LLM-based system to production (RAG, agents, extraction or classification, assistants) used by real users. You know evals, cost, latency, guardrails and the typical failure modes. Production experience in Python or TypeScript with AI SDKs, and you’re happy to work in the client’s stack. You can work in Elixir codebases, at least with AI assistance. Claude Code, Cursor or similar tools are your everyday way of building software. You’ve technically led a client implementation, or a part of one, all the way to production. You still code every day and can build a prototype that tests a hypothesis in a day or two. You can turn a vague business problem into an architecture, a list of integrations and data sources, risks and a first estimate. You’re comfortable running workshops with non-technical stakeholders and writing short, clear recommendations for business decision-makers. You’ve onboarded, mentored or trained other engineers, or set team standards. You understand the commercial side of discovery: you can cut scope down to a first phase that’s doable and sellable, and you’ll tell a client when they shouldn’t build something. Native-level Polish and C1 English, spoken and written. What you’ll do Lead the technical side of client discovery: workshops, interviews, analysis of systems, data and integrations, feasibility and risks. Build prototypes and PoCs, mostly LLM-based, that settle key questions before the client decides to go ahead. Co-create the discovery report, the technical part of the offer and the estimate, then present the solution to the client. Technically lead the first phase of delivery while preparing an engineer to take over. Build Appunite’s playbook for AI discovery and delivery based on real projects. Train engineers through shadowing until they can run technical discovery on their own. Run internal AI sessions and create technical materials that support sales. Take part in technical interviews for future Forward Deployed Engineers. What does the recruitment process look like? Video interview with our People Team. Technical interview with an engineers. Final check with Team Leader. The decision, after which we can say “welcome on board”.

items.desc: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Engineering Manager __ Your Role & Responsibilities: Do you enjoy turning complex plant requirements into clear, reliable electrical designs? As a Project Engineer Electrical at ABB, you will be the technical reference for electrical engineering on small and mid-sized projects, from database planning and cabinet design through to on-site commissioning, bringing care for quality and safety, courage to challenge ideas, and curiosity to improve how we work. You will join a welcoming, collaborative team of colleagues who look out for each other, from lunch walks and coffee breaks to yearly team events. The work model for this role is: on-site with 8 home office days per month and 40% obligatory travel. Design and maintain electrical documentation in EPLAN, including database planning, control cabinet planning, and automated generation of electrical schematics, completing the remaining schematics yourself Act as design authority for low-to-medium complexity electrical engineering, delivering to contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements and cybersecurity policies Support installation, testing and on-site commissioning, and coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain and project managers from contract to project closure Work flexibly between the office, home office and project sites, with approx. 40% travel within Austria (currently including Vorarlberg) with pool cars available at your disposal Our team dynamics: Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there. What it takes to Run what runs the world: An electrical engineering qualification such as a HTL diploma with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a completed apprenticeship with approx. 10 years of practical experience or equivalent Advanced hands-on experience with EPLAN Electric P8 Experience in plant engineering (Anlagenbau) and EMSR design, ideally in mechanically led plant projects Experience in power generation, such as power plants or hydropower plants is a strong advantage Written and spoken German and English at B2 level or higher We offer a full range of benefits to help you thrive at work and beyond: Work-Life Balance – Flexible working models, including flextime and hybrid options, to support your personal and professional life. Health & Well-being – Access to various health measures, a Global Employee Assistance Program , and a gender-neutral parental leave policy . Financial Perks – Participation in the Global Employee Shareholder Acquisition Program (ESAP) and meal allowances. Career Growth – Extensive training opportunities and structured development programs to help you advance. Inclusive Culture – An international work environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. The minimum compensation, in accordance with the electrical and electronics industry collective agreement, is 3.800 EUR monthly for a full-time position as of May 2026. We are happy to speak in person about your compensation package in accordance with your qualifications and experience. More about us: The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle. Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World. #ABBcareers #LI-Hybrid #RunwithABB #Runwhatrunstheworld Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

items.desc: adesso Belgium, who are we? We are an IT (start-up) provider working under the adesso umbrella with proven track record in different industries. The new Belgian entity of adesso is part of the expansion and growth strategy of the adesso group. With more than 10.000 employees spread over 60 locations we are entering an exciting period with our presence in Brussels, the capital of Europe. As part of adesso’s group ‘’grow together’’ mission, we want to attract talents who are ready for common growth. This means supporting the company’s vision, strategy, and growth in customers, industries, and, of course, the adessi community in Belgium. Do you want to make data truly work ? At adesso, we are looking for a Data Engineer who knows how to translate complex data issues into scalable, efficient solutions. Someone who embraces cloud technology, but also understands that good data solutions start with understanding the process behind the numbers. As a Data Engineer at adesso, you are an indispensable link in our data-driven projects. You ensure that raw, scattered, and unstructured data is transformed into reliable and accessible information. You do this by building robust data pipelines, modeling data layers, and setting up (cloud) data architectures that really work for the customer. What makes you special is that you are not only technically strong, but also contribute ideas about the content. You understand the customer's context, set realistic expectations, and work closely with data scientists, analysts, and other specialists. Your Role in Projects: Designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines and data platforms in the cloud Structuring, transforming, and loading structured and unstructured data Translating customer processes into workable data structures Building reliable and scalable architectures with an eye for performance and maintenance Setting up data storage, integrations, and access via BI tools or APIs Contributing ideas about data quality, governance, and security Collaborating with colleagues in multidisciplinary teams Required technical skills & knowledge: PL/SQL - Python - Microsoft Fabric - Microsoft Synapse - Microsoft SQL Server - Snowflake - DBT -Agile - Power BI - AI - Databricks - ML Your profile You have a bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in computer science or equivalent. You have at least 5 years work experience as data engineer and experience in at least one data platform: Databricks, Microsoft Fabric or Snowflake You have strong command of SQL & Python, ETL/ELT processes and data modeling. You communicate clearly in Dutch/French and English (spoken and written) Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP Experience with CI/CD (preferred) and knowledge of dbt and/or Spark (preferred) Familiarity with data integration tools such as SSIS, ADF, or Airflow Experience with visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau Understanding of data governance, security, and Agile working methods You are analytical, structured, and have strong communication skills Why join adesso Belgium? Meaningful work and projects: work within your domain of expertise where you can create value for customers and grow together with the company Strategic opinion: your opinion and contribution to the expansion of the company is very valuable, it counts! You can give the company direction bringing in your ideas, creativity and vision for future growth! GROWtogether : With over 400 training courses and our digital learning platform, we support your continuous development. Work-Life Balance & Flexibility : Enjoy hybrid working options and a dynamic work environment: we are located nearby the Brussels North Train Station in ‘Gare Maritime - Tour & Taxi’ where with a lot of different facilities are present: food corner, gym, padel courts, …. there is even a skate park :) Comprehensive Benefits : Competitive salary, company car with mobility budget, charging card, net allowance, meal vouchers, insurances and 32 days of annual leave. Global Reach with Local Expertise : you will be part of a small agile company where our culture code will drive us to success. As part of an international company we are supported in different domains with expertise and top notch reference cases! More info about Adesso-group & Press release

L'entreprise Wavestone recherche actuellement des profils : Dans un monde où savoir se transformer est la clé du succès, l'ambition de Wavestone est d'apporter à ses clients des réponses uniques sur le marché, en les éclairant et les guidant dans leurs décisions les plus stratégiques. Wavestone est un nouveau cabinet de conseil, issu du rapprochement début 2016 de Solucom et des activités européennes de Kurt Salmon (à l'exclusion de consumer goods & retail en dehors de France). Notre cabinet rassemble 2800 collaborateurs présents sur 4 continents, figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe, et constitue le 1er cabinet de conseil indépendant en France. Pour satisfaire nos clients, nous développons 18 terrains d’excellence, à la fois sectoriels, fonctionnels, et technologiques. Sur chacun d’eux, nous nous engageons à apporter à nos clients une profondeur d’expertise de premier plan. Mais surtout, et c’est là le cœur de notre proposition de valeur, nous combinons ces 18 terrains d’excellence sans couture et sans silos. Enfin, pour enrichir notre offre, nous investissons dans 5 assets à forte valeur ajoutée : le Research Knowledge Center, parce que pour prendre de bonnes décisions il faut de bonnes informations, le Creadesk, qui permet de stimuler la créativité et l’innovation, la Faktory, pour prototyper des idées en mode « test and learn », le Machine Learning et Data Lab, pour exploiter les gisements de valeur qui se cachent dans les données de nos clients et Shake Up', pour accompagner des start-ups dans leur croissance et leur développement. Nous recrutons des talents aux parcours diversifiés, de tous niveaux d'expérience. Des personnalités engagées, reconnues pour leur goût d'entreprendre et leur esprit d'équipe. Venez vivre une expérience unique au sein de Wavestone ! \n\n Description de l'entreprise Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques. Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Nous accompagnons les DSI et les directions métiers dans leurs transformations les plus structurantes, de la définition de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle : gouvernance et modèle opérationnel, pilotage de grands programmes de transformation, cloud, infrastructures et digital workplace, digitalisation des processus, conduite du changement et amélioration de la performance IT. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans la protection de leurs systèmes, données et activités : : gouvernance cybersécurité et gestion des risques, conformité réglementaire (NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001), cyber-résilience et gestion de crise, audits de sécurité et tests d’intrusion, gestion des identités et des accès (IAM), supervision et réponse aux incidents, sécurisation des environnements cloud et industriels. L'entreprise Sopra Steria recherche actuellement des profils : Sopra Steria, acteur majeur de la Tech en Europe avec 56000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays, est reconnu pour ses activités de conseil, de services numériques et d’édition de logiciels. Il aide ses clients à mener leur transformation digitale et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables. Le Groupe apporte une réponse globale aux enjeux de compétitivité des grandes entreprises et organisations, combinant une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d’activité et des technologies innovantes à une approche résolument collaborative. Sopra Steria place l’humain au centre de son action et s’engage auprès de ses clients à tirer le meilleur parti du digital pour construire un avenir positif. En 2023, le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 5,8 milliards d’euros. The world is how we shape it \n\n Description de l'entreprise La Business Line Cybersécurité de Sopra Steria est présente en Europe avec plus de 2500 experts - dont plus de la moitié en France -, notre mission est d’apporter des solutions et des services de confiance aux acteurs publics et privés les plus exposés pour assurer la résilience de leurs systèmes critiques et protéger leur patrimoine numérique sensible. Au-delà de la forte présence européenne, la division cybersécurité se positionne et se développe en Amérique du nord (Toronto), ainsi qu’en Asie Pacifique (Singapour). Nous proposons 3 domaines d’offres : Prévention, Protection & détection et réponse. Ces 3 domaines s’articulent les uns avec les autres pour apporter à nos clients une information homogène et des capacités de décisions éclairées par la réalité opérationnelle. Cette approche s’appuie sur notre méthodologie transverse centrée sur Mitre Att&ck. Sopra Steria se base sur des capacités souveraines éprouvées et reconnues pour renforcer votre résilience face aux cyberattaques et accélérer votre transformation digitale. Une solution de confiance de bout-en-bout Une approche « security by design » centrée sur les risques métiers et transverse à l’organisation. Un engagement dans le développement de solutions souveraines innovantes. Chaque individu peut avoir un impact sur la réponse à ces nouveaux défis en matière de cyber risques. Chacun contribue à la fois individuellement et collectivement à sécuriser nos clients et la société tout en maintenant sa croissance personnelle et professionnelle. Description du poste Au sein de la value center Protect, rejoignez une équipe experte en cybersécurité pour concevoir, sécuriser et faire évoluer les architectures de connectivité (LAN, WAN, Cloud, Internet) pour des clients majeurs. Vous garantissez un accès réseau fiable, sécurisé et conforme aux exigences de cybersécurité (Zero Trust, segmentation, micro-segmentation, protection des flux). Votre rôle et vos missions : Vous assurez la conception et le déploiement d’architectures sécurisées (LAN/WAN/Cloud/SASE/SDWAN/Interconnexions). Vous réalisez la mise en œuvre et la gestion des firewalls, VPN, Proxy, SASE/SSE, inspection TLS, IDS/IPS, NAC. Vous appliquez les principes Zero Trust et de segmentation. Vous prenez en charge la gestion des incidents, audits, revues de configuration, amélioration continue. Vous produisez la documentation technique et d’exploitation. Vous accompagnez les équipes projets et clients sur leurs besoins de connectivité sécurisée. Vous contribuez à l’industrialisation des solutions (automatisation, IA). items.desc: Heidelberg Materials is one of the world's largest integrated manufacturers of building materials and solutions with leading market positions in cement, aggregates, and ready-mixed concrete. We are represented in more than 50 countries with around 51,000 employees at almost 3,000 locations and now we’re seeking to recruit in Heidelberg Materials Digital Hub Wrocław. What will you do: As an AI-Native Software Engineer, you build and run production software for Heidelberg Materials using AI as a core part of your engineering workflow. You delegate work to coding agents, review and own everything they produce, and keep the engineering fundamentals (security, architecture, testing, refactoring, continuous delivery) that make AI-assisted delivery safe at scale. You’ll turn AI capabilities into real product features, taking ideas from experimentation through to production and user impact. Design, build, and operate production services and applications end to end. You own what you ship, including what an agent wrote. Work in a research, plan, implement cycle: let agents research and draft the plan, review the plan with your peers before any code is written, then hand off the implementation and review the result. Raise the quality bar where AI shifts the bottleneck. More generated code means architecture discipline matters more, not less. When an agent makes the same mistake twice, fix the setup, not just the output: improve the repository instructions, checks, hooks or a shared skill. Contribute what works back to our shared tooling so other teams benefit. Bring business and system context into your work through our shared knowledge base and connections to Jira and Confluence, and add what only lives in people's heads so that colleagues and agents can use it. Apply judgement on AI-specific risks: prompt injection, personal data and secrets in prompts, licensing, and wrong AI output reaching production. Try new AI capabilities early and share what you learn (what worked, what didn't, what it cost) with our internal AI-native community. Use the speed AI gives you to shorten the loop, not to build more unvalidated software - prototype, show it, learn, discard or harden. Spend AI credits where they create value: know roughly what a task costs and stop when more spend no longer pays off. Work directly with business stakeholders or your product manager across the whole lifecycle: shape the problem, test feasibility with prototypes, investigate production issues and follow up on adoption. Communicate trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders across countries and departments We are looking for these competencies: BSc or MSc in Computer Science or comparable education. Solid experience building and operating production software, including hands-on delivery with coding agents on real codebases. Curiosity to keep up with AI capabilities as they change, and the habit of sharing what you learn. Comfortable working across .NET, Python and TypeScript. Hands-on experience with cloud services (Azure preferred), containerisation, and CI/CD pipelines. Solid testing discipline (unit, integration, contract) and an instinct for what AI-generated code needs covered. A working understanding of how large language models behave and where they fail, and the judgement to know when not to use AI. Awareness of AI-specific security and compliance risks (prompt injection, data leakage, secrets in context, IP and licensing). Proven track record of working directly with stakeholders and end users, not only through a product owner. Bias for short feedback loops: shipping small, validating with real users, and changing course on evidence. Passion for finding simple solutions to complex problems. Proficient in both verbal and written English. items.desc: Company Description InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape. The Global Architecture Team is a small, senior group of individual contributors working directly with our CTO. Together with the domains, the team defines the target architecture for InPost markets and helps shape the north star technology roadmap. It owns the process for global and cross-domain decisions and guides the standards the whole technology organization builds on. Its current focus is the cloud journey and the strategy for legacy systems, connecting technology direction with what directors and the board need. The team works closely with Senior Engineering Directors, Principal Engineers and Senior Engineering Managers Job Description Help us simplify a global technology landscape, not just document it. We are looking for a Solution Architect who combines an architectural perspective with a highly practical approach to system migrations and decommissioning . This is an opportunity to work across systems, business capabilities and markets, translating target architecture into an actionable rationalisation roadmap and helping the organisation turn that roadmap into real change. We are not looking for someone whose work ends with a diagram or presentation. What matters is the impact you can have on which systems we evolve, migrate, consolidate and ultimately retire . Your impact You will help own and continuously evolve our group-wide business capability model , mapping capabilities to systems across markets and keeping that information up to date in the central architecture repository. In practice, you will: maintain a clear baseline of systems involved in migration and rationalisation, work with project teams to assess major changes across the technology landscape, translate target architecture into a sequenced rationalisation roadmap , coordinate cross-domain and group-wide migrations from the architecture perspective, stay actively involved in global programme and domain roadmaps to identify risks, dependencies and exceptions to target architecture, influence decisions and roadmaps across domains and markets without having to own delivery directly. Your impact will extend beyond a single product or application. You will operate at the intersection of enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, technology transformation and global roadmaps , turning target architecture into concrete migration, rationalisation and decommissioning decisions. If you enjoy making sense of complex technology landscapes, creating structure and then helping turn that structure into real change, we would like to hear from you. Qualifications You could be a great fit if... You bring 6+ years of commercial experience in business analysis, software engineering, solution architecture or a related field. Most importantly, you have participated in at least one cross-team system migration or decommissioning initiative on a global scale, end to end . You understand what it takes to move from architecture and planning to navigating dependencies across systems, teams and markets. You will also feel at home in this role if you: have hands-on experience with business capability modelling and gap analysis at group or multi-system level, can read and discuss architecture diagrams fluently and ask sharp questions, communicate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders, can influence decisions and roadmaps across domains and markets without directly owning delivery, bring strong analytical precision and attention to detail, use AI tools such as Claude Code or Codex in your day-to-day work, communicate in English at C1 level Nice to have Experience with BPMN, C4 Model or other business and architecture modelling approaches. Experience in logistics, e-commerce or parcel delivery . Additional Information What we offer Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits for people and investing in providing training opportunities for their development. You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and the circular economy every day. Excellent environment and flexible hours We offer B2B type of contract

What's in it for you: Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms). A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories. A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers). English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job. A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings. An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal. You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create. You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job. You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support). You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers. You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning. You will become part of Allegro Tech - we speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk …

items.desc: Your Mission We are scientists, doctors, techies and humanity lovers, with the mission of pioneering real time precision neurology to cure brain-related disorders. INBRAIN harnesses the extraordinary material properties of Graphene, the world’s thinnest and nobel-prize winning material, to build high resolution neural systems. Our mission is to decode and modulate neural networks to restore people's lives. As an Electronics Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing cutting-edge medical devices, with a strong emphasis on advanced medical electronic systems. Currently, we are looking for several Mid-level and Senior profiles specializing in Design or Verification/Validation. You will be at the forefront of bringing advanced healthcare solutions to market, making a tangible difference in people´s lives worldwide. What You'll Do Main Responsibilities: Development of medical device electronic circuits that are part of an implantable neurostimulation system, in close collaboration with mechanical and software engineering teams. Translate requirements and user needs into electronic system designs. Develop medical devices according to applicable standards. Work with external partners in the outsourced design, assembly and test of electronic systems that are part of an implantable neurostimulation system. Participate in design failure mode and effect analysis (DFMEA) on designs. Develop and build (automated) test systems to characterize and verify electronics and embedded systems. Create test plans to verify the electronics and embedded systems against the product and manufacturing requirements. Perform system integration, verification, and validation. Contribute to design reviews, technical reviews, and milestone reviews. Understand and apply DFR/DFM/DFT (Design for Reliability, Design for Manufacturing and Design for Test). What You'll Bring Education BSc or MSc in Electronics Engineering , or a related technical discipline. Experience and Technical Skills At least +5 years of work experience in a relevant medical device development environment. Experienced in electronics and PCB design according to IPC standards . A system-thinking attitude, team oriented, a sparring partner to colleagues. Strong practical engineering background in electronics and embedded design . Experienced with electronic simulation and design methodologies and tools (e.g., Spice, Altium, etc.). Experienced in Verification test design and execution. Experienced in T est tool and test system development. Fluency in English required (English is company language). Fluency in Spanish is a plus. Behavioural Competencies Determination to develop yourself. Be a team player. Communicate effectively. Think and act strategically. Preferred Experience in electronics design for active medical implantable devices according to ISO 14708 . Experience in design and testing for electrical safety according to IEC60601. Experience in design and testing for electro-magnetic compatibility. Familiarity with IC design. Familiar with electronics manufacturing processes. Understanding of medical risk analysis and FMEA. Experience in neuroscience. Recruitment Process At INBRAIN , we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and lead to better outcomes for our team, our technology, and the patients we serve. We encourage individuals from underrepresented backgrounds to apply, even if they do not meet every qualification listed, as we recognize that talent and potential come in many forms. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min) – A deeper discussion focused on your experience, technical expertise, and alignment with the role and team. Culture Fit Interview (60 min) - Conversations with key stakeholder and People & Culture Representative. This approach allows us to get to know you holistically while giving you the opportunity to learn more about our team, culture, and mission. Why us? items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for a Space Quality Assurance Engineer (AIT) has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space in Getafe (Madrid). The selected candidate will join the Space Quality Assurance Team within Airbus Defence and Space. Our multidisciplinary and multicultural department is in charge of ensuring the highest quality and reliability standards across complex space hardware and systems throughout their lifecycle. The jobholder will reinforce our Assembly, Integration, and Test (AIT) Quality operations, playing a key role in guaranteeing product integrity and compliance for cutting-edge space programs in close collaboration with Manufacturing Engineering, Materials & Processes, and AIT management. RESPONSIBILITIES The jobholder will be responsible for: Project Quality Point of Contact: Act as the primary quality interface throughout the Assembly, Integration, and Test (AIT) phases, collaborating closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Materials & Processes, and AIT management, while supporting international test campaigns on-site when required. Inspections & Reviews Management: Coordinate and perform incoming/outgoing inspections, Key Inspection Points (KIPs), and Mandatory Inspection Points (MIPs), as well as organize and manage Integration Readiness Reviews (IRRs). Non-Conformity & Root Cause Management: Manage non-conformities and deviations during AIT phases—including leading internal Non-Conformity Review Board (NRB) meetings—and drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) processes for critical or repetitive issues. Quality Documentation & Deliverables: Prepare core quality deliverables (Quality Assurance Plans, Quality Control Plans, inspection reports) and contribute to key project documentation such as KIP/MIP Plans, PFMEAs, and Action Plans. Continuous Improvement & Cost Optimization: Identify and implement initiatives to reduce the cost of quality, such as optimizing inspection and sampling strategies. Preventive Quality Culture: Promote a preventive quality mindset across the AIT team by ensuring the implementation of foundational quality processes, including quality authorization, quality delegation, and operational surveillance. We are looking forward to knowing you: Education: Engineering degree or equivalent in a scientific/technical discipline (Aeronautical, Industrial, Physics, Chemistry, or related fields). Experience: At least 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance within space sector projects, including hands-on cleanroom and hardware experience (inspections, monitoring integration activities). Soft skills: Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with high adaptability to work in multidisciplinary environments and travel abroad for test campaigns. Languages: Fluent in Spanish (minimum C1 level) and English (minimum C1 level). Technical knowledge: Solid familiarity with European Cooperation for Space Standardization (ECSS) standards, Root Cause Analysis methodologies, PFMEA, and Non-Conformity Review Board (NRB) processes. Valuable / Nice to have: Experience optimizing cost of quality or implementing quality delegation frameworks in aerospace/space manufacturing environments. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. In Retail Concept Operations, as part of Retail Concept, we protect, develop, and enable the IKEA Concept across markets and franchisees. We turn the "what" of the IKEA Concept into the "how" of everyday retail operations, making it easy to use, scale, and trust across the value chain. Capability Architecture is where we make sure that all dimensions of process, people, data and technology are held together in each Capability Area, across core businesses, data and technology, and across the full Inter IKEA Group value chain. Our team is based in Malmö (Sweden) and Delft (The Netherlands). You can be based in either of these offices. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important. About the role As a Capability Area Architect, you’ll play an important part in the team and bring valuable IKEA knowledge into a new setting. In the coming years, we will continue to develop our digital and architectural landscape and strengthen how processes, people, data and technology are held together across our capability areas and the full IKEA value chain. Your primary focus will be bringing clarity from complexity and helping IKEA develop in an integrated, cost-conscious and future-proof way. You will shape and maintain the architectural direction for a Capability Area so that the capability vision, target state, roadmap and design decisions stay coherent, simple, cost-efficient and future-proof. You help translate strategy into architectural direction, support execution of the roadmap, and secure alignment with end-to-end process architecture, enterprise principles and related capability areas. The impact of our work continues to resonate in homes and hearts across the world. Ina typical day, you will: Define and evolve the target architecture for the Capability Area across the process, people, data and technology dimensions. Give input to the Capability Area vision and roadmap, define the architecture needed to support it, and shape the logical roadmap towards the target state together with Capability Area leadership. Actively lead and contribute to architecture design, translating target architecture into concrete design decisions, patterns and reference solutions in close collaboration with engineering teams, product and platform owners, and architecture peers. Proactively identify and resolve dependencies within the Capability Area and across other capability areas and end-to-end processes before complexity becomes rework. Align architecture with Enterprise Architects, contribute to a coherent federated EA governance model, and support decisions in architecture and design forums. Set clear architectural frames through guardrails, constraints and fitness functions, enabling autonomous engineering decisions close to delivery while securing alignment with target architecture and standards. Qualifications What we’d like you to bring to the table The role as a Capability Area Architect requires you to: Bring a minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in architecture, business change, digital transformation or a related field. Have a strong analytical and structured approach, with the ability to connect strategy, business needs and architectural implications. Have the ability to define target states, logical roadmaps and architectural guardrails that support effective planning and execution. Possess strong collaboration skills and experience working across Capability Area leadership, Enterprise Architects, engineers, product teams and other architects. Balance long-term architectural integrity with practical business needs and delivery priorities. Be a strong communicator, with the ability to explain architecture clearly, frame trade-offs and build trust and buy-in among stakeholders. Be commited to enabling simplicity, cost-consciousness and future-proof development across stakeholders and domains. Demonstrate the ability to identify cross-domain dependencies and support proactive decision-making …

items.desc: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. When a drone fails a test on our production floor or shows a hardware defect, you're the first person we call. As Production Quality Control Specialist (Hardware), you're the first line of technical support for production. You troubleshoot, diagnose and fix hardware failures across our VTOL drones, their sub-assemblies and components. That way every aircraft we ship meets the standard our customers rely on in the field. You also step back from single failures and look at the data. You analyze yields and quarantine trends, find the root causes behind repeat problems and decide which fixes to tackle first. You work closely with Production, Engineering and Supply Chain, and your work shows up directly in product quality and output. Responsibilities First on the scene. You're the first-line technical support for production issues, from failed quality inspections and assembly defects to nonconforming parts. Own the checks. You set up the incoming inspections and in-process quality control tests, read the results and make them better over time. Decide what happens to quarantined material. You choose whether it gets reworked, repaired, scrapped or returned to the supplier. Find the real cause. You lead root cause analyses (5 Whys, Ishikawa, 8D) on recurring and high-impact failures. Let the data point the way . You analyze yields and quarantine Paretos to spot the biggest quality drivers. See fixes through. You turn your findings into prioritized corrective actions (CAPA) and follow them until they are closed. Help new and existing parts move from engineering to production. Keep failure, test and repair records traceable. Share what you learn. You feed findings back to Engineering and suppliers, and you train assembly staff on failure modes and workmanship. Requirements You've spent 4+ years as a quality technician, quality inspector or assembly technician on a complex mechatronic product. You know GD&T, geometrical measurements, and mechanical parts testing and inspection. You're at ease with data. You can build yield and failure Paretos and draw sound conclusions from them. You're methodical and keep good records, and you make sound calls under production pressure. You have a technical apprenticeship or technical diploma in Engineering, Manufacturing or Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience. You communicate excellently in English and enjoy working together on the shop floor. Plus Experience with UAVs, RC aircraft or avionics SPC, Cp/Cpk, MSA or a Six Sigma Green Belt AI tools for data analysis Experience with non-conformance tracking, quality management systems or manufacturing ERP/PLM software Familiarity with inspection tools, measurement equipment, technical drawings and CAD Continuous improvement methods such as 8D, 5S and CAPA Hands-on work with assembly line operators, manufacturing engineers and quality teams Speaking or understanding German Joining Wingtra, you gain deep insight into applied robotics and aerial photogrammetry. You work in a startup, so you make a personal impact on both the technology and the organization itself. Please send your CV in English. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. items.desc: We are looking for experienced and motivated Advanced Clinical Practitioners to join our urgent community response services and support the continued development of our Enhanced Call Before Convey (CB4C) service in west essex . This is an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of an innovative multidisciplinary model, providing senior clinical assessment and decision-making to help ambulance crews and system partners identify safe alternatives to hospital conveyance. The role will work closely with Urgent Community Response, Hospital at Home, Community Assessment Treatment Unit, primary care and other system partners, supporting patients to receive the right care in the right place wherever clinically appropriate. The posts are offered on a fixed-term basis until 31 March 2027 to support delivery through the winter period. The post holder will: Provide advanced clinical assessment, autonomous decision-making and senior clinical advice within the CB4C multidisciplinary hub. Support ambulance crews and system partners to identify safe alternatives to acute hospital conveyance. Undertake senior clinical triage and risk assessment of referrals, including calls received through the EEAST Access to the Stack/Cleric pathway. Navigate patients to appropriate community services including Urgent Community Response, Hospital at Home and CATU , alongside other appropriate pathways. Work collaboratively across organisational boundaries to support timely, person-centred clinical decisions. Support admission avoidance and help maximise the use of community alternatives to Emergency Department attendance. Contribute to the safe management of complex and deteriorating patients within the community. Support continued development and evaluation of the CB4C model, including referral activity, outcomes, conveyance and use of community pathways. Work flexibly across the service operating hours according to clinical and operational demand. Valuing you. Recognising your dedication. At EPUT, we look after you. Receive supervision and support to help you fulfil your potential. Join an inclusive EPUT community and connect with others through engagement events and equality or champion networks. If you need help, we provide mental health and wellbeing services, occupational health advice and counselling. We run recognition awards to recognise staff's hard work and dedication. Benefits 27 days holiday, plus bank holidays, rising to 33 days after 10 years’ service, calculated pro rata. Excellent pension of up to14.5% of your pensionable pay. Staff discounts include Blue Light Card, NHS discount offers, and staff benefits. Season ticket loans are interest-free to cover the cost of travelling to and from work via tram, rail, or bus. As an Advanced Clinical Practitioner within the Urgent Community Response Service, you will provide senior clinical expertise within a multidisciplinary urgent care environment. You will undertake comprehensive assessment and clinical decision-making for patients presenting with urgent and often complex health needs. Working collaboratively with ambulance clinicians and system partners, you will assess clinical risk, determine appropriate management plans and identify alternatives to hospital conveyance where these can be provided safely. You will provide clinical navigation across available community pathways, including Urgent Community Response, Hospital at Home, CATU, primary care and other appropriate services, ensuring patients are directed to the most appropriate level and location of care. The role requires a high level of professional autonomy, advanced assessment skills and the ability to manage clinical uncertainty and risk. The post holder will contribute to multidisciplinary decision-making and provide senior clinical support to colleagues managing complex referrals. The post holder will also contribute to the ongoing development of the CB4C model, supporting evaluation of referral activity, admission avoidance, patient outcomes and service utilisation. The service is being developed to provide enhanced coverage during periods of increased urgent and emergency care demand, including evenings and weekends. The successful candidate will therefore be expected to work flexibly across the service's operating hours in accordance with the agreed roster and service requirements.

items.desc: Job Title: Site Engineer Location: London, Greater London (E14 / On-Site) Job Type: Full-time, Permanent Salary: £46,000 – £50,000 per year + Car Allowance & Benefits Schedule: Monday to Friday About the Role We are seeking a diligent, technically proficient Site Engineer to join our construction and civil engineering delivery team in London. Operating on major commercial high-rise and urban infrastructure projects around Canary Wharf and the Docklands (E14), you will provide accurate setting out, technical quality assurance, and on-site engineering supervision to ensure safe, on-schedule project execution across Greater London. In this site-based engineering role, you will work closely with Site Managers, Project Managers, Design Consultants, and specialist groundworks/structural subcontractors—translating engineering drawings into precise on-site execution while maintaining strict UK health, safety, and environmental compliance. Key Responsibilities Setting Out & Dimensional Control: Perform accurate primary and secondary setting out for piling, reinforced concrete (RC) frames, drainage, utilities, and structural steelwork using Total Stations (Leica/Trimble), GPS rovers, and automatic levels. Drawing Review & Technical Queries: Interpret construction drawings, structural schedules, and BIM models (AutoCAD / Navisworks), raising timely Technical Queries (TQs) and Requests for Information (RFIs) to resolve design clashes prior to construction. Quality Assurance & Inspection Test Plans (ITPs): Maintain comprehensive QA records, execute concrete cube testing, check reinforcement steel placement prior to pours, and sign off Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and as-built surveys. Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Compliance: Assist the Site Manager in reviewing Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS), issuing Permits to Dig/Work, conducting daily site briefings, and enforcing CDM 2015 safety standards. Subcontractor Supervision & Progress Tracking: Monitor day-to-day civil and structural subcontractor activities against the master construction programme, maintaining accurate site diaries and reporting progress to the Project Manager. Temporary Works Coordination: Support the Temporary Works Coordinator with the inspection, loading verification, and sign-off of formwork, falsework, crane bases, and excavation shoring. Requirements & Qualifications Experience: Minimum 2–5 years of post-graduation UK site engineering experience working with a tier-one or tier-two main contractor or specialist civil engineering subcontractor on commercial, residential high-rise, or infrastructure schemes. Technical Proficiency: Hands-on proficiency operating Leica or Trimble robotic Total Stations and GPS surveying equipment. Strong ability to read and interrogate structural and civil engineering drawings using AutoCAD and digital field management platforms (Procore, Fieldwire, or Viewpoint Field View). Solid practical understanding of reinforced concrete frames, deep foundations, groundworks, and drainage installations. Certifications & Tickets: Valid CSCS Card (Professionally Qualified Person or Manager/Black Card). SMSTS or SSSTS certification and current First Aid at Work qualification are highly advantageous. Education: BEng or BSc degree (or HNC/HND) in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering Management, or a closely related discipline. Location & Mobility: Ability to commute reliably to our project site in East London (E14 postcode area) and across Greater London as required. Benefits Competitive base salary (depending on experience) Annual car/travel allowance (£4,500 per year) or company vehicle option Discretionary annual project completion and performance bonus 25 days annual leave + public bank holidays Contributory employer pension scheme Structured chartership support and ICE (Institution of Civil Engineers) training agreement mentorship Private medical cover, life assurance, and comprehensive employee assistance program (EAP) Paid professional membership fees and ongoing technical/safety training (SMSTS, Temporary Works) Work Location & Setup This position is site-based (on-site) at our active commercial and civil engineering project in London, Greater London (E14 postcode area) , conveniently located in Canary Wharf—within a 5-minute walk of Canary Wharf Station (Elizabeth Line, Jubilee Line, and DLR), offering rapid, direct transit links across Central, East, and South East London. Pay: £46,000.00-£50,000.00 per year Benefits: Company pension Free parking Life insurance On-site parking Work Location: In person

items.desc: Quantinuum is seeking an experienced Software Engineer in Test to join its Global Quality Assurance team. The role focuses on automated testing across Quantinuum’s quantum computing infrastructure, from cloud services to internal communications within quantum computing systems. You will design, implement and maintain automated integration and end-to-end test suites for workflows spanning tools developed by different teams. Responsibilities include identifying gaps in coverage, investigating integration failures and developing test plans. Strong software engineering skills are essential; the role involves little manual testing. As a team, we cover broad automated testing areas, as well as software integration and regression tests we also write automated UI, hardware and hardware/software subsystem tests. We aim to ensure, whenever possible, that the right person is working on the right task that suits their own personal skills and strengths, so whilst the team’s overall scope is large, having experience in every area is not expected or required. You will also work with other teams to improve testability and testing practices through technical guidance, practical support and training, and contribute to the development of QA processes for major releases. Key responsibilities: 1. Develop thorough test plans and strategies, both independently and collaboratively with relevant stakeholders; especially identifying major risks and suggesting appropriate tests and mitigations. 2. Execute test plans: Design, develop and maintain automated integration and end-to-end tests and supporting frameworks and tooling for workflows spanning multiple teams’ front-end, back-end and other components across Quantinuum as described above. 3. Integrate automated tests into build and deployment pipelines (CI/CD), for example Github Actions or Jenkins. Work with other teams to ensure these pipelines are effective. 4. Review requirements and designs for testability, and work with teams to investigate defects and understand their root causes. Help develop test plans and QA processes for major releases, aligning testing with release schedules and ensuring that coverage, results and remaining risks are documented and supported by auditable evidence. Must have: Relevant technical education and/or practical experience to reasonably meet the Key Responsibilities listed above. The ability to understand complex systems quickly, both on a technical level but also understanding the broader product and customer requirements to ensure tests are tailored for the real-world. Strong Python programming skills and experience developing maintainable software as well as a good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Clear communication with software engineers, product managers and other stakeholders, the ability to identify and communicate risk, and the ability to prioritize high risk areas of work. 6 years of related work experience with a relevant (Quantum Information, Computer Science, Physics, etc.) Bachelor’s degree (This does not form a strict requirement but may be representative of typical experience level.) We value: (but do not require): A strong understanding (by experience and/or education) of quantum computing and information theory could be very valuable. Experience of testing complex web applications, especially experience testing and assuring SRE-domain work for high reliability services could be very valuable. Experience testing embedded systems, hardware/software integrated platforms, or subsystem-level applications. We use a wide range of tools including Pytest, Robot Framework and Cypress; experience with these specific tools is useful. Quantinuum is a leading quantum computing company delivering a full stack platform designed to make quantum computing deployable in real-world environments. With active engagements spanning pharmaceuticals, material science, financial services, government, industrial sectors, and leading academic and research institutions worldwide, we are helping organizations unlock the transformative potential of quantum computing. Our global team of more than 800 employees includes many of the world's leading scientists, engineers, and researchers, with more than 70% of our technology team holding advanced degrees at the Master's or PhD level. Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, Quantinuum operates across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, and Singapore. By joining Quantinuum, you’ll help shape the future of quantum computing, pushing the limits of technology, and making the impossible possible. Visit our news pages to learn more about Quantinuum and our scientific breakthroughs and achievements: https://www.quantinuum.com/news Quantinuum Intro Video: The Future of Quantum Computing What’s in it for you? We believe our people are our greatest strength and offer a comprehensive rewards package that supports your professional growth, well-being, and long-term success. …
