items.card: The role You teach architecture to international students over a 2-week session. Architecture (16 to 18, Oxford and Cambridge) develops the core principles of planning, design and spatial mapping: students produce technical drawings, build physical and digital models and a portfolio, survey sites, and study the buildings, colleges and museums of their host city on walking tours you lead. In Oxford, our New
items.desc: About Academy Royale International Academy Royale International (ARI) runs award-winning academic summer schools for students aged 10 to 18. Since 2004, more than 50,000 students from over 175 nations have studied with us, living and learning on campus at colleges of the University of Oxford and the University of Cambridge, and at Marlborough College. Our students go deeper into subjects they love, from medicine, law and engineering to artificial intelligence, business and English language, in discussion-led classes with expert tutors. They leave with new friends from around the world, a clearer sense of where they are heading and the confidence to get there. We hold the 2024 King's Award for Enterprise for International Trade and have won three Queen's Awards for Enterprise. We are accredited by the British Accreditation Council, and hold a RoSPA Gold Award for student safety. The role You teach architecture to international students over a 2-week session. Architecture (16 to 18, Oxford and Cambridge) develops the core principles of planning, design and spatial mapping: students produce technical drawings, build physical and digital models and a portfolio, survey sites, and study the buildings, colleges and museums of their host city on walking tours you lead. In Oxford, our New Perspectives programme offers Architecture to 12 to 15 year olds: 10 lessons of 90 minutes on form, scale, materials and designing for people, with a drawing, making or testing task in every lesson and a final crit of a scale model. Broadening Horizons students aged 16 to 18 can also take Art & Architecture, 6 drawing-led workshops of 90 minutes that study how buildings stand and how artists have pictured cities, with location drawing on supervised Oxford walks. Classes you may teach: Architecture (16 to 18, Oxford and Cambridge, 39.5 to 41.5 hours a session); Architecture, New Perspectives (12 to 15, Oxford, 15 hours a session); Art & Architecture, Broadening Horizons Power Skills option (16 to 18, Oxford, 9 hours a session). What you will do Prepare every lesson. Complete the training and plan each lesson from the Teacher's Guide, adapting it to your students while covering the aims, learning outcomes, core topics, programme elements and assignments, and agreeing any significant change with the Programme Director. Teach actively. Deliver student-centred lessons, seminars, workshops and practical activities to small classes of students from many countries, with no more than 20 minutes of teacher talk, and differentiate for students of different abilities, backgrounds and levels of English. Assess and report. Mark both assignments with personalised feedback, write a personalised report for every student by the Wednesday of week 2, and nominate students for Academic Prizes. Run your classroom. Arrive 30 minutes before your first lesson to set up, keep the room tidy and safe, take daily registers, report absences and flag equipment needs 2 days ahead. Work with the campus team. Attend the weekly staff meeting, collaborate with teaching colleagues, support programme elements such as Challenge Day and Exhibition Day, and complete end-of-employment feedback. Keep students safe. Follow ARI procedures and our accrediting bodies' requirements, keep professional boundaries and report any safeguarding concern to the Programme Director straight away. What you will bring A practical, interactive teaching style suited to small groups rather than lectures, with the confidence to hold a class's attention. Confident hand drawing and model-making, and the ability to teach history and theory through practical tasks and the buildings around you. A clear grasp of how to pace a lesson, check that students have learned and adapt when they have not. The adaptability to teach students with varied prior knowledge, nationalities and levels of English, and to carry on when equipment or technology lets you down. Clear, encouraging communication, explaining complex ideas simply, in English, because you teach, mark and write reports in English. Strong organisation and preparation, and a willingness to collaborate with the teaching and campus teams. A clear commitment to safeguarding and to ARI's values. Essential An undergraduate degree, or higher, in architecture or a closely related subject (international equivalents included). Confident hand drawing and model-making. For the 16 to 18 course: experience of SketchUp, site surveys and architectural practice. Desirable RIBA Part 2 or 3, or further study in architecture. Experience of teaching architecture workshops to teenagers or undergraduates. Familiarity with the architecture of Oxford or Cambridge. For Art & Architecture: a degree in architecture, fine art or history of art with a strong drawing practice, experience of teaching observational, perspective and tonal drawing from life, and of running crits at 16 to 18, foundation or undergraduate level.  Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in electronic design automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop new and highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics in order to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board and system design.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Build, enhance, and maintain analytics assets, such as dashboards and reports, to unlock actionable insights that drive operational excellence and business outcomes.
 Manipulate and analyze large datasets, to uncover trends and patterns.
 Design and maintain data systems and pipelines to enable reliable, automated, and efficient data flow—from ingestion through transformation, storage, and refresh scheduling.
 Develop and manage robust data models (star/snowflake schemas, semantic layers) that support complex analytics and consistent metric definitions.
 Collaborate with the global customer support team to understand their needs and develop solutions that improve service delivery and customer experience.
 Work closely with global and regional support managers to drive excellence and improve operational KPIs.
 Build interfaces and apps enabling various uses of our data as well as user management and control.
 Continuously evaluate and adopt modern technologies and tools in programming, data analysis, and machine learning to strengthen our data platform and analytics capabilities.
 Qualifications 
 BS/MS plus at least 5 years of relevant work experience (Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, or similar).
 Proven experience in translating complex data into actionable insights and applying those insights to drive operational excellence.
 Understanding of data and analytics infrastructures: data lakes, warehouses, data marts, and BI platforms powering business intelligence.
 Solid Python and SQL; expert dimensional modeling, data manipulation, and KPI/metric design skills.
 Hands-on with Power BI (visualizations, datasets/semantic models, RLS/OLS, workspace/app governance; PBIP and Deployment Pipelines a plus).
 AI enthusiast, avid user of AI-based development tools and Copilots, experienced in AI-enabled automation and AI integration.
 Familiarity with cloud systems, data pipelines, and orchestration. Ideally, experienced in MS Fabric and Snowflake.
 Critical thinking and a problem-solving mindset.
 Excellent communication skills, experience communicating across cultures and seniority levels, ability to persuade and drive change.
 Advanced knowledge of English; both verbal and written.

items.desc: At ING Hubs Spain we are looking for a Junior AI Engineer Your role and work environment: We're looking for an enthusiastic AI Engineer with a passion for cybersecurity and emerging technologies. This role is ideal for someone who is highly motivated to specialize in the secure adoption of AI and Agentic AI at enterprise scale. You will be part of a team that shapes how ING securely designs, deploys, and governs AI solutions by developing security capabilities, best practices, and controls that enable responsible AI innovation across the bank. AI Security & Safety Team This position is part of the AI Security & Safety Team, a newly established team within Global CISO responsible for enabling the secure and responsible adoption of AI across ING. The team monitors emerging AI developments and risks, research industry best practices, validates security standards, and collaborates with policy bodies, regulators, industry forums, research institutions, and universities to stay at the forefront of AI security and safety developments. The team translates these insights into practical security standards, guidance, and capabilities that help ING securely design, deploy, and operate AI and Agentic AI solutions at scale. CISO organization The Chief Information Security Office (CISO) protects ING's information, technology, and digital services against cyber threats while enabling secure innovation across the bank. The organization brings together capabilities across Identity & Access Management (IAM), Security Detection & Response (SDR), Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), and Attack Surface Management (ASM) to strengthen ING's cyber resilience, manage security risks, and support the secure adoption of emerging technologies, including AI. As Frontier AI capabilities continue to advance, ING is investing in dedicated expertise to understand their impact on cybersecurity, strengthen the bank's security posture, and ensure AI and Agentic AI solutions are designed, deployed, and operated securely at scale. The AI Security & Safety Team acts as the CISO's centre of expertise for AI security and safety. How to Succeed as a member of AI Security & Safety team? You combine a passion for software engineering skills with AI and cybersecurity. You stay current with advances in Frontier AI and are able to turn emerging technologies into practical, secure, and scalable solutions for ING. You thrive in fast-moving environments, take ownership from idea to deployment, and actively contribute to building AI security capabilities, standards, and best practices across the organization. You can effectively bridge software engineering, AI innovation, and security, helping ING adopt AI and Agentic AI safely and responsibly at scale. As an AI engineer, What to expect? Develop AI-powered applications and proof of concepts using frontier AI models, commercial AI services, and open-weight models. Evaluate, benchmark, and monitor AI systems to assess their capabilities, limitations, risks, and security implications. Design and implement solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI patterns. Build secure, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions aligned with security and governance requirements. Share knowledge and insights to advance the organization's understanding of AI technologies, opportunities, and risks. What do you bring? Education & experience Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. 2+ year experience n AI Engineering, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, or a related discipline. Core technical stack Advanced Python, SQL, PyTorch/TensorFlow (SAS is an advantage) Familiar with software engineering fundamentals, including testing, code quality, software architecture, and distributed systems design. GenAI & data capabilities Exposure to LLMs, generative AI or AI applications development Familiar with HuggingFace (Transformers, PEFT), LangChain/LlamaIndex, Vector Stores (FAISS/Vertex Search), designing and optimising RAG pipelines. Familiar with frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar. Interest in emerging AI protocols and standards, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, tool-calling, and multi-agent architectures. Platforms & engineering Familiar with cloud platforms such as Azure, GCP, AWS. Experience with Azure DevOps (Git, Pipelines) Familiar with end-to-end pipelines (data → model → deployment) Way of working Conformable working in Agile/Scrum teams Strong willingness to learn and continuously develop your skills Collaborative mindset and good communication skills What do we offer? items.desc: Software Engineer AI & Automation — CDI Paris 3 à 6 ans d'expérience | IA, automatisation, delivery client Le contexte Un cabinet de conseil historiquement positionné sur les secteurs pharma, biotech et industrie a lancé une toute nouvelle business unit dédiée à l’IA. L’idée : ne plus se contenter de recommander des solutions, mais les construire. L’équipe est aujourd’hui composée de trois personnes, un directeur, une responsable commerciale et un lead tech. Nous recrutons le quatrième membre. Ce n’est pas une ESN . Il n’y a pas de mission en régie, pas de solo chez le client. Les projets sont en forfait, les équipes sont internes, et ce qu’on livre tourne vraiment chez les clients. Ce que vous ferez concrètement Une partie du temps, vous êtes chez le client. Vous participez aux ateliers pour comprendre les processus métier, identifier ce qui coince, estimer ce qu’on peut automatiser et ce que ça rapporte. Vous travaillez avec des interlocuteurs qui ne sont pas développeurs, vous devez comprendre leur métier avant de proposer quoi que ce soit. L’autre partie du temps, vous codez. Vous prenez un périmètre en main de bout en bout : spécification, développement, tests, déploiement, documentation. Vous intégrez des LLM, vous construisez des agents, vous livrez des applications qui servent à quelque chose. Les solutions que vous développez alimentent progressivement notre software factory, des briques réutilisables qu’on peut redéployer chez d’autres clients sur des problématiques similaires. Vous travaillez en direct avec le lead tech, qui reste impliqué dans la conception et le code. Vous n’êtes pas seul, mais vous tenez votre périmètre. Ce qu’on cherche Vous êtes développeur. Pas consultant pur, pas data scientist, pas chercheur. Vous savez lire du code, en écrire, le déboguer et l’expliquer. Python est votre langage principal. Vous avez construit des APIs, travaillé sur du fullstack, utilisé Git et Docker au quotidien. Vous avez déjà intégré des LLM ou construit des pipelines RAG dans un projet livré à de vrais utilisateurs. Vous savez que ça ne s’arrête pas au prototype, vous avez géré la mise en production, les ajustements, la maintenance. Vous avez une expérience du développement agentique, sans dépendre d’un seul provider. Vous choisissez l’outil en fonction du problème, pas l’inverse. Vous utilisez les agents de développement (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) dans votre workflow, mais vous restez responsable de ce que vous livrez. La qualité du code et la cohérence architecturale, c’est votre affaire. Et vous aimez parler à des clients. Pas obligatoirement tout le temps, mais vous n’avez pas peur de rentrer dans la compréhension d’un métier que vous ne connaissez pas encore. Le profil 2 à 6 ans d’expérience, formation ingénieur ou équivalent en informatique ou génie logiciel. Une expérience en ESN, cabinet tech ou startup B2B avec livraison chez des clients réels. Anglais opérationnel. Basé IDF, à l’aise avec le présentiel. Rémunération : 45 000 à 60 000 € selon profil. CDI. Paris 16e.

We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. Fondé en 2023 à Paris, Quickscale AI est une société de conseil spécialisée dans le développement d’agents IA sur mesure pour des secteurs exigeants : finance, juridique, conformité, marketing. Nous aidons nos clients à concevoir et déployer des solutions d’IA fiables, auditées et réellement utilisées en production. Notre équipe combine excellence technique, rigueur scientifique et sens produit. Nous croyons à une IA utile, explicable et responsable, au service de la transformation des organisations. Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l’avenir de l’IA en Entreprise ! VOTRE RÔLE En stage de fin d’études, vous rejoignez une squad de consultants qui mettent l’IA agentique en production chez nos clients. Vous développez des agents IA aux côtés de profils seniors, et vous participez à toutes les étapes d’un projet, du besoin métier jusqu’à la production. Concrètement, votre rôle couvre : le développement de systèmes agentiques (LLM, RAG, multi-agents, évaluation) ; la participation au delivery chez nos clients, du cadrage jusqu’au déploiement ; le suivi des sujets internes du cabinet, dont Quickscale Agents ; l’accompagnement des équipes métier dans l’adoption des solutions. Vous travaillez en équipe, avec un tuteur et un lead technique. Vous prenez rapidement des responsabilités réelles, et vous proposez des idées sans attendre qu’on vous les demande. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées. Description du poste NEXTON recrute un AI Engineer H/F, en CDI , à Paris ! Ton futur environnement de travail : Tu interviendras au sein de l'équipe AI Platform de l' AI Factory , qui construit et opère la plateforme agentique d'un grand groupe (socle unique sur lequel sont créés, déployés et exploités les agents IA). Concevoir et industrialiser les chaînes de RAG : ingestion, découpage, indexation, recherche et évaluation de la pertinence. items.desc: We are seeking a talented and experienced AI Engineer with a background in Data Science, Machine Learning, Backend development, or equivalent to join our professional services team of over 60 engineers, headquartered in Israel. The position is available full-time. This remote-first role focuses on Generative AI, specifically working with advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) and building AI agents. You'll work with state-of-the-art foundation models through platforms like AWS Bedrock and GCP Vertex AI to develop innovative GenAI applications and scalable AI infrastructure for our clients. The Mission At Opsfleet, we don't just "wrap" LLMs; we build autonomous, production-grade agentic systems. We are seeking an Engineer who understands that the future of AI isn't a single prompt, but a complex, stateful ecosystem of collaborating agents. You will be responsible for designing the cognitive architectures that allow multiple agents to negotiate, self-correct, and execute complex workflows in production. Core Responsibilities Agentic System Design: Architect and deploy complex Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) that move beyond basic RAG into autonomous reasoning, planning, and execution. Context Orchestration: Design and implement dynamic Context Management strategies, including sliding windows, semantic summarization, and token-efficient pruning to maintain long-term coherence without exceeding model limits. Tool-Use & API Synthesis: Expertise in Function Calling and Tool Definition ; specifically creating standardized interfaces using MCP for agents to interact with external APIs, databases, and local environments. Orchestration & Frameworks: You will be responsible for designing and implementing robust state-handling for long-running agentic tasks using LangChain , LangGraph , Agno , Strands , ADK , etc. Safety & Guardrails: Design and implement Production Safety Measures , including output sanitization, hallucination triggers, and autonomous circuit breakers to ensure reliability in high-stakes environments. Memory & Personalization: Build sophisticated memory layers that manage User Preferences and historical context, ensuring agents provide personalized, context-aware interactions over time. System Evaluations: Define and implement rigorous requirements for Agentic Evaluation , benchmarking trajectory consistency, tool-calling accuracy, and reasoning logic. Technical Stack & Requirements Software Design: 5+ years of Python experience with a focus on Modular Architecture and clean code principles. Agentic Frameworks: Expert-level proficiency in modern orchestration frameworks ( LangChain , LangGraph , Agno , Strands , ADK , etc.). Cloud Infrastructure: Deep experience with AWS Bedrock or GCP Vertex AI for enterprise-scale model deployment and agent hosting. Communication Standards: Hands-on experience with MCP for connecting agents to diverse data sources and tools, and A2A for cross-agent collaboration. Vector & Graph Databases: Proficiency in using Knowledge Graphs and vector storage to ground agentic reasoning and provide structured organizational memory. Preferred Qualifications Agent Engine Mastery: Direct experience working with AgentCore architectures and native Agent Engines (AWS Bedrock Agents / GCP Vertex AI Agent Engine). Multi-Modal Expertise: Experience building agents capable of synthesizing information across Text, Vision, and Video sources. The "Agentic Mindset": You can explain the difference between a linear chain and a directed acyclic graph (DAG), and you know exactly when an agent is the right tool vs. a simple workflow. The Reviewer’s Eye: Experience conducting deep technical reviews of AI implementations, identifying architectural bottlenecks or "lazy" agent logic. Production Battle Scars: You’ve dealt with agents getting stuck in infinite loops or hallucinating tool-calls, and you know how to build the infrastructure to prevent it. AI-Native Delivery (nice to have): Experience with Software Factories or the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC), meaning agentic pipelines where coding agents plan, write, test and review code with engineers in the loop. Why Opsfleet? Define Agentic Autonomy: You aren't just following tutorials; you are architecting the blueprint for how autonomous systems reason, collaborate, and execute. You will set the industry standards for agentic maturity, moving beyond simple task-execution into complex, self-correcting cognitive architectures. Complex Projects: Work on everything from internal coding agents to massive client-facing multi-agent orchestrators. Remote-First: A culture built by engineers, for engineers Employment: Full-time position (40 hours/week) Benefits: • Potential career paths • Collaborative remote team environment • Opportunity to contribute to open-source GenAI initiatives and research publications

items.card: You will be a Prototyping Architect in the AWS PACE (Prototyping and AI Customer Engineering) team, based in Paris. - You are a hands-on AI builder who combines deep technical expertise with excellent interpersonal skills, helping enterprises across France and Europe South turn their most ambitious ideas into working technology proofpoints on AWS, with generative AI and agentic systems at the core of what you build.
items.desc:
If you want to explore the frontier of AI and prove what it can do, alongside great engineers and ambitious customers, we'd love to hear from you. 
You will be a Prototyping Architect in the AWS PACE (Prototyping and AI Customer Engineering) team, based in Paris. 
- You are a hands-on AI builder who combines deep technical expertise with excellent interpersonal skills, helping enterprises across France and Europe South turn their most ambitious ideas into working technology proofpoints on AWS, with generative AI and agentic systems at the core of what you build.
- You work at the intersection of emerging technology and real customer problems. You take an ambiguous business challenge and co-build a real technical implementation of the solution, bringing generative AI, agentic systems, and cloud-native architectures together into a working prototype that proves what is possible on AWS.
- You thrive in ambiguity. Your customers are navigating generational technology shifts, foundation models, autonomous agents, intelligent automation, and you help them cut through the noise, make crisp technical decisions, and move fast. You work backwards from customer outcomes, you insist on the highest standards in design and delivery, and you grow at the frontier of the field.
- You spend most of your time hands-on-keyboard, pair-programming with customer engineers and alongside Prototype Engagement Managers, Solutions Architects, Specialists and partners. You deliver multi-week engagements that de-risk transformation and accelerate customers' paths to production. Just as importantly, you leave the customer's team more capable than you found them, transferring the skills and reusable foundations they need to take the solution forward themselves. 
This role is based in Paris, with French and English used day to day, and supports customers across France and the Europe South region. 
Key job responsibilities
● You partner with the Prototype Engagement Manager and local stakeholders across France and Europe South to technically qualify and scope new prototype opportunities.
● You support customers' agentic transformation with AWS, translating concrete business use cases into buildable prototypes and accelerating the path from idea to measurable business value and production adoption.
● You lead the design and implementation of prototype architectures, working alongside prototyping architects, solutions architects and other stakeholders, with a focus on Generative AI and agentic technologies (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Amazon SageMaker).
● You deliver 3 to 6 week hands-on prototype projects with customers and partners in agile, collaborative development engagements.
● You drive continuous technical enablement and knowledge transfer to the customers and partners you work with, including modern AI-assisted development practices (AI-DLC, coding assistants such as Kiro and Claude Code).
● You develop and present technical demonstrations to senior business and technical leaders, and document your projects as appropriate, including the prototype report and path-to-production recommendations.
● You collaborate proactively with the wider AWS community, such as Solutions Architects and Service and Solution teams, to ensure the best possible customer outcomes during engagements.
● You develop reusable technical assets from your engagements and share them across the PACE, EMEA and worldwide AWS builder community.
A day in the life
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship …

Job Description: 
 Im Bereich MIS Development / Maintenance ED & FCAS (TASDM4) der Airbus Defence & Space GmbH in Manching haben wir uns auf IT Lösungen spezialisiert, die die Aufrechterhaltung der Lufttüchtigkeit für fliegende Waffensysteme garantieren sollen um somit einen sicheren Betrieb im operationellen und technisch­/­logistischen Bereich zu ermöglichen. Unsere jahrelange Erfahrung im Betrieb und Support dieser Systeme bei internen und externen Kunden unterschiedlichster Plattformen war der Antrieb für die Entwicklung eines modularen und plattformunabhängigen Bodenunterstützungssystems MOSS (Maintenance and Operation Support Solution), welches in der ersten Ausbaustufe den Betrieb, die Instandsetzung und die Flugzeugwartung des Eurofighters weiterhin sicherstellen soll.

Sich ändernde Rahmenbedingungen, neue operationelle Szenarien und Technologien sind nur ein Teil der Änderungen, die in die Weiterentwicklung von MOSS einfließen werden.

 You will interact regularly with all other organisations of EBS & ET and within AH (strategy, business, finance, HR, communication, legal...).

 Experience: More than 10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years directly dedicated to R&D public funding capture in high-tech, defense, or aerospace sectors.

Apple's IS&T Accessibility Center of Excellence (CoE) is looking for an Apple Native Platforms
Accessibility Subject Matter Expert (SME). You have solid hands-on experience building and
evaluating accessible native apps and testing them with assistive technologies. You see
accessibility as a basic human right, and you want to work with people who feel the same way.
You will work with many teams on diﬀerent projects. You will use your expertise to guide them
toward accessible results and help improve how Apple approaches accessibility.
The CoE promotes and supports accessibility across Apple. We help teams build accessibility into the apps, websites, and digital services that customers and employees use. We need an Apple Native Platforms Accessibility SME to provide expert-level consulting.
This role suits someone who is self-driven, pays close attention to detail, communicates well in
speech and in writing, and likes hands-on work in a fast-paced environment.
In this role, you will:
• Evaluate iOS and macOS apps for accessibility, record the findings, and give clear, practical
recommendations.
• Help teams fix accessibility issues using technical testing methods.
• Review designs, code, and content for accessibility, and advise the product, design, and
engineering teams.
• Work with cross-functional teams from start to finish of each project.
• Represent the team positively and professionally at all times.
• Help create and deliver accessibility training, tools, and standards.
5+ years of software development experience building accessible native apps using SwiftUI, AppKit and UIKit.
Experience with accessibility standards, technical implementation and testing methods.
Strong hands-on experience testing with assistive technologies, including screen readers such as VoiceOver.
Bachelor's degree in an engineering-related field, or equivalent experience.
Solid understanding of WCAG 2.x guidelines and WAI-ARIA principles.
Clear communication and teamwork with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
A track record of building strong working relationships.
Ability to learn new technologies independently and to manage several projects in a changing environment.

items.desc:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

 

Our Fleet Operations Team ensures that our vehicles and staff continuously meet the highest standards in safety, performance, and regulatory compliance. Working collaboratively across various functions, the team plays a key role in developing and delivering training, maintaining operating standards, and supporting the professional growth of our people within a fast-paced and innovative environment.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

 - Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs, making recommendations for improvements.

 - Maintain up-to-date training records and ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements.

 - Conduct regular assessments of operating standards across teams and individuals to uphold our quality objectives.

 - Develop and maintain training materials, including manuals, presentations, and online resources.

 - Work closely with subject matter experts to identify areas for improvement in training content, delivery, and operating standards.

 - Monitor and analyse training metrics to identify trends and suggest opportunities for improvement.

 - Develop and oversee implementation of quality assurance processes for both training programs and operating standards.

 - Support staff professional development and course completion, in conjunction with Team Leads.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand and anticipate training needs related to the growth of commercial operations.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

 - Building, evaluating, and improving training programs for fleet operations.

 - Upholding and enhancing the effectiveness and compliance of all operating standards across teams.

 - Creating and updating a library of high-quality training materials.

 - Implementing and tracking quality assurance processes for all training and operational exercises.

 - Supporting the development and progression of Wayve’s staff through tailored training and development initiatives.

 - Analysing data to ensure continuous improvement of both training content and delivery methods.

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

 - You hold a full clean DE driving licence and have at least 8 years' driving experience (mainly in DE).

 - You have no blameworthy insurance claims within the past three years.

 - You remain calm and controlled in pressured situations.

 - You’re receptive to feedback, eager to learn from mistakes, and have a growth mindset.

 - You enjoy working closely with people in a team environment.

 - You can manage your wellbeing (including fatigue/stress) and have proven personal strategies for doing so.

 - You have proven experience as a team coordinator or in a similar role.

 - You demonstrate strong leadership and communication skills—both one-to-one, within your team, and when engaging other stakeholders.

 - You can work under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively.

 - You have excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, time management, and organisational ability.

 - You are proficient in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office suite.

 - You have excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

 

Desirable:

 - Recognised Assessor qualification.

 - Qualified Vehicle Safety Operator with a current qualification.

 - Recognised Quality Assurance qualification.

 

Additional Requirements:

 - Available to work full-time onsite (Leonberg office), 5 days a week.

 - Must disclose any second job as part of the application process.

 - All applicants will be subject to a health check before/after employment.

 - Employment is contingent upon passing training, pre-employment checks, and ongoing drug/alcohol testing in line with company policy. Testing will occur during your onsite interview.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the …

 Manufacturing Process Developer
 Join Sonova’s Manufacturing Engineering team as a Manufacturing Process Developer and help develop, optimize, and implement innovative manufacturing technologies that support our hearing care products.

 Strong knowledge of materials science, materials analysis, manufacturing process development, and characterization techniques.
 Hands-on experience conducting laboratory testing, technical investigations, feasibility studies, and process optimization.
 Ability to analyze complex technical challenges, apply statistically reliable methods, and develop practical engineering solutions.
 Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

Bratislava, SK
 Are you passionate about governance, compliance, and creating frameworks that help organizations operate effectively? Join our dynamic team at Swiss Re as we shape the future of policy governance across our global organization. This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact on our governance structure while working with stakeholders across all levels of the business. 
 About the Role 
 As our Policy and Standards Governance Specialist, you'll be the driving force behind Swiss Re's Policy Governance Framework, ensuring consistency, compliance, and usability across the organization. You'll combine governance expertise with stakeholder influence to maintain and enhance our approach to policy management. 
 Please note, this is a 12‑month fixed-term position. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Framework Strategy and Design : Own and evolve the end-to-end Policy Governance Framework, developing governance models, taxonomies, templates, and quality assurance standards 
 Continuous Improvement : Define and implement enhancements to streamline processes, improve user experience, and ensure effective lifecycle management 
 Governance and Oversight : Ensure all new or updated policies and standards meet framework requirements and monitor adherence to lifecycle stages 
 Stakeholder Management : Advise policy and standard owners on framework application and best practices for drafting and implementation 
 Community Building : Build and lead a community of Standard Owners to promote collaboration and knowledge sharing to support consistency and best practices 
 Compliance Support : Contribute to the development and implementation of Compliance policies, standards, processes, and tools 
 Risk Framework Enhancement : Monitor regulatory developments to identify new requirements and potential improvements to risk frameworks 
 Training and Awareness : Prepare and deliver training, guidance, and awareness materials to build Compliance capability 
 About the Team 
 The Compliance Programme, Policies & Awareness (PPA) team is responsible for the global Compliance framework at Swiss Re. We develop, maintain and implement the policies, standards and training programs that educate employees on their responsibilities and behaviours in identifying and managing Compliance Risks. We support the business and our Compliance colleagues by monitoring for new risks and regulations in the jurisdictions in which we operate, and we oversee the operation and implementation of the overall Policy Governance framework across Swiss Re. 
 About You 
 You're a governance professional who thrives on creating order and structure within complex organizations. You have excellent communication skills and can influence stakeholders at all levels. You're detail-oriented yet can see the big picture, allowing you to develop frameworks that are both robust and practical. 
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements: 
 University or equivalent qualification with minimum 8 years of experience in governance, compliance, risk management, program management or other risk and control framework roles 
 Sound experience with policies, standards and governance frameworks, particularly in relation to drafting policies and standards 
 Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills with the ability to interact effectively and accurately across all seniority levels 
 Excellent organizational, process, project management, and analytical skills 
 Fluency in English (written and spoken) 
 These are additional nice to haves: 
 Experience in an international financial services environment 
 Working knowledge of compliance risks, particularly in fraud, conduct risk and bribery and corruption. 
 Additional languages beyond English 
 Experience with digital policy management systems or tools

 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

items.desc: Vous aimez créer des agents IA, connecter des outils et transformer des besoins complexes en solutions utiles ? Venez expérimenter vos idées dans une organisation réelle. Le réseau Interasso, réunissant DSD, HANDISD et FANTAS.IA , recherche une personne pour développer des solutions d’intelligence artificielle au service de projets associatifs : inclusion, coopération, développement durable et coordination des équipes. Votre mission Participer à tout le cycle de développement : comprendre les besoins, construire une première version, la tester avec les utilisateurs et l’améliorer à partir des retours du terrain. Vous pourrez notamment : Créer et orchestrer des agents IA utilisant des LLM, des API et des outils collaboratifs. Automatiser des tâches : recherche d’informations, analyse documentaire, suivi de projets, aide administrative ou préparation de dossiers. Relier les solutions aux outils utilisés par les équipes : Google Workspace, bases de données, n8n, Make ou autres outils pertinents. Décomposer des besoins complexes en étapes réalisables et définir des priorités. Tester les solutions en conditions réelles , repérer les erreurs et évaluer leur utilité. Recueillir les retours d’expérience et développer les versions V2 et V3 . Documenter les réalisations et faciliter leur prise en main par des personnes non techniques. Le profil recherché Vous avez déjà réalisé un projet en développement ou en IA, y compris personnel ou étudiant, et vous souhaitez aller jusqu’à son utilisation concrète. Nous recherchons : Des compétences en programmation, notamment Python ou JavaScript, et en intégration d’API. Une compréhension des LLM, de leurs possibilités et de leurs limites. Un intérêt pour les agents IA, l’orchestration de workflows et l’automatisation. Une capacité à comprendre un fonctionnement associatif et à dialoguer avec différents métiers. De l’autonomie, de la curiosité et un esprit d’équipe. De la réactivité sur les créneaux convenus, des engagements réalistes et le respect des délais annoncés. Le réflexe de signaler rapidement un blocage et de proposer une solution. Une attention à la confidentialité, aux droits d’accès et à la fiabilité des résultats. La connaissance du RAG, des bases vectorielles ou des architectures multi-agents serait un plus. Une démarche agile et concrète Un besoin priorisé → une première version utilisable → des tests terrain → des retours d’expérience → des améliorations. Les objectifs et les échéances sont définis ensemble selon vos disponibilités. Chaque réalisation doit pouvoir être démontrée, testée et transmise à l’équipe. Modalités Bénévolat ou stage conventionné , avec des modalités distinctes à préciser selon votre situation. Organisation basée à Montpellier , avec une participation à distance possible et des rencontres selon les projets. Durée, rythme et disponibilités à convenir ensemble. Collaboration avec les responsables associatifs et les utilisateurs des solutions. Un environnement attentif à la diversité des parcours et des fonctionnements cognitifs. Pour nous rejoindre Envoyez une courte présentation, vos disponibilités et, si possible, un exemple de réalisation : agent IA, automatisation, application, dépôt GitHub ou démonstration. handisd.eat@gmail.com Objet : Candidature — Développeur / Orchestrateur IA — Stage ou bénévolat Type d'emploi : Stage Lieu du poste : Télétravail

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep expertise in coffee machines, water and beverage systems who understand products as complete multidisciplinary systems rather than isolated mechanical, electrical or software components. Support RFQs by evaluating technical feasibility, identifying system risks and providing technical recommendations for sustainable, cost optimized solutions. Ensure system-level integration across mechanics, electronics, software, fluidics and thermal systems. Participate in customer technical discussions and represent WIK on system engineering topics. Guide the engineering teams in solving complex technical challenges and making sound technical decisions. Consider system-level risk assessments and support design reviews throughout development. Capture lessons learned and transform project experience into engineering standards and best practices. Mentor engineers and contribute to the development of future System Experts. Strong understanding of complete coffee machine architecture, including the interaction between mechanical, electrical, electronic and software systems. Experience supporting complex multidisciplinary development projects from concept through industrialization. Strong system thinking with the ability to evaluate technical decisions at product level. Experience working directly with customers, suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams. Ability to identify technical risks and propose and guide practical engineering solutions. Passion for mentoring engineers and sharing technical knowledge. Preferred Experience Coffee and beverage appliance industry. Consumer products or premium household appliances. System engineering or technical project leadership. DFMEA, risk management and structured product development. Platform development or modular product architectures. Experience supporting global engineering organizations. Understanding Sustainability by design, and trade offs in value engineering greatly valued. You will spend most of your time supporting customer development projects while also helping shape WIK's future engineering capability by developing technical standards, mentoring engineers, supporting sustainability targets, platform development and strengthening reusable engineering knowledge across the organization. items.desc: Are you looking for a challenging opportunity and want to take advantage of a great job to give new inpulse to your career? This offer is for you. In order to support one of our clients, a large and famous European Public Institution in Brussels , we are looking for a Cybersecurity Analyst - CyberDevOps. EKXEL IT Services , is a European leader in IT engineering, high-tech consulting and IT services . We offer a unique blend of expertise and support major European groups with international vocation to implement and succeed in their project to transform and modernize their information systems. Job description Mission Overview As a Leader Cybersecurity Analyst / Cyber DevOps Analyst, you will act as a pivotal technical leader driving cybersecurity operations, Identity & Access Management (IAM), secure cloud application architectures, and DevSecOps automation. You will provide advanced guidance and technical leadership across major security-related initiatives within a large-scale European institutional environment. Key Responsibilities & Essential Tasks: Technical Leadership: Serve as technical leader / team leader on major security projects, providing architectural oversight and technical coordination. Identity & Access Management (IAM): Design, implement, and administer Federation services (Microsoft Entra ID), Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), RBAC models, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Conditional Access policies. Authentication Systems & Protocols: Enforce robust security policies and secure authentication mechanisms utilizing SAML, OpenID Connect, and OAuth protocols. DevSecOps & Automation: Integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines, manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security templates, and design Python/Bash automation scripts to connect security platforms and audit compliance. Cloud Networking & Application Security: Define and review secure cloud architectures (Azure, AWS), deploy Cloud Application Firewall solutions (WAF), and secure internal applications exposed to the Internet. Cyber Defense & Security Operations: Contribute to cyber-defense operations, interfacing with SOC and CSIRT units, supporting endpoint security, PKI, and security assessment infrastructure. Vulnerability Assessment & Posture Management: Assess security settings across IT applications and components, analyze logs, interpret vulnerability findings, and propose actionable remediation plans for system owners. Reporting & Institutional Collaboration: Deliver actionable Cyber Threat Information (CTI) and concise executive reports to senior management, system owners, and technical stakeholders. Profile Profile & Requirements What do you need to succeed in this position? Education & Qualifications: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. At least one recognized ICT Security professional certification is strictly required (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CEH, Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect / Security Operations Analyst). Professional Experience: Minimum of 6 years of relevant professional IT security experience. Cyber-Defense Track Record: At least 3 years of operational and technical experience in cyber-defence, including deployment or operation of a SOC, CSIRT, Security assessment platform, or technical Security infrastructure (PKI, endpoint protection, etc.). Leadership Experience: At least 2 years of proven experience as a technical leader or team leader for major security-related projects. Core Technical Expertise: Hands-on expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, SAML/OpenID/OAuth, RBAC, MFA, Conditional Access, WAF, Cloud Networking (Azure/AWS), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code. Scripting & Development: Solid scripting and programming capabilities (Python, Bash, or Java) for workflow automation and API connectivity. Communication & Soft Skills: Outstanding analytical mindset, leadership, autonomy, and commitment to increasing institutional cybersecurity maturity. Ability to chair multi-lingual technical workshops and deliver high-impact presentations. Languages: Complete professional fluency in English (both written and oral) is mandatory. Professional command of French is considered a strong asset. Our offer: A particularly attractive salary package, with many additional benefits, to attract the best of you. A professional and stimulating work environment in the field of telecommunications. Multiple career opportunities within a changing group, advanced training in new technologies, rich and recognized expertise. Your application will be treated with confidentiality. We would be very happy to organize a first appointment to talk to you about this opportunity and consider your next career development. Send us your CV

Service Delivery & Hub Orchestration: Oversee service delivery performance, fostering operational synergy, cross-hub standardization, and best-practice sharing across global GBS Service Units. SLA & Performance Governance: Establish and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs), operational contracts, and data-driven performance metrics to guarantee reliable, high-quality operations. Cross-Functional Steering: Lead governance forums and steering committees, aligning Business Line Process Owners, regional delivery hubs, and technical development teams around shared value delivery. Demonstrated expertise in governance frameworks: Proven track record of designing, implementing, and enforcing platform governance models, release controls, and compliance standards in large-scale enterprises. Strong data-driven instincts—relying on operational telemetry, usage analytics, and KPIs to guide decision-making rather than guesswork. Exceptional stakeholder orchestration and communication skills, effortlessly bridging regional hubs, process owners, and tech teams. items.desc: Job Title: Network Security Engineer Location: Sheffield, South Yorkshire (S1 / Hybrid) Job Type: Full-time, Permanent Salary: £56,000 – £60,000 per year + Annual Performance Bonus & Benefits Schedule: Monday to Friday About the Role We are seeking a highly analytical, technical Network Security Engineer to join our enterprise IT and network infrastructure team in Sheffield. Operating out of our modern technology hub near St Paul’s Place and the Sheffield Digital Campus (S1), you will design, deploy, harden, and maintain secure enterprise networks, perimeter defenses, and hybrid cloud connectivity across South Yorkshire and the UK. In this hands-on engineering role, you will safeguard critical enterprise infrastructure—implementing Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), managing next-generation firewalls, optimizing SD-WAN architectures, and defending core network assets against emerging cyber threats. Key Responsibilities Firewall & Perimeter Security Administration: Configure, manage, and optimize enterprise next-generation firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet FortiGate, Check Point, or Cisco Firepower), Intrusion Prevention/Detection Systems (IPS/IDS), and Web Application Firewalls (WAF). Network Architecture & Segmentation: Design and enforce network micro-segmentation, VLAN isolation, Access Control Lists (ACLs), and Zero Trust principles across data centers, branch offices, and cloud environments (Azure / AWS). Secure Connectivity & VPNs: Implement and maintain encrypted site-to-site IPsec VPNs, remote access SSL VPNs, SD-WAN deployments, and BGP/OSPF routing security protocols. Threat Detection & Vulnerability Remediation: Monitor network traffic logs via SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk), conduct regular network vulnerability assessments, apply firmware patches, and remediate configuration weaknesses. Tier-3 Escalations & Incident Response: Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex network security incidents, conducting packet-level traffic analysis (Wireshark), root-cause analysis (RCA), and rapid threat containment. Compliance & Documentation: Maintain up-to-date network topology diagrams, firewall rulebase audits, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in compliance with ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus, and PCI-DSS standards. Requirements & Qualifications Experience: Minimum 4–6 years of commercial experience as a Network Security Engineer, Senior Network Engineer, or Infrastructure Security Specialist within an enterprise IT environment or Managed Service Provider (MSP). Technical Stack & Protocols: Deep understanding of core networking protocols (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, DNS, DHCP, SSL/TLS, IPsec). Hands-on administration expertise with enterprise firewalls (Palo Alto / Fortinet / Cisco) and network access control (Cisco ISE / Aruba ClearPass). Experience securing hybrid cloud networking (Azure Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, AWS VPC, Security Groups). Professional Certifications: Industry-recognized networking or security certification required (e.g., Cisco CCNP Security / CCNA, Palo Alto PCNSE, Fortinet NSE 4–7, or CompTIA Security+). Education: Higher National Diploma (HND) or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Networks, Cyber Security, Computer Science, or equivalent practical industry experience. Location & Setup: Ability to work from our Sheffield office (S1 postcode area) on scheduled hybrid days, with occasional visits to regional data centers as required. Benefits Competitive base salary (depending on experience) Discretionary annual performance bonus scheme Flexible hybrid working model (2 days office / 3 days home working) 25 days annual leave + public bank holidays (with option to buy/sell extra days) Contributory employer pension scheme (up to 8% matched) Dedicated annual training budget for vendor certifications (PCNSE, CCNP, Fortinet NSE) and lab access Private medical cover, life assurance, and comprehensive employee assistance program (EAP) Cycle-to-work scheme and local Sheffield city centre corporate discounts Work Location & Setup This position operates on a hybrid basis out of our enterprise tech hub in Sheffield, South Yorkshire (S1 postcode area) , conveniently located near the Sheffield Digital Campus and St Paul’s Place—just a 4-minute walk from Sheffield Railway Station, providing direct rail links to Leeds, Manchester, and Doncaster alongside rapid access to the M1 corridor. Pay: £56,000.00-£60,000.00 per year Benefits: Company pension Free parking Life insurance On-site parking Work Location: In person

Collaborerai con i team di progetto, contribuendo alla documentazione delle soluzioni realizzate e al miglioramento continuo delle funzionalità sviluppate. Requisiti Competenze richieste Esperienza nello sviluppo con Python e familiarità con Git. Conoscenza dei fondamenti di Machine Learning e Generative AI, inclusi Large Language Models (LLM) e tecniche di Prompt Engineering. Esperienza o conoscenza pratica di architetture RAG, Information Retrieval e sistemi di ricerca su documenti e basi di conoscenza. Capacità di lavorare con dati strutturati e non strutturati, come documenti, codice, log ed eventi. Conoscenza delle API REST e capacità di integrare modelli e servizi AI con applicazioni e strumenti aziendali. Familiarità con la valutazione dei risultati dei modelli, attraverso test, monitoraggio e gestione di errori o output non affidabili. Competenze nell'analisi dei log, Anomaly Detection e analisi di serie temporali. Conoscenza di pipeline di streaming e strumenti come Kafka e OpenSearch. Esperienza nell'integrazione con piattaforme e strumenti aziendali, come Jira, Confluence e GitHub. Conoscenza di sistemi legacy. Identifier les problématiques de qualité, disponibilité, cohérence et traçabilité des données. Définir et mettre en œuvre des indicateurs de qualité des données. Participer à la structuration des référentiels, métadonnées et règles de gouvernance. Contribuer à la préparation des données pour des solutions IA et IA générative. Développer des prototypes et outils d'analyse permettant d'évaluer la maturité des données. Produire des tableaux de bord de suivi et des recommandations d'amélioration. Collaborer avec les équipes métiers, experts data et développeurs IA. Livrables Attendus Diagnostic de maturité des données. Catalogue de données ou référentiel de métadonnées. Tableau de bord de qualité des données. Recommandations de gouvernance. Prototype ou démonstrateur montrant l'impact de la qualité des données sur une application IA. Bénéfices Pour Le Stagiaire Découverte des enjeux industriels liés à la Data et à l'IA. Expérience concrète sur des projets Data Gouvernance et IA Générative. Collaboration avec des experts Data Steward, Data Engineer et AI Specialists. Notions de gouvernance des données, qualité des données et gestion des métadonnées. Connaissance des environnements Microsoft (Power BI, Power Apps, SharePoint) appréciée. items.card: The role combines solid software engineering fundamentals with growing hands-on experience implementing AI capabilities in production environments. Location: Barcelona, Spain Key Responsibilities Build and ship AI-powered features: LLM-based workflows (RAG, agents, document understanding) and predictive analytics on operational cargo data Contribute to architectural decisions for AI/ML integration into CHAMP
items.desc: Overview CHAMP Cargosystems provides the most comprehensive range of integrated IT solutions and distribution services for the air cargo transport chain. The portfolio spans core management systems, messaging services, and eCargo solutions, including applications supporting customs and security requirements, quality optimization, e‑freight, and mobility needs. CHAMP’s solutions, marketed under the Cargospot and Traxon brands, serve over 200 airlines and GSAs, connecting them with approximately 3,000 forwarders and GHAs worldwide. Headquartered in Luxembourg, CHAMP operates offices in London, Zurich, Frankfurt, Manila, Singapore, and Atlanta. At CHAMP, you'll build intelligent solutions used across the global air cargo industry. As part of our Cargo Management team, you'll develop AI-powered products, create production-ready AI/ML services, and help drive the next generation of automation through our AI Hub. If you're passionate about software engineering, emerging technologies, and solving complex business challenges, we'd love to meet you. Join CHAMP’s Cargo Management team and help shape our AI powered products, where agentic AI and RAG-powered automation solve real-world air cargo challenges. Design and deliver intelligent products, integrate AI/ML into production systems, and build scalable APIs powering industry-leading platforms like Cargospot Neo. Work with Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Python, Docker, OpenShift, GitLab CI, and Agile teams to create solutions used across the global air cargo industry. Role Summary Reporting to the Principal Product Manager, the Software Engineer builds and helps integrate AI-based features into CHAMP products and platforms, working closely with senior engineers on architecture and design. The role combines solid software engineering fundamentals with growing hands-on experience implementing AI capabilities in production environments. Location: Barcelona, Spain Key Responsibilities Build and ship AI-powered features: LLM-based workflows (RAG, agents, document understanding) and predictive analytics on operational cargo data Contribute to architectural decisions for AI/ML integration into CHAMP products, under guidance from senior engineers, with an eye on performance, security, scalability, and maintainability Develop production-grade APIs and services exposing AI functionality, integrating with platforms built on Java/Spring Boot and Angular Work with product owners and business analysts to translate requirements into working technical solutions Contribute to the AI engineering foundations: evaluation, testing, monitoring, and deployment practices for AI features Grow your craft through code reviews, pairing, and architectural discussions with senior engineers — especially on AI/ML-specific practices (prompt engineering, model evaluation, RAG design) Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Must-Haves: Solid proficiency in Python. Good software engineering fundamentals (API design, testing, version control, and writing maintainable code). Hands-on experience building AI/ML-powered features (ideally LLM-based like RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, agent frameworks, or vector search). Strong curiosity and self-direction. Nice-to-Haves: Familiarity with MLOps or GenAI tooling (model serving, vector databases, LLM evaluation frameworks). Exposure to classical ML (training or deploying predictive models). Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines (specifically GitLab CI). Experience with OpenShift or Kubernetes. Experience with Java/Spring Boot or Angular (for surrounding platforms). Knowledge of coding design patterns. Experience with SCRUM practices. Interest in or knowledge of the air cargo and logistics industry. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 2–4 years of professional software development experience. Proven experience building AI/ML features, whether in production, serious side projects, or a previous role. Employment is subject to satisfactory reference and background checks, where applicable and permitted by local law. Security : the successful candidate will have to comply with CHAMP Security Requirements (including but not limited to CHAMP’s IT Security Policies, especially the ISMS Policy and the Acceptable Use Policy, mandatory courses, confidentiality and data protection, use of company assets, and incident reporting). We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. items.desc: MegaGroup Trade Holding is a network of technical wholesalers providing water solutions across 10+ locations in Europe. Become our new AI Engineer colleague! Availability: full-time Location: MegaGroup Logistics Services in Poznań, Poland Do you enjoy turning AI ideas into dependable solutions that people can use in their everyday work? Join a fast-growing international company where your impact truly matters. YOUR MISSION MegaGroup Trade Holding is an international technical wholesaler specialising in water solutions that improve people’s lives. We take pride in addressing global water challenges and supporting sectors such as irrigation, livestock, swimming pools, building services and industry. As our AI Engineer, you will build AI applications and automation that make everyday work easier. You will take practical solutions from idea to production and work closely with our Head of AI, business colleagues, IT and an external delivery partner. In doing so, you will support business growth and help shape MegaGroup’s AI engineering capability. You will create intelligent assistants, knowledge applications and connected workflows that reduce repetitive work and enable better-informed decisions across our brands. You will use straightforward automation for predictable tasks and apply AI where it adds genuine value, keeping people in control and measurable business benefits at the centre of the solution. HOW YOU'LL DRIVE SUCCESS Turn business needs into production-ready AI applications and automation using Python, SQL and APIs. Connect business systems and trusted knowledge through reusable, permission-aware integrations with traceable sources. Select practical tools together with business, IT and data colleagues, reusing existing capabilities where possible and developing custom components where they add value. Develop scalable solutions in an Azure environment, using reusable components and consistent data definitions. Build security, privacy and human oversight into solutions so that data access and automated actions remain controlled and traceable. Test, release and continuously improve solutions in collaboration with users and IT. Monitor solution quality, performance and cost, and provide clear documentation and effective support handovers. WHAT YOU BRING Essential requirements Programming and integration: Strong Python and SQL skills, with practical experience integrating REST APIs. Applied AI: Experience building and deploying applications with integrated large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings and tool or function calling. Software delivery: Experience with Git, automated testing, code review, continuous integration and deployment, production monitoring and troubleshooting. Cloud and security: Experience developing cloud applications and integrations relevant to Azure, together with an understanding of authentication, authorisation and secure data access. Data and evaluation: Strong data-modelling fundamentals and the ability to evaluate AI output and retrieval quality, explain technical trade-offs and balance performance with cost. Communication and background: Clear English communication, the ability to translate business needs into maintainable solutions, and a relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. Alignment with our core values: Client Obsession, Execution Excellence, Teamwork and Enjoy Together. Bonus points You do not need experience with everything listed below. We are interested in how you approach problems, select appropriate tools and turn ideas into dependable solutions. Experience with cloud AI services, identity and access management, low-code automation or analytics platforms. Familiarity with AI frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol integrations and Docker. Experience with the Microsoft Azure technology stack, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI or Microsoft Dynamics 365. Experience integrating business systems or supporting e-commerce, wholesale or multi-company operations. WHAT WE OFFER An independent and versatile role in a fast-growing international organisation. The opportunity to develop practical AI solutions that create measurable value across multiple European business units. Personal development and career growth opportunities. Training and coaching support. A supportive international team that works together and celebrates successes. A market-competitive salary and benefits package aligned with MegaGroup’s employment conditions in Poland. READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? Build useful AI and connect it to the business. Apply now and help MegaGroup turn promising ideas into secure, scalable and dependable solutions as our new AI Engineer .

items.desc: Wer wir sind Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. Seit 1998 in Gründerhand, entwickeln wir Software und beraten Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir setzen auf Cloud Native, modernisieren Software und unterstützen unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten AI-Lösungen. Wir bauen unseren Businessbereich “Generative AI” aus und suchen dafür dich, um gute Software für Kunden zu bauen, die relevante Probleme löst. Was dich erwartet Du entwickelst Individualsoftware für verschiedene Kunden und unterschiedlichste Use-Cases auf Basis von LLMs (z. B. GPT, Claude, Mistral) unter Nutzung von Frameworks und Bibliotheken wie LangChain, LangGraph, Open Hermes, Transformers für Generative AI- und RAG-Pipelines. Du nutzt und verarbeitet Daten über Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken, APIs, Cloud-Speicher und Legacy-/Unternehmenssysteme, damit AI-Anwendungen mit relevanten Informationen arbeiten, um für den Kunden echten Mehrwert zu schaffen. Du bringst die Fähigkeit mit, dein bestehendes Know-How auf neue Herausforderungen anzuwenden. Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der fachlichen und technischen Umsetzung von GenAI-Anwendungen und deren Integration. Du teilst dein Wissen gerne, z. B. auf Konferenzen, Meetups oder in Fachartikeln. Du nutzt Open Source zur Problemlösung und lässt Verbesserungen und Erweiterungen zurückfließen. Du hast einen Blick auf den GenAI-Markt und die Weiterentwicklung von Technologien und Trends. Das solltest du mitbringen Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder IT-Beratung. Erfahrung mit RAG- oder RAG-Pipelines unter Verwendung von Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken und LLMs. Grundkenntnisse in probabilistischem Testen mit Testsets und Qualitätssicherung mit Metriken. Du hast Spaß an der Interaktion mit Kunden (wie etwa bei der Beratung oder im Pre-Sales). Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch auf C1+ Niveau sowie konversationssicheres Englisch. 1-2 Mal im Monat innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen, um Kunden und Kolleg:innen persönlich zu treffen, stellt kein Hindernis für dich dar. Das haben wir zu bieten Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nachdem welche Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen du mitbringst, vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 65.000 € bis 75.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden. Kein 08/15: Bei unseren AI-Projekten sind Forschungsgeist und Experimentierfreude gefragt, da wir innovative Konzepte verproben, um Lösungen mit hohem Kundennutzen zu schaffen. Lass dich inspirieren: Arbeite mit einem der führenden Köpfe auf dem Gebiete der generative Artificial Intelligence - unserem CTO Johann-Peter Hartmann Mache einen Unterschied: Du hast bei uns viel Verantwortung und einen großen Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir sind ein mittelständisches Unternehmen, in dem dein Beitrag unseren wirtschaftlichen Erfolg beeinflusst. Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche stellen sicher, dass du dich stets weiterentwickelst. Wir arbeiten selbtsorganisiert: Mit einem hohen Grad an Selbstorganisation und soziokratischen Strukturen hast du alle notwendigen Freiheitsgrade, um die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen. Wir schaffen den Rahmen, den du brauchst, um gut arbeiten zu können. Werde berühmt: Du hast eine technische Redaktion, die dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren unterstützt, sodass du als Expert:in nach außen sichtbar wirst. Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet, dass du nach Feierabend erreichbar bist, Nachrichten beantwortest trotz Krankmeldung oder im Urlaub noch ein paar Kleinigkeiten erledigst . Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück ist kein Problem. Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen. Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad. Der Kontakt zu uns Du hast Feedback oder Fragen zu der Stelle? Schreib uns eine Email an bewerbung@mayflower.de

items.desc: Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Security AI Engineer to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Managed Security Services domain. About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact. Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover. Today, we are around 450 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Security AI Engineer who wants to make a difference in our Managed Security Services domain. Managed Security Services Truesec helps customers globally with Attack Prediction Services, Vulnerability Management Services and Managed Detection & Response services for IT and OT environments. Our services are all delivered by skilled security analysis teams that conducts 24/7 attack monitoring, threat hunting, threat intelligence analysis, and threat remediation. Our team of experts works tirelessly to identify and prevent cyber breaches, and to help increase our customers’ proactive cybersecurity defenses. Our goal is to be an extension of our customers’ IT organizations, customizing a combination of capabilities and tooling, tailored to prevent cyber attacks in the most efficient way. The Role As a Security AI Engineer in Managed Security Services, you will help shape the next generation of security operations. You will turn operational SOC needs into secure, production-ready AI solutions across alert analysis, enrichment, orchestration and response. You will work closely with SOC analysts, service architects, security engineers and developers to ensure that AI-powered automation and agentic workflows create measurable value while keeping human expertise and operational control at the center. Design, develop and improve AI and deterministic agents and agentic workflows for SOC operations. Build prompts, tools, knowledge sources, RAG capabilities and integrations across security platforms, internal systems, APIs and AI services. Evaluate solution quality, accuracy, security, reliability and operational impact before production use. Lead AI-supported security solutions from technical design and experimentation through production deployment and continuous improvement. Your Potential Background You are an experienced AI, machine learning or data engineer with a strong understanding of cybersecurity and modern SOC operations. You enjoy turning complex operational needs into practical, production-ready AI solutions. You combine hands-on engineering experience with sound security judgment, can explain technical design decisions clearly and are comfortable guiding colleagues in a cross-functional environment. Required Skills: Strong experience in data engineering, machine learning or applied data science, including working with data pipelines, data and feature preparation, model development, evaluation and production-oriented ML workflows. Strong software engineering, scripting and integration skills using Python, PowerShell, APIs or comparable technologies. Practical understanding of cybersecurity engineering, SOC operations and platforms such as SIEM, EDR, XDR or SOAR. Experience taking secure technical solutions from design and experimentation into reliable production use. Experience mentoring engineers, guiding technical decisions and helping operational teams Bonus Skills: Hands-on experience designing, developing and evaluating AI agents, LLM-based applications, RAG solutions or comparable AI-powered workflows. Experience with prompt engineering, agent orchestration, knowledge grounding, tool integration and AI evaluation frameworks. Experience with Microsoft security technologies, cloud platforms or workflow orchestration. Knowledge of threat detection, threat hunting, incident response or security data engineering. Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit. Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field. So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!
