items.desc: Build AI agents that help run real mines and processing plants: agents that query live sensor data, call physics-based models and flag problems before people notice them! About IntelliSense.io At IntelliSense.io, we are pioneering the future of industrial decision intelligence. Our platform is trusted by Tier 1 and Tier 2 global mining leaders and cutting-edge secondary metal recycling operations. We combine digital twins of individual industrial processes with AI agents for machines and humans, including role-specific solutions like a "Digital Metallurgist" or "Digital Geologist", predictive ambient agents, and a 24/7 site memory that survives shift changes and staff turnover. As an AI-first company, we harness intelligence across everything we do to cut time-to-value and scale rapidly. The role and why it matters You will build the tools and LangGraph workflows that let agents query live plant data, call physics-based models, search documentation and show results as live charts and tables in Next.js. You will also help build ambient agents that monitor industrial sites 24/7, with tracing and evaluation so they are safe to rely on. You bring modern Python (async, type hints), hands-on experience building an LLM agent or tool-calling app, SQL and RAG, good engineering habits, and curiosity beyond Python. Mentorship from senior engineers; mining knowledge not required. What You'll Do Build the tools our agents use: querying time-series, relational, graph and vector data (Postgres, MongoDB, Neo4j, Qdrant), RAG over documentation, and integrations with services such as Slack, Notion and ClickUp. Design and improve multi-agent workflows in LangGraph, including prompts, few-shot examples and agent configuration. Connect agents to our domain models for grinding, flotation and thickening circuits. Help build generative UI in Next.js with the Vercel AI SDK, so agents can show live charts, tables and widgets. Contribute to ambient agents that monitor the health of industrial sites and of our platform. Add tracing, evaluation and monitoring so agent reasoning is transparent, reliable and safe for industrial use. Help colleagues across the company use and improve our agents. What You'll Bring You will ideally have a Master’s preferred in Computer Science, AI, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field. Your technical skills should include: Modern Python: Strong foundation in Python (3.12+), specifically async/await and type hinting. Agentic Mindset: You’ve moved beyond simple prompts and are excited by the challenge of state management, tool-calling, and reliability in LLM systems. Full-Stack Curiosity: You are happy to dive deep into a Python backend but also open to investigating new APIs and data formats, shipping a React component, or tweaking a Dockerfile. First-Principles Thinking: You enjoy breaking down complex problems and are comfortable working in a field where the best practices change every week. Signal vs. Noise: You possess the critical thinking to separate first-principles engineering from marketing hype. Operational Rigor: An interest in building production-grade software with clean code, unit tests, and thoughtful documentation. What We Offer Unlimited holidays: we trust you to manage your time and your energy. True flexibility: work in a way that brings out your best results. Direct mentorship from senior engineers defining the architecture of industrial agentic systems. A diverse team spanning the UK, Ireland, Spain, Chile, Saudi Arabia, Australia and beyond. Location Cambridge, hybrid. Our process A short call with our People team, a technical interview about a project you have built, a take-home exercise (3-4 hours) with a review session, a conversation with the team, and references. All stages can be held online. We endeavour to complete the hiring process in approximately 8 weeks. Inclusion We want our teams to reflect the range of people who use and are affected by our technology. We welcome applications from everyone and will make reasonable adjustments at any stage: just tell us what you need. If you meet most, but not all, of the essentials, we would still like to hear from you.

items.desc:
Our opportunity 
 Credit Analyst - WKV & WKV Banking / Long Term Underwriting 
 As a Senior Credit Analyst, you will play a key role in assessing complex credit risks and driving high-quality underwriting decisions for the German market. 
 Your role 
 As a Credit Analyst, your main responsibilities will involve: 
 Independently analyze financial statements, business performance, and risk profiles of domestic and international corporate clients 
 Assess transaction, counterparty, and group risks at both national and international level 
 Make independent credit decisions within delegated authority and prepare recommendations for higher-level approvals 
 Lead discussions on complex risk cases and provide expert recommendations 
 Monitor credit portfolios and proactively identify risk mitigation opportunities 
 Serve as a key contact point between Bratislava and German Credit Analysis teams 
 Build relationships with brokers, policyholders, and internal stakeholders and confidently defend credit decisions 
 Support less experienced team members through knowledge sharing and coaching 
 Drive process optimization initiatives and participate in international projects 
 Contribute to the development of underwriting and risk assessment practices 
 Your Skills and Experience 
 As a Credit Analyst, your skills and experience will ideally include: 
 University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field 
 5+ of experience in credit risk analysis, corporate banking, trade credit insurance, surety, or a comparable field 
 Strong expertise in financial statement analysis, credit assessment methodologies, and risk classification 
 Proven ability to make independent credit decisions and manage complex cases 
 Strong understanding of industry and market dynamics 
 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills 
 Ability to influence decisions and challenge business partners when necessary 
 Good knowledge of MS Office and credit-related systems 
 Very good command of English 
 German language skills are an advantage, but not required 
 We offer 
 Compensation for roles at Zurich depends on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific role, skill set, level of experience, and subject to applicable law. Zurich thus provides a range of compensation aligned to internal job architecture and market benchmarks to ensure fair and consistent pay for comparable roles. 
 The starting base salary range for this position is 2200 EUR / Gross. 
 Working time benefits 
Personal days off, Concentrated work week, Additional vacation, Home office, Extra days off at occasion of childbirth, Sabbatical leave, Workcation 
 Monetary benefits 
 Life insurance from Zurich Austria, Compensation for salary loss during sick leave, 3rd pension pillar contribution, Risk Life Insurance, Meal contribution on top of the legally required minimum, Years of service bonus, Wedding bonus, Baby bonus 
 Other benefits 
 Electronic cafeteria, Public Transport contribution, Maternity leave benefits, Massages in the office 
 Learning/Development 
 Professional Certifications, Online Education Portals, Extensive Onboarding program, Strengths based culture (GALLUP) 
 About us 
 At our company, we recognize the importance of fostering an open-minded, safe and inclusive environment for everyone. We stand with diversity and respect different backgrounds and lifestyles. That's why we've implemented numerous initiatives to ensure our employees feel comfortable, accepted and respected at all times.

items.desc: About Behavox Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world. From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise. Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are. We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before. About the Role The Front Office Subject Matter Expert is an experienced individual contributor in the Subject Matter Expert (SME) team. The role is the primary owner of one or two related asset classes and makes sure that the Behavox Financial Data Model (BFDM) and the Unified Risk Taxonomy (URT) reflect how trading desks, venues and regulation actually work. The URT is the common language for risks across preventive controls (such as conflicts of interest and conduct) and detective controls (such as trade and communications surveillance). Working with little day-to-day instruction, the role defines asset class data specifications, turns market abuse typologies into scenarios for Polaris, the Behavox trade surveillance product, and advises product, engineering and data science teams. It supports the revenue team in client meetings, demos and requests for proposal (RFPs) alongside a senior SME or the manager, but does not lead engagements with high-profile prospects or regulators on its own. The role is AI-native: it works with AI agents and agentic workflows, not only chat assistants, specifying requirements for agent-based pipelines and validating their outputs through structured data models and Git-based workflows. This is a remote friendly opportunity. Typical background: Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a front office role, in market surveillance, or with front office data at an exchange, trading venue, market data provider or trading technology vendor. Languages: English required; other languages a strong plus. Agentic workflows: hands-on experience is a plus. Location: open for a remote candidate within Italy. What You'll Bring: Asset class markets – Practitioner-level knowledge of at least one of: commodities and environmental products; digital assets and event contracts; fixed income and structured products; equities and funds; foreign exchange and money markets. This includes instruments, venues, trading conventions and pricing. Front office workflows – Understanding of how execution, sales, research and risk functions operate on a trading desk, including order handling, quoting and hedging. Market abuse typologies – Knowledge of behaviors such as insider dealing, spoofing and layering, wash trading, front running and benchmark manipulation, and how they appear in trade, order and market data. Financial markets regulation – Working knowledge of trading conduct rules, such as the EU Market Abuse Regulation (MAR), the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID II), and US rules of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Structured data modelling – Understanding of trade, order, market and reference data, their quality issues, and modelling concepts such as entities, schemas, validation rules and versioning. What You'll Do: Asset class data specification – Defines BFDM fields, schemas and validation rules for owned asset classes, and checks data outputs against them. Surveillance scenario design – Turns market abuse typologies into Polaris risk scenarios, anchors them to regulatory enforcement cases, and validates their outputs with engineering and data science. Risk taxonomy maintenance – Maps owned asset classes to URT risk situations and regulatory requirements, and keeps coverage current. Client engagement support – Answers front office, data and surveillance questions in client meetings, demos and RFPs alongside the revenue team, and produces SME-reviewed collateral. AI-native, agentic ways of working – Writes clear specifications for agent-based pipelines, reviews and validates their outputs, and contributes changes through Git-based workflows in GitLab. What We Offer: A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation Highly competitive compensation with 100% bonus pay already integrated Benefits include individual career development budget for your learning and growth Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule About Our Process: We take Talent …

Experience with process mapping, capability maturity assessment, options analysis and business case development. Understanding of data, analytics, KPIs and reporting requirements. Experience using tools such as JIRA, Confluence and other collaboration platforms. Join us at a pivotal moment for BT Business. We are executing a multi-year transformation to restore growth, modernise at scale and unlock new markets beyond connectivity. Our ambition is clear – return to sustainable revenue and EBITDA growth, strengthen our market position, and deliver meaningful shareholder value through disciplined execution and bold reinvention. items.desc: Who You Will Be Working With As a Data Engineer at Capgemini, you'll design, build and operate reliable, scalable data pipelines and data products: the trusted foundations that power analytics, AI, GenAI and increasingly agentic systems. You'll work hands-on with modern data engineering tooling and cloud services to ingest, transform and serve data, and you'll prepare and govern the datasets that AI models and AI agents depend on to behave safely and correctly. You'll also use AI-assisted engineering to accelerate your own delivery, while keeping clear human ownership of every outcome. You'll be part of the Data Platforms team within the Insights and Data Global Practice, which has seen strong, sustained growth across a wide range of sectors. Data Platforms is home to Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, Solution Architects and Business Analysts driving our customers' digital and data transformation on modern cloud platforms. We specialise in the latest frameworks, reference architectures and technologies across AWS, Azure and GCP, and data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake. Please Note Security Clearance: To be successfully appointed to this role, must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC)clearance or DV (Developed Vetting clearance). To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements. Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process. The Focus of Your Role You'll build and run the data products that modern AI depends on. That means classic, high-quality data engineering (batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse and warehouse patterns, well-governed and auditable datasets), and the newer discipline of engineering data for AI and agents: retrieval pipelines, embeddings and vector stores, feature and context preparation, and the observability needed when the systems consuming your data are non-deterministic and can't simply be unit tested. You'll build and run the data products that modern AI depends on. That means classic, high-quality data engineering (batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse and warehouse patterns, well-governed and auditable datasets), and the newer discipline of engineering data for AI and agents: retrieval pipelines, embeddings and vector stores, feature and context preparation, and the observability needed when the systems consuming your data are non-deterministic and can't simply be unit tested. What You’ll Be Doing You'll work within agreed security and compliance boundaries throughout, which matters in the regulated and public sector environments we operate in. Build and maintain data pipelines and data products. Use appropriate ETL/ELT and distributed processing to ingest, transform and curate trusted data in cloud storage and analytics platforms. Engineer data for AI and agentic use cases. Prepare curated, governed datasets and features for analytics and ML; build retrieval and embedding pipelines (vector stores, chunking, metadata) that serve RAG and agent workflows; and help expose data to AI systems through patterns such as APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Apply data modelling, quality and governance. Develop scalable models, apply validation and quality checks, and maintain lineage and documentation so data products are reliable and auditable. This matters even more when an AI agent, not just a human, is acting on them. Build in observability for non-deterministic systems. Implement logging, alerting and SLAs for production pipelines, and contribute to evaluation and monitoring of AI-facing data and outputs (e.g. drift, retrieval quality, anomaly detection) with clear human review. Use AI-assisted engineering responsibly. Accelerate development, testing and documentation with coding assistants, applying good prompt hygiene, protecting confidential data, and owning the results. Collaborate across teams. Work with business analysts, platform engineers, data scientists and DevOps to deliver secure, well-tested solutions in an agile environment, communicating your design decisions clearly. Keep raising the bar. Use version control, code review, automated testing and CI/CD; share knowledge, contribute to accelerators and standards, and keep current with modern data and AI engineering practice. What You Will Bring And Experience Needed You'll bring solid, hands-on experience delivering data engineering in production, and a genuine interest in how AI and agentic systems change what good data engineering looks like. You don't need to have done all of the AI-specific work below already, but you should be eager to, and able to show the engineering fundamentals that make it …

items.desc: About The Company We believe in the positive power of energy – and in people who are ready to shape the future with their ideas and dedication. That’s why we established the EnBW Tech Hub in Portugal to drive innovation and develop digital solutions that support the energy transition and improve the way we work. As a key pillar of EnBW’s technological transformation, the Tech Hub plays a vital role in our journey. EnBW is one of the largest energy companies, headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, employing approximately 30,000 people. ENBW IT SOLUTIONS, UNIPESSOAL LDA, a wholly owned subsidiary of EnBW, operates as an integral part of EnBW's IT division. In Lisbon, we bring together experts in IT, administration, project management and HR to collaborate in an agile, international environment and create smart, scalable solutions. Our Benefits Private supplementary health insurance including coverage for your immediate family, offering peace of mind beyond the public system. Meal allowance to support your daily work routines. Additional paid days off (24 December & Carnival Day) on top of statutory annual leave - giving you more time for what matters. Hybrid working model with a mix of remote and office days to support flexibility and modern ways of working. Intercultural collaboration & cross border projects - grow your international experience by working with colleagues in Germany. Modern technology and continuous development opportunities to support your growth and keep you up to date in your field. Bright, appealing offices in a trendy Lisbon area, designed for productive and enjoyable workdays. Your tasks Develop backend services for agentic AI applications, including LLM orchestration, tool integration, and agent workflow logic Build polished, user-friendly frontend interfaces that make GenAI capabilities accessible to business users Deliver GenAI use cases end-to-end — from rapid prototyping through production deployment and ongoing iteration Design and develop reusable application templates, components, and patterns for other teams to leverage Integrate enterprise data sources, APIs, and third-party services into agentic workflows Your profile Must-haves Strong development skills in Python (backend) and a modern JavaScript/TypeScript framework such as React, Vue, or Angular (frontend) Practical experience with GenAI technologies — LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, agent logic, or conversational interfaces Demonstrated daily practice of using agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf) with clear understanding of where they accelerate delivery and where human judgment is essential Comfortable with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native development on Azure Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs; understanding of microservice and event-driven architectures Familiarity with vector databases (Azure AI Search, Qdrant, Weaviate) Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD A mindset that balances delivery speed with reusability — you look for ways to turn solutions into components others can use Effective in cross-functional, distributed teams within a corporate environment Nice-to-haves Experience with agent orchestration frameworks: LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or similar Track record of introducing or scaling agentic development practices within a team Background in building internal tools or platform products for enterprise use Experience in the energy sector or regulated industries Language skills: English: Fluent (required — daily working language) About The Department You will join our Agentic Factory team, which sits at the heart of EnBW's generative AI and data delivery. We build and operate the central AI platform and GenAI use cases that drive real impact across the organization — from intelligent automation to AI-powered decision support in the energy sector. Our team in Lisbon works as an integral part of cross-functional squads in Germany, combining deep technical expertise with the agility to move fast in a rapidly evolving technology landscape. We value curiosity, ownership, and a hands-on engineering culture where agentic tools and AI-augmented ways of working are not just what we build — they are how we work every day. #LI-Hybrid
Location: Barcelona, Spain
At Novartis, we combine cutting-edge science with innovative digital technology to help bring medicines to patients faster.

You will build enterprise GenAI and agentic AI solutions using technologies such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker and AWS cloud services, helping teams move from high-value business problems to production-ready AI-enabled products.
This is a hands-on role where you will move from discovery and rapid prototyping through to engineering, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.

 Turn ambiguous business requirements into practical, production-ready AWS solutions through rapid prototyping and iterative delivery.
 Create reusable AWS components, patterns and documentation, sharing knowledge and coaching colleagues to strengthen internal engineering capability.
 Measure solution performance, adoption and business value, using insights to continuously improve solutions and inform product and platform roadmaps.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenAgents is our platform for building and running conversational AI agents at scale. As our first Application Security Engineer embedded in the Agents team, you’ll make the secure way the easy way. You’ll build the security tooling and reusable primitives that let engineers ship securely by default.

This is a builder role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building tools and internal systems, and the rest working with engineers, staying in sync with Core Security, and doing security research. More than half of the work is greenfield and most of it starts with you, you’ll spot the problems worth solving and own each solution from idea to production.

You will:

 - Build security primitives that are easy for engineers to adopt, starting from what you find when you audit the Agents codebase

 - Review new product work for security and feed what you learn back into shared tooling

 - Lead the major security improvements to the Agents platform, working closely with Core Security

 - Make sure Agents platform uses authn and authz controls correctly and building the guardrails that keep the platform from compromising on security best practices

 - Set the security bar for the Agents platform and make meeting it the easy path for product engineers

 - Work with engineers daily to help them ship fast and safely




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years in application security engineering at scale, covering secure design, vulnerability management and security tooling

 - Strong software engineering skills: you have built and shipped products end to end, in production-quality code

 - Fluency in Python, our main language. Golang or another language is fine if you can pick up Python quickly

 - Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization. Experience securing cross-service communication is a bonus

 - Experience with large-scale, customer-facing backend systems and enterprise-grade security

 - Clear communication and a real enjoyment of working with developers

 - A track record of owning delivery end to end

Bonus:

 - Security for AI and LLM applications

 - Cloud-native experience (AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, IAM, networking, Linux internals)

 - Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, HIPAA)

 - Not required: Compliance certifications, incident …

Nos applications phares gèrent les incidents et les changements IT critiques pour l'ensemble du Groupe et de ses filiales dans le monde, représentant plus de 70 000 utilisateurs et 500 applications partenaires. Vos missions : Intégré(e) au cœur de notre équipe pluridisciplinaire, vous contribuez activement à l’exploration et à l’implémentation de solutions d'Intelligence Artificielle Générative (GenAI) et d’automatisation appliquées à nos outils d'ITSM. Mission principale : Chatbot IA de documentation Vous étudiez les solutions possibles pour un chatbot d'interrogation documentaire, en privilégiant les plateformes internes Orange d'IA "self-service" que sont Live-Intelligence (chatbot GenAI multi-LLM, multi-agents) et FIND, puis vous mettez en œuvre une (ou les 2) solution(s) et vous en faites l’expérimentation / évaluation. En particulier vous devrez proposer une solution : sécurisée, facile à utiliser et avec une bonne fiabilité de réponses permettant d'automatiser la récupération des documents source lorsqu'ils sont mis à jour, d'effectuer les éventuelles transformations si nécessaire, permettant d'identifier les réponses incorrectes du chatbot selon les utilisateurs, avec un reporting associé. Vous préconisez d’éventuelles modifications du format des documents source Vous expérimentez la solution avec nos utilisateurs clés, accompagnez les utilisateurs finaux lors de la mise place de l’outil retenu, rédigez la documentation technico-fonctionnelle et utilisateurs. Si les résultats obtenus avec les plates-formes Live-Intelligence et FIND ne donnent pas satisfaction, vous étudierez une solution sur-mesure alternative avec les composants à disposition dans l’écosystème Orange (IA Agentique, Langchain, Langsmith, RAG …) pour réaliser le chatbot documentaire. items.desc: Last date to apply: 03 December 2026 Do you want to design cloud solutions that dozens of teams reuse, instead of building for just one? Our mission is to enable our DevOps teams to focus on building great applications by providing a shared internal developer platform, tools, templates and ways of working that simplify the entire software development lifecycle. Today, we support more than 20 teams across all three divisions, combining hands-on engineering with coaching, training and technical enablement. Ultimately, our goal is simple: remove complexity, create great developer experiences and enable teams to deliver secure, high-quality software faster. Role Description As a Cloud Architect in CORE Platform, you will help shape the AWS foundation that our DevOps teams build on. Instead of every team solving the same cloud challenges themselves, we create reusable patterns, guardrails and infrastructure-as-code that make it easier to build, deploy and operate software securely and efficiently. You will combine hands-on cloud engineering with architecture and enablement , designing and operating shared AWS capabilities while working closely with the teams that use them. Their challenges and feedback become input for better automation, self-service and reusable solutions across the organization. Together with colleagues across Platform Engineering, Product and Security, you will help develop a coherent platform where reliability and security are built in from the start. You will also run Game Days, including sessions together with AWS, and use those learnings to continuously strengthen the platform. Looking ahead, we are preparing for AI agents to become platform users alongside developers. You will have the opportunity to help shape the cloud patterns and secure environments that make that possible, while influencing how Husqvarna’s use of AWS evolves. What you will do: Design and build reusable AWS patterns, templates and guardrails as code. Ensure our cloud capabilities are reliable, secure and performant. Improve automation and self-service based on the needs of our DevOps teams. Run Game Days and turn learnings into concrete improvements. Evolve our cloud patterns as AWS, technology and user needs change. Coach and mentor engineers across teams. Your profile Beyond your technical expertise, you have a customer-focused mindset and genuinely care about creating solutions that teams find useful and want to adopt. You are curious, pragmatic and comfortable exploring new technologies and unfamiliar challenges. As a senior colleague, you enjoy sharing your knowledge, coaching others and helping people grow. You are also curious about how AI is changing software development, while taking a balanced and practical view of where it creates real value. Most importantly, you are a collaborative and humble team player who brings a positive attitude, a sense of humour and a willingness to succeed together. You have: 5+ years of professional experience working with cloud technologies, with deep knowledge of AWS. Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code and designing and running containerized applications in AWS. Experience building highly available, reliable cloud solutions and the ability to explain the trade-offs behind your architectural decisions. Experience with container services such as ECS and/or Kubernetes platforms such as EKS. Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Experience with AWS CDK is a plus. Location Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive. items.desc: Sambla Group is a fintech company with a clear goal – to be your trusted financial partner. We’ve grown into one of the biggest fintech companies, bridging the gap between borrowers and lenders, thanks to the 500+ amazing people who work here. In the summer of 2026, we were granted authorisation as a credit market company, marking an important milestone in our continued journey to expand into own lending and opening an exciting new chapter for Sambla Group. We are looking for a Finnish-speaking GEO Marketer to join the GEO & Content team, part of Marketing Acquisition, at our headquarters in central Stockholm. People increasingly find financial guidance through AI assistants and answer engines, not only through Google. You will help Sambla Group move from traditional SEO to GEO, built on content optimization and visibility in AI answers, so that we stay visible, trusted and competitive in search engines, AI-driven discovery and the external content sources that matter in our markets. For one or more markets, you will own organic visibility, website content, accessibility and engagement. The work runs from keyword, intent research and content briefs through optimization, implementation and localization, to technical SEO recommendations, LLM visibility initiatives and performance analysis. You will use AI tools in all of it and help make it a natural part of the team's daily workflow. If you want to work with organic growth, AI and coding, and care about how people look for financial advice online, this could be a great fit. What you will do You will grow organic visibility, demand and trust in your assigned market. The role is broad and close to the business: you take ownership from day one and help shape how Sambla Group builds AI-enabled organic acquisition across markets. Your responsibilities will include: Own organic visibility for your market across search engines, AI search, answer engines and other relevant discovery platforms. Set and run the local organic roadmap, covering priorities, initiatives, content requirements and expected impact. Turn market needs, user search behavior, competitor activity and search trends into clear content and optimization priorities. Research keywords, topics and intent, and write content briefs that serve both SEO and GEO goals. Rework existing content for clarity, authority, relevance and conversion intent, and so that AI systems can discover it. Take responsibility for website content, site accessibility, Core Web Vitals and user engagement, and keep improving them. Make sure content and site code are structured so search engines, users, LLMs and AI agents can access, understand and use them. That means working with site structure, metadata, structured data, internal linking and crawlability. Adapt global content and GEO frameworks to what works in your local market. Bring AI into research, topic clustering, briefs, localization, content refreshes, performance analysis and insights. Build and share AI-supported workflows that raise speed and quality and scale across GEO and content work. Partner with Growth Marketing, Digital PR & Content, Affiliation and Marketing Engineering so organic growth supports wider acquisition priorities. Track and analyze organic performance, and use the data to decide what to scale, improve, refresh, automate or stop. Who we are looking for An organic growth specialist who likes working hands-on across SEO, GEO, content, AI, coding and performance. Who understand how search behavior is changing and want to build ways of working that keep us visible in both traditional search engines and AI-driven discovery. You bring: 5+ years of experience in content marketing, copywriting, organic growth, online marketing or a similar role, at least 3 of them in SEO or GEO. Practical experience with keyword research, search intent, content optimization and organic performance analysis. Experience coding and building websites, with a strong grasp of technical SEO and GEO, from site structure and code to Core Web Vitals. In-depth understanding of how LLMs and AI agents work, how websites and apps can communicate with them, and how AI search, LLM visibility and generative discovery are changing organic acquisition. A strong interest in AI, automation, workflow optimization and new ways of working in GEO and content marketing, including practical, responsible use of AI tools for briefs, content creation, refreshes, localization, research and insights. Experience owning organic performance development from insight through execution and optimization, including turning global frameworks into local execution. Good collaboration skills and experience working with performance marketing, content, PR, affiliation, analytics or tech teams. A structured, proactive way of working, strong ownership and a focus on quality, scalability and measurable impact. Strong communication skills in English. Native-level Finnish. It is a plus if you have experience from …

Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data
items.desc: Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Job Description As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the Switzerland market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities. You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. The Embedded Approach The Advisory Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. What You’ll Do As the Advisory Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. Key responsibilities include: Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. Qualifications What We’re Looking For To succeed in this role, you should bring: Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity …

items.desc: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Expedia Business is the B2B arm of Expedia Group. items.desc:

 engineering background as a plus

items.desc: Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer bij PwC werk je dicht bij de klant en de mensen die de oplossing gebruiken. Je onderzoekt hoe hun processen werkelijk werken, brengt een nog onduidelijk probleem terug tot iets dat je kunt bouwen en vertaalt feedback uit de praktijk direct naar werkende software. Je schrijft productiecode, bouwt integraties en brengt oplossingen naar productie. Je wacht niet tot alle requirements zijn uitgewerkt, maar stelt vragen, maakt aannames expliciet en bouwt snel een eerste versie om met gebruikers te toetsen wat daadwerkelijk werkt. Waar je terechtkomt Binnen het Data & AI Consulting-team van PwC Nederland werk je aan complexe vraagstukken bij ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, financiële instellingen en grote commerciële opdrachtgevers. Je helpt klanten om generatieve AI niet alleen te verkennen, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van hun processen, applicaties en dagelijkse werk. Forward deployed betekent bij ons dat je regelmatig dicht op de praktijk van de klant werkt. Je spreekt met gebruikers en domeinexperts, werkt met echte data en bestaande systemen en ontwikkelt de oplossing samen met het klantteam. Maar, je begint niet vanaf nul: we nemen onze AI-versnellers en frameworks mee naar de klant en versterken daarmee onze eigen producten. Afhankelijk van de fase van het traject werk je bij de klant, op ons kantoor in Amsterdam of vanuit huis. Belangrijk om te weten wat deze rol níet is. Je bent geen consultant die alleen analyseert en adviseert, geen sales engineer die vooral demo’s bouwt en geen software engineer die uitsluitend vanuit een uitgewerkt backlog werkt. Je bent en blijft een engineer. Je schrijft productiecode en bent aanspreekbaar op wat je bouwt, dus we meten je niet af op je PowerPoint slides en beschermen je focustijd. Tegelijk ga je zelf naar de bron. Samen met onze consultants spreek je met gebruikers, onderzoek je data en processen en stel je aannames ter discussie. Ons werk is pas geslaagd als de oplossing technisch werkt én in de dagelijkse praktijk waarde oplevert. Dit ga je doen Je werkt van een nog niet volledig uitgewerkt klantvraagstuk naar een AI-oplossing die in de dagelijkse praktijk wordt gebruikt. Je combineert discovery, software-engineering en klantgerichte delivery. Concreet: Je onderzoekt samen met gebruikers het echte probleem. Je brengt processen, knelpunten, data en bestaande systemen in kaart en vertaalt een nog onduidelijke klantvraag naar heldere requirements, succescriteria en een eerste leverbare stap. Je bouwt en toetst snel een eerste werkende oplossing. Met echte gebruikers en realistische data test je aannames en ontwikkel je GenAI-oplossingen met bijvoorbeeld LLM’s, RAG, agents en reguliere softwarecomponenten. Je integreert de oplossing in de klantomgeving. Je bouwt API’s, datastromen, authenticatie en koppelingen met bestaande applicaties en systemen. Daarbij maak je bewust de afweging wanneer AI waarde toevoegt en wanneer reguliere softwarelogica beter past. We werken voor klanten waar security, privacy en compliancy van levensbelang zijn (zoals banken en ministeries). Snel naar productie gaan is daar een uitdaging. Jouw rol is om met onze teamleden de discussie aan te gaan met security-officers en architecten. Je helpt hen in te zien hoe we op een veilige en verantwoorde manier die eerste versies live kunnen krijgen. Je brengt de oplossing betrouwbaar naar productie. Je zorgt voor geautomatiseerde tests, evaluaties, security, CI/CD, monitoring en logging. Je blijft betrokken bij livegang en stabilisatie en draagt bij aan het oplossen van technische blokkades in de klantomgeving. Je verbetert op basis van gebruik en maakt lessen herbruikbaar. Je verzamelt feedback, meet kwaliteit en gebruik, begeleidt de technische ingebruikname en vertaalt terugkerende patronen naar herbruikbare componenten, evaluatieframeworks en implementatieaanpakken. Je staat er niet alleen voor . Hoewel je als FDE de technische leiding neemt over de AI-oplossing, werk je nauw samen met onze gespecialiseerde data-engineers, architecten en consultants. Jij focust op de AI-logica, integratie en de developer experience van de oplossing, terwijl je collega’s zich op de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur en de organisatorische adoptie richten. Je maakt daarbij steeds een bewuste afweging tussen AI en reguliere softwarelogica. Niet ieder probleem heeft een LLM of agent nodig. Waar je mee werkt Onze stack varieert per klant en per vraagstuk. Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer werk je regelmatig in een technische omgeving die je niet zelf hebt gekozen. We zoeken daarom een sterke technische basis, brede nieuwsgierigheid en het vermogen om nieuwe tools snel eigen te maken. AI-applicaties bouwen: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic en SQL. Voor RAG en agentic AI gebruiken we bijvoorbeeld LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Microsoft Agent Framework, MCP, embeddings en vector stores zoals Azure AI Search of pgvector. Integreren en naar productie brengen: Microsoft Azure is ons meest …

items.desc: CONTEXT: AETHER aims to be the key partner for intrapreneurial projects in Belgium, and we want to reinforce our partnerships with key actors in the services sector, who are facing interesting challenges regarding the reliable operation of AI services for employees and customers. Projects are ongoing to ensure that employees and customers can use AI assistants and agents with reliable answers and dependable connections to business systems. If you're keen to support intrapreneurs and see this opportunity as a way to grow your own intrapreneurial or entrepreneurial leadership, we are looking for a medior AI Engineer to strengthen our team of Project Partners. TASK DESCRIPTION: As an AETHER Project Partner embedded within the project team, your objective will be to take over AI services from the engineers who built them and keep them reliable, measured, secure and cost-efficient in production. The services include retrieval-based assistants and AI agents that use tools and business systems on users' behalf. Initial services enter production before the assignment starts, with further releases planned during 2027. You will work alongside an internal AI Platform Architect, two Senior AI Engineers responsible for development, business and content owners, and IT operations teams. The platform combines managed Azure services with self-hosted open-source components on AKS. It uses Microsoft Foundry with the OpenAI model family for LLMs and embeddings, Azure AI Search, Azure API Management and Azure AI Content Safety. Agent orchestration uses Python and LangChain, alongside an ingestion pipeline. MLflow on Databricks supports evaluation and tracing with OpenTelemetry. The delivery team manages Infrastructure-as-Code for application-scoped Azure resources using Terraform and Azure DevOps pipelines. Key responsibilities might include: Activities will vary from service to service. Typically you will: Operate AI services in production: monitor availability, response times and errors, handle incidents and service requests, analyse root causes, then fix or escalate issues. Keep answer quality under control: run and maintain evaluation sets, or golden sets, with business content owners; track answer quality, non-answer rates and user feedback; detect and investigate quality regressions. Operate ingestion pipelines: manage incremental refreshes, failed documents, index health and the addition of new content sources or business domains through existing connectors. Operate agent integrations: monitor tool calls and connections to business systems, handle failures and timeouts, and review action logs and exceptions for agents acting on users' behalf. Manage change safely: validate model version upgrades and retirements, prompt and configuration changes, and dependency and security updates against evaluation sets before release. Follow operating costs: track token consumption and cost per service, set alerts for unexpected changes and propose optimisations. Maintain Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps artefacts, and keep DEV, TST, ACC and PROD environments consistent. Apply data protection rules: manage trace retention, erasure and access restrictions as defined in each service's data protection impact assessment. Maintain runbooks and documentation, and regularly report service health to service owners and the AI governance team. Deliver small enhancements and fixes; structural changes and new features remain with the development team. PROFILE: Medior AI Engineer able to take ownership of production operations for AI agents and RAG services. Intermediate proficiency in vector databases, Azure DevOps, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure OpenAI Service, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Terraform, Python, LangChain and LLMs (Large Language Models). Native or bilingual proficiency in Dutch and French, and full professional proficiency in English. Available for an assignment in Brussels, Belgium, from 4 January 2027 to 31 December 2027, lasting approximately 11 months. An entrepreneurial experience or ambition is a plus, including extra-professional or extra-academic activities. OUR VISION: Success in industry often relies on key individuals who demonstrate intrapreneurial leadership — those who continuously initiate, transform, and pursue excellence. The best way to develop this strength is through ad interim projects, i.e. working as a consultant with established intrapreneurs in international companies, to support their major expansion or improvement initiatives regarding governance, studies, or operations. Since 2014, AETHER has been managing these opportunities for outstanding consultants in key international groups, as these offer greater learning opportunities with multi-million impacts. Please share your CV and we will check if this demand is the current best opportunity for your career as a consultant. INSPIRE | LEAD GROWTH | CREATE IMPACT

items.desc: Description de l'entreprise CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l’intégration et l’exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2 600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l’énergie, l’industrie, le transport, l’aéronautique et la cybersécurité. Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Engagés à vos côtés, au service de vos enjeux critiques. Accélérer la transformation industrielle, en toute sécurité. Notre Business Unit Industrie accompagne les leaders des secteurs de l’aéronautique, de l’énergie et du transport dans la conception, la sécurisation et l’optimisation de leurs systèmes critiques. Avec plus de 700 collaborateurs en France et en Amérique du Nord, elle mobilise une expertise reconnue permettant la réalisation de projets innovants dans les domaines des systèmes embarqués, de la simulation numérique, de la cybersécurité, de la data intelligence et de la digitalisation des processus industriels. Rejoindre cette Business Unit, c’est transformer l’industrie avec des solutions à fort impact. Description du poste Nous recrutons un(e) Stage - Développement d'agent IA pour la vérification et validation de logiciels critiques pour rejoindre notre Business Unit INDUSTRIE au sein de l’agence Systèmes Embarqués Industriels et Cybersécurisés. Le Pôle de compétence SEIC contribue au développement de systèmes embarqués et industriels à fortes contraintes temps réel et de sûreté de fonctionnement ainsi qu’à leur mise en œuvre opérationnelle intégrant les concepts de sécurité. Contexte et objectifs Dans la continuité des travaux de CS GROUP sur l’intégration de méthodes d’IA dans les projets critiques et certifiables, ce stage vise à étudier et développer un framework permettant d’assister et d’orchestrer des workflows métier de Vérification & Validation (V&V) appliqués à des projets DO-178C. L’objectif sera de formaliser différents scénarios de V&V sous forme de workflows déterministes et traçables, puis d’étudier l’intégration de harnais agentiques capables de déléguer certaines tâches à des agents spécialisés utilisant notamment des LLM, du RAG et des outils métier. Une attention particulière sera portée à la structuration des données échangées entre agents, aux règles de délégation, aux boucles de contrôle et à la conservation des éléments de preuve nécessaires aux activités de V&V. Vos missions : 1. Formaliser les workflows métier et les scénarios V&V DO-178C Analyser les activités de spécification, revue, vérification, test, traçabilité et couverture afin de les formaliser les workflows explicites (étapes, rôles, entrées/sorties, règles métier, critères d’acceptation et points de contrôle). Identifier pour chaque scénario les tâches déterministes et celles pouvant être assistées par l’IA ou une validation humaine. 2. Définir l’architecture du harnais agentique et les mécanismes de délégation Concevoir une architecture d’orchestration permettant de décomposer un workflow métier en tâches spécialisées et de les déléguer à différents agents, outils ou fonctions déterministes. Définir les règles de déclenchement, de délégation, d’escalade, de validation et de terminaison des boucles agentiques. 3. Structurer les données et le contexte manipulés par les agents Définir des structures de données intermédiaires, typées et traçables permettant aux agents de manipuler exigences, spécifications, tests, résultats, éléments de couverture, preuves et relations de traçabilité. Mettre en place une représentation de l’état du workflow permettant de conserver le contexte, l’historique des décisions, les artefacts produits et les éléments nécessaires aux itérations successives des agents. 4. Mettre en place les mécanismes de contrôle et de vérification des boucles agentiques Définir des garde-fous déterministes permettant de vérifier les entrées et sorties des agents avant le passage d’une étape du workflow à la suivante : validation de schémas, règles de cohérence, complétude des données, contrôle de traçabilité et mécanismes de reprise en cas d’échec. 5. Our Information Security professionals enable the organization to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and respond to security events as they happen. Within Information Security, we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions across the security lifecycle. You will join a team of security-focused professionals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative and secure solutions that provide business value. Working with Architecture, Product, Operations, application teams, Security and vendors, the Engineer will translate complex requirements into secure, supportable solutions aligned with IAM standards and EY’s global technology and security strategies. The individual will provide technical leadership from design through production and operational handover, mentor engineers, and promote engineering quality and leading practices. Architect AI-augmented IAM capabilities, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration patterns, adaptive access control, predictive threat detection, identity analytics and intelligent workflow automation. Establish reusable frameworks, engineering standards and guardrails for scalable, resilient, maintainable, observable, secure and operationally supportable IAM automation and AI capabilities. Provide technical leadership across Microsoft Entra ID, M365, workload identities, federated credentials, authentication, authorization, session management, token protection, certificates and secrets management. Design secure integrations using REST APIs, Microsoft Graph API, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and related standards, with appropriate identity, authorization and security controls for AI agents, applications and workloads. Automate IAM security, compliance and audit controls and establish logging, monitoring, alerting and incident-response integrations using Azure Monitor, Microsoft Sentinel or comparable platforms. Design and maintain secure CI/CD, DevSecOps and Infrastructure as Code patterns using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, ARM templates or equivalent technologies, with appropriate testing and deployment controls. Conduct architecture, technical design and code reviews; guide engineers on IAM, automation, software engineering, DevSecOps and Agentic AI implementation practices. Maîtrise de l'intégration de LLM (OpenAI, Mistral, Gemini) et du prompt engineering. Bonnes bases infra : Linux RHEL, Docker, OpenShift ou Kubernetes (Helm, routes, scaling), TLS et certificats, API REST. Développement Python, JavaScript, SQL. Une connaissance de Dydu, Konverso ou Talkr est un vrai plus, ainsi qu'Elasticsearch/Kibana, PostgreSQL, S3, Teams/SharePoint avec SSO et Dynatrace. Autonomie, réactivité face aux urgences de production, rigueur documentaire, français écrit courant indispensable.

items.desc: Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy's industry-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real-time trading decisions and mid-to-long-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It's both challenging work and work with a purpose. Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation. This role sits within the Platform Team, part of the Product Technology Services (PTS) group, and is focused on the foundation our development and operations teams depend on: application platform support, CI/CD pipelines, containers and Kubernetes, observability, and infrastructure as code that is repeatable, safe, and secure. items.desc: Brand: Kalmar Team: R&D & Engineering Job Location: Ljungby, SWE Information at a Glance Development Engineer, Mechatronics At Kalmar, we are moving goods in critical supply chains around the world. As the forerunner in sustainable material handling equipment and services, we set the industry benchmark for a zero-emission future. We are driven by teamwork, innovation, and taking ownership to deliver results. With our global reach and local expertise, our success starts with a strong focus on the customer, ensuring their needs guide our daily work. We are dedicated to respecting others and fostering an inclusive culture where all voices are heard, empowering us to succeed together. With us, your work has an impact. Your work moves the world! Join us and take your career to the next level We're looking for an experienced engineer who loves seeing their code and hardware move massive loads in the real world. As our next Development Engineer, Mechatronics , you will take technical ownership of critical subsystems in our Counterbalanced division - integrating mechanics, electrics, and software to build the cleanest, smartest heavy machinery on the market. You’ll collaborate directly with global R&D leads and specialized suppliers, driving technical decision-making and mentoring peers to engineer sustainable solutions that define the future of logistics. What are your key responsibilities: System & Component Leadership: Drive and steer the development of advanced mechatronic systems and components alongside tier-one suppliers, partners, and Principal Systems Engineers (PSE), translating complex customer demands into robust technical architectures and specifications. Safety & Compliance Excellence: Ensure all mechanical, electrical, and control interfaces comply with international product safety standards, legislation, and stringent internal benchmarks. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Technical Mentorship: Act as a senior technical bridge between R&D, Sourcing, and Operations, coordinating cross-product designs, guiding less experienced colleagues, and resolving critical production, service, and supplier challenges. Testing, Prototyping & Validation: Define verification strategies, plan and procure test setups, and validate system reliability through field evaluations, customer visits, and supplier reviews. Strategic Delivery & Accountability: Partner closely with R&D Managers and PSEs to set project milestones, manage technical risk, ensure delivery against schedule, and proactively drive solutions when deviations arise. What we offer you: "Customers depend on us. Our focus isn’t optional - it’s what keeps terminals running and trust alive." Rewards that truly count: We offer meaningful development opportunities through varied assignments, fair and gender-neutral pay, and flexible working conditions - all within a culture that values your growth and celebrates success. Safety that moves us forward: Build your career with a company rooted in safety since the 1940s, ensuring stability and an environment that empowers you to speak and be heard. Purpose that drives change: You'll contribute to solutions that transform global trade, creating environmental and operational innovations. You'll be in the driver's seat of ideas, developing digital and mechatronic technologies that set industry standards and position us as the forerunner. People who move together: You'll collaborate with people who build lasting relationships through global expertise, connections, and a commitment to sustainability. Become part of our global network of 485 R&D Engineers, driving innovative, sustainable solutions and making an impact worldwide. What you bring to the role: Qualifications & Education: B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechatronics, Electrical, Computer Science, or Mechanical Engineering, backed by substantial professional engineering experience. Senior Industry Track Record: Solid experience in product development, including extensive technical knowledge of non-road mobile machinery (NRMM), heavy rubber-tired vehicles, or complex industrial machinery. Software & Programming Toolset: Hands-on proficiency with relevant programming and software engineering tools (e.g., C/C++, Python, MATLAB/Simulink, or IEC 61131-3 embedded environments) applied to machine control and system integration. Architectural & Analytical Drive: Strong systems-thinking perspective with the ability to architect complex mechatronic interfaces, resolve deep technical roadblocks, and mentor others toward practical solutions. Collaborative Influence & Fluency: Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with fluency in English (both written and verbal) to steer cross-functional initiatives and align global partners. Ready to elevate your career? Apply today! We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. items.desc: About the Role Destinus is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on mechanical engineer capable of delivering engineering solutions as part of the research and development in the Destinus Systems department. In this role you will design and develop a control node for air defence and strike systems, including all relevant mechanical subsystems. The ideal candidate is a strong team player with good social and communication skills to continuously coordinate with the peers of the respective engineering disciplines and teams, has a demonstrated ability to take technical ownership during development and drive technical solutions. What you will do Generate 3D CAD models, drawings, schematics, bills of material, and other related documentation required for manufacturing, integration and testing Deliver technical documentation including any engineering calculations, analysis and assumptions required to substantiate your design decisions and solutions Create engineering design, prototypes, and manufacturing plans for an air defence and strike systems control node Manage suppliers and manufacturers by addressing any technical questions and resolving any issues which may arise during the manufacturing process. Select standard parts, fasteners, equipment, and consumables following best practices and industry standards Take ownership of your design work and closely coordinate with your peers in the engineering department across the involved engineering disciplines (systems, safety, electrical, aerospace, etc.) Coach junior engineers and interns in mechanical design, manufacturing and CAD. Support the product development process through the design review process (SRR, PDR, CDR etc.) Support and accompany the integration, assembly and manufacturing phases of the control nodes from a mechanical engineering point of view Drive innovation with new ideas to keep Destinus’ air defence and strike systems Support both the structured product development process as well as the rapid prototyping approach at the engineering department Requirements What you will need BSc. In Mechanical Engineering, Design Engineering or a related discipline. Ideally, technical training as a mechanical designer / drafter 2-5 years of working experience in mechanical engineering in defence or in a related industry sector (e.g. aerospace) with close ties to manufacturing Experience with design of automated solutions, special machines or test benches is a benefit Experience with Siemens NX is a must, experience with Teamcenter is a plus Ideally, experience in several different phases: design, build, integration, test, and operation. Knowledge of military standards (MIL-STD, STANAG, AECTP) and engineering and requirement management tools (Jama, Jira, Confluence etc.) Knowledge of relevant technical topics for military control nodes (communication protocols, tactical data links, firing control, radar sensors, safety etc.) is a plus Willingness to travel to different Destinus sites (max. 20%) Strong communication skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, international and multidisciplinary development team Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities Strong analytical skills and ability to work autonomously Fluency in English is required; German is a plus.

items.desc: University Hospital Southampton is delighted to offer a fantastic opportunity to work with us Job Title: Research & Development (R&D) Specialist Data Analyst Contract Type: Permanent Please be advised that this vacancy may close earlier than stated if we receive a large number of applications. This is an exciting opportunity to join our growing Data & AI team within the Research & Development department at University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust, as a Senior Research Analyst. Working within the Southampton Emerging Therapies and Technologies (SETT) Centre, you will combine advanced analytical and data engineering expertise with line management responsibilities, leading a group of analysts and data engineers to deliver high-quality research data projects. Our team supports clinical and academic research through the extraction, processing and analysis of routinely collected healthcare data, developing innovative tools and infrastructure to expand research capacity and improve patient outcomes. You will play an important role in supporting research project delivery, ensuring technical quality, and working in the team to improve team processes and capabilities. The SETT Data & AI team works to drive future transformation in patient care through the streamlined extraction of high quality data at scale, and the application of state of the art analytical techniques to drive research. By developing a data landscape friendly to research, we aim to expand Trust-wide research capacity and improve patient outcomes through helping to shape the future of medicine. This is a creative and rapidly evolving unit within the hospital’s R&D environment, and successful candidates will have the exciting opportunity to help shape its direction and long-term aims. As one of the largest acute teaching Trusts in England, we offer learning and development opportunities to help you achieve the career you aspire to. UHS is rated ‘Good’ by the CQC and in the latest national NHS Staff Survey, we were in the top 10 acute trusts for staff engagement and for staff recommending the hospital as a place to work or receive care. We support flexible working and will consider requests taking into account the needs of the service. UHS employees are able to access a range of NHS discounts, are entitled to a minimum of 35 days paid holiday (pro rata), and we offer a generous pension scheme. Southampton is an attractive place to live and work situated on the south coast, with an international airport and direct trains to London. The New Forest National Park and beaches of the Jurassic coast are also right on our doorstep. The city offers living costs 30% lower than London and 17 schools rated outstanding by Ofsted. We believe that using technology wisely shows strong time management and commitment to innovation. However, personalising your recruitment application to highlight your unique skills and experiences is crucial. Relying too heavily on generic, AI-generated content instead of drawing from your own strengths and accomplishments may lead to your application being rejected if multiple candidates present identical or similar information. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the delivery of complex research data analysis projects within the Data & AI team. You will support project development and delivery, maintain high technical standards, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of the team's capabilities and working practices. The Data & AI team works closely with clinical and academic researchers across University Hospital Southampton and partner organisations, supporting a diverse portfolio of research projects using routinely collected healthcare data. Our work ranges from developing automated data extraction and transformation pipelines to undertaking advanced analytical studies, building innovative research tools and improving the infrastructure that enables research at scale. Through this work, we aim to expand research capacity, support scientific discovery and ultimately improve patient outcomes. Your key responsibilities will include: Research project development and delivery: Develop and manage a pipeline of research data projects, guiding enquiries from initial Expression of Interest through feasibility assessment, scoping, resource estimation and prioritisation into active delivery. Support the analytical delivery of allocated projects, monitoring progress, and working closely with researchers and research delivery teams to ensure projects meet their scientific and technical requirements. Technical and analytical leadership: Undertake complex analyses of routinely collected NHS healthcare data, alongside the design and development of robust, reproducible data extraction, transformation and processing pipelines across clinical information systems. Provide technical oversight, including code review, testing, validation and documentation, while supporting the adoption of consistent technical …

items.desc: Se non ci conosci, ci presentiamo! CED Digital & Servizi è la società del Gruppo Caltagirone Editore specializzata nella progettazione, nello sviluppo e nella gestione delle piattaforme digitali delle testate del Gruppo. Supportiamo l'innovazione tecnologica attraverso la gestione delle infrastrutture IT, lo sviluppo di soluzioni digitali e la consulenza tecnologica rivolta alle società del Gruppo e ai partner commerciali. Il Gruppo Il Gruppo Caltagirone Editore è una delle principali realtà editoriali italiane e riunisce 12 società che operano in modo integrato lungo l'intera filiera dell'informazione. Con testate come Il Messaggero, Il Mattino, Il Gazzettino, Corriere Adriatico, Nuovo Quotidiano di Puglia e Leggo, insieme a realtà specializzate in tecnologia, advertising, produzione e servizi, il Gruppo dà vita a un ecosistema in cui professionalità complementari collaborano per creare valore e dare forma al futuro dell'editoria. Le tue sfide quotidiane Entrerai a far parte di un team impegnato nello sviluppo di soluzioni basate su AI Generativa, Large Language Models (LLM) e AI Agent, contribuendo alla progettazione di prodotti innovativi a supporto del business. Dopo una prima fase conoscitiva del contesto, ti occuperai di: Sviluppare applicazioni che integrano LLM, tecnologie di AI Generativa e Machine Learning Progettare e implementare AI Agent autonomi e multi-agent Sviluppare sistemi di orchestrazione agentica per l'automazione dei processi aziendali Implementare architetture Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) e sistemi di Knowledge Retrieval Integrare gli agenti con API, database, sistemi enterprise e servizi cloud Definire tool, memory, reasoning e workflow per agenti AI Ottimizzare performance, latenza, costi e qualità delle risposte dei modelli Implementare sistemi di monitoring, evaluation e observability delle applicazioni AI Collaborare con il team per definire architetture scalabili e best practice di sviluppo Must Have Crediamo nella crescita e nella valorizzazione del talento. I dati personali contenuti nelle candidature saranno trattati esclusivamente per finalità di selezione del personale, nel rispetto del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679 (GDPR) e della normativa vigente in materia di protezione dei dati personali.
