items.desc: Do you want to connect our systems and put AI to work where it creates real value for the business? At Nine United, our brands run on a landscape of strong platforms: D365 Finance & Operations, PIM, DAM, B2B and commerce, CRM, Power BI and a growing number of partner solutions. Their full value only comes when they are connected well. Like a good piece of furniture, the quality lies in the joints. We also believe AI can change how we work, from handling orders and invoices to enriching product data and supporting our colleagues in their daily tasks. As part of our IT strategy, we are strengthening both our integration and AI capabilities. We are looking for a consultant who can build the connections that hold our platforms together and help us turn AI from potential into practice. YOUR ROLE - CONNECTING PLATFORMS AND PUTTING AI TO WORK You will be our go-to person for integrations and a driving force in our AI initiatives across Nine United and our brands. You will work closely with your colleagues in IT, who are responsible for ERP, master data, PIM/DAM, commerce and Power BI, as well as with the business and external partners. You will see the whole picture: how data flows between systems, where processes can be automated, and where AI can make a real difference. You will: Design, develop and maintain integrations between D365 F&O and our surrounding platforms, such as PIM/DAM, B2B/commerce, CRM, logistics partners and other suppliers. Help define and develop our integration architecture and standards, so new integrations are built consistently and can scale. Identify, prioritize and implement AI use cases together with the business. Examples include document processing, product data enrichment, AI agents and assistants, and intelligent automation of manual workflows. Build AI-powered solutions on top of our data and integrations, and take them from proof of concept to stable operation. Contribute to our AI platform choices, governance and responsible use of AI, including data security and compliance. Drive adoption by training, inspiring and supporting colleagues across the organization, so AI is actually used in daily work. Monitor, troubleshoot and improve existing integrations and solutions, with a focus on stability and transparency. Document integrations, data flows and AI solutions, so knowledge is shared and not tied to a single person. WE IMAGINE THAT YOU Must have: Have several years of experience with system integrations in an ERP-heavy environment, ideally with D365 F&O (data entities, OData, DMF, business events). Have hands-on experience with integration and API technologies, e.g. Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure Functions or similar. Have practical experience with AI and automation, and have built solutions with tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI services or large language models through APIs. Have a solid understanding of data structures and data quality, and know that both integrations and AI are only as good as the data behind them. Are curious and pragmatic. You can separate hype from value and explain AI in plain language to non-technical colleagues. Are good at coordinating with internal teams and external suppliers, without losing track of the overview or the progress. Nice to have: Experience with Power Automate and the wider Power Platform. Experience with AI agents, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Knowledge of PIM, DAM, e-commerce platforms and EDI Experience with integration monitoring and DevOps. WHAT WE OFFER We support our employees in creating a healthy work-life balance and offer, among other things, an employee healthcare programme and a delicious and healthy lunch scheme. The tone is informal and reflects the fact that we are an organisation made up of people from diverse backgrounds, where there is a close and approachable relationship between employees and management. We offer an exciting workplace with challenging and varied tasks, as well as plenty of opportunities to shape your own working day. WHY JOIN NINE UNITED? You will be part of a global organization with strong brands and ambitious growth plans, where IT plays a key role in how we work and grow. You will get real influence on how our platforms are built and used, and you will work closely with colleagues responsible for Master Data, ERP, Finance, B2B, PIM, DAM, Commerce and Power BI. We have high ambitions, a short way from idea to action, and room for both professionalism and humor. You will report to Karsten Ø. Kristensen, CIO. WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU If you have any questions about the position, please contact Karsten on +45 42 82 01 55 or at karsten.kristensen@nineunited.com. Please upload your short application in Danish or English and CV as soon as possible. We evaluate applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. items.desc: Company Description It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Job Description ServiceNow is seeking an Advisor Partner Technical Architect - AI Platform & Data (Moveworks) to drive AI-enabled partner growth through deep, L400-level AI/ML architecture expertise, strategic business development, and ecosystem-wide thought leadership. This is an Advisory technical Architect role focused on helping partners build differentiated AI-powered solutions on the ServiceNow platform - from agent architecture and model selection through RAG design, multimodal AI, and AI-first solution commercialization - with particular depth in Moveworks, EmployeeWorks, and Agent Studio. As a Practice-aligned Advisor Partner Technical Architect within the AI Platform & Data Practice, you will be engaged where deep AI expertise is required - working alongside partner-aligned Partner Technology Architects and Partner Solution Engineers to shape commercially viable, technically excellent AI solutions. Your focus is on how to architect and design AI solutions that partners build - not how to govern AI at the enterprise level (which is owned by the Partner Technology Architect - Governance & Security through AI Control Tower). Your expertise extends beyond ServiceNow capabilities to encompass the full AI ecosystem - foundation models, open-source frameworks, competing platforms - enabling you to guide partners on hybrid architectures and multi-vendor AI strategies that position ServiceNow as the enterprise AI platform of choice. What you get to do in this role: As an Advisor Partner Technology Architect - AI Platform & Data, you will serve as the go-to AI architecture expert across the partner ecosystem, driving deep technical co-innovation and commercial success for AI-powered partner solutions, and as the Moveworks technical authority for partners in your region. AI Architecture & Solution Co-Creation Co-create AI-native architectures with partners, developing reference architectures, reusable patterns, and integration libraries that partners can extend and monetize. Provide L400-level expertise in agentic AI architectures including autonomous agent design, multi-agent orchestration, tool use patterns, and human-in-the-loop design patterns. Drive collaborative adoption of emerging AI technologies across agent frameworks, RAG architectures, multimodal AI, and foundation model integration. Build reusable co-innovation assets including solution templates, starter kits, scripts, demo environments, and vertical-specific architecture blueprints that enable partners and validate feasibility. Partners own delivery. Influence AI product architecture and roadmap based on partner ecosystem needs through formal feedback loops with product teams. Moveworks Specialization Serve as the dee[ technical authority on Moveworks and EmployeeWorks for partners in your region, with command of platform internals, Agent Studio, integration patterns, and supported architectures. Guide partners through integration design with enterprise systems (ITSM, HCM, ERP, CRM), including authentication and data flows. Prototype and test approaches to validate feasibility, including when documentation is incomplete or a first approach fails. Enable partners to technically qualify, scope, position, and design Moveworks solutions independently, and to deploy EmployeeWorks and win new logos through partner-led motions. Route Moveworks product feedback and partner questions through the designated PTAG Moveworks lead, who holds the interface to the Moveworks business unit. items.desc: Turn business questions and data into practical AI solutions. As a Junior AI Engineer, you will combine data analysis, machine learning and modern AI engineering to generate reliable business insights and build scalable applications. You will work with business and domain experts to understand their needs, explore and validate data, communicate clear recommendations, and help translate promising ideas into production-ready solutions. The role has three complementary pillars: Data Analysis & Business Insights, Machine Learning & Generative AI, and Software & Cloud Engineering. You will receive guidance while progressively taking ownership of analytical, development, testing, deployment and documentation activities. Data Analysis & Business Insights Use SQL and Python to explore, combine, clean, filter and validate data and answer business questions in a reliable, repeatable way. Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, correlations, anomalies and data-quality issues. Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches, hypotheses and measurable outcomes. Apply statistical methods and effective visualizations to validate findings and communicate them clearly. Independently investigate unfamiliar datasets, ask the right questions and select an appropriate analytical or machine-learning approach. Explain evidence, model drivers, reliability, assumptions, limitations and potential bias to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Produce concise analytical notes that document conclusions, limitations and actionable recommendations. Work closely with domain experts to gather context, respectfully challenge assumptions, validate conclusions and document decisions. Machine Learning & Generative AI Build, test and explain practical machine-learning solutions, including regression, classification, clustering and similarity analysis. Use anomaly-detection and forecasting techniques to identify unusual patterns and estimate future outcomes. Contribute to Generative AI and LLM-based applications, including prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions and basic agentic workflows. Assess the quality and suitability of AI outputs using appropriate evaluation methods and business criteria. Prototype and validate AI solutions with business stakeholders before further industrialization. Software & Cloud Engineering Develop maintainable Python components and contribute to reliable AI applications. Contribute to deploying, monitoring and maintaining AI solutions in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure. Apply software-engineering, DevOps and MLOps practices, including Git, testing, CI/CD and reproducible experimentation. Collaborate with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers and business experts throughout the solution lifecycle. Create clear technical documentation and contribute to team knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. Your Profile Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Up to 2 years of relevant professional experience. Internships, academic projects and personal AI or data projects are valued. Good foundation in Python and common data-analysis or machine-learning libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn. Working knowledge of SQL and experience analysing structured datasets. Understanding of statistics, data validation, machine learning and effective data visualization. Strong interest in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and modern AI architectures. Ability to connect analytical findings to business questions and communicate recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch is a strong asset. Technologies you may work with Python, SQL, pandas, scikit-learn and data-visualization libraries. LLM frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen or CrewAI. Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Search, vector databases, graph databases and knowledge graphs. Databricks, including catalogue structures and AI/ML capabilities. Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines and MLflow. What will help you succeed Business curiosity: you seek to understand the underlying business question before selecting a technical approach. Critical thinking: you check assumptions, explore alternative explanations and validate conclusions against evidence. Problem solving: you can structure ambiguous problems and learn unfamiliar technologies or datasets quickly. Collaboration: you work constructively with engineering, data and business colleagues. Communication: you document your work clearly and adapt explanations to the audience. Quality and ownership: you test your work, pay attention to detail, ask for support when needed and follow through on commitments. You do not need to master every technology listed above. Disegnare architetture basate su AI Agents e
items.desc: Profilo Il/la Cloud Data Engineer - Agentic/Generative AI entrerà a far parte della Practice Data & Intelligence di NTT DATA Italia, contribuendo alla realizzazione di soluzioni innovative che integrano Data Platform, Generative AI e tecnologie Agentiche su ecosistemi cloud enterprise. Lavorerà a stretto contatto con architetti, data engineer, AI specialist e clienti, supportando l'adozione delle funzionalità AI native dei principali hyperscaler e vendor tecnologici per accelerare l'evoluzione delle moderne piattaforme dati. La figura ricercata è un/una professionista con solide competenze di Data Engineering, in grado di progettare e sviluppare soluzioni che combinano dati, servizi AI e framework agentici. Il ruolo è focalizzato sull'integrazione e industrializzazione delle capabilities Generative AI e Agentic AI all'interno delle architetture aziendali: dati governati, pipeline, knowledge retrieval, servizi cloud e requisiti di produzione. Non richiede un profilo di modellazione statistica o Data Science. Cerchiamo una persona con esperienza concreta nella progettazione, sviluppo e messa in produzione di soluzioni Data & AI su almeno un hyperscaler. Deve inoltre avere conoscenza pratica delle principali piattaforme Generative AI e Agentic AI. Certificazioni o percorsi specialistici rilasciati da hyperscaler, piattaforme dati e vendor in ambito Cloud, Data e AI costituiscono titolo fortemente preferenziale. Responsabilità Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni Data & AI su piattaforme cloud enterprise. Implementare funzionalità Generative AI e Agentic AI all'interno di Data Platform moderne. Realizzare pipeline dati, integrazioni API e componenti di knowledge retrieval, incluso il disegno di pipeline RAG con adeguate strategie di chunking, retrieval e gestione dei metadati. Disegnare architetture basate su AI Agents e Agentic Workflows , selezionando gli approcci più adatti a contesto, vincoli e requisiti di affidabilità. Integrare servizi LLM, vector database e componenti AI nelle soluzioni dati, inclusi prompting, tool use, memoria e gestione del contesto. Sfruttare le capabilities AI native di Azure, AWS, Google Cloud e delle principali piattaforme di mercato. Contribuire alla definizione e all'adozione di pratiche di evaluation, osservability, guardrail e governance per applicazioni AI in produzione. Collaborare con clienti e team progettuali nella definizione di use case e soluzioni innovative. Contribuire all'evoluzione di framework, acceleratori e best practice della Practice Data & Intelligence. Required Skills Comprovata esperienza in ambito Cloud Data Engineering. Esperienza nell'utilizzo di servizi Generative AI e Agentic AI forniti dai principali hyperscaler. Esperienza concreta su almeno una piattaforma cloud tra Microsoft Azure, AWS e Google Cloud Platform, inclusi servizi di data platform, integrazione, sicurezza e servizi AI nativi. Esperienza nello sviluppo di pipeline dati, integrazioni API e architetture cloud-native. Buona padronanza di SQL per interrogazione, trasformazione e validazione dei dati su database relazionali e/o data platform cloud. Esperienza nel progettare e implementare soluzioni RAG, vector o graph database e sistemi di knowledge retrieval. Conoscenza dei principali framework per la realizzazione di AI Agents e workflow agentici, nonché di protocolli di integrazione tra modelli, tool e sistemi esterni (come MCP, A2A) Buona conoscenza di almeno un linguaggio di programmazione moderno per lo sviluppo di soluzioni Data & AI, preferibilmente Python, con capacità di realizzare API, integrazioni, codice modulare e pratiche di versionamento. Esperienza in contesti consulenziali e progetti di trasformazione digitale. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Costituiscono un plus Esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni Multi-Agent. Conoscenza di strumenti di observability, governance e monitoraggio delle applicazioni AI. Esperienza su piattaforme e servizi Generative/Agentic AI dei principali hyperscaler e data platform, secondo gli strati tecnologici riportati di seguito: Piattaforme e runtime per agenti: Amazon Bedrock/Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft AI Foundry, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (ex Vertex AI) - Agent Runtime, Databricks Agent Bricks, Snowflake Cortex Agents. Framework agentici: LangChain / LangGraph, Strands Agents, Microsoft Agent Framework (ex Semantic Kernel/AutoGen), Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK. Observability, evaluation e guardrail: LangSmith, AgentCore Observability ed Evaluations, Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, Google Model Armor, Databricks MLflow 3 e Unity AI Gateway, Snowflake Cortex AI Guardrails. Partecipazione a community, PoC o iniziative di innovazione in ambito Generative AI. Possesso di certificazioni vendor in ambito Cloud, Data, Generative AI e Agentic AI. Certificazioni richieste o fortemente preferenziali Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103) Microsoft Certified: Multi-Agent AI Solutions Expert (AI-500) AWS …

items.desc: Etudiants/ Jeunes diplômés Ingénierie logicielle Stage ID 594812-fr_FR Chez Sogeti, la technologie coule dans nos veines . C’est cet intérêt pour la technologie qui nous guide au quotidien et qui est reflété dans notre slogan « Made In Tech ». Grâce à notre passion commune pour la technologie , à notre culture entrepreneuriale et à l'importance que nous accordons à la formation continue, nous mettrons tout en oeuvre pour vous accompagner à libérer votre plein potentiel VOS MISSIONS Durant votre stage, vous explorerez les opportunités offertes par l’IA générative afin de créer des applications, assistants et agents intelligents capables d’automatiser des tâches, faciliter la prise de décision et améliorer l’expérience utilisateur. Vous participerez à toutes les étapes, de l’expérimentation à la mise en production de prototypes innovants Au sein de nos équipes, vous contribuerez notamment aux activités suivantes : Développement de solutions IA : conception, développement et intégration de fonctionnalités s’appuyant sur des modèles d’intelligence artificielle et des LLM ; IA générative & LLM : expérimentation autour des modèles de langage, conception de prompts, mise en place de solutions de type RAG et développement d’agents IA ; Développement & intégration : création de services, API et interfaces permettant d’intégrer les briques IA au sein d’applications ; Prototypage & POC : réalisation de preuves de concept afin de tester rapidement de nouveaux usages et technologies IA ; Optimisation & qualité : évaluation des résultats, amélioration des performances et participation aux phases de tests et de validation ; Innovation et amélioration continue : participation à l'évaluation de nouvelles technologies, méthodes et outils afin d'optimiser les processus, enrichir nos offres et accompagner la transformation numérique de nos clients Innovation : participation, selon les sujets, aux expérimentations et projets menés au sein du SogetiLab. VOTRE PROFIL Vous préparez un Bac+5 / Master 2 en informatique , idéalement avec une spécialisation en intelligence artificielle, data ou développement logiciel ; Vous avez de bonnes bases en développement , notamment en Python , et appréciez transformer une idée en solution concrète ; Vous aimez explorer de nouvelles technologies, analyser des problématiques complexes et concevoir des solutions pragmatiques apportant une réelle valeur aux utilisateurs Vous avez idéalement déjà expérimenté certains outils ou frameworks liés à l’IA, par exemple LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face ou des API de modèles de langage ; Des connaissances en API, Git, bases de données ou environnements cloud seront appréciées ; Vous êtes curieux(se), autonome et orienté(e) solution : vous aimez expérimenter, tester, apprendre et résoudre des problématiques techniques ; Vous appréciez également le travail en équipe et êtes capable de partager simplement vos choix et vos résultats. QUELQUES RAISONS DE NOUS REJOINDRE Qualité de vie au travail : profitez d’un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle, d’une possibilité de télétravailler, ainsi que des dispositifs de santé et bien-être (ligne d'écoute, plateforme dédiée...). Environnement inclusif : rejoignez des réseaux engagés comme Women@Capgemini, Parents@Capgemini, OUTfront ou CapAbility, et évoluez dans un cadre certifié EDGE+ et reconnu par le Bloomberg Gender Equality Index. Happy Trainees : notre engagement envers les jeunes talents est reconnu dans le classement HappyTrainees, preuve que chez nous, les stagiaires et alternants ne viennent pas juste apprendre… ils viennent s’épanouir. Sogeti fait partie du groupe Capgemini et accompagne les organisations dans leur mise en oeuvre de l'innovation , en tant que partenaire local à l'échelle mondiale . En combinant son agilité et sa rapidité Sogeti propose des solutions innovantes en testing, cloud et développement d'applications , toutes pilotées par l'IA , les données et l'automatisation . items.desc: Role Description We are building the next generation of AI-native engineering talent engineers who use AI as a core part of how they work, not as an add-on. As an AI Engineer (Software), you will design, build, and ship production-grade software across the full stack, using AI-assisted tooling as standard daily practice alongside your core engineering skills. You will work on real client programs across industries, building production-grade software that connects to and supports agentic AI systems — understanding how your full-stack work integrates with agent architecture, LLM APIs, and enterprise AI pipelines. This is not a stepping-stone role: it is a core engineering function in the most in-demand part of the market, with a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer program for those who develop agentic depth. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity — combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams, structured AI certification pathways, and a clear development track toward agentic and forward-deployed engineering. Key Responsibilities Use AI coding assistants daily as a standard part of delivery, actively, frequently, and with demonstrable impact on productivity and output quality Integrate LLM APIs into applications in production: calling AI provider APIs in live code, managing token limits and latency, and building initial abstraction layers Apply AI across the full software delivery lifecycle: AI-generated tests, AI-assisted debugging, AI-accelerated code review, and prompt engineering for development tasks Own the quality of AI-generated outputs in your delivery scope, exercise engineering judgment about reliability, limitations, and failure modes; know when AI output is production-ready and when it is not Define and track KPIs to evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of AI-assisted workflows; present AI productivity and quality metrics to project stakeholders Own delivery end-to-end — from design through to production support — in Agile sprint cycles alongside client engineering teams Contribute to shared knowledge bases, reusable components, and internal AI tooling standards that benefit the wider team Build and integrate the application layers, APIs, and interfaces that connect full-stack systems to agentic backends — understanding data flows, context handoffs, and integration points between your code and AI pipelines Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field Commercial software engineering experience in production environments (or equivalent demonstrated through academic projects, internships, or shipped personal projects) Proficiency in at least one primary backend language: Python, Java, or TypeScript Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI tools actively in day-to-day engineering work — with practical examples of how AI was used to solve real problems, iterate on outputs, and improve delivery; including direct experience calling LLM APIs in production code with an understanding of token management, latency, and cost tradeoffs Basic understanding of web technologies including JavaScript, HTML, and CSS Familiarity with cloud fundamentals (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containers (Docker), and CI/CD pipelines Understanding of Agile delivery fundamentals Experience with databases — SQL or NoSQL Ability to validate, evaluate, and improve AI-generated outputs; understanding of AI limitations and responsible use Familiarity with agentic system concepts — awareness of orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent), RAG pipelines, and how full-stack applications connect to agent-based architecture; production experience preferred, conceptual understanding required

items.card: Vos missions en tant qu’Ingénieur Digital Foundations en stage : Contribuer à la conception et à la modernisation d’architectures cloud, applicatives et AI-native, sur des environnements Azure, AWS ou GCP. Explorer et prototyper des solutions autour de l’Agentic AI et du Software Engineering : agents IA, Agentic SDLC, MCP, RAG, multi-agent systems, AI-assisted testing et CI/CD. Développer et automatiser des agents,
items.desc: Réinventer avec Accenture. Développez des compétences d’avenir, évoluez dans le conseil, la technologie et l’IA, aux côtés de nos experts, et agissez sur des projets concrets pour avoir un impact durable sur le monde qui nous entoure. Vos missions en tant qu’Ingénieur Digital Foundations en stage : Contribuer à la conception et à la modernisation d’architectures cloud, applicatives et AI-native, sur des environnements Azure, AWS ou GCP. Explorer et prototyper des solutions autour de l’Agentic AI et du Software Engineering : agents IA, Agentic SDLC, MCP, RAG, multi-agent systems, AI-assisted testing et CI/CD. Développer et automatiser des agents, APIs, workflows et composants de plateformes en utilisant notamment Python, Git, Infrastructure as Code et Kubernetes. Participer à la modernisation des systèmes existants : refactoring, APIs, événements, microservices, analyse du code et définition d’architectures cibles. Concevoir et industrialiser des solutions permettant d’exécuter, superviser et gouverner des agents IA à l’échelle, notamment via AgentOps, observabilité LLM, guardrails et evaluation frameworks. Collaborer avec les architectes, développeurs, cloud engineers et spécialistes IA pour analyser les systèmes d’information et définir des trajectoires de transformation technologique. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Développez votre première expertise du conseil et des métiers. Apprenez aux côtés de nos communautés d’experts en France et à l’international. Explorez l’IA en situation réelle et bénéficiez de formations dédiées. Evoluez dans un cadre de travail hybride et évolutif avec la possibilité de télétravailler selon votre projet et ajusté avec votre manager. Profitez des évènements internes : afterworks, coaching, engagement solidaire via la Fondation Accenture, vie associative et sportive. Votre profil: Vous êtes étudiant(e) en cursus Bac+5 d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'une université, idéalement avec une spécialisation en informatique, génie logiciel, cloud, systèmes distribués ou IA, et recherchez un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois ou une alternance. Vous aimez coder et comprendre comment fonctionnent les choses, mais vous souhaitez également prendre du recul sur l'architecture d'un système et les choix techniques qui le structurent. Vous avez de bonnes bases dans au moins un langage de programmation, idéalement Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go ou C#. Git, APIs, conteneurs, CI/CD ou un premier cloud comme Azure, AWS ou GCP ne vous sont pas totalement étrangers. Vous expérimentez avec les LLM et l'IA générative et avez envie d'aller plus loin que le simple prompting pour comprendre agents, outils, contexte, RAG, MCP, orchestration et évaluation. Vous êtes curieux(se), autonome, rigoureux(se), aimez apprendre et n'avez pas peur de tester une technologie que vous ne connaissez pas encore. Vous aimez autant construire un prototype que comprendre pourquoi il fonctionne, où il échoue et comment le rendre utilisable à l'échelle. Français et anglais courants. Vous n'avez évidemment pas besoin de maîtriser toutes ces technologies pour nous rejoindre. Nous cherchons avant tout des ingénieurs curieux, qui aiment construire, expérimenter et apprendre vite. Découvrez notre processus de recrutement Accenture, c'est une communauté de plus de 750 000 talents et une mission commune : réaliser la promesse technologique alliée à l’ingéniosité humaine. Dans un monde en perpétuel changement, nous accélérons la transformation des plus grandes entreprises, de la stratégie à la réalisation des projets, grâce à la technologie, la data et l’IA et nous créons de la valeur pour nos clients et pour nos collaborateurs grâce à notre expertise multi-sectorielle. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, ou de genre et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

items.title: STAGE - Ingenieur IA Qualite pour la creation et lorchestration de donnees scientifiques (F/H)
items.card: Vos missions Comment permettre à une intelligence artificielle de comprendre une demande scientifique, de construire un plan fiable, d’utiliser plusieurs applications et de vérifier ses actions avant de les exécuter ? Au sein de l’équipe Quality Assurance de BIOVIA , vous contribuerez à faire évoluer un prototype interne fondé sur l’ IA générative , les Large Language Models (LLM) et les agents IA . Ce prototype
items.desc: Vous intégrerez l’équipe QA de BIOVIA et collaborerez avec des profils variés : ingénieurs qualité, développeurs, architectes, Product Managers, équipes Industry et équipes techniques avant-vente. Ces interlocuteurs, situés en Europe, aux États-Unis et en Inde, vous aideront à identifier les cas d’usage, à confronter vos idées aux besoins réels et à évaluer le prototype sur des scénarios concrets. Vos missions Comment permettre à une intelligence artificielle de comprendre une demande scientifique, de construire un plan fiable, d’utiliser plusieurs applications et de vérifier ses actions avant de les exécuter ? Au sein de l’équipe Quality Assurance de BIOVIA , vous contribuerez à faire évoluer un prototype interne fondé sur l’ IA générative , les Large Language Models (LLM) et les agents IA . Ce prototype permet déjà de transformer des instructions en langage naturel en actions exécutées dans plusieurs applications scientifiques. Il aide nos équipes à créer plus rapidement des données complexes utilisées pour les tests logiciels et les démonstrations. Votre objectif sera de le rendre plus interactif, plus robuste et capable de traiter de nouveaux scénarios. Vous ne partirez pas d’une page blanche : le prototype, son architecture, ses outils et ses scénarios de test existent déjà. Le sujet sera néanmoins co-construit avec vous , en fonction de vos expérimentations, de vos propositions et des retours des utilisateurs. Ce stage s’adresse à une personne curieuse, qui apprécie les sujets ouverts, l’expérimentation et la recherche de solutions pragmatiques. Toutes les réponses ne sont pas définies à l’avance : vos analyses et vos choix techniques contribueront directement à l’évolution du projet. Vos Qualifications Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau BAC+5 en informatique, intelligence artificielle, Data Science, génie logiciel ou dans un domaine équivalent. Vous disposez : D’une bonne maîtrise de Python ; De bonnes bases en développement logiciel ; D’un intérêt marqué pour l’IA générative, les LLM et les agents IA ; D’une capacité à analyser et décomposer des problèmes complexes ; D’autonomie, de rigueur et de curiosité ; D’un très bon niveau d’anglais pour collaborer dans un environnement international. Une première expérience, académique ou personnelle, autour des LLM ou de l’IA générative sera appréciée, sans être obligatoire. Des connaissances en LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, RAG, APIs REST, Docker, SQL ou tests automatisés constitueront un plus. Il n’est pas attendu que vous maîtrisiez déjà l’ensemble de ces technologies. Aucune connaissance préalable de la chimie, de la pharmacie ou des applications BIOVIA n’est requise. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement collaboratif et innovant Collaboration internationale Diversité des technologies, produits et solutions Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

VOTRE PROFIL Vous préparez un Bac+5 / Master 2 en informatique, idéalement avec une spécialisation en intelligence artificielle, data ou développement logiciel ; Vous avez de bonnes bases en développement, notamment en Python, et appréciez transformer une idée en solution concrète ; Vous aimez explorer de nouvelles technologies, analyser des problématiques complexes et concevoir des solutions pragmatiques apportant une réelle valeur aux utilisateurs Vous avez idéalement déjà expérimenté certains outils ou frameworks liés à l’IA, par exemple LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face ou des API de modèles de langage ; Des connaissances en API, Git, bases de données ou environnements cloud seront appréciées ; Vous êtes curieux(se), autonome et orienté(e) solution : vous aimez expérimenter, tester, apprendre et résoudre des problématiques techniques ; Vous appréciez également le travail en équipe et êtes capable de partager simplement vos choix et vos résultats. QUELQUES RAISONS DE NOUS REJOINDRE Qualité de vie au travail : profitez d’un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle, d’une possibilité de télétravailler, ainsi que des dispositifs de santé et bien-être (ligne d'écoute, plateforme dédiée...). Environnement inclusif : rejoignez des réseaux engagés comme Women@Capgemini, Parents@Capgemini, OUTfront ou CapAbility, et évoluez dans un cadre certifié EDGE+ et reconnu par le Bloomberg Gender Equality Index. Happy Trainees : notre engagement envers les jeunes talents est reconnu dans le classement HappyTrainees, preuve que chez nous, les stagiaires et alternants ne viennent pas juste apprendre… ils viennent s’épanouir. Sogeti fait partie du groupe Capgemini et accompagne les organisations dans leur mise en oeuvre de l'innovation , en tant que partenaire local à l'échelle mondiale . En combinant son agilité et sa rapidité Sogeti propose des solutions innovantes en testing, cloud et développement d'applications , toutes pilotées par l'IA , les données et l'automatisation . items.desc: Deerdata is a Stockholm-based consulting firm helping companies succeed with data, analytics, and AI. Our AI practice is growing fast, and we take ideas from strategy through to real, live systems in production. We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join our AI & Agentic team. You’re a strong software engineer at your core, and you’ve shipped AI systems people actually use: agents with real tool access, retrieval and memory layers that hold up against messy customer data, and assistants that face end users without a human babysitting them. You know that a demo is easy and production is hard, and you enjoy closing that gap. What you’ll do Design and build customer-facing AI solutions, including agentic systems, GenAI applications, and voice/chat interfaces, from prototype to production Own the engineering craft: clean, testable code, sensible architecture, CI/CD, observability, cost and latency awareness Work directly with clients as a trusted technical partner, translating business problems into concrete AI solutions Support other engineers on the team, and help shape our internal engineering standards and reusable components Stay ahead of the frontier: evaluate new models, frameworks, and patterns, and bring the right ones into our work We’re looking for someone who has 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong grounding in Python and modern backend or full-stack development Hands-on experience building AI-powered products in production, ideally with LLMs, agent frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, ADK or similar), RAG, and vector and graph databases Comfort with at least one major cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and modern deployment practices (containers, IaC, CI/CD) A pragmatic mindset: you care about accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and maintainability, not just what looks good in a notebook Strong communication skills in English, and the confidence to work directly with client stakeholders. Swedish is good to have, and might be required at some of our customer projects Nice to have Experience with real-time voice AI Background in data engineering or MLOps (dbt, Airflow/Dagster, MLflow, evaluation pipelines) Open-source contributions, technical writing, or speaking at conferences Experience in a consulting or client-facing setting What we offer A seat in a small, sharp team where you’ll build real systems for real users, not slideware Hybrid way of working 30 days of vacation, occupational pension, and wellness allowance Curious, kind colleagues who like to roll up their sleeves and co-create

items.desc:
Join our Team
 About this opportunity: 
 Are you passionate about driving innovation and working on groundbreaking 5G and 6G mobile communication solutions? Do you thrive in a flexible working culture, where new insights are championed, and you are encouraged to develop new skills? Then join Ericsson and our team in Stockholm.
 We are looking for a Senior FPGA Developer within Ericsson Silicon organization. You will work with dedicated engineers passionate about developing world-class Radio and RAN compute products. You will play a key role in FPGA team - developing and integrating high-performance FPGA solutions.
 What you will do 
 Design and implement FPGA-based Radio and RAN Compute solutions. 
 Develop and optimize FPGA designs for performance, power, and cost efficiency. 
 Take technical leadership responsibility for FPGA top-level design, including design planning, technical decisions, integration, and coordination of development activities. 
 Guide FPGA developers, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the team. 
 Drive technical alignment across FPGA, hardware, software, verification, and system teams
 Collaborate with hardware and software engineers to integrate FPGA solutions into larger systems. 
 Perform FPGA verification, testing, troubleshooting, and debugging to ensure functionality and reliability. 
 Apply industry-standard tools, methodologies, and quality practices for FPGA development and implementation. 
 Research and stay current with advancements in FPGA technology and relevant academic and industry trends in AI and machine learning. 
 Document design specifications, technical decisions, test procedures, and results for future reference. 
 Participate in design reviews and contribute innovative ideas to improve FPGA solutions. 
 The skills you bring: 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or equivalent experience, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
 8+ years of experience in FPGA development, with demonstrated experience in technical leadership, design coordination, or leading complex FPGA development activities. 
 Strong technical leadership skills with the ability to make design decisions, manage dependencies, and align teams.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to mentor colleagues and contribute to the technical development of the team. 
 Solid knowledge of FPGA technology, design environments, development flows, and design methodologies. 
 Expertise in FPGA design tools such as Vivado, Quartus, or equivalent tools. 
 Solid command of hardware description languages, including Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL. 
 Good knowledge of UVM methodology and modern verification techniques. 
 Familiarity with modern FPGA device families, implementation tools, and RTL simulation. 
 Experience with communication protocols and interfaces such as DDRx, AXI4, PCIe, Ethernet, SPI, I2C, and embedded processing. 
 Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Tcl, or shell scripting. 
 Familiarity with radio base station hardware architecture and digital signal processing. 
 Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 A track record of successful cross-team and cross-site collaboration.

Design data models, dashboards and reports that present AI outputs clearly to project teams and decision-makers. Apply security, data protection and responsible AI practices, including defences against prompt injection, data residency controls and human-in-the-loop review, ensuring alignment with AECOM's global standards. Turn successful solutions into reusable, configurable components that can be deployed for multiple clients with minimal rework. Document work through specifications, implementation plans and post-delivery reviews, capturing evidence of the value delivered. Support bids and proposals by shaping AI solutions to client requirements, writing technical responses, estimating effort and running cost, and preparing demonstrations for client presentations and interviews.  ingenieurwissenschaftlicher Hintergrund von Vorteil

items.desc: Keep our global cloud platform reliable, scalable, and resilient. Do you enjoy solving complex production challenges before they turn into incidents? Are you the kind of engineer who automates repetitive tasks, improves reliability through engineering, and believes that every outage is an opportunity to build a better system? And are you an experienced, hands-on engineer who wants to stay close to the technology rather than move into people management? We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the Global Platform Team at Vertage. In this role, you'll help build and operate the cloud platform that powers our global Workforce-as-a-Service (WaaS) ecosystem. You'll work alongside Cloud Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Engineers, and AI specialists to improve platform resilience, reduce operational overhead, and ensure that our Azure-based engineering environment remains reliable, scalable, and resilient. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, with no people management responsibilities. Your impact As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, your focus is to keep our platforms healthy, reliable, and easy to operate while continuously improving how we build, run and recover production systems. You'll help build the engineering foundations behind our Headless Data Architecture (HDA), which runs on Azure and Databricks, as well as the Custom Apps Infrastructure (CA) that powers integrations, internal applications, and operational workflows across our international organization. Instead of spending your days reacting to incidents, you'll focus on preventing them through automation, observability, and reliability engineering. You'll reduce operational burden, improve platform resilience, and build systems that scale, recover automatically whenever possible, and provide engineering teams across Cloud, Data, and AI with the visibility they need to run production workloads with confidence. What you will do Improve the reliability, availability, and performance of our Azure platform and production environments. Build and improve monitoring, logging, and alerting using Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics. Automate operational tasks and eliminate repetitive manual work using Infrastructure as Code and scripting. Design self-healing capabilities and automated remediation to reduce incidents and improve recovery times. Investigate production incidents, perform root cause analyses, and implement long-term improvements. Define, measure, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Optimize platform performance, scalability, and operational efficiency. Work closely with Cloud Engineers to improve platform design, resilience, security, and operational reliability. Support Data and AI teams by improving the reliability of Azure Databricks environments. Help shape and raise engineering standards around observability, automation, and operational excellence. Continuously look for opportunities to reduce operational complexity and improve developer productivity. Act as a technical point of reference for reliability engineering, helping shape technical decisions while remaining hands-on in the technology. About the role As part of the Global Platform Team, you'll work alongside engineers in Cloud, Data, and AI to improve the reliability of our Azure-based platform. Using technologies such as Kubernetes, Terraform, Databricks, GitHub Actions, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry, you'll help ensure that our global Workforce-as-a-Service ecosystem remains reliable, scalable, and resilient. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will have significant technical ownership and will be expected to get into the detail when needed, from troubleshooting complex production issues to improving automation, observability and system reliability. You will act as a technical reference point for others, but you will not have people management responsibilities. About Vertage Vertage is one of Europe's leading providers of workforce and talent solutions. Operating across multiple countries, we are transforming into a cloud-native, AI-powered organization that connects people, technology, and data through a modern digital platform. The Global Platform Team is at the heart of that transformation, enabling engineering teams across Cloud, Data, AI, and Software Engineering to build and operate scalable solutions for the future. You're passionate about building reliable systems and solving operational challenges through engineering rather than manual intervention. You enjoy understanding how distributed systems behave, thrive in cloud-native environments, and are always looking for ways to improve automation, resilience, and observability. You stay calm under pressure, take ownership of problems, and enjoy collaborating with others to continuously improve the platform's reliability. You have significant experience operating production systems and still enjoy getting …

items.desc: Meet the Team The Forward Engineering team is part of Cisco’s Customer Experience Business Unit, focused on driving AI adoption for strategic customers across Cisco’s contact-center portfolio, including Webex Contact Center, Webex Contact Center Enterprise, and on-premises solutions. We bring together customer interactions, human and AI agents, workflows, and enterprise systems to improve customer experience and business performance. You’ll work alongside customers, Cisco’s partner ecosystem, account teams, product managers, and engineers in a collaborative, hands-on environment. Our work connects customer priorities with technical delivery and product development, turning successful deployments into reusable approaches and enabling partners to scale their impact. Join us to help shape how leading organizations bring AI into their contact-center operations. Your Impact Drive AI adoption for strategic customers across Cisco’s contact-center portfolio, working with Cisco’s partner ecosystem to guide engagements from discovery and solution design through production deployment and measurable business outcomes. Identify and prioritize AI use cases with customers and partners by assessing customer journeys, contact-center operations, existing systems, and business objectives. Build and deploy AI solutions and production integrations using Cisco AI capabilities, APIs, and enterprise platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow. Lead pilots and adoption programs while enabling partners through hands-on collaboration, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing to deliver and scale successful solutions. Translate customer needs and deployment findings into actionable product feedback, reusable architectures, and implementation playbooks that accelerate adoption across customers and partners. Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of experience developing software or delivering enterprise technology solutions, including hands-on implementation. Experience programming in Python, Node.js, or a comparable language. Experience building integrations using APIs, webhooks, and enterprise systems. Experience delivering technical solutions for enterprise customers or stakeholders, from requirements gathering through production deployment. Experience building or integrating an AI application using an LLM platform, conversational AI framework, or AI service. Preferred Qualifications Experience with contact-center platforms, CCaaS, CPaaS, CRM, IVR, or call-routing environments. Familiarity with Webex Contact Center, Webex Contact Center Enterprise, or Cisco on-premises contact-center solutions. Experience with conversational AI, voice agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or real-time analytics, including evaluating quality, cost, latency, and reliability. Experience defining success measures, evaluating pilot results, and supporting adoption of AI solutions in enterprise operations. Strong consultative and communication skills, including experience collaborating with partners, providing technical enablement, and translating business needs into technical solutions. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

items.card: About The Role The Esko AI team is a group of specialists focused on leveraging AI to solve valuable and often challenging customer problems that have historically resisted automation via purely rule-based approaches. To succeed in the complex domain of packaging graphics, AI agents must operate reliably according to regulatory requirements, technical specifications, brand guidelines, customer-specific conventions -
items.desc: Location: Prague (Hybrid); Czech Republic (Remote); UK (Remote); Ghent (Hybrid), Poland (Remote), Hungary (Remote), Romania (Remote) Function: Software Engineering Reports to: Manager, Esko AI About The Role The Esko AI team is a group of specialists focused on leveraging AI to solve valuable and often challenging customer problems that have historically resisted automation via purely rule-based approaches. To succeed in the complex domain of packaging graphics, AI agents must operate reliably according to regulatory requirements, technical specifications, brand guidelines, customer-specific conventions - and invoke expert human judgement when required. This is a complex engineering problem that goes beyond the boundaries of standard agentic scenarios. We're looking for a Technical Expert to take technical ownership of core agentic capabilities within Esko’s AI Platform, from experimentation and design through production implementation.be a senior authority and author on agentic AI across Esko's AI Platform. This is a hands-on technical role, not a management one: you'll set direction and raise the bar through writing code, leading experiments, writing documentation, and mentorship of team members for a platform that spans multiple agentic capabilities (knowledge & reasoning, tool use and orchestration, evaluation, and safety/guardrails) and which is used by many product teams across the business. You should bring experience from multiple agentic AI projects with a similar order of complexity in terms of the technical challenges you have successfully tackled, together with a ‘sixth sense’ for agentic AI operation to predict the approaches which are likely yield successful results as the platform grows into new domains. What You Will Do Go deep on the hardest technical problems inside the agentic AI platform - the ones where progress depends on specialist expertise, not just engineering effort: data discovery & consolidation, agent planning and tool-use, retrieval and grounding, validation-before-action, conflict/ambiguity handling, and similar hard sub-problems. Personally design, build, and harden the platform's most technically demanding components - the pieces where correctness, edge cases, and failure modes are subtle enough to need deep, hands-on ownership rather than delegation. Act as the team's go-to technical expert on agentic AI and LLM systems: the person others bring their hardest "how do we actually make this work" problems to, providing depth on specific technical questions rather than setting overall team direction. Diagnose and resolve the platform's toughest technical issues - performance, reliability, correctness, and edge-case failures - where specialist knowledge is the difference between a real fix and a workaround. Contribute into architecture discussions, stress-testing designs against hard technical realities (scaling limits, failure modes, subtle correctness issues) that come from real specialist experience. Evaluate emerging techniques, frameworks, and tools in agentic AI and LLM tooling, and give the team pragmatic, evidence-based recommendations on what's worth adopting. Write technical deep-dives and documentation that make complex mechanisms legible to the rest of the team, so your expertise compounds rather than staying tacit. What We Are Looking For Strong software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language. 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial time as a senior/staff/principal-level individual contributor architecting and operating production agentic AI systems involving multi-step reasoning, tool use, planning, or orchestration, where alignment and dependability of the agent’s output is a key success factor. Experience across multiple distinct agentic AI projects, able to draw on that breadth to guide technical decisions in unfamiliar contexts. Deep, hands-on expertise in: LLM agent frameworks and orchestration, tool-calling and validation-before-action patterns, RAG and retrieval architecture, evaluation and observability for AI systems. A track record of setting technical direction and shaping outcomes across teams without formal management authority. Sound engineering judgement on production concerns at platform scale: reliability, security, multi-tenancy, performance, and observability for services consumed by many internal teams. Excellent technical communication - able to write RFCs and architectural documents that align diverse stakeholders, and to move fluently between deeply technical and business audiences. Comfort operating with significant ambiguity and autonomy, including defining the right problem as much as solving it. Undergraduate, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Preferred Experience Public technical-leadership signals: conference …

items.card: The Role You will own the full lifecycle of Roche's digital analytics and GenAI applications, from identifying user problems through discovery, prototyping, launch, and continuous improvement. You are the accountable product leader: you decide what gets built, why, and in what order, and you are responsible for whether the product gets used and creates value for commercial teams. What You Will Do Discover: Identify
items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 The Role
You will own the full lifecycle of Roche's digital analytics and GenAI applications, from identifying user problems through discovery, prototyping, launch, and continuous improvement. You are the accountable product leader: you decide what gets built, why, and in what order, and you are responsible for whether the product gets used and creates value for commercial teams.
 What You Will Do
 Discover: Identify the business problems to be solved with Commercial stakeholders and turn them into clear problem statements and opportunity areas.
 Define and prioritize: Own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for your apps. Make trade-off decisions between features, technical debt, and new AI capabilities.
 Build with your squad: Work daily with engineers, data scientists, ML and GenAI engineers, and UX/UI designers as a hands-on decision partner. Shape solution design, including how LLMs, RAG, and agentic features are used in the user experience.
 Ship and iterate: Manage releases, test with users, and improve the product in short cycles. Own the production roadmap for the app.
 Measure and grow: Define product metrics (adoption, retention, task completion, time saved) and use them to guide decisions. Report results to business leaders.
 Drive adoption: Build onboarding, in-app guidance, training materials, and feedback channels so users adopt the product and keep using it.
 Partner on governance: Work with data platform, IT, security, and compliance teams to ensure the product meets security, privacy, and regulatory requirements. You own the decisions, and these teams advise on constraints.
 Stay current: Track emerging AI tools and patterns and bring practical ones into the product. Have a clear Build / Buy strategy with the current emerging capabilities 
 What You Bring
 8+ years of experience building digital products, with at least 3 years as the accountable owner of a live application used by real users.
 Proven end-to-end product ownership: you have taken ideas from concept through to launch and ongoing operation.
 Working knowledge of how software is built and delivered (web or mobile apps, APIs, cloud, agile delivery). You can have credible technical conversations without needing to write code.
 Experience using data and analytics to make product decisions, including product analytics tools and A/B testing.
 Hands-on understanding of AI and GenAI capabilities (LLMs, prompt design, RAG, semantic search) and their practical limits.
 Track record of user-centered design and research.
 Strong communication skills for both engineers and executives.
 Advanced degree in a quantitative, technical, or product field, or equivalent experience.
 Nice to Have
 Experience in pharma, biotech, or healthcare, especially commercial data (syndicated sales, marketing metrics, RWE, payer data).
 Experience designing adoption programs for complex, matrixed organizations.
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Company description: 
 Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide. 
 Our people work with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place. Taking pride in our work, we draw on each other's expertise and experience to achieve excellence. Our diversity and teamwork culture propel us to accomplish the extraordinary - on the ground, in the sky and in space. 
 Founded in 2021, the Airbus Global Business Services (AGBS) unit will be contributing to Airbus’ global success and play a vital role in Airbus’ transformation journey in standardisation, harmonisation, digitalisation and automation of end-to-end processes (e.g.Procure to Pay) of all overhead functions. Our target is that siloed ways of working / processes will be a relic of the past within the AGBS. To drive such culture change we are looking for candidates with pioneering spirit that make data-driven decisions and take responsibility for the best outcome of their internal customers. All while embracing a spirit of problem-solving and living the Airbus values: Customer focus, integrity, respect, creativity, reliability and teamwork. 
 Our purpose defines why we exist: ‘We pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world’. 
 Responsibilities - your mission 
 SAP Platform lifecycle management with our ESP 
 SAP Platform monitoring 
 Performance analysis (resources, load balancing, Hints, Archiving, etc…) 
 Security guideline deployment (SSO, parameters, SAP note, sFTP, encryption, etc…) 
 Incident management, root cause analysis and associated improvement plan management 
 System refresh and upgrade management (SPAU/SPDD, BlueCopy, etc…) 
 Transports and project support (ChaRM, OSS call, ALE, Workflow, dumps, Interfaces, job scheduling, etc…) 
 Requirements - our ideal candidate will have: 
 Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Basis and NetWeaver system administration. 
 Coordination: Proven experience coordinating external Managed Service Providers, tracking SLA/KPI compliance, validating technical change requests, and orchestrating complex maintenance windows, project cutovers, and incident escalations across cross-functional teams. 
 Database & Core Systems: Advanced administration of SAP HANA (performance tuning, backup/recovery, memory management, and HANA System Replication / HSR). 
 Deep technical knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and legacy SAP ECC 6.0 landscapes. 
 System Lifecycle & Maintenance: Coordinate upgrades, kernel patches and Support Package stacks.

items.desc: Full time Hamburg eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future. We are looking for a Senior QPU Integration Engineer (Micro-fabrication focused). You will be a lead technical expert in our QPU Development team, driving the physical integration, yield optimization, and technology transfer of next-generation quantum processor architectures. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the primary bridge between chip design teams and fabrication engineers. You will own both front-end-of-line (FEOL) and back-end-of-line (BEOL) fabrication modules, leading R&D activities within our internal cleanroom facility while managing strategic development projects with external foundry partners. Responsibilities: Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for critical FEOL/BEOL fabrication modules (e.g., advanced lithography, thin-film deposition, metal/dielectric stack etch, dielectric isolation, surface passivation, and interconnects). Lead end-to-end integration flows, evaluating and optimizing process interactions across multi-layer QPU stack architectures. Collaborate closely with QPU designers, device physics teams, and packaging specialists to translate architectural requirements into manufacturable Design Rules (DRC) and process design kits (PDKs). Feed cleanroom metrology, yield data, and failure analysis insights directly back into design and layout iterations. Take the lead in managing daily internal cleanroom fabrication activities, schedule runs, set process baselines, and resolve real-time process deviations. Oversee internal R&D projects to develop, qualify, and integrate novel materials, geometries, and process steps for next-gen QPU platforms. Drive technology development and project management with external commercial foundry partners and research institutes. Lead process transfer, yield matching, and contract negotiation for out-of-house fabrication and prototyping runs. Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical integration failures, lot losses, or performance degradation. Define and maintain Statistical Process Control (SPC) guidelines, process windows, and target specifications across internal and external fabrication runs. Mentor junior fabrication engineers and technicians on advanced processing techniques, cleanroom protocols, and experimental design (DOE). Author comprehensive process specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and technical roadmaps for executive and cross-functional review. Required Skills: Master’s or Ph.D. in Microelectronics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Applied Physics, Nanotechnology, or a related field. 5+ years (or equivalent extensive industry experience) of hands-on semiconductor or quantum hardware integration experience in a professional cleanroom environment (Class 10 / 100 / ISO 4–5). Deep technical expertise in both Front-End (FEOL) and Back-End (BEOL) module development (e.g., e-beam/optical lithography, PVD/ALD thin films, reactive ion etching (RIE/DRIE), planarization, lift-off processes, and flip-chip/interconnect technologies). Proven track record of taking complex solid-state micro/nano devices from initial R&D concept to stable, repeatable integration flows. Demonstrated experience in managing joint development projects (JDPs) or technology transfers with commercial external foundries or external fabrication partners. Strong project management capabilities, including timeline tracking, deliverable management, and milestone execution. Solid understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC), Design of Experiments (DOE), PFMEA, and structured RCA techniques (e.g., 8D, Fishbone). Proficiency with layout and data tools (e.g., KLayout, Cadence, Python/MATLAB for yield and parametric analysis). Fluent in English (written and spoken) with excellent technical writing and presentation skills. We value (Bonus): Experience in quantum hardware integration (e.g., superconducting circuits, trapped-ion traps, spin qubits, or photonic chips). Experience developing novel low-loss dielectric materials, superconducting interconnects, or 3D integration / TSV technologies. Proven experience establishing a cleanroom process baseline or setting up new-process lines/tools from scratch. Background in managing foundry contracts, IP considerations, and wafer delivery schedules. Et si vous étiez au cœur de la prochaine vague de transformation des entreprises ? L'IA agentique ne manque ni d'outils ni d'ambition. Ce qu'il manque, ce sont des profils capables de transformer l'expérimentation en résultat opérationnel : d'identifier la valeur, de construire les agents, de piloter l'adoption et de mesurer l'impact, bref d’appliquer une approche produit aux agents C'est exactement ce que fait un Product Builder IA chez Niji. Vous êtes le pivot entre les enjeux métiers de nos clients et l'expertise technique de nos équipes. Vous cadrez, prototypez et déployez des agents IA qui transforment concrètement des processus : de la souscription bancaire à la gestion RH, du marketing à l'avant-vente. items.desc: Vos missions Notre Vision Est De Placer L'innovation Au Cœur Des Stratégies D'entreprise Grâce à La Data Ingénierie Et à L'IA Générative. En Rejoignant Notre Équipe En Tant Que Stagiaire, Vous Contribuerez à La Réalisation D’un Projet De R&D Porté Par Le Lab De Capgemini Invent, Et Participerez à Des Missions De Conseil En Data Engineering Ainsi Qu’en GenAI / Agentic Engineering Pour Des Clients De Capgemini Invent. Votre Rôle Consistera à Agir Sur Tout Ou Partie De La Chaîne De Valeur De L’ingénierie De La Donnée Et De L'IA, De La Plateforme Data Jusqu'à La Mise En Production De Systèmes à Base De LLM Et D'agents Création de Data Pipeline : construire des solutions à l’état de l’art pour la collecte, l'organisation et la modélisation des données, répondant aux exigences de forte volumétrie, et faciliter leur utilisation optimale par les analystes et data scientists, ainsi que l'alimentation des cas d'usage d'IA générative : ingestion et parsing documentaire, chunking, génération d'embeddings et indexation dans des bases vectorielles ; Déploiement Infrastructure DevOps et LLMOps : déploiement grâce à des outils d’infrastructure-as-code et d’intégration et de déploiement continu d’infrastructures complexes sur cloud provider ou on premise. Déploiement de stacks data et IA incluant notamment des stockages de données brutes / structurées, ainsi que les briques de serving de modèles, de passerelle LLM et d'orchestration d'agents. GenAI & Agentic Engineering : conception et industrialisation d'applications reposant sur des LLM, architectures RAG et RAG avancé, orchestration d'agents et de systèmes multi-agents (LangGraph), outillage des agents, gestion du contexte et de la mémoire, sélection et comparaison des modèles selon les contraintes de coût, de latence et de souveraineté ; Évaluation, observabilité et fiabilité des systèmes d'IA : construction de jeux d'évaluation et de métriques (pertinence, hallucinations, coût, latence), mise en place du tracing et du monitoring en production, et implémentation des garde-fous nécessaires à un usage industriel (sécurité, confidentialité, conformité AI Act) ; Développement Back-End et Exposition de modèles IA : conception, développement et containerisation d’applications back-end en REST API embarquant de la data, de l'IA ou des agents LLM pour exposition en production à des utilisateurs finaux ou d’autres services applicatifs. Architecture Data & IA : Conception et design de la stack d’architecture data et IA complète, mettant en avant et répondant aux problématiques de sécurité, scalabilité, auditabilité et disponibilité des données et systèmes applicatifs joints, y compris l'intégration des composants GenAI (passerelle LLM, RAG, agents) dans le SI existant du client. Activité de veille technologique : Innover et partager des compétences technologiques : participer activement à la veille technologique pour rester à la pointe des dernières tendances et technologies, en particulier sur l'écosystème GenAI et agentique dont les cycles d'innovation sont très courts, afin d'améliorer continuellement nos pratiques et offrir des solutions avant-gardistes à nos clients. Votre profil Prérequis En dernière année d’étude en école d’ingénieur ou d'un master (bac+5) en informatique, en sciences des données ou en intelligence artificielle Connaissances théoriques solides en processing de données, stockage de données (base de données, Data Lake, Data Warehouse) et transport de donnée (batch et streaming) Capacité à développer en Python et délivrer un code propre et documenté, testable et maintenable Premières connaissances des LLM et de la GenAI : prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG et notions d'orchestration d'agents, acquises en projet académique, personnel ou en stage Bilingue anglais/français, mobile, curieux, et adaptable Enthousiaste à l’idée d’évoluer dans un milieu stimulant, avec un fort esprit d'équipe, et des compétences analytiques. Esprit critique face aux résultats produits par un modèle et goût pour l'expérimentation rigoureuse. Quelques raisons de nous rejoindre Avantages groupe : bénéficiez d’un ensemble d’avantages tels que les primes de cooptation, tickets restaurant, ainsi que des activités sociales et culturelles variées proposées par le CSE. Des dispositifs d’accompagnement à la parentalité, comme le temps partiel à 90% pendant les vacances scolaires, sont également disponibles, ainsi que de nombreux autres avantages issus de nos accords collectifs. Communauté d’experts : intégrez le réseau international de consultants de Capgemini Invent. Apprentissage continu : bénéficiez d’un accompagnement de proximité via The Institute, et de nos formations ciblées avec des ateliers comme le Consulting Skills Workshop. Vous participez aussi à InventX, un événement mondial de formation organisé à Paris. items.desc: DESCRIPTION General Job Function: The role is for a highly skilled and innovative Full-Stack Senior AI Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of designing, building, and scaling advanced Enterprise AI solutions within a robust SaaS architecture. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between traditional full-stack software development and cutting-edge artificial intelligence. You will leverage your expertise in modern front-end frameworks, robust back-end engineering, cloud infrastructure, and state-of-the-art AI—including Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and vectorization. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and data teams to deliver end-to-end; high-impact intelligent, secure, and compliant systems deployed across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Duties and Responsibilities (by order of priority): Design, develop, implement, support, and maintain applications based on business requirements, using approved technologies and coding standards. Design, develop, implement, support, and maintain software components and systems to adhere to and satisfy engineering, scientific, regulatory, and manufacturing requirements. Design and develop Agentic AI applications that automate multi-step workflows and solve real-world operational challenges (e.g., systems that interpret context, plan actions, call tools/services, and complete tasks end-to-end). Apply secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities in code and contribute to enterprise standards that enable safe, scalable Agentic AI adoption. Integrate LLMs into SaaS applications via secure, robust service layers and APIs, including orchestration, evaluation, and implement modern GenAI patterns such as RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Design and implement scalable backend services in Python and REST APIs that support AI/agent capabilities and product workflows. Partner with UX/design and product stakeholders to deliver intuitive AI/agent user experiences for enterprise users. Build, deploy, and operate cloud-native services in Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data quality, governance alignment, and performance for AI/agent use cases. Containerize services using Docker and support CI/CD pipelines for reliable delivery. Provide technical leadership as a senior individual contributor driving architecture, code quality, engineering best practices, and mentor team members. Desired Background: Demonstrated professional software engineering experience building SaaS applications with scalable backend services and modern frontends. items.desc: About the Role We're looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer who can bridge the gap between advanced AI engineering and real-world business problems. You'll work directly with clients to design, build, and deploy agentic AI platforms that integrate into their existing systems and workflows. This isn't a role where you'll just build prototypes and hand them off. You'll own technical delivery, work closely with end users, and turn complex requirements into production-ready solutions. We need someone who understands how to build sophisticated AI systems, navigate enterprise environments, and deliver measurable outcomes . What You'll Be Doing Design and build agentic AI platforms using Python and modern AI frameworks. Architect LLM orchestration systems using LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and related technologies. Develop multi-agent systems with tool use, workflow orchestration, memory, and decision-making capabilities. Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines connected to enterprise data sources. Integrate AI platforms with client APIs, data platforms, cloud services, and enterprise applications. Configure Kubernetes environments and deploy production workloads. Design deployment architectures across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments. Work directly with clients and end users to understand requirements, solve technical challenges, and iterate on solutions. Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders throughout client engagements. Take ownership of complex consulting engagements, from technical planning through execution and delivery. What We're Looking For 3+ years of commercial software engineering experience, with a proven track record of delivering at Senior Engineer level. Strong hands-on experience with Python and modern AI development frameworks. Experience designing and building agentic platforms and LLM-powered applications. Deep understanding of LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen. Experience implementing multi-agent architectures, including tool calling, memory, and workflow management. Hands-on experience building and deploying RAG pipelines using enterprise data. Experience integrating complex systems through APIs, cloud services, and enterprise platforms. Practical knowledge of Kubernetes configuration and workload deployment. Experience designing cloud, on-premise, and hybrid deployment architectures. Strong consulting and client-facing experience, with the ability to translate business problems into technical solutions. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable working in fast-moving environments where requirements evolve and solutions are refined through direct user feedback. ﻿Why TEN-XER? At TEN-XER, we believe great work starts with great people. We're focused on connecting exceptional talent with opportunities where they can make a meaningful impact. If you're someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems, working closely with clients, and taking AI systems from architecture to production, we'd like to hear from you. Interested? Apply now and let's talk.
